Thabit ne humaare liye ijaazat maangi aur hum daakhil hue, aur unhone Thabit ko apne saath apne palang par bithaaya. Unhone unse kaha: Aye Abu Hamza, aapke Basra ke rehne wale bhaai chaahte hain ki aap unhein shafaa'at ki hadees sunaayein. Unhone kaha: Muhammad (SAW) ne humein bataaya: Jab Qayamat ka Din hoga, to kuch log ghabraahat mein ek doosre ke paas daudenge. Wo Aadam ke paas aayenge aur kahenge: Apne Rab se apni aulaad ke liye shafaa'at karo. Wo kahenge: Main ye karne ke laayak nahi hoon, lekin Ibrahim (AS) ke paas jao, kyunki wo Allah ke Dost hain. Wo Ibrahim ke paas aayenge, lekin wo kahenge: Main ye karne ke laayak nahi hoon, lekin Musa ke paas jao, kyunki wo Allah ke Hum-Kalaam hain. Wo Musa ke paas aayenge, lekin wo kahenge: Main ye karne ke laayak nahi hoon, lekin tumhein Isa ke paas jaana chahiye, kyunki wo Allah ki Rooh aur Uska Kalima hain. Wo Isa ke paas aayenge, aur wo kahenge: Main ye karne ke laayak nahi hoon; behtar hoga tum Muhammad (SAW) ke paas jao. Wo mere paas aayenge, aur main kahunga: Main ye karne ke laayak hoon. Main jaaunga aur apne Rab se ijaazat maangunga aur mujhe di jaayegi. Phir main Uske saamne khada hounga aur Uski aisi tareef karunga jo main abhi nahi kar sakta, lekin jismein Allah mujhe ilhaam dega, phir main sajde mein gir jaaunga aur mujhse kaha jaayega: Aye Muhammad, apna sar uthaao, aur kaho aur suna jaayega; maango aur tumhein diya jaayega; shafaa'at karo aur qubool ki jaayegi. Main kahunga: Mere Rab, meri ummat, meri ummat. Kaha jaayega: Jao, aur usmein se us shaks ko nikaalo jiske dil mein gehun ya jau ke daane barabar imaan hai. Main jaaunga aur aisa karunga; phir main apne Rab ke paas wapas jaaunga aur Uski un tareefon ke saath tareef karunga, phir main sajde mein gir jaaunga. Mujhse kaha jaayega: Aye Muhammad, apna sar uthaao, aur kaho aur suna jaayega; maango aur tumhein diya jaayega; shafaa'at karo aur shafaa'at qubool ki jaayegi. Is liye main kahunga: Meri ummat, meri ummat. Mujhse kaha jaayega: Jao, aur usmein se us shaks ko nikaalo jiske dil mein sarson ke daane barabar imaan hai. Main jaaunga aur aisa karunga. Main dobara apne Rab ke paas wapas jaaunga aur Uski un tareefon ke saath tareef karunga. Phir main sajde mein gir jaaunga. Mujhse kaha jaayega: Aye Muhammad, apna sar uthaao: kaho, aur tumhaari baat suni jaayegi; maango, aur tumhein diya jaayega; shafaa'at karo, aur shafaa'at qubool ki jaayegi. Main kahunga: Mere Rab, meri ummat, meri ummat. Mujhse kaha jaayega: Jao, aur Aag mein se us shaks ko nikaalo jiske dil mein sarson ke daane se bhi choti, choti, choti maqdaar mein imaan hai. Main jaaunga aur aisa karunga.

Ye wo hadees hai jo Anas ne humein bayan ki. Hum unke ghar se nikle aur jab hum Jabban ke oopari hisse tak pahunche, to humne kaha: Kaash hum Hasan se milte aur unhein salaam karte, aur wo Abu Khalifa ke ghar mein chhupe hue the. Unhone kaha: Hum unke paas gaye aur unhein salaam kiya aur humne kaha: Aye Abu Sa'id, hum aapke bhai Abu Hamza ke paas se aa rahe hain, aur humne shafaa'at ke baare mein kabhi is jaisi hadees nahi suni jo unhone humein sunaayi. Unhone kaha: Ise sunaao, humne hadees sunaayi. Unhone kaha: Aur sunaao. Humne kaha: Unhone humaare saamne isse zyada kuch nahi kaha. Unhone kaha: Unhone ise humein bees saal pehle sunaaya tha, jab wo mazboot aur tandurust the. Unhone haqeeqat mein kuch chhod diya hai. Main tay nahi kar sakta ki kya budhe shaks bhool gaye hain ya unhone jaan-boojh kar tumhein ye batana taala hai iske khauf se ki tum is par poori tarah bharosa kar loge aur nek amal karna chhod doge. Humne unse kaha: Ye humein bataiye, aur wo hanse aur kaha: Insaan ki fitrat mein jaldbaazi hoti hai. Maine ye tumhein is liye zikr nahi kiya sivaay iske ki main tumhein ye bataana chaahta tha aur izafa kiya ki Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Phir main apne Rab ke paas chauthi baar wapas jaaunga aur in tareefon ke saath Uski tareef karunga. Phir main sajde mein gir jaaunga. Mujhse kaha jaayega: Aye Muhammad, apna sar uthaao: kaho aur suna jaayega; maango aur diya jaayega; shafaa'at karo aur qubool ki jaayegi. Main kahunga: Aye mere Rab, mujhe us shaks ke baare mein ijaazat dijiye jisne 'Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi' ka elaan kiya. Wo kahega: Ye tumhaare liye nahi hai, ya ye wo nahi hai jo tumhaare paas hai, lekin Meri Izzat, Shaan, Azmat aur Qudrat ki qasam, Main zaroor us shaks ko nikaal loonga jisne iska elaan kiya: 'Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi'. Unhone kaha: Main is baat ki gawahi deta hoon ki Hasan ne humein jo hadees sunaayi wo unhone Anas bin Malik se suni thi aur main dekh sakta hoon ki unhone ise bees saal pehle bayan kiya tha, jab wo hattaa-kattaa the.

1.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، - وَاتَّفَقَا فِي سِيَاقِ الْحَدِيثِ إِلاَّ مَا يَزِيدُ أَحَدُهُمَا مِنَ الْحَرْفِ بَعْدَ الْحَرْفِ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَيَّانَ عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ أُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمًا بِلَحْمٍ فَرُفِعَ إِلَيْهِ الذِّرَاعُ وَكَانَتْ تُعْجِبُهُ فَنَهَسَ مِنْهَا نَهْسَةً فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ أَنَا سَيِّدُ النَّاسِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَهَلْ تَدْرُونَ بِمَ ذَاكَ يَجْمَعُ اللَّهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ الأَوَّلِينَ وَالآخِرِينَ فِي صَعِيدٍ وَاحِدٍ فَيُسْمِعُهُمُ الدَّاعِي وَيَنْفُذُهُمُ الْبَصَرُ وَتَدْنُو الشَّمْسُ فَيَبْلُغُ النَّاسَ مِنَ الْغَمِّ وَالْكَرْبِ مَا لاَ يُطِيقُونَ وَمَا لاَ يَحْتَمِلُونَ فَيَقُولُ بَعْضُ النَّاسِ لِبَعْضٍ أَلاَ تَرَوْنَ مَا أَنْتُمْ فِيهِ أَلاَ تَرَوْنَ مَا قَدْ بَلَغَكُمْ أَلاَ تَنْظُرُونَ مَنْ يَشْفَعُ لَكُمْ إِلَى رَبِّكُمْ فَيَقُولُ بَعْضُ النَّاسِ لِبَعْضٍ ائْتُوا آدَمَ ‏.‏ فَيَأْتُونَ آدَمَ فَيَقُولُونَ يَا آدَمُ أَنْتَ أَبُو الْبَشَرِ خَلَقَكَ اللَّهُ بِيَدِهِ وَنَفَخَ فِيكَ مِنْ رُوحِهِ وَأَمَرَ الْمَلاَئِكَةَ فَسَجَدُوا لَكَ اشْفَعْ لَنَا إِلَى رَبِّكَ أَلاَ تَرَى إِلَى مَا نَحْنُ فِيهِ أَلاَ تَرَى إِلَى مَا قَدْ بَلَغَنَا فَيَقُولُ آدَمُ إِنَّ رَبِّي غَضِبَ الْيَوْمَ غَضَبًا لَمْ يَغْضَبْ قَبْلَهُ مِثْلَهُ وَلَنْ يَغْضَبَ بَعْدَهُ مِثْلَهُ وَإِنَّهُ نَهَانِي عَنِ الشَّجَرَةِ فَعَصَيْتُهُ نَفْسِي نَفْسِي اذْهَبُوا إِلَى غَيْرِي اذْهَبُوا إِلَى نُوحٍ ‏.‏ فَيَأْتُونَ نُوحًا فَيَقُولُونَ يَا نُوحُ أَنْتَ أَوَّلُ الرُّسُلِ إِلَى الأَرْضِ وَسَمَّاكَ اللَّهُ عَبْدًا شَكُورًا اشْفَعْ لَنَا إِلَى رَبِّكَ أَلاَ تَرَى مَا نَحْنُ فِيهِ أَلاَ تَرَى مَا قَدْ بَلَغَنَا فَيَقُولُ لَهُمْ إِنَّ رَبِّي قَدْ غَضِبَ الْيَوْمَ غَضَبًا لَمْ يَغْضَبْ قَبْلَهُ مِثْلَهُ وَلَنْ يَغْضَبَ بَعْدَهُ مِثْلَهُ وَإِنَّهُ قَدْ كَانَتْ لِي دَعْوَةٌ دَعَوْتُ بِهَا عَلَى قَوْمِي نَفْسِي نَفْسِي اذْهَبُوا إِلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَيَأْتُونَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ فَيَقُولُونَ أَنْتَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ وَخَلِيلُهُ مِنْ أَهْلِ الأَرْضِ اشْفَعْ لَنَا إِلَى رَبِّكَ أَلاَ تَرَى إِلَى مَا نَحْنُ فِيهِ أَلاَ تَرَى إِلَى مَا قَدْ بَلَغَنَا فَيَقُولُ لَهُمْ إِبْرَاهِيمُ إِنَّ رَبِّي قَدْ غَضِبَ الْيَوْمَ غَضَبًا لَمْ يَغْضَبْ قَبْلَهُ مِثْلَهُ وَلاَ يَغْضَبُ بَعْدَهُ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏ وَذَكَرَ كَذَبَاتِهِ نَفْسِي نَفْسِي اذْهَبُوا إِلَى غَيْرِي اذْهَبُوا إِلَى مُوسَى ‏.‏ فَيَأْتُونَ مُوسَى صلى الله عليه وسلم فَيَقُولُونَ يَا مُوسَى أَنْتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ فَضَّلَكَ اللَّهُ بِرِسَالاَتِهِ وَبِتَكْلِيمِهِ عَلَى النَّاسِ اشْفَعْ لَنَا إِلَى رَبِّكَ أَلاَ تَرَى إِلَى مَا نَحْنُ فِيهِ أَلاَ تَرَى مَا قَدْ بَلَغَنَا فَيَقُولُ لَهُمْ مُوسَى صلى الله عليه وسلم إِنَّ رَبِّي قَدْ غَضِبَ الْيَوْمَ غَضَبًا لَمْ يَغْضَبْ قَبْلَهُ مِثْلَهُ وَلَنْ يَغْضَبَ بَعْدَهُ مِثْلَهُ وَإِنِّي قَتَلْتُ نَفْسًا لَمْ أُومَرْ بِقَتْلِهَا نَفْسِي نَفْسِي اذْهَبُوا إِلَى عِيسَى صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَيَأْتُونَ عِيسَى فَيَقُولُونَ يَا عِيسَى أَنْتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ وَكَلَّمْتَ النَّاسَ فِي الْمَهْدِ وَكَلِمَةٌ مِنْهُ أَلْقَاهَا إِلَى مَرْيَمَ وَرُوحٌ مِنْهُ فَاشْفَعْ لَنَا إِلَى رَبِّكَ أَلاَ تَرَى مَا نَحْنُ فِيهِ أَلاَ تَرَى مَا قَدْ بَلَغَنَا فَيَقُولُ لَهُمْ عِيسَى صلى الله عليه وسلم إِنَّ رَبِّي قَدْ غَضِبَ الْيَوْمَ غَضَبًا لَمْ يَغْضَبْ قَبْلَهُ مِثْلَهُ وَلَنْ يَغْضَبَ بَعْدَهُ مِثْلَهُ - وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ لَهُ ذَنْبًا - نَفْسِي نَفْسِي اذْهَبُوا إِلَى غَيْرِي اذْهَبُوا إِلَى مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَيَأْتُونِّي فَيَقُولُونَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ أَنْتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ وَخَاتَمُ الأَنْبِيَاءِ وَغَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَكَ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ اشْفَعْ لَنَا إِلَى رَبِّكَ أَلاَ تَرَى مَا نَحْنُ فِيهِ أَلاَ تَرَى مَا قَدْ بَلَغَنَا فَأَنْطَلِقُ فَآتِي تَحْتَ الْعَرْشِ فَأَقَعُ سَاجِدًا لِرَبِّي ثُمَّ يَفْتَحُ اللَّهُ عَلَىَّ وَيُلْهِمُنِي مِنْ مَحَامِدِهِ وَحُسْنِ الثَّنَاءِ عَلَيْهِ شَيْئًا لَمْ يَفْتَحْهُ لأَحَدٍ قَبْلِي ثُمَّ يُقَالُ يَا مُحَمَّدُ ارْفَعْ رَأْسَكَ سَلْ تُعْطَهْ اشْفَعْ تُشَفَّعْ ‏.‏ فَأَرْفَعُ رَأْسِي فَأَقُولُ يَا رَبِّ أُمَّتِي أُمَّتِي ‏.‏ فَيُقَالُ يَا مُحَمَّدُ أَدْخِلِ الْجَنَّةَ مِنْ أُمَّتِكَ مَنْ لاَ حِسَابَ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْبَابِ الأَيْمَنِ مِنْ أَبْوَابِ الْجَنَّةِ وَهُمْ شُرَكَاءُ النَّاسِ فِيمَا سِوَى ذَلِكَ مِنَ الأَبْوَابِ وَالَّذِي نَفْسُ مُحَمَّدٍ بِيَدِهِ إِنَّ مَا بَيْنَ الْمِصْرَاعَيْنِ مِنْ مَصَارِيعِ الْجَنَّةِ لَكَمَا بَيْنَ مَكَّةَ وَهَجَرٍ أَوْ كَمَا بَيْنَ مَكَّةَ وَبُصْرَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏
1.en:
Abu Huraira reported: Meat was one day brought to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and a foreleg was offered to him, a part which he liked. He sliced with his teeth a piece out of it and said: I shall be the leader of mankind on the Day of Resurrection. Do you know why? Allah would gather in one plain the earlier and the later (of the human race) on the Day of Resurrection. Then the voice of the proclaimer would be heard by all of them and the eyesight would penetrate through all of them and the sun would come near. People would then experience a degree of anguish, anxiety and agony which they shall not be able to bear and they shall not be able to stand. Some people would say to the others: Don you see in which trouble you are? Don't you see what (misfortune) has overtaken you? Why don't you find one who should intercede for you with your Lord? Some would say to the others: Go to Adam. And they would go to Adam and say: O Adam, thou art the father of mankind. Allah created thee by His own Hand and breathed in thee of His spirit and ordered the angels to prostrate before thee. Intercede for us with thy Lord Don't you see in what (trouble) we are? Don't you see what (misfortune) has overtaken us? Adam would say: Verily, my Lord is angry, to an extent to which He had never been angry before nor would He be angry afterward. Verily, He forbade me (to go near) that tree and I disobeyed Him. I am concerned with my own self. Go to someone else; go to Noah. They would come to Noah and would say: O Noah, thou art the first of the Messengers (sent) on the earth (after Adam), and Allah named thee as a" Grateful Servant," intercede for us with thy Lord. Don't you see in what (trouble) we are? Don't you see what (misfortune) has overtaken us? He would say: Verily, my Lord is angry today as He had never been angry before, and would never be angry afterwards. There had emanated a curse from me with which I cursed my people. I am concerned with only myself, I am concerned only with myself; you better go to Ibrahim (peace be upon him). They would go to Ibrahim and say: Thou art the apostle of Allah and His Friend amongst the inhabitants of the earth; intercede for us with thy Lord. Don't you see in which (trouble) we are? Don't you see what (misfortune) has overtaken us? Ibrahim would say to them: Verily, my Lord is today angry as He had never been angry before and would never be angry afterwards. and (Ibrahim) would mention his lies (and then say): I am concerned only with myself, I am concerned only with myself. You better go to someone else: go to Moses. They would come to Moses (peace be upon him) and say: O Moses, thou art Allah's messenger, Allah blessed thee with His messengership and His conversation amongst people. Intercede for us with thy Lord. Don't you see in what (trouble) we are? Don't you see what (misfortune) has overtaken us? Moses (peace be upon him) would say to them: Verily. my Lord is angry as He had never been angry before and would never be angry afterwards. I, in fact, killed a person whom I had not been ordered to kill. I am concerned with myself, I am concerned with myself. You better go to Jesus (peace be upon him). They would come to Jesus and would say: O Jesus, thou art the messenger of Allah and thou conversed with people in the cradle, (thou art) His Word which I-Ie sent down upon Mary. and (thou art) the Spirit from Him; so intercede for us with thy Lord. Don't you see (the trouble) in which we are? Don't you see (the misfortune) that has overtaken us? Jesus (peace be upon him) would say: Verily, my Lord is angry today as He had never been angry before or would ever be angry afterwards. He mentioned no sin of his. (He simply said: ) I am concerned with myself, I am concerned with myself; you go to someone else: better go to Muhammad (ﷺ). 
They would come to me and say: O Mahammad, thou art the messenger of Allah and the last of the apostles. Allah has pardoned thee all thy previous and later sins. Intercede for us with thy Lord; don't you see in which (trouble) we are? Don't you see what (misfortune) has overtaken us? I shall then set off and come below the Throne and fall down prostrate before my Lord; then Allah would reveal to me and inspire me with some of His Praises and Glorifications which He had not revealed to anyone before me. He would then say: Muhammad, raise thy head; ask and it would be granted; intercede and intercession would be accepted I would then raise my head and say: O my Lord, my people, my people. It would be said: O Muhammad, bring in by the right gate of Paradise those of your people who would have no account to render. They would share with the people some other door besides this door. The Prophet then said: By Him in Whose Hand is the life of Muhammad, verify the distance between two door leaves of the Paradise is as great as between Mecca and Hajar, or as between Mecca and Busra.
1.hi:
Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Ek din Rasoolullah (SAW) ko gosht laaya gaya aur unhein ek agli taang di gayi, wo hissa jo unhein pasand tha. Unhone apne daanton se usmein se ek tukda kaata aur kaha: Main Qayamat ke Din insaaniyat ka rehnuma hounga. Kya tumhein pata hai kyun? Allah Qayamat ke Din agle aur pichhle poori insaaniyat ko ek maidan mein jama karega. Phir elaan karne wale ki awaaz sab tak pahunchegi aur nazar sab tak pahunchegi aur suraj qareeb aa jaayega. Log itni pareshaani, betaabi aur takleef mehsoos karenge ki jise wo bardaasht nahi kar payenge aur khade nahi reh payenge. Kuch log doosron se kahenge: Kya tum nahi dekhte ki tum kis museebat mein ho? Kya tum nahi dekhte ki tumpar kya afat aa padi hai? Tum kisi aise shaks ko kyun nahi dhoondte jo tumhaare liye apne Rab se shafaa'at kare? Kuch log doosron se kahenge: Aadam ke paas jao. Aur wo Aadam ke paas jaayenge aur kahenge: Aye Aadam, tum insaaniyat ke waalid ho. Allah ne tumhein apne haath se paida kiya aur tummein apni Rooh phoonki aur Farishton ko hukum diya ki tumhein sajda karein. Humaare liye apne Rab se shafaa'at karo. Kya tum nahi dekhte ki hum kis museebat mein hain? Kya tum nahi dekhte ki humpar kya afat aa padi hai? Aadam kahenge: Beshak, mera Rab itna naaraaz hai jitna Wo kabhi nahi hua aur kabhi hoga bhi nahi. Beshak, Usne mujhe us ped ke qareeb jaane se mana kiya tha aur maine Uski nafarmaani ki. Mujhe apni fikr hai. Kisi aur ke paas jao; Nooh ke paas jao. Wo Nooh ke paas aayenge aur kahenge: Aye Nooh, tum zameen par Allah ke bheje gaye pehle Rasool ho, aur Allah ne tumhein 'Shukr Guzaar Banda' kaha, humaare liye apne Rab se shafaa'at karo. Kya tum nahi dekhte ki hum kis museebat mein hain? Kya tum nahi dekhte ki humpar kya afat aa padi hai? Wo kahenge: Beshak, mera Rab aaj itna naaraaz hai jitna Wo kabhi nahi hua aur kabhi hoga bhi nahi. Mujhse ek laanat nikli thi jisse maine apni qaum par laanat bheji thi. Mujhe sirf apni fikr hai, mujhe sirf apni fikr hai; behtar hoga tum Ibrahim (AS) ke paas jao. Wo Ibrahim ke paas jaayenge aur kahenge: Tum Allah ke Rasool ho aur zameen ke logon mein Uske Dost ho; humaare liye apne Rab se shafaa'at karo. Kya tum nahi dekhte ki hum kis museebat mein hain? Kya tum nahi dekhte ki humpar kya afat aa padi hai? Ibrahim unse kahenge: Beshak, mera Rab aaj itna naaraaz hai jitna Wo kabhi nahi hua aur kabhi hoga bhi nahi, aur apne jhoot yaad karenge aur phir kahenge: Mujhe sirf apni fikr hai, mujhe sirf apni fikr hai. Behtar hoga tum kisi aur ke paas jao: Musa ke paas jao. Wo Musa (AS) ke paas aayenge aur kahenge: Aye Musa, tum Allah ke Rasool ho, Allah ne tumhein apni Risaalat aur logon se apni baatcheet se nawaaza. Humaare liye apne Rab se shafaa'at karo. Kya tum nahi dekhte ki hum kis museebat mein hain? Kya tum nahi dekhte ki humpar kya afat aa padi hai? Musa (AS) unse kahenge: Beshak, mera Rab itna naaraaz hai jitna Wo kabhi nahi hua aur kabhi hoga bhi nahi. Maine haqeeqat mein ek shaks ko maar diya tha jise maarne ka mujhe hukum nahi diya gaya tha. Mujhe apni fikr hai, mujhe apni fikr hai. Behtar hoga tum Isa (AS) ke paas jao. Wo Isa ke paas aayenge aur kahenge: Aye Isa, tum Allah ke Rasool ho aur tumne jhoole mein logon se baat ki, tum Uska Kalima ho jise Usne Maryam par nazil kiya, aur tum Uski taraf se Rooh ho; is liye humaare liye apne Rab se shafaa'at karo. Kya tum nahi dekhte ki hum kis museebat mein hain? Kya tum nahi dekhte ki humpar kya afat aa padi hai? Isa (AS) kahenge: Beshak, mera Rab aaj itna naaraaz hai jitna Wo kabhi nahi hua ya kabhi hoga bhi nahi. Unhone apna koi gunah zikr nahi kiya. Unhone bas itna kaha: Mujhe apni fikr hai, mujhe apni fikr hai; tum kisi aur ke paas jao: behtar hoga Muhammad (SAW) ke paas jao.

Wo mere paas aayenge aur kahenge: Aye Muhammad, tum Allah ke Rasool ho aur Rasoolon mein sabse aakhri. Allah ne tumhaare pehle aur baad ke sab gunah maaf kar diye hain. Humaare liye apne Rab se shafaa'at karo; kya tum nahi dekhte ki hum kis museebat mein hain? Kya tum nahi dekhte ki humpar kya afat aa padi hai? Main phir chal padunga aur Arsh ke neeche aaunga aur apne Rab ke saamne sajde mein gir jaaunga; phir Allah mujhpar wahi nazil karega aur mujhe Apni kuch aisi Tareefein aur Buzurgi ki baatein ilhaam karega jo Usne mujhse pehle kisi par zaahir nahi ki thi. Phir Wo kahega: Muhammad, apna sar uthaao; maango aur diya jaayega; shafaa'at karo aur shafaa'at qubool ki jaayegi. Phir main apna sar uthaaunga aur kahunga: Aye mere Rab, meri ummat, meri ummat. Kaha jaayega: Aye Muhammad, apni ummat ke un logon ko jinka koi hisaab nahi liya jaayega Jannat ke daayen darwaze se andar le jaao. Wo iske alaawa doosre darwaazon se bhi logon ke saath Jannat mein daakhil honge. Nabi (SAW) ne phir farmaya: Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein Muhammad ki jaan hai, beshak Jannat ke do darwaazon ke kivaadon ke darmiyaan itni doori hai jitni Makkah aur Hajar ke darmiyaan, ya jitni Makkah aur Busra ke darmiyaan.

1.ar: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ الْقَعْقَاعِ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ وُضِعَتْ بَيْنَ يَدَىْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَصْعَةٌ مِنْ ثَرِيدٍ وَلَحْمٍ فَتَنَاوَلَ الذِّرَاعَ وَكَانَتْ أَحَبَّ الشَّاةِ إِلَيْهِ فَنَهَسَ نَهْسَةً فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَنَا سَيِّدُ النَّاسِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ نَهَسَ أُخْرَى فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَنَا سَيِّدُ النَّاسِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا رَأَى أَصْحَابَهُ لاَ يَسْأَلُونَهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَلاَ تَقُولُونَ كَيْفَهْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا كَيْفَهْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَقُومُ النَّاسُ لِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ أَبِي حَيَّانَ عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ وَزَادَ فِي قِصَّةِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ فَقَالَ وَذَكَرَ قَوْلَهُ فِي الْكَوْكَبِ هَذَا رَبِّي ‏.‏ وَقَوْلَهُ لآلِهَتِهِمْ بَلْ فَعَلَهُ كَبِيرُهُمْ هَذَا ‏.‏ وَقَوْلَهُ إِنِّي سَقِيمٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسُ مُحَمَّدٍ بِيَدِهِ إِنَّ مَا بَيْنَ الْمِصْرَاعَيْنِ مِنْ مَصَارِيعِ الْجَنَّةِ إِلَى عِضَادَتَىِ الْبَابِ لَكَمَا بَيْنَ مَكَّةَ وَهَجَرٍ أَوْ هَجَرٍ وَمَكَّةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ أَدْرِي أَىَّ ذَلِكَ قَالَ ‏.‏
1.en: It is reported on the authority of Abu Huraira that there was placed before the Messenger of Allah a cup of soft bread, soup and meat. He took part of the foreleg which he liked most. He sliced (with his teeth) a slice (out of that) and said: I would be the leader of mankind on the Day of Resurrection. He then sliced (that meat) for the second time and said: I am the leader of mankind on the Day of Resurrection. When he saw that his companions did not ask him (about this assertion) he said: Why don't you say: How would that be? They said: How would be it, Messenger of Allah? He said: People would stand before the Lord of the worlds. And the rest of the hadith was narrated like the one transmitted by Abu Hayyan, on the authority of Abu Zur'a, and in the story of Ibrahim, this addition was made. He said and made mention of his words with regard to the star: This is my Lord. And his words with regard to their gods: But the big among them has done that. And his words: I am ailing. He (the Holy Prophet) said: By Him in Whose Hand is the life of Muhammad, the distance between two leaves of the door from their supporting frames is as the distance between Mecca and Hajar or Hajar and Mecca. I do not remember how he said it (whether Mecca and Hajar or Hajar and Mecca).
1.hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saamne narm roti, shorba aur gosht ka ek pyaala rakha gaya. Unhone agli taang ka hissa liya jo unhein sabse zyada pasand tha. Unhone apne daanton se usmein se ek tukda kaata aur kaha: Main Qayamat ke Din insaaniyat ka rehnuma hounga. Phir unhone us gosht ko doosri baar kaata aur kaha: Main Qayamat ke Din insaaniyat ka rehnuma hoon. Jab unhone dekha ki unke saathi unse is dawe ke baare mein nahi poochh rahe, to unhone kaha: Tum ye kyun nahi poochte: Ye kaise hoga? Unhone kaha: Ye kaise hoga, Ya Rasoolullah? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Log duniyaon ke Rab ke saamne khade honge. Aur baaki hadees waisi hi riwayat ki gayi jaisi Abu Hayyan ne Abu Zur'a ki sanad se riwayat ki, aur Ibrahim ke qisse mein, ye izafa kiya gaya. Unhone kaha aur sitaare ke baare mein unke alfaaz ka zikr kiya: Ye mera Rab hai. Aur unke maabudon ke baare mein unke alfaaz: Balki unmein se bade ne aisa kiya. Aur unke alfaaz: Main bimaar hoon. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein Muhammad ki jaan hai, do darwaaze ke kivaadon ke unke chaukhaton se doori itni hai jitni Makkah aur Hajar ke darmiyaan ya Hajar aur Makkah ke darmiyaan. Mujhe yaad nahi ki unhone ye kaise kaha.

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ طَرِيفِ بْنِ خَلِيفَةَ الْبَجَلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَالِكٍ الأَشْجَعِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، وَأَبُو مَالِكٍ عَنْ رِبْعِيٍّ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، قَالاَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَجْمَعُ اللَّهُ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى النَّاسَ فَيَقُومُ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ حَتَّى تُزْلَفَ لَهُمُ الْجَنَّةُ فَيَأْتُونَ آدَمَ فَيَقُولُونَ يَا أَبَانَا اسْتَفْتِحْ لَنَا الْجَنَّةَ ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ وَهَلْ أَخْرَجَكُمْ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ إِلاَّ خَطِيئَةُ أَبِيكُمْ آدَمَ لَسْتُ بِصَاحِبِ ذَلِكَ اذْهَبُوا إِلَى ابْنِي إِبْرَاهِيمَ خَلِيلِ اللَّهِ - قَالَ - فَيَقُولُ إِبْرَاهِيمُ لَسْتُ بِصَاحِبِ ذَلِكَ إِنَّمَا كُنْتُ خَلِيلاً مِنْ وَرَاءَ وَرَاءَ اعْمِدُوا إِلَى مُوسَى صلى الله عليه وسلم الَّذِي كَلَّمَهُ اللَّهُ تَكْلِيمًا ‏.‏ فَيَأْتُونَ مُوسَى صلى الله عليه وسلم فَيَقُولُ لَسْتُ بِصَاحِبِ ذَلِكَ اذْهَبُوا إِلَى عِيسَى كَلِمَةِ اللَّهِ وَرُوحِهِ ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ عِيسَى صلى الله عليه وسلم لَسْتُ بِصَاحِبِ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏ فَيَأْتُونَ مُحَمَّدًا صلى الله عليه وسلم فَيَقُومُ فَيُؤْذَنُ لَهُ وَتُرْسَلُ الأَمَانَةُ وَالرَّحِمُ فَتَقُومَانِ جَنَبَتَىِ الصِّرَاطِ يَمِينًا وَشِمَالاً فَيَمُرُّ أَوَّلُكُمْ كَالْبَرْقِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ بِأَبِي أَنْتَ وَأُمِّي أَىُّ شَىْءٍ كَمَرِّ الْبَرْقِ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَلَمْ تَرَوْا إِلَى الْبَرْقِ كَيْفَ يَمُرُّ وَيَرْجِعُ فِي طَرْفَةِ يْنٍ ثُمَّ كَمَرِّ الرِّيحِ ثُمَّ كَمَرِّ الطَّيْرِ وَشَدِّ الرِّجَالِ تَجْرِي بِهِمْ أَعْمَالُهُمْ وَنَبِيُّكُمْ قَائِمٌ عَلَى الصِّرَاطِ يَقُولُ رَبِّ سَلِّمْ سَلِّمْ حَتَّى تَعْجِزَ أَعْمَالُ الْعِبَادِ حَتَّى يَجِيءَ الرَّجُلُ فَلاَ يَسْتَطِيعُ السَّيْرَ إِلاَّ زَحْفًا - قَالَ - وَفِي حَافَتَىِ الصِّرَاطِ كَلاَلِيبُ مُعَلَّقَةٌ مَأْمُورَةٌ بِأَخْذِ مَنْ أُمِرَتْ بِهِ فَمَخْدُوشٌ نَاجٍ وَمَكْدُوسٌ فِي النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسُ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ بِيَدِهِ إِنَّ قَعْرَ جَهَنَّمَ لَسَبْعُونَ خَرِيفًا ‏.‏
1.en: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira and Hudhaifa that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, would gather people. The believers would stand till the Paradise would be brought near them. They would come to Adam and say: O our father, open for us the Paradise. He would say: What turned ye out from the Paradise was the sin of your father Adam. I am not in a position to do that; better go to my son Ibrahim, the Friend of Allah. He (the Holy Prophet) said: He (Ibrahim) would say: I am not in a position to do that. Verily I had been the Friend (of Allah) from beyond, beyond; you better approach Moses (peace be upon him) with whom Allah conversed. They would come to Moses (peace be upon him), but he would say: I am not in a position to do that; you better go to Jesus, the Word of Allah and His Spirit. Jesus (peace be upon him) would say: I am not in a position to do that. So they would come to Muhammad (ﷺ). He would then be permitted (to open the door of Paradise). Trustworthiness and kinship would be despatched, and these would stand on the right and left of the Path and the first of you would pass with (the swiftness) of lightning. He (the narrator) said: I said, O thou who art far dearer to me than my father and my mother I which thing is like the passing of lightning? He said: Have you not seen lightning, how it passes and then comes back within the twinkling of an eye? Then (they would pass) like the passing of the wind, then like the passing of a bird, and the hastening of persons would be according to their deeds, and your Apostle would be standing on the Path saying: Save, O my Lord, save. (The people would go on passing) till the deeds of the servants would be failing in strength, till a man would come who would find it hard to go along (that Path) but crawlingly. He (the narrator) said: And on the sides of the Path hooks would be suspended ready to catch anyone whom these would be required (to catch). There would be those who would somehow or other succeed in trasversing that Path and some would be piled up in Hell. By Him in Whose Hand is the life of Abu Huraira it would take one seventy years to fathom the depth of Hell.
1.hi: Abu Huraira aur Hudhaifa se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Allah, Mubarak aur Buland, logon ko jama karega. Momineen khade rahenge yahan tak ki Jannat unke qareeb laayi jaayegi. Wo Aadam ke paas aayenge aur kahenge: Aye humaare waalid, humaare liye Jannat kholo. Wo kahenge: Jis cheez ne tumhein Jannat se nikaala wo tumhaare waalid Aadam ka gunah tha. Main ye karne ki halat mein nahi hoon; behtar hoga mere bete Ibrahim, Allah ke Dost, ke paas jao. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Wo kahenge: Main ye karne ki halat mein nahi hoon. Beshak main door-door tak Allah ka Dost tha; behtar hoga tum Musa (AS) ke paas jao jinse Allah ne baat ki. Wo Musa (AS) ke paas aayenge, lekin wo kahenge: Main ye karne ki halat mein nahi hoon; behtar hoga tum Isa, Allah ke Kalime aur Uski Rooh ke paas jao. Isa (AS) kahenge: Main ye karne ki halat mein nahi hoon. Is liye wo Muhammad (SAW) ke paas aayenge. Phir unhein Jannat ka darwaza kholne ki ijaazat di jaayegi. Amaanatdaari aur rishtedaari ko bheja jaayega, aur wo Raste ke daayin aur baayin taraf khade honge, aur tum mein se pehla shaks bijli ki raftaar ki tarah guzrega. Unhone kaha: Maine kaha, Aye Wo Jo mujhe mere maa-baap se zyada aziz hain! kaunsi cheez bijli ke guzarne jaisi hoti hai? Unhone kaha: Kya tumne bijli nahi dekhi, kaise wo guzarti hai aur phir palak jhapakte hi wapas aa jaati hai? Phir wo log guzrenge hawa ke guzarne ki tarah, phir parinde ke guzarne ki tarah, aur logon ki tezi unke amal ke mutaabiq hogi, aur tumhaare Rasool Raste par khade hokar kahenge: Bacha, Aye mere Rab, bacha. Log guzarte rahenge yahan tak ki bandon ke amal kamzor padne lagenge, yahan tak ki ek shaks aayega jiske liye wahan se rengte hue guzarna hi mumkin hoga. Unhone kaha: Aur Raste ke kinaaron par ankude latakte honge, jo taiyaar honge kisi ko bhi pakadne ke liye jise unhein pakadne ki zaroorat ho. Kuch log kisi tarah is Raste ko paar karne mein kaamyaab ho jaayenge aur kuch Jahannam mein dher ho jaayenge. Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein Abu Huraira ki jaan hai, Jahannam ki gehraayi tak pahunchne mein sattar (70) saal lag jaayenge.

1.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ قُتَيْبَةُ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الْمُخْتَارِ بْنِ فُلْفُلٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ أَنَا أَوَّلُ النَّاسِ يَشْفَعُ فِي الْجَنَّةِ وَأَنَا أَكْثَرُ الأَنْبِيَاءِ تَبَعًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
1.en: Anas b. Malik reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: I would be the first among people to intercede in the Paradise and amongst the apostles I would have the largest following (on the Day of Resurrection).
1.hi: Anas bin Malik ne bataaya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Main logon mein sabse pehla hounga jo Jannat mein shafaa'at karega aur Rasoolon mein mera sabse zyada peirokaar hoga.

1.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ مُخْتَارِ بْنِ فُلْفُلٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ أَنَا أَكْثَرُ الأَنْبِيَاءِ تَبَعًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَأَنَا أَوَّلُ مَنْ يَقْرَعُ بَابَ الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
1.en: Anas b. Malik reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Amongst the apostles I would have the largest following on the Day of Resurrec tion, and I would be the first to knock at the door of Paradise.
1.hi: Anas bin Malik ne bataaya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Rasoolon mein Qayamat ke Din mera sabse zyada peirokaar hoga, aur main sabse pehla hounga jo Jannat ke darwaze par dastak dega.

1.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ زَائِدَةَ، عَنِ الْمُخْتَارِ بْنِ فُلْفُلٍ، قَالَ قَالَ أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ أَنَا أَوَّلُ شَفِيعٍ فِي الْجَنَّةِ لَمْ يُصَدَّقْ نَبِيٌّ مِنَ الأَنْبِيَاءِ مَا صُدِّقْتُ وَإِنَّ مِنَ الأَنْبِيَاءِ نَبِيًّا مَا يُصَدِّقُهُ مِنْ أُمَّتِهِ إِلاَّ رَجُلٌ وَاحِدٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
1.en: Anas b. Malik said: The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) said: I would be the first intercessor in the Paradise and no apostle amongst the apostles has been testified (by such a large number of people) as I have been testified. And verily there woald be an apostle among the apostles who would be testified to by only one man from his people.
1.hi: Anas bin Malik ne kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Main Jannat mein sabse pehla shafaa'at karne waala hounga, aur Rasoolon mein se kisi bhi Rasool ko itni badi tadaad mein logon ne sach nahi maana jitna mujhe maana gaya hai. Aur beshak Rasoolon mein se ek Rasool aisa hoga jinhein unki qaum mein se sirf ek shaks ne sach maana hoga.

1.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ آتِي بَابَ الْجَنَّةِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَأَسْتَفْتِحُ فَيَقُولُ الْخَازِنُ مَنْ أَنْتَ فَأَقُولُ مُحَمَّدٌ ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ بِكَ أُمِرْتُ لاَ أَفْتَحُ لأَحَدٍ قَبْلَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
1.en: Anas b. Malik reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: I will come to the gate of Paradise on the Day of Resurrection. and would seek its opening. and the keeper would say: Who art thou? I would say: Muhammad. He would then say: It is for thee that I have been ordered, and not to open it for anyone before thee.
1.hi: Anas bin Malik ne bataaya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Main Qayamat ke Din Jannat ke darwaze par aaunga, aur ise kholne ki darkhwaast karunga, aur nigehbaan poochega: Tum kaun ho? Main kahunga: Muhammad. Wo phir kahega: Mujhe tumhaare liye hi hukum diya gaya tha, aur tumse pehle kisi ke liye ise na kholne ka.

1.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ دَعْوَةٌ يَدْعُوهَا فَأُرِيدُ أَنْ أَخْتَبِئَ دَعْوَتِي شَفَاعَةً لأُمَّتِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
1.en: Abu Huraira reported: Verity the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: There is for every apostle a (special) prayer with which he would pray. I wish I could reserve, my prayer for intercession of my Ummah on the Day of Resurrection.
1.hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Beshak Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Har Rasool ke liye ek khaas dua hai jiske saath wo dua karega. Kaash main apni dua Qayamat ke Din apni Ummat ki shafaa'at ke liye mahfooz rakh sakoon.

1.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَخِي ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ دَعْوَةٌ وَأَرَدْتُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ أَنْ أَخْتَبِئَ دَعْوَتِي شَفَاعَةً لأُمَّتِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
1.en: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: There is for every apostle a prayer, and I intend (if Allah so willed) that I would reserve my prayer for the intercession of my Ummah on the Day of Resurrection.
1.hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Har Rasool ke liye ek dua hai, aur main iraada rakhta hoon, Allah chaahe to, ki main apni dua Qayamat ke Din apni Ummat ki shafaa'at ke liye mahfooz rakhunga.

1.ar: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَخِي ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ، حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ بْنِ أَسِيدِ بْنِ جَارِيَةَ الثَّقَفِيُّ، مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
1.en: 'Amr b. Abu Sufyan transmitted a hadith like this from Abu Huraira who narrated it from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).
1.hi: Amr bin Abu Sufyan ne isi tarah ki hadees Abu Huraira se riwayat ki jinhone ise Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat kiya.

1.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّ عَمْرَو بْنَ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ بْنِ أَسِيدِ بْنِ جَارِيَةَ الثَّقَفِيَّ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ لِكَعْبِ الأَحْبَارِ إِنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ دَعْوَةٌ يَدْعُوهَا فَأَنَا أُرِيدُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ أَنْ أَخْتَبِئَ دَعْوَتِي شَفَاعَةً لأُمَّتِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ كَعْبٌ لأَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ أَنْتَ سَمِعْتَ هَذَا مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏
1.en: Amr b. Abu Sufyan reported: Abu Huraira said to Ka'b al-Ahbar that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had said: For every apostle there Is a (special) prayer by which he would pray (to his Lord). I, however, intend (if Allah so willed) that I would reserve my prayer for the intercession of my Ummah on the Day of Resurrection. Ka'b said to Abu Huraira: Did you hear this from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)? Abu Huraira said: Yes.
1.hi: Amr bin Abu Sufyan ne bataaya: Abu Huraira ne Ka'b al-Ahbar se kaha ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya tha: Har Rasool ke liye ek khaas dua hai jiske saath wo apne Rab se dua karega. Main, phir bhi, iraada rakhta hoon, Allah chaahe to, ki main apni dua Qayamat ke Din apni Ummat ki shafaa'at ke liye mahfooz rakhunga. Ka'b ne Abu Huraira se kaha: Kya aap ne ye Rasoolullah (SAW) se suna? Abu Huraira ne kaha: Haan.

1.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي كُرَيْبٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ دَعْوَةٌ مُسْتَجَابَةٌ فَتَعَجَّلَ كُلُّ نَبِيٍّ دَعْوَتَهُ وَإِنِّي اخْتَبَأْتُ دَعْوَتِي شَفَاعَةً لأُمَّتِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَهِيَ نَائِلَةٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ مَنْ مَاتَ مِنْ أُمَّتِي لاَ يُشْرِكُ بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
1.en: Abu Huraira said: The Prophet of Allah (ﷺ) said: There is for every apostle a prayer which is granted, but every prophet showed haste in his prayer. I have, however, reserved my prayer for the intercession of my Ummah on the Day of Resurrection, and it would be granted, if Allah so willed, in case of everyone amongst my Ummah provided he dies without associating anything with Allah.
1.hi: Abu Huraira ne kaha: Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Har Rasool ke liye ek dua hai jo qubool ki jaati hai, lekin har Nabi ne apni dua mein jaldbaazi dikhaayi. Maine, phir bhi, apni dua Qayamat ke Din apni Ummat ki shafaa'at ke liye mahfooz rakhi hai, aur ye, Allah chaahe to, meri Ummat mein se har us shaks ke haq mein qubool hogi jo Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek kiye bagair mare.

1.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ الْقَعْقَاعِ - عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ دَعْوَةٌ مُسْتَجَابَةٌ يَدْعُو بِهَا فَيُسْتَجَابُ لَهُ فَيُؤْتَاهَا وَإِنِّي اخْتَبَأْتُ دَعْوَتِي شَفَاعَةً لأُمَّتِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
1.en: Abu Huraira said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Every Messenger is endowed with a prayer which is granted and by which he would (pray to his Lord) and it would he granted for him. I have, however, reserved my prayer for the intercession of my Ummab on the Day of Resurrection.
1.hi: Abu Huraira ne kaha: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Har Rasool ko ek dua di gayi hai jo qubool ki jaati hai aur jiske zariye wo apne Rab se dua karega aur wo uske liye qubool ki jaayegi. Main, phir bhi, apni dua Qayamat ke Din apni Ummat ki shafaa'at ke liye mahfooz rakhi hai.

1.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ زِيَادٍ - قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ دَعْوَةٌ دَعَا بِهَا فِي أُمَّتِهِ فَاسْتُجِيبَ لَهُ وَإِنِّي أُرِيدُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ أَنْ أُؤَخِّرَ دَعْوَتِي شَفَاعَةً لأُمَّتِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
1.en: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: There was for every apostle a prayer with which he prayed for his Ummah and it was granted to him; but I wish, if Allah so wills, to defer my prayer for the intercession of my Ummah on the Day of Resurrection.
1.hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Har Rasool ke liye ek dua thi jiske saath usne apni Ummat ke liye dua ki aur wo unke liye qubool ki gayi; lekin main chaahta hoon, Allah chaahe to, ki main apni dua Qayamat ke Din apni Ummat ki shafaa'at ke liye taal doon.

1.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو غَسَّانَ الْمِسْمَعِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ حَدَّثَانَا - وَاللَّفْظُ، لأَبِي غَسَّانَ - قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذٌ، - يَعْنُونَ ابْنَ هِشَامٍ - قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ دَعْوَةٌ دَعَاهَا لأُمَّتِهِ وَإِنِّي اخْتَبَأْتُ دَعْوَتِي شَفَاعَةً لأُمَّتِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
1.en: Anas b. Malik reported: Verily the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: There is for every apostle a prayer with which he prays (to Allah) for his Ummah. I have reserved my prayer for the intercession of my Ummah on the Day of Resurrection.
1.hi: Anas bin Malik ne bataaya: Beshak Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Har Rasool ke liye ek dua hai jiske saath wo apni Ummat ke liye Allah se dua karta hai. Maine apni dua Qayamat ke Din apni Ummat ki shafaa'at ke liye mahfooz rakhi hai.

1.ar: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَابْنُ أَبِي خَلَفٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ح
1.en: This hadith is narrated with the same chain of narrators by Qatada.
1.hi: Ye hadees Qatada ne usi sanad se riwayat ki hai.

1.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْجَوْهَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ مِسْعَرٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي، حَدِيثِ وَكِيعٍ قَالَ قَالَ ‏
"‏ أُعْطِيَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ أَبِي أُسَامَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
1.en: Mis'ar transmitted it with the same chain of narrators from Qatada except that in the hadith narrated by Waki' (the Prophet) said: " He was endowed," and in the hadith reported by Abu Usama (the words are):" It is reported from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)."
1.hi: Mis'ar ne ise Qatada se usi sanad se riwayat ki hai, sivaay iske ki Waki ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mein Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: 'Unhein di gayi thi,' aur Abu Usama ki riwayat ki gayi hadees mein alfaaz hain: 'Ye Rasoolullah (SAW) se riwayat ki gayi hai.'

1.ar: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَنَسٍ ‏.‏
1.en: Muhammad b. 'Abd al-A'la reported it to me: Mu'tamir narrated to us on the authority of his father who transmitted it liom Anas that verity the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, and then narrated the hadith like the one transmitted by Qatada on the authority of Anas.
1.hi: Muhammad bin Abdul-A'la ne mujhe ye bataayi: Mu'tamir ne humein apne waalid ki sanad se bataayi jinhone ise Anas se riwayat kiya ki beshak Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya, aur phir hadees Qatada ki Anas se riwayat ki gayi hadees jaisi bayan ki.

1.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ دَعْوَةٌ قَدْ دَعَا بِهَا فِي أُمَّتِهِ وَخَبَأْتُ دَعْوَتِي شَفَاعَةً لأُمَّتِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
1.en: Abu Zubair heard Jabir b. Abdullah reporting it from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): For every apostle was a prayer with which he prayed (to his Lord) for his Ummah, but I have reserved my prayer for the intercession of my Ummah on the Day of Resurrection.
1.hi: Abu Zubair ne Jabir bin Abdullah ko Rasoolullah (SAW) se ye riwayat karte suna: Har Rasool ke liye ek dua thi jiske saath usne apni Ummat ke liye apne Rab se dua ki, lekin maine apni dua Qayamat ke Din apni Ummat ki shafaa'at ke liye mahfooz rakhi hai.

1.ar: حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى الصَّدَفِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، أَنَّ بَكْرَ بْنَ سَوَادَةَ، حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَلاَ قَوْلَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ فِي إِبْرَاهِيمَ ‏{‏ رَبِّ إِنَّهُنَّ أَضْلَلْنَ كَثِيرًا مِنَ النَّاسِ فَمَنْ تَبِعَنِي فَإِنَّهُ مِنِّي‏}‏ الآيَةَ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ عِيسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ ‏{‏ إِنْ تُعَذِّبْهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ عِبَادُكَ وَإِنْ تَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ فَإِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ‏}‏ فَرَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ أُمَّتِي أُمَّتِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَبَكَى فَقَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ يَا جِبْرِيلُ اذْهَبْ إِلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَرَبُّكَ أَعْلَمُ فَسَلْهُ مَا يُبْكِيكَ فَأَتَاهُ جِبْرِيلُ - عَلَيْهِ الصَّلاَةُ وَالسَّلاَمُ - فَسَأَلَهُ فَأَخْبَرَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَا قَالَ ‏.‏ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ اللَّهُ يَا جِبْرِيلُ اذْهَبْ إِلَى مُحَمَّدٍ فَقُلْ إِنَّا سَنُرْضِيكَ فِي أُمَّتِكَ وَلاَ نَسُوءُكَ ‏.‏
1.en: 'Abdullah b. Amr b. al-'As reported: Verily the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) recited the words of Allah, the Great and Glorious, that Ibrahim uttered. My Lord! lo! they have led many of mankind astray:" But whoso followeth me, he verily is of me" (al-Qur'an, xiv. 35) and Jesus (peace be upon him) said:" If thou punisheth them, lo! they are Thy slaves, and if Thou forgiveth them-verily Thou art the Mighty, the Wise" (al-Qur'an, v 117). Then he raised his hands and said: O Lord, my Ummah, my Ummah, and wept; so Allah the High and the Exalted said: O Gabriel, go to Muhammad (though your Lord knows it fully well) and ask him: What makes thee weep? So Gabriel (peace be upon him) came to him and asked him, and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) informed him what he had said (though Allah knew it fully well). Upon this Allah said: O Gabriel, go to Muhammad and say: Verily We will please thee with regard to your Ummah and would not displease thee.
1.hi: Abdullah bin Amr bin al-Aas ne bataaya: Beshak Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Allah, Buland aur Baa-Azmat, ke wo alfaaz tilaawat kiye jo Ibrahim ne kahe the: 'Mere Rab! Beshak inhone bahut se logon ko gumrah kar diya hai: lekin jo mera peirokaar bane, wo mujhse hai' (14:35) aur Isa (AS) ne kaha: 'Agar Tu inhein saza de, to beshak wo Tere bande hain, aur agar Tu inhein maaf kar de - to beshak Tu Zabardast, Hikmat Waala hai' (5:118). Phir aap (SAW) ne apne haath uthaaye aur kaha: Aye Rab, meri Ummat, meri Ummat, aur rone lage; is liye Allah, Buland aur Baa-Azmat, ne kaha: Aye Jibrael, Muhammad ke paas jao, halaanki tumhaara Rab ye poori tarah jaanta hai, aur unse poocho: Tumhein kis cheez ne rulaaya? Is liye Jibrael (AS) unke paas aaye aur unse poocha, aur Rasoolullah (SAW) ne unhein bataaya ki unhone kya kaha tha, halaanki Allah ye poori tarah jaanta tha. Is par Allah ne kaha: Aye Jibrael, Muhammad ke paas jao aur kaho: Beshak Hum tumhein tumhaari Ummat ke maamle mein khush kar denge aur tumhein naaraaz nahi karenge.

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَيْنَ أَبِي قَالَ ‏"‏ فِي النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا قَفَّى دَعَاهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ أَبِي وَأَبَاكَ فِي النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
1.en: Anas reported: Verily, a person said: Messenger of Allah, where is my father? He said: (He) is in the Fire. When he turned away, he (the Holy Prophet) called him and said: Verily my father and your father are in the Fire.
1.hi: Anas ne bataaya: Beshak ek shaks ne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, mere waalid kahan hain? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Wo Aag mein hain. Jab wo shaks mudkar jaane laga, to aap (SAW) ne use bulaaya aur kaha: Beshak mere waalid aur tumhaare waalid Aag mein hain.

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ لَمَّا أُنْزِلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ ‏{‏ وَأَنْذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ الأَقْرَبِينَ‏}‏ دَعَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قُرَيْشًا فَاجْتَمَعُوا فَعَمَّ وَخَصَّ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا بَنِي كَعْبِ بْنِ لُؤَىٍّ أَنْقِذُوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ مِنَ النَّارِ يَا بَنِي مُرَّةَ بْنِ كَعْبٍ أَنْقِذُوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ مِنَ النَّارِ يَا بَنِي عَبْدِ شَمْسٍ أَنْقِذُوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ مِنَ النَّارِ يَا بَنِي عَبْدِ مَنَافٍ أَنْقِذُوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ مِنَ النَّارِ يَا بَنِي هَاشِمٍ أَنْقِذُوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ مِنَ النَّارِ يَا بَنِي عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ أَنْقِذُوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ مِنَ النَّارِ يَا فَاطِمَةُ أَنْقِذِي نَفْسَكِ مِنَ النَّارِ فَإِنِّي لاَ أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا غَيْرَ أَنَّ لَكُمْ رَحِمًا سَأَبُلُّهَا بِبَلاَلِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
1.en: Abu Huraira reported: When this verse was revealed:" And warn thy nearest kindred (al-Qur'an, xxvi. 214), the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) called the Quraish; so they gathered and he gave them a general warning. Then he made a particular (reference to certain tribes) and said: O sons of Ka'b b. Luwayy, rescue yourselves from the Fire; O sons of Murra b. Ka'b, rescue yourselves from the Fire: O sons of Abd Shams, rescue yourselves from the Fire; 0 sons of Abd Manaf rescue yourselves from the Fire; O sons of Hashim, rescue yourselves from the Fire; 0 sons of Abd al-Muttalib, rescue yourselves from the Fire; O Fatimah, rescue thyself from the Fire, for I have no power (to protect you) from Allah in anything except this that I would sustain relationship with you.
1.hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Jab ye aayat nazil hui: 'Aur apne qareebi rishtedaaron ko khabardaar karo' (26:214), to Rasoolullah (SAW) ne Quraish ko bulaaya; is liye wo jama ho gaye aur aap (SAW) ne unhein aam khabardaari di. Phir aap (SAW) ne kuch khaas qabilon ka zikr kiya aur kaha: Aye Bani Ka'b bin Luwayy, apne aap ko Aag se bachaao; Aye Bani Murra bin Ka'b, apne aap ko Aag se bachaao; Aye Bani Abd Shams, apne aap ko Aag se bachaao; Aye Bani Abd Manaf, apne aap ko Aag se bachaao; Aye Bani Hashim, apne aap ko Aag se bachaao; Aye Bani Abdul-Muttalib, apne aap ko Aag se bachaao; Aye Fatima (Alayhas Salam), apne aap ko Aag se bachaao, kyunki mujhme Allah ke saamne tumhaare liye kisi cheez ki taaqat nahi hai sivaay iske ki main tumhaare saath rishtedaari ka taalluq banaaye rakhunga.

1.ar: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْقَوَارِيرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَحَدِيثُ جَرِيرٍ أَتَمُّ وَأَشْبَعُ ‏.‏
1.en: The same hadith is narrated by Ubaidallah b. Umar al-Qawariri from Abu 'Uwana, who transmitted it to 'Abd al-Malik b. 'Umair on the same chain of transmitter and the hadith of Jarir is more perfect and comprehensive.
1.hi: Ye hadees Ubaidullah bin Umar al-Qawariri ne Abu Uwana se riwayat ki, jinhone ise Abdul Malik bin Umair ko usi sanad se riwayat kiya, aur Jarir ki riwayat ki gayi hadees zyada mukammal aur vistaarit hai.

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، وَيُونُسُ بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ ‏{‏ وَأَنْذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ الأَقْرَبِينَ‏}‏ قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى الصَّفَا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتَ مُحَمَّدٍ يَا صَفِيَّةُ بِنْتَ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ يَا بَنِي عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ لاَ أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا سَلُونِي مِنْ مَالِي مَا شِئْتُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
1.en: It is narrated on the authority of 'A'isha that when this verse was revealed: " And warn thy nearest kindred," the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood up on Safa' and said: O Fatima, daughter of Muhammad. O Safiya, daughter of 'Abd al-Muttalib, O sons of 'Abd al-Muttalib. I have nothing which can avail you against Allah; you may ask me what you want of my worldly belongings.
1.hi: Aisha se riwayat hai ki jab ye aayat nazil hui: 'Aur apne qareebi rishtedaaron ko khabardaar karo,' to Rasoolullah (SAW) Safa par khade hue aur kaha: Aye Fatima (Alayhas Salam), Muhammad ki beti. Aye Safiya, Abdul-Muttalib ki beti. Aye Bani Abdul-Muttalib. Mere paas aisa kuch nahi jo Allah ke saamne tumhaare kaam aa sake; tum mujhse mere duniyaawi maal mein se jo chaaho maang sakte ho.

1.ar: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، وَأَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ‏{‏ وَأَنْذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ الأَقْرَبِينَ‏}‏ ‏"‏ يَا مَعْشَرَ قُرَيْشٍ اشْتَرُوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ لاَ أُغْنِي عَنْكُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا يَا بَنِي عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ لاَ أُغْنِي عَنْكُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا يَا عَبَّاسَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ لاَ أُغْنِي عَنْكَ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا يَا صَفِيَّةُ عَمَّةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ لاَ أُغْنِي عَنْكِ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا يَا فَاطِمَةُ بِنْتَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ سَلِينِي بِمَا شِئْتِ لاَ أُغْنِي عَنْكِ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
1.en: Abu Huraira reported: When (this verse) was revealed to him:" Warn your nearest kinsmen." the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: O people of Quraish, buy yourselves from Allah, I cannot avail you at all against Allah; O sons of Abd al-Muttalib. I cannot avail you at all against Allah; 0 Abbas b. 'Abd al- Muttalib, I cannot avail you at all against Allah; O Safiya (aunt of the Messenger of Allah), I cannot avail you at all against Allah; 0 Fatima, daughter of Muhammad, ask me whatever you like, but I cannot avail you at all against Allah.
1.hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Jab ye aayat unpar nazil hui: 'Apne qareebi rishtedaaron ko khabardaar karo,' to Rasoolullah (SAW) ne kaha: Aye Quraish ke logo, khud ko Allah se khareed lo, main Allah ke saamne tumhaare liye kuch nahi kar sakta; Aye Bani Abdul-Muttalib, main Allah ke saamne tumhaare liye kuch nahi kar sakta; Aye Abbas bin Abdul-Muttalib, main Allah ke saamne tumhaare liye kuch nahi kar sakta; Aye Safiya, main Allah ke saamne tumhaare liye kuch nahi kar sakta; Aye Fatima (Alayhas Salam), Muhammad ki beti, mujhse jo chaaho maango, lekin main Allah ke saamne tumhaare liye kuch nahi kar sakta.

1.ar: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ ذَكْوَانَ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَحْوَ هَذَا ‏.‏
1.en: This hadith is narrated from the Apostle (ﷺ) by another chain of narrators, 'Amr al-Naqid, Mu'awiya b. 'Amr, Abdullah b. Dhakwan, A'raj on the authority of Abu Huraira.
1.hi: Ye hadees Rasool (SAW) se ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai: Amr an-Naqid, Mu'awiya bin Amr, Abdullah bin Dhakwan, A'raj ki sanad se, Abu Huraira ki riwayat se.

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا التَّيْمِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ قَبِيصَةَ بْنِ الْمُخَارِقِ، وَزُهَيْرِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، قَالاَ لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ ‏{‏ وَأَنْذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ الأَقْرَبِينَ‏}‏ قَالَ انْطَلَقَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى رَضْمَةٍ مِنْ جَبَلٍ فَعَلاَ أَعْلاَهَا حَجَرًا ثُمَّ نَادَى ‏"‏ يَا بَنِي عَبْدِ مَنَافَاهْ إِنِّي نَذِيرٌ إِنَّمَا مَثَلِي وَمَثَلُكُمْ كَمَثَلِ رَجُلٍ رَأَى الْعَدُوَّ فَانْطَلَقَ يَرْبَأُ أَهْلَهُ فَخَشِيَ أَنْ يَسْبِقُوهُ فَجَعَلَ يَهْتِفُ يَا صَبَاحَاهْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
1.en: Qabisa b. al-Mukhariq and Zuhair b. 'Amr reported: When this verse was revealed:" And warn thy nearest kindred," the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) set off towards a rock of the hill and ascended the highest of the rocks and then called: 0 sons of 'Abd Manaf! I am a warner; my similitude and your similitude is like a man who saw the enemy and went to guard his people, but, being afraid they might get there before him, he shouted: Be on your guard!
1.hi: Qabisa bin al-Mukhariq aur Zuhair bin Amr ne bataaya: Jab ye aayat nazil hui: 'Aur apne qareebi rishtedaaron ko khabardaar karo,' to Rasoolullah (SAW) pahaad ki ek chattaan ki taraf chal pade aur sabse oonchi chattaan par chadh gaye aur phir pukaara: Aye Bani Abd Manaf! Main khabardaar karne wala hoon; meri aur tumhaari misaal us shaks jaisi hai jisne dushman dekha aur apni qaum ko bachaane ke liye gaya, lekin ye dar tha ki wo dushman usse pehle wahan pahunch jaayenge, is liye usne chillaakar kaha: Khabardaar raho!

1.ar: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ زُهَيْرِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، وَقَبِيصَةَ بْنِ مُخَارِقٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِنَحْوِهِ ‏.‏
1.en: This hadith is narrated from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) by another chain of narrators, Muhammad b. Abd al-A'la, Mu'tamir, Abu 'Uthman, Zuhair b. 'Amr, Qabisa b. Mukhariq.
1.hi: Ye hadees Rasoolullah (SAW) se ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai: Muhammad bin Abdul-A'la, Mu'tamir, Abu Uthman, Zuhair bin Amr, Qabisa bin Mukhariq ki sanad se.

1.ar: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ ‏{‏ وَأَنْذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ الأَقْرَبِينَ‏}‏ وَرَهْطَكَ مِنْهُمُ الْمُخْلَصِينَ ‏.‏ خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى صَعِدَ الصَّفَا فَهَتَفَ ‏"‏ يَا صَبَاحَاهْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا مَنْ هَذَا الَّذِي يَهْتِفُ قَالُوا مُحَمَّدٌ ‏.‏ فَاجْتَمَعُوا إِلَيْهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا بَنِي فُلاَنٍ يَا بَنِي فُلاَنٍ يَا بَنِي فُلاَنٍ يَا بَنِي عَبْدِ مَنَافٍ يَا بَنِي عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ ‏"‏ فَاجْتَمَعُوا إِلَيْهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَرَأَيْتَكُمْ لَوْ أَخْبَرْتُكُمْ أَنَّ خَيْلاً تَخْرُجُ بِسَفْحِ هَذَا الْجَبَلِ أَكُنْتُمْ مُصَدِّقِيَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا مَا جَرَّبْنَا عَلَيْكَ كَذِبًا ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَإِنِّي نَذِيرٌ لَكُمْ بَيْنَ يَدَىْ عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ أَبُو لَهَبٍ تَبًّا لَكَ أَمَا جَمَعْتَنَا إِلاَّ لِهَذَا ثُمَّ قَامَ فَنَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ السُّورَةُ تَبَّتْ يَدَا أَبِي لَهَبٍ وَقَدْ تَبَّ ‏.‏ كَذَا قَرَأَ الأَعْمَشُ إِلَى آخِرِ السُّورَةِ ‏.‏
1.en: It is reported on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that when this verse was revealed: " And warn thy nearest kindred" (and thy group of selected people among them) the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) set off till he climbed Safa' and called loudly: Be on your guard! They said: Who is it calling aloud? They said: Muhammad. They gathered round him, and he said: O sons of so and so, O sons of so and so, O sons of 'Abd Manaf, O sons of 'Abd al-Muttalib, and they gathered around him. He (the Apostle) said: If I were to inform you that there were horsemen emerging out of the foot of this mountain, would you believe me? They said: We have not experienced any lie from you. He said: Well, I am a warner to you before a severe torment. He (the narrator) said that Abu Lahab then said: Destruction to you! Is it for this you have gathered us? He (the Holy Prophet) then stood up, and this verse was revealed:" Perish the hands of Abu Lahab, and he indeed perished" (cxi. 1). A'mash recited this to the end of the Sura.
1.hi: Ibn Abbas se riwayat hai ki jab ye aayat nazil hui: 'Aur apne qareebi rishtedaaron ko khabardaar karo,' to Rasoolullah (SAW) chal pade yahan tak ki Safa par chadh gaye aur zor se pukaara: Khabardaar raho! Unhone kaha: Ye zor se pukaarne wala kaun hai? Unhone kaha: Muhammad. Wo unke ird-gird jama ho gaye, aur aap (SAW) ne kaha: Aye falaan ke bete, Aye falaan ke bete, Aye Bani Abd Manaf, Aye Bani Abdul-Muttalib, aur wo unke ird-gird jama ho gaye. Aap (SAW) ne kaha: Agar main tumhein bataaun ki is pahaad ke daaman se ghudsawaar nikal rahe hain, to kya tum mera yaqeen karoge? Unhone kaha: Humne aapse kabhi jhoot nahi suna. Aap (SAW) ne kaha: Achha, main tumhein ek sakht azaab se pehle khabardaar karne wala hoon. Unhone kaha ki phir Abu Lahab ne kaha: Tumhaari tabaahi ho! Kya is liye tumne humein jama kiya? Phir aap (SAW) khade ho gaye, aur ye aayat nazil hui: 'Abu Lahab ke haath tabaah hon, aur wo waaqai tabaah ho gaya' (111:1). A'mash ne ise poori Surah ke aakhir tak tilaawat kiya.

1.ar: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ قَالَ صَعِدَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ الصَّفَا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا صَبَاحَاهْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ أَبِي أُسَامَةَ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ نُزُولَ الآيَةِ ‏{‏ وَأَنْذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ الأَقْرَبِينَ‏}‏
1.en: This hadith was narrated by A'mash on the authority of the same chain of narrators and he said: One day the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) climbed the hill of Safa' and said: Be on your guard, and the rest of the hadith was narrated like the hadith transmitted by Usama; he made no mention of the revelation of the verse:" Warn thy nearest kindred."
1.hi: Ye hadees A'mash ne usi sanad se riwayat ki hai aur unhone kaha: Ek din Rasoolullah (SAW) Safa pahaad par chadhe aur kaha: Khabardaar raho, aur baaki hadees waisi hi bayan ki gayi jaisi Usama ki riwayat ki gayi hai; unhone 'apne qareebi rishtedaaron ko khabardaar karo' aayat ke nazil hone ka zikr nahi kiya.

1.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْقَوَارِيرِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرِ الْمُقَدَّمِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ الأُمَوِيُّ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ نَوْفَلٍ، عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَلْ نَفَعْتَ أَبَا طَالِبٍ بِشَىْءٍ فَإِنَّهُ كَانَ يَحُوطُكَ وَيَغْضَبُ لَكَ قَالَ ‏
"‏ نَعَمْ هُوَ فِي ضَحْضَاحٍ مِنْ نَارٍ وَلَوْلاَ أَنَا لَكَانَ فِي الدَّرْكِ الأَسْفَلِ مِنَ النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
1.en: It is reported on the authority of 'Abbas b. Abd al-Muttalib that he said: Messenger of Allah, have you benefited Abu Talib in any way for he defended you and was fervent in your defence? The Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) said: Yes; he would be in the most shallow part of the Fire and were not for me, he would have been in the bottom-most depth of Hell.
1.hi: Abbas bin Abdul-Muttalib ne kaha: Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, kya aap ne Abu Talib ko kisi tarah faayda pahunchaaya hai, kyunki unhone aapki hifazat ki aur aapke difaa mein josh dikhaaya? Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Haan; wo Aag ke sabse chhichhle hisse mein honge, aur agar main na hota, to wo Jahannam ki sabse gehri gehraayi mein hote.

1.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْعَبَّاسَ، يَقُولُ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ أَبَا طَالِبٍ كَانَ يَحُوطُكَ وَيَنْصُرُكَ فَهَلْ نَفَعَهُ ذَلِكَ قَالَ ‏
"‏ نَعَمْ وَجَدْتُهُ فِي غَمَرَاتٍ مِنَ النَّارِ فَأَخْرَجْتُهُ إِلَى ضَحْضَاحٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
1.en: Abdullah b. al-Harith reported: I heard Abbas say: I said: Messenger of Allah, verily Abu Talib defended you and helped you; would it be beneficial for him? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Yes; I found him in the lowest part of the Fire and I brought him to the shallow part.
1.hi: Abdullah bin al-Harith ne bataaya: Maine Abbas ko ye kehte suna: Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, beshak Abu Talib ne aapki hifazat ki aur aapki madad ki; kya ye unke liye faaydemand hoga? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Haan; maine unhein Aag ke sabse neeche hisse mein paaya aur main unhein chhichhle hisse mein le aaya.

1.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ عُمَيْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي الْعَبَّاسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ، ح 
 وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ أَبِي عَوَانَةَ ‏.‏
1.en: This hadith is narrated from the Apostle (ﷺ) like one narrated by Abu 'Uwana on the authority of the chain of transmitters like Muhammad b. Hatim, Yahya b. Sa'id, Abu Sufyan, 'Abbas b. 'Abd al-Muttalib and others.
1.hi: Ye hadees Rasool (SAW) se, Abu Uwana ki riwayat ki gayi hadees jaisi, ek aur sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai: Muhammad bin Hatim, Yahya bin Sa'id, Abu Sufyan, Abbas bin Abdul-Muttalib aur doosron ki sanad se.

1.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْهَادِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ خَبَّابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذُكِرَ عِنْدَهُ عَمُّهُ أَبُو طَالِبٍ فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ لَعَلَّهُ تَنْفَعُهُ شَفَاعَتِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَيُجْعَلُ فِي ضَحْضَاحٍ مِنْ نَارٍ يَبْلُغُ كَعْبَيْهِ يَغْلِي مِنْهُ دِمَاغُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
1.en: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported: A mention was made of his uncle Abu Talib before the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) He said: My intercession may benefit him on the Day of Resurrection and he may be placed in the shallow part of the Fire which would reach his ankles and his brain would be boiling.
1.hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne bataaya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ke saamne unke chacha Abu Talib ka zikr kiya gaya. Aap (SAW) ne kaha: Meri shafaa'at Qayamat ke Din unhein faayda pahuncha sakti hai aur unhein Aag ke aise chhichhle hisse mein rakha jaa sakta hai jo unke takhno tak pahunche aur jismein unka dimaag ubalta rahe.

1.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ أَبِي عَيَّاشٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ إِنَّ أَدْنَى أَهْلِ النَّارِ عَذَابًا يَنْتَعِلُ بِنَعْلَيْنِ مِنْ نَارٍ يَغْلِي دِمَاغُهُ مِنْ حَرَارَةِ نَعْلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
1.en: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported: Verily, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The least tormented of the inhabitants of the Fire would be he who would wear two shoes of Fire and his brain would boil on account of the heat of the shoes.
1.hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne bataaya: Beshak Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Jahannam ke rehne walon mein sabse kam azaab paane waala wo hoga jo Aag ki do jootiyaan pehnega aur jinki garmi se uska dimaag ubalta rahega.

1.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتٌ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ أَهْوَنُ أَهْلِ النَّارِ عَذَابًا أَبُو طَالِبٍ وَهُوَ مُنْتَعِلٌ بِنَعْلَيْنِ يَغْلِي مِنْهُمَا دِمَاغُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
1.en: Ibn 'Abbas reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: Among the inhabitants of the Fire Abu Talib would have the least suffering, and he would be wearing two shoes (of Fire) which would boil his brain.
1.hi: Ibn Abbas ne bataaya: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya: Jahannam ke rehne walon mein Abu Talib ka azaab sabse kam hoga, aur wo Aag ki do jootiyaan pehne honge jinse unka dimaag ubalta rahega.

1.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا إِسْحَاقَ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ النُّعْمَانَ بْنَ بَشِيرٍ، يَخْطُبُ وَهْوَ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏
"‏ إِنَّ أَهْوَنَ أَهْلِ النَّارِ عَذَابًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ لَرَجُلٌ تُوضَعُ فِي أَخْمَصِ قَدَمَيْهِ جَمْرَتَانِ يَغْلِي مِنْهُمَا دِمَاغُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
1.en: Nu'man b. Bashir was delivering an address and saying: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: the least suffering for the inhabitants of Hell on the Day of Resurrection would be for the man under whose soles would be placed two embers and his brain would boil on account of them.
1.hi: Nu'man bin Bashir khutba de rahe the aur keh rahe the: Maine Rasoolullah (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Qayamat ke Din Jahannam ke rehne walon ke liye sabse kam azaab us shaks ke liye hoga jiske talwon ke neeche do angaare rakhe jaayenge aur unse uska dimaag ubalta rahega.

1.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ إِنَّ أَهْوَنَ أَهْلِ النَّارِ عَذَابًا مَنْ لَهُ نَعْلاَنِ وَشِرَاكَانِ مِنْ نَارٍ يَغْلِي مِنْهُمَا دِمَاغُهُ كَمَا يَغْلِي الْمِرْجَلُ مَا يَرَى أَنَّ أَحَدًا أَشَدُّ مِنْهُ عَذَابًا وَإِنَّهُ لأَهْوَنُهُمْ عَذَابًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
1.en: Nu'man b. Bashir reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Verily the least suffering for the inhabitants of Fire would be for him who would have two shoes and two laces of Fire (on his feet), and with these would boil his brain as boils the cooking vessel, and he would think that he would not see anyone in a more grievous torment than him, whereas he would be in the least torment.
1.hi: Nu'man bin Bashir ne bataaya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Beshak Jahannam ke rehne walon mein sabse kam azaab us shaks ke liye hoga jiske paaon mein Aag ki do jootiyaan aur do fite honge, aur inse uska dimaag aise ubalega jaise khaana pakane ka bartan ubalta hai, aur wo sochega ki usse zyada takleefdeh azaab mein aur koi nahi hoga, jabki wo sabse kam azaab mein hoga.

1.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ابْنُ جُدْعَانَ كَانَ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ يَصِلُ الرَّحِمَ وَيُطْعِمُ الْمِسْكِينَ فَهَلْ ذَاكَ نَافِعُهُ قَالَ ‏
"‏ لاَ يَنْفَعُهُ إِنَّهُ لَمْ يَقُلْ يَوْمًا رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي خَطِيئَتِي يَوْمَ الدِّينِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
1.en: 'A'isha reported: I said: Messenger of Allah, the son of Jud'an established ties of relationship, fed the poor. Would that be of any avail to him? He said: It would be of no avail to him as he did not ever say: O my Lord, pardon my sins on the Day of Resurrection.
1.hi: Aisha ne bataaya: Maine kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, Ibn Jud'an ne rishtedaari ka lihaaz rakha, gareebon ko khaana khilaaya. Kya iska use koi faayda hoga? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Iska use koi faayda nahi hoga kyunki usne kabhi ye nahi kaha: Aye mere Rab, Qayamat ke Din mere gunah maaf kar de.

1.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم جِهَارًا غَيْرَ سِرٍّ يَقُولُ ‏
"‏ أَلاَ إِنَّ آلَ أَبِي - يَعْنِي فُلاَنًا - لَيْسُوا لِي بِأَوْلِيَاءَ إِنَّمَا وَلِيِّيَ اللَّهُ وَصَالِحُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
1.en: 'Amr b. 'As reported: I heard it from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) quite audibly and not secretly: Behold! the posterity of my fathers, that is, so and so, are not my friends. Verily Allah and the pious believers are my friends.
1.hi: Amr bin al-As ne bataaya: Maine ye Rasoolullah (SAW) se bilkul saaf aur khuli tarah suna, chhupa kar nahi: Sun lo! Mere baap-daada ki aulaad, yaani falaan-falaan, mere dost nahi hain. Beshak Allah aur nek momineen hi mere dost hain.

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ سَلاَّمِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ الْجُمَحِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الرَّبِيعُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُسْلِمٍ - عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ يَدْخُلُ مِنْ أُمَّتِي الْجَنَّةَ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفًا بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ مِنْهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَامَ آخَرُ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ سَبَقَكَ بِهَا عُكَّاشَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
1.en: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Seventy thousand (persons) of my Ummah would enter Paradise without rendering an account. Upon this a person said: Messenger of Allah. pray to Allah that He make me one of them. He (the Holy Prophet) said: O Allah! make him one of them. Then another stood up and said: Messenger of Allah, pray to Allah that He make me one of them. He (the Holy Prophet) said: 'Ukkasha has preceded you in this matter.
1.hi: Abu Huraira se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Meri Ummat mein se sattar hazaar (70,000) log bagair kisi hisaab ke Jannat mein daakhil honge. Is par ek shaks ne kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, Allah se dua kijiye ki Wo mujhe unmein se ek banaaye. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Aye Allah, use unmein se ek banaa de. Phir ek aur shaks khada hua aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, Allah se dua kijiye ki Wo mujhe unmein se ek banaaye. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Ukkasha is maamle mein tumse aage nikal gaye.

1.ar: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ زِيَادٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ الرَّبِيعِ ‏.‏
1.en: Muhammad b. Ziyad reported: I heard Abu Huraira narrate this: I heard it from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying a hadith like one narrated by al-Rabi'.
1.hi: Muhammad bin Ziyad ne bataaya: Maine Abu Huraira ko ye riwayat karte suna: Maine ye Rasoolullah (SAW) se suna, al-Rabi ki riwayat ki gayi hadees jaisi.

1.ar: حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، حَدَّثَهُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ يَدْخُلُ مِنْ أُمَّتِي زُمْرَةٌ هُمْ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفًا تُضِيءُ وُجُوهُهُمْ إِضَاءَةَ الْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ الْبَدْرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ فَقَامَ عُكَّاشَةُ بْنُ مِحْصَنٍ الأَسَدِيُّ يَرْفَعُ نَمِرَةً عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ مِنْهُمْ ‏"‏ ثُمَّ قَامَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ سَبَقَكَ بِهَا عُكَّاشَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
1.en: Abu Huraira reported: I heard it from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: A group of my Ummah consisting of seventy thousand persons would enter Paradise; their faces would be as bright as the brightness of the full moon. Abd Huraira said: 'Ukkasha b. Mihsan al-Asadi then stood up wrapping the blanket around him and said: Messenger of Allah, supplicate (before) Allah that He should make me one among them. Upon this the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: O Allah, make him among them. Then stood up a man from the Ansa and said: Messenger of Allah, pray to Allah that He should make me one among them. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Ukkasha has preceded you in this matter.
1.hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Maine ye Rasoolullah (SAW) se suna, unhone farmaya: Meri Ummat ka ek giroh, sattar hazaar (70,000) logon par mushtamil, Jannat mein daakhil hoga; unke chehre poore chaand ki chamak jaise roshan honge. Abu Huraira ne kaha: Ukkasha bin Mihsan al-Asadi phir apni chaadar lapete khade hue aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, Allah se dua kijiye ki Wo mujhe unmein se ek banaaye. Is par Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Aye Allah, use unmein se ek banaa de. Phir Ansaar mein se ek shaks khada hua aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, Allah se dua kijiye ki Wo mujhe unmein se ek banaaye. Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Ukkasha is maamle mein tumse aage nikal gaye.

1.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي حَيْوَةُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو يُونُسَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ مِنْ أُمَّتِي سَبْعُونَ أَلْفًا زُمْرَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ مِنْهُمْ عَلَى صُورَةِ الْقَمَرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
1.en: Abu Huraira reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Seventy thousand (persons) would enter Paradise as one group and among them (there would be people) whom faces would be bright like the moon.
1.hi: Abu Huraira ne bataaya: Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Sattar hazaar (70,000) log ek giroh ke soorat mein Jannat mein daakhil honge aur unmein aise log bhi honge jinke chehre chaand ki tarah roshan honge.

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ خَلَفٍ الْبَاهِلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ حَسَّانَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سِيرِينَ - قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عِمْرَانُ، قَالَ قَالَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ مِنْ أُمَّتِي سَبْعُونَ أَلْفًا بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا وَمَنْ هُمْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ هُمُ الَّذِينَ لاَ يَكْتَوُونَ وَلاَ يَسْتَرْقُونَ وَعَلَى رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَامَ عُكَّاشَةُ فَقَالَ ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَنْتَ مِنْهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَامَ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ سَبَقَكَ بِهَا عُكَّاشَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
1.en: It is reported on the authority of 'Imran that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Seventy thousand people of my Ummah would be admitted into Paradise without rendering any account. They (the companions) said: Who would be of those (fortunate persons)? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Those who do not cauterise and practise charm, but repose trust in their Lord, 'Ukkasha then stood up and said: Supplicate (before) Allah that He should make me one among them. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Thou art one among them He (the narrator) said: A man stood up and said: Apostle of Allah, supplicate (before) Allah that He should make me one among them. He (the Prophet said: 'Ukkasha has preceded you (in this matter).
1.hi: Imran se riwayat hai ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Meri Ummat ke sattar hazaar (70,000) log bagair kisi hisaab ke Jannat mein daakhil kiye jaayenge. Unhone kaha: Wo kaun honge? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Wo jo na daagh lagaate hain na jhaad-phoonk karwaate hain, balki apne Rab par bharosa rakhte hain. Ukkasha phir khade hue aur kaha: Dua kijiye ki Wo mujhe unmein se ek banaaye. Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Tum unmein se ek ho. Unhone kaha: Ek shaks khada hua aur kaha: Ya Rasoolullah, Allah se dua kijiye ki Wo mujhe unmein se ek banaaye. Aap (SAW) ne kaha: Ukkasha is maamle mein tumse aage nikal gaye.

1.ar: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَاجِبُ بْنُ عُمَرَ أَبُو خُشَيْنَةَ الثَّقَفِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ مِنْ أُمَّتِي سَبْعُونَ أَلْفًا بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا مَنْ هُمْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ هُمُ الَّذِينَ لاَ يَسْتَرْقُونَ وَلاَ يَتَطَيَّرُونَ وَلاَ يَكْتَوُونَ وَعَلَى رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
1.en: 'Imran b. Husain reported: Verily the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Seventy thousand men of my Ummah would enter Paradise without rendering account. They (the companions of the Holy Prophet) said: Who would be those, Messenger of Allah? He (the Holy Prophet) said: They would be those who neither practise charm, not take omens, nor do they cauterise, but they repose their trust in their Lord.
1.hi: Imran bin Husain ne bataaya: Beshak Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Meri Ummat ke sattar hazaar (70,000) log bagair kisi hisaab ke Jannat mein daakhil honge. Unhone kaha: Wo kaun honge, Ya Rasoolullah? Aap (SAW) ne farmaya: Wo honge jo na jhaad-phoonk karwaate hain, na shaguni lete hain, na daagh lagaate hain, balki apne Rab par bharosa rakhte hain.

1.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ أَبِي حَازِمٍ - عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ لَيَدْخُلَنَّ الْجَنَّةَ مِنْ أُمَّتِي سَبْعُونَ أَلْفًا أَوْ سَبْعُمِائَةِ أَلْفٍ - لاَ يَدْرِي أَبُو حَازِمٍ أَيَّهُمَا قَالَ - مُتَمَاسِكُونَ آخِذٌ بَعْضُهُمْ بَعْضًا لاَ يَدْخُلُ أَوَّلُهُمْ حَتَّى يَدْخُلَ آخِرُهُمْ وُجُوهُهُمْ عَلَى صُورَةِ الْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ الْبَدْرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
1.en: Abu Hazim narrated it on the authority of Ibn Sa'd that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Seventy thousand persons or seven hundred thousand persons (Abu Hazim does not remember the exact number) would enter Paradise holding and supporting one another, and the first among them would not enter till the last among them would enter (therein) ; (they would enter simultaneously) and their faces would be bright like the full moon.
1.hi: Abu Hazim ne ise Ibn Sa'd ki sanad se riwayat kiya ki Rasoolullah (SAW) ne farmaya: Sattar hazaar (70,000) log ya saat lakh (700,000) log (Abu Hazim ko sahi tadaad yaad nahi) ek doosre ko thaamte aur sahaara dete hue Jannat mein daakhil honge, aur unmein se pehla tab tak daakhil nahi hoga jab tak aakhri wala daakhil na ho jaaye; aur unke chehre poore chaand ki tarah roshan honge.

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا حُصَيْنُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ كُنْتُ عِنْدَ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ فَقَالَ أَيُّكُمْ رَأَى الْكَوْكَبَ الَّذِي انْقَضَّ الْبَارِحَةَ قُلْتُ أَنَا ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قُلْتُ أَمَا إِنِّي لَمْ أَكُنْ فِي صَلاَةٍ وَلَكِنِّي لُدِغْتُ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَمَاذَا صَنَعْتَ قُلْتُ اسْتَرْقَيْتُ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَمَا حَمَلَكَ عَلَى ذَلِكَ قُلْتُ حَدِيثٌ حَدَّثَنَاهُ الشَّعْبِيُّ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ وَمَا حَدَّثَكُمُ الشَّعْبِيُّ قُلْتُ حَدَّثَنَا عَنْ بُرَيْدَةَ بْنِ حُصَيْبٍ الأَسْلَمِيِّ أَنَّهُ قَالَ لاَ رُقْيَةَ إِلاَّ مِنْ عَيْنٍ أَوْ حُمَةٍ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ قَدْ أَحْسَنَ مَنِ انْتَهَى إِلَى مَا سَمِعَ وَلَكِنْ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ عُرِضَتْ عَلَىَّ الأُمَمُ فَرَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ وَمَعَهُ
