15.en: Salim b. Abdullah reported his father (Allah be pleased with him) saying: I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entering the Ka'ba, and Usama b. Zaid, Bilal and 'Uthman b. Talha were along with him, but none (else) entered therein along with them. Then the door was closed for them from within. 'Abdullah b. Umar (Allah be pleased with them) said: Bilal and Uthman b. Talha informed me that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) observed prayer in the interior of the Ka'ba between the two Yemenite pillars.
15.hi: Salim bin Abdullah ne apne walid (RA) ko ye kehte suna: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Kaaba mein daakhil hote dekha, aur Usama bin Zaid, Bilal aur Uthman bin Talha unke saath the, lekin unke saath koi aur usmein daakhil nahi hua. Phir unke liye darwaza andar se band kar diya gaya. Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne kaha: Bilal aur Uthman bin Talha ne mujhe bataya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Kaaba ke andar do Yemani khambon ke beech namaz padhi.

15.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ بَكْرٍ، قَالَ عَبْدٌ أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لِعَطَاءٍ أَسَمِعْتَ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ يَقُولُ إِنَّمَا أُمِرْتُمْ بِالطَّوَافِ وَلَمْ تُؤْمَرُوا بِدُخُولِهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ لَمْ يَكُنْ يَنْهَى عَنْ دُخُولِهِ وَلَكِنِّي سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ أَخْبَرَنِي أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمَّا دَخَلَ الْبَيْتَ دَعَا فِي نَوَاحِيهِ كُلِّهَا وَلَمْ يُصَلِّ فِيهِ حَتَّى خَرَجَ فَلَمَّا خَرَجَ رَكَعَ فِي قُبُلِ الْبَيْتِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏
"‏ هَذِهِ الْقِبْلَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ لَهُ مَا نَوَاحِيهَا أَفِي زَوَايَاهَا قَالَ بَلْ فِي كُلِّ قِبْلَةٍ مِنَ الْبَيْتِ ‏.‏
15.en: Ibn Juraij reported: I said to 'Ata': Have you heard Ibn 'Abbas saying: You have been commanded to observe circumambulation, and not commanded to enter it (the Ka'ba)? He ('Ata') said: He (Ibn Abbas) (at the same time) did not forbid entrance into it. I, however, heard him saying: Usama b. Zaid informed me that when Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) entered the House, he supplicated in all sides of it; and he did not observe prayer therein till he came out, and as he came out he observed two rak'ahs in front of the House, and said: This is your Qibla. I said to him: What is meant by its sides? Does that mean its corners? He said: (In all sides and nooks of the House) there is Qibla.
15.hi: Ibn Juraij ne bayan kiya: Maine Ata se kaha: Kya aapne Ibn Abbas ko ye kehte suna hai: Tumhe tawaaf karne ka hukum diya gaya hai, na ki isme, Kaaba mein, daakhil karne ka? Unhone kaha: Unhone isi waqt isme daakhil hone se mana nahi kiya. Maine, halaanki, unhe ye kehte suna: Usama bin Zaid ne mujhe bataya ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ghar mein daakhil kiya, unhone iski har taraf dua ki; aur unhone wahan namaz nahi padhi jab tak woh bahar nahi aaye, aur jab woh bahar aaye, unhone Ghar ke saamne do rakat padhi, aur kaha: Ye tumhara Qibla hai. Maine unse kaha: Iski taraf ka kya matlab hai? Kya iska matlab uske konay hain? Unhone kaha: Ghar ki har taraf aur konay mein Qibla hai.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَطَاءٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَخَلَ الْكَعْبَةَ وَفِيهَا سِتُّ سَوَارٍ فَقَامَ عِنْدَ سَارِيَةٍ فَدَعَا وَلَمْ يُصَلِّ ‏.‏
15.en: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) entered the Ka'ba, and in it there were six pillars, and he stood near a pillar and made supplication, but did not observe the prayer.
15.hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Kaaba mein daakhil kiya, aur usmein chhe khambe the, aur woh ek khambe ke qareeb khade hue aur dua ki, lekin namaz nahi padhi.

15.ar: وَحَدَّثَنِي سُرَيْجُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنِي هُشَيْمٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي أَوْفَى صَاحِبِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَدَخَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْبَيْتَ فِي عُمْرَتِهِ قَالَ لاَ ‏.‏
15.en: Isma'il b. Abu Khalid reported: I asked Abdullah b. Abu Aufa (Allah be pleased with him), a Companion of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), whether Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) had entered the House, while performing 'Umra, He said: NO.
15.hi: Ismail bin Abu Khalid ne bayan kiya: Maine Abdullah bin Abu Aufa (RA), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke sahabi, se poocha ki kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Umra karte waqt Ghar mein daakhil kiya tha. Unhone kaha: Nahi.

15.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ لَوْلاَ حَدَاثَةُ عَهْدِ قَوْمِكِ بِالْكُفْرِ لَنَقَضْتُ الْكَعْبَةَ وَلَجَعَلْتُهَا عَلَى أَسَاسِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ فَإِنَّ قُرَيْشًا حِينَ بَنَتِ الْبَيْتَ اسْتَقْصَرَتْ وَلَجَعَلْتُ لَهَا خَلْفًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
15.en: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: Allah's Messenger may peace be upon him) said to me: Had your people not been unbelievers in the recent past (had they not quite recently accepted Islam), I would have demolished the Ka'ba and would have rebuilt it on the foundation (laid) by Ibrahim; for when the Quraish had built the Ka'ba, they reduced its (area), and I would also have built (a door) in the rear.
15.hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse kaha: Agar tumhari qaum haal hi tak kaafir na hoti, agar unhone bahut haal mein Islam qubool na kiya hota, to main Kaaba ko toda deta aur use us buniyaad par phir se banaata jo Ibrahim ne rakhi thi; kyunki jab Quraish ne Kaaba banaaya, unhone iska kshetra chhota kar diya, aur main peechhe ek darwaza bhi bana deta.

15.ar: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
15.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters.
15.hi: Ye hadees Hisham ki sanad se isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقِ، أَخْبَرَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ أَلَمْ تَرَىْ أَنَّ قَوْمَكِ حِينَ بَنَوُا الْكَعْبَةَ اقْتَصَرُوا عَنْ قَوَاعِدِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَفَلاَ تَرُدُّهَا عَلَى قَوَاعِدِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَوْلاَ حِدْثَانُ قَوْمِكِ بِالْكُفْرِ لَفَعَلْتُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ لَئِنْ كَانَتْ عَائِشَةُ سَمِعَتْ هَذَا مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا أُرَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَرَكَ اسْتِلاَمَ الرُّكْنَيْنِ اللَّذَيْنِ يَلِيَانِ الْحِجْرَ إِلاَّ أَنَّ الْبَيْتَ لَمْ يُتَمَّمْ عَلَى قَوَاعِدِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ‏.‏
15.en: 'A'isha, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as having said this: Didn't you see that when your people built the Ka'ba, they reduced (its area with the result that it no longer remains) on the foundations (laid) by Ibrahim. I said: Messenger of Allah, why don't you rebuild it on the foundations (laid by) Ibrahim? Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Had your people not been new converts to Islam, I would have done that. 'Abdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) said: If 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) had heard it from Allah's Messenger (may peace be up (vn him), I would not have seen Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) abandoning the touching of the two corners situated near al-Hijr, but (for the fact) that it was not completed on the foundations (laid) by Ibrihim.
15.hi: Aisha, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Kya tumne nahi dekha ki jab tumhari qaum ne Kaaba banaaya, unhone iska kshetra chhota kar diya jiske natije mein ye Ibrahim ki rakhi hui buniyaad par nahi rahi. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aap ise Ibrahim ki rakhi hui buniyaad par phir se kyun nahi banaate? Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Agar tumhari qaum abhi-abhi Islam mein na aayi hoti, to main aisa kar deta. Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne kaha: Agar Aisha (RA) ne ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna hota, to maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko al-Hijr ke qareeb sthit do konon ko chhoote na dekha hota, lekin is baat ki wajah se ki ye Ibrahim ki buniyaad par mukammal nahi thi.

15.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ مَخْرَمَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ، بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مَخْرَمَةُ بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ نَافِعًا، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عُمَرَ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ أَبِي قُحَافَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏
"‏ لَوْلاَ أَنَّ قَوْمَكِ حَدِيثُو عَهْدٍ بِجَاهِلِيَّةٍ - أَوْ قَالَ بِكُفْرٍ - لأَنْفَقْتُ كَنْزَ الْكَعْبَةِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَلَجَعَلْتُ بَابَهَا بِالأَرْضِ وَلأَدْخَلْتُ فِيهَا مِنَ الْحِجْرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
15.en: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her), wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If your people, had not been recent converts to Islam, I would have spent the treasure of the Ka'ba in the way of Allah and would have constructed its door just on the level of the ground and would have encompassed in it the space of Hijr.
15.hi: Aisha (RA), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar tumhari qaum abhi-abhi Islam mein aayi na hoti, to main Kaaba ka khazaana Allah ki raah mein kharch kar deta aur uska darwaza zameen ke barabar bana deta aur usmein Hijr ki jagah shaamil kar leta.

15.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا سَلِيمُ بْنُ حَيَّانَ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مِينَاءَ - قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ، يَقُولُ حَدَّثَتْنِي خَالَتِي، - يَعْنِي عَائِشَةَ - قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ يَا عَائِشَةُ لَوْلاَ أَنَّ قَوْمَكِ حَدِيثُو عَهْدٍ بِشِرْكٍ لَهَدَمْتُ الْكَعْبَةَ فَأَلْزَقْتُهَا بِالأَرْضِ وَجَعَلْتُ لَهَا بَابَيْنِ بَابًا شَرْقِيًّا وَبَابًا غَرْبِيًّا وَزِدْتُ فِيهَا سِتَّةَ أَذْرُعٍ مِنَ الْحِجْرِ فَإِنَّ قُرَيْشًا اقْتَصَرَتْهَا حَيْثُ بَنَتِ الْكَعْبَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
15.en: 'Abdullah b. Zubair (Allah be pleased with him) reported on the authority of his mother's sister ('A'isha) saying that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: 'A'isha, if your people had not been recently polytheists (and new converts to Islam), I would have demolished the Ka'ba, and would have brought it to the level of the ground and would have constructed two doors, one facing the east and the other one to the west, and would have added to it six cubits of area from Hijr, for the Quraish had reduced it when they rebuilt it.
15.hi: Abdullah bin Zubair (RA) ne apni maasi, Aisha, ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Aisha, agar tumhari qaum haal hi mein mushrik na rahi hoti, aur nayi Musalman na hui hoti, to main Kaaba ko todkar zameen ke barabar la deta aur do darwaze banaata, ek poorab ki taraf aur doosra paschim ki taraf, aur Hijr se chhe haath kshetra jodta, kyunki Quraish ne ise chhota kar diya tha jab unhone ise phir se banaaya.

15.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا هَنَّادُ بْنُ السَّرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، قَالَ لَمَّا احْتَرَقَ الْبَيْتُ زَمَنَ يَزِيدَ بْنِ مُعَاوِيَةَ حِينَ غَزَاهَا أَهْلُ الشَّامِ فَكَانَ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ مَا كَانَ تَرَكَهُ ابْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ حَتَّى قَدِمَ النَّاسُ الْمَوْسِمَ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يُجَرِّئَهُمْ - أَوْ يُحَرِّبَهُمْ - عَلَى أَهْلِ الشَّامِ فَلَمَّا صَدَرَ النَّاسُ قَالَ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ أَشِيرُوا عَلَىَّ فِي الْكَعْبَةِ أَنْقُضُهَا ثُمَّ أَبْنِي بِنَاءَهَا أَوْ أُصْلِحُ مَا وَهَى مِنْهَا قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ فَإِنِّي قَدْ فُرِقَ لِي رَأْىٌ فِيهَا أَرَى أَنْ تُصْلِحَ مَا وَهَى مِنْهَا وَتَدَعَ بَيْتًا أَسْلَمَ النَّاسُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَحْجَارًا أَسْلَمَ النَّاسُ عَلَيْهَا وَبُعِثَ عَلَيْهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ابْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ لَوْ كَانَ أَحَدُكُمُ احْتَرَقَ بَيْتُهُ مَا رَضِيَ حَتَّى يُجِدَّهُ فَكَيْفَ بَيْتُ رَبِّكُمْ إِنِّي مُسْتَخِيرٌ رَبِّي ثَلاَثًا ثُمَّ عَازِمٌ عَلَى أَمْرِي فَلَمَّا مَضَى الثَّلاَثُ أَجْمَعَ رَأْيَهُ عَلَى أَنْ يَنْقُضَهَا فَتَحَامَاهُ النَّاسُ أَنْ يَنْزِلَ بِأَوَّلِ النَّاسِ يَصْعَدُ فِيهِ أَمْرٌ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ حَتَّى صَعِدَهُ رَجُلٌ فَأَلْقَى مِنْهُ حِجَارَةً فَلَمَّا لَمْ يَرَهُ النَّاسُ أَصَابَهُ شَىْءٌ تَتَابَعُوا فَنَقَضُوهُ حَتَّى بَلَغُوا بِهِ الأَرْضَ فَجَعَلَ ابْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ أَعْمِدَةً فَسَتَّرَ عَلَيْهَا السُّتُورَ حَتَّى ارْتَفَعَ بِنَاؤُهُ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ عَائِشَةَ تَقُولُ إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ لَوْلاَ أَنَّ النَّاسَ حَدِيثٌ عَهْدُهُمْ بِكُفْرٍ وَلَيْسَ عِنْدِي مِنَ النَّفَقَةِ مَا يُقَوِّي عَلَى بِنَائِهِ لَكُنْتُ أَدْخَلْتُ فِيهِ مِنَ الْحِجْرِ خَمْسَ أَذْرُعٍ وَلَجَعَلْتُ لَهَا بَابًا يَدْخُلُ النَّاسُ مِنْهُ وَبَابًا يَخْرُجُونَ مِنْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَنَا الْيَوْمَ أَجِدُ مَا أُنْفِقُ وَلَسْتُ أَخَافُ النَّاسَ - قَالَ - فَزَادَ فِيهِ خَمْسَ أَذْرُعٍ مِنَ الْحِجْرِ حَتَّى أَبْدَى أُسًّا نَظَرَ النَّاسُ إِلَيْهِ فَبَنَى عَلَيْهِ الْبِنَاءَ وَكَانَ طُولُ الْكَعْبَةِ ثَمَانِيَ عَشْرَةَ ذِرَاعًا فَلَمَّا زَادَ فِيهِ اسْتَقْصَرَهُ فَزَادَ فِي طُولِهِ عَشَرَ أَذْرُعٍ وَجَعَلَ لَهُ بَابَيْنِ أَحَدُهُمَا يُدْخَلُ مِنْهُ وَالآخَرُ يُخْرَجُ مِنْهُ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا قُتِلَ ابْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ كَتَبَ الْحَجَّاجُ إِلَى عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ مَرْوَانَ يُخْبِرُهُ بِذَلِكَ وَيُخْبِرُهُ أَنَّ ابْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ قَدْ وَضَعَ الْبِنَاءَ عَلَى أُسٍّ نَظَرَ إِلَيْهِ الْعُدُولُ مِنْ أَهْلِ مَكَّةَ ‏.‏ فَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ إِنَّا لَسْنَا مِنْ تَلْطِيخِ ابْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ فِي شَىْءٍ أَمَّا مَا زَادَ فِي طُولِهِ فَأَقِرَّهُ وَأَمَّا مَا زَادَ فِيهِ مِنَ الْحِجْرِ فَرُدَّهُ إِلَى بِنَائِهِ وَسُدَّ الْبَابَ الَّذِي فَتَحَهُ ‏.‏ فَنَقَضَهُ وَأَعَادَهُ إِلَى بِنَائِهِ ‏.‏
15.en: 'Ata' reported: The House was burnt during the time of Yazid b. Muawiya when the people of Syria had fought (in Mecca). And it happened with it (the Ka'ba) what was (in store for it). Ibn Zubair (Allah be pleased with him) felt it (in the same state) until the people came in the season (of Hajj). (The idea behind was) that he wanted to exhort them or incite them (to war) against the people of Syria. When the people had arrived he said to them: O people, advise me about the Ka'ba. Should I demolish it and then build it from its very foundation, or should I repair whatever has been damaged of it? Ibn 'Abbas said: An idea has occurred to me according to which I think that you should only repair (the portion which has been) damaged, and leave the House (in that very state in which) people embraced Islam (and leave those very stones in the same state) when people embraced Islam, and over which Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) had raised it. Thereupon Ibn Zubair said: It the house of any one of you is burnt, he would not be contented until he had reconstructed it, then what about the House of your Lord (which is far more Important than your house)? I would seek good advice from my Lord thrice and then I would make up (my mind) about this affair. After seeking good advice thrice, he made up his mind to demolish it. The people apprehended that calamity might fall from heaven on those persons who would be first to climb (over the building for the purpose of demolishing it), till one (took up courage, and ascended the roof), and threw down one of its stones. When the people saw no calamity befalling him, they followed him, demolished it until it was razed to the ground. Then Ibn Zubair erected pillars and hung cartains on them (in order to provide facilities to the people for observing the time of its construction). And the walls were raised; and Ibn Zubair said: I heard 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) say that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) had observed: If the people had Rot recently (abandoned) unbelief, find I had means enough to reconstruct it, which I had not, I would have definitely excompassed in it five cubits of area from Hijr. And I would also have constructed a door for the people to enter, and a door for their exit. I today have (the means to spend) and I entertain no fearfrom the side of people (that they would protest against this change). So he added five cubits of area from the side of Hatim to it that there appeared (the old) foundation (upon which Hadrat Ibrahim had built the Ka'ba). and the people saw that and it was upon this foundation that the wall was raised. The length of the Ka'ba was eighteen cubits. when addition was made to it (which was in its breadth), then naturally the length appears to be) small (as compared with its breadth). Then addition of ten cubits (of area) was made in its length (also). Two doors were also constructed, one of which (was meant) for entrance and the other one for exit. When Ibn Zubair (Allah be pleased with him) was killed, Hajjaj wrote to 'Abd al-Malik (b. Marwan) informing him about it, and telling him that Ibn Zubair (Allah be pleased with him) had built (the Ka'ba) on those very foundations (which were laid by Ibrahim) and which reliable persons among the Meccans had seen. 'Abd al-Malik wrote to him: We are not concerned with the censuring of Ibn Zubair in anything. Keep intact the addition made by him in the side of length, and whatever he has added frem the side of Hijr revert to (its previous) foundation, and wall up the door which he had opened. Thus Hajjaj at the command of Abd al-Malik) demolished it (that portion) and rebuilt it on (its previous) foundations.
15.hi: Ata ne bayan kiya: Ghar Yazid bin Muawiya ke daur mein jal gaya jab Syria ke log Makkah mein lade the. Aur iske saath, Kaaba ke saath, woh hua jo iske liye muqarrar tha. Ibn Zubair (RA) ne ise isi haalat mein mehsoos kiya jab tak log Hajj ke mausam mein na aa gaye. Iske peeche ye soch thi ki woh unhe Syria ke logon ke khilaaf ubhaarna ya bhadkaana chahte the. Jab log aa gaye, unhone unse kaha: Aye logo, mujhe Kaaba ke baare mein salaah do. Kya mujhe ise todkar iski buniyaad se banaana chahiye, ya jo bhi iska nuksaan hua hai use theek karna chahiye? Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Mujhe ek khayal aaya hai jiske mutabik mujhe lagta hai ki aapko sirf, nuksaan huye hisse ki, marammat karni chahiye, aur Ghar ko usi halat mein chhodna chahiye jismein log Islam mein aaye the, aur usi patthar ki halat mein chhodna chahiye jab log Islam mein aaye, aur jispar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ise uthaaya tha. Isper Ibn Zubair ne kaha: Agar tum mein se kisi ka ghar jal jaaye, to woh tab tak santusht nahi hota jab tak use dobara nahi banaata, to phir tumhare Rab ke Ghar ka kya, jo tumhare ghar se kahin zyada ahem hai? Main apne Rab se teen baar achhi salaah maangunga aur phir iske baare mein apna faisla lunga. Teen baar achhi salaah maangne ke baad, unhone ise todne ka faisla kiya. Logon ko dar tha ki kahin aasmaan se aafat na aa jaaye un logon par jo sabse pehle, imaarat par chadhkar ise todne ke liye, chadhein, yahan tak ki ek ne himmat ki, aur chhat par chadha, aur uska ek patthar neeche phenka. Jab logon ne dekha ki uspar koi aafat nahi aayi, unhone uska anusaran kiya, ise toda yahan tak ki ye zameen ke barabar ho gaya. Phir Ibn Zubair ne khambe khade kiye aur unpar parde latka diye, taaki logon ko iski taamir ka waqt dekhne ki suvidha mil sake. Aur deewaren buland ki gayin; aur Ibn Zubair ne kaha: Maine Aisha (RA) ko ye kehte suna ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne bayaan kiya tha: Agar log haal hi mein kufr chhod na aaye hote, aur mere paas ise phir se banaane ke kaafi saadhan hote, jo mere paas nahi the, to main ismein Hijr se paanch haath ka kshetra zaroor shaamil karta. Aur main logon ke daakhil hone ke liye ek darwaza aur unke bahar jaane ke liye ek darwaza bhi banaata. Aaj mere paas kharch karne ke saadhan hain aur mujhe logon ki taraf se koi dar nahi hai, ki woh is badlaav ka virodh karenge. To unhone Hatim ki taraf se paanch haath ka kshetra ismein joda taaki puraani buniyaad zaahir ho jaaye, jispar Hazrat Ibrahim ne Kaaba banaaya tha. Aur logon ne ye dekha aur isi buniyaad par deewaar khadi ki gayi. Kaaba ki lambaai atharah haath thi. Jab ismein izafa kiya gaya, jo iski chaudai mein tha, to swaabhaavik soorat se lambaai chhoti, chaudai ke muqable, dikhne lagi. Phir das haath kshetra ka izafa iski lambaai mein bhi kiya gaya. Do darwaze bhi banaaye gaye, jinmein se ek daakhil hone ke liye tha aur doosra bahar jaane ke liye. Jab Ibn Zubair (RA) ko qatal kiya gaya, Hajjaj ne Abd al-Malik, bin Marwan, ko iske baare mein bataate hue likha, aur unhe bataya ki Ibn Zubair (RA) ne isi buniyaad par Kaaba banaaya tha, jo Ibrahim ne rakhi thi, aur jise Makkah ke bharosemand logon ne dekha tha. Abd al-Malik ne unhe likha: Humein Ibn Zubair ki kisi bhi baat mein nindaa karne ka koi lena-dena nahi hai. Unke ke zariye ki gayi lambaai ki taraf ki barhoutari ko waisi hi rehne do, aur jo bhi unhone Hijr ki taraf se joda hai use waapas, pichhli, buniyaad par le aao, aur us darwaze ko band karo jo unhone khola tha. To Hajjaj ne, Abd al-Malik ke hukum par, use toda aur pichhli buniyaadon par phir se banaaya.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ، اللَّهِ بْنَ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ وَالْوَلِيدَ بْنَ عَطَاءٍ يُحَدِّثَانِ عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبِيعَةَ، قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ وَفَدَ الْحَارِثُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَى عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ مَرْوَانَ فِي خِلاَفَتِهِ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ مَا أَظُنُّ أَبَا خُبَيْبٍ - يَعْنِي ابْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ - سَمِعَ مِنْ عَائِشَةَ مَا كَانَ يَزْعُمُ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَهُ مِنْهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ الْحَارِثُ بَلَى أَنَا سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ سَمِعْتَهَا تَقُولُ مَاذَا قَالَ قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ قَوْمَكِ اسْتَقْصَرُوا مِنْ بُنْيَانِ الْبَيْتِ وَلَوْلاَ حَدَاثَةُ عَهْدِهِمْ بِالشِّرْكِ أَعَدْتُ مَا تَرَكُوا مِنْهُ فَإِنْ بَدَا لِقَوْمِكِ مِنْ بَعْدِي أَنْ يَبْنُوهُ فَهَلُمِّي لأُرِيَكِ مَا تَرَكُوا مِنْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَرَاهَا قَرِيبًا مِنْ سَبْعَةِ أَذْرُعٍ ‏.‏ هَذَا حَدِيثُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ وَزَادَ عَلَيْهِ الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ عَطَاءٍ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَلَجَعَلْتُ لَهَا بَابَيْنِ مَوْضُوعَيْنِ فِي الأَرْضِ شَرْقِيًّا وَغَرْبِيًّا وَهَلْ تَدْرِينَ لِمَ كَانَ قَوْمُكِ رَفَعُوا بَابَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ قُلْتُ لاَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ تَعَزُّزًا أَنْ لاَ يَدْخُلَهَا إِلاَّ مَنْ أَرَادُوا فَكَانَ الرَّجُلُ إِذَا هُوَ أَرَادَ أَنْ يَدْخُلَهَا يَدْعُونَهُ يَرْتَقِي حَتَّى إِذَا كَادَ أَنْ يَدْخُلَ دَفَعُوهُ فَسَقَطَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ لِلْحَارِثِ أَنْتَ سَمِعْتَهَا تَقُولُ هَذَا قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ فَنَكَتَ سَاعَةً بِعَصَاهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ وَدِدْتُ أَنِّي تَرَكْتُهُ وَمَا تَحَمَّلَ.
15.en: Abdullah b. 'Ubaid reported that Harith b. 'Abdullah led a deputation to 'Abd al-Malik b. Marwan during his caliphate. 'Abd al-Malik said: I do riot think that Abu Khubaib (i. e. Ibn Zabair) had heard from 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) (about the intended wish of the Prophet [may peace be upon him) In regard to the alteration of the Ka'ba). Harith said: Yes, I myself did hear from her. He ('Abd al-Malik) said: Well, tell me what you heard from her. He stated that she (Hadrat 'A'isha) had said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) remarked: Verily your people have reduced (the area) of the House from its (original foundations, and if they had not recently abandoned polytheism (and embraced Islam) I would have reversed it to (those foundations) which they had left out of it. nd if your people would take initiative after me in rebuilding it, then come along with me so that I should show you what they have left out of it. He showed her about fifteen cubits of area from the side of Hatim (that they had separated). This is the narration transmitted by 'Abdullah b. Ubaid. Walid b. 'Ata' has, however, made this addition to it:" Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: I would have made two doors on the level of the ground (facing) the east and the west. Do you know why your people raised the level of its door (i. e. the door of the Ka'ba)? She said: No. He said: (They did it) out of vanity so that (they might be in a position) to grant admittance to him only whom they wished. When a person intended to get into it, they let him climb (the stairs), and as he was about to enter, they pushed him and he fell down." 'Abd al-Malik said to Harith; Did you yourself hear her saying this? He said: Yes. He (Harith) said that he ('Abd al-Malik) scratched the ground with his staff for some time and then said: I wish I had left his (Ibn Zubair's) work there.
15.hi: Abdullah bin Ubaid ne bayan kiya ki Harith bin Abdullah ne Abd al-Malik bin Marwan ke daur mein unki khilafat ke daurane ek prtinidhi mandal ki agvaani ki. Abd al-Malik ne kaha: Mujhe nahi lagta ki Abu Khubaib, yaani Ibn Zubair, ne Aisha (RA) se suna hoga, Nabi ki Kaaba mein badlaav ki iraadi khwahish ke baare mein. Harith ne kaha: Haan, maine khud unse suna. Unhone kaha: Achha, mujhe bataao aapne unse kya suna. Unhone bataya ki unhone, Hazrat Aisha ne, kaha tha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Yaqeenan tumhari qaum ne Ghar ka kshetra uski asal buniyaad se chhota kar diya, aur agar unhone haal hi mein shirk chhoda na hota, aur Islam qubool na kiya hota, to main use un buniyaadon par wapas le aata jinhe unhone chhoda tha. Aur agar tumhari qaum mere baad ise phir se banaane ki pahal karti, to mere saath aana taaki main tumhe dikha sakoon jo unhone chhoda hai. Unhone unhe Hatim ki taraf se pandrah haath ka kshetra dikhaaya, jise unhone alag kar diya tha. Ye riwayat Abdullah bin Ubaid ne di hai. Walid bin Ata ne, halaanki, isme ye izafa kiya: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Main zameen ke barabar do darwaze banaata, poorab aur paschim ki taraf. Kya tumhe pata hai tumhari qaum ne kyun uske darwaze, Kaaba ke darwaze, ki oonchai badhaayi? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Unhone kaha: Unhone ye ghamand ki wajah se kiya taaki woh isme takht mein sirf usi ko daakhil karein jise woh chaahein. Jab koi shakhs usmein daakhil hona chahta, woh use seedhiyon par chadhne dete, aur jab woh daakhil hone hi wala hota, woh use dhakel dete aur woh gir jaata." Abd al-Malik ne Harith se kaha: Kya aapne khud unhe ye kehte suna? Unhone kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha ki unhone apni chhadi se kuch der zameen khurchi aur phir kaha: Kaash maine unka, Ibn Zubair ka, kaam wahin chhod diya hota.

15.ar: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ جَبَلَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ بَكْرٍ ‏.‏
15.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Juraij with the same chain of transmitters.
15.hi: Ye hadees Juraij ki sanad se isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai.

15.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ بَكْرٍ السَّهْمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمُ بْنُ أَبِي، صَغِيرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي قَزَعَةَ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ الْمَلِكِ بْنَ مَرْوَانَ، بَيْنَمَا هُوَ يَطُوفُ بِالْبَيْتِ إِذْ قَالَ قَاتَلَ اللَّهُ ابْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ حَيْثُ يَكْذِبُ عَلَى أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُهَا تَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ يَا عَائِشَةُ لَوْلاَ حِدْثَانُ قَوْمِكِ بِالْكُفْرِ لَنَقَضْتُ الْبَيْتَ حَتَّى أَزِيدَ فِيهِ مِنَ الْحِجْرِ فَإِنَّ قَوْمَكِ قَصَّرُوا فِي الْبِنَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ الْحَارِثُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبِيعَةَ لاَ تَقُلْ هَذَا يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ فَأَنَا سَمِعْتُ أُمَّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ تُحَدِّثُ هَذَا ‏.‏ قَالَ لَوْ كُنْتُ سَمِعْتُهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَهْدِمَهُ لَتَرَكْتُهُ عَلَى مَا بَنَى ابْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ ‏.‏
15.en: Abu Qaza'ah reported that while Abd al-Malik b. Marwan was circumambulating the Ka'ba he said: May Allah ruin Ibn Zubair that he lies in attributing to the Mother of the Faithful, as he says: I heard her stating that Allah's Messenger (may'peace be upon him) had said: 'A'isha, if your people had not been new converts to Islam, I would have demolished the House and would have added (in it area) from the Hijr for your people have reduced the area from its foundations. Harith b. 'Abdullah b. Abu Rabi'a (Allah be pleased with him) said: Commander of the Faithful, don't say that, for I heard the Mother of the Faithful saying this, whereupon he said: If I had heard this before demolishing it, I would have left it in the state in which Ibn Zabair had built it.
15.hi: Abu Qaza'a ne bayan kiya ki jab Abd al-Malik bin Marwan Kaaba ka tawaaf kar rahe the, unhone kaha: Allah Ibn Zubair ko barbaad kare ki woh Ummul-Momineen se mansoob karte hue jhoot bolte hain, jaisa woh kehte hain: Maine unhe ye kehte suna ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha tha: Aisha, agar tumhari qaum nayi Musalman na hoti, to main Ghar ko toda deta aur iska kshetra Hijr se badha deta kyunki tumhari qaum ne buniyaad se iska kshetra chhota kar diya. Harith bin Abdullah bin Abu Rabi'a (RA) ne kaha: Ameer-ul-Momineen, ye mat kahiye, kyunki maine khud Ummul-Momineen ko ye kehte suna, isper unhone kaha: Agar maine ye ise todne se pehle suna hota, to main ise usi haalat mein chhod deta jismein Ibn Zubair ne ise banaaya tha.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَشْعَثُ بْنُ أَبِي الشَّعْثَاءِ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْجَدْرِ أَمِنَ الْبَيْتِ هُوَ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ فَلِمَ لَمْ يُدْخِلُوهُ فِي الْبَيْتِ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ قَوْمَكِ قَصَّرَتْ بِهِمُ النَّفَقَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ فَمَا شَأْنُ بَابِهِ مُرْتَفِعًا قَالَ ‏"‏ فَعَلَ ذَلِكِ قَوْمُكِ لِيُدْخِلُوا مَنْ شَاءُوا وَيَمْنَعُوا مَنْ شَاءُوا وَلَوْلاَ أَنَّ قَوْمَكِ حَدِيثٌ عَهْدُهُمْ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ فَأَخَافَ أَنْ تُنْكِرَ قُلُوبُهُمْ لَنَظَرْتُ أَنْ أُدْخِلَ الْجَدْرَ فِي الْبَيْتِ وَأَنْ أُلْزِقَ بَابَهُ بِالأَرْضِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
15.en: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported: I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about the wall, circumpassing the House (i. e. whether the wall on the side of Hijr was included in the Ka'ba). He said, Yes. I said: Then why did they not include it in the House? He said: 'Your people ran short of the means (to do so). I said: Why is it that the level of its door is raised high? He said: Your people did it so that they should admit one whom they liked, and forbid him whom they disliked, and if your people were not new converts to faith, and I did not apprehend that their hearts would feel agitated at this. I would have definitely included (the area of) this wall-in the House and would have brought the door to the level of the ground.
15.hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se Ghar ke aas-paas ki deewaar ke baare mein poocha, yaani kya Hijr ki taraf ki deewaar Kaaba mein shaamil thi. Unhone kaha: Haan. Maine kaha: To phir unhone ise Ghar mein kyun shaamil nahi kiya? Unhone kaha: Tumhari qaum ke paas aisa karne ke saadhan kam pad gaye the. Maine kaha: Aisa kyun hai ki iske darwaze ki oonchai buland hai? Unhone kaha: Tumhari qaum ne aisa is liye kiya taaki woh usi ko andar aane dein jise woh pasand karte hain, aur usse rokein jise woh napasand karte hain, aur agar tumhari qaum nayi imaan waali na hoti, aur mujhe dar na hota ki isse unke dilon mein hulchul hogi, to main zaroor is deewaar ke kshetra ko Ghar mein shaamil karta aur darwaze ko zameen ke barabar laata.

15.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُوسَى - حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ بْنِ أَبِي الشَّعْثَاءِ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْحِجْرِ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ أَبِي الأَحْوَصِ وَقَالَ فِيهِ فَقُلْتُ فَمَا شَأْنُ بَابِهِ مُرْتَفِعًا لاَ يُصْعَدُ إِلَيْهِ إِلاَّ بِسُلَّمٍ وَقَالَ ‏
"‏ مَخَافَةَ أَنْ تَنْفِرَ قُلُوبُهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
15.en: 'A'isha reported: I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about Hijr, and the rest of the hadith is the same. I also said: Why is it that the door has been made on a higher level, and one cannot (get into it) but with the help of a ladder? The rest of the hadith is the same as reported above and the concluding words are: (I do not change it) out of the apprehension that their hearts may disapprove of it."
15.hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se Hijr ke baare mein poocha, aur baaki hadees waisi hi hai. Maine ye bhi kaha: Aisa kyun hai ki darwaza itni oonchai par banaaya gaya hai, aur ismein daakhil sirf seedhi ki madad se hi hua ja sakta hai? Baaki hadees waisi hi hai jaisi upar bayan hui aur aakhri alfaaz hain: "Main ise nahi badalta is dar se ki kahin unke dilon mein iski napasandeegi na paida ho jaaye."

15.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ، يَسَارٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ كَانَ الْفَضْلُ بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ رَدِيفَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَجَاءَتْهُ امْرَأَةٌ مِنْ خَثْعَمَ تَسْتَفْتِيهِ فَجَعَلَ الْفَضْلُ يَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهَا وَتَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِ فَجَعَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَصْرِفُ وَجْهَ الْفَضْلِ إِلَى الشِّقِّ الآخَرِ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ فَرِيضَةَ اللَّهِ عَلَى عِبَادِهِ فِي الْحَجِّ أَدْرَكَتْ أَبِي شَيْخًا كَبِيرًا لاَ يَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ يَثْبُتَ عَلَى الرَّاحِلَةِ أَفَأَحُجُّ عَنْهُ قَالَ ‏
"‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَذَلِكَ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ ‏.‏
15.en: 'Abdullah b. 'Abbas reported that while al-Fadl b. Abbas had been riding behind Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) a women of the tribe of Khath'am came to him (to the Holy Proppet) asking for a religious verdict. Fadl looked at her and she looked at him. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) turned the face of al-Fadl to the other side. She said: Messenger of Allah, there is an obligation from Allah upon His servants in regard to Hajj. (But) my father is an aged man; he is incapable of riding safely. May I perform Hajj on his behalf? He said: Yes. It was during the Farewell Pilgrimage.
15.hi: Abdullah bin Abbas ne bayan kiya ki jab al-Fadl bin Abbas Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke peeche sawaar the, Khath'am qabile ki ek aurat unke paas aayi ek mazhabi fatwe ke liye poochhte hue. Fadl ne unhe dekha aur unhone Fadl ko dekha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne al-Fadl ka chehra doosri taraf moda. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Allah ki taraf se apne bandon par Hajj ka farz hai. Lekin mere waalid ek boodhe aadmi hain; woh mahfooz tarike se sawaari nahi kar sakte. Kya main unki taraf se Hajj kar sakti hoon? Unhone kaha: Haan. Ye Vida ke Hajj ke daurane tha.

15.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ خَشْرَمٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ يَسَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنِ الْفَضْلِ، أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، مِنْ خَثْعَمَ قَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ أَبِي شَيْخٌ كَبِيرٌ عَلَيْهِ فَرِيضَةُ اللَّهِ فِي الْحَجِّ وَهُوَ لاَ يَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ يَسْتَوِيَ عَلَى ظَهْرِ بَعِيرِهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ فَحُجِّي عَنْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
15.en: Fadl reported that a woman of Banu Khath'am said: Messenger of Allah, my father is very old. There is an old obligation of Hajj upon him from Allah, but he is not capable of sitting on the back of the camel. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Perform Hajj on his behalf.
15.hi: Fadl ne bayan kiya ki Banu Khath'am ki ek aurat ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mere waalid bahut boodhe hain. Unpar Allah ki taraf se Hajj ka ek puraana farz hai, lekin woh oont ki peeth par baithne mein saksham nahi hain. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Unki taraf se Hajj karo.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ، عُيَيْنَةَ - قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، - عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَقِيَ رَكْبًا بِالرَّوْحَاءِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَنِ الْقَوْمُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا الْمُسْلِمُونَ ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا مَنْ أَنْتَ قَالَ ‏"‏ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَرَفَعَتْ إِلَيْهِ امْرَأَةٌ صَبِيًّا فَقَالَتْ أَلِهَذَا حَجٌّ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ وَلَكِ أَجْرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
15.en: Ibn Abbas reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) met some riders at al-Rauha and asked who they were. They replied that they were Muslims. They said: Who art thou? He said: (I am) Messengef of Allah. A woman (then) lifted up a boy to him and said: Would this child be credited with having performed the Hajj? Thereupon he said: Yes, and you will have a reward.
15.hi: Ibn Abbas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) al-Rauha mein kuch sawaaron se mile aur poocha ki woh kaun hain. Unhone jawab diya ki woh Musalman hain. Unhone kaha: Aap kaun hain? Unhone kaha: Main Allah ka Rasool hoon. Ek aurat ne phir ek bachche ko unki taraf uthaaya aur kaha: Kya is bachche ko Hajj karne ka sawaab milega? Isper unhone kaha: Haan, aur tumhe bhi sawaab milega.

15.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ، عُقْبَةَ عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ رَفَعَتِ امْرَأَةٌ صَبِيًّا لَهَا فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَلِهَذَا حَجٌّ قَالَ ‏
"‏ نَعَمْ وَلَكِ أَجْرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
15.en: Ibn Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported: A woman lifted up her child and said: Messenger of Allah, would the child be credited with having performed the Hajj? Thereupon he said: Yes, and there would be a reward for you.
15.hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Ek aurat ne apne bachche ko uthaaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya bachche ko Hajj ka sawaab milega? Isper unhone kaha: Haan, aur tumhe bhi sawaab milega.

15.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، رَفَعَتْ صَبِيًّا فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَلِهَذَا حَجٌّ قَالَ ‏
"‏ نَعَمْ وَلَكِ أَجْرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
15.en: Karaib reported: A woman lifted a child and said: Messenger of Allah, would he be credited with Hajj? He said: Yes. and for you there would be a reward.
15.hi: Kuraib ne bayan kiya: Ek aurat ne ek bachche ko uthaaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya use Hajj ka sawaab milega? Unhone kaha: Haan, aur tumhe bhi sawaab milega.

15.ar: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
15.en: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas through another chain of transmitters.
15.hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Ibn Abbas ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

15.ar: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَخْبَرَنَا الرَّبِيعُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ الْقُرَشِيُّ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ خَطَبَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ قَدْ فَرَضَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمُ الْحَجَّ فَحُجُّوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ أَكُلَّ عَامٍ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَسَكَتَ حَتَّى قَالَهَا ثَلاَثًا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَوْ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ لَوَجَبَتْ وَلَمَا اسْتَطَعْتُمْ - ثُمَّ قَالَ - ذَرُونِي مَا تَرَكْتُكُمْ فَإِنَّمَا هَلَكَ مَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ بِكَثْرَةِ سُؤَالِهِمْ وَاخْتِلاَفِهِمْ عَلَى أَنْبِيَائِهِمْ فَإِذَا أَمَرْتُكُمْ بِشَىْءٍ فَأْتُوا مِنْهُ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُمْ وَإِذَا نَهَيْتُكُمْ عَنْ شَىْءٍ فَدَعُوهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
15.en: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) addressed us and said: O people, Allah has made Hajj obligatory for you; so perform Hajj. Thereupon a person said: Messenger of Allah, (is it to be performed) every year? He (the Holy Prophet) kept quiet, and he repeated (these words) thrice, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: If I were to say" Yes," it would become obligatory (for you to perform it every year) and you would not be able to do it. Then he said: Leave me with what I have left to you, for those who were before you were desroyed because of excessive questioning, and their opposition to their apostles. So when I command you to do anything, do it as much as it lies in your power and when I forbid you to do anything, then abandon it.
15.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humse khitaab kiya aur kaha: Aye logo, Allah ne tumpar Hajj farz kiya hai; is liye Hajj karo. Isper ek shakhs ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya ise har saal karna hai? Unhone khamoshi rakhi, aur unhone, us shakhs ne, ye teen baar dohraaya, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Agar main "Haan" kehta, to ye farz ho jaata, har saal ise karna, aur tum aisa kar nahi paate. Phir unhone kaha: Mujhe usi cheez ke saath chhod do jo maine tumhare liye chhoda hai, kyunki tumse pehle log tabaah ho gaye kyunki unhone bahut sawaal poochhe, aur apne Nabiyon ka virodh kiya. Is liye jab main tumhe kisi cheez ka hukum dun, use jitna ho sake karo, aur jab main tumhe kisi cheez se mana karun, to use chhod do.

15.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ الْقَطَّانُ - عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ لاَ تُسَافِرِ الْمَرْأَةُ ثَلاَثًا إِلاَّ وَمَعَهَا ذُو مَحْرَمٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
15.en: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A woman should not set out on three (days' journey) except when she has a Mahram with her.
15.hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek aurat teen din ke safar par tab tak na nikle jab tak uske saath Mahram na ho.

15.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، وَأَبُو أُسَامَةَ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي جَمِيعًا، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ فِي رِوَايَةِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ فَوْقَ ثَلاَثٍ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، ‏
"‏ ثَلاَثَةً إِلاَّ وَمَعَهَا ذُو مَحْرَمٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
15.en: This hadith has been narrated on the same authority by Ubaidullah. And in the narration of Abu Bakr (the words are): " More than three (days)." Ibn Numair narrated on the authority of his father, (and the words are):" Three (days) except (when) she has a Mahram with her."
15.hi: Ye hadees Ubaidullah ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai. Aur Abu Bakr ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: "Teen din se zyada." Ibn Numair ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki, aur alfaaz hain: "Teen din siwaay jab uske saath Mahram ho."

15.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا الضَّحَّاكُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ لاَ يَحِلُّ لاِمْرَأَةٍ تُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ تُسَافِرُ مَسِيرَةَ ثَلاَثِ لَيَالٍ إِلاَّ وَمَعَهَا ذُو مَحْرَمٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
15.en: 'Abdullah b. Umar (Allah -be pleased with them) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: It is not lawful for a woman who believes in Allah and the Hereafter to travel for more than three nights journey except when there is a Mahram with her.
15.hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Us aurat ke liye jaayez nahi hai jo Allah aur Aakhirat par imaan rakhti ho ki woh teen raaton ke safar se zyada ke liye safar kare jab tak uske saath Mahram na ho.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَعُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، - قَالَ قُتَيْبَةُ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عُمَيْرٍ - عَنْ قَزَعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مِنْهُ، حَدِيثًا فَأَعْجَبَنِي فَقُلْتُ لَهُ أَنْتَ سَمِعْتَ هَذَا، مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ فَأَقُولُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا لَمْ أَسْمَعْ قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ تَشُدُّوا الرِّحَالَ إِلاَّ إِلَى ثَلاَثَةِ مَسَاجِدَ مَسْجِدِي هَذَا وَالْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ وَالْمَسْجِدِ الأَقْصَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَسَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لاَ تُسَافِرِ الْمَرْأَةُ يَوْمَيْنِ مِنَ الدَّهْرِ إِلاَّ وَمَعَهَا ذُو مَحْرَمٍ مِنْهَا أَوْ زَوْجُهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
15.en: Qaza'ah reported: I heard a hadith from Abu Sa'id (Allah be pleased with him) and it impressed me (very much), so I said to him: Did you hear it (yourself) from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? Thereupon he said: (Can) I speak of anything about Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) which I did not bear? He said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying: Do not set out on a journey (for religious devotion) but for the three mosques-for this mosque of mine (at Medina) the Sacred Mosque (at Mecca), and the Mosque al-Aqsa (Bait al-Maqdis), and I heard him saying also: A woman should not travel for two days duration, but only when there is a Mahram with her or her husband.
15.hi: Qaza'a ne bayan kiya: Maine Abu Sa'id (RA) se ek hadees suni aur usne mujhe bahut prabhaavit kiya, is liye maine unse kaha: Kya aapne ise khud Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna? Isper unhone kaha: Kya main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke baare mein aisi koi baat keh sakta hoon jo maine khud na suni ho? Unhone kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Deeni fariziyat ke liye safar sirf teen masjidon ke liye karo - meri is masjid ke liye, Madina mein, Masjid al-Haram, Makkah mein, aur Masjid al-Aqsa, Bait al-Maqdis, aur maine unhe ye bhi kehte suna: Ek aurat do din ke safar par na nikle, siwaay iske ki uske saath Mahram ya uska shohar ho.

15.ar: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ، عُمَيْرٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ قَزَعَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مِنْ، رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَرْبَعًا فَأَعْجَبْنَنِي وَآنَقْنَنِي نَهَى أَنْ تُسَافِرَ الْمَرْأَةُ مَسِيرَةَ يَوْمَيْنِ إِلاَّ وَمَعَهَا زَوْجُهَا أَوْ ذُو مَحْرَمٍ ‏.‏ وَاقْتَصَّ بَاقِيَ الْحَدِيثِ ‏.‏
15.en: Qaza'ah reported: I heard Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) saying: I heard four things from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) which impressed me and captivated me (and one out of these is this), that he forbade a woman to undertake journey extending over two days but with her husband, or with a Mahram; and he then narrated the rest of the hadith.
15.hi: Qaza'a ne bayan kiya: Maine Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ko ye kehte suna: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se chaar cheezein sunin jinhone mujhe prabhaavit kiya aur mera dil moh liya, aur unmein se ek ye hai, ki unhone ek aurat ko do din se zyada ke safar par jaane se mana kiya siwaay uske shohar ya Mahram ke saath; aur phir unhone baaki hadees bayan ki.

15.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ سَهْمِ بْنِ، مِنْجَابٍ عَنْ قَزَعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ لاَ تُسَافِرِ الْمَرْأَةُ ثَلاَثًا إِلاَّ مَعَ ذِي مَحْرَمٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
15.en: Abu Sa'id (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A woman should not set out on three (days') journey, but in the company of a Mahram.
15.hi: Abu Sa'id (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek aurat teen din ke safar par na nikle, lekin Mahram ki sohbat mein.

15.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو غَسَّانَ الْمِسْمَعِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ، - قَالَ أَبُو غَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذٌ، - حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ قَزَعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ لاَ تُسَافِرِ امْرَأَةٌ فَوْقَ ثَلاَثِ لَيَالٍ إِلاَّ مَعَ ذِي مَحْرَمٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
15.en: Abu Sa'id Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: A woman should not set out on a journey extending beyond three nights but with a Mahram.
15.hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek aurat teen raaton se zyada ke safar par na nikle, lekin Mahram ke saath.

15.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ ‏
"‏ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ثَلاَثٍ إِلاَّ مَعَ ذِي مَحْرَمٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
15.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Qatada with the same chain of transmitters and he said: " More than three (days) except in the company of a Mahram."
15.hi: Ye hadees Qatada ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai aur unhone kaha: "Teen din se zyada siwaay Mahram ki sohbat mein."

15.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ لاَ يَحِلُّ لاِمْرَأَةٍ مُسْلِمَةٍ تُسَافِرُ مَسِيرَةَ لَيْلَةٍ إِلاَّ وَمَعَهَا رَجُلٌ ذُو حُرْمَةٍ مِنْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
15.en: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: It is not lawful for a Muslim woman to travel a night's journey except when there is a Mahram with her.
15.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Musalman aurat ke liye ek raat ka safar karna jaayez nahi hai siwaay iske ki uske saath Mahram ho.

15.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ، بْنُ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ لاَ يَحِلُّ لاِمْرَأَةٍ تُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ تُسَافِرُ مَسِيرَةَ يَوْمٍ إِلاَّ مَعَ ذِي مَحْرَمٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
15.en: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: It is not lawful for a woman who believes in Allah and the Hereafter to undertake a day's journey except in the company of a Mahram.
15.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Us aurat ke liye jaayez nahi hai jo Allah aur Aakhirat par imaan rakhti ho ki woh ek din ka safar kare siwaay Mahram ki sohbat mein.

15.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ لاَ يَحِلُّ لاِمْرَأَةٍ تُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ تُسَافِرُ مَسِيرَةَ يَوْمٍ وَلَيْلَةٍ إِلاَّ مَعَ ذِي مَحْرَمٍ عَلَيْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
15.en: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: It is not lawful for a woman believing in Allah and the Hereafter to undertake journey extending over a day and a night except when there is a Mahram with her.
15.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Us aurat ke liye jaayez nahi hai jo Allah aur Aakhirat par imaan rakhti ho ki woh ek din aur ek raat ka safar kare jab tak uske saath Mahram na ho.

15.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُفَضَّلٍ - حَدَّثَنَا سُهَيْلُ بْنُ، أَبِي صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ لاَ يَحِلُّ لاِمْرَأَةٍ أَنْ تُسَافِرَ ثَلاَثًا إِلاَّ وَمَعَهَا ذُو مَحْرَمٍ مِنْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
15.en: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: It is not lawful for a woman to undertake three (days, ) journey except when there is a Mahram with her.
15.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Aurat ke liye teen din ka safar karna jaayez nahi hai jab tak uske saath Mahram na ho.

15.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ جَمِيعًا - عَنْ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ، قَالَ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، - عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ لاَ يَحِلُّ لاِمْرَأَةٍ تُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ أَنْ تُسَافِرَ سَفَرًا يَكُونُ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ فَصَاعِدًا إِلاَّ وَمَعَهَا أَبُوهَا أَوِ ابْنُهَا أَوْ زَوْجُهَا أَوْ أَخُوهَا أَوْ ذُو مَحْرَمٍ مِنْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
15.en: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: It is not lawful for a woman believing in Allah and the Hereafter to undertake journey extending over three days or more, except when she is in the company of her father, or her son, or her husband, or her brother, or any other Mahram.
15.hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Us aurat ke liye jaayez nahi hai jo Allah aur Aakhirat par imaan rakhti ho ki woh teen din ya usse zyada ka safar kare, siwaay iske ki woh apne waalid, ya apne bete, ya apne shohar, ya apne bhai, ya kisi doosre Mahram ki sohbat mein ho.

15.ar: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
15.en: A hadith like this has been narrated by A'mash with the same chain of transmitters.
15.hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees A'mash ne isi sanad se riwayat ki hai.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، - قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، - حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْبَدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَخْطُبُ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لاَ يَخْلُوَنَّ رَجُلٌ بِامْرَأَةٍ إِلاَّ وَمَعَهَا ذُو مَحْرَمٍ وَلاَ تُسَافِرِ الْمَرْأَةُ إِلاَّ مَعَ ذِي مَحْرَمٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَامَ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ امْرَأَتِي خَرَجَتْ حَاجَّةً وَإِنِّي اكْتُتِبْتُ فِي غَزْوَةِ كَذَا وَكَذَا ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ انْطَلِقْ فَحُجَّ مَعَ امْرَأَتِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
15.en: Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) delivering a sermon and making this observation:" No person should be alone with a woman except when there is a Mahram with her, and the woman should not undertake journey except with a Mahram." A person stood up and said: Allah's Messenger, my wife has set out for pilgrimage, whereas I am enlisted to fight in such and such battle, whereupon he said:" You go and perform Hajj with your wife."
15.hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko khutba dete aur ye kehte suna: "Koi bhi shakhs kisi aurat ke saath akela na rahe siwaay iske ki uske saath Mahram ho, aur aurat ko Mahram ke bagair safar nahi karna chahiye." Ek shakhs khada hua aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, meri biwi Hajj ke liye nikli hai, jabki mera naam ek fauji abhiyaan mein likha gaya hai, falan-falan jung ke liye, isper unhone kaha: "Jao aur apni biwi ke saath Hajj karo."

15.ar: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
15.en: A hadith like this has been narrated by 'Amr on the authority of the same chain of transmitters.
15.hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Amr ne isi sanad se riwayat ki hai.

15.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سُلَيْمَانَ - الْمَخْزُومِيُّ عَنِ ابْنِ، جُرَيْجٍ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ ‏
"‏ لاَ يَخْلُوَنَّ رَجُلٌ بِامْرَأَةٍ إِلاَّ وَمَعَهَا ذُو مَحْرَمٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
15.en: Ibn Juraij narrated this hadith with the same chain of transmitters, but he made no mention of it: " No person (man) should be alone with a woman except when there is a Mahram with her."
15.hi: Ibn Juraij ne ye hadees isi sanad se riwayat ki, lekin unhone iska koi zikr nahi kiya: "Koi bhi shakhs, mard, kisi aurat ke saath akela na rahe siwaay iske ki uske saath Mahram ho."

15.ar: حَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ عَلِيًّا الأَزْدِيَّ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ عَلَّمَهُمْ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا اسْتَوَى عَلَى بَعِيرِهِ خَارِجًا إِلَى سَفَرٍ كَبَّرَ ثَلاَثًا ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الأَهْلِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالأَهْلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا رَجَعَ قَالَهُنَّ ‏.‏ وَزَادَ فِيهِنَّ ‏"‏ آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
15.en: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) mounted his camel while setting out on a journey, he glorified Allah (uttered Allah-o-Akbar) thrice, and then said: Hallowed is He Who subdued for us this (ride) and we were not ourselves powerful enough to use It as a ride, and we are going to return to our Lord. O Allah, we seek virtue and piety from Thee in this journey of ours and the act which pleaseth Thee. O Allah, lighten this journey of ours, and make its distance easy for us. O Allah, Thou art (our) companion during the journey, and guardian of (our) family. O Allah, I seek refuge with Thee from hardships of the journey, gloominess of the sights, and finding of evil changes in property and family on return. And he (the Holy Prophet) uttered (these words), and made this addition to them: We are returning, repentant, worshipping our Lord. and praising Him.
15.hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab bhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apne oont par sawaar hote safar shuru karte waqt, woh Allah ki tasbeeh karte, teen baar Allahu Akbar kehte, aur phir kehte: Muqaddas hai Woh jisne humare liye ye sawaari muskhar kar di jabki hum khud isse sawaari ke taur par istemal karne ki taaqat nahi rakhte, aur hum apne Rab ki taraf laut ne wale hain. Aye Allah, hum Tujhse achhaai aur takwa maangte hain apni is safar mein aur woh amal jo Tujhe pasand ho. Aye Allah, humare is safar ko aasaan bana, aur iski doori humare liye sahi kar de. Aye Allah, Tu safar mein hamara saathi hai, aur hamare khaandaan ka rakshak. Aye Allah, main Teri panah maangta hoon safar ki mushkilon se, manzaron ki udaasi se, aur wapas aane par maal aur khaandaan mein buri tabdeeliyaan paane se. Aur unhone ye alfaaz kahe, aur isme ye izafa kiya: Hum wapas aa rahe hain, tauba karte hue, apne Rab ki ibadat karte hue, aur uski tareef karte hue.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ الأَحْوَلِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ بْنِ سَرْجِسَ قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا سَافَرَ يَتَعَوَّذُ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ وَكَآبَةِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ وَالْحَوْرِ بَعْدَ الْكَوْرِ وَدَعْوَةِ الْمَظْلُومِ وَسُوءِ الْمَنْظَرِ فِي الأَهْلِ وَالْمَالِ‏.‏
15.en: Abdullah b. Sarjis (Allah be pleased with him) reported that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) set forth on a journey, he sought refuge (with Allah) from the hardships of the travelling, and finding of evil changes on return, and disgrace after honour, and the curse of the oppressed and a gloomy sad scene in family and property.
15.hi: Abdullah bin Sarjis (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) safar par nikalte the, woh Allah se safar ki mushkilon se panah maangte, aur wapas aane par buri tabdeeliyaan paane se, izzat ke baad zillat se, aur mazloom ki bad-dua se, aur khaandaan aur maal mein ek udaas manzar se.

15.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي حَامِدُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي حَدِيثِ عَبْدِ الْوَاحِدِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالأَهْلِ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَازِمٍ قَالَ يَبْدَأُ بِالأَهْلِ إِذَا رَجَعَ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَتِهِمَا جَمِيعًا ‏
"‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
15.en: A hadlth like this has been narrated on the authority of Asim With the same chain of transmitters except (this difference) that the hadith transmitted by 'Abd al-Wahid (one of the narrators) the (word)" property" precedes the family, and in the hadith transmitted by Mahammad b. Khazim (the word)" family" precedes (theword" Property" ), on returning home, in the narrations of both the narrators (these words are found): " O Allah I seek refuge with Thee from the hardships of the journey."
15.hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Asim ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai siwaay is farq ke ki Abd al-Wahid, ek raawi, ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein alfaaz "maal" khaandaan se pehle aata hai, aur Muhammad bin Khazim ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein alfaaz "khaandaan", alfaaz "maal" se, pehle aata hai, ghar wapas aate waqt, dono raawiyon ki riwayat mein ye alfaaz milte hain: "Aye Allah main safar ki mushkilon se Teri panah maangta hoon."

15.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، ح .
 وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ الْقَطَّانُ - عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا قَفَلَ مِنَ الْجُيُوشِ أَوِ السَّرَايَا أَوِ الْحَجِّ أَوِ الْعُمْرَةِ إِذَا أَوْفَى عَلَى ثَنِيَّةٍ أَوْ فَدْفَدٍ كَبَّرَ ثَلاَثًا ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏
"‏ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ سَاجِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ صَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَعْدَهُ وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ وَهَزَمَ الأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
15.en: Abdullah b. 'Umar reported that whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came back from the battle or from expeditions or from Hajj or Umra and as he reached the top of the hillock or upon the elevated hard ground, he uttered Allah-o- Akbar thrice, and then said: There is no god but Allah. He is One, there is no partner with Him, His is the sovereignty and His is the praise and He is Potent over everything. (We are) returning, repenting, worshipping, prostrating before our Lord, and we praise Him Allah fulfilled His promise and helped His servant, and routed the confederates alone.
15.hi: Abdullah bin Umar ne bayan kiya ki jab bhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) jung se ya muhimon se ya Hajj ya Umra se wapas aate aur jab woh pahaadi ke shikhar par ya buland kathor zameen par pahunchte, woh teen baar Allahu Akbar kehte, aur phir kehte: Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi. Woh Ek hai, uska koi shareek nahi, uski hi baadshahat hai aur uski hi tareef hai aur Woh har cheez par Qaadir hai. Hum wapas aa rahe hain, tauba karte hue, ibadat karte hue, apne Rab ke aage sajda karte hue, aur hum uski tareef karte hain. Allah ne apna wada poora kiya aur apne banda ki madad ki, aur ittihaadi giroahon ko akele shikast di.

15.ar: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عُلَيَّةَ - عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْنٌ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا الضَّحَّاكُ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ إِلاَّ حَدِيثَ أَيُّوبَ فَإِنَّ فِيهِ التَّكْبِيرَ مَرَّتَيْنِ ‏.‏
15.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Umar through another chain of transmitters (but with one alteration) that here Allah-o-Akbar is mentioned twice.
15.hi: Ye hadees Ibn Umar ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin ek badlaav ke saath, ki yahan Allahu Akbar do baar zikr hua hai.

15.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ قَالَ أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ أَقْبَلْنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَا وَأَبُو طَلْحَةَ ‏.‏ وَصَفِيَّةُ رَدِيفَتُهُ عَلَى نَاقَتِهِ حَتَّى إِذَا كُنَّا بِظَهْرِ الْمَدِينَةِ قَالَ ‏
"‏ آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلَمْ يَزَلْ يَقُولُ ذَلِكَ حَتَّى قَدِمْنَا الْمَدِينَةَ ‏.‏
15.en: Anas b. Malik (Allah be pleased with him) reported: I and Abu Talha (both) came back along with Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). Safiyyah (the wife of the Holy Prophet) rode behind him on his camel and as we came to the out- skirts of Medina he said: (We are those) who return, who repent, who worship our Lord, who praise (Him), and he went on uttering this until we entered Medina.
15.hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya: Main aur Abu Talha, dono, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath wapas aaye. Safiyyah, Nabi ki zauja, unke oont par unke peeche sawaar thin aur jab hum Madina ki simaon tak pahunche unhone kaha: Hum woh hain jo wapas aate hain, jo tauba karte hain, jo apne Rab ki ibadat karte hain, jo uski tareef karte hain, aur woh ise kehte rahe yahan tak ki hum Madina mein daakhil huye.

15.ar: وَحَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدُ بْنُ مَسْعَدَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْمُفَضَّلِ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
15.en: A hadith like this has been narrated by Anas b. Malik (Allah be pleased with him) through another chain of transmitters.
15.hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Anas bin Malik (RA) ne ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki hai.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَاخَ بِالْبَطْحَاءِ الَّتِي بِذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ فَصَلَّى بِهَا ‏.‏ وَكَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ يَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏
15.en: Abdullah b. 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made (his camel) kneel down (i, e. halt at the stony ground of Dhu'l-Hulaifa) and prayed there, and so did Abdullah b. Umar (Allah be pleased with them).
15.hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne oont ko bithaya, yaani Dhu'l-Hulaifa ki patthreeli zameen par ruke, aur wahan namaz padhi, aur Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne bhi aisa hi kiya.

15.ar: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحِ بْنِ الْمُهَاجِرِ الْمِصْرِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، قَالَ كَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ يُنِيخُ بِالْبَطْحَاءِ الَّتِي بِذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ الَّتِي كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُنِيخُ بِهَا وَيُصَلِّي بِهَا ‏.‏
15.en: Nafi' reported that 'Abdullah b. Umar (Allah be pleased with them) used to halt his camel in the stony ground at Dhu'l-Hulaifa, where Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to make a halt (and pray).
15.hi: Nafi ne bayan kiya ki Abdullah bin Umar (RA) apne oont ko Dhu'l-Hulaifa ki patthreeli zameen mein rokte the, jahan Allah ke Rasool (SAW) rukte the aur namaz padhte.

15.ar: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ الْمُسَيَّبِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَنَسٌ، - يَعْنِي أَبَا ضَمْرَةَ - عَنْ مُوسَى، بْنِ عُقْبَةَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، كَانَ إِذَا صَدَرَ مِنَ الْحَجِّ أَوِ الْعُمْرَةِ أَنَاخَ بِالْبَطْحَاءِ الَّتِي بِذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ الَّتِي كَانَ يُنِيخُ بِهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
15.en: Nafi' reported that when 'Abdullah b. 'Umar returned from Hajj or 'Umra he made his camel kneel down (i. e. halted) in the stony ground of Dhu'l-Hulaifa where Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had made his camel halt.
15.hi: Nafi ne bayan kiya ki jab Abdullah bin Umar Hajj ya Umra se wapas aate, woh apne oont ko Dhu'l-Hulaifa ki patthreeli zameen mein bithaate, yaani rukte, jahan Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne oont ko roka tha.

15.ar: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ - عَنْ مُوسَى، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عُقْبَةَ - عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أُتِيَ فِي مُعَرَّسِهِ بِذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ فَقِيلَ لَهُ إِنَّكَ بِبَطْحَاءَ مُبَارَكَةٍ ‏.‏
15.en: Salim (b. Abdullah b. 'Umar) reported on the authority of his father (Allah be pleased with them) that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) was visited by (someone, i. e. an angel) during the fag end of the night at Dhu'l-Hulaifa, and it was said to him: Verily it is a blessed stony-ground.
15.hi: Salim, bin Abdullah bin Umar, ne apne walid (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se Dhu'l-Hulaifa mein raat ke aakhri hisse mein koi, yaani ek farishta, mile, aur unse kaha gaya: Yaqeenan ye ek barakat wali patthreeli zameen hai.

15.ar: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكَّارِ بْنِ الرَّيَّانِ، وَسُرَيْجُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِسُرَيْجٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أُتِيَ وَهُوَ فِي مُعَرَّسِهِ مِنْ ذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ فِي بَطْنِ الْوَادِي فَقِيلَ إِنَّكَ بِبَطْحَاءَ مُبَارَكَةٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ مُوسَى وَقَدْ أَنَاخَ بِنَا سَالِمٌ بِالْمُنَاخِ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ الَّذِي كَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ يُنِيخُ بِهِ يَتَحَرَّى مُعَرَّسَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ أَسْفَلُ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ الَّذِي بِبَطْنِ الْوَادِي بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْقِبْلَةِ وَسَطًا مِنْ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏
15.en: Salim b. Abdullah b. Umar reported on the authority of his father (Allah be pleased with them) that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) came to Dhu'l- Hulaifa in the heart of the valley at the fag end of the night, and it was said to him: It is a blessed stony ground. Musa (one of the narrators) said: Salim made his came) halt at the mosque where 'Abdullah made his camel halt as seeking the place of stay of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). It is, in fact, situated at a lower plain than the mosque, which stands in the heart of the valley, and it is between it (the mosque) (and Qibla) that that place (where Allah's Apostle used to get down for rest and prayer) is situated.
15.hi: Salim bin Abdullah bin Umar ne apne walid (RA) ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Dhu'l-Hulaifa mein wadi ke dil mein aaye raat ke aakhri hisse mein, aur unse kaha gaya: Ye ek barakat wali patthreeli zameen hai. Musa, ek raawi, ne kaha: Salim ne apne oont ko us masjid mein rokha jahan Abdullah apne oont ko rokte the, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke padaav ki jagah dhoondhte hue. Ye, dar-asal, masjid se ek neechle maidaan mein sthit hai, jo wadi ke dil mein khadi hai, aur ismein aur usmein, masjid aur Qibla ke beech, woh jagah sthit hai jahan Allah ke Rasool aaraam aur namaz ke liye utarte the.

15.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، ح .
 وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى التُّجِيبِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، أَنَّ ابْنَ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ بَعَثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقُ فِي الْحَجَّةِ الَّتِي أَمَّرَهُ عَلَيْهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَبْلَ حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ فِي رَهْطٍ يُؤَذِّنُونَ فِي النَّاسِ يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ لاَ يَحُجُّ بَعْدَ الْعَامِ مُشْرِكٌ وَلاَ يَطُوفُ بِالْبَيْتِ عُرْيَانٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ فَكَانَ حُمَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ يَقُولُ يَوْمُ النَّحْرِ يَوْمُ الْحَجِّ الأَكْبَرِ ‏.‏ مِنْ أَجْلِ حَدِيثِ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ‏.‏
15.en: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported: Abu Bakr Siddiq (Allah be pleased with him) sent me during Hajj before the Farewell Pilgrimage for which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had appointed him an Amir, among a group of people whom he had ordered to make announcement to the people on the Day of Nahr:" After this year no polytheist may perform the Pilgrimage and no naked person may circumambulate the House." Ibn Shihab stated that Humaid b. Abd al-Rahman said that according to this narration of Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) the day of Hajj al-Akbar (Great Hajj) is this Day of Nahr (10th of Dhu'l-Hijja).
15.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Abu Bakr Siddiq (RA) ne mujhe Vida ke Hajj se pehle Hajj ke daurane bheja, jiske liye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe Amir muqarrar kiya tha, ek giroh ke logon ke saath jinhe unhone hukum diya ki woh logon ko Nahr ke din ye ailaan karein: "Is saal ke baad koi mushrik Hajj nahi kar sakta aur koi nanga shakhs Ghar ka tawaaf nahi kar sakta." Ibn Shihab ne bayaan kiya ki Humaid bin Abd al-Rahman ne kaha ki Abu Huraira (RA) ki is riwayat ke mutabik, Hajj al-Akbar, Bada Hajj, ka din yehi Nahr ka din hai, 10 Zul-Hijja.

15.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ عِيسَى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مَخْرَمَةُ بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ يُونُسَ بْنَ يُوسُفَ، يَقُولُ عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، قَالَ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ مَا مِنْ يَوْمٍ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ أَنْ يُعْتِقَ اللَّهُ فِيهِ عَبْدًا مِنَ النَّارِ مِنْ يَوْمِ عَرَفَةَ وَإِنَّهُ لَيَدْنُو ثُمَّ يُبَاهِي بِهِمُ الْمَلاَئِكَةَ فَيَقُولُ مَا أَرَادَ هَؤُلاَءِ ‏"‏‏.‏
15.en: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There is no day when God sets free more servants from Hell than the Day of 'Arafa. He draws near, then praises them to the angels, saying: What do these want?
15.hi: Aisha (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Koi bhi din aisa nahi hai jab Allah Arafa ke din se zyada bandon ko jahannam se azaad karta ho. Woh qareeb aata hai, phir unhe farishton ke saamne bayan karta hai, kehta hai: Ye kya chahte hain?

15.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ سُمَىٍّ، مَوْلَى أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ السَّمَّانِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ الْعُمْرَةُ إِلَى الْعُمْرَةِ كَفَّارَةٌ لِمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَالْحَجُّ الْمَبْرُورُ لَيْسَ لَهُ جَزَاءٌ إِلاَّ الْجَنَّةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
15.en: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: An Umra is an expiation for the sins committed between it and the next, and Hajj which is accepted will receive no other reward than Paradise.
15.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek Umra unmein hue gunahon ka kaffara hai jo iske aur agle Umra ke beech hote hain, aur ek maqbool Hajj ko Jannat ke siwaay koi doosra badla nahi milta.

15.ar: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ الأُمَوِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ، الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ الْمُخْتَارِ عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، كُلُّ هَؤُلاَءِ عَنْ سُمَىٍّ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ مَالِكٍ ‏.‏
15.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) through another chain of transmitters.
15.hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

15.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ، زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ مَنْ أَتَى هَذَا الْبَيْتَ فَلَمْ يَرْفُثْ وَلَمْ يَفْسُقْ رَجَعَ كَمَا وَلَدَتْهُ أُمُّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
15.en: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who came to this House (Ka'ba) (with the intention of performing Pilgrimage), and neither spoke indecently nor did he act wickedly. would return (free from sin) as on the (very first day) his mother bore him.
15.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo is Ghar, Kaaba, mein aaye, Hajj karne ke iraade se, aur na ashleel baat ki na hi burai ka koi kaam kiya, woh gunah se aazad hokar waise hi wapas aayega jaise woh us din tha jab uski maa ne use paida kiya.

15.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عَوَانَةَ، وَأَبِي الأَحْوَصِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ، بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ مِسْعَرٍ، وَسُفْيَانَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، كُلُّ هَؤُلاَءِ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَفِي حَدِيثِهِمْ جَمِيعًا ‏
"‏ مَنْ حَجَّ فَلَمْ يَرْفُثْ وَلَمْ يَفْسُقْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
15.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Mainsur with the same chain of transmitters (and the words are): " He who performed Pilgrimage but neither spoke indecently nor acted wickedly."
15.hi: Ye hadees Mansur ki sanad se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai, aur alfaaz hain: "Jisne Hajj kiya lekin na ashleel baat ki na hi burai ka koi kaam kiya."

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ سَيَّارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
15.en: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him).
15.hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

15.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ، بْنُ يَزِيدَ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّ عَلِيَّ بْنَ حُسَيْنٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَمْرَو بْنَ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَفَّانَ أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ حَارِثَةَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَتَنْزِلُ فِي دَارِكَ بِمَكَّةَ فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ وَهَلْ تَرَكَ لَنَا عَقِيلٌ مِنْ رِبَاعٍ أَوْ دُورٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَكَانَ عَقِيلٌ وَرِثَ أَبَا طَالِبٍ هُوَ وَطَالِبٌ وَلَمْ يَرِثْهُ جَعْفَرٌ وَلاَ عَلِيٌّ شَيْئًا لأَنَّهُمَا كَانَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ وَكَانَ عَقِيلٌ وَطَالِبٌ كَافِرَيْنِ ‏.‏
15.en: Usama b. Zaid b. Haritha (Allah be pleased with him) said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ): Will you stay in your house at Mecca (which you abandoned at the time of migration)? Thereupon he said: Has 'Aqil left for as any land or house? And 'Aqil and Talib became the Inheritors of Abu Talib's (property), and neither Ja'far nor 'Ali inherited anything from him, for both (Ja'far and 'Ali) were Muslims whereas 'Aqil and Talib were non-Muslims.
15.hi: Usama bin Zaid bin Haritha (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kaha: Kya aap Makkah mein apne ghar mein rahenge, jise aapne hijrat ke waqt chhoda tha? Isper unhone kaha: Kya Aqil ne hamare liye koi zameen ya ghar chhoda hai? Aur Aqil aur Talib Abu Talib ki maal ke waaris bane, aur na to Ja'far ne na hi Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne unse kuch virasat mein paaya, kyunki dono, Ja'far aur Ali (Alayhis Salam), Musalman the jabki Aqil aur Talib ghair-Musalman the.

15.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مِهْرَانَ الرَّازِيُّ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ عَبْدِ، الرَّزَّاقِ - قَالَ ابْنُ مِهْرَانَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، - عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حُسَيْنٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَيْنَ تَنْزِلُ غَدًا وَذَلِكَ فِي حَجَّتِهِ حِينَ دَنَوْنَا مِنْ مَكَّةَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ وَهَلْ تَرَكَ لَنَا عَقِيلٌ مَنْزِلاً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
15.en: Usama b. Zaid (Allah be pleased with him) said: Allah's Messenger, God willing, where will you stay tomorrow? And it was at the time of the Conquest (of Mecca). Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Has 'Aqil left any accommodation for us?
15.hi: Usama bin Zaid (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Allah chahega to aap kal kahan rukenge? Aur ye Fatah, Makkah ki, ke waqt ki baat hai. Isper unhone kaha: Kya Aqil ne humare liye koi rehne ki jagah chhodi hai?

15.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي حَفْصَةَ، وَزَمْعَةُ، بْنُ صَالِحٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حُسَيْنٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ، بْنِ زَيْدٍ أَنَّهُ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَيْنَ تَنْزِلُ غَدًا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ وَذَلِكَ زَمَنَ الْفَتْحِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏
"‏ وَهَلْ تَرَكَ لَنَا عَقِيلٌ مِنْ مَنْزِلٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
15.en: Narrated Usama b. Zaid : Usama b. Zaid (Allah be pleased with him) said: Allah's Messenger, God willing, where will you stay tomorrow?  Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Has 'Aqil left any accommodation for us?
15.hi: Usama bin Zaid ne bayan kiya: Usama bin Zaid (RA) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Allah chahega to aap kal kahan rukenge? Isper unhone kaha: Kya Aqil ne humare liye koi rehne ki jagah chhodi hai?

15.ar:
