يُوَسِّعَ عَلَى أُمَّتِكَ فَقَدْ وَسَّعَ عَلَى فَارِسَ وَالرُّومِ وَهُمْ لاَ يَعْبُدُونَ اللَّهَ فَاسْتَوَى جَالِسًا ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَفِي شَكٍّ أَنْتَ يَا ابْنَ الْخَطَّابِ أُولَئِكَ قَوْمٌ عُجِّلَتْ لَهُمْ طَيِّبَاتُهُمْ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ اسْتَغْفِرْ لِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ وَكَانَ أَقْسَمَ أَنْ لاَ يَدْخُلَ عَلَيْهِنَّ شَهْرًا مِنْ شِدَّةِ مَوْجِدَتِهِ عَلَيْهِنَّ ‏.‏ حَتَّى عَاتَبَهُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏.‏
 قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ فَأَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ لَمَّا مَضَى تِسْعٌ وَعِشْرُونَ لَيْلَةً دَخَلَ عَلَىَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَدَأَ بِي فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّكَ أَقْسَمْتَ أَنْ لاَ تَدْخُلَ عَلَيْنَا شَهْرًا وَإِنَّكَ دَخَلْتَ مِنْ تِسْعٍ وَعِشْرِينَ أَعُدُّهُنَّ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ الشَّهْرَ تِسْعٌ وَعِشْرُونَ - ثُمَّ قَالَ - يَا عَائِشَةُ إِنِّي ذَاكِرٌ لَكِ أَمْرًا فَلاَ عَلَيْكِ أَنْ لاَ تَعْجَلِي فِيهِ حَتَّى تَسْتَأْمِرِي أَبَوَيْكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ عَلَىَّ الآيَةَ ‏{‏ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ قُلْ لأَزْوَاجِكَ‏}‏ حَتَّى بَلَغَ ‏{‏ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا‏}‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ قَدْ عَلِمَ وَاللَّهِ أَنَّ أَبَوَىَّ لَمْ يَكُونَا لِيَأْمُرَانِي بِفِرَاقِهِ قَالَتْ فَقُلْتُ أَوَفِي هَذَا أَسْتَأْمِرُ أَبَوَىَّ فَإِنِّي أُرِيدُ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَالدَّارَ الآخِرَةَ ‏.‏ قَالَ مَعْمَرٌ فَأَخْبَرَنِي أَيُّوبُ أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ لاَ تُخْبِرْ نِسَاءَكَ أَنِّي اخْتَرْتُكَ فَقَالَ لَهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ أَرْسَلَنِي مُبَلِّغًا وَلَمْ يُرْسِلْنِي مُتَعَنِّتًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قَتَادَةُ صَغَتْ قُلُوبُكُمَا مَالَتْ قُلُوبُكُمَا‏.‏
18.en:
Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with them) reported. I had always been anxious to ask 'Umar (Allah be pleased with him) about the two ladies amongst the wives of Allah's Prophet (may peace be upon Lim) about whom Allah, the Exalted, said: " If you both turn in repentance to Allah, then indeed your hearts are inclined (to this)" (Ixvi. 4), until 'Umar (Allah be pleased with him) set out for Hajj and I also went along with him. And as we were going along a path, 'Umar (Allah be pleased with hiyn) went aside and I also went aside with him with a jug (of water). He answered the call of nature, and then came to me and I poured water over his hands and he performed ablution I said: Commander of the Faithful, who are the two ladies amongst the wives of Allah's Prophet (ﷺ) about whom Allah, the Exalted and Majestic, said: 'If you both turn to Allah in repentance, then indeed your heart are inclined to it"? 'Umar (Allah he pleased with him) said: How strange is it for you, Ibn 'Abbas! (Zuhri said: By Allah, he disliked what he asked about, but did not keep it a secret.) He ('Umar) said: They are Hafsa and 'A'isha; and he then began to narrate the hadith and said: We were such people among the Quraish who dominated women, and as we reached Medina we found there people who were dominated by their women, and our women began to learn (the habits) of their women. He further said: And my house was situated in the suburb of Aledina in the tribe of Banu Umayya b. Zaid. One day I became angry with my wife and she retorted upon me. I did not like that she should retort upon me. She said: You disapprove of my retorting upon you By Allah, the wives of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) retort upon him, and one of them detaches herself from him for the day until the night. So I ('Umar) went out and visited Hafsa and said: Do you retort upon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? She said: Yes. I said; Does any one of you detach herself from him from the day to the night? She said: Yes. He said: She who did like it amongst you in fact failed and incurred loss. Does everyone amongst you not fear the wrath of Allah upon her due to the wrath of His Messenger (ﷺ), and (as a result thereof) she may perish? So do not retort upon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and do not ask him for anything, but ask me that which you desire, (and the frank behaviour) of your companion may not mislead you, if she is more graceful and is dearer to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) than you (meaning 'A'isha) (Allah be pleased with her). 
He (Hadrat 'Umar further) said: I had a compalaion from the Ansar and, we used to remain in the company of the Messenger (ﷺ) turn by turn. He remained there for a day while I remained there on the other day, and he brought me the news about the revelation and other (matter), and I brought him (the news) like this. And we discussed that the Ghassanids were shoeing the horses in order to attack us. Id y companion once attended (the Apostle). and then came to me at night and knocked at my door and called me, and I came out to him, and he said: A matter of great importance has happened. I said: What is that? Have the Ghassanids come? He said: No, but even more serious and more significant than that: the Prophet (ﷺ) has divorced his wives. I said: Hafsa has failed and has incurred loss. and I feared that it would happen. When it was dawn I observed the dawn prayer and dressed myself, and then came there (in the house of the Holy Prophet) and visited Hafsa, and she was weeping. I said: Has Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) divorced you (all)? She said: I do not know. He has, however, separated himself in his attic. I came to a black servant and said to him: Seek permission for 'Umar. He went in and then came to me and said: I made mention of you to him, but he kept quiet. I then went to the pulpit and sat there, and there was a group of people sitting by it and some of then were weeping. I sat there for some time, until I was overpowered (by that very idea) which was in my mind. I then came back to the boy and said to him: Seek permission for Umar. He went in and came to me and said: I made mention of you to him but he kept quiet. I was about to turn back when the boy called me and said: Go in; permission has been granted to you. I went in and greeted Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he was reclining against the couch of mat and it had left its marks upon his side. I said: Messenger of Allah, have you divorced your wives? He raised his head towards me and said: No. I said: Allah is the Greatest. Messenger of Allah, I wish if you had seen how we the people of Quraish had domination over women but when we came to Medina we found people whom their women dominated. So our women began to learn from their women. One dily I became angry with my wife and she began to retort upon me. I did not approve that she should retort upon me. She said: You do not like that I should retort upon you, but, by Allah. the wives of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) retort upon him and any one of them separates herself from him for a day until night. I said: He who did that amongst them in fact failed and incurred loss. Does any of them feel sate from the wrath of Allahupon her due to the wrath of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and she has certainly perished. Allah's Messtnger (ﷺ) smiled, I said: Messenger of Allah, I visited Hafsa and said: (The behaviour) of your companion ('A'isha) may not mislead you, If she is more graceful than you and is dearer to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) than you. 
Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) smiled for the second time. I said: Allah's Messenger, way I talk to you about agreeable things? He said: Yes. I sat down and lifted my head (to see things) in the house and, by Allah, I did not see anything significant besides three hides. I said: Messenger of Allah, supplicate the Lord that He should make (life) prosperous for your Ummah as He has made plentiful for the people of Persia and Rome (in spite of the fact) that they do no, worship Allah, the Exalted and Majestic, whereupon he (Allah's Messenger) sat up an I then said: Ibn Khattab, do you doubt that they are a nation whom their nice things have been given immediately in the life of this world. I said: Allah's Messenger! seek pardon for me. And he (Allah's Messenger) had taken an oath that he would not visit them for a month due to extreme annoyance with them until Allah showed His displeasure to him (Allah's Messenger). Zuhri said: 'Urwa informed me that 'A'Isha (Allah be pleased with her) said: When twenty-nine nights were over, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) visited me, and he began (his visit) with me. I said: Messenger of Allah, you had taken an oath that you would not visit us for a month, while you have visited after I have counted only twenty-nine (nights). Thereupon he said: The month may also be of twenty-nine (days). He then said: 'A'isha, I am going to talk to you about a matter, and you should not be hasty in it (and do not give your final decision) until you have consulted your parents. He then recited this verse to me:" O Prophet, say to your wives" till he reached" mighty reward" (xxxiii. 28). 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) said: By Allah, he knew that my parents would not allow me to separate from him. I said: Is there any need to consult my parents in this matter? I in fact choose Allah and His Messenger (ﷺ) and the abode in the Hereafter. Ma'mar said: Ayyub reported to me that 'A'isha said: Don't inform your wives that I have chosen you, whereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Verily Allah has sent me as a conveyer of message, and He has not sent me as a source of hardship (to others). Qatada said:" Saghat qulubukum" means" Your hearts have inclined."
18.hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Main hamesha ye poochne ke liye betaab tha Umar (RA) se un do khavateen ke baare mein Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ki zaujaon mein se jinke baare mein Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, ne kaha: "Agar tum dono Allah ki taraf tauba mein mudho, to yaqeenan tumhare dil jhuk chuke hain" (66:4), yahan tak ki Umar (RA) Hajj ke liye nikle aur main bhi unke saath gaya. Aur jab hum ek raaste par ja rahe the, Umar (RA) alag ho gaye aur main bhi unke saath paani ke jag ke saath alag ho gaya. Unhone zaroorat poori ki, aur phir mere paas aaye aur maine unke haathon par paani daala aur unhone wuzu kiya. Maine kaha: Ameer-ul-Momineen, Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ki zaujaon mein woh do khavateen kaun hain jinke baare mein Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, ne kaha: 'Agar tum dono Allah ki taraf tauba mein mudho, to yaqeenan tumhare dil jhuk chuke hain'? Umar (RA) ne kaha: Kitni ajeeb baat hai tumhare liye, Ibn Abbas! (Zuhri ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, unhe napasand tha jo unhone poocha lekin ise raaz nahi rakha.) Unhone kaha: Woh Hafsa aur Aisha hain; aur phir woh hadees riwayat karne lage aur kaha: Hum aise log the Quraish mein jo auraton par hukmaraan the, aur jab hum Madina pahunche humein wahan log mile jo apni auraton se hukmaraani mein the, aur hamari auraten unki auraton ki aadatein seekhne lagin. Unhone aage kaha: Aur mera ghar Madina ke bahri hisse mein tha Banu Umayya bin Zaid qabile mein. Ek din main apni zauja par gussa hua aur unhone mujhe jawaab diya. Mujhe ye pasand nahi tha ki woh mujhe jawaab de. Unhone kaha: Aap ise napasand karte hain ki main aapko jawaab dun. Allah ki qasam, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zaujaen unhe jawaab deti hain, aur unmein se ek din se raat tak unse alag ho jaati hai. To main, Umar, bahar gaya aur Hafsa ke paas gaya aur kaha: Kya tum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko jawaab deti ho? Unhone kaha: Haan. Maine kaha: Kya tum mein se koi din se raat tak unse alag ho jaati hai? Unhone kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: Jisne tum mein se aisa kiya usne dar-asal khud ko nuksaan pahunchaaya. Kya tum mein se har ek ko Allah ke gusse ka dar nahi hai uske Rasool (SAW) ke gusse ki wajah se, aur (natijatan) woh tabaah na ho jaaye? Is liye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko jawaab mat do aur unse kuch mat maango, lekin mujhse maango jo tumhe chahiye, (aur tumhari saathi ka khulapan) tumhe bhramit na kare, agar woh tumse zyada khoobsurat hai aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko tumse zyada aziz hai (unka matlab Aisha se tha) (RA). Unhone (Hazrat Umar ne aage) kaha: Mera ek saathi Ansar mein se tha, aur hum baari-baari Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein rehte the. Woh ek din wahan rahte jabki main doosre din wahan rahta, aur woh mere paas wahi aur doosre maamle ki khabar laata, aur main use is tarah khabar laata. Aur humne charcha ki ki Ghassanids apne ghodon ko naal chadhaa rahe hain hamare khilaaf hamla karne ke liye. Mera saathi ek baar Nabi ke paas gaya, aur phir raat ko mere paas aaya aur mera darwaza khatkhataaya aur mujhe bulaaya, aur main unke paas bahar aaya, aur unhone kaha: Ek bahut aham baat hui hai. Maine kaha: Woh kya hai? Kya Ghassanids aa gaye hain? Unhone kaha: Nahi, lekin isse bhi zyada sangin aur ahem: Nabi (SAW) ne apni zaujaon ko talaaq de di hai. Maine kaha: Hafsa tabaah ho gayi aur nuksaan uthaaya, aur mujhe dar tha ki aisa hoga. Jab subah hui, maine fajr ki namaz padhi aur khud ko taiyaar kiya, aur phir wahan aaya (Nabi ke ghar) aur Hafsa ke paas gaya, aur woh ro rahi thin. Maine kaha: Kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne tumhe (sab ko) talaaq de di hai? Unhone kaha: Mujhe nahi pata. Unhone, halaanki, apne chhat wale kamre mein khud ko alag kar liya hai. Main ek kaale khaadim ke paas aaya aur usse kaha: Umar ke liye ijazat maango. Woh andar gaya aur phir mere paas aaya aur kaha: Maine unse aapka zikr kiya, lekin woh khamosh rahe. Main phir mimbar ki taraf gaya aur wahan baitha, aur wahan ek giroh baitha hua tha aur unmein se kuch ro rahe the. Main wahan kuch der baitha raha, jab tak main us khyaal se dabaav mein aa gaya jo mere zehan mein tha. Main phir launde ke paas aaya aur usse kaha: Umar ke liye ijazat maango. Woh andar gaya aur mere paas wapas aaya aur kaha: Maine unse aapka zikr kiya lekin woh khamosh rahe. Main wapas jaane hi wala tha ki launde ne mujhe bulaaya aur kaha: Andar jaao; aapko ijazat mil gayi hai. Main andar gaya aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko salaam kiya aur woh ek chataayi wale takht par tek lagaaye hue the aur usne unke pehlu par nishaan chhod diye the. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya aapne apni zaujaon ko talaaq de di hai? Unhone apna sar meri taraf uthaaya aur kaha: Nahi. Maine kaha: Allah sabse Buland hai. Allah ke Rasool, kaash aapne dekha hota ki hum, Quraish ke log, kaise auraton par hukmaraan the lekin jab hum Madina aaye, humein aise log mile jinhein unki auraten hukmaraan karti thin. To hamari auraten bhi unki auraton se seekhne lagin. Ek din main apni zauja par gussa hua aur woh mujhe jawaab dene lagi. Mujhe pasand nahi tha ki woh mujhe jawaab de. Unhone kaha: Aapko pasand nahi ki main aapko jawaab dun, lekin, Allah ki qasam, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zaujaen unhe jawaab deti hain aur unmein se koi ek din se raat tak unse alag ho jaati hai. Maine kaha: Jisne aisa kiya usne dar-asal khud ko nuksaan pahunchaaya. Kya unmein se koi Allah ke gusse se apne aap ko mahfooz mehsoos karti hai uske Rasool (SAW) ke gusse ki wajah se, aur woh zaroor tabaah ho gayi hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) muskuraaye, maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, main Hafsa ke paas gaya aur kaha: (Tumhari saathi Aisha ki) khulapan tumhe bhramit na kare, agar woh tumse zyada khoobsurat hai aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko tumse zyada aziz hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) doosri baar muskuraaye. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya main aapse kuch khushnuma baaton par baat kar sakta hoon? Unhone kaha: Haan. Main baith gaya aur apna sar uthaaya (cheezein dekhne ke liye) ghar mein aur, Allah ki qasam, maine teen chamdon ke ilawa koi aham cheez nahi dekhi. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, apne Rab se dua kijiye ki Woh aapki ummat ke liye khushhaali karde jaisa Usne Farsi aur Roman logon ke liye bahutayat ki hai jabki woh Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, ki ibadat nahi karte, isper woh (Allah ke Rasool) baithe aur maine phir kaha: Ibn Khattab, kya tumhe shaq hai ki woh ek qaum hain jinhe unki achhi cheezein isi duniyavi zindagi mein turant di gayi hain. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool! mere liye maafi maangiye. Aur unhone, Allah ke Rasool, qasam khayi thi ki woh unse ek mahine ke liye nahi milenge unke saath ziyaadti ki wajah se yahan tak ki Allah ne unhe apni napasandeegi dikhaayi. Zuhri ne kaha: Urwa ne mujhe bataya ki Aisha (RA) ne kaha: Jab untees raaten guzar gayin, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mere paas aaye, aur unhone apna dauraa mere saath shuru kiya. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aapne qasam khayi thi ki aap humse ek mahine tak nahi milenge, jabki aap sirf untees (raaton) ke baad aaye hain jinhe maine gina hai. Isper unhone kaha: Mahina untees (dinon) ka bhi ho sakta hai. Unhone phir kaha: Aisha, main tumse ek maamle par baat karne wala hoon, aur tumhe usmein jaldbaazi nahi karni chahiye jab tak tum apne maa-baap se salaah na lo. Unhone phir ye aayat mujhe padhi: "Aye Nabi, apni zaujaon se kaho" yahan tak ki woh pahunche "bade sawaab" (33:28). Aisha (RA) ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, unhe pata tha ki mere maa-baap mujhe unse alag hone ki ijazat nahi denge. Maine kaha: Kya ismein mere maa-baap se salaah lene ki koi zaroorat hai? Main dar-asal Allah aur Uske Rasool (SAW) aur Aakhirat ke ghar ko chunti hoon. Ma'mar ne kaha: Ayyub ne mujhe riwayat ki ki Aisha ne kaha: Apni doosri zaujaon ko mat bataayiye ki maine aapko chuna hai, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Yaqeenan Allah ne mujhe ek payaam pahunchaane wale ke taur par bheja hai, aur Usne mujhe doosron ke liye mushkilon ka zariya banaakar nahi bheja hai. Qatada ne kaha: "Saghat qulubukum" ka matlab hai "Tumhare dil jhuk gaye hain."

18.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، مَوْلَى الأَسْوَدِ بْنِ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ قَيْسٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا عَمْرِو بْنَ حَفْصٍ، طَلَّقَهَا الْبَتَّةَ وَهُوَ غَائِبٌ فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهَا وَكِيلُهُ بِشَعِيرٍ فَسَخِطَتْهُ فَقَالَ وَاللَّهِ مَا لَكِ عَلَيْنَا مِنْ شَىْءٍ ‏.‏ فَجَاءَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَتْ ذَلِكَ لَهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لَيْسَ لَكِ عَلَيْهِ نَفَقَةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَمَرَهَا أَنْ تَعْتَدَّ فِي بَيْتِ أُمِّ شَرِيكٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ تِلْكَ امْرَأَةٌ يَغْشَاهَا أَصْحَابِي اعْتَدِّي عِنْدَ ابْنِ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ فَإِنَّهُ رَجُلٌ أَعْمَى تَضَعِينَ ثِيَابَكِ فَإِذَا حَلَلْتِ فَآذِنِينِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَلَمَّا حَلَلْتُ ذَكَرْتُ لَهُ أَنَّ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنَ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ وَأَبَا جَهْمٍ خَطَبَانِي ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَمَّا أَبُو جَهْمٍ فَلاَ يَضَعُ عَصَاهُ عَنْ عَاتَقِهِ وَأَمَّا مُعَاوِيَةُ فَصُعْلُوكٌ لاَ مَالَ لَهُ انْكِحِي أُسَامَةَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَكَرِهْتُهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ انْكِحِي أُسَامَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَنَكَحْتُهُ فَجَعَلَ اللَّهُ فِيهِ خَيْرًا وَاغْتَبَطْتُ بِهِ ‏.‏
18.en: Fatima bint Qais reported that Abu 'Amr b. Hafs divorced her absolutely when he was away from home, and he sent his agent to her with some barley. She was displeased with him and when he said: I swear by Allah that you have no claim on us. she went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and mentioned that to him. He said: There is no maintenance due to you from him, and he commanded her to spend the 'Idda in the house of Umm Sharik, but then said: That is a woman whom my companions visit. So better spend this period in the house of Ibn Umm Maktum, for he is a blind man and you can put off your garments. And when the 'Idda is over, inform me. She said: When my period of 'Idda was over, I mentioned to him that Mu'awiya b. Abu Sufyan and Jahm had sent proposal of marriage to me, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: As for Abu Jahm, he does not put down his staff from his shoulder, and as for Mu'awiya, he is a poor man having no property; marry Usama b. Zaid. I objected to him, but he again said: Marry Usama; so I married him. Allah blessed there in and I was envied (by others).
18.hi: Fatima bint Qais ne bayan kiya ki Abu Amr bin Hafs ne unhe poori tarah talaaq de di jab woh ghar se door the, aur unhone apna agent unke paas kuch jau ke saath bheja. Woh unse naaraaz thin aur jab unhone kaha: Main Allah ki qasam khaata hoon ki tumhara humpar koi haq nahi hai, woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gayi aur unse ye zikr kiya. Unhone kaha: Tumhare liye unse koi bhar-poshan nahi banta hai, aur unhone unhe Umm Sharik ke ghar mein iddat guzaarne ka hukum diya, lekin phir kaha: Woh ek aisi aurat hain jinke ghar mere sahaba aate hain. Is liye behtar hoga ki tum ye muddat Ibn Umm Maktum ke ghar mein guzaaro, kyunki woh ek andhe aadmi hain aur tum apne kapde utaar sakti ho. Aur jab iddat khatam ho jaaye, mujhe bataana. Unhone kaha: Jab meri iddat ki muddat khatam ho gayi, maine unhe bataaya ki Muawiya bin Abu Sufyan aur Jahm ne mujhe shaadi ka prastaav bheja hai, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jahan tak Abu Jahm ka sawal hai, woh apni chhadi apne kandhe se neeche nahi rakhte, aur jahan tak Muawiya ka sawal hai, woh ek gareeb aadmi hai jiske paas koi maal nahi hai; Usama bin Zaid se shaadi karo. Maine unse aitraaz kiya, lekin unhone phir kaha: Usama se shaadi karo; to maine unse shaadi ki. Allah ne isme barkat di aur mujhse doosron ko rashk hua.

18.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ أَبِي حَازِمٍ وَقَالَ قُتَيْبَةُ أَيْضًا حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْقَارِيَّ - كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي، سَلَمَةَ عَنْ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ قَيْسٍ، أَنَّهُ طَلَّقَهَا زَوْجُهَا فِي عَهْدِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَكَانَ أَنْفَقَ عَلَيْهَا نَفَقَةَ دُونٍ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْ ذَلِكَ قَالَتْ وَاللَّهِ لأُعْلِمَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَإِذَا كَانَ لِي نَفَقَةٌ أَخَذْتُ الَّذِي يُصْلِحُنِي وَإِنْ لَمْ تَكُنْ لِي نَفَقَةٌ لَمْ آخُذْ مِنْهُ شَيْئًا قَالَتْ فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ لاَ نَفَقَةَ لَكِ وَلاَ سُكْنَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏
18.en: Fatima bint Qais reported that her husband divorced her during the life time of Allah's Prophet (ﷺ) and gave her a meagre maintenance allowance. When she saw that, she said: By Allah, I will inform Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and if maintenance allowance is due to me then I will accept that which will suffice me, and if it is not due to me, I will not accept anything from him. She said: I made a mention of that to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he said: There is neither maintenance allowance for you nor lodging.
18.hi: Fatima bint Qais ne bayan kiya ki unke shohar ne unhe Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein talaaq di aur unhe thoda bhar-poshan diya. Jab unhone ye dekha, unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko bataungi, aur agar bhar-poshan mujhe milna chahiye to main woh qubool karungi jo mere liye kaafi ho, aur agar ye mera haq nahi hai, to main unse kuch qubool nahi karungi. Unhone kaha: Maine iska zikr Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kiya aur unhone kaha: Na tumhe bhar-poshan milega na hi rehne ki jagah.

18.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ أَبِي أَنَسٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتَ قَيْسٍ فَأَخْبَرَتْنِي أَنَّ زَوْجَهَا الْمَخْزُومِيَّ طَلَّقَهَا فَأَبَى أَنْ يُنْفِقَ عَلَيْهَا فَجَاءَتْ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرَتْهُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ لاَ نَفَقَةَ لَكِ فَانْتَقِلِي فَاذْهَبِي إِلَى ابْنِ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ فَكُونِي عِنْدَهُ فَإِنَّهُ رَجُلٌ أَعْمَى تَضَعِينَ ثِيَابَكِ عِنْدَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
18.en: Fatima bint Qais reported that her husband al-Makhzulmi divorced her and refused to pay her maintenance allowance. So she came to Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) and informed him, whereupon he said: There is no maintenance allowance for you, and you better go to the house of Ibn Umm Maktum and live with him for he is a blind man and you can put off your clothes in his house (i. e. you shall not face much difficulty in observing purdah there).
18.hi: Fatima bint Qais ne bayan kiya ki unke shohar al-Makhzumi ne unhe talaaq di aur unhe bhar-poshan dene se inkaar kiya. To woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur unhe bataaya, isper unhone kaha: Tumhare liye koi bhar-poshan nahi hai, aur behtar hoga ki tum Ibn Umm Maktum ke ghar jao aur unke saath raho kyunki woh ek andhe aadmi hain aur tum unke ghar mein apne kapde utaar sakti ho (yaani tumhe wahan parde ki adhik zaroorat nahi padegi).

18.ar: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ - أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ، أَنَّ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتَ قَيْسٍ، أُخْتَ الضَّحَّاكِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّ أَبَا حَفْصِ بْنَ الْمُغِيرَةِ الْمَخْزُومِيَّ طَلَّقَهَا ثَلاَثًا ثُمَّ انْطَلَقَ إِلَى الْيَمَنِ فَقَالَ لَهَا أَهْلُهُ لَيْسَ لَكِ عَلَيْنَا نَفَقَةٌ ‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقَ خَالِدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ فِي نَفَرٍ فَأَتَوْا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي بَيْتِ مَيْمُونَةَ فَقَالُوا إِنَّ أَبَا حَفْصٍ طَلَّقَ امْرَأَتَهُ ثَلاَثًا فَهَلْ لَهَا مِنْ نَفَقَةٍ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَيْسَتْ لَهَا نَفَقَةٌ وَعَلَيْهَا الْعِدَّةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَأَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهَا ‏"‏ أَنْ لاَ تَسْبِقِينِي بِنَفْسِكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَأَمَرَهَا أَنْ تَنْتَقِلَ إِلَى أُمِّ شَرِيكٍ ثُمَّ أَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهَا ‏"‏ أَنَّ أُمَّ شَرِيكٍ يَأْتِيهَا الْمُهَاجِرُونَ الأَوَّلُونَ فَانْطَلِقِي إِلَى ابْنِ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ الأَعْمَى فَإِنَّكِ إِذَا وَضَعْتِ خِمَارَكِ لَمْ يَرَكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقَتْ إِلَيْهِ فَلَمَّا مَضَتْ عِدَّتُهَا أَنْكَحَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أُسَامَةَ بْنَ زَيْدِ بْنِ حَارِثَةَ.
18.en: Abu Salama reported that Fatima bint Qais, the sister of al-Dahhak b. Qais informed him that Abu Hafs b. Mughira al-Makhzumi divorced her three times and then he proceeded on to the Yemen. The members of his family said to her: There is no maintenance allowance due to you from us. Khalid b. Walid along with a group of persons visited Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the house of Maimuna and they said: Abu Hafs has divorced his wife with three pronouncements; is there any maintenance allowance due to her? Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: No maintenance allowance is due to her, but she is required to spend the 'Idda; and he sent her the message that she should not be hasty in making a decision about herself and commanded her to move to the house of Umm Sharik, and then sent her the message that as the first immigrants (frequently) visit the house of Umm Sharik, she should better go to the house of Ibn Umm Maktum, the blind, (and further said: In case you put off your head-dress, he (Ibn Umm Makhtum) will not see you. So she went to his house, and when the 'Idda was over, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) married her to Usama b. Zaid b. Haritha.
18.hi: Abu Salama ne bayan kiya ki Fatima bint Qais, al-Dahhak bin Qais ki behn, ne unhe bataaya ki Abu Hafs bin Mughira al-Makhzumi ne unhe teen baar talaaq di aur phir Yemen chale gaye. Unke khaandaan ke logon ne unse kaha: Humse tumhare liye koi bhar-poshan nahi banta. Khalid bin Walid kuch logon ke saath Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas Maimuna ke ghar gaye aur kaha: Abu Hafs ne apni zauja ko teen baar talaaq di hai; kya unke liye koi bhar-poshan banta hai? Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Unke liye koi bhar-poshan nahi banta, lekin unhe iddat guzaarni zaroori hai; aur unhone unhe payaam bheja ki woh apne baare mein jaldbaazi mein faisla na len aur unhe Umm Sharik ke ghar mein muntaqil hone ka hukum diya, aur phir unhe payaam bheja ki chunki pehle Muhajir Umm Sharik ke ghar (aksar) aate hain, unhe behtar hoga Ibn Umm Maktum, andhe, ke ghar jaana chaahiye, aur ye bhi kaha: Agar tum apna sar ka kapda utaar do, woh (Ibn Umm Maktum) tumhe nahi dekhenge. To woh unke ghar gayi, aur jab iddat khatam hui, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unki shaadi Usama bin Zaid bin Haritha se karwaayi.

18.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - يَعْنُونَ ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ قَيْسٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ قَيْسٍ، قَالَ كَتَبْتُ ذَلِكَ مِنْ فِيهَا كِتَابًا قَالَتْ كُنْتُ عِنْدَ رَجُلٍ مِنْ بَنِي مَخْزُومٍ فَطَلَّقَنِي الْبَتَّةَ فَأَرْسَلْتُ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ أَبْتَغِي النَّفَقَةَ ‏.‏ وَاقْتَصُّوا الْحَدِيثَ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ ‏.‏ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي حَدِيثِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو ‏
"‏ لاَ تَفُوتِينَا بِنَفْسِكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
18.en: Fatima bint Qais reported: I had been married to a person from Banu Makhzum and he divorced me with irrevocable divorce. I sent a message to his family asking for maintenance allowance, and the rest of the hadith has been transmitted with a slight change of words.
18.hi: Fatima bint Qais ne bayan kiya: Meri shaadi Banu Makhzum ke ek shakhs se hui thi aur unhone mujhe akhandit talaaq di. Maine unke khaandaan ko bhar-poshan ke liye payaam bheja, aur baaki hadees alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

18.ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، بْنِ سَعْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا سَلَمَةَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتَ قَيْسٍ أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّهَا، كَانَتْ تَحْتَ أَبِي عَمْرِو بْنِ حَفْصِ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ فَطَلَّقَهَا آخِرَ ثَلاَثِ تَطْلِيقَاتٍ فَزَعَمَتْ أَنَّهَا جَاءَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَسْتَفْتِيهِ فِي خُرُوجِهَا مِنْ بَيْتِهَا فَأَمَرَهَا أَنْ تَنْتَقِلَ إِلَى ابْنِ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ الأَعْمَى فَأَبَى مَرْوَانُ أَنْ يُصَدِّقَهُ فِي خُرُوجِ الْمُطَلَّقَةِ مِنْ بَيْتِهَا وَقَالَ عُرْوَةُ إِنَّ عَائِشَةَ أَنْكَرَتْ ذَلِكَ عَلَى فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ قَيْسٍ.‏
18.en: Fatima bint Qais (Allah be pleased with her) reported that she had been married to Abu 'Amr b. Hafs b. al-Mughira and he divorced her with three pronouncements. She stated that she went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asking him about abandoning that house. He commanded her to move to the house of Ibn Umm Maktum, the blind. Marwan refused to testify the divorced woman abandoning her house (before the 'Idda was over). 'Urwa said that 'A'isha objected to (the words of) Fatima bint Qais.
18.hi: Fatima bint Qais (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unki shaadi Abu Amr bin Hafs bin al-Mughira se hui thi aur unhone unhe teen baar talaaq di. Unhone bataya ki woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gayi unse ghar chhodne ke baare mein poochne ke liye. Unhone unhe Ibn Umm Maktum, andhe, ke ghar mein jaane ka hukum diya. Marwan ne talaaqshuda aurat ki iddat khatam hone se pehle ghar chhodne ki gawaahi dene se inkaar kiya. Urwa ne kaha ki Aisha ne Fatima bint Qais (ke alfaazon) par aitraaz kiya.

18.ar: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حُجَيْنٌ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ مَعَ قَوْلِ عُرْوَةَ إِنَّ عَائِشَةَ أَنْكَرَتْ ذَلِكَ عَلَى فَاطِمَةَ ‏.‏
18.en: This hadith has been transmitted through another chain of narrators.
18.hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

18.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِعَبْدٍ - قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ، الرَّزَّاقِ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، أَنَّ أَبَا عَمْرِو بْنَ حَفْصِ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ، خَرَجَ مَعَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ إِلَى الْيَمَنِ فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَى امْرَأَتِهِ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ قَيْسٍ بِتَطْلِيقَةٍ كَانَتْ بَقِيَتْ مِنْ طَلاَقِهَا وَأَمَرَ لَهَا الْحَارِثَ بْنَ هِشَامٍ وَعَيَّاشَ بْنَ أَبِي رَبِيعَةَ بِنَفَقَةٍ فَقَالاَ لَهَا وَاللَّهِ مَا لَكِ نَفَقَةٌ إِلاَّ أَنْ تَكُونِي حَامِلاً ‏.‏ فَأَتَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَتْ لَهُ قَوْلَهُمَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ نَفَقَةَ لَكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَاسْتَأْذَنَتْهُ فِي الاِنْتِقَالِ فَأَذِنَ لَهَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ أَيْنَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِلَى ابْنِ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَكَانَ أَعْمَى تَضَعُ ثِيَابَهَا عِنْدَهُ وَلاَ يَرَاهَا فَلَمَّا مَضَتْ عِدَّتُهَا أَنْكَحَهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أُسَامَةَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهَا مَرْوَانُ قَبِيصَةَ بْنَ ذُؤَيْبٍ يَسْأَلُهَا عَنِ الْحَدِيثِ فَحَدَّثَتْهُ بِهِ فَقَالَ مَرْوَانُ لَمْ نَسْمَعْ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ إِلاَّ مِنِ امْرَأَةٍ سَنَأْخُذُ بِالْعِصْمَةِ الَّتِي وَجَدْنَا النَّاسَ عَلَيْهَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ فَاطِمَةُ حِينَ بَلَغَهَا قَوْلُ مَرْوَانَ فَبَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكُمُ الْقُرْآنُ قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏ لاَ تُخْرِجُوهُنَّ مِنْ بُيُوتِهِنَّ‏}‏ الآيَةَ قَالَتْ هَذَا لِمَنْ كَانَتْ لَهُ مُرَاجَعَةٌ فَأَىُّ أَمْرٍ يَحْدُثُ بَعْدَ الثَّلاَثِ فَكَيْفَ تَقُولُونَ لاَ نَفَقَةَ لَهَا إِذَا لَمْ تَكُنْ حَامِلاً فَعَلاَمَ تَحْبِسُونَهَا.
18.en: 'Ubaidullah b. 'Abdullah b. 'Utba reported that 'Amr b. Hafs b. al-Mughira set out along with 'Ali b. Abi Talib (Allah be pleased with him) to the Yemen and sent to his wife the one pronouncement of divorce which was still left from the (irrevocable) divorce; and he commanded al-Harith b. Hisham and 'Ayyash b. Abu Rabi'a to give her maintenance allowance. They said to her: By Allah, there is no maintenance allowance for you, except in case you are pregnant. She came to Allah's Apostle (may peace he upon him) and mentioned their opinion to him, whereupon he said: There is no maintenance allowance for you. Then she sought permission to move (to another place), and he (the Holy Prophet) permitted her. She said: Allah's Messenger, where (should I go)? He said: To the house of Ibn Umm Maktum and, as he is blind, she could put off her garmeqts in his presence and he would not see her. And when her 'Idda was over. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) married her to Usama b. Zaid. Marwan (the governor of Medina) sent Qabisa b. Dhuwaib in order to ask her about this hadith, and she narrated it to him, whereupon Marwan said: We have not heard this hadith but from a woman. We would adopt a safe (path) where we found the people. Fatima said that when these words of, Marwan were conveyed to her. There is between me and you the word of Allah, the Exalted and Majestic: Do" not turn them out" of their houses. She asserted: This is in regard to the revocable divorce what new (turn can the event take) after three pronouncements (separation between irrevocable). Why do you say there is no maintenance allowance for her if she is not pregnant? Then on what ground do you restrain her?
18.hi: Ubaidullah bin Abdullah bin Utba ne bayan kiya ki Amr bin Hafs bin al-Mughira Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) (RA) ke saath Yemen ke liye nikle aur apni zauja ko akhri talaaq bheji jo (akhandit) talaaq mein se baaki bachi thi; aur unhone al-Harith bin Hisham aur Ayyash bin Abu Rabi'a ko unhe bhar-poshan dene ka hukum diya. Unhone unse kaha: Allah ki qasam, tumhare liye koi bhar-poshan nahi hai, siwaay is baat ke ki tum garbhvati ho. Woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gayi aur unki raay unhe bataayi, isper unhone kaha: Tumhare liye koi bhar-poshan nahi hai. Phir unhone (ghar) muntaqil hone ki ijazat maangi, aur unhone unhe ijazat de di. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kahan (jaaun)? Unhone kaha: Ibn Umm Maktum ke ghar, aur woh andhe hain, woh apne kapde unke saamne utaar sakti hain aur woh unhe nahi dekhenge. Aur jab unki iddat khatam hui, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unki shaadi Usama bin Zaid se karwaayi. Marwan (Madina ke gavarnar) ne Qabisa bin Dhuwaib ko unse is hadees ke baare mein poochne bheja, aur unhone use ye riwayat ki, isper Marwan ne kaha: Humne ye hadees sirf ek aurat se suni hai. Hum ek mahfooz raasta apnaayenge jahan humne logon ko paaya. Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ne kaha ki jab Marwan ke ye alfaaz unhe pahunchaaye gaye. Mere aur tumhare beech Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, ka lafz hai: "Unhe unke gharon se mat nikaalo." Unhone kaha: Ye akhandit talaaq ke baare mein hai; teen baar talaaq (poori talaaq) ke baad kya naya rukh ho sakta hai? Tum kyun kehte ho ki unke liye koi bhar-poshan nahi hai agar woh garbhvati nahi hain? Phir tum kis buniyaad par unhe rokte ho?

18.ar: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا سَيَّارٌ، وَحُصَيْنٌ، وَمُغِيرَةُ، وَأَشْعَثُ، وَمُجَالِدٌ وَإِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبِي خَالِدٍ وَدَاوُدُ كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، قَالَ دَخَلْتُ عَلَى فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ قَيْسٍ فَسَأَلْتُهَا عَنْ قَضَاءِ، رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَيْهَا فَقَالَتْ طَلَّقَهَا زَوْجُهَا الْبَتَّةَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ فَخَاصَمْتُهُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي السُّكْنَى وَالنَّفَقَةِ - قَالَتْ - فَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ لِي سُكْنَى وَلاَ نَفَقَةً وَأَمَرَنِي أَنْ أَعْتَدَّ فِي بَيْتِ ابْنِ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ ‏.‏
18.en: Sha'bi reported: I visited Fatima bint Qais and asked her about the verdict of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about (board and lodging during the 'Idda) and she said that her husband divorced her with an irrevocable divorce. She (further. said): I contended with him before Allah's Messerger (ﷺ) about lodging and maintenance allowance, and she said: He did not provide me with any lodging or maintenance allowance, and he commanded me to spend the 'Idda in the house of Ibn Umm Maktum.
18.hi: Sha'bi ne bayan kiya: Main Fatima bint Qais ke paas gaya aur unse Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke fatwe ke baare mein poocha (rehne aur bhar-poshan ke baare mein iddat ke daurane) aur unhone kaha ki unke shohar ne unhe akhandit talaaq di. Unhone aage kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saamne rehne aur bhar-poshan ke baare mein unse jhagda kiya, aur unhone kaha: Unhone mujhe koi rehne ki jagah ya bhar-poshan nahi diya, aur unhone mujhe Ibn Umm Maktum ke ghar mein iddat guzaarne ka hukum diya.

18.ar: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ، وَدَاوُدَ، وَمُغِيرَةَ، وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ، وَأَشْعَثَ عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ دَخَلْتُ عَلَى فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ قَيْسٍ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ زُهَيْرٍ عَنْ هُشَيْمٍ.
18.en: A hadith like this has been trarismitted on the authority of Hushaim through another chain of narrators.
18.hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Hushaim ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

18.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ الْهُجَيْمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا قُرَّةُ، حَدَّثَنَا سَيَّارٌ، أَبُو الْحَكَمِ حَدَّثَنَا الشَّعْبِيُّ، قَالَ دَخَلْنَا عَلَى فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ قَيْسٍ فَأَتْحَفَتْنَا بِرُطَبِ ابْنِ طَابٍ وَسَقَتْنَا سَوِيقَ سُلْتٍ فَسَأَلْتُهَا عَنِ الْمُطَلَّقَةِ، ثَلاَثًا أَيْنَ تَعْتَدُّ قَالَتْ طَلَّقَنِي بَعْلِي ثَلاَثًا فَأَذِنَ لِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ أَعْتَدَّ فِي أَهْلِي ‏.
18.en: Sha'bi reported: We visited Fatima bint Qais and she served us fresh dates and a drink of barley flour, and I asked her: Where should a woman who has been divorced by three pronouncements, spend the period of her 'Idda. She said: My husband divorced me with three pronouncements, and Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) permitted me to spend my 'Idda period with my family (with my parents).
18.hi: Sha'bi ne bayan kiya: Hum Fatima bint Qais ke paas gaye aur unhone humein taazi khajooren aur jau ke aate ka sherbet pesh kiya, aur maine unse poocha: Ek aurat, jise teen baar talaaq mili hai, kahan apni iddat ki muddat guzaare? Unhone kaha: Mere shohar ne mujhe teen baar talaaq di, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe apni iddat apne khaandaan ke saath, apne maa-baap ke saath, guzaarne ki ijazat di.

18.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ كُهَيْلٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ قَيْسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْمُطَلَّقَةِ ثَلاَثًا قَالَ ‏
"‏ لَيْسَ لَهَا سُكْنَى وَلاَ نَفَقَةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
18.en: Fatima bint Qais (Allah be pleased with her) reported from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that there is no lodging and maintenance allowance for a woman who has been given irrevocable divorce.
18.hi: Fatima bint Qais (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki ki us aurat ke liye koi rehne ki jagah aur bhar-poshan nahi banta jise akhandit talaaq di gayi ho.

18.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمَّارُ بْنُ، رُزَيْقٍ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ قَيْسٍ، قَالَتْ طَلَّقَنِي زَوْجِي ثَلاَثًا فَأَرَدْتُ النُّقْلَةَ فَأَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ انْتَقِلِي إِلَى بَيْتِ ابْنِ عَمِّكِ عَمْرِو بْنِ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ فَاعْتَدِّي عِنْدَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
18.en: Fatima bint Qais (Allah be pleased with her) reported: My husband divorced me with three pronouncements. I decided to move (from his house to another place). So I came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and he said: Move to the house of your cousin 'Amr b. Umm Maktum and spend your period of 'Idda there.
18.hi: Fatima bint Qais (RA) ne bayan kiya: Mere shohar ne mujhe teen baar talaaq di. Maine (ghar se doosri jagah) muntaqil hone ka faisla kiya. To main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi, aur unhone kaha: Apne chachere bhai Amr bin Umm Maktum ke ghar muntaqil ho jao aur apni iddat ki muddat wahan guzaaro.

18.ar: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ جَبَلَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أَحْمَدَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمَّارُ بْنُ رُزَيْقٍ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ كُنْتُ مَعَ الأَسْوَدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ جَالِسًا فِي الْمَسْجِدِ الأَعْظَمِ وَمَعَنَا الشَّعْبِيُّ فَحَدَّثَ الشَّعْبِيُّ بِحَدِيثِ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ قَيْسٍ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمْ يَجْعَلْ لَهَا سُكْنَى وَلاَ نَفَقَةً ثُمَّ أَخَذَ الأَسْوَدُ كَفًّا مِنْ حَصًى فَحَصَبَهُ بِهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ وَيْلَكَ تُحَدِّثُ بِمِثْلِ هَذَا قَالَ عُمَرُ لاَ نَتْرُكُ كِتَابَ اللَّهِ وَسُنَّةَ نَبِيِّنَا صلى الله عليه وسلم لِقَوْلِ امْرَأَةٍ لاَ نَدْرِي لَعَلَّهَا حَفِظَتْ أَوْ نَسِيَتْ لَهَا السُّكْنَى وَالنَّفَقَةُ قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏ لاَ تُخْرِجُوهُنَّ مِنْ بُيُوتِهِنَّ وَلاَ يَخْرُجْنَ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَأْتِينَ بِفَاحِشَةٍ مُبَيِّنَةٍ‏}‏ ‏.‏
18.en: Abu Ishaq reported: I was with al-Aswad b. Yazid sitting in the great mosque, and there was with us al-Sha'bi, and he narrated the narration of Fatima bint Qais (Allah be pleased with her) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not make any provision for lodging and maintenance allowance for her. Al-Aswad caught hold of some pebbles in his fist and he threw them towards him saying: Woe be to thee, you narrate like it, whereas Umar said: We cannot abandon the Book of Allah and the Sunnah of our Apostle (ﷺ) for the words of a woman. We do not know whether she remembers that or she forgets. For her, there is a provision of lodging and maintenance allowance. Allah, the Exalted and Majestic, said:" Turn them not from their houses nor should they themselves go forth unless they commit an open indecency" (lxv. 1).
18.hi: Abu Ishaq ne bayan kiya: Main al-Aswad bin Yazid ke saath badi masjid mein baitha tha, aur hamare saath al-Sha'bi bhi the, aur unhone Fatima bint Qais (RA) ki riwayat sunaayi ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unke liye koi rehne aur bhar-poshan ka intezaam nahi kiya. Al-Aswad ne mutthi bhar kankariyaan uthaayin aur unhe unki taraf phenka ye kehte hue: Tumpar afsos, tum aisa riwayat karte ho, jabki Umar ne kaha: Hum Allah ki Kitaab aur hamare Rasool (SAW) ki Sunnat ko ek aurat ke alfaazon ke liye nahi chhod sakte. Humein nahi pata ki woh yaad rakhti hai ya bhool jaati hai. Uske liye rehne aur bhar-poshan ka intezaam hai. Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, ne kaha: "Unhe unke gharon se mat nikaalo, na hi unhe khud nikalna chahiye jab tak woh koi khula bura kaam na karein" (65:1).

18.ar: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدَةَ الضَّبِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، عَنْ أَبِي، إِسْحَاقَ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ أَبِي أَحْمَدَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ رُزَيْقٍ، بِقِصَّتِهِ ‏.‏
18.en: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Ishaq with the same chain of transmitters.
18.hi: Isi tarah ki ek hadees Ishaq ki sanad se isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai.

18.ar: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ أَبِي، الْجَهْمِ بْنِ صُخَيْرٍ الْعَدَوِيِّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتَ قَيْسٍ، تَقُولُ إِنَّ زَوْجَهَا طَلَّقَهَا ثَلاَثًا فَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ لَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سُكْنَى وَلاَ نَفَقَةً قَالَتْ قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِذَا حَلَلْتِ فَآذِنِينِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَآذَنْتُهُ فَخَطَبَهَا مُعَاوِيَةُ وَأَبُو جَهْمٍ وَأُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَمَّا مُعَاوِيَةُ فَرَجُلٌ تَرِبٌ لاَ مَالَ لَهُ وَأَمَّا أَبُو جَهْمٍ فَرَجُلٌ ضَرَّابٌ لِلنِّسَاءِ وَلَكِنْ أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ بِيَدِهَا هَكَذَا أُسَامَةُ أُسَامَةُ فَقَالَ لَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ طَاعَةُ اللَّهِ وَطَاعَةُ رَسُولِهِ خَيْرٌ لَكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَتَزَوَّجْتُهُ فَاغْتَبَطْتُ ‏.‏
18.en: Fatima bint Qais (Allah be pleased with her) reported that her husband divorced her with three, pronouncements and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made no provision for her lodging and maintenance allowance. She (further said): Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me: When your period of 'Idda is over, inform me. So I informed him. (By that time) Mu'awiya, Abu Jahm and Usama b. Zaid had given her the proposal of marriage. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: So far as Mu'awiya is concerned, he is a poor man without any property. So far as Abu Jahm is concerned, he is a great beater of women, but Usama b. Zaid... She pointed with her hand (that she did not approve of the idea of marrying) Usama. But Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon himn) said: Obedience to Allah and obedience to His Messenger is better for thee. She said: So I married him, and I became an object of envy.
18.hi: Fatima bint Qais (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unke shohar ne unhe teen baar talaaq di aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unke liye rehne aur bhar-poshan ka koi intezaam nahi kiya. Unhone aage kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse kaha: Jab tumhari iddat ki muddat khatam ho jaaye, mujhe bataana. To maine unhe bataaya. (Us waqt tak) Muawiya, Abu Jahm aur Usama bin Zaid ne unhe shaadi ka prastaav diya tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jahan tak Muawiya ka sawal hai, woh ek gareeb aadmi hai bina kisi maal ke. Jahan tak Abu Jahm ka sawal hai, woh auraton ko bahut maarne wala hai, lekin Usama bin Zaid... Unhone apne haath se ishara kiya ki unhe Usama se shaadi karna pasand nahi tha. Lekin Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Allah ki itaat aur Uske Rasool ki itaat tumhare liye behtar hai. Unhone kaha: To maine unse shaadi ki, aur main rashk ka vishay ban gayi.

18.ar: وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ، أَبِي الْجَهْمِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتَ قَيْسٍ، تَقُولُ أَرْسَلَ إِلَىَّ زَوْجِي أَبُو عَمْرِو بْنُ حَفْصِ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَيَّاشَ بْنَ أَبِي رَبِيعَةَ بِطَلاَقِي وَأَرْسَلَ مَعَهُ بِخَمْسَةِ آصُعِ تَمْرٍ وَخَمْسَةِ آصُعِ شَعِيرٍ فَقُلْتُ أَمَا لِي نَفَقَةٌ إِلاَّ هَذَا وَلاَ أَعْتَدُّ فِي مَنْزِلِكُمْ قَالَ لاَ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَشَدَدْتُ عَلَىَّ ثِيَابِي وَأَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ كَمْ طَلَّقَكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ ثَلاَثًا ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ صَدَقَ لَيْسَ لَكِ نَفَقَةٌ ‏.‏ اعْتَدِّي فِي بَيْتِ ابْنِ عَمِّكِ ابْنِ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ فَإِنَّهُ ضَرِيرُ الْبَصَرِ تُلْقِي ثَوْبَكِ عِنْدَهُ فَإِذَا انْقَضَتْ عِدَّتُكِ فَآذِنِينِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَخَطَبَنِي خُطَّابٌ مِنْهُمْ مُعَاوِيَةُ وَأَبُو الْجَهْمِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ مُعَاوِيَةَ تَرِبٌ خَفِيفُ الْحَالِ وَأَبُو الْجَهْمِ مِنْهُ شِدَّةٌ عَلَى النِّسَاءِ - أَوْ يَضْرِبُ النِّسَاءَ أَوْ نَحْوَ هَذَا - وَلَكِنْ عَلَيْكِ بِأُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
18.en: Fatima bint Qais (Allah be pleased with her) reported: My husband Abu 'Amr b. Hafs b. al-Mughira sent 'Ayyish b. Abu Rabi'a to me with a divorce, and he also sent through him five si's of dates and five si's of barley. I said: Is there no maintenance allowance for me but only this, and I cannot even spend my 'Idda period in your house? He said: No. She said: I dressed myself and came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He said: How many pronouncements of divorce have been made for you? I said: Three. He said what he ('Ayyish b. Abu Rabi'a) had stated was true. There is no maintenance allowance for you. Spend 'Idda period in the house of your cousin, Ibn Umm Maktum. He is blind and you can put off your garment in his presence. And when you have spent your Idda period, you inform me. She said: Mu'awiya and Abu'l-Jahm (Allah be pleased with them) were among those who had given me the proposal of marriage. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Mu'awiya is destitute and in poor condition and Abu'l-Jahm is very harsh with women (or he beats women, or like that), you should take Usama b. Zaid (as your husband).
18.hi: Fatima bint Qais (RA) ne bayan kiya: Mere shohar Abu Amr bin Hafs bin al-Mughira ne Ayyish bin Abu Rabi'a ko mere paas talaaq ke saath bheja, aur unhone unke haath paanch sa khajooren aur paanch sa jau bhi bheji. Maine kaha: Kya mere liye sirf itna hi bhar-poshan hai, aur kya main apni iddat ki muddat bhi aapke ghar mein nahi guzaar sakti? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Unhone kaha: Maine khud ko taiyaar kiya aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi. Unhone kaha: Tumhe kitni baar talaaq di gayi hai? Maine kaha: Teen baar. Unhone kaha: Jo unhone, Ayyish bin Abu Rabi'a ne, kaha woh sahi hai. Tumhare liye koi bhar-poshan nahi hai. Apni iddat apne chachere bhai, Ibn Umm Maktum, ke ghar mein guzaaro. Woh andhe hain aur tum unke saamne apna kapda utaar sakti ho. Aur jab tum apni iddat ki muddat guzaar chuko, mujhe bataana. Unhone kaha: Muawiya aur Abu'l-Jahm (RA) un logon mein the jinhone mujhe shaadi ka prastaav diya tha. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Muawiya bebas aur gareeb haalat mein hain aur Abu'l-Jahm auraton ke saath bahut sakht hain, ya woh auraton ko maarte hain, ya isi jaisa, tumhe Usama bin Zaid ko apna shohar banaana chahiye.

18.ar: وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ الثَّوْرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي الْجَهْمِ، قَالَ دَخَلْتُ أَنَا وَأَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَلَى فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ قَيْسٍ فَسَأَلْنَاهَا فَقَالَتْ كُنْتُ عِنْدَ أَبِي عَمْرِو بْنِ حَفْصِ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ فَخَرَجَ فِي غَزْوَةِ نَجْرَانَ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ مَهْدِيٍّ وَزَادَ قَالَتْ فَتَزَوَّجْتُهُ فَشَرَّفَنِي اللَّهُ بِابْنِ زَيْدٍ وَكَرَّمَنِي اللَّهُ بِابْنِ زَيْدٍ ‏.‏
18.en: Abu Bakr b. Abu'l-Jahm reported: I and Abu Salama b 'Abd al-Rahman came to fatima bint Qais (Al! ah be pleased with her) and asked her (about divorce, etc.). She said: I was the wife of Abu 'Amr b. Hafs b. al-Mughira, and he set out to join the battle of Najran. The rest of the hadith is the same, but he made this addition:" She said: I married him and Allah hornoured me on account of Ibn Zaid and Allah favoured me because of him."
18.hi: Abu Bakr bin Abu'l-Jahm ne bayan kiya: Main aur Abu Salama bin Abd al-Rahman Fatima bint Qais (RA) ke paas aaye aur unse (talaaq waghera ke baare mein) poocha. Unhone kaha: Main Abu Amr bin Hafs bin al-Mughira ki zauja thi, aur woh Najran ki jung mein shaamil hone gaye. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai, lekin unhone ye izafa kiya: Unhone kaha: Maine unse shaadi ki aur Allah ne mujhe Ibn Zaid ki wajah se izzat di aur Allah ne mujhpar unki wajah se meherbaani ki.

18.ar: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرٍ، قَالَ دَخَلْتُ أَنَا وَأَبُو سَلَمَةَ عَلَى فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ قَيْسٍ زَمَنَ ابْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ فَحَدَّثَتْنَا أَنَّ زَوْجَهَا طَلَّقَهَا طَلاَقًا بَاتًّا ‏.‏ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ سُفْيَانَ ‏.‏
18.en: Abu Bakr reported: I and Abu Salama came to Fatima bint Qais (Allah be pleased with her) during the time of Ibn Zubair (Allah be pleased with him) and she narrated to us that her husband gave her an irrevocable divorce. (The rest of the hadith is the same.)
18.hi: Abu Bakr ne bayan kiya: Main aur Abu Salama Fatima bint Qais (RA) ke paas aaye Ibn Zubair (RA) ke daur mein aur unhone humein riwayat ki ki unke shohar ne unhe akhandit talaaq di. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

18.ar: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ السُّدِّيِّ، عَنِ الْبَهِيِّ، عَنْ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ قَيْسٍ، قَالَتْ طَلَّقَنِي زَوْجِي ثَلاَثًا فَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سُكْنَى وَلاَ نَفَقَةً ‏.‏
18.en: Fatima bint Qais (Allah be pleased with her) reported: My husband divorced me with three pronouncements and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made no provision for lodging and maintenance allowance.
18.hi: Fatima bint Qais (RA) ne bayan kiya: Mere shohar ne mujhe teen baar talaaq di aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mere liye koi rehne aur bhar-poshan ka intezaam nahi kiya.

18.ar: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي قَالَ، تَزَوَّجَ يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْعَاصِ بِنْتَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ فَطَلَّقَهَا فَأَخْرَجَهَا مِنْ عِنْدِهِ فَعَابَ ذَلِكَ عَلَيْهِمْ عُرْوَةُ فَقَالُوا إِنَّ فَاطِمَةَ قَدْ خَرَجَتْ ‏.‏ قَالَ عُرْوَةُ فَأَتَيْتُ عَائِشَةَ فَأَخْبَرْتُهَا بِذَلِكَ فَقَالَتْ مَا لِفَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ قَيْسٍ خَيْرٌ فِي أَنْ تَذْكُرَ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ ‏.‏
18.en: Hisham reported on the authority of his father that Yahya b. Sa'id b. al-'As married the daughter of 'Abd al-Rahman b. al-Hakam, and he divorced her and he turned her out from his house. 'Urwa (Allah be -pleased with him) criticised this (action) of theirs (the members of the family of her in-laws). They said: Verily, Fatima too went out (of her in-laws' house). 'Urwa said: I came to 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) and told her about it and she said: There is no good for Fatima bint Qais (Allah be pleased with her) in making mention of it.
18.hi: Hisham ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Yahya bin Sa'id bin al-As ne Abd al-Rahman bin al-Hakam ki beti se shaadi ki, aur unhone unhe talaaq di aur apne ghar se nikaal diya. Urwa (RA) ne unke (uske sasural walon ke) is amal ki aalochana ki. Unhone kaha: Yaqeenan, Fatima bhi bahar gayi thi (apne sasural ke ghar se). Urwa ne kaha: Main Aisha (RA) ke paas aaya aur unhe iske baare mein bataaya aur unhone kaha: Fatima bint Qais (RA) ke liye is baat ka zikr karna achha nahi hai.

18.ar: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ فَاطِمَةَ، بِنْتِ قَيْسٍ قَالَتْ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ زَوْجِي طَلَّقَنِي ثَلاَثًا وَأَخَافُ أَنْ يُقْتَحَمَ عَلَىَّ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَمَرَهَا فَتَحَوَّلَتْ ‏.‏
18.en: Fatima bint Qais (Allah be pleased with her) reported that she said: Allah's Messenger, my husband has divorcee me with three pronouncements and I am afraid that I may be put to hardship, and so he commanded her and so she moved (to another house).
18.hi: Fatima bint Qais (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mere shohar ne mujhe teen baar talaaq di hai aur mujhe dar hai ki mujhe mushkilon mein daala jaayega, aur isper unhone unhe hukum diya aur woh (doosre ghar mein) muntaqil ho gayin.

18.ar: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ مَا لِفَاطِمَةَ خَيْرٌ أَنْ تَذْكُرَ هَذَا ‏.‏ قَالَ تَعْنِي قَوْلَهَا لاَ سُكْنَى وَلاَ نَفَقَةَ ‏.‏
18.en: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) said: It is no good for Fatima to make mention of it, i. e. her statement:" There is no lodging and maintenance allowance (for the divorced women)."
18.hi: Aisha (RA) ne kaha: Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ke liye is baat ka zikr karna achha nahi hai, yaani unka ye bayaan: "Talaaqshuda auraton ke liye koi rehne aur bhar-poshan ka intezaam nahi hai."

18.ar: وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَ عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ لِعَائِشَةَ أَلَمْ تَرَىْ إِلَى فُلاَنَةَ بِنْتِ الْحَكَمِ طَلَّقَهَا زَوْجُهَا الْبَتَّةَ فَخَرَجَتْ فَقَالَتْ بِئْسَمَا صَنَعَتْ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَلَمْ تَسْمَعِي إِلَى قَوْلِ فَاطِمَةَ فَقَالَتْ أَمَا إِنَّهُ لاَ خَيْرَ لَهَا فِي ذِكْرِ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏
18.en: Ibn al-Qasim narrated on the authority of his father that 'Urwa b. Zubair (Allah be pleased with him) said to 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her): Didn't you see that such and such daughter of al-Hakam was divorced by her husband with an irrevocable divorce, and she left (the house of her husband)? Thereupon 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) said: It was bad that she did. He ( Urwa) said: Have you not heard the words of Fatima? Thereupon she said: There if no good for her in making mention of it.
18.hi: Ibn al-Qasim ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ki Urwa bin Zubair (RA) ne Aisha (RA) se kaha: Kya aapne nahi dekha ki al-Hakam ki falan-falan beti ko uske shohar ne akhandit talaaq di, aur woh (uske sasural ke ghar se) bahar chali gayi? Isper Aisha (RA) ne kaha: Ye bura tha ki usne aisa kiya. Unhone (Urwa ne) kaha: Kya aapne Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ke alfaaz nahi sune? Isper unhone kaha: Uske liye ye baat kehna achha nahi hai.

18.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمِ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ طُلِّقَتْ خَالَتِي فَأَرَادَتْ أَنْ تَجُدَّ نَخْلَهَا فَزَجَرَهَا رَجُلٌ أَنْ تَخْرُجَ فَأَتَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ بَلَى فَجُدِّي نَخْلَكِ فَإِنَّكِ عَسَى أَنْ تَصَدَّقِي أَوْ تَفْعَلِي مَعْرُوفًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
18.en: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported: My maternal aunt was divorced, and she intended to pluck her dates. A person scolded her for having come out (during the period of 'Idda). She came to Allah's Prophet (may peace be upon him.) and he said: Certainly you can pluck (dates) from your palm trees, for perhaps you may give charity or do an act of kindness.
18.hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya: Meri maasi ko talaaq di gayi thi, aur unka iraada apni khajooren todne ka tha. Ek shakhs ne unhe (iddat ke daurane) bahar aane ke liye daanta. Woh Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ke paas gayi aur unhone kaha: Yaqeenan tum apne khajoor ke darakhton se (khajooren) tod sakti ho, kyunki shayad tum sadaqa do ya koi nek kaam karo.

18.ar: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، - وَتَقَارَبَا فِي اللَّفْظِ - قَالَ حَرْمَلَةُ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، - حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، أَنَّ أَبَاهُ، كَتَبَ إِلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الأَرْقَمِ الزُّهْرِيِّ يَأْمُرُهُ أَنْ يَدْخُلَ، عَلَى سُبَيْعَةَ بِنْتِ الْحَارِثِ الأَسْلَمِيَّةِ فَيَسْأَلَهَا عَنْ حَدِيثِهَا وَعَمَّا قَالَ لَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ اسْتَفْتَتْهُ فَكَتَبَ عُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ إِلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ يُخْبِرُهُ أَنَّ سُبَيْعَةَ أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ تَحْتَ سَعْدِ ابْنِ خَوْلَةَ وَهُوَ فِي بَنِي عَامِرِ بْنِ لُؤَىٍّ وَكَانَ مِمَّنْ شَهِدَ بَدْرًا فَتُوُفِّيَ عَنْهَا فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ وَهْىَ حَامِلٌ فَلَمْ تَنْشَبْ أَنْ وَضَعَتْ حَمْلَهَا بَعْدَ وَفَاتِهِ فَلَمَّا تَعَلَّتْ مِنْ نِفَاسِهَا تَجَمَّلَتْ لِلْخُطَّابِ فَدَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا أَبُو السَّنَابِلِ بْنُ بَعْكَكٍ - رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي عَبْدِ الدَّارِ - فَقَالَ لَهَا مَا لِي أَرَاكِ مُتَجَمِّلَةً لَعَلَّكِ تَرْجِينَ النِّكَاحَ إِنَّكِ وَاللَّهِ مَا أَنْتِ بِنَاكِحٍ حَتَّى تَمُرَّ عَلَيْكِ أَرْبَعَةُ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرٌ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ سُبَيْعَةُ فَلَمَّا قَالَ لِي ذَلِكَ جَمَعْتُ عَلَىَّ ثِيَابِي حِينَ أَمْسَيْتُ فَأَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَأَفْتَانِي بِأَنِّي قَدْ حَلَلْتُ حِينَ وَضَعْتُ حَمْلِي وَأَمَرَنِي بِالتَّزَوُّجِ إِنْ بَدَا لِي ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ فَلاَ أَرَى بَأْسًا أَنْ تَتَزَوَّجَ حِينَ وَضَعَتْ وَإِنْ كَانَتْ فِي دَمِهَا غَيْرَ أَنْ لاَ يَقْرَبُهَا زَوْجُهَا حَتَّى تَطْهُرَ ‏.‏
18.en: 'Ubaidullah b. 'Abdullah b. 'Utba (b. Mas'ud) reported that his father wrote to Umar b. 'Abdullah b al Arqam al-Zuhri that he would go to Subai'ah bint al-Hirith al-Aslamiyya (Allah be pleased with her) and ask her about a verdict from him which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave her when she had asked that from him (in regard to the termination of 'Idda at the birth of a child) 'Umar b. Abdullah wrote to 'Abdullah b. 'Utba informing him that Subai'ah had told him that she had been married to Sa'd b. Khaula and he belonged to the tribe of Amir b. Lu'ayy, and was one of those who participated in the Battle of Badr, and he died in the Farewell Pilgrimage and she had been in the family way at that time. And much time had not elapsed that she gave birth to a child after his death and when she was free from the effects of childbirth she embellished herself for those who had to give proposals of marriage. Abd al-Sunabil b. Ba'kak (from Banu 'Abd al-Dar) came to her and said: What is this that I see you embellished; perhaps you are inclined to marry, By Allah, you cannot marry unless four months and ten days (of 'Idda are passed). When he said that. I dressed myself, and as it was evening I came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and asked him about it, and he gave me a religious verdict that I was allowed to marry when I had given birth to a child and asked me to marry if I so liked. Ibn Shihab said: I do not find any harm fur her in marrying when she has given birth to a child even when she is bleeding (after the birth of the child) except that her husband should not go near her until she is purified.
18.hi: Ubaidullah bin Abdullah bin Utba (bin Mas'ud) ne bayan kiya ki unke walid ne Umar bin Abdullah bin al-Arqam al-Zuhri ko likha ki woh Subai'ah bint al-Harith al-Aslamiyya (RA) ke paas jaayein aur unse ek fatwe ke baare mein poochhein jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe diya tha jab unhone unse ye poocha tha (bachche ki paidaish par iddat khatam hone ke baare mein). Umar bin Abdullah ne Abdullah bin Utba ko likha aur unhe bataya ki Subai'ah ne unhe bataaya tha ki unki shaadi Sa'd bin Khaula se hui thi aur woh Amir bin Lu'ayy qabile ke the, aur Badr ki jung mein shaamil huye the, aur unka intiqaal Vida ke Hajj mein hua aur woh us waqt garbhvati thin. Aur zyada waqt nahi guzra tha ki unhone unki maut ke baad ek bachche ko paida kiya aur jab woh bachche ki paidaish ke asraat se azaad hui to unhone khud ko un logon ke liye sajaaya jinhe shaadi ka prastaav dena tha. Abd al-Sunabil bin Ba'kak (Banu Abd al-Dar se) unke paas aaye aur kaha: Ye kya hai ki main aapko saja hua dekh raha hoon; shayad aap shaadi karna chahti hain, Allah ki qasam, aap shaadi tab tak nahi kar sakti jab tak chaar mahine aur das din (iddat ke) na guzar jaayein. Jab unhone ye kaha, maine khud ko taiyaar kiya, aur chunki shaam ho gayi thi main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur unse iske baare mein poocha, aur unhone mujhe fatwa diya ki mujhe shaadi ki ijazat hai jab maine bachche ko paidaish de diya hai aur mujhse kaha ki agar main chahun to shaadi kar loon. Ibn Shihab ne kaha: Mujhe koi nuksaan nazar nahi aata uske liye shaadi karne mein jab usne bachche ko paidaish de diya ho chahe woh khoon bah raha ho (bachche ki paidaish ke baad) siwaay is baat ke ki uska shohar use tab tak na chhue jab tak woh paak na ho jaaye.

18.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى الْعَنَزِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ يَحْيَى بْنَ سَعِيدٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ يَسَارٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا سَلَمَةَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، وَابْنَ، عَبَّاسٍ اجْتَمَعَا عِنْدَ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ وَهُمَا يَذْكُرَانِ الْمَرْأَةَ تُنْفَسُ بَعْدَ وَفَاةِ زَوْجِهَا بِلَيَالٍ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ عِدَّتُهَا آخِرُ الأَجَلَيْنِ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَبُو سَلَمَةَ قَدْ حَلَّتْ ‏.‏ فَجَعَلاَ يَتَنَازَعَانِ ذَلِكَ قَالَ فَقَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ أَنَا مَعَ ابْنِ أَخِي - يَعْنِي أَبَا سَلَمَةَ - فَبَعَثُوا كُرَيْبًا - مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ - إِلَى أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ يَسْأَلُهَا عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَجَاءَهُمْ فَأَخْبَرَهُمْ أَنَّ أُمَّ سَلَمَةَ قَالَتْ إِنَّ سُبَيْعَةَ الأَسْلَمِيَّةَ نُفِسَتْ بَعْدَ وَفَاةِ زَوْجِهَا بِلَيَالٍ وَإِنَّهَا ذَكَرَتْ ذَلِكَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَمَرَهَا أَنْ تَتَزَوَّجَ ‏.‏
18.en: Abu Salama b. 'Abd al-Rahman and Ibn 'Abbas. (Allah be pleased with them) got together in the house of Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) and began to discuss about the woman who gave birth to a child a few nights after the death of her husband. Ibn 'Abbas (Allah be pleased with then) ) said: Her 'Idda is that period which is longer of the two (between four months and ten days and the birth of the child, whichever is longer). AbuSalama, however said: Her period of 'Idda is over (with the birth of the child), and they were contending with each other over this issue, whereupon Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) said: I subscribe (to the view) held by my nephew (i. e. Abu Salama). They sent Kuraib (the freed slave of Ibn 'Abbas) to Umm Salama to ask her about it. He came (back) to them and informed them that Umm Salama (Allah be pleased with her) said that Subai'ah al-Aslamiyya gave birth to a child after the death of her husband when the few flights (had hardly) passed and she made mention of that to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he commanded her to marry.
18.hi: Abu Salama bin Abd al-Rahman aur Ibn Abbas (RA) Abu Huraira (RA) ke ghar ikattha huye aur us aurat ke baare mein charcha shuru ki jisne apne shohar ki maut ke kuch raaton baad bachche ko paida kiya. Ibn Abbas (RA) ne kaha: Uski iddat woh muddat hai jo do mein se lambi ho, chaar mahine das din aur bachche ki paidaish ke beech, jo bhi lamba ho. Abu Salama, halaanki, ne kaha: Uski iddat khatam ho jaati hai, bachche ki paidaish ke saath, aur woh is mudde par ek-doosre se jhagad rahe the, isper Abu Huraira (RA) ne kaha: Main apne bhatije, yaani Abu Salama, ki raay ka himayat karta hoon. Unhone Kuraib (Ibn Abbas ke aazad kiye hue ghulam) ko Umm Salama ke paas bheja unse iske baare mein poochne ke liye. Woh (wapas) unke paas aaye aur unhe bataya ki Umm Salama (RA) ne kaha ki Subai'ah al-Aslamiyya ne apne shohar ki maut ke baad ek bachche ko paida kiya jab kuch hi raaten guzri thi aur usne iska zikr Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kiya aur unhone use shaadi karne ka hukum diya.

18.ar: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو، النَّاقِدُ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ غَيْرَ أَنَّقَالَ فِي حَدِيثِهِ فَأَرْسَلُوا إِلَى أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ وَلَمْ يُسَمِّ كُرَيْبًا ‏.‏
18.en: This hadith has been narated with the same chain of transrmitters except with a small change of words (and that is): They sent him to Umm Salama, but no mention was made of Kuraib.
18.hi: Ye hadees isi tarah ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai siwaay alfaazon mein choti tabdeeli ke, ki: Unhone use Umm Salama ke paas bheja, lekin Kuraib ka koi zikr nahi kiya gaya.

18.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، أَنَّهَا أَخْبَرَتْهُ هَذِهِ الأَحَادِيثَ الثَّلاَثَةَ، قَالَ قَالَتْ زَيْنَبُ دَخَلْتُ عَلَى أُمِّ حَبِيبَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ تُوُفِّيَ أَبُوهَا أَبُو سُفْيَانَ فَدَعَتْ أُمُّ حَبِيبَةَ بِطِيبٍ فِيهِ صُفْرَةٌ خَلُوقٌ أَوْ غَيْرُهُ فَدَهَنَتْ مِنْهُ جَارِيَةً ثُمَّ مَسَّتْ بِعَارِضَيْهَا ثُمَّ قَالَتْ وَاللَّهِ مَا لِي بِالطِّيبِ مِنْ حَاجَةٍ غَيْرَ أَنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ ‏"‏ لاَ يَحِلُّ لاِمْرَأَةٍ تُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ تُحِدُّ عَلَى مَيِّتٍ فَوْقَ ثَلاَثٍ إِلاَّ عَلَى زَوْجٍ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
 قَالَتْ زَيْنَبُ ثُمَّ دَخَلْتُ عَلَى زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ جَحْشٍ حِينَ تُوُفِّيَ أَخُوهَا فَدَعَتْ بِطِيبٍ فَمَسَّتْ مِنْهُ ثُمَّ قَالَتْ وَاللَّهِ مَا لِي بِالطِّيبِ مِنْ حَاجَةٍ غَيْرَ أَنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ ‏"‏ لاَ يَحِلُّ لاِمْرَأَةٍ تُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ تُحِدُّ عَلَى مَيِّتٍ فَوْقَ ثَلاَثٍ إِلاَّ عَلَى زَوْجٍ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
 قَالَتْ زَيْنَبُ سَمِعْتُ أُمِّي أُمَّ سَلَمَةَ، تَقُولُ جَاءَتِ امْرَأَةٌ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ ابْنَتِي تُوُفِّيَ عَنْهَا زَوْجُهَا وَقَدِ اشْتَكَتْ عَيْنُهَا أَفَنَكْحُلُهَا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ مَرَّتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثًا كُلَّ ذَلِكَ يَقُولُ لاَ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا هِيَ أَرْبَعَةُ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرٌ وَقَدْ كَانَتْ إِحْدَاكُنَّ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ تَرْمِي بِالْبَعَرَةِ عَلَى رَأْسِ الْحَوْلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
 قَالَ حُمَيْدٌ قُلْتُ لِزَيْنَبَ وَمَا تَرْمِي بِالْبَعَرَةِ عَلَى رَأْسِ الْحَوْلِ فَقَالَتْ زَيْنَبُ كَانَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ إِذَا تُوُفِّيَ عَنْهَا زَوْجُهَا دَخَلَتْ حِفْشًا وَلَبِسَتْ شَرَّ ثِيَابِهَا وَلَمْ تَمَسَّ طِيبًا وَلاَ شَيْئًا حَتَّى تَمُرَّ بِهَا سَنَةٌ ثُمَّ تُؤْتَى بِدَابَّةٍ حِمَارٍ أَوْ شَاةٍ أَوْ طَيْرٍ فَتَفْتَضُّ بِهِ فَقَلَّمَا تَفْتَضُّ بِشَىْءٍ إِلاَّ مَاتَ ثُمَّ تَخْرُجُ فَتُعْطَى بَعَرَةً فَتَرْمِي بِهَا ثُمَّ تُرَاجِعُ بَعْدُ مَا شَاءَتْ مِنْ طِيبٍ أَوْ غَيْرِهِ ‏.‏
18.en: Zainab (bint Abu Salama) (Allah be pleased with her) reported: I went to Umm Habiba, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), when her father Abu Sufyan had died. Umm Habiba sent for a perfume having yellowness in it or something else like it, and she applied it to a girl and then rubbed it on her cheeks and then said: By Allah, I need no perfume but for the fact that I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say on the pulpit:" It is not permissible for a woman believing in Allah and the Hereafter to mourn for the dead beyond three days, but (in case of the death) of the husband it is permissible for four months and ten days." Zainab said: I then visited Zainab hint Jahsh (Allah be pleased with her) when her brother died and she sent for perfume and applied it and then said: By Allah, I don't feel any need for the perfume but that I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say on the pulpit:" It is not permissible for a woman believing in Allah and the Hereafbler to mourn the dead beyond three days except in case of her husband (for whom she can mourn) for four months and ten days." Zainab (Allah be pleased with her) said: I heard my mother Umm Salama (Allah be pleased with her) as saying: A woman came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger. I have a daughter whose husband has died and there has developed some trouble in her eye; should we apply collyrium to it? Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: No (repeating it twice or thrice, saying only, NO" all the time). Then he said: It is only four mouths and ten days, whereas in the preIslamic period none of you threw away the dung until one year had passed. Humaid said: I said to Zainab: What is this throwing of dung until a year is passed? Zainab said: When the husband of a woman died, she went into a hut and put on her worst clothes, and did not apply perfume or something like it until a year was over. Then an animal like a donkey, or a goat, or a bird was brought to her and she rubbed her hand over it, and it so happened that one on which she rubbed her hand died. She then came out of her house and she was given dung and she threw it and then she made use of anything like perfume or something else as she liked.
18.hi: Zainab (bint Abu Salama) (RA) ne bayan kiya: Main Umm Habiba, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ke paas gayi jab unke waalid Abu Sufyan ka intiqaal hua tha. Umm Habiba ne peelaapan wali khushboo ya usi jaisa kuch mangwaaya, aur unhone use ek larki par lagaayi aur phir apne gaalon par mala, aur phir kaha: Allah ki qasam, mujhe khushboo ki koi zaroorat nahi hai siwaay is baat ke ki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko mimbar par ye kehte suna: "Kisi aurat ke liye jo Allah aur Aakhirat par imaan rakhti hai, murde ke liye teen din se zyada shok manaana jaayez nahi hai, lekin shohar ki maut ke maamle mein ye chaar mahine das din ke liye jaayez hai." Zainab ne kaha: Main phir Zainab bint Jahsh (RA) ke paas gayi jab unke bhai ka intiqaal hua aur unhone khushboo mangwaayi aur use lagaya aur phir kaha: Allah ki qasam, mujhe koi khushboo ki zaroorat mehsoos nahi hoti siwaay is baat ke ki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko mimbar par ye kehte suna: "Kisi aurat ke liye jo Allah aur Aakhirat par imaan rakhti hai, murde ke liye teen din se zyada shok manaana jaayez nahi hai siwaay uske shohar ke maamle mein jiske liye woh chaar mahine das din shok mana sakti hai." Zainab (RA) ne kaha: Maine apni maa Umm Salama (RA) ko ye kehte suna: Ek aurat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, meri ek beti hai jiske shohar ka intiqaal ho gaya hai aur uski aankh mein kuch takleef paida ho gayi hai; kya humein usme surma lagaana chahiye? Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Nahi (do ya teen baar dohraate hue, sirf "NAHI" kehte hue). Phir unhone kaha: Ye sirf chaar mahine das din ke liye hai, jabki Islam se pehle ke daur mein tum mein se koi bhi mal tab tak nahi phenkti thi jab tak ek saal na guzar jaaye. Humaid ne kaha: Maine Zainab se kaha: Ye kya hai, ek saal tak mal phenkna? Zainab ne kaha: Jab kisi aurat ke shohar ka intiqaal hota, woh ek jhopdi mein chali jaati aur apne sabse buray kapde pehanti, aur woh khushboo ya usi jaisi koi cheez tab tak nahi lagati jab tak ek saal na guzar jaaye. Phir gadhe, bakri, ya parinde jaisa koi jaanwar laaya jaata aur woh apna haath uspar malti, aur aisa hota tha ki jispar woh apna haath malti woh mar jaata. Woh phir apne ghar se bahar aati aur use mal diya jaata aur woh use phenkti aur phir woh koi khushboo ya usi jaisi cheez istemal karti jaisa woh chahti.

18.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ نَافِعٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتَ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، قَالَتْ تُوُفِّيَ حَمِيمٌ لأُمِّ حَبِيبَةَ فَدَعَتْ بِصُفْرَةٍ فَمَسَحَتْهُ بِذِرَاعَيْهَا وَقَالَتْ إِنَّمَا أَصْنَعُ هَذَا لأَنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏
"‏ لاَ يَحِلُّ لاِمْرَأَةٍ تُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ أَنْ تُحِدَّ فَوْقَ ثَلاَثٍ إِلاَّ عَلَى زَوْجٍ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
18.en: Zainab bint Umm Salama (Allah be pleased with her) reported that a relative of Umm Habiba (Allah he pleased with her) died. She sent for a yellow (perfume) and applied that to her forearm and said: I, am doing it, for I have heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying: It is not permissible for a woman believing in Allah and the Hereafter to mourn beyond three days except the husband (for whom she can mourn) for four months and ten days.
18.hi: Zainab bint Umm Salama (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Umm Habiba (RA) ke ek rishtedaar ka intiqaal hua. Unhone peeli khushboo mangwaayi aur use apni baazu par lagaayi aur kaha: Main ye kar rahi hoon, kyunki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Kisi aurat ke liye jo Allah aur Aakhirat par imaan rakhti hai, teen din se zyada shok manaana jaayez nahi hai siwaay shohar ke jiske liye woh chaar mahine das din shok mana sakti hai.

18.ar: وَحَدَّثَتْهُ زَيْنَبُ، عَنْ أُمِّهَا، وَعَنْ زَيْنَبَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَوْ عَنِ امْرَأَةٍ مِنْ بَعْضِ أَزْوَاجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
18.en: This hadith was narrated by Zainab from her mother and from Zainab, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), or from some other lady from among the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ).
18.hi: Ye hadees Zainab ne apni maa se aur Zainab, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, se, ya Nabi (SAW) ki zaujaon mein se kisi aur khaatoon se riwayat ki hai.

18.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ نَافِعٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتَ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، تُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أُمِّهَا، أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، تُوُفِّيَ زَوْجُهَا فَخَافُوا عَلَى عَيْنِهَا فَأَتَوُا النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَاسْتَأْذَنُوهُ فِي الْكُحْلِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ قَدْ كَانَتْ إِحْدَاكُنَّ تَكُونُ فِي شَرِّ بَيْتِهَا فِي أَحْلاَسِهَا - أَوْ فِي شَرِّ أَحْلاَسِهَا فِي بَيْتِهَا - حَوْلاً فَإِذَا مَرَّ كَلْبٌ رَمَتْ بِبَعَرَةٍ فَخَرَجَتْ أَفَلاَ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
18.en: Zainab bint Umm Salama (Allah be pleased with her) reported on the authority of her mother that a woman lost her husband. (As her eyes were ailing) they (her kith and kin) entertained fear about her eyes, so they came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and sought permission for the use of collyrium, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: One among you used to spend one year in a dungeon dressed in worst clothes. (And at the end of this period) she threw dung at the dog which happened to pass that way and then she came out (of her 'Idda). Can't she (wait) even for four months and ten days?
18.hi: Zainab bint Umm Salama (RA) ne apni maa ke hawale se riwayat ki ki ek aurat ne apna shohar kho diya. (Kyunki uski aankhein bimaar thin) unhe (uske rishtedaaron ko) uski aankhon ki fikar thi, is liye woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur surma istemal karne ki ijazat maangi, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Tum mein se koi apne sabse buray kapdon mein ek saal andheri jagah mein guzaarti thi. (Aur is muddat ke akhir mein) woh kutte par mal phenkti jo waha se guzarta aur phir woh (iddat se) bahar aati. Kya woh chaar mahine das din bhi intezaar nahi kar sakti?

18.ar: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ نَافِعٍ، بِالْحَدِيثَيْنِ جَمِيعًا حَدِيثِ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ فِي الْكُحْلِ وَحَدِيثِ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ وَأُخْرَى مِنْ أَزْوَاجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ لَمْ تُسَمِّهَا زَيْنَبُ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ ‏.‏
18.en: Humaid b. Nafi' narrated two traditions from Umm Salama dealing with collyrium and the other hadith from the wives of Allah's Prophet (ﷺ) except with this that no mention was made of Zainab.
18.hi: Humaid bin Nafi ne Umm Salama se surme ke baare mein do riwayaten aur Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ki zaujaon se doosri hadees riwayat ki siwaay is baat ke ki Zainab ka koi zikr nahi kiya gaya.

18.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتَ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، تُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، وَأُمِّ حَبِيبَةَ تَذْكُرَانِ أَنَّ امْرَأَةً أَتَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَتْ لَهُ أَنَّ بِنْتًا لَهَا تُوُفِّيَ عَنْهَا زَوْجُهَا فَاشْتَكَتْ عَيْنُهَا فَهْىَ تُرِيدُ أَنْ تَكْحُلَهَا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ قَدْ كَانَتْ إِحْدَاكُنَّ تَرْمِي بِالْبَعَرَةِ عِنْدَ رَأْسِ الْحَوْلِ وَإِنَّمَا هِيَ أَرْبَعَةُ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
18.en: Zainab bint Abu Salama reported: Umm Salama and Umm Habiba (Allah be pleased with them) were talking with each other (and saying) that a woman came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and mentioned to him that her daughter had lost her husband, and her eyes were sore and she wanted to use collyrium, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: One among you used to throw dung at the end of a year, and now (this abstinence from adornment) is only for four months and ten days.
18.hi: Zainab bint Abu Salama ne bayan kiya: Umm Salama aur Umm Habiba (RA) ek-doosre se baat kar rahi thin ki ek aurat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur unhe bataaya ki uski beti ne apna shohar kho diya hai, aur uski aankhein dukh rahi hain aur woh surma istemal karna chahti hai, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Tum mein se koi ek saal ke akhir mein mal phenkti thi, aur ab ye sirf chaar mahine das din ke liye hai.

18.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِعَمْرٍو - حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ مُوسَى، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، قَالَتْ لَمَّا أَتَى أُمَّ حَبِيبَةَ نَعِيُّ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ دَعَتْ فِي الْيَوْمِ الثَّالِثِ بِصُفْرَةٍ فَمَسَحَتْ بِهِ ذِرَاعَيْهَا وَعَارِضَيْهَا وَقَالَتْ كُنْتُ عَنْ هَذَا غَنِيَّةً سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏
"‏ لاَ يَحِلُّ لاِمْرَأَةٍ تُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ أَنْ تُحِدَّ فَوْقَ ثَلاَثٍ إِلاَّ عَلَى زَوْجٍ فَإِنَّهَا تُحِدُّ عَلَيْهِ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرًا ‏"‏‏.‏
