The narrator continued: People turned to the house of Abu Sufyan and people locked their doors. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) proceeded until he approached the (Black) Stone. He kissed it and circumambulated the Ka'ba. He reached near an idol by the side of the Ka'ba which was worshipped by the people. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had a bow in his hand, and he was holding it from a corner. When he came near the idol, he began to pierce its eyes with the bow and (while doing so) was saying: Truth has been established and falsehood has perished. When he had finished the circumambulation, he came to Safa', ascended it to a height from where he could see the Ka'ba, raised his hands (in prayer) and began to praise Allah and prayed what he wanted to pray.
32.hi: Abdullah bin Rabah ne Abu Huraira se riwayat ki jinhone kaha: Kayi numainda mandal Muawiya ke paas aaye. Ye Ramzan ke mahine mein tha. Hum ek-doosre ke liye khaana taiyaar karte. Abu Huraira un logon mein se the jo hamein aksar apne ghar bulaate the. Maine kaha: Kya mujhe khaana taiyaar nahi karna chahiye aur unhe apni jagah nahi bulaana chahiye? To maine khaana taiyaar karne ka hukum diya. Phir main shaam ko Abu Huraira se mila aur kaha: (Aapko) aaj raat mere saath khaana khaana hai. Unhone kaha: Aapne mujhse pehle hi ye kaha (yaani mera bhi yahi iraada tha). Maine kaha: Haan, aur unhe bulaaya. (Jab woh khaane se farigh hue) Abu Huraira ne kaha: Kya main tumhe tumhari hi ek riwayat na sunaun, Aye Ansar ke giroh? Unhone phir Makkah ki Fatah ka byora diya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aage baDhe yahan tak ki woh Makkah pahunche. Unhone Zubair ko apni daayi taraf aur Khalid ko baayi taraf muqarrar kiya, aur unhone Abu Ubaida ko us fauj ke saath bheja jiske paas koi kavach nahi tha. Woh wadi ke andar ki taraf aage baDhe. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) laDaakon ke ek bade dal ke beech mein the. Unhone mujhe dekha aur kaha: Abu Huraira. Maine kaha: Main aapki pukaar par haazir hoon, Allah ke Rasool 1 Unhone kaha: Mere paas Ansar ke ilawa koi na aaye, is liye mujhe Ansar (hi) bulaao. Abu Huraira ne aage kaha: To woh unke charon taraf ikattha hue. Quraish ne bhi apne buray logon aur apne (nichle darje ke) anuyaayiyon ko ikattha kiya, aur kaha: Hum inhe aage bhejte hain. Agar unhe kuch milta hai, to hum unke saath honge (ise baantne ke liye), aur agar koi durbhaagya unhe pahunchta hai, to hum jo bhi humse maanga jaaye, muaaviza denge. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (Ansar se) kaha: Tum Quraish ke buray logon aur (nichle darje ke) anuyaayiyon ko dekhte ho. Aur unhone apne ek haath ko doosre par (maarkar) ishara kiya ki unhe qatal kar diya jaana chahiye aur kaha: Mujhse as-Safa mein milo. Phir hum aage baDhe (aur) agar hummein se koi chaahta ki koi khaas shakhs qatal kiya jaaye, use qatal kar diya jaata, aur koi bhi virodh nahi kar paata. Abu Huraira ne aage kaha: Phir Abu Sufyan aaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Quraish ka khoon bahut sasta ho gaya hai. Aaj se koi Quraish nahi hoga. Phir unhone (Nabi ne) kaha: Jo Abu Sufyan ke ghar mein daakhil hota hai, woh mahfooz hoga. Kuch Ansar ne aapas mein kaanaphusi ki: (Aakhirkaar), apne shehar ke liye muhabbat aur apne rishtedaaron ke prati narmi ne unhe abhibhoot kar liya hai. Abu Huraira ne kaha: (Is pal) Nabi (SAW) par wahi utri aur jab woh wahi paane wale hote, hum ise samajh jaate the, aur jab woh use (waaqai) paate, hummein se koi bhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki taraf apni aankhein uthaane ki himmat nahi karta jab tak wahi khatm na ho jaaye. Jab wahi khatm hui, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Aye Ansar ke giroh! Unhone kaha: Hum yahan hain aapki khidmat mein, Allah ke Rasool. Unhone kaha: Tum keh rahe the ki apne shehar ke liye muhabbat aur apne logon ke prati narmi ne is aadmi ko abhibhoot kar liya hai. Unhone kaha: Haan, aisa hi tha. Unhone kaha: Nahi, kabhi nahi. Main Allah aur Uske Rasool ka banda hoon. Maine Allah ki taraf aur tumhari taraf hijrat ki. Main tumhare saath rahunga aur tumhare saath maroonga. To, woh (Ansar) aansuon mein unki taraf mude aur keh rahe the: Allah ki qasam, humne jo kaha woh Allah aur Uske Rasool ke prati apne dridh lagaav ki wajah se kaha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Yaqeenan, Allah aur Uske Rasool tumhare daave ki gawaahi dete hain aur tumhari maafi qubool karte hain. Raawi ne aage kaha: Log Abu Sufyan ke ghar ki taraf mude aur logon ne apne darwaze band kar liye. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aage baDhe yahan tak ki woh (Kaale) Patthar ke qareeb pahunche. Unhone use chooma aur Kaaba ka tawaaf kiya. Woh Kaaba ke bagal mein ek but ke paas pahunche jiski log ibadat karte the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke haath mein ek dhanush tha, aur woh use ek kone se pakDe hue the. Jab woh but ke qareeb aaye, unhone dhanush se uski aankhein bhedni shuru ki aur (aisa karte hue) keh rahe the: Sach qaim ho gaya hai aur jhoot khatm ho gaya hai. Jab unhone tawaaf khatm kiya, woh Safa aaye, uspar chaDhe itni oonchai tak jahan se woh Kaaba dekh sakte the, apne haath uthaaye (dua mein) aur Allah ki tareef karne lage aur jo woh chahte the dua ki.

32.ar: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ هَاشِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَزَادَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ ثُمَّ قَالَ بِيَدَيْهِ إِحْدَاهُمَا عَلَى الأُخْرَى ‏"‏ احْصُدُوهُمْ حَصْدًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ قَالُوا قُلْنَا ذَاكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَمَا اسْمِي إِذًا كَلاَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
32.en: The tradition has been narrated by a different chain of transmitters with the following additions: (i) Then be (the Messenger of Allah) said with his hands one upon the other: Kill them (who stand in your way).... (ii) They (the Ansar) replied: We said so, Messenger of Allah! He said: What is my name? I am but Allah's bondman and His Messenger.
32.hi: Riwayat ek doosri sanad ke zariye in izafon ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai: (i) Phir unhone (Allah ke Rasool ne) apne haathon ko ek-doosre par (rakhkar) kaha: Unhe (jo tumhare raaste mein khade hain) qatal karo.... (ii) Unhone (Ansar ne) jawaab diya: Humne aisa kaha, Allah ke Rasool! Unhone kaha: Mera naam kya hai? Main sirf Allah ka banda aur Uska Rasool hoon.

32.ar: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ، بْنُ سَلَمَةَ أَخْبَرَنَا ثَابِتٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ رَبَاحٍ، قَالَ وَفَدْنَا إِلَى مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ وَفِينَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ رَجُلٍ مِنَّا يَصْنَعُ طَعَامًا يَوْمًا لأَصْحَابِهِ فَكَانَتْ نَوْبَتِي فَقُلْتُ يَا أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ الْيَوْمُ نَوْبَتِي ‏.‏ فَجَاءُوا إِلَى الْمَنْزِلِ وَلَمْ يُدْرِكْ طَعَامُنَا فَقُلْتُ يَا أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ لَوْ حَدَّثْتَنَا عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى يُدْرِكَ طَعَامُنَا فَقَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ الْفَتْحِ فَجَعَلَ خَالِدَ بْنَ الْوَلِيدِ عَلَى الْمُجَنِّبَةِ الْيُمْنَى وَجَعَلَ الزُّبَيْرَ عَلَى الْمُجَنِّبَةِ الْيُسْرَى وَجَعَلَ أَبَا عُبَيْدَةَ عَلَى الْبَيَاذِقَةِ وَبَطْنِ الْوَادِي فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ادْعُ لِي الأَنْصَارَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَدَعَوْتُهُمْ فَجَاءُوا يُهَرْوِلُونَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا مَعْشَرَ الأَنْصَارِ هَلْ تَرَوْنَ أَوْبَاشَ قُرَيْشٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ انْظُرُوا إِذَا لَقِيتُمُوهُمْ غَدًا أَنْ تَحْصِدُوهُمْ حَصْدًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَأَخْفَى بِيَدِهِ وَوَضَعَ يَمِينَهُ عَلَى شِمَالِهِ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَوْعِدُكُمُ الصَّفَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَمَا أَشْرَفَ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَهُمْ أَحَدٌ إِلاَّ أَنَامُوهُ - قَالَ - وَصَعِدَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الصَّفَا وَجَاءَتِ الأَنْصَارُ فَأَطَافُوا بِالصَّفَا فَجَاءَ أَبُو سُفْيَانَ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أُبِيدَتْ خَضْرَاءُ قُرَيْشٍ لاَ قُرَيْشَ بَعْدَ الْيَوْمِ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو سُفْيَانَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ دَخَلَ دَارَ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ فَهُوَ آمِنٌ وَمَنْ أَلْقَى السِّلاَحَ فَهُوَ آمِنٌ وَمَنْ أَغْلَقَ بَابَهُ فَهُوَ آمِنٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتِ الأَنْصَارُ أَمَّا الرَّجُلُ فَقَدْ أَخَذَتْهُ رَأْفَةٌ بِعَشِيرَتِهِ وَرَغْبَةٌ فِي قَرْيَتِهِ ‏.‏ وَنَزَلَ الْوَحْىُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ قُلْتُمْ أَمَّا الرَّجُلُ فَقَدْ أَخَذَتْهُ رَأْفَةٌ بِعَشِيرَتِهِ وَرَغْبَةٌ فِي قَرْيَتِهِ ‏.‏ أَلاَ فَمَا اسْمِي إِذًا - ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ - أَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولُهُ هَاجَرْتُ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَإِلَيْكُمْ فَالْمَحْيَا مَحْيَاكُمْ وَالْمَمَاتُ مَمَاتُكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا وَاللَّهِ مَا قُلْنَا إِلاَّ ضِنًّا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ يُصَدِّقَانِكُمْ وَيَعْذِرَانِكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
32.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Abdullah b. Rabah who said: We came to Mu'awiya b. Abu Sufyan as a deputation and Abu Huraira was among us. Each of us would prepare food for his companions turn by turn for a day. (Accordingly) when it was my turn I said: Abu Huraira, it is my turn today. So they came to my place. The food was not yet ready, so I said to Abu Huraira: I wish you could narrate to us a tradition from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) until the food was ready. (Complying with my request) Abu Huraira said: We were with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the day of the Conquest of Mecca. He appointed Khalid b. Walid as commander of the right flank, Zubair as commander of the left flank, and Abu 'Ubaida as commander of the foot-soldiers (who were to advance) to the interior of the valley. He (then) said: Abu Huraira, call the Ansar to me. So I called out to them and they came hurriedly. He said: O ye Assembly of the Ansaar, do you see the ruffians of the Quraish? They said: Yes. He said: See, when you meet them tomorrow, wipe them out. He hinted at this with his hand, placing his right hand on his left and said: You will meet us at as-Safa'. (Abu Huraira continued): Whoever was seen by them that day was put to death. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ascended the mount of as-Safa'. The Ansar also came there and surrounded the mount. Then came Abu Sufyan and said: Messenger ot Allah, the Quraish have perished. No member of the Quraish tribe will survive this day. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Who enters the house of Abu Safyin will be safe, who lays down arms will be safe, who locks his door will be safe. (some of) the Ansar said: (After all) the man has been swayed by tenderness towards his family and love for his city. At this, Divine inspiration descended upon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He said: You were saying that the man has been swayed by tenderness towards his family and love for his city. Do you know what my name is? I am Muhammad, the bondman of God and His Messenger. (He repeated this thrice.) I left my native place for the take of Allah and joined you. So I will live with you and die with you. Now the Ansar said: By God, we said (that) only out of our greed for Allah and His Messenger. He said: Allah and His Apostle testify to you and accept your apology.
32.hi: Abdullah bin Rabah ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Hum Muawiya bin Abu Sufyan ke paas ek numainda mandal ke soorat mein aaye aur Abu Huraira humme the. Hummein se har ek baari-baari se ek din apne saathiyon ke liye khaana taiyaar karta. (Uske mutabik) jab meri baari thi maine kaha: Abu Huraira, aaj meri baari hai. To woh mere yahan aaye. Khaana abhi taiyaar nahi tha, is liye maine Abu Huraira se kaha: Kaash aap Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ek riwayat sunaate jab tak khaana taiyaar nahi hota. (Meri guzaarish maanke) Abu Huraira ne kaha: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Makkah ki Fatah ke din the. Unhone Khalid bin Walid ko daayi taraf ka sardaar muqarrar kiya, Zubair ko baayi taraf ka sardaar, aur Abu Ubaida ko paidal sipaahiyon ka sardaar (jinhe wadi ke andar ki taraf aage baDhna tha). Unhone (phir) kaha: Abu Huraira, Ansar ko mere paas bulaao. To maine unhe pukaara aur woh jaldi mein aaye. Unhone kaha: Aye Ansar ke giroh, kya tum Quraish ke buray logon ko dekhte ho? Unhone kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: Dekho, jab tum unse kal milo, unhe mita do. Unhone apne haath se ishara karte hue kaha, apna daaya haath apne baaye par rakhte hue, aur kaha: Tum humse as-Safa mein miloge. (Abu Huraira ne aage kaha): Us din jise bhi unhone dekha use maar diya gaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) as-Safa ke pahaad par chaDhe. Ansar bhi wahan aaye aur pahaad ko gher liya. Phir Abu Sufyan aaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Quraish barbaad ho gaya hai. Quraish qabile ka koi sadasya aaj is din se nahi bachega. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jo Abu Sufyan ke ghar mein daakhil hoga woh mahfooz hoga, jo hathiyaar rakh dega woh mahfooz hoga, jo apna darwaza band karega woh mahfooz hoga. Ansar mein se (kuch) ne kaha: (Aakhirkaar) us aadmi ko apne khaandaan ke prati narmi aur apne shehar ke liye muhabbat ne abhibhoot kar diya hai. Isper, Ilaahi targhib Allah ke Rasool (SAW) par utri. Unhone kaha: Tum keh rahe the ki us aadmi ko apne khaandaan ke prati narmi aur apne shehar ke liye muhabbat ne abhibhoot kar diya hai. Kya tumhe pata hai mera naam kya hai? Main Muhammad hoon, Allah ka aur Uske Rasool ka banda. (Unhone ye teen baar dohraaya.) Maine apni janambhoomi Allah ki khaatir chhoDi aur tumhare saath aa mila. Is liye main tumhare saath rahunga aur tumhare saath maroonga. Ab Ansar ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, humne (ye) sirf Allah aur Uske Rasool ke prati apne hirs ki wajah se kaha. Unhone kaha: Allah aur Uske Rasool tumhari gawaahi dete hain aur tumhari maafi qubool karte hain.

32.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ - قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ دَخَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَكَّةَ وَحَوْلَ الْكَعْبَةِ ثَلاَثُمِائَةٍ وَسِتُّونَ نُصُبًا فَجَعَلَ يَطْعُنُهَا بِعُودٍ كَانَ بِيَدِهِ وَيَقُولُ ‏"‏ ‏{‏ جَاءَ الْحَقُّ وَزَهَقَ الْبَاطِلُ إِنَّ الْبَاطِلَ كَانَ زَهُوقًا‏}‏ ‏{‏ جَاءَ الْحَقُّ وَمَا يُبْدِئُ الْبَاطِلُ وَمَا يُعِيدُ‏}‏ زَادَ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ يَوْمَ الْفَتْحِ ‏.‏
32.en: It has been narrated by Ibn Abdullah who said: The Prophet (ﷺ) entered Mecca. There were three hundred and sixty idols around the Ka'ba. He began to thrust them with the stick that was in his hand saying:" Truth has come and falsehood has vanished. Lo! falsehood was destined to vanish" (xvii. 8). Truth has arrived, and falsehood can neither create anything from the beginning nor can It restore to life
32.hi: Ibn Abdullah ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Nabi (SAW) Makkah mein daakhil hue. Kaaba ke aas-paas teen sau saTh but the. Unhone unhe apne haath mein pakDi hui lakDi se hilaana shuru kiya ye kehte hue: "Sach aa gaya hai aur jhoot mit gaya hai. Dekho! Jhoot ko mitna hi tha" (17:81). Sach aa gaya hai, aur jhoot na to shuruaat se kuch bana sakta hai na zindagi ko wapas la sakta hai.

32.ar: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ حَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا الثَّوْرِيُّ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ زَهُوقًا ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ الآيَةَ الأُخْرَى وَقَالَ بَدَلَ نُصُبًا صَنَمًا ‏.‏
32.en: This tradition has been narrated by Ibn Abu Najah through a different chain of transmitters up to the word: Zahaqa, (This version) does not contain the second verse and substitutes Sanam for Nusub (both the words mean" idol" or" image" that is worshipped).
32.hi: Ye riwayat Ibn Abu Najah ne ek doosri sanad ke zariye lafz 'Zahaqa' tak riwayat ki hai. (Ye soorat) doosri aayat shaamil nahi karta aur 'Nusub' ki jagah 'Sanam' istemal karta hai (donon lafzon ka matlab hai "but" ya "pratima" jiski ibadat ki jaati hai).

32.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، وَوَكِيعٌ، عَنْ زَكَرِيَّاءَ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُطِيعٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ يَوْمَ فَتْحِ مَكَّةَ ‏
"‏ لاَ يُقْتَلُ قُرَشِيٌّ صَبْرًا بَعْدَ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
32.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Abdullah b. Muti' who heard from his father and said: I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) say on the day of the Conquest of Mecca: No Quraishite will be killed hound hand and foot from this day until the Day of judgment.
32.hi: Abdullah bin Muti ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone apne walid se suna aur kaha: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko Makkah ki Fatah ke din ye kehte suna: Aaj se Qayamat ke din tak koi bhi Quraishi haath-paon baandhkar qatal nahi kiya jaayega.

32.ar: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ وَزَادَ قَالَ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ أَسْلَمَ أَحَدٌ مِنْ عُصَاةِ قُرَيْشٍ غَيْرَ مُطِيعٍ كَانَ اسْمُهُ الْعَاصِي فَسَمَّاهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُطِيعًا ‏.‏
32.en: The same tradition has been narrated on the authority of Zakriyya through the same chain of transmitters with the following addition: " No rebellious Quraishite with al-Asi as his name embraced Islam that day except Muti. His name-was al-Asi, but the Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him) changed his name to Muti.
32.hi: Yehi riwayat Zakriyya ki sanad se isi sanad se in izafe ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai: "Us din al-Asi naam wale kisi bhi baaghi Quraishi ne Islam qubool nahi kiya siwaay Muti ke. Unka naam al-Asi tha, lekin Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unka naam badalkar Muti kar diya."

32.ar: حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ بْنَ عَازِبٍ، يَقُولُ كَتَبَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي طَالِبٍ الصُّلْحَ بَيْنَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَبَيْنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ يَوْمَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ فَكَتَبَ ‏"‏ هَذَا مَا كَاتَبَ عَلَيْهِ مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا لاَ تَكْتُبْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ فَلَوْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ لَمْ نُقَاتِلْكَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِعَلِيٍّ ‏"‏ امْحُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ مَا أَنَا بِالَّذِي أَمْحَاهُ ‏.‏ فَمَحَاهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدِهِ قَالَ وَكَانَ فِيمَا اشْتَرَطُوا أَنْ يَدْخُلُوا مَكَّةَ فَيُقِيمُوا بِهَا ثَلاَثًا وَلاَ يَدْخُلُهَا بِسِلاَحٍ إِلاَّ جُلُبَّانَ السِّلاَحِ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ لأَبِي إِسْحَاقَ وَمَا جُلُبَّانُ السِّلاَحِ قَالَ الْقِرَابُ وَمَا فِيهِ ‏.‏
32.en: It has been narrated on the authority of al-Bara' b. 'Azib who said: 'Ali b. Abu Talib penned the treaty between the Prophet (ﷺ) and the polytheists on the Day of Hudaibiya. He wrote: This is what Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah, has settled. They (the polytheists) said: Do not write words" the Messenger of Allah". If we knew that you were the Messenger of Allah, we would not fight against you. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to 'Ali: Strike out these words. He (Ali) said: I am not going to strike them out. So the Prophet (ﷺ) struck them out with his own hand. The narrator said that the conditions upon which the two sides had agreed included that the Muslims would enter Mecca (next year) and would stay there for three days, and that they would not enter bearing arms except in their sheaths or bolsters.
32.hi: Al-Bara bin Azib ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ne Nabi (SAW) aur mushrikeen ke beech ki sandhi Hudaibiya ke din likhi. Unhone likha: Ye woh hai jo Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool, ne tay kiya hai. Unhone (mushrikeen ne) kaha: "Allah ke Rasool" alfaaz mat likho. Agar humein pata hota ki tum Allah ke Rasool ho, to hum tumhare khilaaf jung na karte. Nabi (SAW) ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) se kaha: In alfaazon ko mitao. Unhone (Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne) kaha: Main inhe nahi mitaunga. To Nabi (SAW) ne unhe apne khud ke haath se mitaya. Raawi ne kaha ki jin sharton par donon paksh sehmat hue unmein ye shaamil tha ki Musalman (agle saal) Makkah mein daakhil honge aur wahan teen din tak rahenge, aur ki woh apni talwaaron ke myaanon ke bagair aur oont ke pallang (bolster) ke bagair daakhil nahi honge.

32.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ بْنَ عَازِبٍ، يَقُولُ لَمَّا صَالَحَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَهْلَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ كَتَبَ عَلِيٌّ كِتَابًا بَيْنَهُمْ قَالَ فَكَتَبَ ‏"‏ مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ مُعَاذٍ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَذْكُرْ فِي الْحَدِيثِ ‏"‏ هَذَا مَا كَاتَبَ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
32.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Ishaq, who heard Bars' b. Azib say: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) made peace with the people of Hudaibiya, 'Ali drew up the agreement between them, and so he wrote: Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah. (This is followed by the same wording as we have in the previous tradition except the omission of the words: This is what he has settled.)
32.hi: Abu Ishaq ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone Bars bin Azib ko ye kehte suna: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Hudaibiya ke logon ke saath shaanti banaayi, Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne unke beech ka samjhauta likha, aur unhone likha: Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool. (Iske baad wahi alfaaz hain jo pichhli hadees mein hain siwaay in alfaazon ko chhodne ke: Ye woh hai jo unhone tay kiya hai.)

32.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ جَنَابٍ الْمِصِّيصِيُّ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ يُونُسَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لإِسْحَاقَ - أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، أَخْبَرَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ، قَالَ لَمَّا أُحْصِرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عِنْدَ الْبَيْتِ صَالَحَهُ أَهْلُ مَكَّةَ عَلَى أَنْ يَدْخُلَهَا فَيُقِيمَ بِهَا ثَلاَثًا وَلاَ يَدْخُلَهَا إِلاَّ بِجُلُبَّانِ السِّلاَحِ السَّيْفِ وَقِرَابِهِ ‏.‏ وَلاَ يَخْرُجَ بِأَحَدٍ مَعَهُ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا وَلاَ يَمْنَعَ أَحَدًا يَمْكُثُ بِهَا مِمَّنْ كَانَ مَعَهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ لِعَلِيٍّ ‏"‏ اكْتُبِ الشَّرْطَ بَيْنَنَا بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ هَذَا مَا قَاضَى عَلَيْهِ مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ الْمُشْرِكُونَ لَوْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ تَابَعْنَاكَ وَلَكِنِ اكْتُبْ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَأَمَرَ عَلِيًّا أَنْ يَمْحَاهَا فَقَالَ عَلِيٌّ لاَ وَاللَّهِ لاَ أَمْحَاهَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَرِنِي مَكَانَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَرَاهُ مَكَانَهَا فَمَحَاهَا وَكَتَبَ ‏"‏ ابْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَقَامَ بِهَا ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ فَلَمَّا أَنْ كَانَ يَوْمُ الثَّالِثِ قَالُوا لِعَلِيٍّ هَذَا آخِرُ يَوْمٍ مِنْ شَرْطِ صَاحِبِكَ فَأْمُرْهُ فَلْيَخْرُجْ ‏.‏ فَأَخْبَرَهُ بِذَلِكَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَخَرَجَ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ جَنَابٍ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ مَكَانَ تَابَعْنَاكَ بَايَعْنَاكَ ‏.‏
32.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Bara' who said: When the Prophet (ﷺ) was checked from going to the Ka'ba, the people of Mecca made peace with him'on the condition that he would (be allowed to) enter Mecca (next year) and stay there for three days, that he would not enter (the city) except with swords in their sheaths and arms encased in their covers, that he would not take eway with him anyone from its dwellers, nor would he prevent anyone from those with him to stay on in Mecca (if he so desired). He said to 'Ali: Write down the terms settled between us. (So 'Ali wrote): In the name of Allah, most Gracious and most Merciful. This is what Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah, has settled (with the Meccans), The polytheists said to him: If we knew that thou art the Messenger of of Allah, we would follow you. But write: Muhammad b. 'Abdullah. So he told 'Ali to strike out these words. 'Ali said: No, by Allah, I will not strike them out. The Messenger of Allah (may Peace be upon him) said: Show me their place (on the parchment). So he ('Ali) showed him their place and he (the Holy Prophet) struck them out; and 'Ali wrote: Ibn 'Abdullah. (According to the terms of the treaty, next year) the Prophet (ﷺ) stayed there for three days When it was the third day, they said to 'Ali: This is the last day according to the terms of your companion. So tell him to leave. 'Ali informed the Prophet (ﷺ) accordingly. He said: Yes, and left (the city). Ibn Janab in his version of the tradition used:" we would swear allegiance to you" instead of" we would follow you".
32.hi: Bara ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Jab Nabi (SAW) ko Kaaba tak jaane se roka gaya, Makkah ke logon ne unse shaanti banaayi is shart par ki woh (agle saal) Makkah mein daakhil ho sakenge aur teen din tak rahenge, ki woh (shehar mein) tab tak daakhil nahi honge jab tak talwaaren myaanon mein aur hathiyaar apne khaanon mein na hon, ki woh apne saath uske kisi bhi vaasi ko nahi le jaayenge, na hi unhe apne saath waalon mein se kisi ko Makkah mein rehne se rokenge (agar woh chaahe). Unhone Ali (Alayhis Salam) se kaha: Humare beech tay hui sharten likh do. (To Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne likha): Allah ke naam par, Sabse Meherbaan, Sabse Rehmvaan. Ye woh hai jo Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool, ne (Makkah ke logon ke saath) tay kiya hai. Mushrikeen ne unse kaha: Agar humein pata hota ki tum Allah ke Rasool ho, to hum tumhara anusaran karte. Lekin likho: Muhammad bin Abdullah. To unhone Ali (Alayhis Salam) se in alfaazon ko mitane ko kaha. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: Nahi, Allah ki qasam, main inhe nahi mitaunga. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Mujhe unki jagah dikhaao (chamde par). To unhone (Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne) unhe unki jagah dikhaayi aur unhone (Nabi ne) unhe mitaya; aur Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne likha: Ibn Abdullah. (Sandhi ki sharton ke mutabik, agle saal) Nabi (SAW) wahan teen din rahe. Jab teesra din tha, unhone Ali (Alayhis Salam) se kaha: Ye tumhare saathi ki sharton ke mutabik aakhri din hai. Is liye unhe jaane ko kaho. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne Nabi (SAW) ko iske mutabik bataaya. Unhone kaha: Haan, aur (shehar) chhoD diya. Ibn Janab ki riwayat mein "hum tumhara anusaran karte" ki jagah "hum tumse wafadaari ki qasam khaate" istemal kiya gaya hai.

32.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ قُرَيْشًا، صَالَحُوا النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِيهِمْ سُهَيْلُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِعَلِيٍّ ‏"‏ اكْتُبْ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ سُهَيْلٌ أَمَّا بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ فَمَا نَدْرِي مَا بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ وَلَكِنِ اكْتُبْ مَا نَعْرِفُ بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اكْتُبْ مِنْ مُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا لَوْ عَلِمْنَا أَنَّكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ لاَتَّبَعْنَاكَ وَلَكِنِ اكْتُبِ اسْمَكَ وَاسْمَ أَبِيكَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اكْتُبْ مِنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَاشْتَرَطُوا عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّ مَنْ جَاءَ مِنْكُمْ لَمْ نَرُدَّهُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَمَنْ جَاءَكُمْ مِنَّا رَدَدْتُمُوهُ عَلَيْنَا فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَنَكْتُبُ هَذَا قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ إِنَّهُ مَنْ ذَهَبَ مِنَّا إِلَيْهِمْ فَأَبْعَدَهُ اللَّهُ وَمَنْ جَاءَنَا مِنْهُمْ سَيَجْعَلُ اللَّهُ لَهُ فَرَجًا وَمَخْرَجًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
32.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Anas that the Quraish made peace with the Prophet (ﷺ). Among them was Suhail b. Amr. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to 'Ali: Write" In the name of Allah, most Gracious and most Merciful." Suhail said: As for" Bismillah," we do not know what is meant by" Bismillah-ir-Rahman-ir-Rahim" (In the name of Allah most Gracious and most Merciful). But write what we understand, i. e. Bi ismika allahumma (in thy name. O Allah). Then, the Prophet (ﷺ) said: Write:" From Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah." They said: If we knew that thou welt the Messenger of Allah, we would follow you. Therefore, write your name and the name of your father. So the Prophet (ﷺ) said: Write" From Muhammad b. 'Abdullah." They laid the condition on the Prophet (ﷺ) that anyone who joined them from the Muslims, the Meccans would not return him, and anyone who joined you (the Muslims) from them, you would send him back to them. The Companions said: Messenger of Allah, should we write this? He said: Yes. One who goes away from us to join them-may Allah keep him away! and one who comes to join us from them (and is sent back) Allah will provide him relief and a way of escape.
32.hi: Anas ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Quraish ne Nabi (SAW) ke saath shaanti banaayi. Unmein Suhail bin Amr the. Nabi (SAW) ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) se kaha: Likho "Allah ke naam par, Sabse Meherbaan, Sabse Rehmvaan." Suhail ne kaha: Jahan tak "Bismillah" ka sawal hai, humein nahi pata ki "Bismillah-ir-Rahman-ir-Rahim" (Allah ke naam par sabse meherbaan, sabse rehmvaan) ka kya matlab hai. Lekin woh likho jo hum samajhte hain, yaani Bi ismika allahumma (tere naam mein, Aye Allah). Phir, Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Likho: "Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool ki taraf se." Unhone kaha: Agar humein pata hota ki tum Allah ke Rasool ho, to hum tumhara anusaran karte. Is liye, apna naam aur apne waalid ka naam likho. To Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Likho "Muhammad bin Abdullah ki taraf se." Unhone Nabi (SAW) par ye shart rakhi ki jo koi bhi Musalmaanon mein se unse mil jaaye, Makkah ke log use wapas nahi karenge, aur jo koi bhi unmein se tum (Musalmaanon) se mile, tum use unhe wapas bhej doge. Sahaba ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya humein ye likhna chahiye? Unhone kaha: Haan. Jo humse door jaakar unse mile - Allah use door rakhe! aur jo unse humse milne aata hai (aur wapas bhej diya jaata hai) Allah use rahat aur bachne ka raasta dega.

32.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، - وَتَقَارَبَا فِي اللَّفْظِ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ سِيَاهٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَبِيبُ بْنُ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، قَالَ قَامَ سَهْلُ بْنُ حُنَيْفٍ يَوْمَ صِفِّينَ فَقَالَ أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّهِمُوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ لَقَدْ كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ وَلَوْ نَرَى قِتَالاً لَقَاتَلْنَا وَذَلِكَ فِي الصُّلْحِ الَّذِي كَانَ بَيْنَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَبَيْنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ فَجَاءَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ فَأَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَلَسْنَا عَلَى حَقٍّ وَهُمْ عَلَى بَاطِلٍ قَالَ ‏"‏ بَلَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَلَيْسَ قَتْلاَنَا فِي الْجَنَّةِ وَقَتْلاَهُمْ فِي النَّارِ قَالَ ‏"‏ بَلَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَفِيمَ نُعْطِي الدَّنِيَّةَ فِي دِينِنَا وَنَرْجِعُ وَلَمَّا يَحْكُمِ اللَّهُ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا ابْنَ الْخَطَّابِ إِنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ وَلَنْ يُضَيِّعَنِي اللَّهُ أَبَدًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَانْطَلَقَ عُمَرُ فَلَمْ يَصْبِرْ مُتَغَيِّظًا فَأَتَى أَبَا بَكْرٍ فَقَالَ يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ أَلَسْنَا عَلَى حَقٍّ وَهُمْ عَلَى بَاطِلٍ قَالَ بَلَى ‏.‏ قَالَ أَلَيْسَ قَتْلاَنَا فِي الْجَنَّةِ وَقَتْلاَهُمْ فِي النَّارِ قَالَ بَلَى ‏.‏ قَالَ فَعَلاَمَ نُعْطِي الدَّنِيَّةَ فِي دِينِنَا وَنَرْجِعُ وَلَمَّا يَحْكُمِ اللَّهُ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَقَالَ يَا ابْنَ الْخَطَّابِ إِنَّهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ وَلَنْ يُضَيِّعَهُ اللَّهُ أَبَدًا ‏.‏ قَالَ فَنَزَلَ الْقُرْآنُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْفَتْحِ فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَى عُمَرَ فَأَقْرَأَهُ إِيَّاهُ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَوَفَتْحٌ هُوَ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَطَابَتْ نَفْسُهُ وَرَجَعَ ‏.‏
32.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Wa'il who said: Sahal b. Hunaif stood up on the Day of Siffin and said: O ye people, blame yourselves (for want of discretion) ; we were with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the Day of Hudaibiya. If we had thought it fit to fight, we could fight. This was in the truce between the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and the polytheists. Umar b. Khattab came, approached the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: Messenger of Allah, aren't we fighting for truth and they for falsehood? He replied: By all means. He asked: Are not those killed from our side in Paradise and those killed. from their side in the Fire? He replied: Yes. He said: Then why should we put a blot upon our religion and return, while Allah has not decided the issue between them and ourselves? He said: Son of Khattab, I am the Messenger of Allah. Allah will never ruin me. (The narrator said): Umar went away, but he could not contain himself with rage. So he approached Abu Bakr and said: 'Abu Bakr, aren't we fighting for truth and they for falsehood? He replied: Yes. He asked: Aren't those killed from our side in Paradise and those killed from their side in the Fire? He replied: Why not? He (then) said: Why should we then disgrace our religion and return while God has not yet decided the issue between them and ourselves? Abu Bakr said: Son of Khattab, verily, he is the Messenger of Allah, and Allah will never ruin him. (The narrator continued): At this (a Sura of) the Qur'an (giving glad tidings of the victory) was revealed to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He sent for Umar and made him read it. He asked: Is (this truce) a victory? He (the Messenger of Allah) replied: Yes. At this Umar was pleased, and returned.
32.hi: Abu Wa'il ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Sahal bin Hunaif Siffin ke din khade hue aur kaha: Aye logo, khud ko dosh do (vivek ki kami ke liye); hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Hudaibiya ke din the. Agar humne jung karna theek samjha hota, to hum jung karte. Ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur mushrikeen ke beech ki sandhi mein tha. Umar bin Khattab aaye, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya hum sach ke liye nahi ladh rahe aur woh jhoot ke liye? Unhone jawab diya: Bilkul. Unhone poocha: Kya humari taraf se maare gaye Jannat mein nahi hain aur unki taraf se maare gaye Aag mein? Unhone jawab diya: Haan. Unhone kaha: To phir humein apne deen par dagh kyun lagaana chahiye aur wapas jaana chahiye, jabki Allah ne unke aur humare beech maamla tay nahi kiya hai? Unhone kaha: Khattab ke bete, main Allah ka Rasool hoon. Allah mujhe kabhi barbaad nahi karega. (Raawi ne kaha): Umar chale gaye, lekin woh apne aap ko gusse se sanbhal nahi paaye. To woh Abu Bakr ke paas gaye aur kaha: 'Abu Bakr, kya hum sach ke liye nahi ladh rahe aur woh jhoot ke liye? Unhone jawab diya: Haan. Unhone poocha: Kya humari taraf se maare gaye Jannat mein nahi hain aur unki taraf se maare gaye Aag mein? Unhone jawab diya: Kyun nahi? Unhone (phir) kaha: To phir humein apne deen ko apmaanit kyun karna chahiye aur wapas jaana chahiye jabki Allah ne abhi tak unke aur humare beech maamla tay nahi kiya hai? Abu Bakr ne kaha: Khattab ke bete, yaqeenan, woh Allah ke Rasool hain, aur Allah unhe kabhi barbaad nahi karega. (Raawi ne jaari rakha): Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) par Quran (ki ek Surah, jeet ki khushkhabri sunaate hue) nazil hui. Unhone Umar ko bulaaya aur use unhe padha diya. Unhone poocha: Kya (ye samzhauta) ek jeet hai? Unhone (Allah ke Rasool ne) jawab diya: Haan. Isper Umar khush hue, aur wapas gaye.

32.ar: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَهْلَ بْنَ حُنَيْفٍ، يَقُولُ بِصِفِّينَ أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّهِمُوا رَأْيَكُمْ وَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُنِي يَوْمَ أَبِي جَنْدَلٍ وَلَوْ أَنِّي أَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ أَرُدَّ أَمْرَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَرَدَدْتُهُ وَاللَّهِ مَا وَضَعْنَا سُيُوفَنَا عَلَى عَوَاتِقِنَا إِلَى أَمْرٍ قَطُّ إِلاَّ أَسْهَلْنَ بِنَا إِلَى أَمْرٍ نَعْرِفُهُ إِلاَّ أَمْرَكُمْ هَذَا ‏.‏ لَمْ يَذْكُرِ ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ إِلَى أَمْرٍ قَطُّ ‏.‏
32.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Shaqiq who said: I heard Sahl b. Hunaif say at Siffin: O ye people, find fault with your (own) discretion. By Allah, on the Day of Abu Jandal (i. e. the day of Hudaibiya), I thought to myself that, if I could, I would reverse the order of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) (the terms of the truce being unpalatable). By Allah, we have never hung our swords on our shoulders in any situation whatsoever except when they made easy for us to realise the goal envisaged by us, but this battle of yours (seems to be an exception). Ibn Numair (in his version) did not mention the words:" In any situation whatsoever"
32.hi: Shaqiq ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Maine Sahl bin Hunaif ko Siffin mein ye kehte suna: Aye logo, apne (khud ke) vivek mein dosh dhoondho. Allah ki qasam, Abu Jandal ke din (yaani Hudaibiya ke din), maine socha ki, agar main kar paata, to main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke hukum ko palat deta (samjhauta ki sharton se santusht na hote hue). Allah ki qasam, humne kabhi bhi apni talwaaren apne kandhon par kisi bhi paristhiti mein nahi latkaayi siwaay jab unhone humare liye humare lakshya ko poora karna aasaan bana diya, lekin tumhari ye jung (ek apwaad lagti hai). Ibn Numair ne (apne soorat mein) ye alfaaz zikr nahi kiye: "Kisi bhi paristhiti mein."

32.ar: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَعِيدٍ، الأَشَجُّ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِهِمَا إِلَى أَمْرٍ يُفْظِعُنَا.‏
32.en: The same tradition has been narrated through a different chain of transmitters on the authority of A'mash. This version contains the words: Ila amrin yofzi'una instead of Ila amrin na'rifuhu.
32.hi: Yehi riwayat A'mash ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai. Is soorat mein alfaaz hain: Ila amrin yofzi'una, 'Ila amrin na'rifuhu' ki jagah.

32.ar: وَحَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْجَوْهَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ مِغْوَلٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حَصِينٍ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَهْلَ بْنَ حُنَيْفٍ، بِصِفِّينَ يَقُولُ اتَّهِمُوا رَأْيَكُمْ عَلَى دِينِكُمْ فَلَقَدْ رَأَيْتُنِي يَوْمَ أَبِي جَنْدَلٍ وَلَوْ أَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ أَرُدَّ أَمْرَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم - مَا فَتَحْنَا مِنْهُ فِي خُصْمٍ إِلاَّ انْفَجَرَ عَلَيْنَا مِنْهُ خُصْمٌ ‏.‏
32.en: It has been narrated through a different chain of transmitters on the authority of Abu Wa'il who said: I heard Sahl b. Hunaif say at Siffin: Blame (the hollowness) of your views about your religion. I thought to myself on the day of Abu Jandal that if I could turn down the order of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), I would. The situation was so difficult that if we mended it at one place, it was rent at another.
32.hi: Ye riwayat ek doosri sanad ke zariye Abu Wa'il se hai jinhone kaha: Maine Sahl bin Hunaif ko Siffin mein ye kehte suna: Apne deen ke baare mein apne (khokhle) vichaaron ko dosh do. Maine Abu Jandal ke din socha ki agar main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke hukum ko radd kar sakoon, to main aisa karta. Haalat itni mushkil thi ki agar humne ise ek jagah theek kiya, to woh doosri jagah phaT gayi.

32.ar: وَحَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي، عَرُوبَةَ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، أَنَّ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، حَدَّثَهُمْ قَالَ لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ ‏{‏ إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحًا مُبِينًا * لِيَغْفِرَ لَكَ اللَّهُ‏}‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏ فَوْزًا عَظِيمًا‏}‏ مَرْجِعَهُ مِنَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ وَهُمْ يُخَالِطُهُمُ الْحُزْنُ وَالْكَآبَةُ وَقَدْ نَحَرَ الْهَدْىَ بِالْحُدَيْبِيَةِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لَقَدْ أُنْزِلَتْ عَلَىَّ آيَةٌ هِيَ أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا جَمِيعًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
32.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik who said: When they (Companions of the Holy Prophet) were overwhelmed with grief and distress on his return from Hudaibiya where he had slaughtered his sacrificial beasts (not being allowed to proceed to Mecca), the Qur'anic verse: Inna fatahna... laka fathan mobinan to fauzan 'aziman, was revealed to him. (At this) he said: On me has descended a verse that is dearer to me than the whole world.
32.hi: Anas bin Malik ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Jab woh (Nabi ke sahaba) Hudaibiya se unki wapasi par dukh aur pareshaani se abhibhoot the, jahan unhone (Makkah jaane ki ijazat na milne par) apne qurbaani ke jaanwar zibah kiye the, Qurani aayat: Inna fatahna... laka fathan mobinan to fauzan 'aziman, unpar nazil hui. (Isper) unhone kaha: Mujhpar ek aisi aayat utri hai jo mujhe poori duniya se zyada aziz hai.

32.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمُ بْنُ النَّضْرِ التَّيْمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، ح
 وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ ‏.‏
32.en: This tradition has been narrated through a different chain of transmitters.
32.hi: Ye riwayat ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

32.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ جُمَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الطُّفَيْلِ حَدَّثَنَا حُذَيْفَةُ بْنُ الْيَمَانِ، قَالَ مَا مَنَعَنِي أَنْ أَشْهَدَ، بَدْرًا إِلاَّ أَنِّي خَرَجْتُ أَنَا وَأَبِي - حُسَيْلٌ - قَالَ فَأَخَذَنَا كُفَّارُ قُرَيْشٍ قَالُوا إِنَّكُمْ تُرِيدُونَ مُحَمَّدًا فَقُلْنَا مَا نُرِيدُهُ مَا نُرِيدُ إِلاَّ الْمَدِينَةَ ‏.‏ فَأَخَذُوا مِنَّا عَهْدَ اللَّهِ وَمِيثَاقَهُ لَنَنْصَرِفَنَّ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ وَلاَ نُقَاتِلُ مَعَهُ فَأَتَيْنَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرْنَاهُ الْخَبَرَ فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ انْصَرِفَا نَفِي لَهُمْ بِعَهْدِهِمْ وَنَسْتَعِينُ اللَّهَ عَلَيْهِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
32.en: It has been reported on the authority of Hudbaifa b. al-Yaman who said: Nothing prevented me from being present at! he Battle of Badr except this incident. I came out with my father Husail (to participate in the Battle), but we were caught by the disbelievers of Quraish. They said: (Do) you intend to go to Muhammad? We said: We do not intend to go to him, but we wish to go (back) to Medina. So they took from us a covenant in the name of God that we would turn back to Medina and would not fight on the side of Muhammad (ﷺ). So, we came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and related the incident to him. He said: Both, of you proceed (to Medina) ; we will fulfil the covenant made with them and seek God's help against them.
32.hi: Hudbaifa bin al-Yaman ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Mujhe Badr ki jung mein maujood rehne se sirf is ghatna ne roka. Main apne waalid Husail ke saath nikla (jung mein hissa lene ke liye), lekin humein Quraish ke kaafiron ne pakad liya. Unhone kaha: Kya tumhara iraada Muhammad ke paas jaane ka hai? Humne kaha: Humara iraada unke paas jaane ka nahi hai, lekin hum (wapas) Madina jaana chahte hain. To unhone humse Allah ke naam par ek ehad liya ki hum Madina wapas jaayenge aur Muhammad (SAW) ki taraf se jung nahi karenge. To, hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unhe ghatna sunaayi. Unhone kaha: Tum donon (Madina) aage baDho; hum unke saath kiya gaya ehad poora karenge aur unke khilaaf Allah ki madad chaahenge.

32.ar: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ كُنَّا عِنْدَ حُذَيْفَةَ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ لَوْ أَدْرَكْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَاتَلْتُ مَعَهُ وَأَبْلَيْتُ فَقَالَ حُذَيْفَةُ أَنْتَ كُنْتَ تَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَيْلَةَ الأَحْزَابِ وَأَخَذَتْنَا رِيحٌ شَدِيدَةٌ وَقُرٌّ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَلاَ رَجُلٌ يَأْتِينِي بِخَبَرِ الْقَوْمِ جَعَلَهُ اللَّهُ مَعِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَسَكَتْنَا فَلَمْ يُجِبْهُ مِنَّا أَحَدٌ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَلاَ رَجُلٌ يَأْتِينَا بِخَبَرِ الْقَوْمِ جَعَلَهُ اللَّهُ مَعِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَسَكَتْنَا فَلَمْ يُجِبْهُ مِنَّا أَحَدٌ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَلاَ رَجُلٌ يَأْتِينَا بِخَبَرِ الْقَوْمِ جَعَلَهُ اللَّهُ مَعِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَسَكَتْنَا فَلَمْ يُجِبْهُ مِنَّا أَحَدٌ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ قُمْ يَا حُذَيْفَةُ فَأْتِنَا بِخَبَرِ الْقَوْمِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلَمْ أَجِدْ بُدًّا إِذْ دَعَانِي بِاسْمِي أَنْ أَقُومَ قَالَ ‏"‏ اذْهَبْ فَأْتِنِي بِخَبَرِ الْقَوْمِ وَلاَ تَذْعَرْهُمْ عَلَىَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا وَلَّيْتُ مِنْ عِنْدِهِ جَعَلْتُ كَأَنَّمَا أَمْشِي فِي حَمَّامٍ حَتَّى أَتَيْتُهُمْ فَرَأَيْتُ أَبَا سُفْيَانَ يَصْلِي ظَهْرَهُ بِالنَّارِ فَوَضَعْتُ سَهْمًا فِي كَبِدِ الْقَوْسِ فَأَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَرْمِيَهُ فَذَكَرْتُ قَوْلَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَلاَ تَذْعَرْهُمْ عَلَىَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَوْ رَمَيْتُهُ لأَصَبْتُهُ فَرَجَعْتُ وَأَنَا أَمْشِي فِي مِثْلِ الْحَمَّامِ فَلَمَّا أَتَيْتُهُ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ بِخَبَرِ الْقَوْمِ وَفَرَغْتُ قُرِرْتُ فَأَلْبَسَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ فَضْلِ عَبَاءَةٍ كَانَتْ عَلَيْهِ يُصَلِّي فِيهَا فَلَمْ أَزَلْ نَائِمًا حَتَّى أَصْبَحْتُ فَلَمَّا أَصْبَحْتُ قَالَ ‏"‏ قُمْ يَا نَوْمَانُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
32.en: It has been narrated by Ibrahim al-Taimi on the authority of his father who said: We were sitting in the company of Hudhaifa. A man said: If I were in the time of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), I would have fought by his side and would have striven hard for his causes. Hudhaifa said: You might have done that, (but you should not make a flourish of your enthusiasm). I was with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the night of the Battle of Abzib and we were gripped by a violent wind and severe cold. The Messenger of Allah (may peace be him) said: Hark, the man who (goes reconnoitring and) brings me the news of the enemy shall be ranked with me on the Day of Judgment by Allah (the Glorious and Exalted). We all kept quiet and none of us responed to him. (Again) he said: Hark, a man who (goes reconnoitring and) brings me the news of the enemy shall be ranked with me on the Day of Judgment by Allah (the Glorious and Exalted). We kept quiet and none of us responded to him. He again said: Hark, a man who (goes reconnoitring and) brings me the news of the enemy shall be ranked with me on the Day of Judgtuent by Allah (the Glorious and Exalted) Then he said: Get up Hudhaifa, bring me the news of the enemy. When he called me by name I had no alternative but to get up. He said: Go and bring me information about the enemy, and do nothing that may provoke them against me. When I left him, I felt warm as if I were walking in a heated bath untill I reached them. I saw Abu Sufyan warming his back against fire I put an arrow in the middle of the bow. intending to shoot at him, when I recalled the words of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)" Do not provoke them against me." Had I shot at him, I would have hit him. But I returned and (felt warm as if) I were walking in a heated bath (hammam). Presenting myself before him, I gave him information about the enemy. When I had done so, I began to feel cold, so the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) wrapped me in a blanket that he had in excess to his own requirement and with which he used to cover himself while saying his prayers. So I continued to sleep until it was morning. When it was morning he said: Get up, O heavy sleeper.
32.hi: Ibrahim al-Taimi ne apne walid ke hawale se riwayat ki jinhone kaha: Hum Hudhaifa ki sohbat mein baithe the. Ek shakhs ne kaha: Agar main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke daur mein hota, to main unke pehlu mein larta aur unke maksad ke liye kaDi mehnat karta. Hudhaifa ne kaha: Aap aisa kar sakte the, (lekin aapko apne josh ka dikhaava nahi karna chahiye). Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath tha Ahzab ki jung ki raat aur hum ek tez hawa aur sakht sardi mein phanse hue the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Suno, jo shakhs (jaasoosi karke) mujhe dushman ki khabar laayega use Qayamat ke din Allah, Shaandaar aur Buland-o-Azeem, ke zariye mere saath darje mein rakha jaayega. Hum sab khamosh rahe aur hummein se koi bhi jawaab nahi diya. (Dobara) unhone kaha: Suno, jo shakhs mujhe dushman ki khabar laayega use Qayamat ke din Allah, Shaandaar aur Buland-o-Azeem, ke zariye mere saath darje mein rakha jaayega. Hum khamosh rahe aur hummein se koi bhi jawaab nahi diya. Unhone phir kaha: Suno, jo shakhs mujhe dushman ki khabar laayega use Qayamat ke din Allah, Shaandaar aur Buland-o-Azeem, ke zariye mere saath darje mein rakha jaayega. Phir unhone kaha: Uth jao Hudhaifa, mujhe dushman ki khabar lao. Jab unhone mujhe naam se pukaara mere paas uth jaane ke ilawa koi ikhtiyar nahi tha. Unhone kaha: Jao aur mujhe dushman ke baare mein jaankaari lao, aur aisa kuch mat karo jo unhe mere khilaaf uksaaye. Jab main unse (Nabi se) alag hua, mujhe garmi mehsoos hui jaise main ek garam snaanghar mein chal raha hoon yahan tak ki main unke paas pahuncha. Maine dekha ki Abu Sufyan aag ke saamne apni peeth garam kar rahe hain. Maine dhanush ke beech mein ek teer rakha, unpar chalaane ke iraade se, jab mujhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke alfaaz yaad aaye "Unhe mere khilaaf mat uksaao." Agar maine unpar teer chalaaya hota, to main unhe maar deta. Lekin main wapas gaya aur (mehsoos kiya jaise) main ek garam snaanghar (hammam) mein chal raha hoon. Unke saamne khud ko pesh karte hue, maine unhe dushman ke baare mein jaankaari di. Jab main aisa kar chuka, mujhe sardi mehsoos hone lagi, is liye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe ek kambal mein lapeta jo unki apni zaroorat se zyada tha aur jisse woh apni namaz ke daurane khud ko dhaakte the. To main tab tak sota raha jab tak subah nahi hui. Jab subah hui unhone kaha: Uth jao, Aye gehri neend mein sone wale.

32.ar: وَحَدَّثَنَا هَدَّابُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ الأَزْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، وَثَابِتٍ، الْبُنَانِيِّ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أُفْرِدَ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ فِي سَبْعَةٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ وَرَجُلَيْنِ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ فَلَمَّا رَهِقُوهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ يَرُدُّهُمْ عَنَّا وَلَهُ الْجَنَّةُ أَوْ هُوَ رَفِيقِي فِي الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَتَقَدَّمَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ فَقَاتَلَ حَتَّى قُتِلَ ثُمَّ رَهِقُوهُ أَيْضًا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ يَرُدُّهُمْ عَنَّا وَلَهُ الْجَنَّةُ أَوْ هُوَ رَفِيقِي فِي الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَتَقَدَّمَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ فَقَاتَلَ حَتَّى قُتِلَ فَلَمْ يَزَلْ كَذَلِكَ حَتَّى قُتِلَ السَّبْعَةُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِصَاحِبَيْهِ ‏"‏ مَا أَنْصَفْنَا أَصْحَابَنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
32.en: It has been reported on the authority of Anas b. Malik that (when the enemy got the upper hand) on the day of the Battle of Uhud, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was left with only seven men from the ansar and two men from the Quraish. When the enemy advanced towards him and overwhelmed him, he said: Whoso turns them away from us will attain Paradise or will be my Companion in Paradise. A man from the Ansar came forward and fought (the enemy) until he was killed. The enemy advanced and overwhelmed him again and he repeated the words: Whoso turns them away, from us will attain Paradise or will be my Companion in Paradise. A man from the Arsar came forward and fought until he was killed. This state continued until the seven Ansar were killed (one after the other). Now, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to his two Companions: We have not done justice to our Companions.
32.hi: Anas bin Malik ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki (jab dushman haavi ho gaya) Uhud ki jung ke din, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath sirf Ansar ke saat aadmi aur Quraish ke do aadmi reh gaye. Jab dushman unki taraf baDha aur unpar haavi hua, unhone kaha: Jo unhe humse door karega use Jannat milegi ya woh Jannat mein mera saathi hoga. Ansar mein se ek shakhs aage aaya aur (dushman se) lada yahan tak ki woh maara gaya. Dushman aage baDha aur unpar dobara haavi hua aur unhone dohraaya: Jo unhe humse door karega use Jannat milegi ya woh Jannat mein mera saathi hoga. Ansar mein se ek shakhs aage aaya aur lada yahan tak ki woh maara gaya. Ye haalat tab tak jaari rahi jab tak saatoon Ansar (ek ke baad ek) maare nahi gaye. Ab, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne do saathiyon se kaha: Humne apne saathiyon ke saath insaaf nahi kiya.

32.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ سَهْلَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ، يُسْأَلُ عَنْ جُرْحِ، رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ فَقَالَ جُرِحَ وَجْهُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَكُسِرَتْ رَبَاعِيَتُهُ وَهُشِمَتِ الْبَيْضَةُ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ فَكَانَتْ فَاطِمَةُ بِنْتُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَغْسِلُ الدَّمَ وَكَانَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي طَالِبٍ يَسْكُبُ عَلَيْهَا بِالْمِجَنِّ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْ فَاطِمَةُ أَنَّ الْمَاءَ لاَ يَزِيدُ الدَّمَ إِلاَّ كَثْرَةً أَخَذَتْ قِطْعَةَ حَصِيرٍ فَأَحْرَقَتْهُ حَتَّى صَارَ رَمَادًا ثُمَّ أَلْصَقَتْهُ بِالْجُرْحِ فَاسْتَمْسَكَ الدَّمُ ‏.‏
32.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Abd-ul-'Aziz b. Abu Hazim, who learnt from his father (Abu Hazim). The latter heard it from Sahl b. Sa'd who was asked about the injury which the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) got on the day of the Battle of Uhud. He said: The face of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was injured, his front teeth were damaged and his helmet was crushed. Fatima, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), was washing the blood (from his head), and 'Ali b. Abu Talib was pouring water on it from a shield. When Fatima saw that the bleeding had increased on account of (pouring) water (on the wound), she took a piece of mat and burnt it until it was reduced to ashes. She put the ashes on the wound and the bleeding stopped.
32.hi: Abd-ul-Aziz bin Abu Hazim ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone apne walid (Abu Hazim) se seekha. Unhone (Abu Hazim ne) ise Sahl bin Sa'd se suna jinse Uhud ki jung ke din Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko lagi chot ke baare mein poocha gaya. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka chehra ghayal hua, unke agle daant tooTe, aur unka khod (helmet) kuchal gaya. Fatima (Alayhas Salam), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki beti, unke sar se khoon dho rahi thin, aur Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ek dhaal se usper paani daal rahe the. Jab Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ne dekha ki (ghaav par) paani daalne se khoon aur badh raha hai, unhone chataayi ka ek tukda liya aur use jalaaya yahan tak ki woh raakh mein badal gaya. Unhone raakh ghaav par lagaayi aur khoon behna band ho gaya.

32.ar: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْقَارِيَّ - عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ سَهْلَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ، وَهُوَ يُسْأَلُ عَنْ جُرْحِ، رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ أَمَ وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَعْرِفُ مَنْ كَانَ يَغْسِلُ جُرْحَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَمَنْ كَانَ يَسْكُبُ الْمَاءَ ‏.‏ وَبِمَاذَا دُووِيَ جُرْحُهُ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ زَادَ وَجُرِحَ وَجْهُهُ وَقَالَ مَكَانَ هُشِمَتْ كُسِرَتْ ‏.‏
32.en: It has been reported on the authority of Abu Hazim who heard from Sahl b. Sa'd. The latter was asked about the injury of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He said: By God, I know the person who washed the wound of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), who poured water on it and with what the wound was treated. Then Sahl narrated the same tradition as has been narrated by 'Abd al-'Azlz except that he added the words:" And his face was injured" and replaced the word" Hushimat" by" Kusirat" (i. e. it was broken).
32.hi: Abu Hazim ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone Sahl bin Sa'd se suna. Unse Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki chot ke baare mein poocha gaya. Unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, mujhe pata hai us shakhs ka jisne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka ghaav dhoya, jisne usper paani daala aur jisse ghaav ka ilaaj kiya gaya. Phir Sahl ne wahi hadees riwayat ki jo Abd al-Azlz ne riwayat ki hai siwaay is baat ke ki unhone ye alfaaz izafa kiye: "Aur unka chehra ghayal hua tha," aur "Hushimat" lafz ki jagah "Kusirat" (yaani ye tooTa tha) lafz istemal kiya.

32.ar: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَابْنُ، أَبِي عُمَرَ جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ سَوَّادٍ الْعَامِرِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ، وَهْبٍ أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي هِلاَلٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَهْلٍ التَّمِيمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُطَرِّفٍ - كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ، بْنِ سَعْدٍ ‏.‏ بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فِي حَدِيثِ ابْنِ أَبِي هِلاَلٍ أُصِيبَ وَجْهُهُ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ ابْنِ مُطَرِّفٍ جُرِحَ وَجْهُهُ ‏.‏
32.en: The same tradition has been narrated on the authority of Sahl b. Sa'd through a different chain of transmitters with a slight difference in the wording.
32.hi: Yehi riwayat Sahl bin Sa'd ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

32.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كُسِرَتْ رَبَاعِيَتُهُ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ وَشُجَّ فِي رَأْسِهِ فَجَعَلَ يَسْلُتُ الدَّمَ عَنْهُ وَيَقُولُ ‏"‏ كَيْفَ يُفْلِحُ قَوْمٌ شَجُّوا نَبِيَّهُمْ وَكَسَرُوا رَبَاعِيَتَهُ وَهُوَ يَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَى اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏ لَيْسَ لَكَ مِنَ الأَمْرِ شَىْءٌ‏}‏
32.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Anas that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had his front teeth damaged on the day of the Battle of Uhud, and got a wound on his head. He was wiping the blood (from his face) and was saying: How will these people attain salvation who have wounded their Prophet and broken his tooth while he called them towards God? At this time, God, the Exalted and Glorious, revealed the Verse:" Thou hast no authority" (iii. 127).
32.hi: Anas ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke agle daant Uhud ki jung ke din tooTe, aur unke sar par chot lagi. Woh apne (chehre se) khoon pochh rahe the aur keh rahe the: Ye log mukti kaise paayenge jinhone apne Nabi ko zakhmi kiya aur unka daant toDa jabki unhone unhe Allah ki taraf bulaaya? Isi waqt, Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne aayat nazil ki: "Tumhe ismein koi ikhtiyar nahi hai" (3:127).

32.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَحْكِي نَبِيًّا مِنَ الأَنْبِيَاءِ ضَرَبَهُ قَوْمُهُ وَهُوَ يَمْسَحُ الدَّمَ عَنْ وَجْهِهِ وَيَقُولُ ‏
"‏ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِقَوْمِي فَإِنَّهُمْ لاَ يَعْلَمُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
32.en: It has been narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah who said: It appeared to me as if I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) (and heard him) relate the story of a Prophet who had been beaten by his people, was wiping the blood from his face and was saying. My Lord, forgive my people, for they do not know.
32.hi: Abdullah ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Mujhe aisa laga jaise maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko dekha (aur unhe sunaa) ek Nabi ki kahani riwayat karte hue jinhe unke logon ne maara tha, aur woh apne chehre se khoon pochh rahe the aur keh rahe the: Mere Rab, mere logon ko maaf kar de, kyunki woh nahi jaante.

32.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ فَهُوَ يَنْضِحُ الدَّمَ عَنْ جَبِينِهِ ‏.‏
32.en: A version of the tradition with a slightly different wording has been narrated by another chain of transmitters.
32.hi: Riwayat ka ek soorat alfaaz mein thoDe antar ke saath ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

32.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، قَالَ هَذَا مَا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ أَحَادِيثَ مِنْهَا وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اشْتَدَّ غَضَبُ اللَّهِ عَلَى قَوْمٍ فَعَلُوا هَذَا بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَهُوَ حِينَئِذٍ يُشِيرُ إِلَى رَبَاعِيَتِهِ وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اشْتَدَّ غَضَبُ اللَّهِ عَلَى رَجُلٍ يَقْتُلُهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
32.en: It has been narrated by Hammam b. Munabbih who said: This is what has been related to us by Abu Huraira from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). (With this introduction) he narrated a number of traditions. One of these was that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Great is the wrath of Allah upon a people who have done this to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and he was at that time pointing to his front teeth. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) also said: Great is the wrath of Allah upon a person who has been killed by the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in the way of Allah, the Exalted and Glorious.
32.hi: Hammam bin Munabbih ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Ye woh hai jo humein Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki. (Is bhoomika ke saath) unhone kayi riwayaten riwayat kin. Unmein se ek ye thi ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Bada hai Allah ka gussa un logon par jinhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath aisa kiya, aur us waqt woh apne agle daant ki taraf ishara kar rahe the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ye bhi kaha: Bada hai Allah ka gussa us shakhs par jise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ki raah mein qatal kiya hai.

32.ar: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبَانَ الْجُعْفِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سُلَيْمَانَ - عَنْ زَكَرِيَّاءَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ الأَوْدِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ بَيْنَمَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي عِنْدَ الْبَيْتِ وَأَبُو جَهْلٍ وَأَصْحَابٌ لَهُ جُلُوسٌ وَقَدْ نُحِرَتْ جَزُورٌ بِالأَمْسِ فَقَالَ أَبُو جَهْلٍ أَيُّكُمْ يَقُومُ إِلَى سَلاَ جَزُورِ بَنِي فُلاَنٍ فَيَأْخُذُهُ فَيَضَعُهُ فِي كَتِفَىْ مُحَمَّدٍ إِذَا سَجَدَ فَانْبَعَثَ أَشْقَى الْقَوْمِ فَأَخَذَهُ فَلَمَّا سَجَدَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَضَعَهُ بَيْنَ كَتِفَيْهِ قَالَ فَاسْتَضْحَكُوا وَجَعَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ يَمِيلُ عَلَى بَعْضٍ وَأَنَا قَائِمٌ أَنْظُرُ ‏.‏ لَوْ كَانَتْ لِي مَنَعَةٌ طَرَحْتُهُ عَنْ ظَهْرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالنَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَاجِدٌ مَا يَرْفَعُ رَأْسَهُ حَتَّى انْطَلَقَ إِنْسَانٌ فَأَخْبَرَ فَاطِمَةَ فَجَاءَتْ وَهِيَ جُوَيْرِيَةُ فَطَرَحَتْهُ عَنْهُ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ تَشْتِمُهُمْ فَلَمَّا قَضَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلاَتَهُ رَفَعَ صَوْتَهُ ثُمَّ دَعَا عَلَيْهِمْ وَكَانَ إِذَا دَعَا دَعَا ثَلاَثًا ‏.‏ وَإِذَا سَأَلَ سَأَلَ ثَلاَثًا ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ عَلَيْكَ بِقُرَيْشٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ فَلَمَّا سَمِعُوا صَوْتَهُ ذَهَبَ عَنْهُمُ الضِّحْكُ وَخَافُوا دَعْوَتَهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ عَلَيْكَ بِأَبِي جَهْلِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ وَعُتْبَةَ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ وَشَيْبَةَ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ وَالْوَلِيدِ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ وَأُمَيَّةَ بْنِ خَلَفٍ وَعُقْبَةَ بْنِ أَبِي مُعَيْطٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَذَكَرَ السَّابِعَ وَلَمْ أَحْفَظْهُ فَوَالَّذِي بَعَثَ مُحَمَّدًا صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْحَقِّ لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ الَّذِينَ سَمَّى صَرْعَى يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ ثُمَّ سُحِبُوا إِلَى الْقَلِيبِ قَلِيبِ بَدْرٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ عُقْبَةَ غَلَطٌ فِي هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ ‏.‏
32.en:
It has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Mas'ud who said: While the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was saying his prayer near the Ka'ba and Abu Jahl with his companions was sitting (near by), Abu Jahl said, referring to the she-camel that had been slaughtered the previous day: Who will rise to fetch the foetus of the she-camel of so and so, and place it between the shoulders of Muhammad when he goes down in prostration (a posture in prayer). The one most accursed among the people got up, brought the foetus and, when the Prophet (ﷺ) went down in prostration, placed it between his shoulders. Then they laughed at him and some of them leaned upon the others with laughter. And I stood looking. If I had the power, I would have thrown it away from the back of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). The Prophet (ﷺ) had bent down his head in prostration and did not raise it, until a man went (to his house) and informed (his daughter) Fatima, who was a young girl (at that time) (about this ugly incident). She came and removed (the filthy thing) from him. Then she turned towards them rebuking them (the mischief-mongers). When the Prophet (ﷺ) had finished his prayer, he invoked God's imprecations upon them in a loud voice. When he prayed, he prayed thrice, and when he asked for God's blessings, he asked thrice. Then he said thrice: O Allah, it is for Thee to deal with the Quraish. When they heard his voice, laughter vanished from them and they feared his malediction. Then he said: O God, it is for Thee to deal with Abu Jahl b. Hisham, 'Utba b. Rabi'a, Shaiba b. Rabi'a. Walid b. Uqba, Umayya b. Khalaf, Uqba b. Abu Mu'ait (and he mentioned the name of the seventh person. which I did not remember). By One Who sent Muhammad with truth, I saw (all) those he had named lying slain on the Day of Badr. Their dead bodies were dragged to be thrown into a pit near the battlefield. 
Abu Ishiq had said that the name of Walid b. 'Uqba has been wrongly mentioned in this tradition.
32.hi: Ibn Mas'ud ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Kaaba ke qareeb apni namaz padh rahe the aur Abu Jahl apne saathiyon ke saath (qareeb) baitha tha, Abu Jahl ne, pichhle din zibah ki gayi oontni ka zikr karte hue, kaha: Kaun jaayega falan-falan ki oontni ka bhroon laane, aur use Muhammad ke kandhon ke beech rakhega jab woh sajde mein jaayenge (namaz ki ek mudra)? Logon mein sabse zyada shraapit shakhs uThA, bhroon laaya, aur jab Nabi (SAW) sajde mein gaye, use unke kandhon ke beech rakh diya. Phir woh unpar hanse aur unmein se kuch hansi mein ek-doosre par jhuk gaye. Aur main khada dekh raha tha. Agar mujhme taqat hoti, to main ise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki peeth se hataa deta. Nabi (SAW) ne sajde mein apna sar jhukaaya rakha aur ise nahi uThAya, yahan tak ki ek shakhs gaya (apne ghar) aur (unki beti) Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ko soochit kiya, jo us waqt ek jawaan larki thin (is ghinauni ghatna ke baare mein). Woh aayin aur unhe (gandi cheez) unse hataayi. Phir woh unki (buraai karne walon ki) taraf mudi unhe daantne. Jab Nabi (SAW) ne apni namaz khatm ki, unhone unke khilaaf Allah ki laanat buland aawaaz mein maangi. Jab unhone dua ki, unhone teen baar dua ki, aur jab unhone Allah ki barkatein maangi, unhone teen baar maangi. Phir unhone teen baar kaha: Aye Allah, Quraish ke saath vyavahaar karna Tera kaam hai. Jab unhone unki aawaaz suni, unse hansi gaayab ho gayi aur woh unki laanat se Darne lage. Phir unhone kaha: Aye Allah, Abu Jahl bin Hisham, Utba bin Rabi'a, Shaiba bin Rabi'a, Walid bin Uqba, Umayya bin Khalaf, Uqba bin Abu Mu'ait (aur unhone saatvein shakhs ka naam liya, jo mujhe yaad nahi raha) ke saath vyavahaar karna Tera kaam hai. Us hasti ki qasam jisne Muhammad ko sach ke saath bheja, maine (un sab) ko jinke naam unhone liye the, Badr ke din maare hue paDe dekha. Unki laashein maidaan-e-jung ke qareeb ek gadde mein phenkne ke liye kheenchi gayin. Abu Ishiq ne kaha tha ki Walid bin Uqba ka naam is hadees mein galat zikr kiya gaya hai.

32.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا إِسْحَاقَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ بَيْنَمَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَاجِدٌ وَحَوْلَهُ نَاسٌ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ إِذْ جَاءَ عُقْبَةُ بْنُ أَبِي مُعَيْطٍ بِسَلاَ جَزُورٍ فَقَذَفَهُ عَلَى ظَهْرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمْ يَرْفَعْ رَأْسَهُ فَجَاءَتْ فَاطِمَةُ فَأَخَذَتْهُ عَنْ ظَهْرِهِ وَدَعَتْ عَلَى مَنْ صَنَعَ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ اللَّهُمَّ عَلَيْكَ الْمَلأَ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ أَبَا جَهْلِ بْنَ هِشَامٍ وَعُتْبَةَ بْنَ رَبِيعَةَ وَعُقْبَةَ بْنَ أَبِي مُعَيْطٍ وَشَيْبَةَ بْنَ رَبِيعَةَ وَأُمَيَّةَ بْنَ خَلَفٍ أَوْ أُبَىَّ بْنَ خَلَفٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ شُعْبَةُ الشَّاكُّ قَالَ فَلَقَدْ رَأَيْتُهُمْ قُتِلُوا يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ فَأُلْقُوا فِي بِئْرٍ غَيْرَ أَنَّ أُمَيَّةَ أَوْ أُبَيًّا تَقَطَّعَتْ أَوْصَالُهُ فَلَمْ يُلْقَ فِي الْبِئْرِ ‏.‏
32.en: It has been narrated by Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) who said: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was lying postrate in prayer and around him were some people from the Quraish, 'Uqba b. Abu Mu'ait brought the foetus of a she-camel and threw it on the back of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He did not raise his head until Fatima arrived, removed it from his back and cured him who had done that (ugly act). He said: O Allah, it is for Thee to deal with the chiefs of the Quraish. Abu Jahl b. Hisham, 'Utba b. Rabi'a. Uqba b. Abu Mu'ait, Shaiba b. Rabi'a, Umayya b. Khalaf or Ubayy b. Khalaf (Shu'ba, one of the narrator of this tradition is in doubt about the exact person). I saw that all were slain in the Battle of Badr and their dead bodies were thrown into a well, except that of Umayya or Ubayy which was cut into pieces and was thrown into the well.
32.hi: Abdullah (bin Mas'ud) ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) namaz mein sajde mein leTe the aur unke aas-paas Quraish ke kuch log the, Uqba bin Abu Mu'ait ek oontni ka bhroon laaye aur use Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki peeth par phenka. Unhone apna sar nahi uThAya jab tak Fatima (Alayhas Salam) nahi aayin, unhone use unki peeth se hataaya aur jisne woh (ghinauna kaam) kiya use bura-bhala kaha. Unhone kaha: Aye Allah, Quraish ke sardaaron ke saath vyavahaar karna Tera kaam hai. Abu Jahl bin Hisham, Utba bin Rabi'a, Uqba bin Abu Mu'ait, Shaiba bin Rabi'a, Umayya bin Khalaf ya Ubayy bin Khalaf (Shu'ba, is hadees ke raawiyon mein se ek, isme shak mein hain kaunse sahi shakhs). Maine dekha ki sab Badr ki jung mein maare gaye aur unki laashein ek kuen mein phenki gayin, siwaay Umayya ya Ubayy ke jise kaTkar tukdon mein kuen mein phenka gaya.

32.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي، إِسْحَاقَ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ وَزَادَ وَكَانَ يَسْتَحِبُّ ثَلاَثًا يَقُولُ ‏
"‏ اللَّهُمَّ عَلَيْكَ بِقُرَيْشٍ اللَّهُمَّ عَلَيْكَ بِقُرَيْشٍ اللَّهُمَّ عَلَيْكَ بِقُرَيْشٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثَلاَثًا وَذَكَرَ فِيهِمُ الْوَلِيدَ بْنَ عُتْبَةَ وَأُمَيَّةَ بْنَ خَلَفٍ وَلَمْ يَشُكَّ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ وَنَسِيتُ السَّابِعَ ‏.‏
32.en: Abu Ishiq has narrated a similar tradition through a different chain of transmitters and has added: He (the Messenger of Allah) loved to repeat the supplication thrice. He was saying: O Allah, it is for Thee to deal with the Quraish (repeating these words thrice). And among the Quraish, he mentioned (the names of) al-Walid b. 'Utba and Umayya b. Khalaf. (The narrator says there is no doubt about the names of these persons but he has forgotten the name of the seventh man).
32.hi: Abu Ishiq ne isi jaisi ek riwayat ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki hai aur ye izafa kiya hai: Unhe (Allah ke Rasool ko) dua ko teen baar dohraana pasand tha. Woh keh rahe the: Aye Allah, Quraish ke saath vyavahaar karna Tera kaam hai (in alfaazon ko teen baar dohraate hue). Aur Quraish mein, unhone al-Walid bin Utba aur Umayya bin Khalaf ke (naam) zikr kiye. (Raawi kehte hain ki in logon ke naamon mein koi shak nahi hai lekin unhe saatvein shakhs ka naam yaad nahi raha.)

32.ar: وَحَدَّثَنِي سَلَمَةُ بْنُ شَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ أَعْيَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ اسْتَقْبَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْبَيْتَ فَدَعَا عَلَى سِتَّةِ نَفَرٍ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ ‏.‏ فِيهِمْ أَبُو جَهْلٍ وَأُمَيَّةُ بْنُ خَلَفٍ وَعُتْبَةُ بْنُ رَبِيعَةَ وَشَيْبَةُ بْنُ رَبِيعَةَ وَعُقْبَةُ بْنُ أَبِي مُعَيْطٍ فَأُقْسِمُ بِاللَّهِ لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُهُمْ صَرْعَى عَلَى بَدْرٍ ‏.‏ قَدْ غَيَّرَتْهُمُ الشَّمْسُ وَكَانَ يَوْمًا حَارًّا ‏.‏
32.en: It has been narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah that, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) turned his face towards the Ka'ba and invoked God's imprecations upon six men of the Quraish, amorig whom were Abu Jahl. Umayya b. Khalaf, Utba b. Rabi'a, Shaiba b. Rabi'a and 'Uqba b. Abu Mu'ait I swear by God that I saw them lying slain in the battlefield of Badr. It being a hot day, their complexion had changed (showing signs of decay).
32.hi: Abdullah ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apna chehra Kaaba ki taraf moda aur Quraish ke chhe aadmiyon ke khilaaf Allah ki laanat maangi, jinmein Abu Jahl, Umayya bin Khalaf, Utba bin Rabi'a, Shaiba bin Rabi'a aur Uqba bin Abu Mu'ait shaamil the. Main Allah ki qasam khaakar kehta hoon ki maine unhe Badr ke maidaan-e-jung mein maare hue paDe dekha. Ye ek garam din tha, unka rang badal gaya tha (kshay ke chinh dikhaate hue).

32.ar: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَرْحٍ وَحَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى وَعَمْرُو بْنُ سَوَّادٍ الْعَامِرِيُّ - وَأَلْفَاظُهُمْ مُتَقَارِبَةٌ - قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ  ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَدَّثَتْهُ أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَلْ أَتَى عَلَيْكَ يَوْمٌ كَانَ أَشَدَّ مِنْ يَوْمِ أُحُدٍ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لَقَدْ لَقِيتُ مِنْ قَوْمِكِ وَكَانَ أَشَدَّ مَا لَقِيتُ مِنْهُمْ يَوْمَ الْعَقَبَةِ إِذْ عَرَضْتُ نَفْسِي عَلَى ابْنِ عَبْدِ يَالِيلَ بْنِ عَبْدِ كُلاَلٍ فَلَمْ يُجِبْنِي إِلَى مَا أَرَدْتُ فَانْطَلَقْتُ وَأَنَا مَهْمُومٌ عَلَى وَجْهِي فَلَمْ أَسْتَفِقْ إِلاَّ بِقَرْنِ الثَّعَالِبِ فَرَفَعْتُ رَأْسِي فَإِذَا أَنَا بِسَحَابَةٍ قَدْ أَظَلَّتْنِي فَنَظَرْتُ فَإِذَا فِيهَا جِبْرِيلُ فَنَادَانِي فَقَالَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ قَدْ سَمِعَ قَوْلَ قَوْمِكَ لَكَ وَمَا رَدُّوا عَلَيْكَ وَقَدْ بَعَثَ إِلَيْكَ مَلَكَ الْجِبَالِ لِتَأْمُرَهُ بِمَا شِئْتَ فِيهِمْ قَالَ فَنَادَانِي مَلَكُ الْجِبَالِ وَسَلَّمَ عَلَىَّ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ سَمِعَ قَوْلَ قَوْمِكَ لَكَ وَأَنَا مَلَكُ الْجِبَالِ وَقَدْ بَعَثَنِي رَبُّكَ إِلَيْكَ لِتَأْمُرَنِي بِأَمْرِكَ فَمَا شِئْتَ إِنْ شِئْتَ أَنْ أُطْبِقَ عَلَيْهِمُ الأَخْشَبَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ بَلْ أَرْجُو أَنْ يُخْرِجَ اللَّهُ مِنْ أَصْلاَبِهِمْ مَنْ يَعْبُدُ اللَّهَ وَحْدَهُ لاَ يُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئًا ‏"‏ ‏.
32.en: It has been narrated on the authority of `A'isha, the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ), who said to the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him): Messenger of Allah, has there come upon you a day more terrible than the day of Uhud. He said: I have experienced from thy people and the hardest treatment I met from them was what I received from them on the day of `Aqaba. I betook myself to Ibn `Abd Yalil b. `Abd Kulal with the purpose of inviting him to Islam, but he did not respond to me as I desired. So I departed with signs of (deep) distress on my face. I did not recover until I reached Qarn al-Tha`alib. Where I raised my head, lo! near me was a cloud which had cast its shadow on me. I looked and lo! there was in it the angel Jibril who called out to me and said: God, the Honoured and Glorious, has heard what thy people have said to thee, and how they have reacted to thy call. And He has sent to thee the angel in charge of the mountains so that thou mayest order him what thou wishest (him to do) with regard to them. The angel in charge of the mountains (then) called out to me, greeted me and said: Muhammad, God has listened to what thy people have said to thee. I am the angel in charge of the mountains, and thy Lord has sent me to thee so that thou mayest order me what thou wishest. If thou wishest that I should bring together the two mountains that stand opposite to each other at the extremities of Mecca to crush them in between, (I would do that). But the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) said to him: I rather hope that God will produce from their descendants such persons as will worship Allah, the One, and will not ascribe partners to Him.
32.hi: Aisha, Nabi (SAW) ki zauja, ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya aappar Uhud ke din se zyada bhayaanak koi din aaya hai. Unhone kaha: Maine tumhare logon se tajurba kiya, aur unse mila sabse kaThOr vyavahaar woh tha jo mujhe Aqaba ke din mila. Main Ibn Abd Yalil bin Abd Kulal ke paas gaya unhe Islam ka nimantran dene ke maqsad se, lekin unhone mujhe wo jawaab nahi diya jo maine chaaha tha. To main (gehre) dukh ke chinh apne chehre par liye chala gaya. Main tab tak theek nahi hua jab tak main Qarn al-Tha'alib nahi pahuncha. Jahan maine apna sar uThAya, dekho! Mere qareeb ek badal tha jisne mujhpar apni chhaaya daali thi. Maine dekha aur dekho! Usmein farishta Jibril the jinhone mujhe pukaara aur kaha: Allah, Sammanit aur Shaandaar, ne suna hai jo tumhare logon ne tumse kaha, aur unhone tumhare aahvaan ka kaisa jawaab diya. Aur Usne tumhe pahaadon ke prabhaari farishte ko bheja hai taaki tum unhe unke baare mein apni ichchha ke mutabik hukum de sako. Pahaadon ke prabhaari farishte ne (phir) mujhe pukaara, mujhe salaam kiya aur kaha: Muhammad, Allah ne suna hai jo tumhare logon ne tumse kaha. Main pahaadon ka prabhaari farishta hoon, aur tumhare Rab ne mujhe tumhare paas bheja hai taaki tum mujhe apni ichchha ke mutabik hukum de sako. Agar tum chahte ho ki main un do pahaadon ko jo Makkah ke conaron par ek-doosre ke saamne khade hain, ek saath laaun unhe beech mein kuchal ne ke liye, (main aisa karunga). Lekin Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha: Main balki ummeed rakhta hoon ki Allah unki aulaad se aise log paida karega jo Allah, jo Ek hai, ki ibadat karenge aur Usko koi shareek nahi maanenge.

32.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ أَبِي عَوَانَةَ، قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ جُنْدُبِ بْنِ سُفْيَانَ، قَالَ دَمِيَتْ إِصْبَعُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي بَعْضِ تِلْكَ الْمَشَاهِدِ فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ هَلْ أَنْتِ إِلاَّ إِصْبَعٌ دَمِيتِ وَفِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ مَا لَقِيتِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
32.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Jundub b. Sufyan who said: A finger of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was wounded in one of the encounters He said: Thou art just a little finger which has bled, and what thou hast experienced is in the cause of Allah.
32.hi: Jundub bin Sufyan ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki ek ungli kisi ek muqaable mein zakhmi ho gayi. Unhone kaha: Tum bas ek choti ungli ho jo khoon behi hai, aur jo tumne tajurba kiya hai woh Allah ki raah mein hai.

32.ar: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي غَارٍ فَنُكِبَتْ إِصْبَعُهُ ‏.‏
32.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Aswad b. Qais who said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was in a cave (or raid) when his finger was hurt.
32.hi: Aswad bin Qais ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek ghufa (ya hamle) mein the jab unki ungli zakhmi hui.

32.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جُنْدُبًا، يَقُولُ أَبْطَأَ جِبْرِيلُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ قَدْ وُدِّعَ مُحَمَّدٌ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏ وَالضُّحَى * وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَى * مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَى‏}‏
32.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Aswad b. Qais who heard Jundub saying that Gabriel delayed his visit to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) The polytheists began to say that Muhammad has been forsaken. At this Allah, the Glorious and Exalted, revealed: " Wa'dd hd wa'l-laili iza saja, ma wadda'ka Rabbuka wa' ma qala" .
32.hi: Aswad bin Qais ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone Jundub ko ye kehte suna ki Jibril ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se milne mein deri ki. Mushrikeen kehne lage ki Muhammad ko chhoD diya gaya hai. Isper Allah, Shaandaar aur Buland-o-Azeem, ne nazil kiya: "Wa'dd hd wa'l-laili iza saja, ma wadda'ka Rabbuka wa' ma qala."
