وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، وَأَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، قَالَ أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ، هَارُونُ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، أَخْبَرَتْهُ عَنْ بَيْعَةِ النِّسَاءِ، قَالَتْ مَا مَسَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدِهِ امْرَأَةً قَطُّ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَأْخُذَ عَلَيْهَا فَإِذَا أَخَذَ عَلَيْهَا فَأَعْطَتْهُ قَالَ ‏
"‏ اذْهَبِي فَقَدْ بَايَعْتُكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated on the authority of 'Urwa that 'A'isha described to him the way the Prophet (ﷺ) took the oath of fealty from women. She said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) never touched a woman with his hand. He would only take a vow from her and when he had taken the (verbal) vow, he would say: You may go. I have accepted your fealty.
33.hi: Urwa ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Aisha ne unhe woh tareeka bataaya jisse Nabi (SAW) auraton se wafadaari ki qasam lete the. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kabhi kisi aurat ko apne haath se nahi chhua. Woh sirf unse ek vaada lete aur jab unhone (maukhik) vaada le liya hota, woh kehte: Tum jaa sakti ho. Maine tumhari wafadaari qubool kar li hai.

33.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ أَيُّوبَ - قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ جَعْفَرٍ - أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ دِينَارٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، يَقُولُ كُنَّا نُبَايِعُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى السَّمْعِ وَالطَّاعَةِ يَقُولُ لَنَا ‏
"‏ فِيمَا اسْتَطَعْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Abdullah b. 'Umar who said: We used to take oath to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that we would listen to and obey his orders. He would tell us (to say in the oath): As far as it lies in my power.
33.hi: Abdullah bin Umar ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se qasam lete the ki hum unki baat sunenge aur unke hukumon ki itaat karenge. Woh humein (qasam mein kehne ko) kehte: Jitna mere vash mein hai.

33.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ عَرَضَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ فِي الْقِتَالِ وَأَنَا ابْنُ أَرْبَعَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً فَلَمْ يُجِزْنِي وَعَرَضَنِي يَوْمَ الْخَنْدَقِ وَأَنَا ابْنُ خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً فَأَجَازَنِي ‏.‏ قَالَ نَافِعٌ فَقَدِمْتُ عَلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ وَهُوَ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَلِيفَةٌ فَحَدَّثْتُهُ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ فَقَالَ إِنَّ هَذَا لَحَدٌّ بَيْنَ الصَّغِيرِ وَالْكَبِيرِ ‏.‏ فَكَتَبَ إِلَى عُمَّالِهِ أَنْ يَفْرِضُوا لِمَنْ كَانَ ابْنَ خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً وَمَنْ كَانَ دُونَ ذَلِكَ فَاجْعَلُوهُ فِي الْعِيَالِ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar who said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) inspected me on the battlefield on the Day of Uhud, and I was fourteen years old. He did not allow me (to take part in the fight). He inspected me on the Day of Khandaq-and I was fifteen yearsold, and he permitted me (to fight), Nafi' said: I came to 'Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz who was then Caliph, and narrated this tradition to him. He said: Surely, this is the demarcation between a minor and a major. So he wrote to his governors that they should pay subsistence allowance to one who was fifteen years old, but should treat those of lesser age among children.
33.hi: Ibn Umar ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe Uhud ke din jung ke maidaan mein jaancha, aur meri umar chaudah saal thi. Unhone mujhe (jung mein hissa lene ki) ijazat nahi di. Unhone mujhe Khandaq ke din jaancha - aur meri umar pandrah saal thi, aur unhone mujhe (larne ki) ijazat di. Nafi ne kaha: Main Umar bin Abd al-Aziz ke paas gaya jo us waqt Khalifa the, aur unhe ye hadees riwayat ki. Unhone kaha: Yaqeenan, ye ek naabaalig aur ek baalig ke beech ki seema hai. To unhone apne gavarnaron ko likha ki unhe us shakhs ko bhar-poshan bhatta dena chahiye jo pandrah saal ka tha, lekin bachchon mein se choti umar walon ko doosri tarah se maanein.

33.ar: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، وَعَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ بْنُ، سُلَيْمَانَ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، - يَعْنِي الثَّقَفِيَّ - جَمِيعًا عَنْ عُبَيْدِ، اللَّهِ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي حَدِيثِهِمْ وَأَنَا ابْنُ أَرْبَعَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً فَاسْتَصْغَرَنِي ‏.‏
33.en: This tradition has been handed down through a different chain Of transmitters with the following change in the wording: " I was fourteen years old and he thought me too young (to participate in the fight)."
33.hi: Ye riwayat ek doosri sanad ke zariye is alfaazon mein badlaav ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai: "Meri umar chaudah saal thi aur unhone mujhe (jung mein hissa lene ke liye) bahut jawaan samjha."

33.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ،
 قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُسَافَرَ بِالْقُرْآنِ إِلَى أَرْضِ الْعَدُوِّ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar who said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade that one should travel to the land of the enemy taking the Qur'an with him.
33.hi: Ibn Umar ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mana kiya ki koi bhi Quran apne saath lekar dushman ki zameen mein safar kare.

33.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ،
 اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَنْهَى أَنْ يُسَافَرَ بِالْقُرْآنِ إِلَى
 أَرْضِ الْعَدُوِّ مَخَافَةَ أَنْ يَنَالَهُ الْعَدُوُّ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Abdullah b. Umar that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to forbid that one should travel to the land of the enemy taking the Qur'an (with him) lest it should fall into the hands of the enemy.
33.hi: Abdullah bin Umar ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mana kiya karte the ki koi bhi Quran (apne saath) lekar dushman ki zameen mein safar kare kahin ye dushman ke haathon mein na pad jaaye.

33.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الْعَتَكِيُّ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ،
 عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ لاَ تُسَافِرُوا بِالْقُرْآنِ فَإِنِّي لاَ
 آمَنُ أَنْ يَنَالَهُ الْعَدُوُّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَيُّوبُ فَقَدْ نَالَهُ الْعَدُوُّ وَخَاصَمُوكُمْ بِهِ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Do not take the Qur'an on a journey with you, for I am afraid lost it should fall into the hands of the enemy. Ayyub (one of the narrators in the chain of transmitters) said: The enemy may seize it and may quarrel with you over it.
33.hi: Ibn Umar ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Quran ko apne saath safar par mat le jaao, kyunki mujhe dar hai ki ye dushman ke haathon mein pad jaayega. Ayyub (sanad ke raawiyon mein se ek) ne kaha: Dushman ise pakad sakta hai aur ismein tumse jhagda kar sakta hai.

33.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ يَعْنِي ابْنَ عُلَيَّةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ،
 حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، وَالثَّقَفِيُّ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا 
 الضَّحَّاكُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عُثْمَانَ - جَمِيعًا عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم ‏.‏ فِي حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ وَالثَّقَفِيِّ ‏"‏ فَإِنِّي أَخَافُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ سُفْيَانَ وَحَدِيثِ الضَّحَّاكِ
 بْنِ عُثْمَانَ ‏"‏ مَخَافَةَ أَنْ يَنَالَهُ الْعَدُوُّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: The above hadith has been narrated through several other chains with slight differences of wording.
33.hi: Upar wali hadees kayi doosri sanadon ke zariye alfaazon mein halke antar ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

33.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ،
 ‏.‏ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَابَقَ بِالْخَيْلِ الَّتِي قَدْ أُضْمِرَتْ مِنَ الْحَفْيَاءِ وَكَانَ
 أَمَدُهَا ثَنِيَّةَ الْوَدَاعِ وَسَابَقَ بَيْنَ الْخَيْلِ الَّتِي لَمْ تُضْمَرْ مِنَ الثَّنِيَّةِ إِلَى مَسْجِدِ بَنِي زُرَيْقٍ وَكَانَ
 ابْنُ عُمَرَ فِيمَنْ سَابَقَ بِهَا ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had a race of the horses which had been especially prepared for the purpose from Hafya' to Thaniyyat al-Wada' (the latter being the winning post), and of those which had not been trained from Thaniyya to the mosque of Banu Zuraiq, and Ibn Umar was among those who took part in this race.
33.hi: Ibn Umar ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne un ghodon ki daud karvaayi jo khaas taur par is maqsad ke liye taiyaar kiye gaye the Hafya se Thaniyyat al-Wada tak (baad wala jeet ka nishaan tha), aur un ghodon ki (daud) jo prashikshit nahi the Thaniyya se Banu Zuraiq ki masjid tak, aur Ibn Umar un logon mein the jinhone is daud mein hissa liya.

33.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ،
 ح وَحَدَّثَنَا خَلَفُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، وَأَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ زَيْدٍ
 - عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ،
 حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، ح 
 وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَعُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ الْقَطَّانُ
 - جَمِيعًا عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدَةَ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، قَالُوا
 حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا 
 ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ،
 أَخْبَرَنِي أُسَامَةُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زَيْدٍ - كُلُّ هَؤُلاَءِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ مَالِكٍ
 عَنْ نَافِعٍ، ‏.‏ وَزَادَ فِي حَدِيثِ أَيُّوبَ مِنْ رِوَايَةِ حَمَّادٍ وَابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ فَجِئْتُ سَابِقًا
 فَطَفَّفَ بِي الْفَرَسُ الْمَسْجِدَ ‏.‏
33.en: This tradition has been handed down through several other chains of transmitters.  One of the chaines has the addition of the following words from Abdullah b. 'Umar: " I came first in the race and my horse jumped into the mosque with me."
33.hi: Ye riwayat kayi doosri sanadon ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai. Ek sanad mein Abdullah bin Umar ke ye izafi alfaaz hain: "Main daud mein pehle aaya aur mera ghoda mere saath masjid mein kood gaya."

33.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ الْخَيْلُ فِي نَوَاصِيهَا الْخَيْرُ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Umar that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: There will be great benefit in the forelock of the horses until the Day of judgment.
33.hi: Ibn Umar ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ghodon ki peshaani mein Qayamat ke din tak bada faayda hoga.

33.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، رُمْحٍ عَنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ،
 حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ،
 اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا 
 ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أُسَامَةُ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
 بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ ‏.‏
33.en: The same tradition has been handed down through a different chain of transmitters.
33.hi: Yehi riwayat ek doosri raawi sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

33.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، وَصَالِحُ بْنُ حَاتِمِ بْنِ وَرْدَانَ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ يَزِيدَ،
 - قَالَ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، - حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ،
 عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ جَرِيرٍ، عَنْ جَرِيرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم يَلْوِي نَاصِيَةَ فَرَسٍ بِإِصْبَعِهِ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ ‏
"‏ الْخَيْلُ مَعْقُودٌ بِنَوَاصِيهَا الْخَيْرُ
 إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ الأَجْرُ وَالْغَنِيمَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Jarir b. Abdullah who said: I saw that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was twisting the forelock of a horse with his fingers and he was saying: (A great) benefit. i. e. reward (for rearing them for Jihad) and spoils of war, has been tied to the forelocks of horses until the Day of Judgment.
33.hi: Jarir bin Abdullah ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Maine dekha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek ghode ki peshaani ke baal apni ungliyon se moD rahe the aur keh rahe the: (Ek bada) faayda, yaani sawaab (unhe Jihad ke liye paalne ka) aur maal-e-ganimat, ghodon ki peshaaniyon se Qayamat ke din tak jodi gayi hai.

33.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ،
 أَبِي شَيْبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ يُونُسَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
33.en: The above tradition has also been narrated on the authority of Yunus through a different chain of transmitters.
33.hi: Upar wali riwayat Yunus ki sanad se ek doosri sanad ke zariye bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

33.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ 
 عُرْوَةَ الْبَارِقِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ الْخَيْلُ مَعْقُودٌ فِي نَوَاصِيهَا
 الْخَيْرُ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ الأَجْرُ وَالْمَغْنَمُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: The same tradition has been narrated on the authority of Urwat al-Bariqi who said that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: Great good is attached to the forelock of the horses until the Day of Judgment.
33.hi: Yehi riwayat Urwat al-Bariqi ke hawale se riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha ki Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Bahut achhaai ghodon ki peshaani se Qayamat ke din tak judi hai.

33.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، وَابْنُ، إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ، عَنِ 
 الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ الْبَارِقِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ الْخَيْرُ مَعْقُوصٌ
 بِنَوَاصِي الْخَيْلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقِيلَ لَهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ بِمَ ذَاكَ قَالَ ‏"‏ الأَجْرُ وَالْمَغْنَمُ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
 ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: 'Urwat al-Bariqi reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said this: Good is tied to the forelock of the horses. It Was said to him: Messenger of Allah, why is it so? He (the Prophet said): For reward and booty until the Day of Judgment.
33.hi: Urwat al-Bariqi ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ye kaha: Achhaai ghodon ki peshaani se judi hai. Unse poocha gaya: Allah ke Rasool, aisa kyun hai? Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Sawaab aur maal-e-ganimat ke liye Qayamat ke din tak.

33.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ
 قَالَ عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الْجَعْدِ ‏.‏
33.en: This hadith has been narrated with the same chain of transmitters with the difference that here instead of" Urwat al-Bariqi" there is" Urwa b. ja'd."
33.hi: Ye hadees isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai is antar ke saath ki yahan "Urwat al-Bariqi" ki jagah "Urwa bin ja'd" hai.

33.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَخَلَفُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ جَمِيعًا عَنْ أَبِي،
 الأَحْوَصِ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ 
 شَبِيبِ بْنِ غَرْقَدَةَ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ الْبَارِقِيِّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ الأَجْرَ
 وَالْمَغْنَمَ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ سُفْيَانَ سَمِعَ عُرْوَةَ الْبَارِقِيَّ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
33.en: A version of the tradition narrated on the authority of 'Urwat al-Bariqi does not mention (the words): " reward and booty".
33.hi: Urwat al-Bariqi ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi riwayat ka ek soorat in alfaazon ka zikr nahi karta: "Sawaab aur maal-e-ganimat."

33.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ
 حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْعَيْزَارِ بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ،
 بْنِ الْجَعْدِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِهَذَا ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ ‏
"‏ الأَجْرَ وَالْمَغْنَمَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: A version of the tradition transmitted on the authority of 'Urwa b. al-ja'd does not mention" reward and booty".
33.hi: Urwa bin al-ja'd ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi riwayat ka ek soorat "sawaab aur maal-e-ganimat" ka zikr nahi karta.

33.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ
 قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي التَّيَّاحِ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ
 قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ الْبَرَكَةُ فِي نَوَاصِي الْخَيْلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: There is a blessing in the forelocks of the war horses.
33.hi: Anas bin Malik ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jung ke ghodon ki peshaani mein ek barkat hai.

33.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْحَارِثِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ،
 الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي التَّيَّاحِ، سَمِعَ أَنَسًا، يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ 
 النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
33.en: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Anas through another chain of transmitters.
33.hi: Isi jaisi ek hadees Anas ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

33.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ
 قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرُونَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ سَلْمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ 
 أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَكْرَهُ الشِّكَالَ مِنَ
 الْخَيْلِ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Abn Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to dislike the Shikal horse.
33.hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Shikal ghode ko napasand karte the.

33.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ،
 الرَّزَّاقِ جَمِيعًا عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ وَزَادَ فِي حَدِيثِ عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ وَالشِّكَالُ أَنْ
 يَكُونَ الْفَرَسُ فِي رِجْلِهِ الْيُمْنَى بَيَاضٌ وَفِي يَدِهِ الْيُسْرَى أَوْ فِي يَدِهِ الْيُمْنَى وَرِجْلِهِ الْيُسْرَى
 ‏.‏
33.en: This tradition has been narrated on the authority of Sufyan with the addition from Abd ar-Razzaq (one of the narrators) explaining the meaning of shikal as a bone whose right back foot and left front foot or left back foot and right front foot are white.
33.hi: Ye riwayat Sufyan ki sanad se Abd ar-Razzaq (ek raawi) ke izafe ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone shikal ka matlab samjhaaya jise ek aisi haddi (ghoda) hai jiska daaya peechla paon aur baaya aagla paon, ya baaya peechla paon aur daaya aagla paon safed ho.

33.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ يَعْنِي ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى،
 حَدَّثَنِي وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ النَّخَعِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ،
 عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ وَكِيعٍ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ وَهْبٍ
 عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ النَّخَعِيَّ ‏.‏
33.en: The tradition has been handed down through a different chain of transmitters.
33.hi: Ye riwayat ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

33.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ الْقَعْقَاعِ - عَنْ 
 أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ تَضَمَّنَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ
 خَرَجَ فِي سَبِيلِهِ لاَ يُخْرِجُهُ إِلاَّ جِهَادًا فِي سَبِيلِي وَإِيمَانًا بِي وَتَصْدِيقًا بِرُسُلِي فَهُوَ عَلَىَّ
 ضَامِنٌ أَنْ أُدْخِلَهُ الْجَنَّةَ أَوْ أَرْجِعَهُ إِلَى مَسْكَنِهِ الَّذِي خَرَجَ مِنْهُ نَائِلاً مَا نَالَ مِنْ أَجْرٍ أَوْ غَنِيمَةٍ
 ‏.‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسُ مُحَمَّدٍ بِيَدِهِ مَا مِنْ كَلْمٍ يُكْلَمُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ إِلاَّ جَاءَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ كَهَيْئَتِهِ حِينَ
 كُلِمَ لَوْنُهُ لَوْنُ دَمٍ وَرِيحُهُ مِسْكٌ وَالَّذِي نَفْسُ مُحَمَّدٍ بِيَدِهِ لَوْلاَ أَنْ يَشُقَّ عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِينَ مَا قَعَدْتُ
 خِلاَفَ سَرِيَّةٍ تَغْزُو فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ أَبَدًا وَلَكِنْ لاَ أَجِدُ سَعَةً فَأَحْمِلَهُمْ وَلاَ يَجِدُونَ سَعَةً وَيَشُقُّ
 عَلَيْهِمْ أَنْ يَتَخَلَّفُوا عَنِّي وَالَّذِي نَفْسُ مُحَمَّدٍ بِيَدِهِ لَوَدِدْتُ أَنِّي أَغْزُو فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَأُقْتَلُ
 ثُمَّ أَغْزُو فَأُقْتَلُ ثُمَّ أَغْزُو فَأُقْتَلُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (may peace upon him) said: Allah has undertaken to look after the affairs of one who goes out to fight in His way believing in Him and affirming the truth of His Apostles. He is committed to His care that Re will either admit him to Paradise or bring him back to his home from where he set out with a reward or (his share of) booty. By the Being in Whose Hand is the life of Muhammad. If a person gets wounded in the way of Allah, he will come on the Day of Judgment with his wound in the same condition as it was when it was first inflicted; its colour being the colour of blood but its smell will be the smell of musk. By, the Being in Whose Hand is Muhammad's life, if it were not to be too hard upon the Muslime. I would not lag behind any expedition which is going to fight in the cause of Allah. But I do not have abundant means to provide them (the Mujahids) with riding beasts, nor have they (i. e. all of them) abundant means (to provide themselves with all the means of Jihad) so that they could he left behind. By the Being in Whose Hand is Muhammad's life, I love to fight in the way of Allah and be killed, to fight and again be killed and to fight again and be killed.
33.hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Allah ne us shakhs ke maamlon ki dekhbhaal karne ki zimmedaari li hai jo Uski raah mein larne nikalta hai, Uspar imaan rakhte hue aur Uske Rasoolon ki sachchaai ko maante hue. Woh Uski dekhbhaal mein hai ki Woh use ya to Jannat mein daakhil karega ya use ghar wapas laayega jahan se woh nikla tha sawaab ya maal-e-ganimat mein se hisse ke saath. Us Hasti ki qasam jiske Haath mein Muhammad ki zindagi hai, agar koi shakhs Allah ki raah mein zakhmi hota hai, woh Qayamat ke din apne zakhm ke saath aayega usi haalat mein jaisa ye pehli baar pahunchaayi gayi thi; iska rang khoon ka rang hoga lekin iski mahak mushk ki mahak hogi. Us Hasti ki qasam jiske Haath mein Muhammad ki zindagi hai, agar ye Musalmaanon par bahut mushkil na hoti, main kisi bhi muhim se peeche nahi rahta jo Allah ki khaatir larne jaa rahi hai. Lekin mere paas unhe (Mujahids ko) sawaari waale jaanwar dene ke liye kaafi saadhan nahi hain, na hi unke paas (yaani unmein se sab ke paas) kaafi saadhan hain (khud ko Jihad ke saare saadhan mahaiyaa karaane ke liye) taaki unhe peeche chhoDa jaa sake. Us Hasti ki qasam jiske Haath mein Muhammad ki zindagi hai, main Allah ki raah mein larna aur qatal ho jaana pasand karta hoon, phir larna aur dobara qatal ho jaana aur phir larna aur qatal ho jaana.

33.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ،
 بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
33.en: The same tradition has been melted through another chain of transmitters.
33.hi: Yehi riwayat ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

33.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحِزَامِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ،
 عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ تَكَفَّلَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ جَاهَدَ
 فِي سَبِيلِهِ لاَ يُخْرِجُهُ مِنْ بَيْتِهِ إِلاَّ جِهَادٌ فِي سَبِيلِهِ وَتَصْدِيقُ كَلِمَتِهِ - بِأَنْ يُدْخِلَهُ الْجَنَّةَ أَوْ
 يَرْجِعَهُ إِلَى مَسْكَنِهِ الَّذِي خَرَجَ مِنْهُ مَعَ مَا نَالَ مِنْ أَجْرٍ أَوْ غَنِيمَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira who said: Allah has undertaken to provide for one who leaves his home (only) to fight for His cause and to affirm the truth of His word; Allah will either admit him to Paradise or will bring him back home from where he had come out, with his reward and booty.
33.hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Allah ne us shakhs ke liye intezam karne ki zimmedaari li hai jo apna ghar chhoDta hai (sirf) Uski khaatir larne aur Uske alfaazon ki sachchaai ki pushti karne ke liye; Allah use ya to Jannat mein daakhil karega ya use ghar wapas laayega jahan se woh nikla tha, apne sawaab aur maal-e-ganimat ke saath.

33.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ،
 عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ لاَ يُكْلَمُ أَحَدٌ فِي سَبِيلِ
 اللَّهِ - وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ يُكْلَمُ فِي سَبِيلِهِ - إِلاَّ جَاءَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَجُرْحُهُ يَثْعَبُ اللَّوْنُ لَوْنُ دَمٍ
 وَالرِّيحُ رِيحُ مِسْكٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: One who is wounded in the way of Allah-and Allah knows better who is wounded in His way-will appear on the Day of Judgment with his wound bleediing. The colour (of its discharge) will be the colour of blood, (but) its smell will be the smell of musk.
33.hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jo Allah ki raah mein zakhmi hota hai - aur Allah behtar jaanta hai ki kaun Uski raah mein zakhmi hota hai - Qayamat ke din apne zakhm se khoon bahaate hue pragat hoga. Iske (rise ka) rang khoon ka rang hoga, (lekin) iski mahak mushk ki mahak hogi.

33.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، قَالَ
 هَذَا مَا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ أَحَادِيثَ مِنْهَا وَقَالَ
 رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ كُلُّ كَلْمٍ يُكْلَمُهُ الْمُسْلِمُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ تَكُونُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
 كَهَيْئَتِهَا إِذَا طُعِنَتْ تَفَجَّرُ دَمًا اللَّوْنُ لَوْنُ دَمٍ وَالْعَرْفُ عَرْفُ الْمِسْكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسُ مُحَمَّدٍ فِي يَدِهِ لَوْلاَ أَنْ أَشُقَّ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ مَا قَعَدْتُ
 خَلْفَ سَرِيَّةٍ تَغْزُو فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَلَكِنْ لاَ أَجِدُ سَعَةً فَأَحْمِلَهُمْ وَلاَ يَجِدُونَ سَعَةً فَيَتَّبِعُونِي
 وَلاَ تَطِيبُ أَنْفُسُهُمْ أَنْ يَقْعُدُوا بَعْدِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Haraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Every wound received by a Muslim in the way of Allah will appear on the Day of Judgment in the same condition as it was when it was inflicted, and would be bleeding profusely. The colour (of its discharge) will be the colour of blood, but its smell will be the smell of musk. By the Being in Whose Hand is Muhammad's life, if it were not hard upon the Muslims, I would not lag behind any expedition undertaken for Jihad, but I do not possess abundant means to provide the Mujahids with riding animals, nor do they (i. e. all of them) have abundant means (to provide themselves with all the means of Jihad) to follow me, nor would it please their hearts to stay behind me.
33.hi: Abu Haraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Kisi Musalman ko Allah ki raah mein lagi har chot Qayamat ke din usi haalat mein pragat hogi jaisi ye pahunchaayi gayi thi, aur bahut zyada khoon behta hoga. Iske (rise ka) rang khoon ka rang hoga, lekin iski mahak mushk ki mahak hogi. Us Hasti ki qasam jiske Haath mein Muhammad ki zindagi hai, agar Musalmaanon par ye mushkil na hoti, main Jihad ke liye undertaken kisi bhi muhim se peeche nahi rahta, lekin mere paas Mujahids ko sawaari waale jaanwar dene ke liye kaafi saadhan nahi hain, na hi unke paas (yaani sabke paas) mera anusaran karne ke liye kaafi saadhan hain, na hi unke dilon ko ye achha lagta ki woh mere peeche reh jaayein.

33.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ،
 قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لَوْلاَ أَنْ أَشُقَّ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ما قَعَدْتُ
 خِلاَفَ سَرِيَّةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏.‏ وَبِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏"‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لَوَدِدْتُ أَنِّي أُقْتَلُ فِي
 سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ أُحْيَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira who said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: I would not stay behind (when) an expedition (for Jihad was being mobilised) if it were going to be too hard upon the believers.... This is followed by the same words as have appeared in the previous tradition, but this tradition has the same ending as the previous hadith with a slight difference in the wording:" By the Being in Whose Hand is my life, I love that I should be killed in the way of Allah; then I should be brought back to life and be killed again in His way...."
33.hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Main kisi muhim se peeche nahi rahta (jab) ek muhim (Jihad ke liye sanchaalit ki jaa rahi hoti) agar ye momino par bahut mushkil na hoti.... Iske baad wahi alfaaz hain jo pichhli hadees mein aaye hain, lekin ye hadees pichhli hadees jaisi hi khatam hoti hai alfaazon mein halke antar ke saath: "Us Hasti ki qasam jiske Haath mein meri zindagi hai, mujhe pasand hai ki main Allah ki raah mein qatal ho jaaun; phir mujhe zinda kiya jaaye aur Uski raah mein dobara qatal kiya jaaun...."

33.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ يَعْنِي الثَّقَفِيَّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ،
 بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ، كُلُّهُمْ
 عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم ‏
"‏ لَوْلاَ أَنْ أَشُقَّ عَلَى أُمَّتِي لأَحْبَبْتُ أَنْ لاَ أَتَخَلَّفَ خَلْفَ سَرِيَّةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: If it were not hard upon my Umma (to follow my example), I would not lag behind any expedition-as in the traditions gone before.
33.hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Agar meri Ummat ke liye ye mushkil na hoti (mera udaaharan follow karne ke liye), main kisi bhi muhim se peeche nahi rahta - jaise pichhli hadeeson mein hai.

33.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ
 قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ تَضَمَّنَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ خَرَجَ فِي سَبِيلِهِ - إِلَى قَوْلِهِ -
 مَا تَخَلَّفْتُ خِلاَفَ سَرِيَّةٍ تَغْزُو فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: Another version of the tradition narrated through a different chain of transmitters on the authority of Abu Huraira has the same wording as the previous tradition: " Allah takes care of one who goes out in the way of Allah" but ends in the words:" I would not lag behind any expedition which is undertaken to fight in the way of Allah, the Exalted."
33.hi: Ek doosri sanad ke zariye Abu Huraira ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi riwayat ka doosra soorat pichhli hadees jaisa hi hai: "Allah us shakhs ki dekhbhaal karta hai jo Allah ki raah mein nikalta hai" lekin in alfaazon mein khatam hota hai: "Main kisi bhi muhim se peeche nahi rahta jo Allah, Buland-o-Azeem, ki raah mein larne ke liye undertaken ki jaati hai."

33.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ الأَحْمَرُ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، وَحُمَيْدٍ،
 عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ مَا مِنْ نَفْسٍ تَمُوتُ لَهَا عِنْدَ
 اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ يَسُرُّهَا أَنَّهَا تَرْجِعُ إِلَى الدُّنْيَا وَلاَ أَنَّ لَهَا الدُّنْيَا وَمَا فِيهَا إِلاَّ الشَّهِيدُ فَإِنَّهُ يَتَمَنَّى
 أَنْ يَرْجِعَ فَيُقْتَلَ فِي الدُّنْيَا لِمَا يَرَى مِنْ فَضْلِ الشَّهَادَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: " Nobody who dies and has something good for him with Allah will (ever like to) return to this world even though he were offered the whole world and all that is in its (as an inducement), except the martyr who desires to return and be killed in the world for the (great) merit of martyrdom that he has seen.
33.hi: Anas bin Malik ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: "Koi bhi jo marta hai aur uske liye Allah ke paas kuch achha hai, woh (kabhi) is duniya mein wapas nahi aana chaahega chahe use poori duniya aur usmein jo kuch hai woh sab pesh kiya jaaye (protsaahan ke soorat mein), siwaay shaheed ke jo wapas aana aur duniya mein qatal hona chaahta hai shahaadat ke (bade) ahmiyat ke liye jo usne dekha hai.

33.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ،
 عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ مَا
 مِنْ أَحَدٍ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ يُحِبُّ أَنْ يَرْجِعَ إِلَى الدُّنْيَا وَأَنَّ لَهُ مَا عَلَى الأَرْضِ مِنْ شَىْءٍ غَيْرُ الشَّهِيدِ
 فَإِنَّهُ يَتَمَنَّى أَنْ يَرْجِعَ فَيُقْتَلَ عَشْرَ مَرَّاتٍ لِمَا يَرَى مِنَ الْكَرَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik (through a different chain of transmitters) that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Nobody who enters Paradise will (ever like to) return to this world even if he were offered everything on the surface of the earth (as an inducement) except the martyr who will desire to return to this world and be killed ten times for the sake of the great honour that has been bestowed upon him.
33.hi: Anas bin Malik ke hawale se (ek doosri sanad ke zariye) ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Koi bhi jo Jannat mein daakhil hota hai woh (kabhi) is duniya mein wapas nahi aana chaahega chahe use zameen ki satah par har cheez pesh ki jaaye (protsaahan ke soorat mein) siwaay shaheed ke jo is duniya mein wapas aana chaahega aur das baar qatal hona chaahega us bade samman ki khaatir jo unhe diya gaya hai.

33.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْوَاسِطِيُّ، عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي،
 صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قِيلَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا يَعْدِلُ الْجِهَادَ
 فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ تَسْتَطِيعُونَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَعَادُوا عَلَيْهِ مَرَّتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثًا
 كُلُّ ذَلِكَ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لاَ تَسْتَطِيعُونَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ فِي الثَّالِثَةِ ‏"‏ مَثَلُ الْمُجَاهِدِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ كَمَثَلِ
 الصَّائِمِ الْقَائِمِ الْقَانِتِ بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ لاَ يَفْتُرُ مِنْ صِيَامٍ وَلاَ صَلاَةٍ حَتَّى يَرْجِعَ الْمُجَاهِدُ فِي سَبِيلِ
 اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira who said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was asked: What deed could be an equivalent of Jihad in the way of Allah, the Almighty and Exalted? He answered: You do not have the strength to do that deed. The narrator said: They repeated the question twice or thrice. Every time he answered: You do not have the strength to do it. When the question was asked for the third time, he said: One who goes out for Jihad is like a person who keeps fasts, stands in prayer (constantly), (obeying) Allah's (behests contained in) the verses (of the Qur'an), and does not exhibit any lassitude in fasting and prayer until the Mujahid returns from Jihad in the way of Allah, the Exalted.
33.hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se poocha gaya: Kaunsa amal Allah, Sarvashaktimaan aur Buland-o-Azeem, ki raah mein Jihad ke barabar ho sakta hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Tum mein us amal ko karne ki taqat nahi hai. Raawi ne kaha: Unhone ye sawaal do ya teen baar dohraaya. Har baar unhone jawaab diya: Tum mein ise karne ki taqat nahi hai. Jab teesri baar sawaal poocha gaya, unhone kaha: Jo Jihad ke liye nikalta hai woh us shakhs jaisa hai jo (lagataar) roze rakhta hai, namaz mein khada hota hai, (Quran ki aayaton mein Allah ke hukumon ki) itaat karta hai, aur roza aur namaz mein koi thakaavat nahi dikhaata jab tak Mujahid Allah, Buland-o-Azeem, ki raah mein Jihad se wapas nahi aata.

33.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ،
 ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ
 ‏.‏
33.en: This tradition has been handed down through a different chain of transmitters.
33.hi: Ye riwayat ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

33.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي حَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو تَوْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ سَلاَّمٍ، عَنْ 
 زَيْدِ بْنِ سَلاَّمٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا سَلاَّمٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي النُّعْمَانُ بْنُ بَشِيرٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ عِنْدَ مِنْبَرِ رَسُولِ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مَا أُبَالِي أَنْ لاَ أَعْمَلَ عَمَلاً بَعْدَ الإِسْلاَمِ إِلاَّ أَنْ أُسْقِيَ
 الْحَاجَّ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ آخَرُ مَا أُبَالِي أَنْ لاَ أَعْمَلَ عَمَلاً بَعْدَ الإِسْلاَمِ إِلاَّ أَنْ أَعْمُرَ الْمَسْجِدَ الْحَرَامَ
 ‏.‏ وَقَالَ آخَرُ الْجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ أَفْضَلُ مِمَّا قُلْتُمْ ‏.‏ فَزَجَرَهُمْ عُمَرُ وَقَالَ لاَ تَرْفَعُوا أَصْوَاتَكُمْ
 عِنْدَ مِنْبَرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ يَوْمُ الْجُمُعَةِ وَلَكِنْ إِذَا صَلَّيْتُ الْجُمُعَةَ دَخَلْتُ
 فَاسْتَفْتَيْتُهُ فِيمَا اخْتَلَفْتُمْ فِيهِ ‏.‏ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏ أَجَعَلْتُمْ سِقَايَةَ الْحَاجِّ وَعِمَارَةَ الْمَسْجِدِ
 الْحَرَامِ كَمَنْ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ‏}‏ الآيَةَ إِلَى آخِرِهَا ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Nu'man b. Bashir who said: As I was (sitting) near the pulpit of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), a man said: I do not care if, after embracing Islam, I do not do any good deed (except) distributing drinking water among the pilgrims. Another said: I do not care if, after embracing Islam, I do not do any good deed beyond maintenance service to the Sacred Mosque. Another said: Jihad in the way of Allah is better than what you have said. 'Umar reprimanded them and said: Don't raise your voices near the pulpit of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on Friday. When prayer was over, I entered (the apartment of the Holy Prophet) and asked his verdict about the matter in which they had differed. (It was upon this that) Allah, the Almighty and Exalted, revealed the Qur'anic verse:" Do you make the giving of drinking water to the pilgrims and the maintenance of the Sacred Mosque equal to (the service of those) who believe in Allah and the Last Day and strive hard in the cause of Allah. They are not equal in the sight of God. And Allah guides not the wrongdoing people" (ix. 20).
33.hi: Nu'man bin Bashir ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Jab main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke mimbar ke qareeb (baitha) tha, ek shakhs ne kaha: Mujhe koi parvaah nahi agar, Islam qubool karne ke baad, main koi achha amal nahi karta (siwaay) haajiyon ke beech peene ka paani baantne ke. Doosre ne kaha: Mujhe koi parvaah nahi agar, Islam qubool karne ke baad, main koi achha amal nahi karta siwaay Muqaddas Masjid ki dekhbhaal ki sewa ke. Doosre ne kaha: Allah ki raah mein Jihad tumhare kahe se behtar hai. Umar ne unhe daanta aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke mimbar ke qareeb juma ke din apni aawaazein buland mat karo. Jab namaz khatm hui, main (Nabi-e-Paak ke kamre mein) daakhil hua aur unse us maamle par unka faisla poocha jismein woh muttafiq nahi the. (Isi par) Allah, Sarvashaktimaan aur Buland-o-Azeem, ne Qurani aayat nazil ki: "Kya tum haajiyon ko peene ka paani dene aur Muqaddas Masjid ki dekhbhaal ko unke (sewa) ke barabar maante ho jo Allah aur Aakhri Din par imaan rakhte hain aur Allah ki raah mein poori koshish karte hain. Woh Allah ki nazar mein barabar nahi hain. Aur Allah anyaaykaari logon ko margdarshan nahi deta" (9:20).

33.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ،
 أَخْبَرَنِي زَيْدٌ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا سَلاَّمٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي النُّعْمَانُ بْنُ بَشِيرٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ عِنْدَ مِنْبَرِ رَسُولِ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ أَبِي تَوْبَةَ ‏.‏
33.en: This tradition has been narrated on the authority of Nu'man b. Bashir through another chain of transmitters.
33.hi: Ye hadees Nu'man bin Bashir ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

33.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ،
 بْنِ مَالِكٍ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ لَغَدْوَةٌ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ أَوْ رَوْحَةٌ خَيْرٌ
 مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا فِيهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Leaving (for Jihad) in the way of Allah in the morning or in the evening (will merit a reward) better than the world and all that is in it.
33.hi: Anas bin Malik ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Allah ki raah mein subah ya shaam nikalna (sawaab ke laayak hai jo) duniya aur usmein jo kuch hai usse behtar hai.

33.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سَهْلِ،
 بْنِ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيِّ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ وَالْغَدْوَةَ يَغْدُوهَا الْعَبْدُ
 فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا فِيهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Sahl b. Sa'd as-Sa'idi that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The journey undertaken by a person in the morning (for Jihad) in the way of Allah (will merit a reward) better than the world and all that is in it.
33.hi: Sahl bin Sa'd as-Sa'idi ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Kisi shakhs ke zariye subah undertaken ki gayi safar (Jihad ke liye) Allah ki raah mein (sawaab ke laayak hai jo) duniya aur usmein jo kuch hai usse behtar hai.

33.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ،
 عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيِّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ غَدْوَةٌ
 أَوْ رَوْحَةٌ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا فِيهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Sahl b. Sa'd as-Sa'idi that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: A journey undertaken in the morning or evening (fond Jihad) in the way of Allah (will merit a reward) better than the world and all that is in it.
33.hi: Sahl bin Sa'd as-Sa'idi ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Subah ya shaam ko undertaken ki gayi ek safar (Jihad ke liye) Allah ki raah mein (sawaab ke laayak hai jo) duniya aur usmein jo kuch hai usse behtar hai.

33.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ ذَكْوَانَ،
 بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَوْلاَ أَنَّ رِجَالاً
 مِنْ أُمَّتِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ وَقَالَ فِيهِ ‏"‏ وَلَرَوْحَةٌ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ أَوْ غَدْوَةٌ خَيْرٌ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا
 وَمَا فِيهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: If some persons of my Umma (were not to undertake the hardships of Jihad), and he (Abu Huraira) then narrated the rest of the hadith and then said: A journey undertaken for jihad in the evening or morning merits a reward better than the world and all that is in it.
33.hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Agar meri Ummat ke kuch log (Jihad ki mushkilon ka bhaar undertaken karne se) na katraate, aur unhone (Abu Huraira ne) phir hadees ka baaki hissa riwayat kiya aur phir kaha: Shaam ya subah undertaken ki gayi Jihad ki safar ka sawaab duniya aur usmein jo kuch hai usse behtar hai.

33.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ
 لأَبِي بَكْرٍ وَإِسْحَاقَ - قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ حَدَّثَنَا الْمُقْرِئُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ
 عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ حَدَّثَنِي شُرَحْبِيلُ بْنُ شَرِيكٍ الْمَعَافِرِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحُبُلِيِّ
 قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا أَيُّوبَ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ غَدْوَةٌ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ
 أَوْ رَوْحَةٌ خَيْرٌ مِمَّا طَلَعَتْ عَلَيْهِ الشَّمْسُ وَغَرَبَتْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Ayyub that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: A journey undertaken in the morning or evening (for Jihad) in the way of Allah is better than (anything) on which the sun rises or sets.
33.hi: Abu Ayyub ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Subah ya shaam undertaken ki gayi safar (Jihad ke liye) Allah ki raah mein us cheez se behtar hai jispar suraj uthta ya dubta hai.

33.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ قُهْزَاذَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ،
 أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ، وَحَيْوَةُ بْنُ شُرَيْحٍ، قَالَ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا حَدَّثَنِي شُرَحْبِيلُ بْنُ،
 شَرِيكٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحُبُلِيِّ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا أَيُّوبَ الأَنْصَارِيَّ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ سَوَاءً ‏.‏
33.en: This tradition has been narrated on the authority of Abu Ayyub through a different chain of transmitters having the same wording.
33.hi: Ye riwayat Abu Ayyub ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se isi alfaazon ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

33.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو هَانِئٍ الْخَوْلاَنِيُّ،
 عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحُبُلِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 قَالَ ‏"‏ يَا أَبَا سَعِيدٍ مَنْ رَضِيَ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا وَبِالإِسْلاَمِ دِينًا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيًّا وَجَبَتْ لَهُ الْجَنَّةُ
 ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَعَجِبَ لَهَا أَبُو سَعِيدٍ فَقَالَ أَعِدْهَا عَلَىَّ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَفَعَلَ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَأُخْرَى يُرْفَعُ
 بِهَا الْعَبْدُ مِائَةَ دَرَجَةٍ فِي الْجَنَّةِ مَا بَيْنَ كُلِّ دَرَجَتَيْنِ كَمَا بَيْنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالأَرْضِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ
 وَمَا هِيَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ الْجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ الْجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Sa`id al-Khudri that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said (to him): Abu Sa`id, whoever cheerfully accepts Allah as his Lord, Islam as his religion and Muhammad as his Apostle is necessarily entitled to enter Paradise. He (Abu Sa`id) wondered at it and said: Messenger of Allah, repeat it for me. He (the Messenger of Allah) did that and said: There is another act which elevates the position of a man in Paradise to a grade one hundred (higher), and the elevation between one grade and the other is equal to the height of the heaven from the earth. He (Abu Sa`id) said: What is that act? He replied: Jihad in the way of Allah! Jihad in the way of Allah!
33.hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (unse) kaha: Abu Sa'id, jo koi khushi se Allah ko apna Rab, Islam ko apna deen, aur Muhammad ko apna Rasool maanta hai woh zaroor Jannat mein daakhil hoga. Unhone (Abu Sa'id ne) isse hairat kiya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ise mere liye dohraiye. Unhone (Allah ke Rasool ne) aisa kiya aur kaha: Ek aur amal hai jo Jannat mein aadmi ki haalat ko sau (uchhi) darjon tak uThAta hai, aur ek darje aur doosre ke beech utna hi antar hai jitna zameen se aasmaan ki oonchai. Unhone (Abu Sa'id ne) poocha: Woh amal kya hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Allah ki raah mein Jihad! Allah ki raah mein Jihad!

33.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي،
 قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَهُ يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَامَ فِيهِمْ
 فَذَكَرَ لَهُمْ ‏"‏ أَنَّ الْجِهَادَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَالإِيمَانَ بِاللَّهِ أَفْضَلُ الأَعْمَالِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَامَ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ
 يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ قُتِلْتُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ تُكَفَّرُ عَنِّي خَطَايَاىَ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ نَعَمْ إِنْ قُتِلْتَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَأَنْتَ صَابِرٌ مُحْتَسِبٌ مُقْبِلٌ غَيْرُ مُدْبِرٍ ‏"‏
 ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ كَيْفَ قُلْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ قُتِلْتُ فِي سَبِيلِ
 اللَّهِ أَتُكَفَّرُ عَنِّي خَطَايَاىَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ نَعَمْ وَأَنْتَ صَابِرٌ مُحْتَسِبٌ
 مُقْبِلٌ غَيْرُ مُدْبِرٍ إِلاَّ الدَّيْنَ فَإِنَّ جِبْرِيلَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ لِي ذَلِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Qatada that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) stood up among them (his Companions) to deliver his sermon in which he told them that Jihad in the way of Allah and belief in Allah (with all His Attributes) are the most meritorious of acts. A man stood up and said: Messenger of Allah, do you think that if I am killed in the way of Allah, my sins will be blotted out from me? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Yes, in case you are killed in the way of Allah and you were patient and sincere and you always fought facing the enemy, never turming your back upon him. Then he added: What have you said (now)? (Wishing to have further assurance from him for his satisfaction), he asked (again): Do you think if I am killed in the way of Allah, all my sins will be obliterated from me? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Yes, it you were patient and sincere and always fought facing the enemy and never turning your back upon him, (all your lapses would be forgiven) except debt. Gabriel has told me this.
33.hi: Abu Qatada ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unke (apne sahaba ke) beech khutba dene khade hue jismein unhone unhe bataya ki Allah ki raah mein Jihad aur Allah par imaan (Uske saare Gunon ke saath) sabse punyapurna amal hain. Ek shakhs khada hua aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aapko kya lagta hai agar main Allah ki raah mein qatal kiya jaaun, kya mere gunah mujhse mit jaayenge? Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Haan, agar tum Allah ki raah mein qatal kiye jaate ho aur tum sabar aur eemaandaar rahe aur tum hamesha dushman ka saamna karte hue lade, kabhi apni peeth na mode. Phir unhone izafa kiya: Tumne (ab) kya kaha? (Unse aur bharosa paane ki khwaish karte hue apni santushti ke liye), unhone (phir) poocha: Aapko kya lagta hai agar main Allah ki raah mein qatal kiya jaaun, kya mere sab gunah mujhse mit jaayenge? Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Haan, agar tum sabar aur eemaandaar the aur hamesha dushman ka saamna karte hue lade aur kabhi apni peeth nahi modi, (tumhari saari galtiyaan maaf ho jaayengi) siwaay karze ke. Jibril ne mujhe ye bataya hai.

33.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَخْبَرَنَا 
 يَحْيَى، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَعِيدٍ - عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ،
 عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ قُتِلْتُ فِي
 سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ اللَّيْثِ ‏.‏
33.en: The tradition has been narrated through a different chain of transmitters on the authority of Abu Qatada who said: A man came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) while he was on the pulpit and said: Do you think if I am killed in the way of Allah... (except this difference in its beginning, the rest of the tradition is the same as the previous one).
33.hi: Ye riwayat ek doosri sanad ke zariye Abu Qatada ke hawale se riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya jab woh mimbar par the aur kaha: Aapko kya lagta hai agar main Allah ki raah mein qatal kiya jaaun... (iski shuruaat mein ye antar chhodkar, baaki riwayat pichhli jaisi hi hai).

33.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ،
 ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَجْلاَنَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ،
 عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَزِيدُ أَحَدُهُمَا عَلَى صَاحِبِهِ أَنَّ رَجُلاً أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله
 عليه وسلم وَهُوَ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ فَقَالَ أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ ضَرَبْتُ بِسَيْفِي ‏.‏ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ ‏.‏
33.en: Another version of the tradition differently transmitted begins with the words: " A man came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he was sitting on the pulpit.... He said: What do you find if I strike with the sword?" (The rest of the tradition is the same as the previous one.)
33.hi: Riwayat ka doosra soorat, jise alag tarike se riwayat kiya gaya hai, in alfaazon se shuru hota hai: "Ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur woh mimbar par baithe the.... Unhone kaha: Aapko kya lagta hai agar main talwaar se maarun?" (Baaki riwayat pichhli jaisi hi hai.)

33.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ بْنُ يَحْيَى بْنِ صَالِحٍ الْمِصْرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُفَضَّلُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ فَضَالَةَ
 - عَنْ عَيَّاشٍ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ الْقِتْبَانِيُّ - عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحُبُلِيِّ،
 عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ يُغْفَرُ لِلشَّهِيدِ
 كُلُّ ذَنْبٍ إِلاَّ الدَّيْنَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been reported on the authority of 'Amr b. al-'As that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: All the sins of a Shahid (martyr) are forgiven except debt.
33.hi: Amr bin al-As ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ek Shahid (shaheed) ke sab gunah maaf kar diye jaate hain siwaay karze ke.

33.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْمُقْرِئُ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي،
 أَيُّوبَ حَدَّثَنِي عَيَّاشُ بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ الْقِتْبَانِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحُبُلِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ،
 عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ الْقَتْلُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ يُكَفِّرُ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ
 إِلاَّ الدَّيْنَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been reported on the authority of Amr b. al-'As through a different chain of transmitters that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Death in the way of Allah blots out everything except debt.
33.hi: Amr bin al-As ke hawale se ek doosri sanad ke zariye ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Allah ki raah mein maut sab kuch mita deti hai siwaay karze ke.

33.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا 
 إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، وَعِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا 
 مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا أَسْبَاطٌ، وَأَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ،
 عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، قَالَ سَأَلْنَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ عَنْ هَذِهِ الآيَةِ، ‏{‏ وَلاَ تَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِينَ قُتِلُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ أَمْوَاتًا بَلْ أَحْيَاءٌ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ يُرْزَقُونَ‏}‏ قَالَ أَمَا إِنَّا قَدْ سَأَلْنَا عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَرْوَاحُهُمْ فِي جَوْفِ طَيْرٍ خُضْرٍ لَهَا قَنَادِيلُ مُعَلَّقَةٌ بِالْعَرْشِ تَسْرَحُ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ حَيْثُ شَاءَتْ ثُمَّ تَأْوِي إِلَى تِلْكَ الْقَنَادِيلِ فَاطَّلَعَ إِلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُمُ اطِّلاَعَةً فَقَالَ هَلْ تَشْتَهُونَ شَيْئًا قَالُوا أَىَّ شَىْءٍ نَشْتَهِي وَنَحْنُ نَسْرَحُ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ حَيْثُ شِئْنَا فَفَعَلَ ذَلِكَ بِهِمْ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ فَلَمَّا
 رَأَوْا أَنَّهُمْ لَنْ يُتْرَكُوا مِنْ أَنْ يُسْأَلُوا قَالُوا يَا رَبِّ نُرِيدُ أَنْ تَرُدَّ أَرْوَاحَنَا فِي أَجْسَادِنَا حَتَّى نُقْتَلَ فِي سَبِيلِكَ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا رَأَى أَنْ لَيْسَ لَهُمْ حَاجَةٌ تُرِكُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Masruq Who said: We asked 'Abdullah about the Qur'anic verse:" Think not of those who are slain in Allah's way as dead. Nay, they are alive, finding their sustenance in the presence of their Lord.." (iii. 169). He said: We asked the meaning of the verse (from the Holy Prophet) who said: The souls, of the martyrs live in the bodies of green birds who have their nests in chandeliers hung from the throne of the Almighty. They eat the fruits of Paradise from wherever they like and then nestle in these chandeliers. Once their Lord cast a glance at them and said: Do ye want anything? They said: What more shall we desire? We eat the fruit of Paradise from wherever we like. Their Lord asked them the same question thrice. When they saw that they will continue to be asked and not left (without answering the question). they said: O Lord, we wish that Thou mayest return our souls to our bodies so that we may be slain in Thy way once again. When He (Allah) saw that they had no need, they were left (to their joy in heaven).
33.hi: Masruq ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Humne Abdullah se Qurani aayat ke baare mein poocha: "Un logon ko murda mat samjho jo Allah ki raah mein maare gaye hain. Nahi, woh zinda hain, apne Rab ke saamne rozi paate hue.." (3:169). Unhone kaha: Humne (Nabi-e-Paak se) is aayat ka matlab poocha, aur unhone kaha: Shaheedon ki roohein hare parindon ke badan mein zinda hain jinke ghosle Sarvashaktimaan ke singhaasan se latke jhaad-fanoos mein hain. Woh Jannat ke phal khaate hain jahan se woh chaahein aur phir in jhaad-fanoos mein baste hain. Ek baar unke Rab ne unpar nazar daali aur kaha: Kya tumhe kuch chahiye? Unhone kaha: Hum aur kya chaahein? Hum Jannat ke phal khaate hain jahan se hum chaahein. Unke Rab ne unse yahi sawaal teen baar poocha. Jab unhone dekha ki unse baar-baar poocha jaayega aur unhe (jawaab diye bina) nahi chhoDa jaayega, unhone kaha: Aye Rab, humari khwaish hai ki Tu humari roohein humare badan mein wapas de taaki hum dobara Teri raah mein qatal ho sakein. Jab Unhone (Allah ne) dekha ki unhe kisi cheez ki zaroorat nahi hai, unhe (unki jannat mein khushi mein) chhoD diya gaya.

33.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورُ بْنُ أَبِي مُزَاحِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ الزُّبَيْدِيِّ،
 عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ اللَّيْثِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ أَىُّ النَّاسِ أَفْضَلُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ رَجُلٌ يُجَاهِدُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ بِمَالِهِ وَنَفْسِهِ
 ‏"‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ مَنْ قَالَ ‏"‏ مُؤْمِنٌ فِي شِعْبٍ مِنَ الشِّعَابِ يَعْبُدُ اللَّهَ رَبَّهُ وَيَدَعُ النَّاسَ مِنْ شَرِّهِ
 ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Sa'id Khudri that a man came to the Prophet (may peace he upon him) and said: Who is the best of men? He replied: A man who fights in the way of Allah spending his wealth and staking his life. The man then asked: Who is next to him (in excellence)? He said: Next to him is a believer who lives in a mountain gorge worshipping hid Lord and sparing men from his mischief.
33.hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki ek shakhs Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Insaanon mein sabse behtareen kaun hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Ek aadmi jo Allah ki raah mein larta hai apni daulat kharch karke aur apni jaan daav par lagaakar. Us aadmi ne phir poocha: Unke baad kaun hai (fazeelat mein)? Unhone kaha: Unke baad ek imaandaar hai jo ek pahaadi khaai mein rehta hai apne Rab ki ibadat karte hue aur logon ko apni shararat se bachaate hue.

33.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ،
 بْنِ يَزِيدَ اللَّيْثِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَجُلٌ أَىُّ النَّاسِ أَفْضَلُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ مُؤْمِنٌ
 يُجَاهِدُ بِنَفْسِهِ وَمَالِهِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ مَنْ قَالَ ‏"‏ ثُمَّ رَجُلٌ مُعْتَزِلٌ فِي شِعْبٍ مِنَ
 الشِّعَابِ يَعْبُدُ رَبَّهُ وَيَدَعُ النَّاسَ مِنْ شَرِّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated (through a diferent chain of transmetters) on the same authority (i. e. Abu Sa'id Khadri) who said: A man asked: Messenger of Allah, which of men is the best? He said: A believer who fights staking his life and spending his wealth in the way of Allah. He asked: Who is next to him (in excellence)? He said: Next to him is a man who lives an isolated life in a mountain gorge, worshipping his Lord and sparing men from his mischief.
33.hi: (Ek doosri sanad ke zariye) Usi raawi (yaani Abu Sa'id Khadri) ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Ek shakhs ne poocha: Allah ke Rasool, insaanon mein kaun sabse behtareen hai? Unhone kaha: Ek imaandaar jo apni jaan daav par lagaakar aur Allah ki raah mein apni daulat kharch karke larta hai. Unhone poocha: Unke baad kaun hai (fazeelat mein)? Unhone kaha: Unke baad ek aadmi hai jo ek pahaadi khaai mein alag-thalag zindagi jeeta hai, apne Rab ki ibadat karte hue aur logon ko apni shararat se bachaate hue.

33.ar: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، عَنِ الأَوْزَاعِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ وَرَجُلٌ فِي شِعْبٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ ‏"‏ ثُمَّ رَجُلٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: A version of the tradition narrated on the authority of Ibn Shihab has a little differently worded ending. i. e." A man in a mountain valley." but did not mention" next to him a man who...."
33.hi: Ibn Shihab ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi riwayat ka ek soorat thoda halke alfaazon mein khatm hota hai, yaani "Ek aadmi ek pahaadi wadi mein." lekin "unke baad ek aadmi jo...." ka zikr nahi kiya.

33.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ 
 بَعْجَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏
"‏ مِنْ خَيْرِ مَعَاشِ
 النَّاسِ لَهُمْ رَجُلٌ مُمْسِكٌ عِنَانَ فَرَسِهِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ يَطِيرُ عَلَى مَتْنِهِ كُلَّمَا سَمِعَ هَيْعَةً أَوْ
 فَزْعَةً طَارَ عَلَيْهِ يَبْتَغِي الْقَتْلَ وَالْمَوْتَ مَظَانَّهُ أَوْ رَجُلٌ فِي غُنَيْمَةٍ فِي رَأْسِ شَعَفَةٍ مِنْ هَذِهِ
 الشَّعَفِ أَوْ بَطْنِ وَادٍ مِنْ هَذِهِ الأَوْدِيَةِ يُقِيمُ الصَّلاَةَ وَيُؤْتِي الزَّكَاةَ وَيَعْبُدُ رَبَّهُ حَتَّى يَأْتِيَهُ الْيَقِينُ
 لَيْسَ مِنَ النَّاسِ إِلاَّ فِي خَيْرٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Of the men he lives the best life who holds the reins of his horse (ever ready to march) in the way of Allah, flies on its back whenever he hears a fearful shriek, or a call for help, flies to it seeking death at places where it can be expected. (Next to him) is a man who lives with his sheep at a hill-top or in a valley, says his prayers regularly, gives Zakat and worships his Lord until death comes to him. There is no better person among men except these two.
33.hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Insaanon mein sabse achhi zindagi woh jeeta hai jo apne ghode ki lagaam pakde rehta hai (hamesha march karne ke liye taiyaar) Allah ki raah mein, uski peeth par udta hai jab bhi woh koi bhayaanak chillaahat, ya madad ki pukaar sunta hai, use maut ki taraf udta hai un jagahon par jahan iski ummeed ki jaa sakti hai. (Unke baad) ek aadmi hai jo apni bhedon ke saath ek pahaadi ki chotti par ya wadi mein rehta hai, muqarrar soorat se apni namaz padhta hai, Zakat deta hai aur apne Rab ki ibadat karta hai yahan tak ki use maut aati hai. In do logon ke ilawa insaanon mein koi behtareen shakhs nahi hai.

33.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، وَيَعْقُوبُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ
 عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْقَارِيَّ - كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ وَقَالَ عَنْ بَعْجَةَ بْنِ،
 عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بَدْرٍ وَقَالَ ‏
"‏ فِي شِعْبَةٍ مِنْ هَذِهِ الشِّعَابِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ خِلاَفَ رِوَايَةِ يَحْيَى ‏.‏
33.en: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Huraira with a slight variation of wording.
33.hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

33.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ،
 عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ بَعْجَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْجُهَنِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله
 عليه وسلم بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ أَبِي حَازِمٍ عَنْ بَعْجَةَ وَقَالَ ‏
"‏ فِي شِعْبٍ مِنَ الشِّعَابِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: Two more versions of the tradition narrated by 'Abdullah b. Badr and Abu Huraira, respectively, have been handed down through different chains of transmitters with negligible difference in the wording.
33.hi: Riwayat ke do aur soorat, jo kramashah Abdullah bin Badr aur Abu Huraira ke zariye riwayat kiye gaye hain, mukhtalif sanadon ke zariye alfaazon mein mamuli antar ke saath riwayat kiye gaye hain.

33.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ الْمَكِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ 
 أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ يَضْحَكُ اللَّهُ إِلَى رَجُلَيْنِ يَقْتُلُ أَحَدُهُمَا
 الآخَرَ كِلاَهُمَا يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا كَيْفَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ يُقَاتِلُ هَذَا فِي سَبِيلِ
 اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ فَيُسْتَشْهَدُ ثُمَّ يَتُوبُ اللَّهُ عَلَى الْقَاتِلِ فَيُسْلِمُ فَيُقَاتِلُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ
 فَيُسْتَشْهَدُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: God laughs at the two men both of whom will enter Paradise (though) one of them kills the other. They said: Messenger of Allah, how is it? He said: One of them fights in the way of Allah, the Almighty and Exalted. and dies a martyr. Then God turns in mercy to the murderer who embraces Islam, fights in the way of Allah, the Almighty and Exalted, and dies a martyr.
33.hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Allah do aadmiyon par hansta hai jinmein se donon Jannat mein daakhil honge (halaanki) unmein se ek doosre ko qatal karta hai. Unhone (poochha): Allah ke Rasool, ye kaise? Unhone kaha: Unmein se ek Allah, Sarvashaktimaan aur Buland-o-Azeem, ki raah mein larta hai, aur ek shaheed ke soorat mein marta hai. Phir Allah rehmat mein qaatil ki taraf mudta hai jo Islam qubool karta hai, Allah, Sarvashaktimaan aur Buland-o-Azeem, ki raah mein larta hai, aur ek shaheed ke soorat mein marta hai.

33.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ،
 عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
33.en: The same tradition has been narrated on the authority of Abu Zinad (with the same chain of transmitters).
33.hi: Yehi riwayat Abu Zinad ki sanad se (isi sanad se) riwayat ki gayi hai.

33.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، قَالَ
 هَذَا مَا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ أَحَادِيثَ مِنْهَا وَقَالَ
 رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَضْحَكُ اللَّهُ لِرَجُلَيْنِ يَقْتُلُ أَحَدُهُمَا الآخَرَ كِلاَهُمَا يَدْخُلُ
 الْجَنَّةَ ‏"‏ قَالُوا كَيْفَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ يُقْتَلُ هَذَا فَيَلِجُ الْجَنَّةَ ثُمَّ يَتُوبُ اللَّهُ عَلَى الآخَرِ
 فَيَهْدِيهِ إِلَى الإِسْلاَمِ ثُمَّ يُجَاهِدُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَيُسْتَشْهَدُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been reported on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: God laughs at the two men one of whom kills the other; both of them will enter Paradise. They (the Companions) said: How, Messenger of Allah? He said: One is slain (in the way of Allah) and enters Paradise. Then God forgives the other and guides him to Islam; then he fights in the way of Allah and dies a martyr.
33.hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Allah do aadmiyon par hansta hai jinmein se ek doosre ko qatal karta hai; donon Jannat mein daakhil honge. Unhone (sahaba ne) kaha: Kaise, Allah ke Rasool? Unhone kaha: Ek qatal kiya jaata hai (Allah ki raah mein) aur Jannat mein daakhil hota hai. Phir Allah doosre ko maaf karta hai aur use Islam ki taraf margdarshit karta hai; phir woh Allah ki raah mein larta hai aur shaheed ke soorat mein marta hai.

33.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - يَعْنُونَ
 ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ
 ‏
"‏ لاَ يَجْتَمِعُ كَافِرٌ وَقَاتِلُهُ فِي النَّارِ أَبَدًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger Allah (ﷺ) said: A disbeliever and a believer who killed him will never be gathered together in Hell.
33.hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ek kaafir aur woh imaandaar jisne use qatal kiya, kabhi bhi Jahannam mein ikattha nahi honge.

33.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَوْنٍ الْهِلاَلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ الْفَزَارِيُّ، إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ
 عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ يَجْتَمِعَانِ فِي النَّارِ اجْتِمَاعًا يَضُرُّ أَحَدُهُمَا الآخَرَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قِيلَ مَنْ هُمْ يَا رَسُولَ
 اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ مُؤْمِنٌ قَتَلَ كَافِرًا ثُمَّ سَدَّدَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: No two such persons shall be together in Hell as if one of them is such that his presence hurts the other. It was asked: Messenger of Allah, who are they? He said: A believer who killed a disbeliever and (then) kept to the right path."
33.hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Do aise log Jahannam mein saath nahi honge ki unmein se ek ki maujoodgi doosre ko dukh de. Poocha gaya: Allah ke Rasool, woh kaun hain? Unhone kaha: Ek imaandaar jisne ek kaafir ko qatal kiya aur (phir) sahi raah par chala.

33.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي عَمْرٍو،
 الشَّيْبَانِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ بِنَاقَةٍ مَخْطُومَةٍ فَقَالَ هَذِهِ فِي سَبِيلِ
 اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ لَكَ بِهَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ سَبْعُمِائَةِ نَاقِةٍ كُلُّهَا
 مَخْطُومَةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari who said A man brought a muzzled she-camel and said: It is (offered) in the way of Allah. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: For this you will have seven hundred she-camels on the Day of Judgment all of which will be muzzled.
33.hi: Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Ek shakhs ek naath waali oontni laaya aur kaha: Ye (Allah ki raah mein) pesh ki jaati hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Iske liye tumhe Qayamat ke din sat sau oontniyaan milengi, sab naath waali hongi.

33.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ زَائِدَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي بِشْرُ بْنُ،
 خَالِدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ
 ‏.‏
33.en: A similar tradition has been narrated on the authority of al-A'mash.
33.hi: Isi jaisi ek riwayat al-A'mash ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

33.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي كُرَيْبٍ
 - قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي عَمْرٍو الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ الأَنْصَارِيِّ،
 قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ إِنِّي أُبْدِعَ بِي فَاحْمِلْنِي فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا
 عِنْدِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَنَا أَدُلُّهُ عَلَى مَنْ يَحْمِلُهُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله
 عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ دَلَّ عَلَى خَيْرٍ فَلَهُ مِثْلُ أَجْرِ فَاعِلِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari who said: A man came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: My riding beast has been killed, so give me some animal to ride upon. He (the Holy Prophet) said: I have none with me. A man said: Messenger of Allah, I can guide him to one who will provide him with a riding beast. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: One who guides to something good has a reward similar to that of its doer.
33.hi: Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Meri sawaari waali jaanwar qatal ho gayi hai, is liye mujhe koi jaanwar dijiye sawaar hone ke liye. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Mere paas koi nahi hai. Ek shakhs ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, main use kisi aise shakhs tak margdarshit kar sakta hoon jo use sawaari waala jaanwar de. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jo kisi achhi cheez ki taraf margdarshit karta hai use uske karne wale jaisa hi sawaab milta hai.

33.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي بِشْرُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ،
 أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا 
 سُفْيَانُ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
33.en: The above tradition has been handed down through a different chain of transmitters.
33.hi: Upar wali riwayat ek doosri sanad ke zariye bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

33.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتٌ،
 عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، ح 
 وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا 
 ثَابِتٌ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ فَتًى، مِنْ أَسْلَمَ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي أُرِيدُ الْغَزْوَ وَلَيْسَ مَعِي
 مَا أَتَجَهَّزُ قَالَ ‏
"‏ ائْتِ فُلاَنًا فَإِنَّهُ قَدْ كَانَ تَجَهَّزَ فَمَرِضَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَتَاهُ فَقَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم يُقْرِئُكَ السَّلاَمَ وَيَقُولُ أَعْطِنِي الَّذِي تَجَهَّزْتَ بِهِ قَالَ يَا فُلاَنَةُ أَعْطِيهِ
 الَّذِي تَجَهَّزْتُ بِهِ وَلاَ تَحْبِسِي عَنْهُ شَيْئًا فَوَاللَّهِ لاَ تَحْبِسِي مِنْهُ شَيْئًا فَيُبَارَكَ لَكِ فِيهِ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik that a young man from Aslam tribe said: Messenger of Allah, I wish to fight (in the way of Allah) but I don't have anything to equip myself with for fighting. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Go to so and so, for he had equipped himself (for fighting) but he fell ill. So, he (the young man) went to him and said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sends you his greetings and says that you should give me the equipage that you have provided yourself with. The man said (to his wife or maidservant): So and so, give him the equipage I have collected for myself and do not withhold anything from him. Do not withhold anything from him so that you may be blessed therein.
33.hi: Anas bin Malik ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Aslam qabile ke ek jawaan shakhs ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, main (Allah ki raah mein) larna chahta hoon lekin mere paas larne ke liye khud ko lais karne ke liye kuch nahi hai. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Falan-falan ke paas jao, kyunki unhone apne aap ko (larne ke liye) taiyaar kiya tha lekin woh bimaar pad gaye. To, woh (jawaan shakhs) unke paas gaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aapko salaam bhejte hain aur kehte hain ki aapko mujhe woh saamaan dena chahiye jo aapne apne liye taiyaar kiya tha. Us shakhs ne (apni zauja ya laundi se) kaha: Falan-falan, unhe woh saamaan do jo maine apne liye ikattha kiya hai aur unse kuch mat rokna. Unse kuch mat rokna taaki tumhein isme barkat mile.

33.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، وَأَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، قَالَ أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، وَقَالَ،
 سَعِيدٌ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ الأَشَجِّ، عَنْ بُسْرِ،
 بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏
"‏ مَنْ
 جَهَّزَ غَازِيًا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَقَدْ غَزَا وَمَنْ خَلَفَهُ فِي أَهْلِهِ بِخَيْرٍ فَقَدْ غَزَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Zaid b. Khalid al-Juhani that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Anybody who equips a warrior (going to fight) in the way of Allah (is like one who actually) fights. And anybody who looks well after his family in his absence (is also like one who actually) fights.
33.hi: Zaid bin Khalid al-Juhani ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jo koi Allah ki raah mein (jung karne jaane wale) ek mujahid ko taiyaar karta hai (woh usi ke barabar hai jo waaqai) larta hai. Aur jo koi uski gairhaazri mein uske khaandaan ka achhi tarah khyaal rakhta hai (woh bhi usi ke barabar hai jo waaqai) larta hai.

33.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زُرَيْعٍ - حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنٌ،
 الْمُعَلِّمُ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ بُسْرِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ 
 زَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ مَنَ جَهَّزَ غَازِيًا فَقَدْ غَزَا
 وَمَنْ خَلَفَ غَازِيًا فِي أَهْلِهِ فَقَدْ غَزَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: The above tradition has been narrated on the authority of Khalid al- Juhani who said: The Prophet of Allah (ﷺ) said: He who equips a warrior in the way of Allah (is like one who dctually fights) aud he who looks after the family of a warrior in the way of Allah in fact participated in the battle.
33.hi: Upar wali riwayat Khalid al-Juhani ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Allah ke Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Jo Allah ki raah mein ek mujahid ko taiyaar karta hai (woh usi jaisa hai jo waaqai larta hai) aur jo Allah ki raah mein ek mujahid ke khaandaan ka khyaal rakhta hai woh waaqai mein jung mein hissa leta hai.

33.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ، حَدَّثَنَا 
 يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَعِيدٍ، مَوْلَى الْمَهْرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعَثَ بَعْثًا إِلَى بَنِي لِحْيَانَ - مِنْ هُذَيْلٍ - فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ لِيَنْبَعِثْ مِنْ كُلِّ
 رَجُلَيْنِ أَحَدُهُمَا وَالأَجْرُ بَيْنَهُمَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Sa'id Khudri that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent a force to Banu Lihyan (who are from Banu Hudhail, and said: One man from every two and the reward (will be divided) between the two.
