 السَّاعَةُ إِلاَّ عَلَى شِرَارِ الْخَلْقِ هُمْ شَرٌّ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ لاَ يَدْعُونَ اللَّهَ بِشَىْءٍ إِلاَّ رَدَّهُ
 عَلَيْهِمْ ‏.‏ فَبَيْنَمَا هُمْ عَلَى ذَلِكَ أَقْبَلَ عُقْبَةُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ فَقَالَ لَهُ مَسْلَمَةُ يَا عُقْبَةُ اسْمَعْ مَا يَقُولُ
 عَبْدُ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُقْبَةُ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ وَأَمَّا أَنَا فَسَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ
 ‏
"‏ لاَ تَزَالُ عِصَابَةٌ مِنْ أُمَّتِي يُقَاتِلُونَ عَلَى أَمْرِ اللَّهِ قَاهِرِينَ لِعَدُوِّهِمْ لاَ يَضُرُّهُمْ مَنْ خَالَفَهُمْ
 حَتَّى تَأْتِيَهُمُ السَّاعَةُ وَهُمْ عَلَى ذَلِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ أَجَلْ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ يَبْعَثُ اللَّهُ رِيحًا كَرِيحِ
 الْمِسْكِ مَسُّهَا مَسُّ الْحَرِيرِ فَلاَ تَتْرُكُ نَفْسًا فِي قَلْبِهِ مِثْقَالُ حَبَّةٍ مِنَ الإِيمَانِ إِلاَّ قَبَضَتْهُ ثُمَّ
 يَبْقَى شِرَارُ النَّاسِ عَلَيْهِمْ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated on the authority of 'Abd al-Rahman b. Shamasa al- Mahri who said: I was in the company of Maslama b. Mukhallad, and 'Abdullah b. 'Amr b. 'As was with him. 'Abdullah said: The Hour shall some oniy when the worst type of people are left on the earth. They will be worse than the people of pre-Islamic days. They will get whatever they ask of Allah. While we were yet sitting when 'Uqba b. 'Amir came, and Maslama said to him: 'Uqba, listen to what 'Abdullah says. 'Uqba said: He knows better; so far as I am concerned, I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: A group of people from my Umma will continue to fight in obedience to the Command of Allah, remaining dominant over their enemies. Those who will oppose them shall not do them any harm. They will remain ill this condition until the Hour overtakes them. (At this) 'Abdullah said: Yes. Then Allah will raise a wild which will be fragrant like musk and whose touch will be like the touch of silk; (but) it will cause the death of all (faithful) persons, not leaving behind a single person with an iota of faith in his heart. Then only the worst of men will remain to be overwhelmed by the Hour.
33.hi: Abd al-Rahman bin Shamasa al-Mahri ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Main Maslama bin Mukhallad ki sohbat mein tha, aur Abdullah bin Amr bin al-As unke saath the. Abdullah ne kaha: Ghadi (Qiyamat) tabhi aayegi jab zameen par sirf sabse buray kism ke log bache honge. Woh Islam-purv daur ke logon se bhi bure honge. Unhe woh sab kuch milega jo woh Allah se maangenge. Jab hum abhi baithe hue the ki Uqba bin Amir aaye, aur Maslama ne unse kaha: Uqba, suno Abdullah kya keh rahe hain. Uqba ne kaha: Woh behtar jaante hain; jahan tak mera sawal hai, maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Meri Ummat ke logon ka ek giroh Allah ke Hukum ki itaat mein larna jaari rakhega, apne dushmanon par haavi rehte hue. Jo unka virodh karenge woh unhe koi nuksaan nahi pahunchaayenge. Woh is haalat mein rahenge jab tak Ghadi unhe pakad na le. (Isper) Abdullah ne kaha: Haan. Phir Allah ek hawa uThAyega jo mushk jaisi khushboodaar hogi aur jiska sparsh resham ke sparsh jaisa hoga; (lekin) ye sab (imaandaar) logon ki maut ka wajah banegi, kisi bhi ek shakhs ko peeche na chhodte hue jiske dil mein imaan ki ek zarra bhi ho. Phir sirf sabse bure log bachenge jinhe Ghadi apne aagosh mein le legi.

33.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ،
 عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ لاَ يَزَالُ أَهْلُ الْغَرْبِ
 ظَاهِرِينَ عَلَى الْحَقِّ حَتَّى تَقُومَ السَّاعَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated by Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The people of the West will continue to triumphantly follow the truth until the Hour is established.
33.hi: Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Paschim ke log sach ka jeettA hua anusaran karna jaari rakhenge jab tak Ghadi sthapit nahi ho jaati.

33.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ
 قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ إِذَا سَافَرْتُمْ فِي الْخِصْبِ فَأَعْطُوا الإِبِلَ حَظَّهَا
 مِنَ الأَرْضِ وَإِذَا سَافَرْتُمْ فِي السَّنَةِ فَأَسْرِعُوا عَلَيْهَا السَّيْرَ وَإِذَا عَرَّسْتُمْ بِاللَّيْلِ فَاجْتَنِبُوا
 الطَّرِيقَ فَإِنَّهَا مَأْوَى الْهَوَامِّ بِاللَّيْلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When you journey through a fertile land, you should (go slow and) give the camels a chance to graze in the land. When you travel In an arid (land) where there is scarcity of vegetation, you should quicken their pace (lest your camels grow feeble and emaciated for lack of fodder). When you halt for the night, avoid (pitching your tent on) the road, for it is the abode of noxious little animals at night.
33.hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jab tum ek upjaau zameen se guzarte ho, tumhe (dheere jaana chahiye aur) oonton ko zameen mein charne ka mauka dena chahiye. Jab tum ek shushk (zameen) mein safar karte ho jahan vanaspati ki kami hai, tumhe unki raftaar tez karni chahiye (kahin tumhare oont chaare ki kami se kamzor aur dubla-patla ho jaayein). Jab tum raat ke liye rukte ho, raaste (par apna khaima gaadne) se bacho, kyunki ye raat mein haanikaarak choti jaanwaron ka basera hai.

33.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ - عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ 
 أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ إِذَا سَافَرْتُمْ فِي الْخِصْبِ
 فَأَعْطُوا الإِبِلَ حَظَّهَا مِنَ الأَرْضِ وَإِذَا سَافَرْتُمْ فِي السَّنَةِ فَبَادِرُوا بِهَا نِقَيَهَا وَإِذَا عَرَّسْتُمْ
 فَاجْتَنِبُوا الطَّرِيقَ فَإِنَّهَا طُرُقُ الدَّوَابِّ وَمَأْوَى الْهَوَامِّ بِاللَّيْلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated (through another chain of transmitters) on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: When you travel (through a land) where there is plenty of vegetation, you should (go slow and) give the camels a chance to enjoy the benefit of the earth. When you travel (through a land) where there is scarcity of vegetation, you should hasten with them (so that you may be able to cross that land while your animals ore still in a good condition of health). When you make a halt for the night, avoid (doing so on) the road, for the tracks are the pathways of wild beasts or the abode of noxious little animals.
33.hi: (Ek doosri sanad ke zariye) Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jab tum (aisi zameen mein) safar karte ho jahan bahut vanaspati hai, tumhe (dheere jaana chahiye aur) oonton ko zameen ka faayda lene ka mauka dena chahiye. Jab tum (aisi zameen mein) safar karte ho jahan vanaspati ki kami hai, tumhe unke saath jaldi karni chahiye (taaki tum us zameen ko paar kar sako jab tak tumhare jaanwar abhi bhi achhi sehat mein hain). Jab tum raat ke liye rukte ho, raaste par (aisa karne) se bacho, kyunki ye raaste jangli jaanwaron ke raaste hain ya haanikaarak choti jaanwaron ka basera hain.

33.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، وَإِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبِي أُوَيْسٍ، وَأَبُو مُصْعَبٍ
 الزُّهْرِيُّ وَمَنْصُورُ بْنُ أَبِي مُزَاحِمٍ وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى،
 بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - قَالَ قُلْتُ لِمَالِكٍ حَدَّثَكَ سُمَىٌّ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِي
 هُرَيْرَةَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ السَّفَرُ قِطْعَةٌ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ يَمْنَعُ أَحَدَكُمْ
 نَوْمَهُ وَطَعَامَهُ وَشَرَابَهُ فَإِذَا قَضَى أَحَدُكُمْ نَهْمَتَهُ مِنْ وَجْهِهِ فَلْيُعَجِّلْ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ
 ‏.‏
33.en: On the authority of Abu Huraira that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: Travelling is a tortuous experience. It deprives a person of his sleep. his food and drink. When one of you has accomplished his purpose, he should hasten his return to his family.
33.hi: Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Nabi (SAW) ne kaha: Safar ek pareshaani bhara tajurba hai. Ye insaan se uski neend, uska khaana aur peena chheen leti hai. Jab tum mein se koi apna maqsad poora kar leta hai, use apne khaandaan ke paas jaldi wapas jaana chahiye.

33.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، عَنْ هَمَّامٍ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ،
 بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ
 لاَ يَطْرُقُ أَهْلَهُ لَيْلاً وَكَانَ يَأْتِيهِمْ غُدْوَةً أَوْ عَشِيَّةً ‏.
33.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would not come (back) to his family by night. He would come to them in the morning or in the evening.
33.hi: Anas bin Malik ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) raat mein apne khaandaan ke paas (wapas) nahi aate the. Woh unke paas subah ya shaam ko aate the.

33.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا 
 إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ
 غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ كَانَ لاَ يَدْخُلُ ‏.
33.en: Another version of the tradition narrated on the same authority worded slightly differently. It says: (He) would not enter (upon his household at night).
33.hi: Isi raawi ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi riwayat ka doosra soorat alfaazon mein thoda alag hai. Ismein kaha gaya hai: (Woh) raat mein (apne khaandaan ke paas) daakhil nahi hote the.

33.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ سَالِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا سَيَّارٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى،
 - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ سَيَّارٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ
 رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي غَزَاةٍ فَلَمَّا قَدِمْنَا الْمَدِينَةَ ذَهَبْنَا لِنَدْخُلَ فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ أَمْهِلُوا
 حَتَّى نَدْخُلَ لَيْلاً - أَىْ عِشَاءً - كَىْ تَمْتَشِطَ الشَّعِثَةُ وَتَسْتَحِدَّ الْمُغِيبَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Jabir b. 'Abdullah who said: We accompanied the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on an expedition. When we came (back) to Medina and were going to enter our houses, he said: Wait and enter (your houses) in the later part of the evening so that a woman with dishevelled hair may have used the comb, and a woman whose husband has been away from home may have removed the hair from her private parts.
33.hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath ek muhim par gaye. Jab hum Madina (wapas) aaye aur apne gharon mein daakhil hone waale the, unhone kaha: Ruko aur shaam ke aakhri hisse mein daakhil ho taaki bikhre baalon waali aurat ne kangha kar liya ho, aur jis aurat ka shohar ghar se door raha ho usne apne guptaang ke baal hataa liye hon.

33.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سَيَّارٍ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ،
 عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ إِذَا قَدِمَ أَحَدُكُمْ لَيْلاً فَلاَ يَأْتِيَنَّ أَهْلَهُ
 طُرُوقًا حَتَّى تَسْتَحِدَّ الْمُغِيبَةُ وَتَمْتَشِطَ الشَّعِثَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated on the authority of Jabir that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: If one of you comes (back from a journey) at night. he should not enter his house as a night visitor (but should wait) until a woman whose husband has been away from house has removed the hair from her private parts and a woman with dishevelled hair has combed her hair.
33.hi: Jabir ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Agar tum mein se koi raat ko (safar se) wapas aata hai, use apne ghar mein raat ke mehmaan ki tarah daakhil nahi hona chahiye (balki intezaar karna chahiye) jab tak woh aurat jiska shohar ghar se door raha ho apne guptaang ke baal hataa na le aur bikhre baalon waali aurat ne apne baalon mein kangha na kar liya ho.

33.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا سَيَّارٌ، بِهَذَا
 الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
33.en: This tradition has been handed down through another chain of transmitters.
33.hi: Ye riwayat ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

33.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ 
 عَاصِمٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا
 أَطَالَ الرَّجُلُ الْغَيْبَةَ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ أَهْلَهُ طُرُوقًا ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated (through a different chain of tranmitters) on the authority of Jabir who said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade that a man who had long absent should come to his family like (an unexpected) night visitor.
33.hi: (Ek doosri sanad ke zariye) Jabir ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mana kiya ki ek aadmi jo lambe waqt se gair-haazir raha ho apne khaandaan ke paas (ek achaanak) raat ke mehmaan ki tarah aaye.

33.ar: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
33.en: The above tradition has been narrated through another chain of transmitters.
33.hi: Upar wali riwayat ek doosri sanad ke zariye bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

33.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ مُحَارِبٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ،
 قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَطْرُقَ الرَّجُلُ أَهْلَهُ لَيْلاً يَتَخَوَّنُهُمْ أَوْ يَلْتَمِسُ
 عَثَرَاتِهِمْ ‏.‏
33.en: It has been narrated (through a different chain of tranmitten) on the authority of Jabir who said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade that a man should come to his family like (an unexpected) night visitor doubting their fidelity and spying into their lapses.
33.hi: (Ek doosri sanad ke zariye) Jabir ke hawale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai jinhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mana kiya ki ek aadmi apne khaandaan ke paas ek (achaanak) raat ke mehmaan ki tarah aaye, unki wafadaari par shak karte hue aur unki khaamiyon ki jaasoosi karte hue.

33.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ قَالَ
 عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ لاَ أَدْرِي هَذَا فِي الْحَدِيثِ أَمْ لاَ ‏.‏ يَعْنِي أَنْ يَتَخَوَّنَهُمْ أَوْ يَلْتَمِسَ
 عَثَرَاتِهِمْ ‏.‏
33.en: This tradition has been reported through anothee chain.  'Abdurahman, one of the sub-narrators, said "I do not know if it in the hadith or not", meaning (the words) "doubting their fidelity and spying into their lapses."
33.hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai. Abdurahman, sanad ke ek raawi, ne kaha: "Mujhe nahi pata ki ye hadees mein hai ya nahi," unka matlab (in alfaazon se) tha "unki wafadaari par shak karte hue aur unki khaamiyon ki jaasoosi karte hue."

33.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ،
 حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي قَالاَ، جَمِيعًا حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مُحَارِبٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 بِكَرَاهَةِ الطُّرُوقِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ يَتَخَوَّنُهُمْ أَوْ يَلْتَمِسُ عَثَرَاتِهِمْ ‏.‏
33.en: A version of the tradition narrated on the authority of Jabir (but through a different chain of transmitters) mentions the undesirability of coining to one's house like a night visitor, but does not contain the words: " Doubting their fidelity or spying into their lapses."
33.hi: Jabir ki sanad se (lekin ek doosri sanad ke zariye) riwayat ki gayi riwayat ka ek soorat apne ghar mein raat ke mehmaan ki tarah aane ki napasandeegi ka zikr karta hai, lekin ismein ye alfaaz nahi hain: "Unki wafadaari par shak karte hue ya unki khaamiyon ki jaasoosi karte hue."

34.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ 
 هَمَّامِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ حَاتِمٍ، قَالَ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي أُرْسِلُ الْكِلاَبَ الْمُعَلَّمَةَ
 فَيُمْسِكْنَ عَلَىَّ وَأَذْكُرُ اسْمَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا أَرْسَلْتَ كَلْبَكَ الْمُعَلَّمَ وَذَكَرْتَ اسْمَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
 فَكُلْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ وَإِنْ قَتَلْنَ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَإِنْ قَتَلْنَ مَا لَمْ يَشْرَكْهَا كَلْبٌ لَيْسَ مَعَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ لَهُ فَإِنِّي
 أَرْمِي بِالْمِعْرَاضِ الصَّيْدَ فَأُصِيبُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا رَمَيْتَ بِالْمِعْرَاضِ فَخَزَقَ فَكُلْهُ وَإِنْ أَصَابَهُ
 بِعَرْضِهِ فَلاَ تَأْكُلْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
34.en: 'Adi b. Hatim reported: I said: Messenger of Allah, I set off trained dogs and they catch for me (the game) and I recite the name of Allah over it (I slaughter the game by reciting Bismillah-i-Allah-o-Akbar), whereupon he said: When you set off your trained dogs, if you recited the name of Allah (while setting them off), then eat (the game). I said: Even if they (the trained dogs) kill that (the game)? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Even if these kill, but (on the condition) that no other dog, which you did not set off (along with your dogs), participates (in catching the game). I said to him: I throw Mi'rad, a heavy featherless blunt arrow, for hunting and killing (the game). Thereupon he said: When you throw Mi'rad, and it pierces, then eat, but if it falls flatly (and beats the game to death), then do not eat that.
34.hi: Adi bin Hatim ne bayan kiya: Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, main apne sikhaaye hue kutte chhodta hoon aur woh mere liye (shikaar) pakadte hain aur main uspar Allah ka naam padhta hoon (main shikaar ko Bismillah-i-Allah-o-Akbar padhkar zibah karta hoon), isper unhone kaha: Jab tum apne sikhaaye hue kutte chhodte ho, agar tumne (unhe chhodte waqt) Allah ka naam liya, to (shikaar) khaao. Maine kaha: Chahe woh (sikhaaye hue kutte) use maar bhi dein? Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Chahe woh maar dein, lekin (is shart par) ki koi doosra kutta, jise tumne (apne kutton ke saath) na chhoda ho, shaamil na ho (shikaar pakadne mein). Maine unse kaha: Main shikaar ke liye Mi'rad, ek bhaari bina par ka kunda teer, phenkta hoon. Isper unhone kaha: Jab tum Mi'rad phenko, aur ye (shikaar ko) bhed de, to khaao, lekin agar ye chapte soorat mein gire (aur shikaar ko maar-maar kar maut de), to use mat khaao.

34.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنْ بَيَانٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ،
 بْنِ حَاتِمٍ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قُلْتُ إِنَّا قَوْمٌ نَصِيدُ بِهَذِهِ الْكِلاَبِ
 فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ إِذَا أَرْسَلْتَ كِلاَبَكَ الْمُعَلَّمَةَ وَذَكَرْتَ اسْمَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهَا فَكُلْ مِمَّا أَمْسَكْنَ عَلَيْكَ وَإِنْ قَتَلْنَ
 إِلاَّ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ الْكَلْبُ فَإِنْ أَكَلَ فَلاَ تَأْكُلْ فَإِنِّي أَخَافُ أَنْ يَكُونَ إِنَّمَا أَمْسَكَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ وَإِنْ
 خَالَطَهَا كِلاَبٌ مِنْ غَيْرِهَا فَلاَ تَأْكُلْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
34.en: 'Adi b. Hatim reported: I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying: We are a people who hunt with these (trained) dogs, then (what should we do)? Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: When you set of your trained dogs having recited the name of Allah, then eat what these (hounds) have caught for you, even if it (the game) is killed, provided (the hunting dog) has not eaten (any part of the game). If it has eaten (the game), then you don't eat it as I fear that it might have caught for its own self. And do not eat it if other dogs have joined your trained dogs.
34.hi: Adi bin Hatim ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se poocha: Hum aise log hain jo in (sikhaaye hue) kutton se shikaar karte hain, to (humein kya karna chahiye)? Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Jab tum Allah ka naam lekar apne sikhaaye hue kutte chhoDte ho, to woh khaao jo ye (shikaari kutte) tumhare liye pakadein, chahe (shikaar) maara gaya ho, bashart-e ki (shikaari kutte ne) usmein se kuch na khaaya ho. Agar usne (shikaar) khaaya hai, to tum use mat khaao kyunki mujhe Dar hai ki usne shayad ye apne khud ke liye pakda ho. Aur ise mat khaao agar doosre kutte tumhare sikhaaye hue kutton ke saath shaamil ho gaye hon.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ،
 أَبِي السَّفَرِ عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ حَاتِمٍ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 عَنِ الْمِعْرَاضِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا أَصَابَ بِحَدِّهِ فَكُلْ وَإِذَا أَصَابَ بِعَرْضِهِ فَقَتَلَ فَإِنَّهُ وَقِيذٌ فَلاَ
 تَأْكُلْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَسَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْكَلْبِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا أَرْسَلْتَ كَلْبَكَ
 وَذَكَرْتَ اسْمَ اللَّهِ فَكُلْ فَإِنْ أَكَلَ مِنْهُ فَلاَ تَأْكُلْ فَإِنَّهُ إِنَّمَا أَمْسَكَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ فَإِنْ
 وَجَدْتُ مَعَ كَلْبِي كَلْبًا آخَرَ فَلاَ أَدْرِي أَيُّهُمَا أَخَذَهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَلاَ تَأْكُلْ فَإِنَّمَا سَمَّيْتَ عَلَى كَلْبِكَ
 وَلَمْ تُسَمِّ عَلَى غَيْرِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
34.en: 'Adi b. Hatim reported that he asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about (hunting) with the help of an arrow having a stub end. He said: If it strikes (the game) with its point, then eat, but if it strikes flatly and it dies, that is Waqidh (beaten into death), do not eat that. I asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about (hunting with the help of) dogs, whereupon he said. When you send your dog (for hunting) reciting the name of Allah, then eat (the game), but if some part of it is eaten (by the dogs, then do not eat that, for it (your dog) has caught that (the-game) for itself. I (again) said: If I find along with my dog another dog, and do not know which of (the dogs) has caught (the game). then (what should I do)? Thereupon he ('Allah's Messenger) said: Then don't eat that, for you recited the name of Allah on your dog and not on the other one.
34.hi: Adi bin Hatim ne bayan kiya ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ek bina par ke kunde teer ki madad se (shikaar) ke baare mein poocha. Unhone kaha: Agar ye (shikaar ko) apne nukili sire se maare, to khaao, lekin agar ye chapte soorat mein maare aur woh mar jaaye, to ye Waqidh hai (peeta-maara), use mat khaao. Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kutton (ki madad se shikaar) ke baare mein poocha, isper unhone kaha: Jab tum Allah ka naam lekar apne kutte ko (shikaar ke liye) bhejte ho, to (shikaar) khaao, lekin agar iska koi hissa (kutton ke zariye) khaaya gaya hai, to use mat khaao, kyunki usne (tumhaare kutte ne) use apne liye pakda hai. Maine (dobara) kaha: Agar main apne kutte ke saath ek doosra kutta paaun, aur mujhe nahi pata ki (kutton mein se) kisne (shikaar) pakda hai, to (mujhe kya karna chahiye)? Isper unhone (Allah ke Rasool ne) kaha: Phir use mat khaao, kyunki tumne apne kutte par Allah ka naam liya tha aur doosre par nahi.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ،
 أَبِي السَّفَرِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الشَّعْبِيَّ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ عَدِيَّ بْنَ حَاتِمٍ، يَقُولُ سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْمِعْرَاضِ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
34.en: Adi b. Hatim reported: I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about Mi'rad (i. e. hunting with the help of arrow having a stub end, and he stated the same (as we find in the previous hadith).
34.hi: Adi bin Hatim ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se Mi'rad (yaani ek bina par ke kunde teer ki madad se shikaar) ke baare mein poocha, aur unhone wahi kaha jaisa humein pichhli hadees mein milta hai.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ الْعَبْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ،
 أَبِي السَّفَرِ وَعَنْ نَاسٍ، ذَكَرَ شُعْبَةُ عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَدِيَّ بْنَ حَاتِمٍ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْمِعْرَاضِ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏
34.en: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of 'Adi b. Hatim with a slight variation of words.
34.hi: Ye hadees Adi bin Hatim ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ 
 عَدِيِّ بْنِ حَاتِمٍ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ صَيْدِ الْمِعْرَاضِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏
 مَا أَصَابَ بِحَدِّهِ فَكُلْهُ وَمَا أَصَابَ بِعَرْضِهِ فَهُوَ وَقِيذٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَسَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ صَيْدِ الْكَلْبِ فَقَالَ
 ‏"‏ مَا أَمْسَكَ عَلَيْكَ وَلَمْ يَأْكُلْ مِنْهُ فَكُلْهُ فَإِنَّ ذَكَاتَهُ أَخْذُهُ فَإِنْ وَجَدْتَ عِنْدَهُ كَلْبًا آخَرَ فَخَشِيتَ
 أَنْ يَكُونَ أَخَذَهُ مَعَهُ وَقَدْ قَتَلَهُ فَلاَ تَأْكُلْ إِنَّمَا ذَكَرْتَ اسْمَ اللَّهِ عَلَى كَلْبِكَ وَلَمْ تَذْكُرْهُ عَلَى
 غَيْرِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
34.en: 'Adi b. Hatim reported: I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about hunting the game with the help of Mi'rad, whereupon he said: If it strikes (the game) with its point, then eat it, but if it strikes flat, that is (the game is) beaten (into death), (then do not eat that) 'Adi further said: I asked him about hunting with the help of a dog, whereupon he said: If that (the dog) catches it (the game) for you and does not eat out of that, then you eat (the game) for Dhakat (slaughtering) of that is its being caught by it (by the dog). But if you find another dog besides it, and you fear that that dog (the second one) had caught it (the game) along with that (your dog) and killed it. then don't eat; for you recited the name of Allah on your dog and did not recite that on the other one (which joined your dog incidentally).
34.hi: Adi bin Hatim ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se Mi'rad ki madad se shikaar ke baare mein poocha, isper unhone kaha: Agar ye (shikaar ko) apne nukili sire se maare, to ise khaao, lekin agar ye chapte soorat mein maare, ki (shikaar) maara gaya hai (peeta gaya hai), (to use mat khaao). Adi ne aage kaha: Maine unse kutte ki madad se shikaar ke baare mein poocha, isper unhone kaha: Agar ye (kutta) tumhare liye ise (shikaar ko) pakadta hai aur usmein se nahi khaata, to tum (shikaar) khaao kyunki uska Dhakat (zibah) uski uske (kutte) ke zariye pakde jaane mein hai. Lekin agar tum uske ilawa ek aur kutta paate ho, aur tumhe Dar hai ki us kutte (doosre) ne use (tumhare kutte) ke saath (shikaar) pakda aur use maara, to phir mat khaao; kyunki tumne apne kutte par Allah ka naam liya aur doosre par (jo galti se tumhare kutte ke saath shaamil ho gaya) nahi liya.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ بْنُ أَبِي،
 زَائِدَةَ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
34.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zakariya b. Abu Za'ida with the same chain of transmitters.
34.hi: Ye hadees Zakriyya bin Abu Za'ida ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ 
 سَعِيدِ بْنِ مَسْرُوقٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الشَّعْبِيُّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَدِيَّ بْنَ حَاتِمٍ، - وَكَانَ لَنَا جَارًا وَدَخِيلاً
 وَرَبِيطًا بِالنَّهْرَيْنِ - أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ أُرْسِلُ كَلْبِي فَأَجِدُ مَعَ كَلْبِي
 كَلْبًا قَدْ أَخَذَ لاَ أَدْرِي أَيُّهُمَا أَخَذَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏
"‏ فَلاَ تَأْكُلْ فَإِنَّمَا سَمَّيْتَ عَلَى كَلْبِكَ وَلَمْ تُسَمِّ عَلَى
 غَيْرِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
34.en: Sha'bi reported: I heard Adi b. Hatim say-and he was our neighbour, and our partner and co worker at Nahrain-that he asked Allah's Apostle (may peace he upon him) saying: I let off my dog and find another dog along with my dog and that (any one of them) catches the (game), but I do not know which one had caught it, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Then don't eat that, for you recited the name of Allah while letting off your dog and did not recite on the other.
34.hi: Sha'bi ne bayan kiya: Maine Adi bin Hatim ko ye kehte suna - aur woh humare padosi, saanjhedaar aur Nahrain mein saath-saath kaam karne wale the - ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se poocha: Main apna kutta chhodta hoon aur apne kutte ke saath ek doosra kutta paata hoon aur woh (unmein se koi bhi) (shikaar) pakadta hai, lekin mujhe nahi pata ki kisne use pakda, isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Phir use mat khaao, kyunki tumne apna kutta chhodte waqt Allah ka naam liya aur doosre par nahi liya.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ،
 عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ حَاتِمٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏
34.en: This hadith has been narrated oif the authority of 'Adi b. Hatim through another chain of transmitters.
34.hi: Ye hadees Adi bin Hatim ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

34.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ شُجَاعٍ السَّكُونِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ،
 عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ حَاتِمٍ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ إِذَا أَرْسَلْتَ كَلْبَكَ فَاذْكُرِ
 اسْمَ اللَّهِ فَإِنْ أَمْسَكَ عَلَيْكَ فَأَدْرَكْتَهُ حَيًّا فَاذْبَحْهُ وَإِنْ أَدْرَكْتَهُ قَدْ قَتَلَ وَلَمْ يَأْكُلْ مِنْهُ فَكُلْهُ
 وَإِنْ وَجَدْتَ مَعَ كَلْبِكَ كَلْبًا غَيْرَهُ وَقَدْ قَتَلَ فَلاَ تَأْكُلْ فَإِنَّكَ لاَ تَدْرِي أَيُّهُمَا قَتَلَهُ وَإِنْ رَمَيْتَ
 سَهْمَكَ فَاذْكُرِ اسْمَ اللَّهِ فَإِنْ غَابَ عَنْكَ يَوْمًا فَلَمْ تَجِدْ فِيهِ إِلاَّ أَثَرَ سَهْمِكَ فَكُلْ إِنْ شِئْتَ
 وَإِنْ وَجَدْتَهُ غَرِيقًا فِي الْمَاءِ فَلاَ تَأْكُلْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
34.en: Adi b. Hatim reported: Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) said to me: When you let off your dog, recite the name of Allah, and if it catches (game for you) and you find it alive, then slaughter it; if you find it killed and that (your dog) has eaten nothing out of that, (even then) you may eat it; but if you find along with your dog another dog, and (the game an) dead, then don't eat, for you do not know which of the two has killed it. And if you shoot your arrow, recite the name of Allah, but if it (game) goes out of your sight for a day and you do not find on that but the mark of your arrow, then eat that it you so like, but if you find it drowned in water, then don't eat that.
34.hi: Adi bin Hatim ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse kaha: Jab tum apna kutta chhodte ho, Allah ka naam lo, aur agar ye (shikaar) pakadta hai aur tum use zinda paate ho, to use zibah karo; agar tum use maara hua paate ho aur (tumhare kutte ne) usmein se kuch nahi khaaya, (tab bhi) tum use khaa sakte ho; lekin agar tum apne kutte ke saath ek doosra kutta paate ho, aur (shikaar) mara hua hai, to use mat khaao, kyunki tumhe nahi pata ki dono mein se kisne use maara. Aur agar tum apna teer chalaate ho, Allah ka naam lo, lekin agar ye (shikaar) ek din ke liye tumhari nazron se ojhal ho jaaye aur tumhe usmein tumhare teer ke nishaan ke siwaay kuch na mile, to agar tum chaho use khaa sakte ho, lekin agar tum use paani mein Dooba hua paate ho, to use mat khaao.

34.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَاصِمٌ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ،
 عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ حَاتِمٍ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الصَّيْدِ قَالَ ‏
"‏ إِذَا رَمَيْتَ
 سَهْمَكَ فَاذْكُرِ اسْمَ اللَّهِ فَإِنْ وَجَدْتَهُ قَدْ قَتَلَ فَكُلْ إِلاَّ أَنْ تَجِدَهُ قَدْ وَقَعَ فِي مَاءٍ فَإِنَّكَ لاَ
 تَدْرِي الْمَاءُ قَتَلَهُ أَوْ سَهْمُكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
34.en: 'Adi b. Hatim reported: I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about hunting. He said: When you shoot your arrow, recite the name of Allah, and if you find it (the arrow) killed (that). then eat, except when you find it fallen into water, for in that case you do not know whether it is water that caused its death or your arrow.
34.hi: Adi bin Hatim ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se shikaar ke baare mein poocha. Unhone kaha: Jab tum apna teer chalaao, Allah ka naam lo, aur agar tum ise (teer ko shikaar ko) maara hua paate ho, to khaao, siwaay tab jab tum use paani mein gira hua paao, kyunki tab tumhe nahi pata ki iski maut paani ki wajah se hui ya tumhare teer ki wajah se.

34.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا هَنَّادُ بْنُ السَّرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنْ حَيْوَةَ بْنِ شُرَيْحٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ 
 رَبِيعَةَ بْنَ يَزِيدَ الدِّمَشْقِيَّ، يَقُولُ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو إِدْرِيسَ، عَائِذُ اللَّهِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا ثَعْلَبَةَ الْخُشَنِيَّ،
 يَقُولُ أَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّا بِأَرْضِ قَوْمٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ
 الْكِتَابِ نَأْكُلُ فِي آنِيَتِهِمْ وَأَرْضِ صَيْدٍ أَصِيدُ بِقَوْسِي وَأَصِيدُ بِكَلْبِيَ الْمُعَلَّمِ أَوْ بِكَلْبِيَ الَّذِي
 لَيْسَ بِمُعَلَّمٍ فَأَخْبِرْنِي مَا الَّذِي يَحِلُّ لَنَا مِنْ ذَلِكَ قَالَ ‏
"‏ أَمَّا مَا ذَكَرْتَ أَنَّكُمْ بِأَرْضِ قَوْمٍ
 مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ تَأْكُلُونَ فِي آنِيَتِهِمْ فَإِنْ وَجَدْتُمْ غَيْرَ آنِيَتِهِمْ فَلاَ تَأْكُلُوا فِيهَا وَإِنْ لَمْ تَجِدُوا
 فَاغْسِلُوهَا ثُمَّ كُلُوا فِيهَا وَأَمَّا مَا ذَكَرْتَ أَنَّكَ بِأَرْضِ صَيْدٍ فَمَا أَصَبْتَ بِقَوْسِكَ فَاذْكُرِ اسْمَ
 اللَّهِ ثُمَّ كُلْ وَمَا أَصَبْتَ بِكَلْبِكَ الْمُعَلَّمِ فَاذْكُرِ اسْمَ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ كُلْ وَمَا أَصَبْتَ بِكَلْبِكَ الَّذِي لَيْسَ
 بِمُعَلَّمٍ فَأَدْرَكْتَ ذَكَاتَهُ فَكُلْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
34.en: Abu Tha'laba al-Khushani reported: I came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger, we are in the land of the People of the Book, (so) we eat in their utensils, and (live) in a hunting region. where I hunt with, the help of my bow, and hunt with my trained dog, or with my dog which is not trained. So inform me what is lawful (Halal) for us out of that. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Regarding what you have mentioned of the fact that you live in the land belonging to the People of the Book and so you eat in their utensils, but if you can get utensils other than theirs, then don't eat in them; but if you do not find any, then wash them and eat in them. And regarding what you have mentioned about (your living) in a hunting region, what you hunt, (strike) with the help of your bow, recite the name of Allah (while shooting an arrow) and then eat; and what you catch with the help of your trained dog, recite the name of Allah (while letting oil) the dog and then eat it, and what you get with the help of your untrained dog, (if you find it alive) and slaughter it (according to the law of the Shari'ah), eat it.
34.hi: Abu Tha'laba al-Khushani ne bayan kiya: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, hum Kitaab waalon (Ahl-e-Kitaab) ki zameen mein hain, (is liye) hum unke bartano mein khaate hain, aur (rehte hain) ek shikaar ke ilaake mein, jahan main apni kaman ki madad se shikaar karta hoon, aur apne sikhaaye hue kutte se, ya apne kutte se jo sikhaaya hua nahi hai. Is liye mujhe bataiye ki isme se humare liye kya jaayez (Halal) hai. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Jahan tak tumne is baat ka zikr kiya hai ki tum Kitaab waalon ki zameen mein rehte ho aur is liye tum unke bartano mein khaate ho, lekin agar tumhe unke ilawa doosre bartan mil sakte hain, to unmein mat khaao; lekin agar tumhe nahi milte, to unhe dho lo aur unmein khaao. Aur jahan tak tumne apne (shikaar ke ilaake mein rehne) ka zikr kiya hai, jo tum shikaar karte ho, (maarte ho) apni kaman ki madad se, Allah ka naam lo (teer chalaate waqt) aur phir khaao; aur jo tum apne sikhaaye hue kutte ki madad se pakadte ho, Allah ka naam lo (kutte ko chhodte waqt) aur phir use khaao, aur jo tumhe apne na-sikhaaye hue kutte ki madad se milta hai, (agar tum use zinda paate ho) aur use zibah karo (Shariat ke qanoon ke mutabik), use khaao.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُقْرِئُ،
 كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ حَيْوَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ غَيْرَ أَنَّ حَدِيثَ ابْنِ وَهْبٍ، لَمْ
 يَذْكُرْ فِيهِ صَيْدَ الْقَوْسِ ‏.‏
34.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Haiwa with the same chain of transmitters, but with a slight variation of words.
34.hi: Ye hadees Haiwa ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath.

34.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مِهْرَانَ الرَّازِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَمَّادُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ الْخَيَّاطُ عَنْ 
 مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ صَالِحٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي ثَعْلَبَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله
 عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ إِذَا رَمَيْتَ بِسَهْمِكَ فَغَابَ عَنْكَ فَأَدْرَكْتَهُ فَكُلْهُ مَا لَمْ يُنْتِنْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
34.en: Abu Tha'laba reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said this: If you shoot with your arrow and (the game) goes out of your sight and you find it (later on), then eat that if it has not gone rotten.
34.hi: Abu Tha'laba ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Agar tum apna teer chalaao aur (shikaar) tumhari nazron se ojhal ho jaaye aur tum use (baad mein) paao, to use khaao agar ye saDa nahi hai.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْنُ بْنُ عِيسَى، حَدَّثَنِي مُعَاوِيَةُ، عَنْ 
 عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ نُفَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي ثَعْلَبَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي
 الَّذِي يُدْرِكُ صَيْدَهُ بَعْدَ ثَلاَثٍ ‏
"‏ فَكُلْهُ مَا لَمْ يُنْتِنْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
34.en: Abu Tha'laba reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying about one who comes three days later on the game he has shot: Eat it, provided it has not gone rotten.
34.hi: Abu Tha'laba ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko us shakhs ke baare mein kehte suna jo apne shikaar kiye hue jaanwar par teen din baad aata hai: Use khaao, bashart-e ki ye saDa nahi hai.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ صَالِحٍ،
 عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ، عَنْ أَبِي ثَعْلَبَةَ الْخُشَنِيِّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَدِيثَهُ فِي
 الصَّيْدِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ابْنُ حَاتِمٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ وَأَبِي
 الزَّاهِرِيَّةِ عَنْ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ نُفَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي ثَعْلَبَةَ الْخُشَنِيِّ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ الْعَلاَءِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَذْكُرْ
 نُتُونَتَهُ وَقَالَ فِي الْكَلْبِ ‏
"‏ كُلْهُ بَعْدَ ثَلاَثٍ إِلاَّ أَنْ يُنْتِنَ فَدَعْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
34.en: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Tha'laba al- Khushani with a slight variation of (words): He (the Holy Prophet) said in regard to the game killed by (a trained) dog: Eat after three days provided it has not gone rotten.
34.hi: Ye hadees Abu Tha'laba al-Khushani ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai: Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) ek (sikhaaye hue) kutte ke zariye maare gaye shikaar ke baare mein kaha: Teen din baad khaao, bashart-e ki ye saDa nahi hai.

34.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ
 أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي إِدْرِيسَ، عَنْ أَبِي،
 ثَعْلَبَةَ قَالَ نَهَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ أَكْلِ كُلِّ ذِي نَابٍ مِنَ السَّبُعِ ‏.‏ زَادَ إِسْحَاقُ
 وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ فِي حَدِيثِهِمَا قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ وَلَمْ نَسْمَعْ بِهَذَا حَتَّى قَدِمْنَا الشَّامَ ‏.‏
34.en: Abu Tha'laba reported that Allah's Apostle (may peace be upon prohibited the eating of every fanged beast of prey. Zuhri added: We did not bear of it until we came to Syria.
34.hi: Abu Tha'laba ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne har naukile daant waale shikaari jaanwar ko khaane se mana kiya. Zuhri ne izafa kiya: Humne isko tab tak nahi suna jab tak hum Syria nahi aa gaye.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ 
 أَبِي إِدْرِيسَ الْخَوْلاَنِيِّ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا ثَعْلَبَةَ الْخُشَنِيَّ، يَقُولُ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم عَنْ أَكْلِ كُلِّ ذِي نَابٍ مِنَ السِّبَاعِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ وَلَمْ أَسْمَعْ ذَلِكَ مِنْ عُلَمَائِنَا بِالْحِجَازِ
 حَتَّى حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو إِدْرِيسَ وَكَانَ مِنْ فُقَهَاءِ أَهْلِ الشَّامِ ‏.‏
34.en: Abu Tha'laba al-Khushani reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited the eating of all fanged beasts. Ibn Shihab said: I did not bear of this from our 'Ulama' in the Hijaz, until Abu Idris narrated that to me and he was one of the jurists of Syria.
34.hi: Abu Tha'laba al-Khushani ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne sab naukile daant waale jaanwaron ko khaane se mana kiya. Ibn Shihab ne kaha: Maine ise apne ulema se Hijaz mein nahi suna, jab tak Abu Idris ne mujhe ye riwayat nahi ki aur woh Syria ke ek fiqh aalim the.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرٌو، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ
 الْحَارِثِ - أَنَّ ابْنَ شِهَابٍ، حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أَبِي إِدْرِيسَ الْخَوْلاَنِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي ثَعْلَبَةَ الْخُشَنِيِّ، أَنَّالله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ أَكْلِ كُلِّ ذِي نَابٍ مِنَ السِّبَاعِ ‏.‏
34.en: Abu Tha'laba al-Khushani reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having prohibited the eating of all fanged beasts of prey.
34.hi: Abu Tha'laba al-Khushani ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne sab naukile daant waale shikaari jaanwaron ko khaane se mana kiya.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، وَابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ،
 وَعَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ وَيُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ وَغَيْرُهُمْ ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ،
 عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ الْمَاجِشُونِ، ح
 وَحَدَّثَنَا الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ،
 كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَ حَدِيثِ يُونُسَ وَعَمْرٍو كُلُّهُمْ ذَكَرَ الأَكْلَ إِلاَّ صَالِحًا
 وَيُوسُفَ فَإِنَّ حَدِيثَهُمَا نَهَى عَنْ كُلِّ ذِي نَابٍ مِنَ السَّبُعِ ‏.‏
34.en: This hadith has been narrated through several other chains of transmitters, but some of the chains have a slight variation of words.
34.hi: Ye hadees kayi doosri sanadon ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin kuch sanadon mein alfaazon mein halka antar hai.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مَهْدِيٍّ - عَنْ مَالِكٍ،
 عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي حَكِيمٍ، عَنْ عَبِيدَةَ بْنِ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله
 عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ كُلُّ ذِي نَابٍ مِنَ السِّبَاعِ فَأَكْلُهُ حَرَامٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
34.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The eating of all fanged beasts of prey is unlawful.
34.hi: Abu Huraira ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Sab naukile daant waale shikaari jaanwaron ko khaana na-jaayez hai.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ
 مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
34.en: This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters.
34.hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ مَيْمُونِ،
 بْنِ مِهْرَانَ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ كُلِّ ذِي نَابٍ
 مِنَ السِّبَاعِ وَعَنْ كُلِّ ذِي مِخْلَبٍ مِنَ الطَّيْرِ ‏.‏
34.en: Ibn 'Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited the eating of all fanged beasts of prey, and all the birds having talons.
34.hi: Ibn Abbas ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne sab naukile daant waale shikaari jaanwaron aur sab panjon waale parindon ko khaane se mana kiya.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ
 مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
34.en: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Shu'ba.
34.hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ،
 وَأَبُو بِشْرٍ عَنْ مَيْمُونِ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى
 عَنْ كُلِّ ذِي نَابٍ مِنَ السِّبَاعِ وَعَنْ كُلِّ ذِي مِخْلَبٍ مِنَ الطَّيْرِ ‏.‏
34.en: Ibn Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade (the eating) of all the fanged beasts of prey, and of all the birds having talons.
34.hi: Ibn Abbas ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne sab naukile daant waale shikaari jaanwaron aur sab panjon waale parindon ko (khaane se) mana kiya.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ،
 حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، قَالَ أَبُو بِشْرٍ أَخْبَرَنَا عَنْ مَيْمُونِ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ نَهَى ح
 
 وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ مَيْمُونِ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ،
 عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ شُعْبَةَ عَنِ الْحَكَمِ
 ‏.‏
34.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas through a different chain of transmitters.
34.hi: Ye hadees Ibn Abbas ki sanad se ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

34.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، ح 
 وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ بَعَثَنَا
 رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَمَّرَ عَلَيْنَا أَبَا عُبَيْدَةَ نَتَلَقَّى عِيرًا لِقُرَيْشٍ وَزَوَّدَنَا جِرَابًا
 مِنْ تَمْرٍ لَمْ يَجِدْ لَنَا غَيْرَهُ فَكَانَ أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ يُعْطِينَا تَمْرَةً تَمْرَةً - قَالَ - فَقُلْتُ كَيْفَ كُنْتُمْ
 تَصْنَعُونَ بِهَا قَالَ نَمَصُّهَا كَمَا يَمَصُّ الصَّبِيُّ ثُمَّ نَشْرَبُ عَلَيْهَا مِنَ الْمَاءِ فَتَكْفِينَا يَوْمَنَا إِلَى
 اللَّيْلِ وَكُنَّا نَضْرِبُ بِعِصِيِّنَا الْخَبَطَ ثُمَّ نَبُلُّهُ بِالْمَاءِ فَنَأْكُلُهُ قَالَ وَانْطَلَقْنَا عَلَى سَاحِلِ الْبَحْرِ
 فَرُفِعَ لَنَا عَلَى سَاحِلِ الْبَحْرِ كَهَيْئَةِ الْكَثِيبِ الضَّخْمِ فَأَتَيْنَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ دَابَّةٌ تُدْعَى الْعَنْبَرَ
 قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ مَيْتَةٌ ثُمَّ قَالَ لاَ بَلْ نَحْنُ رُسُلُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَفِي
 سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَقَدِ اضْطُرِرْتُمْ فَكُلُوا قَالَ فَأَقَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ شَهْرًا وَنَحْنُ ثَلاَثُ مِائَةٍ حَتَّى سَمِنَّا قَالَ
 وَلَقَدْ رَأَيْتُنَا نَغْتَرِفُ مِنْ وَقْبِ عَيْنِهِ بِالْقِلاَلِ الدُّهْنَ وَنَقْتَطِعُ مِنْهُ الْفِدَرَ كَالثَّوْرِ - أَوْ كَقَدْرِ
 الثَّوْرِ - فَلَقَدْ أَخَذَ مِنَّا أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ ثَلاَثَةَ عَشَرَ رَجُلاً فَأَقْعَدَهُمْ فِي وَقْبِ عَيْنِهِ وَأَخَذَ ضِلَعًا
 مِنْ أَضْلاَعِهِ فَأَقَامَهَا ثُمَّ رَحَلَ أَعْظَمَ بَعِيرٍ مَعَنَا فَمَرَّ مِنْ تَحْتِهَا وَتَزَوَّدْنَا مِنْ لَحْمِهِ وَشَائِقَ
 فَلَمَّا قَدِمْنَا الْمَدِينَةَ أَتَيْنَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرْنَا ذَلِكَ لَهُ فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ هُوَ رِزْقٌ
 أَخْرَجَهُ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ فَهَلْ مَعَكُمْ مِنْ لَحْمِهِ شَىْءٌ فَتُطْعِمُونَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَرْسَلْنَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْهُ فَأَكَلَهُ ‏.‏
34.en: Jabir reported: Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) sent us (on an expedition) and appointed Abu 'Ubaida our chief that we might intercept a caravan of the Quraish and provided us with a bag of dates. And he found for us nothing besides it. Abu Ubaida gave each of us one date (everyday). I (Abu Zubair, one of the narrators) said: What did you do with that? He said: We sucked that just as a baby sucks and then drank water over that, and it sufficed us for the day until night. We beat off leaves with the help of our staffs, then drenched them with water and ate them. We then went to the coast of the sea, and there rose before us on the coast of the sea something like a big mound. We came near that and we found that it was a beast, called al-'Anbar (spermaceti whale). Abu 'Ubaida said. It is dead. He then said: No (but it does not matter), we have been sent by the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in the path of Allah and you are hard pressed (on account of the scarcity of food), so you eat that. We three hundred in number stayed there for a month, until we grew bulky. He (Jabir) said: I saw how we extracted pitcher after pitcher full of fat from the cavity of its eye, and sliced from it compact piece of meat equal to a bull or like a bull. Abu 'Ubaida called forth thirteen men from us and he made them sit in the cavity of its eye, and he took hold of one of the ribs of its chest and made it stand and then saddled the biggest of the camels we had with us and it passed under it (the arched rib), and we provided ourselves with pieces of boiled meat (especially for use in our journey). When we came back to Medina, we went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and made a mention of that to him, whereupon he said: That was a provision which Allah had brought forth for you. Is there any piece of meat (left) with you, so tnat you give to us that? He (Jabir) said: We sent to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) tome of that (a piece of meat) and he ate it.
34.hi: Jabir ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein (ek muhim par) bheja aur Abu Ubaida ko humara sardaar muqarrar kiya taaki hum Quraish ke ek caravan ko rok sakein, aur humein khajooron ka ek thaila diya. Aur unhe humare liye iske ilawa kuch nahi mila. Abu Ubaida ne hummein se har ek ko ek khajoor (roz) diya. Maine (Abu Zubair, ek raawi) kaha: Aapne uske saath kya kiya? Unhone kaha: Hum ise chooste jaise ek bachcha choosta hai aur phir uspar paani peete, aur ye humare liye us din se raat tak kaafi ho jaata. Hum apni lakDiyon se pattoon ko peette, phir unhe paani mein bhigote aur unhe khaate. Hum phir samundar ke kinaare gaye, aur wahan samundar ke kinaare humare saamne ek badi Tille jaisi cheez uThi. Hum uske qareeb aaye aur humne paaya ki ye ek jaanwar hai, jise al-Anbar (spermaceti whale) kaha jaata hai. Abu Ubaida ne kaha: Ye mara hua hai. Unhone phir kaha: Nahi (lekin isse koi farak nahi padta), humein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Allah ki raah mein bheja hai aur tum (khaane ki kami ki wajah se) tang haal ho, is liye ise khaao. Hum teen sau ki tadaad mein wahan ek mahine tak rahe, yahan tak ki hum mote ho gaye. Unhone (Jabir ne) kaha: Maine dekha ki humne kaise uski aankh ki khaai se ghade ke baad ghada charbi nikaali, aur usmein se ek bail ke barabar ya bail jaise gosht ke moTe tukde kaate. Abu Ubaida ne hummein se terah aadmiyon ko bulaaya aur unhe uski aankh ki khaai mein baithaya, aur unhone uski chhaati ki ek paslIyon mein se ek pakDi aur use khada kiya aur phir humare paas sabse bade oont par zeen kasi aur woh uske neeche se guzra (moDi hui paslI), aur humne apne aap ko (khaas taur par apni safar mein istemal karne ke liye) ubale hue gosht ke tukdon se lais kiya. Jab hum Madina wapas aaye, hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaye aur unhe iska zikr kiya, isper unhone kaha: Ye ek rozi thi jo Allah ne tumhare liye laayi. Kya tumhare paas gosht ka koi tukda (bacha hua) hai, taaki tum humein woh do? Unhone (Jabir ne) kaha: Humne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko usmein se kuch (gosht ka ek tukda) bheja aur unhone use khaaya.

34.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْجَبَّارِ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ سَمِعَ عَمْرٌو، جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
 يَقُولُ بَعَثَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَنَحْنُ ثَلاَثُمِائَةِ رَاكِبٍ وَأَمِيرُنَا أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ بْنُ
 الْجَرَّاحِ نَرْصُدُ عِيرًا لِقُرَيْشٍ فَأَقَمْنَا بِالسَّاحِلِ نِصْفَ شَهْرٍ فَأَصَابَنَا جُوعٌ شَدِيدٌ حَتَّى أَكَلْنَا
 الْخَبَطَ فَسُمِّيَ جَيْشَ الْخَبَطِ فَأَلْقَى لَنَا الْبَحْرُ دَابَّةً يُقَالُ لَهَا الْعَنْبَرُ فَأَكَلْنَا مِنْهَا نِصْفَ شَهْرٍ
 وَادَّهَنَّا مِنْ وَدَكِهَا حَتَّى ثَابَتْ أَجْسَامُنَا - قَالَ - فَأَخَذَ أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ ضِلَعًا مِنْ أَضْلاَعِهِ
 فَنَصَبَهُ ثُمَّ نَظَرَ إِلَى أَطْوَلِ رَجُلٍ فِي الْجَيْشِ وَأَطْوَلِ جَمَلٍ فَحَمَلَهُ عَلَيْهِ فَمَرَّ تَحْتَهُ قَالَ وَجَلَسَ
 فِي حَجَاجِ عَيْنِهِ نَفَرٌ قَالَ وَأَخْرَجْنَا مِنْ وَقْبِ عَيْنِهِ كَذَا وَكَذَا قُلَّةَ وَدَكٍ - قَالَ - وَكَانَ
 مَعَنَا جِرَابٌ مِنْ تَمْرٍ فَكَانَ أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ يُعْطِي كُلَّ رَجُلٍ مِنَّا قَبْضَةً قَبْضَةً ثُمَّ أَعْطَانَا تَمْرَةً
 تَمْرَةً فَلَمَّا فَنِيَ وَجَدْنَا فَقْدَهُ ‏.‏
34.en: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported: Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) sent us (on an expedition). We were three hundred riders and our chief (leader) was 'Ubaida b. al-Jarrah. We were on the look out for a caravan of the Quraish. So we stayed on the coast for half a month, and were so much afflicted by extreme hunger that we (were obliged) to eat leaves. That is why it was called the Detachment of the Leaves. The ocean cast out for us an animal which was called al-'Anbar (whale). We ate of that for half of the month and rubbed its fat on our (bodies) until our bodies became stout. Abu 'Ubaida caught hold of one of its ribs and fixed that up. He then cast a glance at the tallest man of the army and the highest of the camels. and then made him ride over that, and that-tnan passed beneath it (the rib), and many a man could sit in its eye-socket, and we extracted many pitchers of fat from the cavity of its eye. We had small bags containing dates with us (before finding the whale). 'Ubaida gave every person amongst us a handful of dates (and when the provision ran short), he then gave each one of us one date. And when that (stock) was exhausted, we felt its loss.
34.hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein (ek muhim par) bheja. Hum teen sau sawaar the aur humare sardaar (agua) Ubaida bin al-Jarrah the. Hum Quraish ke ek caravan ki taak mein the. To hum samundar ke kinaare aadhe mahine tak rahe, aur bahut zyada bhookh se pareshaan hue ki humein (majboor hokar) pattE khaane pade. Isi wajah se ise Pattoon ki Toli kaha jaata hai. Samundar ne humare liye ek jaanwar phenka jise al-Anbar (whale) kaha jaata tha. Humne isse aadhe mahine tak khaaya aur iski charbi apne (badan) par mali yahan tak ki humare badan moTe ho gaye. Abu Ubaida ne uski paslIyon mein se ek pakDi aur use taina kiya. Unhone phir fauj ke sabse lambe aadmi aur sabse ooche oont ki taraf dekha, aur phir use uspar sawaar karaaya, aur woh aadmi iske (paslI ke) neeche se guzra, aur bahut se aadmi iski aankh ki khaai mein baith sakte the, aur humne iski aankh ki khaai se bahut se ghade charbi ke nikaale. Humare paas khajooron ki chhoti thailiyaan thin (whale paane se pehle). Ubaida ne hummein se har shakhs ko mutthi bhar khajooren din (aur jab rozi kam padi), unhone hummein se har ek ko ek khajoor di. Aur jab (ye bhandaar) khatm ho gaya, humein iski kami mehsoos hui.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْجَبَّارِ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ سَمِعَ عَمْرٌو، جَابِرًا يَقُولُ فِي
 جَيْشِ الْخَبَطِ إِنَّ رَجُلاً نَحَرَ ثَلاَثَ جَزَائِرَ ثُمَّ ثَلاَثًا ثُمَّ ثَلاَثًا ثُمَّ نَهَاهُ أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ ‏.‏
34.en: 'Amr reported on the authority of Jabir that in the expedition of Khabat (leaves) a person slaughtered three camels, then three, then three, then Abu 'Ubaida forbade him (to do so fearing that the rides may become short).
34.hi: Amr ne Jabir ki sanad se riwayat ki ki Khabat (patton) ki muhim mein ek shakhs ne teen oont zibah kiye, phir teen, phir teen, phir Abu Ubaida ne unhe (aisa karne se) mana kiya (Dar te hue ki sawaari waale jaanwar kam pad jaayenge).

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سُلَيْمَانَ - عَنْ هِشَامِ،
 بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ وَهْبِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ بَعَثَنَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم وَنَحْنُ ثَلاَثُمِائَةٍ نَحْمِلُ أَزْوَادَنَا عَلَى رِقَابِنَا ‏.‏
34.en: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported: Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) sent us (on an expedition), and we were three hundred in number, and we were carrying our bags of provisions around our necks.
34.hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein (ek muhim par) bheja, aur hum teen sau ki tadaad mein the, aur hum apni rozi ki thailiyaan apni gardanon ke aas-paas le ja rahe the.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ 
 أَبِي نُعَيْمٍ، وَهْبِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ أَنَّ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَهُ قَالَ بَعَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله
 عليه وسلم سَرِيَّةً ثَلاَثَمِائَةٍ وَأَمَّرَ عَلَيْهِمْ أَبَا عُبَيْدَةَ بْنَ الْجَرَّاحِ فَفَنِيَ زَادُهُمْ فَجَمَعَ أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ
 زَادَهُمْ فِي مِزْوَدٍ فَكَانَ يُقَوِّتُنَا حَتَّى كَانَ يُصِيبُنَا كُلَّ يَوْمٍ تَمْرَةٌ ‏.‏
34.en: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent on in expedition a detachment consisting of three hundred (persons) and appointed Abu 'Ubaida b. Jarrah as their chief. Their provisions ran short: 'Abu 'Ubaida collected their provisions in the provision bag. and he fed us (for some time). Later on when the provisions ran short he gave us one date every day.
34.hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne teen sau (logon) ki ek toli ek muhim par bheji aur Abu Ubaida bin Jarrah ko unka sardaar muqarrar kiya. Unki rozi kam pad gayi: Abu Ubaida ne unki rozi ko ek thaile mein ikattha kiya, aur unhone (kuch waqt ke liye) humein khilaaya. Baad mein jab rozi kam pad gayi unhone humein har din ek khajoor di.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ كَثِيرٍ - قَالَ سَمِعْتُ 
 وَهْبَ بْنَ كَيْسَانَ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ بَعَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم سَرِيَّةً أَنَا فِيهِمْ إِلَى سِيفِ الْبَحْرِ ‏.‏ وَسَاقُوا جَمِيعًا بَقِيَّةَ الْحَدِيثِ كَنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ عَمْرِو
 بْنِ دِينَارٍ وَأَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي حَدِيثِ وَهْبِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ فَأَكَلَ مِنْهَا الْجَيْشُ ثَمَانِيَ عَشْرَةَ
 لَيْلَةً ‏.‏
34.en: Jabir b. Abdullah reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent an expedition to the sea coast and I was one among them. The rest of the hadith is the same with a slight variation of wording that in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Wahb b. Kaisan (the words are): " The army ate out of that (the whale) for eighteen days."
34.hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne samundar ke kinaare ek muhim bheji aur main unmein se ek tha. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath ki Wahb bin Kaisan ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hadees mein (alfaaz hain): "Fauj ne usmein se (whale mein se) aTharah dinon tak khaaya."

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ،
 حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْمُنْذِرِ الْقَزَّازُ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مِقْسَمٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ،
 عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ بَعَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعْثًا إِلَى أَرْضِ جُهَيْنَةَ وَاسْتَعْمَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ
 رَجُلاً وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏.‏
34.en: Jabir b. Abdullah reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent an expedition to the land of the tribe of Juhaina, and appointed a person as a chief over them.
34.hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Juhaina qabile ki zameen par ek muhim bheji, aur unpar ek shakhs ko sardaar muqarrar kiya.

34.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ،
 اللَّهِ وَالْحَسَنِ ابْنَىْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ أَبِيهِمَا، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ مُتْعَةِ النِّسَاءِ يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ وَعَنْ لُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ الإِنْسِيَّةِ ‏.‏
34.en: 'Ali b. Abi Talib reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade on the Day of Khaibar temporary marriage (Muta') with women and the eating of the flesh of domestic asses.
34.hi: Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Khaibar ke din auraton ke saath asthaayi shaadi (Mut'a) aur ghareloo gadhon ke gosht khaane se mana kiya.

34.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ،
 ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا 
 ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ،
 أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَفِي حَدِيثِ يُونُسَ وَعَنْ أَكْلِ، لُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ
 الإِنْسِيَّةِ ‏.‏
34.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri through a different chain of transmitters with a slight variation of wording.
34.hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se ek doosri sanad ke zariye alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
 بْنِ سَعْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا إِدْرِيسَ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا ثَعْلَبَةَ قَالَ
 حَرَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لُحُومَ الْحُمُرِ الأَهْلِيَّةِ ‏.‏
34.en: Abu Tha'laba reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited (the eating) of the flesh of domestic asses.
34.hi: Abu Tha'laba ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ghareloo gadhon ke gosht (khaane) se mana kiya.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ،
 وَسَالِمٌ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ أَكْلِ لُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ الأَهْلِيَّةِ
 ‏.‏
34.en: Ibn Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) forbade the eating of the flesh of domestic asses.
34.hi: Ibn Umar ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ghareloo gadhon ke gosht khaane se mana kiya.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي 
 نَافِعٌ، قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ ح 
 وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي وَمَعْنُ بْنُ عِيسَى، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ،
 عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ أَكْلِ الْحِمَارِ الأَهْلِيِّ يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ
 وَكَانَ النَّاسُ احْتَاجُوا إِلَيْهَا ‏.‏
34.en: Ibn 'Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the eating of the (flesh) of domestic asses on the Day of Khaibar in spite of the fact that people needed that.
34.hi: Ibn Umar ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ghareloo gadhon ke gosht ko khaane se mana kiya Khaibar ke din is baat ke bawajood ki logon ko iski zaroorat thi.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنِ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ
 عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي أَوْفَى عَنْ لُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ الأَهْلِيَّةِ، فَقَالَ أَصَابَتْنَا مَجَاعَةٌ يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ وَنَحْنُ
 مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَدْ أَصَبْنَا لِلْقَوْمِ حُمُرًا خَارِجَةً مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ فَنَحَرْنَاهَا
 فَإِنَّ قُدُورَنَا لَتَغْلِي إِذْ نَادَى مُنَادِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنِ اكْفَئُوا الْقُدُورَ وَلاَ
 تَطْعَمُوا مِنْ لُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ شَيْئًا فَقُلْتُ حَرَّمَهَا تَحْرِيمَ مَاذَا قَالَ تَحَدَّثْنَا بَيْنَنَا فَقُلْنَا حَرَّمَهَا
 أَلْبَتَّةَ وَحَرَّمَهَا مِنْ أَجْلِ أَنَّهَا لَمْ تُخَمَّسْ ‏.‏
34.en: Shaibani reported: I asked 'Abdullah b. Abu Aufa about (the lawfulness or unlawfulness of) the flesh of the domestic asses. He said: We experienced hunger on the Day of Khaibar as we were with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). We found domestic asses in the exterior of Medina. We slaughtered them and our earthen pots were boiling when the announcer of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) made an announcement that the earthen pots should be turned upside down and nothing of the flesh of the domestic asses should be eaten. I said: What kind of prohibition is it that he (the Holy Prophet) has made? He said: We discussed it amongst -ourselves. Some of us aaid that it has been declared unlawful for ever, (whereas others said) it has been declared unlawful since one-fifth (of the booty) has not been given (to the treasury, as is legally required).
34.hi: Shaibani ne kaha: Maine Abdullah bin Abu Aufa se ghareloo gadhon ke gosht (ke jaayez ya na-jaayez hone) ke baare mein poocha. Unhone kaha: Humein Khaibar ke din bhookh mehsoos hui jab hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath the. Humein Madina ke bahri hisse mein ghareloo gadhe mile. Humne unhe zibah kiya aur humare mitti ke bartan ubal rahe the jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke ailaan karne wale ne ailaan kiya ki mitti ke bartan ulTe kar diye jaayein aur ghareloo gadhon ke gosht mein se kuch bhi khaaya na jaaye. Maine kaha: Ye kaisa mana hai jo unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kiya hai? Unhone kaha: Humne aapas mein iski charcha ki. Humme se kuch ne kaha ki ise hamesha ke liye na-jaayez ailaan kiya gaya hai, (jabki doosron ne kaha) ise is liye na-jaayez ailaan kiya gaya hai kyunki paanchvaan hissa (maal-e-ganimat ka) nahi diya gaya hai (khazane ko, jaisa kaanooni taur par zaroori hai).

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ، فُضَيْلُ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زِيَادٍ - حَدَّثَنَا 
 سُلَيْمَانُ الشَّيْبَانِيُّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي أَوْفَى، يَقُولُ أَصَابَتْنَا مَجَاعَةٌ لَيَالِيَ خَيْبَرَ
 فَلَمَّا كَانَ يَوْمُ خَيْبَرَ وَقَعْنَا فِي الْحُمُرِ الأَهْلِيَّةِ فَانْتَحَرْنَاهَا فَلَمَّا غَلَتْ بِهَا الْقُدُورُ نَادَى
 مُنَادِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنِ اكْفَئُوا الْقُدُورَ وَلاَ تَأْكُلُوا مِنْ لُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ شَيْئًا
 - قَالَ - فَقَالَ نَاسٌ إِنَّمَا نَهَى عَنْهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لأَنَّهَا لَمْ تُخَمَّسْ
 ‏.‏ وَقَالَ آخَرُونَ نَهَى عَنْهَا أَلْبَتَّةَ ‏.‏
34.en: Sulaiman Shaibini reported: I heard Abdullah b. Abu Aufa say: We were smitten with hunger during the nights of Khaibar. On the Day of Khaibar, we fell upon domestic asses and we slaughtered them, and when our earthen pots boiled with them, the announcer of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made an annoancement that the earthen pots should be turned over, and nothing should be eaten of the flesh of the domestic asses. Some of the people said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had forbidden (the use of this flesh) for one-fifth (due to the State) has not been paid, while others said: He prohibited it for ever.
34.hi: Sulaiman Shaibini ne kaha: Maine Abdullah bin Abu Aufa ko ye kehte suna: Hum Khaibar ki raaton mein bhookh se pareshaan hue. Khaibar ke din, hum ghareloo gadhon par jhapat pade aur humne unhe zibah kiya, aur jab humare mitti ke bartan unke saath ubalte the, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke ailaan karne wale ne ailaan kiya ki mitti ke bartan ulTe kar diye jaayein, aur ghareloo gadhon ke gosht mein se kuch bhi na khaaya jaaye. Kuch logon ne kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (is gosht ke istemal se) mana kiya kyunki paanchvaan hissa (sarkaar ko deye jaane waala) ada nahi kiya gaya tha, jabki doosron ne kaha: Unhone ise hamesha ke liye mana kiya.

34.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَدِيٍّ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ ثَابِتٍ
 - قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ، وَعَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي أَوْفَى، يَقُولاَنِ أَصَبْنَا حُمُرًا فَطَبَخْنَاهَا فَنَادَى مُنَادِي
 رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم اكْفَئُوا الْقُدُورَ ‏.‏
34.en: 'Adi (he was the son of Thabit) said: I heard al-Bara' and 'Abdullah b. Abu Aufa say: We found domestic asses and we cooked them. Then the announcer of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made an announcement that the earthen pots should be turned over.
34.hi: Adi (jo Thabit ke bete the) ne kaha: Maine al-Bara aur Abdullah bin Abu Aufa ko ye kehte suna: Humein ghareloo gadhe mile aur humne unhe pakaaya. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke ailaan karne wale ne ailaan kiya ki mitti ke bartan ulTe kar diye jaayein.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ 
 أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ قَالَ الْبَرَاءُ أَصَبْنَا يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ حُمُرًا فَنَادَى مُنَادِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله
 عليه وسلم أَنِ اكْفَئُوا الْقُدُورَ ‏.‏
34.en: Al-Bara' said: We found on the Day of Khaibar domestic asses, and the announcer of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) made an announcement that the earthen pots should be turned over.
34.hi: Al-Bara ne kaha: Humein Khaibar ke din ghareloo gadhe mile, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke ailaan karne wale ne ailaan kiya ki mitti ke bartan ulTe kar diye jaayein.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ بِشْرٍ، عَنْ 
 مِسْعَرٍ، عَنْ ثَابِتِ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ، يَقُولُ نُهِينَا عَنْ لُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ الأَهْلِيَّةِ، ‏.‏
34.en: Bara was heard saying: We were forbidden (to eat) the flesh of the domestic asses.
34.hi: Bara ko ye kehte suna gaya: Humein ghareloo gadhon ke gosht (khaane) se mana kiya gaya.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ،
 قَالَ أَمَرَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ نُلْقِيَ لُحُومَ الْحُمُرِ الأَهْلِيَّةِ نِيئَةً وَنَضِيجَةً
 ثُمَّ لَمْ يَأْمُرْنَا بِأَكْلِهِ ‏.‏
34.en: Bara' b. 'Azib reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded us to throw away the flesh of domestic asses whether uncooked or cooked; he then never commanded us to eat that.
34.hi: Bara bin Azib ne riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein hukum diya ki ghareloo gadhon ke gosht ko phenk dein chahe kachcha ho ya pakaaya hua; unhone phir humein kabhi ise khaane ka hukum nahi diya.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ غِيَاثٍ - عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، بِهَذَا
 الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
34.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Asim with the same chain of transmitters.
34.hi: Ye hadees Asim ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ الأَزْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي،
 عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ لاَ أَدْرِي إِنَّمَا نَهَى عَنْهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله
 عليه وسلم مِنْ أَجْلِ أَنَّهُ كَانَ حَمُولَةَ النَّاسِ فَكَرِهَ أَنْ تَذْهَبَ حَمُولَتُهُمْ أَوْ حَرَّمَهُ فِي يَوْمِ
 خَيْبَرَ لُحُومَ الْحُمُرِ الأَهْلِيَّةِ ‏.‏
34.en: Ibn 'Abbas reported: I do not know whether Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited (the eating of the domestic ass) due to the fact that they were the beasts of burden for the people, so he (the Holy Prophet) did not like their beasts of burden to be destroyed (as a matter of expediency), or he prohibited the use of the flesh of domestic asses (not as an expediency but as a law of the Shari'ah) on the Day of Khaibar.
34.hi: Ibn Abbas ne riwayat ki: Mujhe nahi pata ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (ghareloo gadhe ko khaane se) mana is liye kiya kyunki woh logon ke bojh dhone waale jaanwar the, is liye unhe (Nabi-e-Paak ko) pasand nahi tha ki unke bojh dhone waale jaanwar tabaah ho jaayein (ek vyaavhaarikta ke maamle ke soorat mein), ya unhone ghareloo gadhon ke gosht ke istemal ko mana kiya (na vyaavhaarikta ke soorat mein balki Shariat ke qanoon ke soorat mein) Khaibar ke din.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ
 - عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي عُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ الأَكْوَعِ، قَالَ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم إِلَى خَيْبَرَ ثُمَّ إِنَّ اللَّهَ فَتَحَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ فَلَمَّا أَمْسَى النَّاسُ الْيَوْمَ الَّذِي فُتِحَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ أَوْقَدُوا
 نِيرَانًا كَثِيرَةً فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا هَذِهِ النِّيرَانُ عَلَى أَىِّ شَىْءٍ تُوقِدُونَ
 ‏"‏ قَالُوا عَلَى لَحْمٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ عَلَى أَىِّ لَحْمٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا عَلَى لَحْمِ حُمُرٍ إِنْسِيَّةٍ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَهْرِيقُوهَا وَاكْسِرُوهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَوْ نُهَرِيقُهَا
 وَنَغْسِلُهَا قَالَ ‏"‏ أَوْ ذَاكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
34.en: Salama b. Akwa' reported: We went to Khaibar with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Then Allah granted (us) victory over them. On that very evening of the day when they had been granted victory, they lit many fires. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: What are those fires and what for those have been lit? They said: (These have been lit) for (cooking) the flesh. Thereupon he said: Of what flesh? They said: For the flesh of the domestic asses. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (may peace bo upon him) said: Throw that away and break them (the earthen pots in which the fiesa was being cooked). A person said: Messenger of Allah, should we throw it away and wash them (the cooking pots)? He said: You may do so.
34.hi: Salama bin Akwa ne riwayat ki: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Khaibar gaye. Phir Allah ne (humein) unpar jeet di. Us din ki shaam jab unhe jeet mili, unhone bahut si aagen jalayin. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ye kaisi aagen hain aur ye kis liye jalaayi gayi hain? Unhone kaha: (Ye jalaayi gayi hain) gosht (pakaane) ke liye. Isper unhone kaha: Kaunsa gosht? Unhone kaha: Ghareloo gadhon ka gosht. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ise phenk do aur unhe (mitti ke bartanon ko jinmein gosht pakaya ja raha tha) toD do. Ek shakhs ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya humein ise phenk dena chahiye aur unhe (bartanon ko) dho lena chahiye? Unhone kaha: Tum aisa kar sakte ho.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ مَسْعَدَةَ، وَصَفْوَانُ بْنُ عِيسَى، ح
 وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ النَّضْرِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ النَّبِيلُ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي عُبَيْدٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ
 ‏.‏
34.en: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Yazid b. Abu Ubaid.
34.hi: Ye hadees Yazid bin Abu Ubaid ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ لَمَّا
 فَتَحَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَيْبَرَ أَصَبْنَا حُمُرًا خَارِجًا مِنَ الْقَرْيَةِ فَطَبَخْنَا مِنْهَا
 فَنَادَى مُنَادِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَلاَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ يَنْهَيَانِكُمْ عَنْهَا فَإِنَّهَا
 رِجْسٌ مِنْ عَمَلِ الشَّيْطَانِ ‏.‏ فَأُكْفِئَتِ الْقُدُورُ بِمَا فِيهَا وَإِنَّهَا لَتَفُورُ بِمَا فِيهَا ‏.‏
34.en: Anas reported: When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) conquered Khaibar, we caught hold of the asses outside the village. We cooked them (their flesh). Then the announcer of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made the announcement: Listen, verily Allah and His Messenger have prohibited you (the eating of) their (flesh), for it is a loathsome evil of Satan's doing. Then the earthen pots were turned over along with what was in them, and these were brimming (with flesh) at that time.
34.hi: Anas ne riwayat ki: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Khaibar fatah kiya, humne gaon ke bahar gadhe pakde. Humne unhe (unka gosht) pakaaya. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke ailaan karne wale ne ailaan kiya: Suno, yaqeenan Allah aur Uske Rasool ne tumhe (unka gosht khaane se) mana kiya hai, kyunki ye Shaitaan ke kaam ki ek ghinaunI burai hai. Phir mitti ke bartan unmein jo tha uske saath ulTe kar diye gaye, aur ye us waqt gosht se bhare hue the.

34.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ الضَّرِيرُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ حَسَّانَ،
 عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ لَمَّا كَانَ يَوْمُ خَيْبَرَ جَاءَ جَاءٍ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ
 اللَّهِ أُكِلَتِ الْحُمُرُ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ جَاءَ آخَرُ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أُفْنِيَتِ الْحُمُرُ فَأَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم أَبَا طَلْحَةَ فَنَادَى إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ يَنْهَيَانِكُمْ عَنْ لُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ فَإِنَّهَا رِجْسٌ
 أَوْ نَجِسٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأُكْفِئَتِ الْقُدُورُ بِمَا فِيهَا ‏.‏
34.en: Anas b. Malik reported: When it was the Day of Khaibar a visitor came and said: Messenger of Allah, the asses have been eaten. Then another came and said: Messenger of Allah, the asses are being destroyed. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded Abu Talha to make an announcement that Allah and His Messenger have prohibited you (from eating) of the flesh of (domestic) asses, for these are loathsome or impure. He (the narrator) said: The earthein pots were turned over along with what was in them.
34.hi: Anas bin Malik ne riwayat ki: Jab Khaibar ka din tha ek visitor aaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, gadhe khaaye ja chuke hain. Phir doosra aaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, gadhe barbaad kiye jaa rahe hain. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Abu Talha ko hukum diya ki woh ailaan karein ki Allah aur Uske Rasool ne tumhe (ghareloo) gadhon ke gosht se mana kiya hai, kyunki ye ghinaune ya apavitra hain. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Mitti ke bartan unmein jo tha uske saath ulTe kar diye gaye.

34.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الْعَتَكِيُّ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِيَحْيَى
 - قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ،
 بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ عَنْ
 لُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ الأَهْلِيَّةِ وَأَذِنَ فِي لُحُومِ الْخَيْلِ ‏.‏
34.en: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited eating of the flesh of domestic asses on the Day of Khaibar, and permitted the cooking of the flesh of horses.
34.hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Khaibar ke din ghareloo gadhon ke gosht khaane se mana kiya, aur ghodon ke gosht pakaane ki ijazat di.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو
 الزُّبَيْرِ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ أَكَلْنَا زَمَنَ خَيْبَرَ الْخَيْلَ وَحُمُرَ الْوَحْشِ وَنَهَانَا
 النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْحِمَارِ الأَهْلِيِّ ‏.‏
34.en: Jabir b. 'Abdullah is reported to have said: We ate during the time of Khaibar the (flesh) of horses and of wild asses, but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited us (to eat) the flesh of domestic asses.
34.hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne kaha: Humne Khaibar ke daurane ghodon aur jangli gadhon ka (gosht) khaaya, lekin Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein ghareloo gadhon ke gosht se mana kiya.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي يَعْقُوبُ الدَّوْرَقِيُّ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ،
 عُثْمَانَ النَّوْفَلِيُّ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
34.en: This hadith has hen transmitted on the authority of Ibn Juraij.
34.hi: Ye hadees Ibn Juraij ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي وَحَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ، وَوَكِيعٌ، عَنْ 
 هِشَامٍ، عَنْ فَاطِمَةَ، عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ، قَالَتْ نَحَرْنَا فَرَسًا عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم فَأَكَلْنَاهُ ‏.‏
34.en: Asma' reported: We slaughtered a horse and ate it during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).
34.hi: Asma ne riwayat ki: Humne ek ghoda zibah kiya aur use khaaya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو
 أُسَامَةَ كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ هِشَامٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
34.en: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Hisham.
34.hi: Ye hadees Hisham ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

34.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالَ
 يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ ابْنَ عُمَرَ،
 يَقُولُ سُئِلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الضَّبِّ فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ لَسْتُ بِآكِلِهِ وَلاَ مُحَرِّمِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
34.en: Ibn 'Umar reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked about the eating of (the flesh) of the lizard, whereupon he said: I am neither the eater of it nor its prohibitor.
34.hi: Ibn Umar ne riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se chhipkali (ke gosht) khaane ke baare mein poocha gaya, isper unhone kaha: Main na to iske khaane wale mein se hoon na hi iske mana karne wale mein se.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ 
 نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ سَأَلَ رَجُلٌ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ أَكْلِ الضَّبِّ فَقَالَ
 ‏
"‏ لاَ آكُلُهُ وَلاَ أُحَرِّمُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
34.en: Ibn 'Umar reported: A person asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about the eating of the lizard, whereupon he said. I neither eat it, nor do I prohibit it.
