34.hi: Ibn Umar ne riwayat ki: Ek shakhs ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se chhipkali khaane ke baare mein poocha, isper unhone kaha: Main na to ise khaata hoon, na hi ise mana karta hoon.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ 
 ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ سَأَلَ رَجُلٌ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ عَنْ أَكْلِ الضَّبِّ
 فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ لاَ آكُلُهُ وَلاَ أُحَرِّمُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
34.en: Ibn 'Umar reported that a person asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as he was sitting on the pulpit about the eating of the lizard, whereupon he said: I neither eat it, nor do I prohibit it.
34.hi: Ibn Umar ne riwayat ki ki ek shakhs ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se, jab woh mimbar par baithe the, chhipkali khaane ke baare mein poocha, isper unhone kaha: Main na to ise khaata hoon, na hi ise mana karta hoon.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، بِمِثْلِهِ فِي هَذَا الإِسْنَادِ
 ‏.‏
34.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Ubaidullah with the same chain of transmitters.
34.hi: Ye hadees Ubaidullah ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا 
 إِسْمَاعِيلُ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ مِغْوَلٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي 
 هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ،
 اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا شُجَاعُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُوسَى بْنَ عُقْبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ،
 الأَيْلِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أُسَامَةُ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله
 عليه وسلم فِي الضَّبِّ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ اللَّيْثِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ غَيْرَ أَنَّ حَدِيثَ أَيُّوبَ أُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم بِضَبٍّ فَلَمْ يَأْكُلْهُ وَلَمْ يُحَرِّمْهُ وَفِي حَدِيثِ أُسَامَةَ قَالَ قَامَ رَجُلٌ فِي
 الْمَسْجِدِ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ ‏.‏
34.en: A hadith pertaining to the eating of the lizard is transmitted from the Prophet (ﷺ) on the authority of Ibn 'Umar, but in this very hadith narrated through a different chain of transmitters there is a slight variation of wording (and the words are): " A lizard was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) but he neither ate that nor declared it unlawful." And in the hadith transmitted through Usama (the words are):" The man (inquirer) was standing in the mosque and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was sitting on the pulpit."
34.hi: Chhipkali khaane se mutaliq ek hadees Nabi (SAW) se Ibn Umar ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin isi hadees mein ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai alfaazon mein thodi tabdeeli ke saath (aur alfaaz hain): "Ek chhipkali Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laayi gayi lekin unhone na to use khaaya na hi ise na-jaayez ailaan kiya." Aur Usama ke zariye riwayat ki hui hadees mein (alfaaz hain): "Woh aadmi (poochhne wala) masjid mein khada tha aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mimbar par baithe the."

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ تَوْبَةَ الْعَنْبَرِيِّ، سَمِعَ الشَّعْبِيَّ،
 سَمِعَ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ مَعَهُ نَاسٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ فِيهِمْ سَعْدٌ وَأُتُوا
 بِلَحْمِ ضَبٍّ فَنَادَتِ امْرَأَةٌ مِنْ نِسَاءِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِنَّهُ لَحْمُ ضَبٍّ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ كُلُوا فَإِنَّهُ حَلاَلٌ وَلَكِنَّهُ لَيْسَ مِنْ طَعَامِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
34.en: Ibn 'Umar reported that there were some persons with Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) from among his Companions, Sa'd being one of them. There was brought to them the flesh of the lizard when a lady amongst the wives of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: It is the flesh of the lizard. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) said: Eat, for it is lawful, but it is not my diet.
34.hi: Ibn Umar ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath unke kuch sahaba the, Sa'd bhi unmein se ek the. Unhe chhipkali ka gosht laaya gaya jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zaujaon mein se ek khaatoon ne kaha: Ye chhipkali ka gosht hai. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Khaao, kyunki ye jaayez hai, lekin ye mera khaana nahi hai.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ تَوْبَةَ الْعَنْبَرِيِّ،
 قَالَ قَالَ لِي الشَّعْبِيُّ أَرَأَيْتَ حَدِيثَ الْحَسَنِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَاعَدْتُ ابْنَ
 عُمَرَ قَرِيبًا مِنْ سَنَتَيْنِ أَوْ سَنَةٍ وَنِصْفٍ فَلَمْ أَسْمَعْهُ رَوَى عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 غَيْرَ هَذَا قَالَ كَانَ نَاسٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِيهِمْ سَعْدٌ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ
 مُعَاذٍ ‏.‏
34.en: Taubat Al-'Anbari reported: Al-Sha'bi (one of the narrators) asked me if I had heard the hadith transmitted on the authority of Hasan from the Prophet (ﷺ). He said: I sat in the company if Ibn 'Umar for two years or a year and a half but I did not hear narrated from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) but this one (pertaining to the flesh of the lizard) as narrated by Mu'adh.
34.hi: Taubat Al-Anbari ne riwayat ki: Al-Sha'bi (raawiyon mein se ek) ne mujhse poocha ki kya maine Hasan ke zariye Nabi (SAW) se riwayat ki gayi hadees suni hai. Unhone kaha: Main Ibn Umar ki sohbat mein do saal ya Dedh saal baitha lekin maine unhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se sirf yehi ek hadees riwayat karte suna (chhipkali ke gosht se mutaliq) jaisi Mu'adh ke zariye riwayat ki gayi.

34.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ،
 بْنِ سَهْلِ بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ دَخَلْتُ أَنَا وَخَالِدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ، مَعَ رَسُولِ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْتَ مَيْمُونَةَ فَأُتِيَ بِضَبٍّ مَحْنُوذٍ فَأَهْوَى إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم بِيَدِهِ فَقَالَ بَعْضُ النِّسْوَةِ اللاَّتِي فِي بَيْتِ مَيْمُونَةَ أَخْبِرُوا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم بِمَا يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ ‏.‏ فَرَفَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدَهُ فَقُلْتُ أَحَرَامٌ
 هُوَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏
"‏ لاَ وَلَكِنَّهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ بِأَرْضِ قَوْمِي فَأَجِدُنِي أَعَافُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ خَالِدٌ
 فَاجْتَرَرْتُهُ فَأَكَلْتُهُ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَنْظُرُ ‏.‏
34.en: 'Abdullah b. 'Abbas reported: I and Khalid b. Walid went to the apartment of Maimuna along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and there was presented to him a roasted lizard. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stretched his hand towards It, whereupon some of the women who had been in the house of Maimuna said: Inform Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) what he intends to eat. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) lifted his hand. I said: Messenger of Allah, Is it forbidden? He said: No. It is not found in the land of my people, and I feel that I have no liking for it. Khalid said: I then chewed and ate it, while, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was looking (at me).
34.hi: Abdullah bin Abbas ne riwayat ki: Main aur Khalid bin Walid Maimuna ke kamre mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath gaye, aur unhe ek bhuni hui chhipkali pesh ki gayi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apna haath iski taraf badhaaya, isper Maimuna ke ghar mein maujood kuch auraton ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko bataao ki woh kya khaane wale hain. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apna haath uThA liya. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya ye mana hai? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Ye mere logon ki zameen mein nahi milti, aur mujhe lagta hai ki mujhe isse koi ruchi nahi hai. Khalid ne kaha: Maine phir ise chaba kar khaaya, jabki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mujhe dekh rahe the.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ حَرْمَلَةُ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ،
 أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ بْنِ سَهْلِ بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ،
 بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ خَالِدَ بْنَ الْوَلِيدِ الَّذِي يُقَالُ لَهُ سَيْفُ اللَّهِ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، دَخَلَ مَعَ رَسُولِ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى مَيْمُونَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهِيَ خَالَتُهُ وَخَالَةُ
 ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فَوَجَدَ عِنْدَهَا ضَبًّا مَحْنُوذًا قَدِمَتْ بِهِ أُخْتُهَا حُفَيْدَةُ بِنْتُ الْحَارِثِ مِنْ نَجْدٍ فَقَدَّمَتِ
 الضَّبَّ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَكَانَ قَلَّمَا يُقَدَّمُ إِلَيْهِ طَعَامٌ حَتَّى يُحَدَّثَ بِهِ وَيُسَمَّى
 لَهُ فَأَهْوَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدَهُ إِلَى الضَّبِّ فَقَالَتِ امْرَأَةٌ مِنَ النِّسْوَةِ الْحُضُورِ
 أَخْبِرْنَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَا قَدَّمْتُنَّ لَهُ ‏.‏ قُلْنَ هُوَ الضَّبُّ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏
 فَرَفَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدَهُ فَقَالَ خَالِدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ أَحَرَامٌ الضَّبُّ يَا رَسُولَ
 اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏
"‏ لاَ وَلَكِنَّهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ بِأَرْضِ قَوْمِي فَأَجِدُنِي أَعَافُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ خَالِدٌ فَاجْتَرَرْتُهُ فَأَكَلْتُهُ
 وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَنْظُرُ فَلَمْ يَنْهَنِي ‏.‏
34.en: 'Abdullah b. 'Abbas reported that Khalid b. Walid who is called the Sword of Allah had informed him that he visited Maimuna, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and she was the sister of his mother (that of Khalid) and that of 'Ibn Abbas, and he found with her a roasted lizard which her sister Hufaida the daughter of al-Harith had brought from Najd, and she presented that lizard to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). It was rare that some food was presented to the Prophet (ﷺ) and it was not mentioned or named. While Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was about to stretch forth his hand towards the lizard, a woman from amongst the women present there informed the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) what they had presented to him. They said: Messenger of Allah, it is a lizard. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) withdrew his hand, whereupon Khalid b. Walid said: Messenger of Allah, is a lizard forbidden? There opon he said: No, but it is not found in the land of my people, and I feel that I have no liking for it. Khalid said: I then chewed and ate it, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was looking at me and he did not forbid (me to eat it).
34.hi: Abdullah bin Abbas ne riwayat ki ki Khalid bin Walid, jinhe Allah ki Talwaar kaha jaata hai, ne unhe bataya ki woh Maimuna, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, se milne gaye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein, aur woh unki (yaani Khalid ki) maa ki behn thin aur Ibn Abbas ki bhi, aur unhe unke paas ek bhuni hui chhipkali mili jise unki behn Hufaida, al-Harith ki beti, Najd se laayi thin, aur unhone woh chhipkali Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko pesh ki. Ye bahut kam hota tha ki koi khaana Nabi (SAW) ko pesh kiya jaaye aur uska zikr ya naam na liya jaaye. Jaise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apna haath chhipkali ki taraf badhaane hi waale the, wahan maujood auraton mein se ek ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko bataya jo unhe pesh kiya gaya tha. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye ek chhipkali hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apna haath waapas kheench liya, isper Khalid bin Walid ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya chhipkali mana hai? Isper unhone kaha: Nahi, lekin ye mere logon ki zameen mein nahi milti, aur mujhe lagta hai ki mujhe isse koi ruchi nahi hai. Khalid ne kaha: Maine phir ise chaba kar khaaya, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mujhe dekh rahe the aur unhone mujhe (ise khaane se) mana nahi kiya.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ النَّضْرِ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ عَبْدٌ أَخْبَرَنِي وَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا 
 يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي،
 أُمَامَةَ بْنِ سَهْلٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّهُ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ خَالِدَ بْنَ الْوَلِيدِ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، دَخَلَ مَعَ رَسُولِ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى مَيْمُونَةَ بِنْتِ الْحَارِثِ وَهْىَ خَالَتُهُ فَقُدِّمَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم لَحْمُ ضَبٍّ جَاءَتْ بِهِ أُمُّ حُفَيْدٍ بِنْتُ الْحَارِثِ مِنْ نَجْدٍ وَكَانَتْ تَحْتَ رَجُلٍ مِنْ
 بَنِي جَعْفَرٍ وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لاَ يَأْكُلُ شَيْئًا حَتَّى يَعْلَمَ مَا هُوَ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ
 ذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ يُونُسَ وَزَادَ فِي آخِرِ الْحَدِيثِ وَحَدَّثَهُ ابْنُ الأَصَمِّ عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ وَكَانَ فِي
 حَجْرِهَا ‏.‏
34.en: Khalid b. Walid reported that he visited Maimuna daughter of al-Harith with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and she was the sister of his mother. She presented to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) the flesh of a lizard which Umm Hufaid daughter of al-Harith had brought from Najd, and she had been married to a person belonging to Banu Ja'far. It was the habit of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) not to eat anything until he knew what that was. The rest of the hadith is the same but with this (addition): " Ibn al-Asamm narrated it from Maimuna and he was under her care."
34.hi: Khalid bin Walid ne riwayat ki ki woh Maimuna, al-Harith ki beti, se milne gaye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath, aur woh unki maa ki behn thin. Unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko chhipkali ka gosht pesh kiya jo Umm Hufaid, al-Harith ki beti, Najd se laayi thin, aur unki shaadi Banu Ja'far se mutaliq ek shakhs se hui thi. Ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki aadat thi ki woh kuch bhi tab tak nahi khaate jab tak unhe pata na chale ki ye kya hai. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai lekin is (izafe) ke saath: "Ibn al-Asamm ne ise Maimuna se riwayat ki aur woh unki dekhbhaal mein the."

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي،
 أُمَامَةَ بْنِ سَهْلِ بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ أُتِيَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَنَحْنُ فِي
 بَيْتِ مَيْمُونَةَ بِضَبَّيْنِ مَشْوِيَّيْنِ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِهِمْ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ يَزِيدَ بْنَ الأَصَمِّ عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ ‏.‏
34.en: Ibn 'Abbas reported: While we were in the house of Maimuna there were brought to Allah's Messenger two roasted lizards. Here no mention is made of al- 'Asamm narrating from Maimuna.
34.hi: Ibn Abbas ne riwayat ki: Jab hum Maimuna ke ghar mein the, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko do bhuni hui chhipkaliyaan laayi gayin. Yahan al-Asamm ke Maimuna se riwayat karne ka koi zikr nahi hai.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، حَدَّثَنِي خَالِدُ بْنُ،
 يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي هِلاَلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، أَنَّ أَبَا أُمَامَةَ بْنَ سَهْلٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ عَنِ ابْنِ،
 عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ أُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ فِي بَيْتِ مَيْمُونَةَ وَعِنْدَهُ خَالِدُ بْنُ
 الْوَلِيدِ بِلَحْمِ ضَبٍّ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ‏.‏
34.en: Ibn 'Abbas reported that there had been brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) the flesh of a lizard and Khalid b. Walid was also present there. The rest of the hadith is the same.
34.hi: Ibn Abbas ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko chhipkali ka gosht laaya gaya aur Khalid bin Walid bhi wahan maujood the. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ قَالَ ابْنُ نَافِعٍ أَخْبَرَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا 
 شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، يَقُولُ أَهْدَتْ خَالَتِي أُمُّ
 حُفَيْدٍ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَمْنًا وَأَقِطًا وَأَضُبًّا فَأَكَلَ مِنَ السَّمْنِ وَالأَقِطِ
 وَتَرَكَ الضَّبَّ تَقَذُّرًا وَأُكِلَ عَلَى مَائِدَةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلَوْ كَانَ حَرَامًا مَا
 أُكِلَ عَلَى مَائِدَةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
34.en: Sa'id b. Jubair reported that he heard Ibn 'Abbas says: The sister of my mother Umm Hufaid presented to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) clarified butter (ghee), cheese and some lizards. He ate out of the clarified butter and cheese, but left the lizard finding no liking for it. But it was eaten on the table of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Had it been forbidden (haram), it could not be eaten on the table of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).
34.hi: Sa'id bin Jubair ne riwayat ki ki unhone Ibn Abbas ko ye kehte suna: Meri maa ki behn Umm Hufaid ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ghee, panir, aur kuch chhipkaliyaan pesh kin. Unhone ghee aur panir khaaya, lekin chhipkali chhod di kyunki unhe isse koi ruchi nahi thi. Lekin ise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki meiz par khaaya gaya. Agar ye mana (haram) hoti, to ise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki meiz par nahi khaaya jaa sakta.

34.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنِ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ،
 الأَصَمِّ قَالَ دَعَانَا عَرُوسٌ بِالْمَدِينَةِ فَقَرَّبَ إِلَيْنَا ثَلاَثَةَ عَشَرَ ضَبًّا فَآكِلٌ وَتَارِكٌ فَلَقِيتُ
 ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ مِنَ الْغَدِ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ فَأَكْثَرَ الْقَوْمُ حَوْلَهُ حَتَّى قَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ آكُلُهُ وَلاَ أَنْهَى عَنْهُ وَلاَ أُحَرِّمُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ بِئْسَ مَا قُلْتُمْ
 مَا بُعِثَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلاَّ مُحِلاًّ وَمُحَرِّمًا إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم بَيْنَمَا هُوَ عِنْدَ مَيْمُونَةَ وَعِنْدَهُ الْفَضْلُ بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ وَخَالِدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ وَامْرَأَةٌ أُخْرَى إِذْ
 قُرِّبَ إِلَيْهِمْ خِوَانٌ عَلَيْهِ لَحْمٌ فَلَمَّا أَرَادَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَأْكُلَ قَالَتْ لَهُ مَيْمُونَةُ
 إِنَّهُ لَحْمُ ضَبٍّ ‏.‏ فَكَفَّ يَدَهُ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَذَا لَحْمٌ لَمْ آكُلْهُ قَطُّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ لَهُمْ ‏"‏ كُلُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَكَلَ
 مِنْهُ الْفَضْلُ وَخَالِدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ وَالْمَرْأَةُ ‏.‏ وَقَالَتْ مَيْمُونَةُ لاَ آكُلُ مِنْ شَىْءٍ إِلاَّ شَىْءٌ يَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ
 رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
34.en: Yazid b. al-Asamm reported: A newly wedded person of Medina invited us to a wedding feast, and he served us thirteen lizards. There were those who ate it and those who abandoned it. I met Ibn 'Abbas the next day, and informed him (about this) in the presence of many persons. Some of them said that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had observed: I neither eat it nor forbid (anyone) from eating it, nor declare it to be unlawful. Thereupon Ibn 'Abbas said: Sad it is what you say! Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) has not been sent, but (to declare in clear words) the lawful and the unlawful (things). We were once with Allah's Messenger (may peace be. upon him) as he was with Maimuna, and there were with him al-Fadl b. 'Abbas, Khalid b. Walid and some women (also) when a tray of food containing flesh was presented to him. As Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) was about to eat that, Maimuna said: It is the flesh of the lizard. He withdrew his hand saying: That is the flesh which I never eat; but he said to them (those who were present there): You may eat. Al-Fadl ate out of that, so did Khalid b Walid, and the women. Maimuna (however) said: I do not eat anything but that which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) eats.
34.hi: Yazid bin al-Asamm ne riwayat ki: Madina ke ek nayi shaadi kiye hue shakhs ne humein shaadi ki daawat par bulaaya, aur usne humein terah chhipkaliyaan serve ki. Kuchne unhe khaaya aur kuchne chhoDa. Main agle din Ibn Abbas se mila aur unhe (iske baare mein) bataya bahut se logon ki maujoodgi mein. Unmein se kuchne kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha tha: Main na to ise khaata hoon na hi (kisi ko) khaane se mana karta hoon, na hi ise na-jaayez ailaan karta hoon. Isper Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Ye bahut afsos ki baat hai jo tum keh rahe ho! Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko sirf is liye bheja gaya hai ki woh (saaf alfaazon mein) jaayez aur na-jaayez cheezon ka ailaan karein. Hum ek baar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath the jab woh Maimuna ke saath the, aur unke saath al-Fadl bin Abbas, Khalid bin Walid aur kuch auraten (bhi) thin jab unhe gosht waali khaane ki ek thaali pesh ki gayi. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ise khaane hi waale the, Maimuna ne kaha: Ye chhipkali ka gosht hai. Unhone apna haath waapas kheench liya ye kehte hue: Ye woh gosht hai jo main kabhi nahi khaata; lekin unhone unse (jo wahan maujood the) kaha: Tum khaa sakte ho. Al-Fadl ne usmein se khaaya, aur Khalid bin Walid ne bhi, aur auraton ne bhi. Maimuna (halaanki) ne kaha: Main kuch bhi nahi khaati siwaay uske jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khaate hain.

34.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنِ ابْنِ،
 جُرَيْجٍ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ أُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم بِضَبٍّ فَأَبَى أَنْ يَأْكُلَ مِنْهُ وَقَالَ ‏
"‏ لاَ أَدْرِي لَعَلَّهُ مِنَ الْقُرُونِ الَّتِي مُسِخَتْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
34.en: Abu Zubair reported that he heard Jabir b. 'Abdullah saying that there was presented to Allah's Messenger (the flesh) of the lizard, but he refused to eat that, saying: I do not know; perhaps it (lizard) might (be one of those natives of) the distant past whose (forms) had beer, distorted.
34.hi: Abu Zubair ne riwayat ki ki unhone Jabir bin Abdullah ko ye kehte suna ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko chhipkali ka gosht pesh kiya gaya, lekin unhone use khaane se inkaar kiya, ye kehte hue: Mujhe nahi pata; shayad ye (chhipkali) (un logon mein se ek ho) jo bahut pehle ke daur ke the jinke (soorat) vikrit kiye gaye the.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي سَلَمَةُ بْنُ شَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ أَعْيَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْقِلٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ،
 قَالَ سَأَلْتُ جَابِرًا عَنِ الضَّبِّ، فَقَالَ لاَ تَطْعَمُوهُ ‏.‏ وَقَذِرَهُ وَقَالَ قَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ إِنَّ
 النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمْ يُحَرِّمْهُ ‏.‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ يَنْفَعُ بِهِ غَيْرَ وَاحِدٍ فَإِنَّمَا طَعَامُ
 عَامَّةِ الرِّعَاءِ مِنْهُ وَلَوْ كَانَ عِنْدِي طَعِمْتُهُ ‏.‏
34.en: Abu Zubair reported: I asked Jabir about ithe eating) of the lizard, whereupon he said: Don't eat that as he (the Holy Prophet) felt disgust. He (the narrator) said that Umar b. al-Khattab reminded: Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) did not declare it to be unlawful. Allah, the Exalted and Majestic, has (made it a source) of benefit for more than one (persons). It is a common diet of the shepherds. Had it been with me, I would have eaten that.
34.hi: Abu Zubair ne riwayat ki: Maine Jabir se chhipkali (khaane) ke baare mein poocha, isper unhone kaha: Ise mat khaao kyunki unhe (Nabi-e-Paak ko) ghrina mehsoos hui. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha ki Umar bin al-Khattab ne yaad dilaaya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ise na-jaayez ailaan nahi kiya. Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne ise (ek se zyada logon ke liye) faayde ka srot banaaya hai. Ye gadariyon ka aam khaana hai. Agar ye mere paas hoti, to main use khaata.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ 
 أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّا بِأَرْضٍ مَضَبَّةٍ فَمَا تَأْمُرُنَا أَوْ فَمَا تُفْتِينَا قَالَ
 ‏
"‏ ذُكِرَ لِي أَنَّ أُمَّةً مِنْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ مُسِخَتْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلَمْ يَأْمُرْ وَلَمْ يَنْهَ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ فَلَمَّا
 كَانَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ قَالَ عُمَرُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ لَيَنْفَعُ بِهِ غَيْرَ وَاحِدٍ وَإِنَّهُ لَطَعَامُ عَامَّةِ هَذِهِ الرِّعَاءِ
 وَلَوْ كَانَ عِنْدِي لَطَعِمْتُهُ إِنَّمَا عَافَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
34.en: Abu Sa'id reported that a person said: Messenger of Allah, we live in a land abounding in lizards, so what do you command or what verdict you give (about eating of it)? Thereupon he said: It was mentioned to me that a people from among Bani Isra'il were distorted (so there is a likelihood that those people might have been distorted in the shape of lizards). So he neither commanded (us to eat that) nor forbade (us). Abu Sa'id said: After some time Umar said: Allah, the Exalted and Majestic, has made it (a source of) benefit for more than one (person), for it is the common diet of shepherds. Had it been with me, I would have eaten that. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) disliked it.
34.hi: Abu Sa'id ne riwayat ki ki ek shakhs ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, hum aisi zameen mein rehte hain jahan chhipkaliyaan bahutayat mein hain, is liye aap kya hukum dete hain ya iske (khaane ke) baare mein kya faisla dete hain? Isper unhone kaha: Mujhe bataaya gaya tha ki Banu Isra'il ke kuch log vikrit kiye gaye the (is liye ye sambhaavna hai ki woh log chhipkaliyon ke soorat mein vikrit ho gaye hon). Is liye unhone na to (humein ise khaane ka) hukum diya na hi (humein) mana kiya. Abu Sa'id ne kaha: Kuch waqt baad Umar ne kaha: Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne ise (ek se zyada logon ke liye) faayde ka srot banaaya hai, kyunki ye gadariyon ka aam khaana hai. Agar ye mere paas hoti, to main ise khaata. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ise napasand karte the.

34.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَقِيلٍ الدَّوْرَقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نَضْرَةَ،
 عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، أَنَّ أَعْرَابِيًّا، أَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ إِنِّي فِي غَائِطٍ مَضَبَّةٍ
 وَإِنَّهُ عَامَّةُ طَعَامِ أَهْلِي - قَالَ - فَلَمْ يُجِبْهُ فَقُلْنَا عَاوِدْهُ ‏.‏ فَعَاوَدَهُ فَلَمْ يُجِبْهُ ثَلاَثًا ثُمَّ
 نَادَاهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الثَّالِثَةِ فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ يَا أَعْرَابِيُّ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَعَنَ أَوْ غَضِبَ
 عَلَى سِبْطٍ مِنْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ فَمَسَخَهُمْ دَوَابَّ يَدِبُّونَ فِي الأَرْضِ فَلاَ أَدْرِي لَعَلَّ هَذَا مِنْهَا
 فَلَسْتُ آكُلُهَا وَلاَ أَنْهَى عَنْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
34.en: Abu Sa'id reported that an Arab of the desert came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: I live in a low land abounding in lizards, and these are the common diet of my family, but he (the Holy Prophet) did not make any reply. We said to him: Repeat it (your problem) and so he repeated it, but he did not make any reply. (It was repeated thrice ) Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) called him out at the third time saying: O man of the desert, verily Allah cursed or showed wrath to a tribe of Bani Isra'il and distorted them to beasts which move on the earth. I do not know, perhaps this (lizard) may be one of them. So I do not eat it, nor do I prohibit the eating of it.
34.hi: Abu Sa'id ne riwayat ki ki registaan ka ek Arab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Main ek neechi zameen mein rehta hoon jahan chhipkaliyaan bahutayat mein hain, aur ye mere khaandaan ka aam khaana hai, lekin unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) koi jawaab nahi diya. Humne unse kaha: Ise (apni samasya ko) dohraao, aur unhone dohraaya, lekin unhone koi jawaab nahi diya. (Ise teen baar dohraaya gaya.) Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne teesri baar unhe bulaaya ye kehte hue: Aye registaan ke aadmi, yaqeenan Allah ne Banu Isra'il ke ek qabile par laanat ki ya gussa dikhaaya aur unhe zameen par chalne waale jaanwaron mein vikrit kiya. Mujhe nahi pata, shayad ye (chhipkali) unmein se ek ho. Is liye main ise nahi khaata, na hi ise khaane se mana karta hoon.

34.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي يَعْفُورٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ،
 أَبِي أَوْفَى قَالَ غَزَوْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَبْعَ غَزَوَاتٍ نَأْكُلُ الْجَرَادَ
 ‏.‏
34.en: Ibn Abu Aufa reported: We went on seven expeditions with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and ate locusts.
34.hi: Ibn Abu Aufa ne riwayat ki: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath saat muhimon par gaye aur tiddiyaan khaayi.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، جَمِيعًا
 عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي يَعْفُورٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ سَبْعَ غَزَوَاتٍ وَقَالَ
 إِسْحَاقُ سِتَّ وَقَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ سِتَّ أَوْ سَبْعَ ‏.‏
34.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Ya'fur with the same chain of transmitters. Abu Bakr (one of the narrators) said" seven expeditions," whereas Ishaq said" six," and Ibn Umar said" six" or" seven".
34.hi: Ye hadees Abu Ya'fur ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai. Abu Bakr (ek raawi) ne kaha "saat muhimein," jabki Ishaq ne kaha "chhe," aur Ibn Umar ne kaha "chhe" ya "saat".

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ بَشَّارٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ،
 بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي يَعْفُورٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ سَبْعَ غَزَوَاتٍ ‏.‏
34.en: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Abu Ya'fur with the same chain of transmitters, and he mentioned seven expeditions.
34.hi: Ye hadees Abu Ya'fur ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, aur unhone saat muhimon ka zikr kiya.

34.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ،
 عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ مَرَرْنَا فَاسْتَنْفَجْنَا أَرْنَبًا بِمَرِّ الظَّهْرَانِ فَسَعَوْا عَلَيْهِ فَلَغَبُوا ‏.‏ قَالَ
 فَسَعَيْتُ حَتَّى أَدْرَكْتُهَا فَأَتَيْتُ بِهَا أَبَا طَلْحَةَ فَذَبَحَهَا فَبَعَثَ بِوَرِكِهَا وَفَخِذَيْهَا إِلَى رَسُولِ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَتَيْتُ بِهَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَبِلَهُ ‏.‏
34.en: Anas b. Malik reported: We chased a hare at Marr az-Zahrin (a valley near Mecca). They (my companions) ran, but felt exhausted; I also tried until I caught hold of it. I brought it to Abu Talha. He slaughtered it and sent its haunch and two hind legs to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) through me; and he accepted them.
34.hi: Anas bin Malik ne riwayat ki: Humne Marr az-Zahrin (Makkah ke qareeb ek wadi) mein ek khargosh ka picha kiya. Woh (mere saathi) daude, lekin thak gaye; maine bhi koshish ki yahan tak ki maine use pakad liya. Main ise Abu Talha ke paas laaya. Unhone ise zibah kiya aur iski jaangh aur do peechhle taangein mere zariye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas bhejin; aur unhone unhe qubool kiya.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا 
 خَالِدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْحَارِثِ - كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَفِي حَدِيثِ يَحْيَى بِوَرِكِهَا
 أَوْ فَخِذَيْهَا ‏.‏
34.en: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Yahya with a slight change of wording.
34.hi: Ye hadees Yahya ki sanad se alfaazon mein halke badlaav ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

34.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا كَهْمَسٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، قَالَ
 رَأَى عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُغَفَّلِ رَجُلاً مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ يَخْذِفُ فَقَالَ لَهُ لاَ تَخْذِفْ فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَكْرَهُ - أَوْ قَالَ - يَنْهَى عَنِ الْخَذْفِ فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يُصْطَادُ بِهِ الصَّيْدُ وَلاَ
 يُنْكَأُ بِهِ الْعَدُوُّ وَلَكِنَّهُ يَكْسِرُ السِّنَّ وَيَفْقَأُ الْعَيْنَ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ رَآهُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ يَخْذِفُ فَقَالَ لَهُ أُخْبِرُكَ
 أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَكْرَهُ أَوْ يَنْهَى عَنِ الْخَذْفِ ثُمَّ أَرَاكَ تَخْذِفُ لاَ أُكَلِّمُكَ
 كَلِمَةً كَذَا وَكَذَا ‏.‏
34.en: Ibn Buraida reported that Abdullah b. al-Mughaffal saw a person from amongst his companions throwing small pebbles, whereupon he said: Don't throw pebbles. for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not like it, or he forbade flinging of pebbles since neither the game is taken thereby, nor an enemy defeated. but it may break a tooth or put out an eye. He, afterwards, again saw him flinging pebbles, and said to him: I inform you that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not approve or he forbade flinging of pebbles, but if I see you again flinging pebbles. I will not speak with you.
34.hi: Ibn Buraida ne riwayat ki ki Abdullah bin al-Mughaffal ne apne saathiyon mein se ek ko choti kankariyaan phenkte dekha, isper unhone kaha: Kankariyaan mat phenko, kyunki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ise pasand nahi karte the, ya unhone kankariyaan phenkne se mana kiya kyunki isse na to shikaar pakda jaata hai, na hi dushman ko shikast di jaati hai, lekin ye ek daant tod sakti hai ya aankh nikaal sakti hai. Unhone, baad mein, unhe dobara kankariyaan phenkte dekha, aur unse kaha: Main tumhe bataata hoon ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kankariyaan phenkna manzoor nahi kiya, ya isse mana kiya, lekin agar main tumhe dobara kankariyaan phenkte dekhta hoon, main tumse baat nahi karunga.

34.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو دَاوُدَ، سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ مَعْبَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، أَخْبَرَنَا كَهْمَسٌ، بِهَذَا
 الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
34.en: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Kahmas.
34.hi: Ye hadees Kahmas ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، قَالاَ
 حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ صُهْبَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُغَفَّلٍ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْخَذْفِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ جَعْفَرٍ فِي حَدِيثِهِ وَقَالَ إِنَّهُ لاَ يَنْكَأُ الْعَدُوَّ وَلاَ
 يَقْتُلُ الصَّيْدَ وَلَكِنَّهُ يَكْسِرُ السِّنَّ وَيَفْقَأُ الْعَيْنَ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ إِنَّهَا لاَ تَنْكَأُ الْعَدُوَّ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ
 يَذْكُرْ تَفْقَأُ الْعَيْنَ ‏.‏
34.en: 'Abdullah b. Mughaffal reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited throwing of pebbles. Ibn Ja'far reported (in the narration transmitted by him) that he (the Holy Prophet) said: It neither inflicts defeat to the enemy nor kills the game but breaks the tooth and puts the eye out. This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ibn Mahdi with a slight variation of wording.
34.hi: Abdullah bin Mughaffal ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kankariyaan phenkne se mana kiya. Ibn Ja'far ne (apni riwayat ki hui riwayat mein) bataya ki unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Ye na to dushman ko shikast deti hai na hi shikaar ko maarti hai, lekin daant toDti hai aur aankh nikaalti hai. Ye hadees Ibn Mahdi ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ،
 بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ أَنَّ قَرِيبًا، لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُغَفَّلٍ خَذَفَ - قَالَ - فَنَهَاهُ وَقَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ الْخَذْفِ وَقَالَ ‏
"‏ إِنَّهَا لاَ تَصِيدُ صَيْدًا وَلاَ تَنْكَأُ عَدُوًّا وَلَكِنَّهَا تَكْسِرُ
 السِّنَّ وَتَفْقَأُ الْعَيْنَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَعَادَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أُحَدِّثُكَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى
 عَنْهُ ثُمَّ تَخْذِفُ لاَ أُكَلِّمُكَ أَبَدًا ‏.‏
34.en: Sa'id b. Jubair reported that. a near one of 'Abdullah b. Mughaffal threw pebbles. He prohibited him (to do so). He said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had prohibited the throwing of pebbles by saying: It does not catch the game, nor does it inflict defeat on the enemy, but breaks the tooth and puts the eye out. He (the near one of Abdullah b. Mughadal) again repeated it (the act of throwing of pebbles) whereupon he said: I narrate to you that Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon hish) disliked and prohibited throwing of pebbles, but I see you again throwing pebbles; I (would therefore) not speak with you.
34.hi: Sa'id bin Jubair ne riwayat ki ki Abdullah bin Mughaffal ke ek qareebi rishtedaar ne kankariyaan phenki. Unhone unhe (aisa karne se) mana kiya. Unhone kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kankariyaan phenkne se mana kiya tha ye kehte hue: Ye na to shikaar pakadti hai, na hi dushman ko shikast deti hai, lekin daant toDti hai aur aankh nikaalti hai. Unhone (Abdullah bin Mughaffal ke rishtedaar ne) ise (kankariyaan phenkne ka amal) dobara dohraaya, isper unhone kaha: Main tumhe bataata hoon ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kankariyaan phenkna napasand kiya aur mana kiya, lekin main tumhe dobara kankariyaan phenkte dekh raha hoon; main (is liye) tumse baat nahi karunga.

34.ar: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا الثَّقَفِيُّ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
34.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ayyub with the same chain of transmitters.
34.hi: Ye hadees Ayyub ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

34.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ، عَنْ 
 أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الأَشْعَثِ، عَنْ شَدَّادِ بْنِ أَوْسٍ، قَالَ ثِنْتَانِ حَفِظْتُهُمَا عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَتَبَ الإِحْسَانَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ فَإِذَا قَتَلْتُمْ فَأَحْسِنُوا الْقِتْلَةَ
 وَإِذَا ذَبَحْتُمْ فَأَحْسِنُوا الذَّبْحَ وَلْيُحِدَّ أَحَدُكُمْ شَفْرَتَهُ فَلْيُرِحْ ذَبِيحَتَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
34.en: Shaddid b. Aus said: Two are the things which I remember Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said: Verily Allah has enjoined goodness to everything; so when you kill, kill in a good way and when you slaughter, slaughter in a good way. So every one of you should sharpen his knife, and let the slaughtered animal die comfortably.
34.hi: Shaddid bin Aus ne kaha: Do baaten hain jo mujhe yaad hain ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kahin: Yaqeenan Allah ne har cheez mein achhaai laazim ki hai; is liye jab tum (kisi ko) qatal karo, achhi tarah se qatal karo aur jab tum zibah karo, achhi tarah se zibah karo. Is liye tum mein se har ek ko apna chaaku tez karna chahiye, aur zibah kiye jaane waale jaanwar ko aaraam se marne dena chahiye.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا 
 عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ الثَّقَفِيُّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا 
 عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ،
 بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، كُلُّ هَؤُلاَءِ عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ، بِإِسْنَادِ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ
 وَمَعْنَى حَدِيثِهِ ‏.‏
34.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Khalid al-Hadhdha' through different chains o transmitters.
34.hi: Ye hadees Khalid al-Hadhdha ki sanad se mukhtalif sanadon ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

34.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ هِشَامَ،
 بْنَ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ قَالَ دَخَلْتُ مَعَ جَدِّي أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ دَارَ الْحَكَمِ بْنِ أَيُّوبَ فَإِذَا
 قَوْمٌ قَدْ نَصَبُوا دَجَاجَةً يَرْمُونَهَا قَالَ فَقَالَ أَنَسٌ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 أَنْ تُصْبَرَ الْبَهَائِمُ ‏.‏
34.en: Hishim b. Zaid b. Anas b. Milik reported: I visited the house of al-Hakam b. Ayyub along with my grandfather Anas b. Milik, (and there) some people had made a hen a target and were shooting arrows at her. Thereupon Asas said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had forbidden tying of the animals (and making them the targets of arrows, etc.).
34.hi: Hishim bin Zaid bin Anas bin Milik ne riwayat ki: Main al-Hakam bin Ayyub ke ghar gaya apne dada Anas bin Milik ke saath, (aur wahan) kuch logon ne ek murgi ko nishaana bana rakha tha aur uspar teer chala rahe the. Isper Anas ne kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne jaanwaron ko baandhne (aur unhe teeron ka nishaana banaane, waghera) se mana kiya tha.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي 
 يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ 
 شُعْبَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
34.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba through other chains of transmitters.
34.hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se doosri sanadon ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ،
 عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ لاَ تَتَّخِذُوا شَيْئًا فِيهِ الرُّوحُ غَرَضًا
 ‏"‏ ‏.‏
34.en: Ibn 'Abbas reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said this: Do not make anything having life as a target.
34.hi: Ibn Abbas ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Kisi bhi jeevit cheez ko nishaana mat banaao.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنْ 
 شُعْبَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
34.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba through a different chain of transmitters.
34.hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي كَامِلٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو
 عَوَانَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ مَرَّ ابْنُ عُمَرَ بِنَفَرٍ قَدْ نَصَبُوا دَجَاجَةً يَتَرَامَوْنَهَا
 فَلَمَّا رَأَوُا ابْنَ عُمَرَ تَفَرَّقُوا عَنْهَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ مَنْ فَعَلَ هَذَا إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله
 عليه وسلم لَعَنَ مَنْ فَعَلَ هَذَا ‏.‏
34.en: Sa'id b. Jubair reported that Ibn 'Umar happened to pass by a party of men who had tied a hen and were shooting arrows at it. As soon as they saw Ibn 'Umar, they scattered from it. Thereupon Ibn Umar said: Who has done this? Verily Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has invoked curse upon him who does this.
34.hi: Sa'id bin Jubair ne riwayat ki ki Ibn Umar aadmiyon ke ek giroh ke paas se guzre jinhone ek murgi ko baandh rakha tha aur uspar teer chala rahe the. Jaise hi unhone Ibn Umar ko dekha, woh usse bikhar gaye. Isper Ibn Umar ne kaha: Kisne ye kiya? Yaqeenan Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne us shakhs par laanat ki hai jo aisa karta hai.

34.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ
 مَرَّ ابْنُ عُمَرَ بِفِتْيَانٍ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ قَدْ نَصَبُوا طَيْرًا وَهُمْ يَرْمُونَهُ وَقَدْ جَعَلُوا لِصَاحِبِ الطَّيْرِ
 كُلَّ خَاطِئَةٍ مِنْ نَبْلِهِمْ فَلَمَّا رَأَوُا ابْنَ عُمَرَ تَفَرَّقُوا فَقَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ مَنْ فَعَلَ هَذَا لَعَنَ اللَّهُ مَنْ
 فَعَلَ هَذَا إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَعَنَ مَنِ اتَّخَذَ شَيْئًا فِيهِ الرُّوحُ غَرَضًا ‏.‏
34.en: Sa'id b. Jubair reported that Ibn 'Umar happened to pass by some young men of the Quraish who had tied a bird (and th, is made it a target) at which they had been shooting arrows Every arrow that they missed came into the possession of the owner of the bird. So no sooner did they see Ibn 'Umar they went away. Thereupon Ibn 'Umar said: Who has done this? Allah has cursed him who does this. Verily Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) invoked curse upon one who made a live thing the target (of one's marksmanship).
34.hi: Sa'id bin Jubair ne riwayat ki ki Ibn Umar Quraish ke kuch jawaan aadmiyon ke paas se guzre jinhone ek parinde ko baandh rakha tha (aur isko nishaana banaaya tha) jispar woh teer chala rahe the. Har teer jo unhone miss kiya woh parinde ke maalik ki malkiyat ban jaata tha. To jaise hi unhone Ibn Umar ko dekha, woh chale gaye. Isper Ibn Umar ne kaha: Kisne ye kiya? Allah ne use laanat di jo aisa karta hai. Yaqeenan Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne us shakhs par laanat ki jisne kisi jeevit cheez ko (apni nishaanebaazi ka) nishaana banaaya.

34.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ،
 بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا 
 حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ
 نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُقْتَلَ شَىْءٌ مِنَ الدَّوَابِّ صَبْرًا ‏.‏
34.en: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade that any beast should be killed after it has been tied.
34.hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mana kiya ki kisi bhi jaanwar ko use baandhne ke baad qatal kiya jaaye.

35.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَسْوَدُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ يَحْيَى،
 بْنُ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، حَدَّثَنِي جُنْدَبُ بْنُ سُفْيَانَ، قَالَ شَهِدْتُ
 الأَضْحَى مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمْ يَعْدُ أَنْ صَلَّى وَفَرَغَ مِنْ صَلاَتِهِ سَلَّمَ فَإِذَا
 هُوَ يَرَى لَحْمَ أَضَاحِيَّ قَدْ ذُبِحَتْ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَفْرُغَ مِنْ صَلاَتِهِ فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ مَنْ كَانَ ذَبَحَ أُضْحِيَّتَهُ
 قَبْلَ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ - أَوْ نُصَلِّيَ - فَلْيَذْبَحْ مَكَانَهَا أُخْرَى وَمَنْ كَانَ لَمْ يَذْبَحْ فَلْيَذْبَحْ بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ
 ‏"‏ ‏.‏
35.en: Jundab b. Sufyan reported: I was with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the day of 'Id al-Adha. While he had not returned after having offered (the Id prayer) and finished it, he saw the flesh of the sacrificial animals which had been slaughtered before he had completed the prayer. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: One who slaughtered his sacrificial animal before his prayer or our prayer ('Id), he should slaughter another one in its stead, and he who did not slaughter, he should slaughter by reciting the name of Allah.
35.hi: Jundab bin Sufyan ne riwayat ki: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath tha Id al-Adha ke din. Jab woh (Id ki namaz) padhkar aur khatm karke wapas nahi aaye the, unhone dekha ki qurbaani ke jaanwaron ka gosht zibah kiya gaya tha unke namaz mukammal karne se pehle. Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Jisne apna qurbaani ka jaanwar apni namaz ya humari (Id ki) namaz se pehle zibah kiya, use uski jagah doosra zibah karna chahiye, aur jisne zibah nahi kiya, use Allah ka naam lekar zibah karna chahiye.

35.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، سَلاَّمُ بْنُ سُلَيْمٍ عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ،
 بْنِ قَيْسٍ عَنْ جُنْدَبِ بْنِ سُفْيَانَ، قَالَ شَهِدْتُ الأَضْحَى مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 فَلَمَّا قَضَى صَلاَتَهُ بِالنَّاسِ نَظَرَ إِلَى غَنَمٍ قَدْ ذُبِحَتْ فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ مَنْ ذَبَحَ قَبْلَ الصَّلاَةِ فَلْيَذْبَحْ
 شَاةً مَكَانَهَا وَمَنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ ذَبَحَ فَلْيَذْبَحْ عَلَى اسْمِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
35.en: Jundab b. Sufyan reported: I was with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (on the occasion) of 'Id al-Adha. After he had completed the prayer with people, he found that the goats had been slaughtered, whereupon he said: He who slaughtered sacrificial animal before the prayer should slaughter a goat (again) in its stead and he who has not slaughtered he should slaughter it by reciting the name of Allah.
35.hi: Jundab bin Sufyan ne riwayat ki: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath tha Id al-Adha (ke avasar par). Jab unhone logon ke saath namaz mukammal kar li, unhone paaya ki bakriyaan zibah ki jaa chuki thin, isper unhone kaha: Jisne namaz se pehle qurbaani ka jaanwar zibah kiya use uski jagah (dobara) ek bakri zibah karni chahiye aur jisne zibah nahi kiya use Allah ka naam lekar zibah karna chahiye.

35.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَابْنُ،
 أَبِي عُمَرَ عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالاَ عَلَى اسْمِ اللَّهِ
 ‏.‏ كَحَدِيثِ أَبِي الأَحْوَصِ ‏.‏
35.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of al-Aswad b. Qais with the same chain of transmitters.
35.hi: Ye hadees al-Aswad bin Qais ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

35.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، سَمِعَ جُنْدَبًا الْبَجَلِيَّ،
 قَالَ شَهِدْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلَّى يَوْمَ أَضْحًى ثُمَّ خَطَبَ فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ مَنْ كَانَ
 ذَبَحَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ فَلْيُعِدْ مَكَانَهَا وَمَنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ ذَبَحَ فَلْيَذْبَحْ بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
35.en: Jundab al-Bajali reported: I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) observing ('Id) prayer on the Day of Sacrifice (10th of Dhu'l-Hijja) and then delivering a sermon and he said: He who sacrificed the (animal) before offering ('Id) prayer, he should offer again in its stead, and he who did not sacrifice the animal should slaughter it by reciting the name of Allah.
35.hi: Jundab al-Bajali ne riwayat ki: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Qurbaani ke Din (10 Zul-Hijja) (Id ki) namaz padhte dekha aur phir khutba dete hue, aur unhone kaha: Jisne (jaanwar) (Id ki) namaz se pehle qurbaan kiya, use uski jagah dobara qurbaani deni chahiye, aur jisne jaanwar qurbaan nahi kiya use Allah ka naam lekar use zibah karna chahiye.

35.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، بِهَذَا
 الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
35.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba through another chain of transmitters.
35.hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

35.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، عَنِ 
 الْبَرَاءِ، قَالَ ضَحَّى خَالِي أَبُو بُرْدَةَ قَبْلَ الصَّلاَةِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏
 تِلْكَ شَاةُ لَحْمٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ عِنْدِي جَذَعَةً مِنَ الْمَعْزِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ضَحِّ بِهَا وَلاَ
 تَصْلُحُ لِغَيْرِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ ضَحَّى قَبْلَ الصَّلاَةِ فَإِنَّمَا ذَبَحَ لِنَفْسِهِ وَمَنْ ذَبَحَ بَعْدَ الصَّلاَةِ
 فَقَدْ تَمَّ نُسُكُهُ وَأَصَابَ سُنَّةَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
35.en: Al-Bara' reported: My maternal uncle Abu Burda sacrificed his animal before ('Id) prayer. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: That is a goat (slaughtered for the sake of) flesh (and not as a sacrifice on the day of Adha). He said: I have a lamb of six months. Thereupon he said: Offer it as a sacrifice, but it will not justify for anyone except you, and then said: He who sacrificed (the animal) before ('Id) prayer, he in fact slaughtered it for his own self, and he who slaughtered after prayer, his ritual of sacrifice became complete and he in fact observed the religious practice of the Muslims.
35.hi: Al-Bara ne riwayat ki: Mere maama Abu Burda ne apna jaanwar (Id ki) namaz se pehle qurbaan kiya. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ye ek bakri hai (gosht ke liye zibah ki gayi, na ki Adha ke din qurbaani ke soorat mein). Unhone kaha: Mere paas chhe mahine ka ek bhed hai. Isper unhone kaha: Ise qurbaani ke soorat mein pesh karo, lekin ye tumhare siwaay kisi doosre ke liye vaajib nahi hogi, aur phir kaha: Jisne (jaanwar) (Id ki) namaz se pehle qurbaan kiya, usne dar-asal ise apne khud ke liye zibah kiya, aur jisne namaz ke baad zibah kiya, uski qurbaani ki rasm mukammal ho gayi aur usne dar-asal Musalmaanon ke deeni amal ka paalan kiya.

35.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ،
 أَنَّ خَالَهُ أَبَا بُرْدَةَ بْنَ نِيَارٍ، ذَبَحَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَذْبَحَ النَّبِيُّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ
 اللَّهِ إِنَّ هَذَا يَوْمٌ اللَّحْمُ فِيهِ مَكْرُوهٌ وَإِنِّي عَجَّلْتُ نَسِيكَتِي لأُطْعِمَ أَهْلِي وَجِيرَانِي وَأَهْلَ دَارِي
 ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَعِدْ نُسُكًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ عِنْدِي
 عَنَاقَ لَبَنٍ هِيَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ شَاتَىْ لَحْمٍ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هِيَ خَيْرُ نَسِيكَتَيْكَ وَلاَ تَجْزِي جَذَعَةٌ عَنْ
 أَحَدٍ بَعْدَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
35.en: Al-Bara' b. 'Azib reported that his maternal'uncle Abu Burda b. Niyar sacrificed his animal earlier than the Prophet (ﷺ) had sacrificed. Thereupon he said: Apostle of Allah, it is the day of meat and it is not desirable (to have longing for it and not to make use of it immediately), so I hastened in offering my animal as a sacrifice, so that I might feed my family and neighbours and my kith and kin. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Offer again your sacrifice. He said: Messenger of Allah, I have a small milch goat of less than one year, and that is better than two dry goats (from which only) meat (can be acquired). Thereupon he said: That is better than the two animals of sacrifice on your behalf, and the sacrifice of a goat, of less than six months shall not be accepted as a sacrifice on behalf of anyone after your (sacrifice).
35.hi: Al-Bara bin Azib ne riwayat ki ki unke maama Abu Burda bin Niyar ne apna jaanwar Nabi (SAW) ke qurbaani karne se pehle qurbaan kiya. Isper unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye gosht ka din hai aur ye vaanchhaneey nahi hai (iske liye tarasna aur turant iska istemal na karna), is liye maine jaldi ki apne jaanwar ko qurbaani ke soorat mein pesh karne mein, taaki main apne khaandaan, padosiyon aur apne rishtedaaron ko khilaa sakoon. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Dobara apni qurbaani pesh karo. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mere paas ek chhoti doodh dene wali bakri hai jo ek saal se kam ki hai, aur ye do sookhi bakriyon se behtar hai (jinse sirf) gosht (haasil kiya jaa sakta hai). Isper unhone kaha: Ye tumhari taraf se do qurbaani ke jaanwaron se behtar hai, aur chhe mahine se kam umar ki bakri ki qurbaani tumhare (qurbaani) ke baad kisi ki taraf se qubool nahi ki jaayegi.

35.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ،
 بْنِ عَازِبٍ قَالَ خَطَبَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ لاَ يَذْبَحَنَّ أَحَدٌ
 حَتَّى يُصَلِّيَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ خَالِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ هَذَا يَوْمٌ اللَّحْمُ فِيهِ مَكْرُوهٌ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ
 بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ هُشَيْمٍ ‏.‏
35.en: Al-Bara' b. 'Azib reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) delivered an address on the day (of Nahr) in which he said: None of you should offer sacrifice of animals until he has completed the ('Id) prayer. Thereupon my maternal uncle said: Messenger of Allah, it is the day of meat, so it is not desirable (to keep my family in the state of longing). The rest of the hadith is the same.
35.hi: Al-Bara bin Azib ne riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (Nahr ke) din ek khitaab diya jismein unhone kaha: Tum mein se koi bhi jaanwaron ki qurbaani tab tak na de jab tak usne (Id ki) namaz mukammal na kar li ho. Isper mere maama ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye gosht ka din hai, is liye ye vaanchhaneey nahi hai (mere khaandaan ko tarasti halat mein rakhna). Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

35.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا 
 أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ، عَنْ فِرَاسٍ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ صَلَّى صَلاَتَنَا وَوَجَّهَ قِبْلَتَنَا وَنَسَكَ نُسُكَنَا فَلاَ يَذْبَحْ حَتَّى يُصَلِّيَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ خَالِي
 يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَدْ نَسَكْتُ عَنِ ابْنٍ لِي ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ذَاكَ شَىْءٌ عَجَّلْتَهُ لأَهْلِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ إِنَّ عِنْدِي
 شَاةً خَيْرٌ مِنْ شَاتَيْنِ قَالَ ‏"‏ ضَحِّ بِهَا فَإِنَّهَا خَيْرُ نَسِيكَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
35.en: Al-Bara' reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said: He who observes prayer like our prayer and turns his face towards our Qibla (in prayer) and who offers sacrifices (of animals) as we do, he must not slaughter the (animal as a sacrifice) until he has completed the prayer. Thereupon my maternal uncle said: Messenger of Allah, I have sacrificed the animal on behalf of my son. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: This is the thing in which you have made haste for your family. He said: I have a goat with me better than two goats. Thereupon he said: Sacrifice it for that is the best.
35.hi: Al-Bara ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Jo humari tarah namaz padhta hai aur humare Qibla ki taraf apna chehra karta hai (namaz mein) aur jo humari tarah (jaanwaron ki) qurbaani deta hai, use jaanwar (qurbaani ke soorat mein) tab tak zibah nahi karna chahiye jab tak usne namaz mukammal na kar li ho. Isper mere maama ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, maine apne bete ki taraf se jaanwar qurbaan kiya hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ye woh cheez hai jismein tumne apne khaandaan ke liye jaldi ki hai. Unhone kaha: Mere paas ek bakri hai do bakriyon se behtar. Isper unhone kaha: Ise qurbaan karo, kyunki ye sabse achhi hai.

35.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ،
 بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ زُبَيْدٍ الإِيَامِيِّ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ أَوَّلَ مَا نَبْدَأُ بِهِ فِي يَوْمِنَا هَذَا نُصَلِّي ثُمَّ نَرْجِعُ فَنَنْحَرُ فَمَنْ
 فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ فَقَدْ أَصَابَ سُنَّتَنَا وَمَنْ ذَبَحَ فَإِنَّمَا هُوَ لَحْمٌ قَدَّمَهُ لأَهْلِهِ لَيْسَ مِنَ النُّسُكِ فِي شَىْءٍ
 ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَكَانَ أَبُو بُرْدَةَ بْنُ نِيَارٍ قَدْ ذَبَحَ فَقَالَ عِنْدِي جَذَعَةٌ خَيْرٌ مِنْ مُسِنَّةٍ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اذْبَحْهَا
 وَلَنْ تَجْزِيَ عَنْ أَحَدٍ بَعْدَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
35.en: Al-Bara' b. 'Azib reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said: The first (act) with which we started our day (the day of 'Id-ul Adha) was that we offered prayer. We then returned and sacrificed the animals and he who did that in fact adhered to our Sunnah (practice). And he who slaughtered the (animal on that day before the 'Id prayer), for him (the slaughtering of animal was directed to the acquiring of) meat for his family, and there is nothing of the sort of sacrifice in it. It was Abu Burda b. Niyar who had slaughtered (the animal before the 'Id prayer). He said: I have a small lamb, of less than one year, but better than that of more than a year. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) qaid: Sacrifice it, but it will not suffice (as a sacrifice) for anyone after you.
35.hi: Al-Bara bin Azib ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Sabse pehla (amal) jisse humne apna din (Id-ul Adha ka din) shuru kiya woh ye tha ki humne namaz padhi. Hum phir wapas gaye aur jaanwar qurbaan kiye aur jisne aisa kiya usne dar-asal humari Sunnat (amal) ka paalan kiya. Aur jisne (jaanwar) us din (Id ki namaz se pehle) zibah kiya, uske liye (jaanwar ka zibah karna) apne khaandaan ke liye gosht haasil karne ke liye tha, aur ismein qurbaani jaisi koi baat nahi hai. Ye Abu Burda bin Niyar the jinhone (jaanwar) (Id ki namaz se pehle) zibah kiya tha. Unhone kaha: Mere paas ek chhota bhed hai, ek saal se kam ka, lekin ek saal se zyada ke bhed se behtar. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ise qurbaan karo, lekin ye (qurbaani ke soorat mein) tumhare baad kisi ke liye kaafi nahi hogi.

35.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ زُبَيْدٍ، سَمِعَ الشَّعْبِيَّ، عَنِ 
 الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
35.en: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of al-Bara' b. 'Azib through another chain of transmitters.
35.hi: Isi jaisi ek hadees al-Bara bin Azib ki sanad se ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

35.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَهَنَّادُ بْنُ السَّرِيِّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا 
 عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ،
 عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ، قَالَ خَطَبَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي يَوْمِ النَّحْرِ بَعْدَ الصَّلاَةِ
 ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏.‏
35.en: al-Bara' b. 'Azib reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) addressed us on the day of Nahr after the ('Id) prayer. The rest of the hadith is the same.
35.hi: Al-Bara bin Azib ne riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein Nahr ke din (Id ki) namaz ke baad khitaab kiya. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

35.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ صَخْرٍ الدَّارِمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، عَارِمُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ
 حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زِيَادٍ - حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ الأَحْوَلُ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، حَدَّثَنِي الْبَرَاءُ،
 بْنُ عَازِبٍ قَالَ خَطَبَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي يَوْمِ نَحْرٍ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ يُضَحِّيَنَّ
 أَحَدٌ حَتَّى يُصَلِّيَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ رَجُلٌ عِنْدِي عَنَاقُ لَبَنٍ هِيَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ شَاتَىْ لَحْمٍ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَضَحِّ
 بِهَا وَلاَ تَجْزِي جَذَعَةٌ عَنْ أَحَدٍ بَعْدَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
35.en: Al-Bara' b. 'Azib reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) addressed us on the day of Nahr and said: None should sacrifice the animal unless he has completed the ('Id) prayer. A person said: I have a milch goat of less than one year, better than two fat goats. Thereupon he said: Sacrifice it, and no goat of less than a year of age will be accepted as sacrifice after you.
35.hi: Al-Bara bin Azib ne riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein Nahr ke din khitaab kiya aur kaha: Kisi ko jaanwar qurbaan nahi karna chahiye jab tak usne (Id ki) namaz mukammal na kar li ho. Ek shakhs ne kaha: Mere paas ek saal se kam ki doodh dene wali bakri hai, do moti bakriyon se behtar. Isper unhone kaha: Ise qurbaan karo, aur ek saal se kam umar ki koi bakri tumhare baad qurbaani ke soorat mein qubool nahi ki jaayegi.

35.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ،
 عَنْ أَبِي جُحَيْفَةَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ، قَالَ ذَبَحَ أَبُو بُرْدَةَ قَبْلَ الصَّلاَةِ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَبْدِلْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لَيْسَ عِنْدِي إِلاَّ جَذَعَةٌ - قَالَ شُعْبَةُ
 وَأَظُنُّهُ قَالَ - وَهِيَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ مُسِنَّةٍ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اجْعَلْهَا مَكَانَهَا
 وَلَنْ تَجْزِيَ عَنْ أَحَدٍ بَعْدَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
35.en: Al-Bara' b. 'Azib reported that Abu Burda slaughtered the animal as a sacrifice before the ('Id) prayer. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Offer a substitute for it (since it does not absolve you of the responsibility of sacrifice). Thereupon he said: Allah's Messenger. I have nothing with me but a goat of less than six months. Shu'ba (one of the narrators) said: I think he (al-Bara' b. 'Azib also) said: And it is better than a goat of one year. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Make it a substitute for that (and sacrifice it), but it will not suffice for anyone (as a sacrifice) after you.
35.hi: Al-Bara bin Azib ne riwayat ki ki Abu Burda ne jaanwar (Id ki) namaz se pehle qurbaani ke soorat mein zibah kiya. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Iske badle mein doosra qurbaan karo (kyunki ye tumhe qurbaani ki zimmedaari se azad nahi karta). Isper unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mere paas chhe mahine se kam umar ki ek bakri ke siwaay kuch nahi hai. Shu'ba (ek raawi) ne kaha: Mujhe lagta hai unhone (al-Bara bin Azib ne bhi) kaha: Aur ye ek saal ki bakri se behtar hai. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ise uska badla banao (aur ise qurbaan karo), lekin ye tumhare baad kisi ke liye (qurbaani ke soorat mein) kaafi nahi hogi.

35.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنِي وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا 
 أَبُو عَامِرٍ الْعَقَدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ الشَّكَّ فِي قَوْلِهِ هِيَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ مُسِنَّةٍ
 ‏.‏
35.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters, but did not mention tht doubt (expressed in his statement) That is (the goat of less than a year) is better than a goat of more than one year.
35.hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin unhone us shak (unke bayaan mein zaahir kiye gaye) ka koi zikr nahi kiya: Ki (ek saal se kam ki bakri) ek saal se zyada ki bakri se behtar hai.

35.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ،
 - وَاللَّفْظُ لِعَمْرٍو - قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ
 قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ ‏
"‏ مَنْ كَانَ ذَبَحَ قَبْلَ الصَّلاَةِ فَلْيُعِدْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
 فَقَامَ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَذَا يَوْمٌ يُشْتَهَى فِيهِ اللَّحْمُ ‏.‏ وَذَكَرَ هَنَةً مِنْ جِيرَانِهِ كَأَنَّ
 رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَدَّقَهُ قَالَ وَعِنْدِي جَذَعَةٌ هِيَ أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ مِنْ شَاتَىْ لَحْمٍ
 أَفَأَذْبَحُهَا قَالَ فَرَخَّصَ لَهُ فَقَالَ لاَ أَدْرِي أَبَلَغَتْ رُخْصَتُهُ مَنْ سِوَاهُ أَمْ لاَ قَالَ وَانْكَفَأَ رَسُولُ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى كَبْشَيْنِ فَذَبَحَهُمَا فَقَامَ النَّاسُ إِلَى غُنَيْمَةٍ فَتَوَزَّعُوهَا ‏.‏ أَوْ
 قَالَ فَتَجَزَّعُوهَا ‏.‏
35.en: Anas (b. Malik) reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said on the day of Nahr (Sacrifice): He who slaughtered (the animal as a sacrifice) before the ('Id) prayer. should repeat it (i. e. offer another animal). Thereupon a person stood up and said: Messenger of Allah, that is the day when meat is much desired, and he also made a mention of the need of his neighbour, and perhaps Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) attested it. He (the person who had sacrificed the animal before the 'Id prayer) said: I have a goat of less than one year of age with me and I like it more than two fleshy goats; should I offer it as a sacrifice? He permitted him to do so. He (the narrator) said: I do not know whether this permission was granted to anyone else besides him or not. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then turned towards two rams. and he slaughtered them, and the people' came to the goats and got them distributed amongst themselves (for offering them as sacrifice).
35.hi: Anas (bin Malik) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Nahr (Qurbaani) ke din ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Jisne (jaanwar ko qurbaani ke soorat mein) (Id ki) namaz se pehle zibah kiya, use ise (yaani doosra jaanwar) dobara pesh karna chahiye. Isper ek shakhs khada hua aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye woh din hai jab gosht ki bahut khwaish hoti hai, aur unhone apne padosi ki zaroorat ka bhi zikr kiya, aur shayad Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ise pramanit kiya. Unhone (jisne Id ki namaz se pehle jaanwar qurbaan kiya tha) kaha: Mere paas ek saal se kam umar ki ek bakri hai aur mujhe ye do maansal bakriyon se zyada pasand hai; kya main ise qurbaani ke soorat mein pesh karun? Unhone unhe aisa karne ki ijazat di. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Mujhe nahi pata ki ye ijazat unke ilawa kisi aur ko di gayi ya nahi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) phir do menDhon ki taraf mude, aur unhe zibah kiya, aur log bakriyon ke paas aaye aur unhe aapas mein baant liya (unhe qurbaani ke soorat mein pesh karne ke liye).

35.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ الْغُبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، وَهِشَامٌ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ،
 عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلَّى ثُمَّ خَطَبَ فَأَمَرَ مَنْ كَانَ ذَبَحَ
 قَبْلَ الصَّلاَةِ أَنْ يُعِيدَ ذِبْحًا ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ ‏.‏
35.en: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offered the 'Id prayer and then delivered the sermon giving the command: He who slaughtered the animal before prayer should slaughter (another animal as a sacrifice). The rest of the hadith is the same.
35.hi: Anas bin Malik ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Id ki namaz padhi aur phir hukum dete hue khutba diya: Jisne jaanwar namaz se pehle zibah kiya use (doosra jaanwar) zibah karna chahiye. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

35.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي زِيَادُ بْنُ يَحْيَى الْحَسَّانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ وَرْدَانَ - حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ،
 عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ خَطَبَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ
 أَضْحًى - قَالَ - فَوَجَدَ رِيحَ لَحْمٍ فَنَهَاهُمْ أَنْ يَذْبَحُوا قَالَ ‏
"‏ مَنْ كَانَ ضَحَّى فَلْيُعِدْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
 ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِهِمَا ‏.‏
35.en: Anas b. Malik reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) addressed us on the day of 'Id al-Adha. He smelt the odour of flesh and he prohibited thern from slaughtering (the animals before the 'Id prayer), saying: He who slaughtered the animals (before the 'Id prayer) should do that again (as it is not valid as a sacrifice).
35.hi: Anas bin Malik ne riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein Id al-Adha ke din khitaab kiya. Unhone gosht ki mahak soongi aur unhone humein (jaanwaron ko (Id ki) namaz se pehle zibah karne se) mana kiya, ye kehte hue: Jisne jaanwaron ko (Id ki namaz se pehle) zibah kiya use dobara aisa karna chahiye (kyunki ye qurbaani ke soorat mein maany nahi hai).

35.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ لاَ تَذْبَحُوا إِلاَّ مُسِنَّةً إِلاَّ أَنْ يَعْسُرَ عَلَيْكُمْ فَتَذْبَحُوا جَذَعَةً مِنَ
 الضَّأْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
35.en: Jabir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Sacrifice only a grown-up animal, unless it is difficult for you, in which case sacrifice a ram (of even less than a year, but more than six months' age).
35.hi: Jabir ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Sirf ek pooran vayask jaanwar qurbaan karo, jab tak ye tumhare liye mushkil na ho, jismein haalat mein ek menDha qurbaan karo (chahe ek saal se kam ka ho, lekin chhe mahine se zyada umar ka ho).

35.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو
 الزُّبَيْرِ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ صَلَّى بِنَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ
 بِالْمَدِينَةِ فَتَقَدَّمَ رِجَالٌ فَنَحَرُوا وَظَنُّوا أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ نَحَرَ فَأَمَرَ النَّبِيُّ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم مَنْ كَانَ نَحَرَ قَبْلَهُ أَنْ يُعِيدَ بِنَحْرٍ آخَرَ وَلاَ يَنْحَرُوا حَتَّى يَنْحَرَ النَّبِيُّ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
35.en: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) led us in the 'Id prayer in Medina on the Day of Sacrifice. Some persons slaughtered their animals ahead of him under the impression that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) had-already offered sacrifice. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Those who had slaughtered their animals ahead of him should slaughter the other ones in their stead. And they should not sacrifice the animal before Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had sacrificed (his animal)
35.hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein Madina mein Qurbaani ke Din Id ki namaz padhayi. Kuch logon ne apne jaanwar unse pehle zibah kiye is dhaarna mein ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne pehle hi qurbaani de di hai. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jinhone apne jaanwar unse pehle zibah kiye unhe unki jagah doosre zibah karne chahiye. Aur unhe apna jaanwar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke jaanwar qurbaan karne se pehle qurbaan nahi karna chahiye.

35.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ 
 يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْخَيْرِ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 أَعْطَاهُ غَنَمًا يَقْسِمُهَا عَلَى أَصْحَابِهِ ضَحَايَا فَبَقِيَ عَتُودٌ فَذَكَرَهُ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ ضَحِّ بِهِ أَنْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُتَيْبَةُ عَلَى صَحَابَتِهِ ‏.‏
35.en: Uqba b. 'Amir reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave the gifts of goats to be distributed amongst his Companions. They sacrificed them, but a lamb of one year of age was left. (Someone) made a mention of that to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), whereupon he said: You sacrifice it.
35.hi: Uqba bin Aamir ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne sahaba mein baantne ke liye bakriyon ke tohfe diye. Unhone unhe qurbaan kiya, lekin ek saal umar ka ek bhed bach gaya. (Kisi ne) iska zikr Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kiya, isper unhone kaha: Ise tum qurbaan karo.

35.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ الدَّسْتَوَائِيِّ، عَنْ 
 يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ بَعْجَةَ الْجُهَنِيِّ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ، قَالَ قَسَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم فِينَا ضَحَايَا فَأَصَابَنِي جَذَعٌ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّهُ أَصَابَنِي جَذَعٌ
 ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ ضَحِّ بِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
35.en: Amir al-Juhani reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) distributed sacrificial animals (amongst us for sacrificing them on 'Id al-Adha). So we sacrificed them. There fell to my lot a lamb of less than one year I said: Allah's Messenger, there has fallen to my lot a lamb (Jadha'a), whereupon he said: Sacrifice that.
35.hi: Amir al-Juhani ne riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne qurbaani ke jaanwar baante (humare beech unhe Id al-Adha par qurbaan karne ke liye). To humne unhe qurbaan kiya. Mere hisse mein ek saal se kam ka ek bhed aaya. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mere hisse mein ek bhed (Jadha'a) aaya hai, isper unhone kaha: Ise qurbaan karo.

35.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ حَسَّانَ -
 أَخْبَرَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ سَلاَّمٍ - حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي بَعْجَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ،
 اللَّهِ أَنَّ عُقْبَةَ بْنَ عَامِرٍ الْجُهَنِيَّ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَسَمَ ضَحَايَا
 بَيْنَ أَصْحَابِهِ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ مَعْنَاهُ ‏.‏
35.en: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of 'Uqba b. 'Amir al-Juhan with a slight change of wording.
35.hi: Ye hadees Uqba bin Aamir al-Juhan ki sanad se alfaazon mein halke badlaav ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

35.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ ضَحَّى النَّبِيُّ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم بِكَبْشَيْنِ أَمْلَحَيْنِ أَقْرَنَيْنِ ذَبَحَهُمَا بِيَدِهِ وَسَمَّى وَكَبَّرَ وَوَضَعَ رِجْلَهُ عَلَى
 صِفَاحِهِمَا ‏.‏
35.en: Anas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sacrificed with his own hands two horned rams which were white with black markings reciting the name of Allah and glorifying Him (saying Allah-o-Akbar). He placed his foot on their sides (while sacrificing).
35.hi: Anas ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne khud ke haathon se do singon waale menDhe qurbaan kiye jo safed the kaale nishaanon ke saath, Allah ka naam lete hue aur Uski buland-o-baala ka bayaan karte hue (Allahu Akbar kehte hue). Unhone apna paon unke pehlu par rakha (zibah karte waqt).

35.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ ضَحَّى
 رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِكَبْشَيْنِ أَمْلَحَيْنِ أَقْرَنَيْنِ قَالَ وَرَأَيْتُهُ يَذْبَحُهُمَا بِيَدِهِ وَرَأَيْتُهُ
 وَاضِعًا قَدَمَهُ عَلَى صِفَاحِهِمَا قَالَ وَسَمَّى وَكَبَّرَ ‏.‏
35.en: Anas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sacrificed two horned rams of white colour with black markings over them. He also stated: I saw him sacrificing them with his own hand and saw him placing his foot on their sides, and recited the name of Allah and Glorified Him.
35.hi: Anas ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne do singon waale menDhe qurbaan kiye jo safed rang ke the kaale nishaanon ke saath. Unhone ye bhi kaha: Maine unhe apne khud ke haath se qurbaan karte dekha aur unhe apna paon unke pehlu par rakhte dekha, aur Allah ka naam liya aur Uski buland-o-baala ka bayaan kiya.

35.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْحَارِثِ - حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، أَخْبَرَنِي 
 قَتَادَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا، يَقُولُ ضَحَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ
 آنْتَ سَمِعْتَهُ مِنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏
35.en: Shu'ba reported: Qatada informed me that he had heard Anas saying that Allah's Messenger (may peace be npon him) sacrificed (the horned rams) and like that. I said: Did you (Qatada) hear from Anas? He said. Yes.
35.hi: Shu'ba ne riwayat ki: Qatada ne mujhe bataya ki unhone Anas ko ye kehte suna ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (singon waale menDhon ko) qurbaan kiya aur waisa hi. Maine kaha: Kya aapne (Qatada ne) ise Anas se suna? Unhone kaha: Haan.

35.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ،
 عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ وَيَقُولُ ‏
"‏ بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
35.en: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Anas with a slight variation of wording.
35.hi: Ye hadees Anas ki sanad se alfaazon mein halke badlaav ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

35.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مَعْرُوفٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ قَالَ حَيْوَةُ أَخْبَرَنِي 
 أَبُو صَخْرٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ قُسَيْطٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله
 عليه وسلم أَمَرَ بِكَبْشٍ أَقْرَنَ يَطَأُ فِي سَوَادٍ وَيَبْرُكُ فِي سَوَادٍ وَيَنْظُرُ فِي سَوَادٍ فَأُتِيَ بِهِ
 لِيُضَحِّيَ بِهِ فَقَالَ لَهَا ‏"‏ يَا عَائِشَةُ هَلُمِّي الْمُدْيَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ اشْحَذِيهَا بِحَجَرٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَفَعَلَتْ
 ثُمَّ أَخَذَهَا وَأَخَذَ الْكَبْشَ فَأَضْجَعَهُ ثُمَّ ذَبَحَهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنْ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ
 مُحَمَّدٍ وَمِنْ أُمَّةِ مُحَمَّدٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ضَحَّى بِهِ ‏.‏
35.en: 'A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded that a ram with black legs, black belly and black (circles) round the eyes should be brought to him, so that he should sacrifice it. He said to 'A'isha: Give me the large knife, and then said: Sharpen it on a stone. She did that. He then took it (the knife) and then the ram; he placed it on the ground and then sacrificed it, saying: Bismillah, Allah-humma Taqabbal min Muhammadin wa Al-i-Muhammadin, wa min Ummati Muhammadin (In the name of Allah," O Allah, accept  on behalf of Muhammad and the family of Muhammad and the Umma of Muhammad" ).
35.hi: Aisha ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne hukum diya ki kaali taangon, kaale pet, aur aankhon ke aas-paas kaale (ghere) waala ek menDha unke paas laaya jaaye, taaki woh use qurbaan kar sakein. Unhone Aisha se kaha: Mujhe bada chaaku do, aur phir kaha: Ise ek patthar par tez karo. Unhone aisa kiya. Unhone phir use (chaaku) liya aur phir menDhe ko, use zameen par rakha aur phir use qurbaan kiya, ye kehte hue: Bismillah, Allah-humma Taqabbal min Muhammadin wa Al-i-Muhammadin, wa min Ummati Muhammadin (Allah ke naam par, "Aye Allah, Muhammad ki taraf se aur Muhammad ke khaandaan ki taraf se, aur Muhammad ki Ummat ki taraf se qubool kar").

35.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى الْعَنَزِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي،
 عَنْ عَبَايَةَ بْنِ رِفَاعَةَ بْنِ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ، عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ، قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّا لاَقُو
 الْعَدُوِّ غَدًا وَلَيْسَتْ مَعَنَا مُدًى قَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَعْجِلْ أَوْ أَرْنِي مَا أَنْهَرَ الدَّمَ
 وَذُكِرَ اسْمُ اللَّهِ فَكُلْ لَيْسَ السِّنَّ وَالظُّفُرَ وَسَأُحَدِّثُكَ أَمَّا السِّنُّ فَعَظْمٌ وَأَمَّا الظُّفُرُ فَمُدَى الْحَبَشَةِ
 ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَأَصَبْنَا نَهْبَ إِبِلٍ وَغَنَمٍ فَنَدَّ مِنْهَا بَعِيرٌ فَرَمَاهُ رَجُلٌ بِسَهْمٍ فَحَبَسَهُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ لِهَذِهِ الإِبِلِ أَوَابِدَ كَأَوَابِدِ الْوَحْشِ فَإِذَا غَلَبَكُمْ مِنْهَا شَىْءٌ
 فَاصْنَعُوا بِهِ هَكَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
35.en: Rafi' b. Khadij is reported to have said: Allah's Messenger, we are going to encounter the enemy tomorrow, but we have no knives with us. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Make haste or be careful (in making arrangements for procuring knives) which would let the blood flow (and along with it) the name of Allah is also to be recited. Then eat, but not the tooth or nail. And I am going to tell you why it is not permissible to slaughter the animal with the help of tooth and bone; and as for the nail. it is a bone, and the bone is the knife of Abyssinians. He (the narrator) said: There fell to our lot as spoils of war camels and goats, and one of the camels among them became wild. A person (amongst usl struck It with an arrow which brought it under control. whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: This camel became wild like wild animals, so if you find any animal getting wild, you do the same with that
35.hi: Rafi bin Khadij ne kaha (aisa kaha jaata hai): Allah ke Rasool, hum kal dushman se muqaabla karne waale hain, lekin humare paas chaaku nahi hain. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jaldi karo ya saavdhaani se karo (chaaku haasil karne ke intezaam mein) jo khoon bahaayein (aur uske saath) Allah ka naam bhi liya jaana chahiye. Phir khaao, lekin daant ya naakhun se nahi. Aur main tumhe bataane wala hoon ki jaanwar ko daant aur haddi ki madad se zibah karna kyun jaayez nahi hai; aur naakhun ke jahan tak sawal hai, ye ek haddi hai, aur haddi Abyssinians ka chaaku hai. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Humein jung ke maal-e-ganimat mein oont aur bakriyaan milin, aur unmein se ek oont jangli ho gaya. Ek shakhs (hummein se) ne use teer se maara jisne use kaboo mein kiya. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ye oont jangli ho gaya jaanwaron ki tarah, is liye agar tum kisi jaanwar ko jangli hote paate ho, tum uske saath waisa hi karo.

35.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ مَسْرُوقٍ،
 عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبَايَةَ بْنِ رِفَاعَةَ بْنِ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ، عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ
