 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ مِنْ تِهَامَةَ فَأَصَبْنَا غَنَمًا وَإِبِلاً فَعَجِلَ الْقَوْمُ فَأَغْلَوْا
 بِهَا الْقُدُورَ فَأَمَرَ بِهَا فَكُفِئَتْ ثُمَّ عَدَلَ عَشْرًا مِنَ الْغَنَمِ بِجَزُورٍ ‏.‏ وَذَكَرَ بَاقِيَ الْحَدِيثِ كَنَحْوِ
 حَدِيثِ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ ‏.‏
35.en: Rafi' b. Khadij reported: While we were with Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) in Dhu'I-Hulaifa in Tihama, we got hold of goats and camels. Some persons (amongst us) made haste and boiled (the flesh of goats and camels) in their earthen pots. He then commanded and these were turned over; then he equalised ten goats for a camel. The rest of the hadith is the same.
35.hi: Rafi bin Khadij ne riwayat ki: Jab hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Dhu'l-Hulaifa mein Tihama mein the, humein bakriyaan aur oont mile. Kuch logon (hummein se) ne jaldi ki aur (bakriyon aur oonton ka gosht) apne mitti ke bartano mein ubaala. Unhone phir hukum diya aur unhe ulTa kar diya gaya; phir unhone das bakriyon ko ek oont ke barabar kiya. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

35.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ مَسْرُوقٍ،
 عَنْ عَبَايَةَ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، رَافِعٍ ثُمَّ حَدَّثَنِيهِ عُمَرُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبَايَةَ بْنِ،
 رِفَاعَةَ بْنِ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ عَنْ جَدِّهِ، قَالَ قُلْنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّا لاَقُو الْعَدُوِّ غَدًا وَلَيْسَ
 مَعَنَا مُدًى فَنُذَكِّي بِاللِّيطِ وَذَكَرَ الْحَدِيثَ بِقِصَّتِهِ وَقَالَ فَنَدَّ عَلَيْنَا بَعِيرٌ مِنْهَا فَرَمَيْنَاهُ بِالنَّبْلِ
 حَتَّى وَهَصْنَاهُ ‏.‏
35.en: Rafi' b. Khadij reported from his grandfather that he said: Allah's Messenger, we are going to encounter the enemy tomorrow, but we do not have long knives with us, should we then slaughter them with the peel of the reed? The rest of the hadith is the same. (And at the end the words are):" A camel became wild (and got out of our control). We attacked it with arrows until we made it fall down."
35.hi: Rafi bin Khadij ne apne dada se riwayat ki jinhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, hum kal dushman se muqaabla karne waale hain, lekin humare paas lambe chaaku nahi hain, kya humein unhe (jaanwaron ko) beans ke chhilke se zibah karna chahiye? Baaki hadees waisi hi hai. (Aur ant mein alfaaz hain): "Ek oont jangli ho gaya (aur humare kaboo se bahar ho gaya). Humne use teeron se hamla kiya yahan tak ki humne use giraaya."

35.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ زَكَرِيَّاءَ، حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ مَسْرُوقٍ،
 بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ الْحَدِيثَ إِلَى آخِرِهِ بِتَمَامِهِ وَقَالَ فِيهِ وَلَيْسَتْ مَعَنَا مُدًى أَفَنَذْبَحُ بِالْقَصَبِ
35.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Sa'id b. Masruq with the same chain of transmitters with a slight variation of words.
35.hi: Ye hadees Sa'id bin Masruq ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halke badlaav ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

35.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ 
 سَعِيدِ بْنِ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَبَايَةَ بْنِ رِفَاعَةَ بْنِ رَافِعٍ، عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ
 اللَّهِ إِنَّا لاَقُو الْعَدُوِّ غَدًا وَلَيْسَ مَعَنَا مُدًى وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ فَعَجِلَ الْقَوْمُ فَأَغْلَوْا
 بِهَا الْقُدُورَ فَأَمَرَ بِهَا فَكُفِئَتْ وَذَكَرَ سَائِرَ الْقِصَّةِ ‏.‏
35.en: Rafi' b. Khadij reported that he said: Allah's Messenger, we are going to encounter the enemy tomorrow. and we do not have large knives with us. The rest of the hadith is the same, but no mention is made of this:" The people hastened and they boiled (flesh) in the earthen pots. He (the Holy Prophet), cammanded and these were turned over and the narrator narrated the whole event.
35.hi: Rafi bin Khadij ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, hum kal dushman se muqaabla karne waale hain, aur humare paas bade chaaku nahi hain. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai, lekin iska koi zikr nahi hai: "Log jaldi karne lage aur mitti ke bartano mein (gosht) ubaala. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) hukum diya aur unhe ulTa kar diya gaya," aur raawi ne poori ghatna riwayat ki.

35.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْجَبَّارِ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا الزُّهْرِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدٍ، قَالَ
 شَهِدْتُ الْعِيدَ مَعَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ فَبَدَأَ بِالصَّلاَةِ قَبْلَ الْخُطْبَةِ وَقَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم نَهَانَا أَنْ نَأْكُلَ مِنْ لُحُومِ نُسُكِنَا بَعْدَ ثَلاَثٍ ‏.‏
35.en: Abu Ubaid reported: I was with 'Ali b. Abi Talib on the occasion of the 'Id day. He started with the 'Id prayer before delivering the sermon, and said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade us to eat the flesh of our sacrificial animals beyond three days.
35.hi: Abu Ubaid ne riwayat ki: Main Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ki sohbat mein tha Id ke din. Unhone khutba dene se pehle Id ki namaz shuru ki, aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein humari qurbaani ke jaanwaron ka gosht teen din se zyada khaane se mana kiya.

35.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، حَدَّثَنِي 
 أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ أَزْهَرَ أَنَّهُ شَهِدَ الْعِيدَ مَعَ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ قَالَ ثُمَّ صَلَّيْتُ مَعَ عَلِيِّ
 بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ - قَالَ - فَصَلَّى لَنَا قَبْلَ الْخُطْبَةِ ثُمَّ خَطَبَ النَّاسَ فَقَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم قَدْ نَهَاكُمْ أَنْ تَأْكُلُوا لُحُومَ نُسُكِكُمْ فَوْقَ ثَلاَثِ لَيَالٍ فَلاَ تَأْكُلُوا ‏.‏
35.en: Abu 'Ubaid, the freed slave of Ibn Azhar, reported that he said 'Id (prayer) with Umar b. al-Khattab, and then said the 'Id (prayer) with 'Ali b. Abu Talib. He (the narrator further) reported: He led us in prayer before delivering the sermon and then addressed the people saying: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has forbidden you to eat the flesh of your sacrificial animals beyond three nights, so do not eat that.
35.hi: Abu Ubaid, Ibn Azhar ke aazad kiye hue ghulam, ne riwayat ki ki unhone Id (ki namaz) Umar bin al-Khattab ke saath padhi, aur phir Id (ki namaz) Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ke saath padhi. Unhone (raawi ne aage) riwayat ki: Unhone humein namaz padhaayi khutba dene se pehle aur phir logon se khitaab karte hue kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne tumhe apni qurbaani ke jaanwaron ka gosht teen raaton se zyada khaane se mana kiya hai, is liye use mat khaao.

35.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَخِي ابْنِ شِهَابٍ،
 ح وَحَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا 
 عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
35.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters.
35.hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

35.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ 
 نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏
"‏ لاَ يَأْكُلْ أَحَدٌ مِنْ لَحْمِ أُضْحِيَّتِهِ
 فَوْقَ ثَلاَثَةِ أَيَّامٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
35.en: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) having said: None of you should eat the flesh of his sacrificial animal beyond three days.
35.hi: Ibn Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Tum mein se koi bhi apni qurbaani ke jaanwar ka gosht teen din se zyada na khaaye.

35.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ،
 بْنُ رَافِعٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا الضَّحَّاكُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عُثْمَانَ - كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ نَافِعٍ،
 عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ اللَّيْثِ ‏.‏
35.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Umar through another chain of transmitters.
35.hi: Ye hadees Ibn Umar ki sanad se ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

35.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ عَبْدٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا 
 عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله
 عليه وسلم نَهَى أَنْ تُؤْكَلَ لُحُومُ الأَضَاحِي بَعْدَ ثَلاَثٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ سَالِمٌ فَكَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ لاَ يَأْكُلُ
 لُحُومَ الأَضَاحِيِّ فَوْقَ ثَلاَثٍ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ بَعْدَ ثَلاَثٍ ‏.‏
35.en: Ibn 'Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade that the flesh of sacrificial animals be eaten beyond three (days) Salim (son of Ibn Umar) said: Ibn 'Umar did not eat the flesh of the sacrificial animals beyond three (days). Ibn Abu 'Umar said:" Beyond three days."
35.hi: Ibn Umar ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne qurbaani ke jaanwaron ka gosht teen (dinon) se zyada khaane se mana kiya. Salim (Ibn Umar ke bete) ne kaha: Ibn Umar qurbaani ke jaanwaron ka gosht teen (dinon) se zyada nahi khaate the. Ibn Abu Umar ne kaha: "Teen din se zyada."

35.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا رَوْحٌ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ،
 أَبِي بَكْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ وَاقِدٍ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ أَكْلِ لُحُومِ
 الضَّحَايَا بَعْدَ ثَلاَثٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِعَمْرَةَ فَقَالَتْ صَدَقَ سَمِعْتُ
 عَائِشَةَ تَقُولُ دَفَّ أَهْلُ أَبْيَاتٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْبَادِيَةِ حِضْرَةَ الأَضْحَى زَمَنَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله
 عليه وسلم فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ ادَّخِرُوا ثَلاَثًا ثُمَّ تَصَدَّقُوا بِمَا بَقِيَ
 ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا كَانَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ النَّاسَ يَتَّخِذُونَ الأَسْقِيَةَ مِنْ ضَحَايَاهُمْ وَيَحْمِلُونَ
 مِنْهَا الْوَدَكَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَمَا ذَاكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا نَهَيْتَ أَنْ تُؤْكَلَ
 لُحُومُ الضَّحَايَا بَعْدَ ثَلاَثٍ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا نَهَيْتُكُمْ مِنْ أَجْلِ الدَّافَّةِ الَّتِي دَفَّتْ فَكُلُوا وَادَّخِرُوا
 وَتَصَدَّقُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
35.en: Abdullah b. Waqid reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade (people) to cat the flesh of sacrificed animals beyond three days. Abdullah b. Abu Bakr said, I made a mention of that to 'Amra, whereupon she said: He has told the truth, for I heard 'A'isha say: The poor among the people of the desert come (to the towns) on the occasion of Id al-Adha during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Upon this Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Retain with you (the flesh) sufficing for three (days), and whatever is left out of that give in charity. After this. they (the Muslims) said: Allah's Messenger, the people make waterskins with the (hides) of their sacrificed animals and they melt fat out of them. Thereupon he said. What the then? They said: You forbade (us) to eat the flesh of sacrificial animals beyond threoq (days), whereupon he said: I forbade you for those (poor persons) who flocked (to the towns on this occasion for getting meat) but now when (this situation has improved) you may eat, preserve and give -in charity.
35.hi: Abdullah bin Waqid ne riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (logon ko) qurbaan kiye gaye jaanwaron ka gosht teen din se zyada khaane se mana kiya. Abdullah bin Abu Bakr ne kaha, maine iska zikr Amra se kiya, isper unhone kaha: Unhone sach kaha, kyunki maine Aisha ko ye kehte suna: Registaan ke gareeb log (shehron mein) Id al-Adha ke avasar par aate the Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Apne paas teen (dinon) ke liye kaafi (gosht) rakho, aur jo bhi isse bacha ho use sadaqe mein do. Iske baad, unhone (Musalmaanon ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, log apni qurbaani ke jaanwaron ki khaal se paani ki thailiyaan banaate hain aur unse charbi pighlaate hain. Isper unhone kaha: Ab kya? Unhone kaha: Aapne humein qurbaani ke jaanwaron ka gosht teen (dinon) se zyada khaane se mana kiya, isper unhone kaha: Maine tumhe un logon (gareebon) ke liye mana kiya jo (is avasar par gosht paane ke liye shehron mein) jama the, lekin ab jab (ye haalat sudhar gayi hai) tum khaa sakte ho, mahfooz rakh sakte ho, aur sadaqe mein de sakte ho.

35.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ نَهَى عَنْ أَكْلِ لُحُومِ الضَّحَايَا بَعْدَ ثَلاَثٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ بَعْدُ ‏
"‏ كُلُوا وَتَزَوَّدُوا
 وَادَّخِرُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
35.en: Jabir reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) forbade eating of the flesh of sacrificed animals beyond three (days). but afterwards said: Eat, make a provision, and keep it.
35.hi: Jabir ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne qurbaan kiye gaye jaanwaron ka gosht teen (dinon) se zyada khaane se mana kiya, lekin baad mein kaha: Khaao, saadhan banao, aur ise mahfooz rakho.

35.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ،
 حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ،
 - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَطَاءٌ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ،
 عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يَقُولُ كُنَّا لاَ نَأْكُلُ مِنْ لُحُومِ بُدْنِنَا فَوْقَ ثَلاَثِ مِنًى فَأَرْخَصَ لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ كُلُوا وَتَزَوَّدُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ لِعَطَاءٍ قَالَ جَابِرٌ حَتَّى جِئْنَا الْمَدِينَةَ قَالَ
 نَعَمْ ‏.‏
35.en: Jabir b. Abdullah reported: We did not eat the flesh of our sacrificial animals beyond three days in Mina. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) permitted us saying: Eat and make it a provision (for journey). I asked 'Ata' whether Jabir had also said: Till we came to Medina. He said: Yes.
35.hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne riwayat ki: Humne apni qurbaani ke jaanwaron ka gosht teen din se zyada nahi khaaya Mina mein. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein ijazat di ye kehte hue: Khaao aur ise (safar ke liye) saadhan banaao. Maine Ata se poocha ki kya Jabir ne bhi kaha tha: Jab tak hum Madina nahi aa gaye. Unhone kaha: Haan.

35.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ بْنُ عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو،
 عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَبِي أُنَيْسَةَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كُنَّا لاَ نُمْسِكُ
 لُحُومَ الأَضَاحِيِّ فَوْقَ ثَلاَثٍ فَأَمَرَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ نَتَزَوَّدَ مِنْهَا وَنَأْكُلَ
 مِنْهَا ‏.‏ يَعْنِي فَوْقَ ثَلاَثٍ ‏.‏
35.en: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported: We did not eat the flesh of sacrificed animals beyond three (days), but then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded us to make it a provision for journey and cat it (beyond three days).
35.hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne riwayat ki: Humne qurbaan kiye gaye jaanwaron ka gosht teen (dinon) se zyada nahi khaaya, lekin phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein hukum diya ki hum ise safar ke liye saadhan banaayein aur ise khaayein (teen din se zyada).

35.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ،
 عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا نَتَزَوَّدُهَا إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
35.en: Jabir reported: We made provision (out of the flesh of sacrificed animals for our journey) to Medina during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).
35.hi: Jabir ne riwayat ki: Humne (qurbaani ke jaanwaron ke gosht se) Madina ke apne safar ke liye saadhan banaaya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein.

35.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، عَنِ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ،
 عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، ح 
 وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي،
 نَضْرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَا أَهْلَ الْمَدِينَةِ
 لاَ تَأْكُلُوا لُحُومَ الأَضَاحِيِّ فَوْقَ ثَلاَثٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى ثَلاَثَةِ أَيَّامٍ ‏.‏ فَشَكَوْا إِلَى رَسُولِ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّ لَهُمْ عِيَالاً وَحَشَمًا وَخَدَمًا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ كُلُوا وَأَطْعِمُوا وَاحْبِسُوا
 أَوِ ادَّخِرُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى شَكَّ عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى ‏.‏
35.en: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said: O people of Medina, do not eat the flesh of sacrificed animals beyond three days. Ibn al-Muthanni said: Three days. They (the Companions of the Holy Prophet) complained to the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) that they had children and servants of theirs (to feed), whereupon he said: Eat, and feed others, and store, and make it a provision of food.
35.hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Aye Madina ke logo, qurbaan kiye gaye jaanwaron ka gosht teen din se zyada mat khaao. Ibn al-Muthanni ne kaha: Teen din. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ke sahaba ne) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se shikaayat ki ki unke bachche aur unke naukar hain (jinhe khilaana hai), isper unhone kaha: Khaao, aur doosron ko khilaao, aur jama karo, aur ise khaane ka saadhan banaao.

35.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي عُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ،
 بْنِ الأَكْوَعِ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ ضَحَّى مِنْكُمْ فَلاَ يُصْبِحَنَّ فِي
 بَيْتِهِ بَعْدَ ثَالِثَةٍ شَيْئًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا كَانَ فِي الْعَامِ الْمُقْبِلِ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ نَفْعَلُ كَمَا فَعَلْنَا
 عَامَ أَوَّلَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ إِنَّ ذَاكَ عَامٌ كَانَ النَّاسُ فِيهِ بِجَهْدٍ فَأَرَدْتُ أَنْ يَفْشُوَ فِيهِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
35.en: Salama b. al-Akwa' reported Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) having said: He who sacrifices (animal) among you nothing should be left in his house (out of its flesh) on the morning of the third day. When it was the next year they (his Companions) said: Should we do this year as we did daring the previous year? Thereupon he said: Don't do that, for that was a year when the people were hard pressed (on account of poverty). so I wanted that the (flesh) might be distributed amongst them.
35.hi: Salama bin al-Akwa ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Jo tum mein se qurbaani karta hai, teesre din ki subah tak uske ghar mein (uske gosht mein se) kuch nahi bachna chahiye. Jab agla saal aaya unhone (unke sahaba ne) kaha: Kya humein is saal wahi karna chahiye jo humne pichhle saal kiya tha? Isper unhone kaha: Aisa mat karo, kyunki woh ek saal tha jab log (gareebi ki wajah se) tang haal the, is liye main chaahta tha ki (gosht) unke beech baanta jaaye.

35.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْنُ بْنُ عِيسَى، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي،
 الزَّاهِرِيَّةِ عَنْ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ نُفَيْرٍ، عَنْ ثَوْبَانَ، قَالَ ذَبَحَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ضَحِيَّتَهُ
 ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏
"‏ يَا ثَوْبَانُ أَصْلِحْ لَحْمَ هَذِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلَمْ أَزَلْ أُطْعِمُهُ مِنْهَا حَتَّى قَدِمَ الْمَدِينَةَ ‏.‏
35.en: Thauban reported that Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) slaughtered his sacrificial animal and then said: Thauban, make his meat usable (for journey), and I continuously served him that until he arrived in Medina.
35.hi: Thauban ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apna qurbaani ka jaanwar zibah kiya aur phir kaha: Thauban, iske gosht ko istemal ke laayak banao (safar ke liye), aur maine lagataar ise use serve kiya jab tak woh Madina nahi pahunche.

35.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَابْنُ، رَافِعٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ حُبَابٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا 
 إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ صَالِحٍ،
 بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
35.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Mu'awiya b. Salih with the same chain of transmitters.
35.hi: Ye hadees Mu'awiya bin Salih ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

35.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُسْهِرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي 
 الزُّبَيْدِيُّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ نُفَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ ثَوْبَانَ، مَوْلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم قَالَ قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ ‏
"‏ أَصْلِحْ
 هَذَا اللَّحْمَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَصْلَحْتُهُ فَلَمْ يَزَلْ يَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ حَتَّى بَلَغَ الْمَدِينَةَ ‏.‏ 
 وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى،
 بْنُ حَمْزَةَ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ ‏.‏
35.en: Thauban, the freed slave of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me on the occasion of Hajjat-al-Wada' (the Farewell Pilgrimage): Make the flesh usable. So I made it usable (for him) and he ate it constantly until he reached Medina. This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Yabya b. Hamza with the same chain of transmitters, but he did not say: On the occasion of Hajjat-al-Wada'.
35.hi: Thauban, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke aazad kiye hue ghulam, ne riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse kaha Hajjat-al-Wada (Vida ke Hajj) ke avasar par: Gosht ko istemal ke laayak banao. To maine ise (unke liye) istemal ke laayak banaaya aur unhone ise lagataar khaaya jab tak woh Madina nahi pahunche. Ye hadees Yahya bin Hamza ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin unhone nahi kaha: Hajjat-al-Wada ke avasar par.

35.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، قَالَ
 أَبُو بَكْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي سِنَانٍ، وَقَالَ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، عَنْ ضِرَارِ بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ مُحَارِبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ،
 عَنْ أَبِيهِ، ح 
 وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ضِرَارُ بْنُ مُرَّةَ،
 أَبُو سِنَانٍ عَنْ مُحَارِبِ بْنِ دِثَارٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ نَهَيْتُكُمْ عَنْ زِيَارَةِ الْقُبُورِ فَزُورُوهَا وَنَهَيْتُكُمْ عَنْ لُحُومِ الأَضَاحِيِّ فَوْقَ
 ثَلاَثٍ فَأَمْسِكُوا مَا بَدَا لَكُمْ وَنَهَيْتُكُمْ عَنِ النَّبِيذِ إِلاَّ فِي سِقَاءٍ فَاشْرَبُوا فِي الأَسْقِيَةِ كُلِّهَا
 وَلاَ تَشْرَبُوا مُسْكِرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
35.en: Abdullah b. Buraida reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said this: I prohibited you from visiting the graves, but (now) you may visit them, and I prohibited you (from eating) the flesh of sacrific- ed animals beyond three days, but now keep it as long as you like. I prohibited you from the use of Nabidh except (that preoared) in dry waterskins. Now drink (Nabidh prepared in any utensil), but do not drink when it becomes intoxicant.
35.hi: Abdullah bin Buraida ne apne waalid ki sanad se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ye kaha: Maine tumhe qabron par jaane se mana kiya tha, lekin (ab) tum unhe visit kar sakte ho, aur maine tumhe (khaane se) qurbaani ke jaanwaron ka gosht teen din se zyada mana kiya tha, lekin ab ise jitna chaaho rakho. Maine tumhe Nabidh (khajoor ka sherbet) ka istemal karne se mana kiya tha siwaay sookhi paani ki thailiyon mein (taiyaar kiya hua). Ab piyo (kisi bhi bartan mein taiyaar kiya hua Nabidh), lekin mat piyo jab ye nashe waala ho jaaye.

35.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا الضَّحَّاكُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ،
 بْنِ مَرْثَدٍ عَنِ ابْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ كُنْتُ نَهَيْتُكُمْ
 ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ أَبِي سِنَانٍ ‏.‏
35.en: Ibn Buraida, on the authority of his father, reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said this: I used to forbid you. The rest of the hadith is the same.
35.hi: Ibn Buraida ne, apne waalid ki sanad se, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Main tumhe mana kiya karta tha. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

35.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ وَزُهَيْرُ
 بْنُ حَرْبٍ قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرُونَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ،
 عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ح 
 وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ عَبْدٌ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ ابْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا 
 عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ لاَ فَرَعَ وَلاَ عَتِيرَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ زَادَ ابْنُ رَافِعٍ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ وَالْفَرَعُ أَوَّلُ
 النِّتَاجِ كَانَ يُنْتَجُ لَهُمْ فَيَذْبَحُونَهُ ‏.‏
35.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: (The sacrifice of Fara' and 'Atira) has no (sanction in Islam). Ibn Rafi' made this addition in his narration that Fara' means the first-born young one of a camel.
35.hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: (Fara aur Atira ki qurbaani) ka (Islam mein koi vidhan) nahi hai. Ibn Rafi ne apni riwayat mein ye izafa kiya ki Fara ka matlab hai oont ka pehla paida kiya bachcha.

35.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ الْمَكِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ،
 بْنِ عَوْفٍ سَمِعَ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيَّبِ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ
 ‏
"‏ إِذَا دَخَلَتِ الْعَشْرُ وَأَرَادَ أَحَدُكُمْ أَنْ يُضَحِّيَ فَلاَ يَمَسَّ مِنْ شَعَرِهِ وَبَشَرِهِ شَيْئًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قِيلَ
 لِسُفْيَانَ فَإِنَّ بَعْضَهُمْ لاَ يَرْفَعُهُ قَالَ لَكِنِّي أَرْفَعُهُ ‏.‏
35.en: Umm Salama reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said this: When any one of you intending to sacrifice the animal enters in the month (of Dhu'l-Hijja) he should not get his hair or nails touched (cut). It was said to Sufyan that some of the (scholars) did not deem this hadith to be Maffu'. He said: But I deem it as Marfu' (i. e. chain of narration traceable right up to the Holy Prophet).
35.hi: Umm Salama ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Jab tum mein se koi (jaanwar ki) qurbaani ka iraada rakhta hai aur (Zul-Hijja ke) mahine mein daakhil hota hai, use apne baal ya naakhun (kaTvaake) nahi chhona chahiye. Sufyan se kaha gaya ki kuch (aalim) is hadees ko Marfu (Nabi tak jaane wali riwayat) nahi maante. Unhone kaha: Lekin main ise Marfu maanta hoon (yaani sanad Nabi-e-Paak tak jaati hai).

35.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ،
 عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، تَرْفَعُهُ قَالَ ‏
"‏ إِذَا دَخَلَ الْعَشْرُ
 وَعِنْدَهُ أُضْحِيَّةٌ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يُضَحِّيَ فَلاَ يَأْخُذَنَّ شَعْرًا وَلاَ يَقْلِمَنَّ ظُفُرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
35.en: Umm Salama reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: If anyone of you intends to offer sacrifice he should not get his hair cut or nails trimmed.
35.hi: Umm Salama ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Agar tum mein se koi qurbaani dene ka iraada rakhta hai use apne baal ya naakhun katvaane nahi chahiye.

35.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ كَثِيرٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ أَبُو غَسَّانَ، حَدَّثَنَا 
 شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ إِذَا رَأَيْتُمْ هِلاَلَ ذِي الْحِجَّةِ وَأَرَادَ أَحَدُكُمْ أَنْ يُضَحِّيَ فَلْيُمْسِكْ
 عَنْ شَعْرِهِ وَأَظْفَارِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
35.en: Umm Salama reported (these words) directly from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ): If anyone has in his possession a sacrificial animal to offer as a sacrifice (on 'Id al-Adha), he should not get his hair cut and nails trimmed after he has entered the first days of Dhu'l Hijja
35.hi: Umm Salama ne seedhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye riwayat ki: Agar kisi ke paas ek qurbaani ka jaanwar hai jise woh (Id al-Adha par) qurbaan karna chahta hai, use Zul-Hijja ke pehle dinon mein daakhil hone ke baad apne baal ya naakhun katvaane nahi chahiye.

35.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ الْهَاشِمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ،
 عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ، أَوْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
35.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Amr b. Muslim with the same chain of transmitters.
35.hi: Ye hadees Amr bin Muslim ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

35.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو اللَّيْثِيُّ،
 عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ عَمَّارِ بْنِ أُكَيْمَةَ اللَّيْثِيِّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيَّبِ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ 
 أُمَّ سَلَمَةَ، زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏
 مَنْ كَانَ لَهُ ذِبْحٌ يَذْبَحُهُ فَإِذَا أُهِلَّ هِلاَلُ ذِي الْحِجَّةِ فَلاَ يَأْخُذَنَّ مِنْ شَعْرِهِ وَلاَ مِنْ أَظْفَارِهِ
 شَيْئًا حَتَّى يُضَحِّيَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
35.en: Umm Salama, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to have said: He who has a sacrificial animal with him whom (he intends) to offer as sacrifice, and he enters the month of Dhu'I-Hijja, he should not get his hair cut or nails trimmed until he has sacrificed the animal.
35.hi: Umm Salama, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Jiske paas ek qurbaani ka jaanwar hai jise (woh qurbaan karna chahta hai), aur woh Zul-Hijja ke mahine mein daakhil hota hai, use apne baal ya naakhun katvaane nahi chahiye jab tak usne jaanwar qurbaan na kar diya ho.

35.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، حَدَّثَنَا 
 عَمْرُو بْنُ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ اللَّيْثِيُّ، قَالَ كُنَّا فِي الْحَمَّامِ قُبَيْلَ الأَضْحَى فَاطَّلَى فِيهِ نَاسٌ فَقَالَ
 بَعْضُ أَهْلِ الْحَمَّامِ إِنَّ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيَّبِ يَكْرَهُ هَذَا أَوْ يَنْهَى عَنْهُ فَلَقِيتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيَّبِ
 فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لَهُ فَقَالَ يَا ابْنَ أَخِي هَذَا حَدِيثٌ قَدْ نُسِيَ وَتُرِكَ حَدَّثَتْنِي أُمُّ سَلَمَةَ زَوْجُ النَّبِيِّ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ مُعَاذٍ عَنْ
 مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو ‏.‏
35.en: 'Amr b. Muslim b. 'Ammar al-Laithi reported: While we were in a bathroom just before 'Id al-Adha some of the persons tried to remove the hair with the help of hair-removing chemicals. Thereupon some of the people owning the bath (or some of the people sitting therein) said that Sa'id b. Musayyib did not approve of it, or he prohibited it. Then I met Sa'id b. Musayyib and made a mention of that to him, whereupon he said: O my nephew, this is the hadith which has been forgotten, and abandoned. Umm Salama, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), narrated to me Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said as narrated above.
35.hi: Amr bin Muslim bin Ammar al-Laithi ne riwayat ki: Jab hum Id al-Adha se pehle ek naahne ki jagah (hammam) mein the kuch logon ne baal hataane waale rasaayanik padaarthon ki madad se baal hataane ki koshish ki. Isper hammam ke kuch maalikon (ya wahan baiThe kuch logon) ne kaha ki Sa'id bin Musayyib ise manzoor nahi karte the, ya unhone ise mana kiya tha. Phir main Sa'id bin Musayyib se mila aur unhe iska zikr kiya, isper unhone kaha: Aye mere bhatije, ye woh hadees hai jise bhula diya gaya hai, aur chhoD diya gaya hai. Umm Salama, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ne mujhe riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne upar bataayi gayi baat kahi thi.

35.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَخِي ابْنِ وَهْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا 
 عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي حَيْوَةُ، أَخْبَرَنِي خَالِدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي هِلاَلٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ،
 بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ الْجُنْدَعِيِّ أَنَّ ابْنَ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ أُمَّ سَلَمَةَ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 أَخْبَرَتْهُ ‏.‏ وَذَكَرَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏.‏
35.en: Amr b. Muslim al-Jundani reported that Ibn Musayyib had told him that it was Umm Salama, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), who had informed him of that as narrated above.
35.hi: Amr bin Muslim al-Jundani ne riwayat ki ki Ibn Musayyib ne unhe bataya tha ki ye Umm Salama, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, thin jinhone unhe upar bataayi gayi baat ki jaankaari di thi.

35.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَسُرَيْجُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ مَرْوَانَ، قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا 
 مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ الْفَزَارِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورُ بْنُ حَيَّانَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الطُّفَيْلِ، عَامِرُ بْنُ وَاثِلَةَ قَالَ
 كُنْتُ عِنْدَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ فَأَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ مَا كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُسِرُّ
 إِلَيْكَ قَالَ فَغَضِبَ وَقَالَ مَا كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُسِرُّ إِلَىَّ شَيْئًا يَكْتُمُهُ النَّاسَ
 غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَدْ حَدَّثَنِي بِكَلِمَاتٍ أَرْبَعٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ مَا هُنَّ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ قَالَ قَالَ ‏
"‏ لَعَنَ
 اللَّهُ مَنْ لَعَنَ وَالِدَهُ وَلَعَنَ اللَّهُ مَنْ ذَبَحَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهِ وَلَعَنَ اللَّهُ مَنْ آوَى مُحْدِثًا وَلَعَنَ اللَّهُ مَنْ غَيَّرَ
 مَنَارَ الأَرْضِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
35.en: Abu Tufail 'Amir b. Withila reported: I was in the company of 'Ali b. Abi Talib, when a person came to him, and said: What was it that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) told you in secret? Thereupon he (liadrat 'All) was enraged and said: Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) did not tell me anything in secret that he hid from people, except that he told me four things. He said: Com- mader of Faithful, what are these? He said: Allah cursed him who cursed his father; Allah cursed him who sacrificed for anyone besides Allah; and Allah cursed him who accommodates an innovator (in religion) ; and Allah cursed him who changed the minarets (the boundary lines) of the land.
35.hi: Abu Tufail Amir bin Withila ne riwayat ki: Main Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ki sohbat mein tha, jab ek shakhs unke paas aaya, aur kaha: Kya thi woh baat jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne aapko chupke se batayi thi? Isper woh (Hazrat Ali (Alayhis Salam)) naaraaz ho gaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe kuch bhi chupke se nahi bataya jise unhone logon se chhupaaya ho, siwaay is baat ke ki unhone mujhe chaar baaten bataayi thin. Unhone kaha: Ameer-ul-Momineen, woh kya hain? Unhone kaha: Allah ne us shakhs par laanat ki jisne apne waalid ko bura-bhala kaha; Allah ne us shakhs par laanat ki jisne Allah ke ilawa kisi doosre ke liye qurbaani di; aur Allah ne us shakhs par laanat ki jo kisi navachaari (deen mein) ko panah deta hai; aur Allah ne us shakhs par laanat ki jisne zameen ke meenaron (seemaon) ko badla.

35.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ الأَحْمَرُ، سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَيَّانَ عَنْ مَنْصُورِ،
 بْنِ حَيَّانَ عَنْ أَبِي الطُّفَيْلِ، قَالَ قُلْنَا لِعَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ أَخْبِرْنَا بِشَىْءٍ، أَسَرَّهُ إِلَيْكَ رَسُولُ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ مَا أَسَرَّ إِلَىَّ شَيْئًا كَتَمَهُ النَّاسَ وَلَكِنِّي سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ ‏
"‏ لَعَنَ
 اللَّهُ مَنْ ذَبَحَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهِ وَلَعَنَ اللَّهُ مَنْ آوَى مُحْدِثًا وَلَعَنَ اللَّهُ مَنْ لَعَنَ وَالِدَيْهِ وَلَعَنَ اللَّهُ مَنْ
 غَيَّرَ الْمَنَارَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
35.en: Abu Tufail reported: We said to 'Ali b. Abi Talib: Inform us about something which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) told you in secret, whereupon he said: He told me nothing in secret which he bid from people, but I heard him say: Allah cursed him who sacrificed for anyone besides Allah; and cursed him who accommodated an innovator; and Allah cursed him who cursed his parents and Allah cursed him who changed the boundary lines (of the land possessed by him).
35.hi: Abu Tufail ne riwayat ki: Humne Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) se kaha: Humein kuch aisa bataiye jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne aapko chupke se bataya, isper unhone kaha: Unhone mujhe kuch bhi chupke se nahi bataaya jise unhone logon se chhupaaya ho, lekin maine unhe ye kehte suna: Allah ne us shakhs par laanat ki jisne Allah ke ilawa kisi doosre ke liye qurbaani di; aur laanat ki us shakhs par jo kisi navachaari ko panah deta hai; aur Allah ne us shakhs par laanat ki jisne apne maa-baap ko bura-bhala kaha aur Allah ne us shakhs par laanat ki jisne (apni malkiyat ki) zameen ki seemaon ko badla.

35.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا 
 مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْقَاسِمَ بْنَ أَبِي بَزَّةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي الطُّفَيْلِ، قَالَ
 سُئِلَ عَلِيٌّ أَخَصَّكُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِشَىْءٍ فَقَالَ مَا خَصَّنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم بِشَىْءٍ لَمْ يَعُمَّ بِهِ النَّاسَ كَافَّةً إِلاَّ مَا كَانَ فِي قِرَابِ سَيْفِي هَذَا -
 قَالَ - فَأَخْرَجَ صَحِيفَةً مَكْتُوبٌ فِيهَا ‏
"‏ لَعَنَ اللَّهُ مَنْ ذَبَحَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهِ وَلَعَنَ اللَّهُ مَنْ سَرَقَ
 مَنَارَ الأَرْضِ وَلَعَنَ اللَّهُ مَنْ لَعَنَ وَالِدَهُ وَلَعَنَ اللَّهُ مَنْ آوَى مُحْدِثًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
35.en: Abu Tufail reported: 'Ali was asked whether Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had showed special favour (by disclosing to him) a thing (which he kept secret from others). Thereupon he said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) singled us not for (disclosing to us) anything (secret) which he did not make public, (but those few things) which lie in the sheath of my sword. He drew out the written document contained in it and on that (it was mentioned): Allah cursed him who sacrificed for anyone else besides Allah; and Allah cursed him who stole the signposts (demarcating the boundary lines of the) land; and Allah cursed him who cursed his father; and Allah cursed him who accommodated an innovator (in religion).
35.hi: Abu Tufail ne riwayat ki: Ali (Alayhis Salam) se poocha gaya ki kya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe koi khaas favour dikhaayi thi (unhe koi aisi cheez bataakar jise unhone doosron se chupaaya). Isper unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein kisi bhi cheez ke liye alag nahi kiya (unhe bataane ke liye) jo unhone doosron ko nahi bataayi, (lekin woh kuch baaten) jo meri talwaar ke myaan mein hain. Unhone myaan mein rakha likha dastaavez nikaala aur usmein (ye likha tha): Allah ne us shakhs par laanat ki jisne Allah ke ilawa kisi doosre ke liye qurbaani di; aur Allah ne us shakhs par laanat ki jisne zameen ki (seemaon ka nirdharan karne wale) nishaan chura liye; aur Allah ne us shakhs par laanat ki jisne apne waalid ko bura-bhala kaha; aur Allah ne us shakhs par laanat ki jo kisi navachaari (deen mein) ko panah deta hai.

36.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، حَدَّثَنِي 
 ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، حُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ،
 قَالَ أَصَبْتُ شَارِفًا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي مَغْنَمٍ يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ وَأَعْطَانِي رَسُولُ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَارِفًا أُخْرَى فَأَنَخْتُهُمَا يَوْمًا عِنْدَ بَابِ رَجُلٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ وَأَنَا
 أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَحْمِلَ عَلَيْهِمَا إِذْخِرًا لأَبِيعَهُ وَمَعِيَ صَائِغٌ مِنْ بَنِي قَيْنُقَاعَ فَأَسْتَعِينَ بِهِ عَلَى وَلِيمَةِ
 فَاطِمَةَ وَحَمْزَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ يَشْرَبُ فِي ذَلِكَ الْبَيْتِ مَعَهُ قَيْنَةٌ تُغَنِّيهِ فَقَالَتْ أَلاَ يَا حَمْزَ
 لِلشُّرُفِ النِّوَاءِ فَثَارَ إِلَيْهِمَا حَمْزَةُ بِالسَّيْفِ فَجَبَّ أَسْنِمَتَهُمَا وَبَقَرَ خَوَاصِرَهُمَا ثُمَّ أَخَذَ مِنْ
 أَكْبَادِهِمَا ‏.‏ قُلْتُ لاِبْنِ شِهَابٍ وَمِنَ السَّنَامِ قَالَ قَدْ جَبَّ أَسْنِمَتَهُمَا فَذَهَبَ بِهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ
 شِهَابٍ قَالَ عَلِيٌّ فَنَظَرْتُ إِلَى مَنْظَرٍ أَفْظَعَنِي فَأَتَيْتُ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَعِنْدَهُ
 زَيْدُ بْنُ حَارِثَةَ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ الْخَبَرَ فَخَرَجَ وَمَعَهُ زَيْدٌ وَانْطَلَقْتُ مَعَهُ فَدَخَلَ عَلَى حَمْزَةَ فَتَغَيَّظَ
 عَلَيْهِ فَرَفَعَ حَمْزَةُ بَصَرَهُ فَقَالَ هَلْ أَنْتُمْ إِلاَّ عَبِيدٌ لآبَائِي فَرَجَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم يُقَهْقِرُ حَتَّى خَرَجَ عَنْهُمْ ‏.‏
36.en: 'Ali b. Abu Talib reported; There fell to my lot along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) an old she-camel from the spoils of Badr. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) granted me another camel. I made them kneel down one day at the door of an Ansari, and I wanted to carry on them Idhkhir (a kind of grass) in order to sell that. There was with me a goldsmith of the tribe of Qainuqa'. I saught to give a wedding feast (on the occasion of marriage with) Fatima with the help of that (the price accrued from the sale of this grass). And Hamza b. 'Abd al-Muttalib was busy in drinking in that house in the company of a singing girl who was singing to him. She said: Hamza, get up for slaughtering the fat she-camels. Hamza attacked them with the sword and cut off their humps and ripped their haunches, and then took out their livers. I said to Ibn Shihab: Did he take out anything from the hump? He said: He cut off the humps altogether. Ibn Shihab reported 'Ali having said: I saw this (horrible) sight and it shocked me, and I came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and there was Zaid b, Haritha with him and communicated to him this news. He came in the company of Zaid and I also went along with him and he went to Hamza and he expressed anger with him. Hamza raised his eyes and said: Are you (not) but the servants of my father? Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) turned back on his heels (on hearing this) until he went away from them.
36.hi: Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ne riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath maal-e-ganimat mein se Badr se mere hisse mein ek boodhi oontni aayi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe ek aur oont diya. Maine unhe ek din ek Ansari ke darwaze par bithaya, aur main unpar Idhkhir (ek tarah ki ghaas) le jaana chahta tha ise bechne ke liye. Mere saath Qainuqa qabile ka ek sunaar tha. Maine (is ghaas ki bikri se aayi raqam se) Fatima (Alayhas Salam) (se shaadi ke avasar par) Waleema karne ki koshish ki. Aur Hamza bin Abd al-Muttalib us ghar mein sharaab peene mein masroof the ek gaane wali larki ki sohbat mein jo unhe gaana suna rahi thi. Usne kaha: Hamza, uTho maansal oontniyon ko zibah karne ke liye. Hamza ne unpar talwaar se hamla kiya aur unke kohaan kaat diye aur unki jaanghen chir dalin, aur phir unke jigar nikaal liye. Maine Ibn Shihab se kaha: Kya unhone kohaan mein se kuch nikaala? Unhone kaha: Unhone kohaan poori tarah kaat diye. Ibn Shihab ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke ye alfaaz riwayat kiye: Maine ye (khaufnaak) nazaara dekha aur ye mujhe sadmen mein daal gaya, aur main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur Zaid bin Haritha unke saath the aur maine ye khabar unhe di. Woh Zaid ki sohbat mein aaye aur main bhi unke saath gaya aur woh Hamza ke paas gaye aur unhone unpar gussa zaahir kiya. Hamza ne apni aankhein uThAyin aur kaha: Kya tum mere waalid ke ghulamon ke ilawa kuch aur ho? Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apni eDiyon par mud gaye (ye sunkar) yahan tak ki woh unse door chale gaye.

36.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ
 مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
36.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Juraij with the same chain of transmitters.
36.hi: Ye hadees Juraij ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

36.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ كَثِيرِ بْنِ عُفَيْرٍ أَبُو عُثْمَانَ الْمِصْرِيُّ،
 حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُسَيْنِ،
 بْنِ عَلِيٍّ أَنَّ حُسَيْنَ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَلِيًّا قَالَ كَانَتْ لِي شَارِفٌ مِنْ نَصِيبِي مِنَ الْمَغْنَمِ
 يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَعْطَانِي شَارِفًا مِنَ الْخُمُسِ يَوْمَئِذٍ فَلَمَّا
 أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَبْتَنِيَ بِفَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَاعَدْتُ رَجُلاً صَوَّاغًا مِنْ
 بَنِي قَيْنُقَاعَ يَرْتَحِلُ مَعِيَ فَنَأْتِي بِإِذْخِرٍ أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَبِيعَهُ مِنَ الصَّوَّاغِينَ فَأَسْتَعِينَ بِهِ فِي
 وَلِيمَةِ عُرْسِي فَبَيْنَا أَنَا أَجْمَعُ لِشَارِفَىَّ مَتَاعًا مِنَ الأَقْتَابِ وَالْغَرَائِرِ وَالْحِبَالِ وَشَارِفَاىَ
 مُنَاخَانِ إِلَى جَنْبِ حُجْرَةِ رَجُلٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ وَجَمَعْتُ حِينَ جَمَعْتُ مَا جَمَعْتُ فَإِذَا شَارِفَاىَ
 قَدِ اجْتُبَّتْ أَسْنِمَتُهُمَا وَبُقِرَتْ خَوَاصِرُهُمَا وَأُخِذَ مِنْ أَكْبَادِهِمَا فَلَمْ أَمْلِكْ عَيْنَىَّ حِينَ رَأَيْتُ
 ذَلِكَ الْمَنْظَرَ مِنْهُمَا قُلْتُ مَنْ فَعَلَ هَذَا قَالُوا فَعَلَهُ حَمْزَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ وَهُوَ فِي هَذَا الْبَيْتِ
 فِي شَرْبٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ غَنَّتْهُ قَيْنَةٌ وَأَصْحَابَهُ فَقَالَتْ فِي غِنَائِهَا أَلاَ يَا حَمْزَ لِلشُّرُفِ النِّوَاءِ
 فَقَامَ حَمْزَةُ بِالسَّيْفِ فَاجْتَبَّ أَسْنِمَتَهُمَا وَبَقَرَ خَوَاصِرَهُمَا فَأَخَذَ مِنْ أَكْبَادِهِمَا قَالَ عَلِيٌّ
 فَانْطَلَقْتُ حَتَّى أَدْخُلَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَعِنْدَهُ زَيْدُ بْنُ حَارِثَةَ - قَالَ
 - فَعَرَفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي وَجْهِيَ الَّذِي لَقِيتُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ مَا لَكَ ‏"‏ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهِ مَا رَأَيْتُ كَالْيَوْمِ قَطُّ عَدَا حَمْزَةُ عَلَى
 نَاقَتَىَّ فَاجْتَبَّ أَسْنِمَتَهُمَا وَبَقَرَ خَوَاصِرَهُمَا وَهَا هُوَ ذَا فِي بَيْتٍ مَعَهُ شَرْبٌ - قَالَ - فَدَعَا
 رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِرِدَائِهِ فَارْتَدَاهُ ثُمَّ انْطَلَقَ يَمْشِي وَاتَّبَعْتُهُ أَنَا وَزَيْدُ بْنُ حَارِثَةَ
 حَتَّى جَاءَ الْبَابَ الَّذِي فِيهِ حَمْزَةُ فَاسْتَأْذَنَ فَأَذِنُوا لَهُ فَإِذَا هُمْ شَرْبٌ فَطَفِقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم يَلُومُ حَمْزَةَ فِيمَا فَعَلَ فَإِذَا حَمْزَةُ مُحْمَرَّةٌ عَيْنَاهُ فَنَظَرَ حَمْزَةُ إِلَى
 رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ صَعَّدَ النَّظَرَ إِلَى رُكْبَتَيْهِ ثُمَّ صَعَّدَ النَّظَرَ فَنَظَرَ إِلَى سُرَّتِهِ
 ثُمَّ صَعَّدَ النَّظَرَ فَنَظَرَ إِلَى وَجْهِهِ فَقَالَ حَمْزَةُ وَهَلْ أَنْتُمْ إِلاَّ عَبِيدٌ لأَبِي فَعَرَفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ ثَمِلٌ فَنَكَصَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى عَقِبَيْهِ الْقَهْقَرَى
 وَخَرَجَ وَخَرَجْنَا مَعَهُ ‏.‏
36.en: Husain b. 'Ali reported 'Ali having said: There fell to my lot a she-camel out of the spoils of war on the Day of Badr, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave me (another) she-camel on that day out of the Khums (one-fifth reserved for Allah and His Messenger). When I made up my mind to consummate my marriage with Fatima, the daughter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), I prevailed upon a goldsmith of the tribe of Qainuqa' to go along with me so that we might bring Idhkhir wishing to sell that to the goldsmiths and thus I should be able to arrange my wedding feast. While I was arranging the equipments. i. e. litters, sacks and ropes, my two she-camels were sitting down at the side of the apartment of a person of the Ansar. I collected (the different articles of equipment) and found to my surprise that their humps had been chopped off and their haunches had been cut off and their livers had been taken out. I could not help weeping when I saw that plight of theirs. I said: Who has done that? They said: Hamza b. 'Abd al-Muttalib has done this. and he is in this house dead drunk in the company of some of the Ansair with asinging girl singing before him and his companions. She said in her song: O Hamza. get up and attack these falty she-camels. Thereupon Hamza stood up with a sword (in his hand) and cut off their humps and ripped their haunches and tore out their livers. 'Ali said: I went away until I came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and there was with him Zaid b. Haritha. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) recognised from my face what I had experienced, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: What has happened to you? I said: Messenger of Allah, by Allah, I have never seen (such an unfortunate day) as this day. Hamza has committed aggression to my she-camels, and has cut off their humps. and ripped their haunches, and he is in a house in the company of some drunkards. (Hearing this) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent for his mantle and, putting it on him, he proceeded, and I and Zaid b. Haritha followed him, until he came to the door (of the house) in which there was Hamza. He (the Holy Prophet) sought permission which they granted him. and they were all drunk. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) began to reprimand Hamza for what he had done. Hamza's eyes were red. He cast a glance at Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and then looked towards his knees. and then lifted his eyes and cast a glance at his waist and then lifted his eyes and saw his face. And then Hamza said: Are you anything but the slaves of my father? Alah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to know that he was intoxicated, and he thus turned upon his heels, and came out, and we also came out along with him.
36.hi: Husain bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke ye alfaaz riwayat kiye: Badr ke din jung ke maal-e-ganimat mein se mere hisse mein ek oontni aayi, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe us din (ek aur) oontni di Khums (Allah aur Uske Rasool ke liye alag rakha gaya paanchvaan hissa) mein se. Jab maine Fatima (Alayhas Salam), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki beti, ke saath apni shaadi poori karne ka mann banaaya, maine Qainuqa qabile ke ek sunaar ko manaaya mere saath jaane ke liye taaki hum Idhkhir laa sakein use sunaaron ko bechne ke iraade se aur is tarah main apna shaadi ka daawat munazzam kar saka. Jab main saamaan (yaani doliyaan, thailiyaan aur rassiyaan) munazzam kar raha tha, meri do oontniyaan ek Ansari ke kamre ke bagal mein baiThi hui thin. Maine (mukhtalif saamaan ki cheezein) ikattha kin aur hairat se paaya ki unke kohaan kaat diye gaye the aur unki jaanghen chir dali gayi thin aur unke jigar nikaal liye gaye the. Maine khud ko rone se rok nahi paaya jab maine unki ye halat dekhi. Maine kaha: Kisne ye kiya hai? Unhone kaha: Hamza bin Abd al-Muttalib ne ye kiya hai, aur woh is ghar mein sharaab ke nashe mein hain kuch Ansar ki sohbat mein aur ek gaane wali larki unke saamne gaa rahi hai aur unke saathi (bhi). Usne apne gaane mein kaha: Aye Hamza, uTho aur in mote-taaze oontniyon par hamla karo. Isper Hamza (talwaar apne haath mein liye) khade hue aur unke kohaan kaat diye aur unki jaanghen chir dalin aur unke jigar nikaal liye. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: Main chala gaya yahan tak ki main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unke saath Zaid bin Haritha the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mere chehre se pehchaan liya ki maine kya tajurba kiya tha, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Tumhe kya hua hai? Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Allah ki qasam, maine kabhi (aisa badnaseeb din) nahi dekha jaisa ye din. Hamza ne meri oontniyon par hamla kiya hai, aur unke kohaan kaat diye hain, aur unki jaanghen chir dali hain, aur woh ek ghar mein kuch sharaabiyon ki sohbat mein hain. (Ye sunkar) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apna chogha mangwaaya aur, use pehankar, woh chal diye, aur main aur Zaid bin Haritha unke peeche gaye, yahan tak ki woh us ghar ke darwaze par pahunche jismein Hamza the. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) ijazat maangi jo unhe di gayi. aur woh sab nashe mein the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Hamza ko unke kiye hue kaam ke liye daantna shuru kiya. Hamza ki aankhein laal thin. Unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki taraf ek nazar daali aur phir unke ghutnon ki taraf dekha, aur phir apni aankhein uThaakar unki kamar ki taraf dekha aur phir apni aankhein uThaakar unka chehra dekha. Aur phir Hamza ne kaha: Kya tum mere waalid ke ghulamon ke ilawa kuch aur ho? Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko samajh aaya ki woh nashe mein hain, aur woh is tarah apni eDiyon par mud gaye, aur bahar aaye, aur hum bhi unke saath bahar aaye.

36.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ قُهْزَاذَ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ،
 بْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
36.en: The above hadith has been narrated likewise through another chain of transmitters.
36.hi: Upar wali hadees ek doosri sanad ke zariye isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai.

36.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ الْعَتَكِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زَيْدٍ - أَخْبَرَنَا 
 ثَابِتٌ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ سَاقِيَ الْقَوْمِ يَوْمَ حُرِّمَتِ الْخَمْرُ فِي بَيْتِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ وَمَا
 شَرَابُهُمْ إِلاَّ الْفَضِيخُ الْبُسْرُ وَالتَّمْرُ ‏.‏ فَإِذَا مُنَادٍ يُنَادِي فَقَالَ اخْرُجْ فَانْظُرْ فَخَرَجْتُ فَإِذَا
 مُنَادٍ يُنَادِي أَلاَ إِنَّ الْخَمْرَ قَدْ حُرِّمَتْ - قَالَ - فَجَرَتْ فِي سِكَكِ الْمَدِينَةِ فَقَالَ لِي أَبُو طَلْحَةَ
 اخْرُجْ فَاهْرِقْهَا ‏.‏ فَهَرَقْتُهَا فَقَالُوا أَوْ قَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ قُتِلَ فُلاَنٌ قُتِلَ فُلاَنٌ وَهِيَ فِي بُطُونِهِمْ
 - قَالَ فَلاَ أَدْرِي هُوَ مِنْ حَدِيثِ أَنَسٍ - فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏ لَيْسَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا
 وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ جُنَاحٌ فِيمَا طَعِمُوا إِذَا مَا اتَّقَوْا وَآمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ‏}‏
36.en: Anas b. Malik reported: I was the cup-bearer of some people in the house of Abu Talha on the day when liquor was forbidden. Their liquor had been prepared from dry dates or fresh dates when the announcer made the announcement. He (Abu Talha) said to me: Go out and find out (what the announcement is). I got out (and found) an announcer making this announcement: Behold, liquor has been declared unlawful. He said: The liquor (was spilt and) flawed in the lanes of Medina. Abu Talha said to me: Go out and Spill it, and I spilt it. They said or some of them said: Such and such were killed, such and such were killed for (the wine) had been in their stomachs. He (the narrator) said. I do not know whether it is the narration transmitted by Anas, (or by someone else). Then Allah, the Exalted and Majestic, revealed:" There shall be no sin (imputed) unto those who have believed and done good works for what they may have eaten as long as they fear (Allah) and believe and do good works" (v. 93).
36.hi: Anas bin Malik ne riwayat ki: Main kuch logon ka saaqi tha Abu Talha ke ghar mein us din jab sharaab mana ki gayi. Unki sharaab sookhi khajooron ya taazi khajooron se taiyaar ki gayi thi jab ailaan karne wale ne ailaan kiya. Unhone (Abu Talha ne) mujhse kaha: Bahar jaao aur pata karo (ailaan kya hai). Main bahar gaya (aur paaya) ki ek ailaan karne wala ye ailaan kar raha tha: Dekho, sharaab ko na-jaayez ailaan kiya gaya hai. Unhone kaha: Sharaab (bikhri gayi thi aur) Madina ki galiyon mein beh rahi thi. Abu Talha ne mujhse kaha: Bahar jaao aur ise bahaa do, aur maine ise bahaa diya. Unhone kaha ya unmein se kuchne kaha: Aisa aisa qatal kiye gaye, aisa aisa qatal kiye gaye (sharaab ke) unke pait mein hone ki wajah se. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha. Mujhe nahi pata ki ye Anas ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hadees hai (ya kisi doosre ke zariye). Phir Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne nazil kiya: "Unke liye koi gunah nahi (aropit) hoga jinhone imaan rakha aur achhe amal kiye us cheez ke liye jo unhone khaya ho jab tak woh (Allah se) darte rahe aur imaan rakhte rahe aur achhe amal karte rahe" (5:93).

36.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ صُهَيْبٍ، قَالَ
 سَأَلُوا أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ عَنِ الْفَضِيخِ، فَقَالَ مَا كَانَتْ لَنَا خَمْرٌ غَيْرَ فَضِيخِكُمْ هَذَا الَّذِي تُسَمُّونَهُ
 الْفَضِيخَ إِنِّي لَقَائِمٌ أَسْقِيهَا أَبَا طَلْحَةَ وَأَبَا أَيُّوبَ وَرِجَالاً مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله
 عليه وسلم فِي بَيْتِنَا إِذْ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ هَلْ بَلَغَكُمُ الْخَبَرُ قُلْنَا لاَ قَالَ فَإِنَّ الْخَمْرَ قَدْ حُرِّمَتْ
 فَقَالَ يَا أَنَسُ أَرِقْ هَذِهِ الْقِلاَلَ قَالَ فَمَا رَاجَعُوهَا وَلاَ سَأَلُوا عَنْهَا بَعْدَ خَبَرِ الرَّجُلِ ‏.‏
36.en: 'Abd al-Aziz b. Suhaib reported: They (some persons) asked Anas b. Malik, about Fadikh (that is, a wine prepared from fresh dates), whereupon he said: There was no liquor with us except this Fadikih of yours. It was only this Fadikh that I had been serving to Abu Talha and Abu Ayyub and some persons from amongst the Companions of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in our house. When a person came and said: Has the news reached you? We said, No. He said: Verily liquor has been declared forbidden. Thereupon, Abd Talha said: Anas, spill these large pitchers. He (the narrator) said: They then never reverted to it, nor even asked about this after the announcement by that person.
36.hi: Abd al-Aziz bin Suhaib ne riwayat ki: Unhone (kuch logon ne) Anas bin Malik se Fadikh (yaani taazi khajooron se taiyaar sharaab) ke baare mein poocha, isper unhone kaha: Humare paas iske ilawa koi sharaab nahi thi (siwaay) is tumhare Fadikh ke. Ye sirf yehi Fadikh tha jo main Abu Talha aur Abu Ayyub aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke kuch sahaba ko humare ghar mein serve karta tha. Jab ek shakhs aaya aur kaha: Kya tumhe khabar pahunchi hai? Humne kaha: Nahi. Usne kaha: Yaqeenan sharaab ko na-jaayez ailaan kiya gaya hai. Isper, Abu Talha ne kaha: Anas, in badi thailiyon ko bahaa do. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Woh phir kabhi isse waapas nahi laute, na hi is shakhs ke ailaan ke baad iske baare mein poocha.

36.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ التَّيْمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا 
 أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ إِنِّي لَقَائِمٌ عَلَى الْحَىِّ عَلَى عُمُومَتِي أَسْقِيهِمْ مِنْ فَضِيخٍ لَهُمْ وَأَنَا أَصْغَرُهُمْ
 سِنًّا فَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ إِنَّهَا قَدْ حُرِّمَتِ الْخَمْرُ فَقَالُوا اكْفَأْهَا يَا أَنَسُ ‏.‏ فَكَفَأْتُهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ
 قُلْتُ لأَنَسٍ مَا هُوَ قَالَ بُسْرٌ وَرُطَبٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَنَسٍ كَانَتْ خَمْرَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ
 ‏.‏ قَالَ سُلَيْمَانُ وَحَدَّثَنِي رَجُلٌ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ذَلِكَ أَيْضًا ‏.‏
36.en: Anas b. Malik reported: I was standing amongst the uncles of my tribe serving them Fadikh while I was the youngest of them, when a person came and said: Verily the use of liqour has been prohibited. They said: Anas, spill it away. So I spilt it. He (one of the narrators. Sulaiman Taimi) said that he asked Anas what that was (the Fadikh). He said: It had been prepared from unripe and ripe dates. Abu Bakr b. Anas said: It was their liquor in those days. Sulaiman said: A person narrated it to me from Anas b. Malik that he had said so.
36.hi: Anas bin Malik ne riwayat ki: Main apne qabile ke chachaon ke beech khada tha unhe Fadikh serve karte hue jabki main unmein sabse jawaan tha, jab ek shakhs aaya aur kaha: Yaqeenan sharaab ke istemal ko mana kiya gaya hai. Unhone kaha: Anas, ise bahaa do. To maine ise bahaa diya. Unhone (raawiyon mein se ek, Sulaiman Taimi ne) kaha ki unhone Anas se poocha ki woh (Fadikh) kya tha. Unhone kaha: Ye kachchi aur pakki khajooron se taiyaar ki gayi thi. Abu Bakr bin Anas ne kaha: Ye un dinon unki sharaab thi. Sulaiman ne kaha: Ek shakhs ne mujhe Anas bin Malik se riwayat ki ki unhone aisa kaha tha.

36.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَ أَنَسٌ كُنْتُ قَائِمًا
 عَلَى الْحَىِّ أَسْقِيهِمْ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَنَسٍ كَانَ خَمْرَهُمْ
 يَوْمَئِذٍ ‏.‏ وَأَنَسٌ شَاهِدٌ فَلَمْ يُنْكِرْ أَنَسٌ ذَاكَ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ
 قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي بَعْضُ مَنْ كَانَ مَعِي أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَنَسًا يَقُولُ كَانَ خَمْرَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ ‏.‏
36.en: Anas reported: I was standing amongst the members of my (tribe) and serving them liquor. The rest of the hadith is the same, but with this variation that Abu Bakr b. Anas said: It was their liquor in those days (prepared from dates), and Anas was present there and he did not deny this (fact) Mu'tamir reported on the authority of his father: A person who was with me told me that he had heard Anas saying that that was their liquor in those days.
36.hi: Anas ne riwayat ki: Main apne (qabile) ke sadasyon ke beech khada tha aur unhe sharaab serve kar raha tha. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai, lekin is antar ke saath ki Abu Bakr bin Anas ne kaha: Ye un dinon unki sharaab thi (khajooron se taiyaar), aur Anas wahan maujood the aur unhone ise nakaara nahi kiya. Mu'tamir ne apne waalid ki sanad se riwayat ki: Ek shakhs jo mere saath tha usne mujhe bataya ki usne Anas ko ye kehte suna tha ki woh un dinon unki sharaab thi.

36.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ،
 عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ أَسْقِي أَبَا طَلْحَةَ وَأَبَا دُجَانَةَ وَمُعَاذَ بْنَ جَبَلٍ فِي
 رَهْطٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ فَدَخَلَ عَلَيْنَا دَاخِلٌ فَقَالَ حَدَثَ خَبَرٌ نَزَلَ تَحْرِيمُ الْخَمْرِ ‏.‏ فَكَفَأْنَاهَا يَوْمَئِذٍ
 وَإِنَّهَا لَخَلِيطُ الْبُسْرِ وَالتَّمْرِ ‏.‏ قَالَ قَتَادَةُ وَقَالَ أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ لَقَدْ حُرِّمَتِ الْخَمْرُ وَكَانَتْ
 عَامَّةُ خُمُورِهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَلِيطَ الْبُسْرِ وَالتَّمْرِ ‏.‏
36.en: Anas b. Malik reported I was serving wine to Abu Talha, and Abu Dujana. and Mu'adh b. jabal admidst a group of Ansar when a visitor came to us and said There is a fresh news; the (verses) concerning the prohibition of liquor have been revealed. So we spilt it on that day; and it was a mixture of dry dates and fresh dates. Anas b. Malik said: Whil Khamr was declared unlawful, the common liquor of theirs was then a mixture of dry dates and fresh dates.
36.hi: Anas bin Malik ne riwayat ki: Main Abu Talha, aur Abu Dujana, aur Mu'adh bin Jabal ko sharaab serve kar raha tha Ansar ke ek giroh ke beech jab ek visitor humare paas aaya aur kaha: Ek taazi khabar hai; (aayaten) sharaab ki mana ke baare mein nazil hui hain. To humne ise us din bahaa diya; aur ye sookhi khajooron aur taazi khajooron ka mishran tha. Anas bin Malik ne kaha: Jab Khamr ko na-jaayez ailaan kiya gaya, tab unki aam sharaab sookhi khajooron aur taazi khajooron ka mishran hoti thi.

36.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو غَسَّانَ الْمِسْمَعِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالُوا أَخْبَرَنَا مُعَاذُ،
 بْنُ هِشَامٍ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ إِنِّي لأَسْقِي أَبَا طَلْحَةَ وَأَبَا دُجَانَةَ
 وَسُهَيْلَ ابْنَ بَيْضَاءَ مِنْ مَزَادَةٍ فِيهَا خَلِيطُ بُسْرٍ وَتَمْرٍ ‏.‏ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ سَعِيدٍ ‏.‏
36.en: Anas b. Malik said: I was serving wine to Abu Talha, Abu Dujana, and Suhail b. Baida' from a waterskin which contained the mixture of unripe dates and fresh dates. The rest of the hadith is the same.
36.hi: Anas bin Malik ne kaha: Main Abu Talha, Abu Dujana, aur Suhail bin Baida ko ek chamde ki thaili se sharaab serve kar raha tha jismein kachchi aur taazi khajooron ka mishran tha. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

36.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَرْحٍ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي 
 عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، أَنَّ قَتَادَةَ بْنَ دِعَامَةَ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ إِنَّ رَسُولَ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى أَنْ يُخْلَطَ التَّمْرُ وَالزَّهْوُ ثُمَّ يُشْرَبَ وَإِنَّ ذَلِكَ كَانَ عَامَّةَ خُمُورِهِمْ
 يَوْمَ حُرِّمَتِ الْخَمْرُ ‏.‏
36.en: Anas b. Malik is reported to have said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had forbidden to mixture fresh dates and unripe dates and then drinking (the wine prepared out of it), and that was their common intoxicant when liquor was prohibited.
36.hi: Anas bin Malik ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne taazi khajooron aur kachchi khajooron ko mishrit karne aur phir (usse taiyaar sharaab) peene se mana kiya, aur ye unki aam nashe waali cheez thi jab sharaab ko na-jaayez ailaan kiya gaya.

36.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ،
 عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ كُنْتُ أَسْقِي أَبَا عُبَيْدَةَ بْنَ الْجَرَّاحِ وَأَبَا
 طَلْحَةَ وَأُبَىَّ بْنَ كَعْبٍ شَرَابًا مِنْ فَضِيخٍ وَتَمْرٍ فَأَتَاهُمْ آتٍ فَقَالَ إِنَّ الْخَمْرَ قَدْ حُرِّمَتْ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ
 أَبُو طَلْحَةَ يَا أَنَسُ قُمْ إِلَى هَذِهِ الْجَرَّةِ فَاكْسِرْهَا ‏.‏ فَقُمْتُ إِلَى مِهْرَاسٍ لَنَا فَضَرَبْتُهَا بِأَسْفَلِهِ
 حَتَّى تَكَسَّرَتْ ‏.‏
36.en: Anas b. Malik reported: I was serving drink to Abu 'Ubaida b. jarrah, Abu Talha and Ubayy b. Ka'b prepared from unripe dates and fresh dates when a visitor came and he said: Verily liquor has been prohibited. Thereupon, Abu Talha said: Anas, stand up and break this pitcher. I stool up and (took hold) of a pointed stone and struck the pitcher with its lower part until it broke into pieces.
36.hi: Anas bin Malik ne riwayat ki: Main Abu Ubaida bin Jarrah, Abu Talha aur Ubayy bin Ka'b ko sharaab serve kar raha tha jo kachchi aur taazi khajooron se taiyaar ki gayi thi jab ek visitor aaya aur usne kaha: Yaqeenan sharaab ko na-jaayez ailaan kiya gaya hai. Isper, Abu Talha ne kaha: Anas, uTho aur is ghade ko toDo. Main uThA aur ek nukili patthar (lekar) uske neechle hisse se ghade ko maara yahan tak ki ye tukdon mein toot gaya.

36.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، - يَعْنِي الْحَنَفِيَّ - حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْحَمِيدِ،
 بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ لَقَدْ أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ الآيَةَ الَّتِي حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ فِيهَا
 الْخَمْرَ وَمَا بِالْمَدِينَةِ شَرَابٌ يُشْرَبُ إِلاَّ مِنْ تَمْرٍ ‏.‏
36.en: Anas b. Malik reported: Allah revealed the verse in which Allah prohibited the use of liquor. In those days no other liquor was drunk but that prepared from dates.
36.hi: Anas bin Malik ne riwayat ki: Allah ne aayat nazil ki jismein Allah ne sharaab ke istemal ko na-jaayez ailaan kiya. Un dinon koi doosri sharaab nahi payi jaati thi siwaay uske jo khajooron se taiyaar ki jaati thi.

36.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ،
 حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنِ السُّدِّيِّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عَبَّادٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم سُئِلَ عَنِ الْخَمْرِ تُتَّخَذُ خَلاًّ فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ لاَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
36.en: Anas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked about the use of Khamr from which vinegar is prepared. He said: No (it is prohibited).
36.hi: Anas ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se us Khamr ke istemal ke baare mein poocha gaya jisse sirka taiyaar kiya jaata hai. Unhone kaha: Nahi (ye mana hai).

36.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا 
 مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ وَائِلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، وَائِلٍ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ،
 أَنَّ طَارِقَ بْنَ سُوَيْدٍ الْجُعْفِيَّ، سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْخَمْرِ فَنَهَا أَوْ كَرِهَ أَنْ
 يَصْنَعَهَا فَقَالَ إِنَّمَا أَصْنَعُهَا لِلدَّوَاءِ فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ بِدَوَاءٍ وَلَكِنَّهُ دَاءٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
36.en: Wa'il al-Hadrami reported that Tariq b. Suwaid a-Ju'fi asked Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) about liquor. He forbade (its use) and he expressed hatred that it should be prepared. He (Tariq) said: I prepare it as a medicine, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: It is no medicine, but an ailment.
36.hi: Wa'il al-Hadrami ne riwayat ki ki Tariq bin Suwaid a-Ju'fi ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se sharaab ke baare mein poocha. Unhone (iske istemal se) mana kiya aur ghrina zaahir ki ki ye taiyaar ki jaaye. Unhone (Tariq ne) kaha: Main ise dawaai ke soorat mein taiyaar karta hoon, isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Ye dawaai nahi hai, balki ek bimaari hai.

36.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَجَّاجُ بْنُ أَبِي،
 عُثْمَانَ حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا كَثِيرٍ، حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ الْخَمْرُ مِنْ هَاتَيْنِ الشَّجَرَتَيْنِ النَّخْلَةِ وَالْعِنَبَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
36.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said: Wine is prepared from the (fruit) of these two trees-date-palm and vine.
36.hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Sharaab in do darakhton ke (phal) se taiyaar ki jaati hai - khajoor aur angoor.

36.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَثِيرٍ،  قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏
"‏ الْخَمْرُ مِنْ  هَاتَيْنِ الشَّجَرَتَيْنِ النَّخْلَةِ وَالْعِنَبَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
36.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through a different chain of transmitters.
36.hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

36.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنِ الأَوْزَاعِيِّ، وَعِكْرِمَةَ،
 بْنِ عَمَّارٍ وَعُقْبَةَ بْنِ التَّوْأَمِ عَنْ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله
 عليه وسلم ‏"‏ الْخَمْرُ مِنْ هَاتَيْنِ الشَّجَرَتَيْنِ الْكَرْمَةِ وَالنَّخْلَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ أَبِي كُرَيْبٍ ‏"‏
 الْكَرْمِ وَالنَّخْلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
36.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Wine comes from vine and date-palms. Abu Kuraib has narrated it with a slight variation of words.
36.hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Sharaab angoor aur khajoor se aati hai. Abu Kuraib ne ise alfaazon mein halke badlaav ke saath riwayat kiya hai.

36.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ، سَمِعْتُ عَطَاءَ بْنَ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ،
 حَدَّثَنَا جَابِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَنْصَارِيُّ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى أَنْ يُخْلَطَ الزَّبِيبُ
 وَالتَّمْرُ وَالْبُسْرُ وَالتَّمْرُ ‏.‏
36.en: Jabir b. 'Abdullah al-Ansari reported that Allah's Messenger (may peace upon him) prohibited the mixing of grapes and fresh dates, and dry dates and fresh dates.
36.hi: Jabir bin Abdullah al-Ansari ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne angoor aur taazi khajooron ke, aur sookhi khajooron aur taazi khajooron ke mishran se mana kiya.

36.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ،
 اللَّهِ الأَنْصَارِيِّ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ نَهَى أَنْ يُنْبَذَ التَّمْرُ وَالزَّبِيبُ جَمِيعًا
 وَنَهَى أَنْ يُنْبَذَ الرُّطَبُ وَالْبُسْرُ جَمِيعًا ‏.‏
36.en: Jabir b. 'Abdullah al-Ansari reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited the (preparation of) Nabidh by mixing together fresh dates and grapes, and he prohibited the preparation of Nabidh by mixing the fresh dates and unripe dates together.
36.hi: Jabir bin Abdullah al-Ansari ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne taazi khajooron aur angoor ko milaakar Nabidh (taiyaar karne) se mana kiya, aur unhone taazi khajooron aur kachchi khajooron ko milaakar Nabidh taiyaar karne se mana kiya.

36.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ،
 بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ رَافِعٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ،
 جُرَيْجٍ قَالَ قَالَ لِي عَطَاءٌ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم ‏
"‏ لاَ تَجْمَعُوا بَيْنَ الرُّطَبِ وَالْبُسْرِ وَبَيْنَ الزَّبِيبِ وَالتَّمْرِ نَبِيذًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
36.en: Jabir b. Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Do not mix fresh dates and dry dates, and grapes and fresh dates for preparing Nabidh.
36.hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Taazi khajooren aur sookhi khajooren, aur angoor aur taazi khajooren mat milaao Nabidh taiyaar karne ke liye.

36.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ 
 أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ الْمَكِّيِّ، مَوْلَى حَكِيمِ بْنِ حِزَامٍ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ نَهَى أَنْ يُنْبَذَ الزَّبِيبُ وَالتَّمْرُ جَمِيعًا وَنَهَى أَنْ يُنْبَذَ الْبُسْرُ وَالرُّطَبُ
 جَمِيعًا ‏.‏
36.en: Jabir b. Abdullah al-Ansari reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) Prohibited the preparation of Nabidh by mixing grapes and fresh dates. and he forbade the preparation of Nabidh by mixing unripe dates with fresh dates.
36.hi: Jabir bin Abdullah al-Ansari ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne angoor aur taazi khajooron ko milaakar Nabidh taiyaar karne se mana kiya, aur unhone kachchi khajooron ko taazi khajooron ke saath milaakar Nabidh taiyaar karne se mana kiya.

36.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، عَنِ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ 
 أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ التَّمْرِ وَالزَّبِيبِ أَنْ يُخْلَطَ بَيْنَهُمَا وَعَنِ
 التَّمْرِ وَالْبُسْرِ أَنْ يُخْلَطَ بَيْنَهُمَا ‏.‏
36.en: Abu Sa'id reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) prohibited that fresh dates and grapes be mixed together and that fresh dates and unripe dates be mixed together.
36.hi: Abu Sa'id ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mana kiya ki taazi khajooren aur angoor ekasath milaayi jaayein aur ki taazi khajooren aur kachchi khajooren ekasath milaayi jaayein.

36.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ أَبُو مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ 
 أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ نَهَانَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ نَخْلِطَ بَيْنَ الزَّبِيبِ
 وَالتَّمْرِ وَأَنْ نَخْلِطَ الْبُسْرَ وَالتَّمْرَ ‏.‏
36.en: Abu Sa'id reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited us to mix grapes and dry dates together and unripe dates and dry dates (to prepare Nabidh.
36.hi: Abu Sa'id ne riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein angoor aur sookhi khajooron ko ekasath, aur kachchi khajooron aur sookhi khajooron ko (Nabidh taiyaar karne ke liye) milaane se mana kiya.

36.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُفَضَّلٍ - عَنْ أَبِي،
 مَسْلَمَةَ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
36.en: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Abi Maslama with the same chain of transmitters.
36.hi: Ye hadees Abi Maslama ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

36.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ الْعَبْدِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي،
 الْمُتَوَكِّلِ النَّاجِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ مَنْ
 شَرِبَ النَّبِيذَ مِنْكُمْ فَلْيَشْرَبْهُ زَبِيبًا فَرْدًا أَوْ تَمْرًا فَرْدًا أَوْ بُسْرًا فَرْدًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
36.en: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who amongst you drinks Nabidh should drink that (prepared either from) grapes alone, or from dates alone, or from unripe dates alone (and not by mixing them with one another).
36.hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Jo tum mein se Nabidh peeta hai use woh peena chahiye jo (ya to) angoor se, ya sirf khajooron se, ya sirf kachchi khajooron se (akela) taiyaar ki gayi ho (na ki unhe ek-doosre ke saath milaakar).

36.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ،
 الْعَبْدِيُّ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ قَالَ نَهَانَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ نَخْلِطَ بُسْرًا بِتَمْرٍ أَوْ
 زَبِيبًا بِتَمْرٍ أَوْ زَبِيبًا بِبُسْرٍ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏
"‏ مَنْ شَرِبَهُ مِنْكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ وَكِيعٍ ‏.‏
36.en: Isma'il b. Muslim al-'Abadi reported on the authority of the same chain of transmitters: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited us that we should mix dry dates with unripe dates or (mix) grapes with dry dates (and prepare Nabidh). He also said: He who amongst you drinks-the rest of the hadith is the same.
36.hi: Isma'il bin Muslim al-Abadi ne isi sanad ke zariye riwayat ki: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein mana kiya ki hum sookhi khajooron ko kachchi khajooron ke saath, ya angoor ko sookhi khajooron ke saath (Nabidh taiyaar karte waqt) milaayein. Unhone ye bhi kaha: Jo tum mein se peeta hai - baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

36.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامٌ الدَّسْتَوَائِيُّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ،
 أَبِي كَثِيرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 ‏
"‏ لاَ تَنْتَبِذُوا الزَّهْوَ وَالرُّطَبَ جَمِيعًا وَلاَ تَنْتَبِذُوا الزَّبِيبَ وَالتَّمْرَ جَمِيعًا وَانْتَبِذُوا كُلَّ وَاحِدٍ
 مِنْهُمَا عَلَى حِدَتِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
36.en: Abu Qatada, on the authority of his father, reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said this: Do not prepare Nabidh by mixing nearly ripe dates and fresh dates together, and do not prepare Nabidh by mixing grapes and dates together, but prepare Nabidh from each (one of them) separately.
36.hi: Abu Qatada ne, apne waalid ki sanad se, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Lagbhag pakki khajooron aur taazi khajooron ko ekasath milaakar Nabidh taiyaar mat karo, aur angoor aur khajooron ko ekasath milaakar Nabidh taiyaar mat karo, balki har ek (inmein se) se alag-alag Nabidh taiyaar karo.

36.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ الْعَبْدِيُّ، عَنْ حَجَّاجِ بْنِ أَبِي،
 عُثْمَانَ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
36.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Yahya b. Abu Kathir with the same chain of transmitters.
36.hi: Ye hadees Yahya bin Abu Kathir ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

36.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَلِيٌّ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ
 - عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏
 لاَ تَنْتَبِذُوا الزَّهْوَ وَالرُّطَبَ جَمِيعًا وَلاَ تَنْتَبِذُوا الرُّطَبَ وَالزَّبِيبَ جَمِيعًا وَلَكِنِ انْتَبِذُوا كُلَّ وَاحِدٍ
 عَلَى حِدَتِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَزَعَمَ يَحْيَى أَنَّهُ لَقِيَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ فَحَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِ هَذَا ‏.‏
36.en: Abu Qatada reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Do not prepare Nabidh by mixing nearly ripe and fresh dates and do not prepare Nabidh by mixing together fresh dates and grapes, but prepare Nabidh out of each (one of them) separately. Yahya stated that he had met 'Abdullah b. Abu Qatada and he narrated it on the authority of his father that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said this.
36.hi: Abu Qatada ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Lagbhag pakki aur taazi khajooron ko milaakar Nabidh taiyaar mat karo aur taazi khajooron aur angoor ko milaakar Nabidh taiyaar mat karo, balki har ek se alag-alag Nabidh taiyaar karo. Yahya ne bataya ki unki mulaqaat Abdullah bin Abu Qatada se hui aur unhone ise apne waalid ki sanad se riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ye kaha.

36.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنٌ الْمُعَلِّمُ، حَدَّثَنَا 
 يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، بِهَذَيْنِ الإِسْنَادَيْنِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏
"‏ الرُّطَبَ وَالزَّهْوَ وَالتَّمْرَ وَالزَّبِيبَ ‏"‏
 ‏.‏
36.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Yahya b. Abu Kathir through these two chains of transmitters but with a slight variation of words.
36.hi: Ye hadees Yahya bin Abu Kathir ki sanad se in do sanadon ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai lekin alfaazon mein halke badlaav ke saath.

36.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبَانٌ الْعَطَّارُ، حَدَّثَنَا 
 يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم نَهَى عَنْ خَلِيطِ التَّمْرِ وَالْبُسْرِ وَعَنْ خَلِيطِ الزَّبِيبِ وَالتَّمْرِ وَعَنْ خَلِيطِ الزَّهْوِ وَالرُّطَبِ
 وَقَالَ ‏
"‏ انْتَبِذُوا كُلَّ وَاحِدٍ عَلَى حِدَتِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
36.en: 'Abdullah b. Abu Qatada, on the authority of his father, reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) forbidding the preparation of the mixture of ripe dates and unripe dates, and the mixture of grapes and dates, and that of nearly ripe dates and fresh dates but the Prophet said: Prepare the Nabidh from each one of them separately.
36.hi: Abdullah bin Abu Qatada ne, apne waalid ki sanad se, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko pakki khajooron aur kachchi khajooron ke mishran se, aur angoor aur khajooron ke mishran se, aur lagbhag pakki aur taazi khajooron ke mishran se mana karte hue riwayat ki, lekin Nabi ne kaha: Har ek se alag-alag Nabidh taiyaar karo.

36.ar:
