Thereupon he said: He in fact did that (but he also said): Except the prints upon the cloth. Did you not hear this? I said: No, whereupon He said: He had in fact made a mention of this.
37.hi: Abu Talha ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Farishte us ghar mein daakhil nahi hote jismein tasveer ho. Busr ne kaha: Zaid bin Khalid bimaar pad gaye aur hum unka haal poochne gaye. Jab hum unke ghar mein the (humne dekha) ek parda jispar tasveerein thin. Maine Ubaidullah Khaulani se kaha: Kya unhone humein ye (Nabi-e-Paak ka tasveeron se mutaliq hukum) riwayat nahi ki? Isper unhone kaha: Unhone waaqai aisa kiya (lekin unhone ye bhi kaha): Siwaay kapde par chhape hue nishaanon ke. Kya tumne ye nahi suna? Maine kaha: Nahi, isper unhone kaha: Unhone waaqai iska zikr kiya tha.

37.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ،
بْنِ يَسَارٍ أَبِي الْحُبَابِ مَوْلَى بَنِي النَّجَّارِ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ الأَنْصَارِيِّ،
قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لاَ تَدْخُلُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ بَيْتًا فِيهِ كَلْبٌ وَلاَ
تَمَاثِيلُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ 
 قَالَ فَأَتَيْتُ عَائِشَةَ فَقُلْتُ إِنَّ هَذَا يُخْبِرُنِي أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ
‏"‏ لاَ تَدْخُلُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ بَيْتًا فِيهِ كَلْبٌ وَلاَ تَمَاثِيلُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَهَلْ سَمِعْتِ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه
وسلم ذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَتْ لاَ وَلَكِنْ سَأُحَدِّثُكُمْ مَا رَأَيْتُهُ فَعَلَ رَأَيْتُهُ خَرَجَ فِي غَزَاتِهِ فَأَخَذْتُ
نَمَطًا فَسَتَرْتُهُ عَلَى الْبَابِ فَلَمَّا قَدِمَ فَرَأَى النَّمَطَ عَرَفْتُ الْكَرَاهِيَةَ فِي وَجْهِهِ فَجَذَبَهُ حَتَّى
هَتَكَهُ أَوْ قَطَعَهُ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَمْ يَأْمُرْنَا أَنْ نَكْسُوَ الْحِجَارَةَ وَالطِّينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَقَطَعْنَا
مِنْهُ وِسَادَتَيْنِ وَحَشَوْتُهُمَا لِيفًا فَلَمْ يَعِبْ ذَلِكَ عَلَىَّ ‏.‏
37.en: Abu Talha Ansari reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Angels do not enter the house in which there is a picture or portraits. I came to 'A'isha and said to her: This is a news that I have received that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) had said: Angels do not enter the house in which there is a picture or a dog, (and further added) whether she had heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) making a mention of it. She said: No (I did not hear this myself), but I narrate to you what I saw him doing. I bear testimony to the fact that he (the Holy Prophet) set out for an expedition. I took a carpet and screened the door with it. When he (the Holy Prophet) came back he saw that carpet and I perceived signs of disapproval on his face. He pulled it until it was torn or it was cut (into pieces) and he said: God has not commanded us to clothe stones and clay. We cut it (the curtain) and prepared two pillowa out of it by stuffing them with the fibre of date-palms and he (the Holy Prophet) did not find fault with it.
37.hi: Abu Talha Ansari ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Farishte us ghar mein daakhil nahi hote jismein tasveer ya moortiyaan ho. Main Aisha ke paas aaya aur unse kaha: Ye khabar mujhe mili hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha tha: Farishte us ghar mein daakhil nahi hote jismein tasveer ya kutta ho, (aur aage poocha) ki kya unhone khud Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko iska zikr karte suna hai. Unhone kaha: Nahi (maine khud ye nahi suna), lekin main tumhe riwayat karti hoon jo maine unhe karte dekha. Main is baat ki gawaahi deti hoon ki unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) ek muhim ke liye prasthaan kiya. Maine ek galeecha liya aur usse darwaze ko dhaaka. Jab woh (Nabi-e-Paak) wapas aaye unhone woh galeecha dekha aur maine unke chehre par napasandeegi ke nishaan mahsoos kiye. Unhone use tab tak kheencha jab tak ye phaT gaya ya kaT gaya (tukdon mein) aur unhone kaha: Allah ne humein pattharon aur mitti ko kapde pahanaane ka hukum nahi diya. Humne ise (parde ko) kaata aur ismein se khajoor ke reshe bhar kar do takiye banaaye aur unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) isme koi kami nahi paayi.

37.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ، عَنْ عَزْرَةَ، عَنْ 
حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ لَنَا سِتْرٌ فِيهِ تِمْثَالُ طَائِرٍ
وَكَانَ الدَّاخِلُ إِذَا دَخَلَ اسْتَقْبَلَهُ فَقَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ حَوِّلِي هَذَا
فَإِنِّي كُلَّمَا دَخَلْتُ فَرَأَيْتُهُ ذَكَرْتُ الدُّنْيَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَكَانَتْ لَنَا قَطِيفَةٌ كُنَّا نَقُولُ عَلَمُهَا حَرِيرٌ
فَكُنَّا نَلْبَسُهَا ‏.‏ 
 حَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، وَعَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ قَالَ
ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى وَزَادَ فِيهِ - يُرِيدُ عَبْدَ الأَعْلَى - فَلَمْ يَأْمُرْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
بِقَطْعِهِ ‏.‏
37.en: A'isha reported: We had a curtain with us which had portraits of birds upon it. Whenever a visitor came, he found them in front of him. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me: Change them, for whenever I enter the room) I see them and it brings to my mind (the pleasures) of worldly life. She said: We had with us a sheet which had silk badges upon it and we used to wear it. This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ibn Muthanna but with this addition: 'Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not command us to tear that."
37.hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya: Humare paas ek parda tha jismein parindon ki tasveerein thin. Jab bhi koi mehmaan aata, use ye unke saamne dikhti. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse kaha: Inhe badlo, kyunki jab bhi main (kamre mein) daakhil hota hoon main inhe dekhta hoon aur ye mere zehan mein duniyaavi zindagi (ki khushiyaan) le aata hai. Unhone kaha: Humare paas ek chaadar thi jismein resham ki paTiyan thin aur hum ise pehanate the. Ye hadees Ibn Muthanna ki sanad se is izafe ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai: "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein use phaadne ka hukum nahi diya."

37.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ 
أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ قَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ سَفَرٍ وَقَدْ سَتَّرْتُ عَلَى
بَابِي دُرْنُوكًا فِيهِ الْخَيْلُ ذَوَاتُ الأَجْنِحَةِ فَأَمَرَنِي فَنَزَعْتُهُ ‏.‏
37.en: A'isha reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came back from the journey and I had screened my door with a curtain having portraits of winged horses upon it. He commanded me and I pulled it away.
37.hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) safar se wapas aaye aur maine apna darwaza ek parde se dhaaka tha jismein paron waale ghodon ki tasveerein thin. Unhone mujhe hukum diya aur maine ise hataa diya.

37.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ،
بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَلَيْسَ فِي حَدِيثِ عَبْدَةَ قَدِمَ مِنْ سَفَرٍ ‏.‏
37.en: This hadith has been narrpted on the authority of Waki' with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
37.hi: Ye hadees Waki ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

37.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورُ بْنُ أَبِي مُزَاحِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ،
بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ دَخَلَ عَلَىَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَنَا مُتَسَتِّرَةٌ بِقِرَامٍ
فِيهِ صُورَةٌ فَتَلَوَّنَ وَجْهُهُ ثُمَّ تَنَاوَلَ السِّتْرَ فَهَتَكَهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏
"‏ إِنَّ مِنْ أَشَدِّ النَّاسِ عَذَابًا يَوْمَ
الْقِيَامَةِ الَّذِينَ يُشَبِّهُونَ بِخَلْقِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
37.en: A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered (my apartment) and I had hung (on the door of my apartment) a thin curtain having pictures on it. The colour of his face underwent a change. He then took hold of that curtain and tore it and then said: The most grievous torfnent for the people on the Day of Resurrection would be for those who try to imitate Allah in the act of creation.
37.hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) (mere kamre mein) daakhil hue aur maine (apne kamre ke darwaze par) ek patla parda latkaaya tha jismein tasveerein thin. Unke chehre ka rang badal gaya. Phir unhone woh parda pakda aur use faad diya aur phir kaha: Qayamat ke din logon ke liye sabse dukhdaayi saza un logon ke liye hogi jo Allah ki srijan ki kriya ki nakal karne ki koshish karte hain.

37.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنِ 
الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، حَدَّثَتْهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ
حَدِيثِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ثُمَّ أَهْوَى إِلَى الْقِرَامِ فَهَتَكَهُ بِيَدِهِ ‏.‏
37.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of A'isha through another chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording (and the variation is that the narrator is reported to have said): He (the Holy Prophet) inclined towards that curtain and tore it with his hand.
37.hi: Ye hadees Aisha ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai (aur antar ye hai ki raawi ne kaha): Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) us parde ki taraf jhukav dikhaya aur use apne haath se faad diya.

37.ar:
حَدَّثَنَاهُ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ جَمِيعًا عَنِ 
ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا 
مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِهِمَا ‏
"‏ إِنَّ أَشَدَّ النَّاسِ عَذَابًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ لَمْ يَذْكُرَا
مِنْ ‏.‏
37.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
37.hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

37.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ
لِزُهَيْرٍ - حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَائِشَةَ،
تَقُولُ دَخَلَ عَلَىَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَدْ سَتَرْتُ سَهْوَةً لِي بِقِرَامٍ فِيهِ تَمَاثِيلُ
فَلَمَّا رَآهُ هَتَكَهُ وَتَلَوَّنَ وَجْهُهُ وَقَالَ ‏
"‏ يَا عَائِشَةُ أَشَدُّ النَّاسِ عَذَابًا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
الَّذِينَ يُضَاهُونَ بِخَلْقِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَقَطَعْنَاهُ فَجَعَلْنَا مِنْهُ وِسَادَةً أَوْ وِسَادَتَيْنِ
‏.‏
37.en: A'isha reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) visited me. and I had a shelf with a thin cloth curtain hangin. over it and on which there were portraits. No sooner did he see it than he tore it and the colour of his face underwent a change and he said: A'isha, the most grievous torment from the Hand of Allah on the Day of Resurrection would be for those who imitate (Allah) in the act of His creation. A'isha said: We tore it into pieces and made a cushion or two cushions out of that.
37.hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mujhse milne aaye. Aur mere paas ek taakh thi jispar ek patla kapda parda latka hua tha jispar tasveerein thin. Jaise hi unhone ise dekha, unhone use faad diya aur unke chehre ka rang badal gaya aur unhone kaha: Aisha, Allah ke Haath se Qayamat ke din sabse dukhdaayi saza un logon ko milegi jo (Allah ki) srijan kriya ki nakal karte hain. Aisha ne kaha: Humne ise tukdon mein faada aur isse ek ya do takiye banaaye.

37.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ،
بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْقَاسِمَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ لَهَا ثَوْبٌ فِيهِ تَصَاوِيرُ مَمْدُودٌ
إِلَى سَهْوَةٍ فَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي إِلَيْهِ فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ أَخِّرِيهِ عَنِّي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ
فَأَخَّرْتُهُ فَجَعَلْتُهُ وَسَائِدَ ‏.‏
37.en: A'isha reported she had a cloth havinc, pictures upon it and it was hanging upon the shelf and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Take it (away) from me (from my sight), so I removed it and made cushions from that.
37.hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki unke paas ek kapda tha jismein tasveerein thin aur ye taakh par latka hua tha aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ise mujhse (meri nazar se) hataao, is liye maine ise hataaya aur usse takiye banaaye.

37.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعُقْبَةُ بْنُ مُكْرَمٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ 
إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبْرَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ الْعَقَدِيُّ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
37.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters.
37.hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

37.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ،
عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ دَخَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَىَّ وَقَدْ سَتَرْتُ نَمَطًا فِيهِ
تَصَاوِيرُ فَنَحَّاهُ فَاتَّخَذْتُ مِنْهُ وِسَادَتَيْنِ ‏.‏
37.en: A'isha reported: Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) visited me when I had screened (my door) with a carpet having pictures on it. He removed it and we made cushions out of that.
37.hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mujhse milne aaye jab maine (apne darwaze ko) ek galeeche se dhaaka tha jismein tasveerein thin. Unhone ise hataaya aur humne isse takiye banaaye.

37.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مَعْرُوفٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، أَنَّ بُكَيْرًا،
حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ الْقَاسِمِ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ أَبَاهُ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله
عليه وسلم أَنَّهَا نَصَبَتْ سِتْرًا فِيهِ تَصَاوِيرُ فَدَخَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَنَزَعَهُ
قَالَتْ فَقَطَعْتُهُ وِسَادَتَيْنِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ فِي الْمَجْلِسِ حِينَئِذٍ يُقَالُ لَهُ رَبِيعَةُ بْنُ عَطَاءٍ مَوْلَى
بَنِي زُهْرَةَ أَفَمَا سَمِعْتَ أَبَا مُحَمَّدٍ يَذْكُرُ أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ فَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه
وسلم يَرْتَفِقُ عَلَيْهِمَا قَالَ ابْنُ الْقَاسِمِ لاَ ‏.‏ قَالَ لَكِنِّي قَدْ سَمِعْتُهُ ‏.‏ يُرِيدُ الْقَاسِمَ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ
‏.‏
37.en: A'isha, the wife of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), reported that she had hung a curtain which had pictures upon it. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered (the room) and he pulled it. A'isha said: I then tore it and prepared two cushions out of that. A person who was then in that company and whose name was Rabi'a b. 'Ata, the freed slave of Banu Zuhra, asked: Did you hear Abu Mabammad making a mention of A'isha having stated that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to recline upon them? lbn al-Qasim said: No, but I heard Qasim b. Muhammad saying so.
37.hi: Aisha, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ne bayan kiya ki unhone ek parda latkaaya tha jismein tasveerein thin. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) (kamre mein) daakhil hue aur unhone ise kheencha. Aisha ne kaha: Maine phir ise faada aur isse do takiye banaaye. Us sabha mein maujood ek shakhs jiska naam Rabi'a bin Ata tha, Banu Zuhra ke aazad kiye hue ghulam, ne poocha: Kya aapne Abu Mabammad ko Aisha ke ye bayaan karte suna ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unpar tek lagaate the? Ibn al-Qasim ne kaha: Nahi, lekin maine Qasim bin Muhammad ko aisa kehte suna.

37.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ،
عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا اشْتَرَتْ نُمْرَقَةً فِيهَا تَصَاوِيرُ فَلَمَّا رَآهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
قَامَ عَلَى الْبَابِ فَلَمْ يَدْخُلْ فَعَرَفْتُ أَوْ فَعُرِفَتْ فِي وَجْهِهِ الْكَرَاهِيَةُ فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ
أَتُوبُ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَإِلَى رَسُولِهِ فَمَاذَا أَذْنَبْتُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا بَالُ
هَذِهِ النُّمْرُقَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتِ اشْتَرَيْتُهَا لَكَ تَقْعُدُ عَلَيْهَا وَتَوَسَّدُهَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله
عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ أَصْحَابَ هَذِهِ الصُّوَرِ يُعَذَّبُونَ وَيُقَالُ لَهُمْ أَحْيُوا مَا خَلَقْتُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ
‏"‏ إِنَّ الْبَيْتَ الَّذِي فِيهِ الصُّوَرُ لاَ تَدْخُلُهُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
37.en: A'isha reported that she bought a carpet which had pictures on it. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw that, he stayed at the door and did not get in. I perceived or I was made to perceive upon his face signs of disgust. She said: Allah's Messenger, I offer repentance to Allah and His Messenger. (but tell me) what is the sin that I have committed. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: What is this carpet? She said: I bought it for you so that you might sit on it and take rest. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The owners of these pictures would be tormented and they would be asked to bring to life what they tried to create. He then said: Angels do not enter the house in which there is a picture.
37.hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki unhone ek galeecha khareeda jismein tasveerein thin. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ise dekha, woh darwaze par ruke aur andar nahi gaye. Maine unke chehre par ghrina ke nishaan dekhe ya mujhe dekhaaye gaye. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, main Allah aur Uske Rasool se maafi maangti hoon (lekin mujhe bataaiye) maine kya gunah kiya hai. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ye galeecha kya hai? Unhone kaha: Maine ise aapke liye khareeda taaki aap ispar baith kar aaraam kar sakein. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: In tasveeron ke maalikon ko saza di jaayegi aur unse kaha jaayega ki jo unhone banaaya use zinda karein. Phir unhone kaha: Farishte us ghar mein daakhil nahi hote jismein tasveer ho.

37.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ قُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، رُمْحٍ عَنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
أَخْبَرَنَا الثَّقَفِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي،
عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ،
ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَلَمَةَ الْخُزَاعِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَخِي،
الْمَاجِشُونِ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ
وَبَعْضُهُمْ أَتَمُّ حَدِيثًا لَهُ مِنْ بَعْضٍ ‏.‏ وَزَادَ فِي حَدِيثِ ابْنِ أَخِي الْمَاجِشُونِ قَالَتْ فَأَخَذْتُهُ
فَجَعَلْتُهُ مِرْفَقَتَيْنِ فَكَانَ يَرْتَفِقُ بِهِمَا فِي الْبَيْتِ ‏.‏
37.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of A'isha through another chain of transmitters also. Some of the other ahadith narrated through other chains of transmitters are more complete and there is an addition in them (transmitted through other chains of transmitters). In the hadith transmitted on the authority of the nephew of Majishun she (A'isha) is reported to have said: I took it and prepared two cushions out of that and he (the Holy Prophet) used to recline against them in the house.
37.hi: Ye hadees Aisha ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai. Doosri sanadon se riwayat ki gayi kuch aur hadeesein zyada mukammal hain aur unmein izafa hai (doosri sanadon ke zariye riwayat kiya gaya). Majishun ke bhatije ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein unhone (Aisha ne) ye kaha bataya jaata hai: Maine ise liya aur usse do takiye banaaye aur woh (Nabi-e-Paak) ghar mein unpar tek lagaate the.

37.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا 
يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ الْقَطَّانُ - جَمِيعًا عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا 
أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
قَالَ ‏
"‏ الَّذِينَ يَصْنَعُونَ الصُّوَرَ يُعَذَّبُونَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يُقَالُ لَهُمْ أَحْيُوا مَا خَلَقْتُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
37.en: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said: Those who paint pictures would be punished on the Day of Resurrection and it would be said to them: Breathe soul into what you have created.
37.hi: Ibn Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo tasveerein banaate hain unhe Qayamat ke din saza di jaayegi aur unse kaha jaayega: Jo tumne banaaya hai usmein jaan phoonko.

37.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا 
إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عُلَيَّةَ - ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا الثَّقَفِيُّ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ 
نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنِ
ابْنِ عُمَرَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
37.en: Ibn 'Umar reported a hadith like this through another chain of transmitters.
37.hi: Ibn Umar ne isi jaisi ek hadees ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki.

37.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَعِيدٍ،
الأَشَجُّ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ
رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ إِنَّ أَشَدَّ النَّاسِ عَذَابًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ الْمُصَوِّرُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ
يَذْكُرِ الأَشَجُّ إِنَّ ‏.‏
37.en: 'Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Verity the most grievously tormented people on the Day of Resurrection would be the painters of pictures. Ashajj (one of the narrators) in the hadith narrated by him did not make mention of the word" verity".
37.hi: Abdullah ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Yaqeenan Qayamat ke din sabse dukhdaayi saza paane wale log tasveer banaane waale honge. Ashajj (raawiyon mein se ek) ne apni riwayat mein "yaqeenan" lafz zikr nahi kiya.

37.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ،
ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ
يَحْيَى وَأَبِي كُرَيْبٍ عَنْ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ، ‏
"‏ إِنَّ مِنْ أَشَدِّ أَهْلِ النَّارِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عَذَابًا الْمُصَوِّرُونَ
‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَحَدِيثُ سُفْيَانَ كَحَدِيثِ وَكِيعٍ ‏.‏
37.en: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Abu Mu`awiya through another chain of transmitters (and the words are): "Verily, the most grievously tormented people amongst the denizens of Hell on the Day of Resurrection would be the painters of pictures." The rest of the hadith is the same.
37.hi: Ye hadees Abu Mu'awiya ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai (aur alfaaz hain): "Yaqeenan, Jahannam ke bashindon mein se sabse dukhdaayi saza Qayamat ke din tasveer banaane walon ko milegi." Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

37.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورٌ،
عَنْ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ صُبَيْحٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ مَعَ مَسْرُوقٍ فِي بَيْتٍ فِيهِ تَمَاثِيلُ مَرْيَمَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ مَسْرُوقٌ هَذَا
تَمَاثِيلُ كِسْرَى ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ لاَ هَذَا تَمَاثِيلُ مَرْيَمَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ مَسْرُوقٌ أَمَا إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ
مَسْعُودٍ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَشَدُّ النَّاسِ عَذَابًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ الْمُصَوِّرُونَ
‏"‏ ‏.‏ 
 قَالَ مُسْلِمٌ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى نَصْرِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى بْنِ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى،
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ
 فَقَالَ إِنِّي رَجُلٌ أُصَوِّرُ هَذِهِ الصُّوَرَ فَأَفْتِنِي فِيهَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ ادْنُ مِنِّي ‏.‏ فَدَنَا مِنْهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ
 ادْنُ مِنِّي ‏.‏ فَدَنَا حَتَّى وَضَعَ يَدَهُ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ قَالَ أُنَبِّئُكَ بِمَا سَمِعْتُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ كُلُّ مُصَوِّرٍ فِي النَّارِ يَجْعَلُ
 لَهُ بِكُلِّ صُورَةٍ صَوَّرَهَا نَفْسًا فَتُعَذِّبُهُ فِي جَهَنَّمَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ إِنْ كُنْتَ لاَ بُدَّ فَاعِلاً فَاصْنَعِ
 الشَّجَرَ وَمَا لاَ نَفْسَ لَهُ ‏.‏ فَأَقَرَّ بِهِ نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ ‏.‏
37.en: Muslim b. Subaih reported: I was with Masriuq in the house which had the portrayals of Mary (hadrat Maryan). Thereupon Masriuq said: These are portraits of Kisra. I said: No, these are of Mary. Masruq said: I heard Abdullah b, Mas'ud as saying Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said: The most grievously tormented people on the Day of Resurrection would be the painters of pictures. (Muslim said): I read this before Nasr b. 'Ali at-Jahdami and he read it before other narrators, the last one being Ibn Sa'id b Abl at Hasan that a person came to Ibn 'Abbas and said: I am the person who paints pictures; give me a religious verdict about them. He (Ibn 'Abbas) said to him: Come near me (still further). He came near him so much so that he placed his hand upon his head and said: I am going to narrate to yor what I heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). I heard him say: All the painters who make pictures would be in the fire of Hell. The soul will be breathed in every picture prepared by him and it shall punish him in the Hell, and he (Ibn 'Abbas) said: If you have to do it at all, then paint the pictures of trees and lifeless things; and Nasr b. 'Ali confirmed it.
37.hi: Muslim bin Subaih ne bayan kiya: Main Masriuq ke saath us ghar mein tha jismein Mary (Hazrat Maryam) ki tasveerein thin. Isper Masriuq ne kaha: Ye Kisra ki tasveerein hain. Maine kaha: Nahi, ye Mary ki hain. Masruq ne kaha: Maine Abdullah bin Mas'ud ko ye kehte suna ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha tha: Qayamat ke din sabse dukhdaayi saza paane wale log tasveer banaane waale honge. (Muslim ne kaha): Maine ise Nasr bin Ali at-Jahdami ke saamne padha aur unhone ise doosre raawiyon ke saamne padha, aakhri wale Ibn Sa'id bin Abl at Hasan the, ki ek shakhs Ibn Abbas ke paas aaya aur kaha: Main woh shakhs hoon jo tasveerein banaata hoon; mujhe iske baare mein ek mazhabi fatwa dijiye. Unhone (Ibn Abbas ne) usse kaha: Mere aur qareeb aao. Woh unke itne qareeb aaya ki unhone apna haath uske sar par rakha aur kaha: Main tumhe wahi riwayat karne wala hoon jo maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna. Maine unhe ye kehte suna: Sab tasveer banaane wale jo tasveerein banaate hain woh Jahannam ki aag mein honge. Har us tasveer mein jaan phoonki jaayegi jo usne banaayi aur woh use Jahannam mein saza degi, aur unhone (Ibn Abbas ne) kaha: Agar tumhe waaqai isse karna hi hai, to darakhton aur nirjeev cheezon ki tasveerein banaao; aur Nasr bin Ali ne iski pushti ki.

37.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ،
 عَنِ النَّضْرِ بْنِ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ جَالِسًا عِنْدَ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فَجَعَلَ يُفْتِي وَلاَ يَقُولُ قَالَ
 رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى سَأَلَهُ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ إِنِّي رَجُلٌ أُصَوِّرُ هَذِهِ الصُّوَرَ ‏.‏
 فَقَالَ لَهُ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ ادْنُهْ ‏.‏ فَدَنَا الرَّجُلُ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله
 عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏
"‏ مَنْ صَوَّرَ صُورَةً فِي الدُّنْيَا كُلِّفَ أَنْ يَنْفُخَ فِيهَا الرُّوحَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَلَيْسَ
 بِنَافِخٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
37.en: Anas b. Malik said: I was sitting with Ibn 'Abbas when he gave religious verdicts but he did not say that it was Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who had said that. However when a man said to him (Ibn 'Abbas): I am the painter of these pictures. Ibn 'Abbas said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who painted pictures in the world would be compelled to breathe soul in them on the Day of Resurrection, but he would not be able to breathe soul (in them).
37.hi: Anas bin Malik ne kaha: Main Ibn Abbas ke saath baitha tha jab woh mazhabi fatwe de rahe the lekin unhone ye nahi kaha ki ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha tha. Lekin jab ek shakhs ne unse (Ibn Abbas se) kaha: Main in tasveeron ka banaane wala hoon. Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jisne is duniya mein tasveerein banaayi use Qayamat ke din unmein jaan phoonkne ke liye majboor kiya jaayega, lekin woh (unmein) jaan phoonkne mein saksham nahi hoga.

37.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو غَسَّانَ الْمِسْمَعِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنَا 
 أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنِ النَّضْرِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، أَتَى ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله
 عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
37.en: Nadr b. Anas reported that a person came to Ibn 'Abbas and he narrated (the above menlioned hadith) from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ).
37.hi: Nadr bin Anas ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs Ibn Abbas ke paas aaya aur unhone (upar bataayi gayi hadees) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki.

37.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ وَأَلْفَاظُهُمْ
 مُتَقَارِبَةٌ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، قَالَ دَخَلْتُ مَعَ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ
 فِي دَارِ مَرْوَانَ فَرَأَى فِيهَا تَصَاوِيرَ فَقَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ
 ‏"‏ قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنْ ذَهَبَ يَخْلُقُ خَلْقًا كَخَلْقِي فَلْيَخْلُقُوا ذَرَّةً أَوْ لِيَخْلُقُوا حَبَّةً
 أَوْ لِيَخْلُقُوا شَعِيرَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ 
 وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، قَالَ دَخَلْتُ
 أَنَا وَأَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ دَارًا تُبْنَى بِالْمَدِينَةِ لِسَعِيدٍ أَوْ لِمَرْوَانَ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَرَأَى مُصَوِّرًا يُصَوِّرُ فِي الدَّارِ
 فَقَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ ‏"‏ أَوْ لِيَخْلُقُوا شَعِيرَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
37.en: Abu Zur'a reported: I visited the house of Marwan in the company of Abu Huraira and he found pictures there. whereupon he said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah, the Glorious and Exalted, said: Who is a more wrongdoer than one who tries to create creation like Mine creation. Let him create an atom or a grain of wheat or that of barley. This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Zur'a and he said: Abu Huraira went to the house of Sa'ld or Marwan which they had built in Medina and he (Abu Huraira) saw a painter who had been painting pictures in his house, whereupon he told that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said like this, but he made no mention of the words:" Let him create the grain of barley."
37.hi: Abu Zur'a ne bayan kiya: Main Marwan ke ghar Abu Huraira ki sohbat mein gaya aur unhone wahan tasveerein paayin, isper unhone kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Allah, Shaandaar aur Buland-o-Azeem, ne kaha: Usse zyada anyaayi kaun hai jo Meri srijan jaisi srijan banaane ki koshish karta hai. Use ek anu ya gehun ka ek daana ya jau ka ek daana banaane do. Ye hadees Abu Zur'a ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur unhone kaha: Abu Huraira Sa'ld ya Marwan ke ghar gaye jo unhone Madina mein banwaaya tha aur unhone (Abu Huraira ne) ek tasveer banaane wale ko dekha jo unke ghar mein tasveerein bana raha tha, isper unhone bataya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne aisa hi kaha tha, lekin unhone in alfaazon ka zikr nahi kiya: "Use jau ka daana banaane do."

37.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ بِلاَلٍ، عَنْ 
 سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ لاَ تَدْخُلُ
 الْمَلاَئِكَةُ بَيْتًا فِيهِ تَمَاثِيلُ أَوْ تَصَاوِيرُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
37.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Angels do not enter the house in which there are portrayals or pictures.
37.hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Farishte us ghar mein daakhil nahi hote jismein akritiyaan ya tasveerein hon.

37.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ، فُضَيْلُ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُفَضَّلٍ
 - حَدَّثَنَا سُهَيْلٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ لاَ
 تَصْحَبُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ رُفْقَةً فِيهَا كَلْبٌ وَلاَ جَرَسٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
37.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Angels do not accompany the travellers who have with them a dog and a bell.
37.hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Farishte un musafiron ke saath nahi jaate jinke paas kutta aur ghantee ho.

37.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، -
 يَعْنِي الدَّرَاوَرْدِيَّ - كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
37.en: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Suhail with the same chain of transmitters.
37.hi: Ye hadees Suhail ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

37.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - يَعْنُونَ ابْنَ
 جَعْفَرٍ - عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ
 ‏
"‏ الْجَرَسُ مَزَامِيرُ الشَّيْطَانِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
37.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The bell is the musical instrument of the Satan.
37.hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ghantee Shaitaan ka baaja hai.

37.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنْ عَبَّادِ،
 بْنِ تَمِيمٍ أَنَّ أَبَا بَشِيرٍ الأَنْصَارِيَّ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، كَانَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي
 بَعْضِ أَسْفَارِهِ - قَالَ - فَأَرْسَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَسُولاً - قَالَ عَبْدُ
 اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ حَسِبْتُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ وَالنَّاسُ فِي مَبِيتِهِمْ - ‏
"‏ لاَ يَبْقَيَنَّ فِي رَقَبَةِ بَعِيرٍ قِلاَدَةٌ
 مِنْ وَتَرٍ أَوْ قِلاَدَةٌ إِلاَّ قُطِعَتْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ مَالِكٌ أُرَى ذَلِكَ مِنَ الْعَيْنِ ‏.‏
37.en: Abu Bashir Ansari reported that he had had (the opportunity of accompanying Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in some of his journeys. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent one of his messengers 'Abdullah b Abi Bakr said: I think he said (these words) when the people were at the places of rest: No necklace of strings be left on the necks of the camels or the necklace kept unbroken. Imam Malik said: To my mind (this practice) of wearing necklace round the necks of camels or animals was because of the fact that they (wanted to save them) from the influence of the evil eye.
37.hi: Abu Bashir Ansari ne bayan kiya ki unhe apne kuch safaron mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath jaane ka mauka mila tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne ek doot ko bheja. Abdullah bin Abi Bakr ne kaha: Mujhe lagta hai unhone (ye alfaaz) kahe the jab log aaraam ki jagahon par the: Oonton ki gardanon par koi doraabandh (dhaage ki maala) na chhoda jaaye ya (agar hai to) doraabandh na toda jaaye. Imam Malik ne kaha: Mera khyaal hai ki (ye riwaaj) oonton ya jaanwaron ki gardanon mein doraabandh pehnne ki is liye thi ki (log unhe bachaana chaahte the) buri nazar ke asar se.

37.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ،
 عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الضَّرْبِ فِي الْوَجْهِ وَعَنِ الْوَسْمِ
 فِي الْوَجْهِ ‏.‏
37.en: Jabir reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade (the animals to be beaten) on the face or cauterisation on the face.
37.hi: Jabir ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mana kiya (jaanwaron ko) chehre par maarne se ya chehre par daagna se.

37.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ،
 أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، ‏.‏ كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ،
 بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يَقُولُ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
37.en: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Jabir b. 'Abdullah through another chain of transmitters.
37.hi: Ye hadees Jabir bin Abdullah ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

37.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي سَلَمَةُ بْنُ شَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ أَعْيَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْقِلٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ،
 عَنْ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَرَّ عَلَيْهِ حِمَارٌ قَدْ وُسِمَ فِي وَجْهِهِ فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ لَعَنَ
 اللَّهُ الَّذِي وَسَمَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
37.en: Jabir reported that there happened to pass before Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) an ass the face of which had been cauterised, whereupon he said: Allah has cursed one who has cauterised it (on the face).
37.hi: Jabir ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saamne ek gadha guzra jiska chehra daaga gaya tha, isper unhone kaha: Allah ne us shakhs par laanat ki jisne ise (chehre par) daaga.

37.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عِيسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ،
 بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ أَنَّ نَاعِمًا أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، مَوْلَى أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، يَقُولُ وَرَأَى
 رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِمَارًا مَوْسُومَ الْوَجْهِ فَأَنْكَرَ ذَلِكَ قَالَ فَوَاللَّهِ لاَ أَسِمُهُ إِلاَّ
 فِي أَقْصَى شَىْءٍ مِنَ الْوَجْهِ ‏.‏ فَأَمَرَ بِحِمَارٍ لَهُ فَكُوِيَ فِي جَاعِرَتَيْهِ فَهُوَ أَوَّلُ مَنْ كَوَى الْجَاعِرَتَيْنِ
 ‏.‏
37.en: Ibn Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw an ass which had been cauterised on the face. He disapproved of it saying: By Allah, I do not cauterise (the animal) but on a part at a distance from the face, and commanded (for the cauterisation) of his ass and it was cauterised on the buttocks and he was the first to cauterise on the buttocks.
37.hi: Ibn Abbas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek gadha dekha jise chehre par daaga gaya tha. Unhone ise napasand kiya aur kaha: Allah ki qasam, main (jaanwar ko) chehre se door kisi hisse par hi daagta hoon, aur unhone apne gadhe ko daagne ka hukum diya aur ise pichhle hisse par daaga gaya aur woh sabse pehle the jinhone pichhle hisse par daaga.

37.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ 
 أَنَسٍ، قَالَ لَمَّا وَلَدَتْ أُمُّ سُلَيْمٍ قَالَتْ لِي يَا أَنَسُ انْظُرْ هَذَا الْغُلاَمَ فَلاَ يُصِيبَنَّ شَيْئًا حَتَّى
 تَغْدُوَ بِهِ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُحَنِّكُهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَغَدَوْتُ فَإِذَا هُوَ فِي الْحَائِطِ وَعَلَيْهِ
 خَمِيصَةٌ جَوْنِيَّةٌ وَهُوَ يَسِمُ الظَّهْرَ الَّذِي قَدِمَ عَلَيْهِ فِي الْفَتْحِ ‏.‏
37.en: Anas reported that Umm Sulaim gave birth to a child. She said to him: Anas, see that nothing is given to this child until he is brought to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) in the morning, so that he should chew some dates and touch his palate with it. I went to him in the morning and he was in the garden at that time having the mantle of Jauniyya over him and he was bus in cauterising (the camels) which had been brought to him (as spoils of war) in victory (over the enemy).
37.hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki Umm Sulaim ne ek bachche ko paida kiya. Unhone unse kaha: Anas, dekho ki is bachche ko kuch bhi na diya jaaye jab tak use subah Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas na le jaaya jaaye, taaki woh kuch khajooren chabaayein aur unse iska taalu chhuyein. Main subah unke paas gaya aur woh baag mein the us waqt Jauniyya ka chogha oDhe hue the aur woh (oonton ko) daagne mein masroof the jo unhe (jung ke maal-e-ganimat ke soorat mein) laaye gaye the (dushman par) jeet mein.

37.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ،
 قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا، يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّ أُمَّهُ، حِينَ وَلَدَتِ انْطَلَقُوا بِالصَّبِيِّ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 يُحَنِّكُهُ قَالَ فَإِذَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي مِرْبَدٍ يَسِمُ غَنَمًا ‏.‏ قَالَ شُعْبَةُ وَأَكْثَرُ عِلْمِي
 أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي آذَانِهَا ‏.‏
37.en: Anas reported that when his mother gave birth to a child they brought that child to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) so that he might chew some dates and touch his palate with them. and Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) was at that time in the fold busy in cauterising the animals Shu'ba said: So far as I know (he was cauterising) their ears.
37.hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki jab unki maa ne ek bachche ko paida kiya, woh use Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laaye taaki woh kuch khajooren chabaayein aur unse uska taalu chhuyein, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) us waqt bade mein the jaanwaron ko daagne mein masroof. Shu'ba ne kaha: Jahan tak mujhe pata hai (woh unke) kaanon ko daag rahe the.

37.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي هِشَامُ بْنُ،
 زَيْدٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا، يَقُولُ دَخَلْنَا عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِرْبَدًا وَهُوَ يَسِمُ
 غَنَمًا ‏.‏ قَالَ أَحْسِبُهُ قَالَ فِي آذَانِهَا ‏.‏ 
 وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ،
 حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، وَيَحْيَى، وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
37.en: Anas reported: We went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as he was in the fold and he was cauterising the animals of the flock and I think (he was cauterising them) on their ears. This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba through another chain of transmitters.
37.hi: Anas ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaye jab woh bade mein the aur woh reWad ke jaanwaron ko daag rahe the aur mujhe lagta hai (woh unhe daag rahe the) unke kaanon par. Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

37.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مَعْرُوفٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنِ الأَوْزَاعِيِّ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ،
 بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ فِي يَدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم الْمِيسَمَ وَهُوَ يَسِمُ إِبِلَ الصَّدَقَةِ ‏.‏
37.en: Anas b. Malik reported: I saw in the hand of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) an instrument for cauterisation and he was cauterising the caracia collected as Zakat.
37.hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke haath mein daagne ka ek upkaran dekha aur woh Zakat ke soorat mein ikattha kiye gaye oonton ko daag rahe the.

37.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَعِيدٍ - عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنِي 
 عُمَرُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ الْقَزَعِ
 ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ لِنَافِعٍ وَمَا الْقَزَعُ قَالَ يُحْلَقُ بَعْضُ رَأْسِ الصَّبِيِّ وَيُتْرَكُ بَعْضٌ ‏.‏
37.en: Ibn Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade Qaza. I said to Nafi: What is Qaza'? He said: This means having a part of a boy's head shaved and leaving a part unshaven.
37.hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Qaza se mana kiya. Maine Nafi se kaha: Qaza kya hai? Unhone kaha: Iska matlab hai ki ek larke ke sar ka ek hissa munda hua ho aur ek hissa bina munda hua chhoda jaaye.

37.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي،
 قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ وَجَعَلَ التَّفْسِيرَ فِي حَدِيثِ أَبِي أُسَامَةَ مِنْ قَوْلِ عُبَيْدِ
 اللَّهِ ‏.‏
37.en: This hadith has been reported on the authority of 'Ubaidullah with the same chain of transmitters. and the exposition of Qaza' is the same as that of Abu Usama.
37.hi: Ye hadees Ubaidullah ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, aur Qaza ki vyaakhya wahi hai jo Abu Usama ki hai.

37.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ الْغَطَفَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ،
 ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أُمَيَّةُ بْنُ بِسْطَامٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زُرَيْعٍ - حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ،
 نَافِعٍ بِإِسْنَادِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ وَأَلْحَقَا التَّفْسِيرَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ ‏.‏
37.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Umar b. Nafi' with the same chain of transmitters and Muhammad b. Muthanna as well as 'Umar b. Nafi have given the same exposition (of the word Qaza') in their narration.
37.hi: Ye hadees Umar bin Nafi ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur Muhammad bin Muthanna aur Umar bin Nafi donon ne apni riwayat mein (Qaza lafz ki) wahi vyaakhya di hai.

37.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَحَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ،
 عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ الدَّارِمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ،
 زَيْدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ السَّرَّاجِ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 بِذَلِكَ ‏.‏
37.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar through another chain of transmitters.
37.hi: Ye hadees Ibn Umar ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

37.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي حَفْصُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ،
 بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِيَّاكُمْ وَالْجُلُوسَ
 فِي الطُّرُقَاتِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا لَنَا بُدٌّ مِنْ مَجَالِسِنَا نَتَحَدَّثُ فِيهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ رَسُولُ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فَإِذَا أَبَيْتُمْ إِلاَّ الْمَجْلِسَ فَأَعْطُوا الطَّرِيقَ حَقَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا وَمَا
 حَقُّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ غَضُّ الْبَصَرِ وَكَفُّ الأَذَى وَرَدُّ السَّلاَمِ وَالأَمْرُ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَالنَّهْىُ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ ‏"‏
 ‏.‏
37.en: Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Avoid sitting on the paths. They (his Companions) said: Allah's Messenger, there is no other help to it (but to sit there as we) hold our meetings and discuss matters there. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: If you have to sit at all, then fulfil the rights, of the path. They said: What are their rights? Thereupon he said: Keeping the eye downward (so that you may not stare at the women), refraining from doing some harm to the other and exchanging mutual greetings (saying as-Salamu 'Alaikum to one another) and commanding the good and forbidding the evil.
37.hi: Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Raaston par baithne se bacho. Unhone (unke sahaba ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, isse bachna mumkin nahi (kyunki hum wahan) apni sabhaen karte hain aur wahan maamlon par charcha karte hain. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Agar tumhe waaqai baithna hi hai, to raaste ke haqoq poore karo. Unhone poocha: Unke haq kya hain? Isper unhone kaha: Aankhon ko neeche rakhna (taaki tum auraton ko na ghooro), doosre ko koi nuksaan pahunchaane se bacho aur aapas mein salaam (ek-doosre se as-Salamu Alaikum kehna) exchange karna aur achhaai ka hukum dena aur burai se rokna.

37.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْمَدَنِيُّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ،
 بْنُ رَافِعٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَعْدٍ - كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ،
 أَسْلَمَ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
37.en: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Zaid b. Aslam with the same chain of transmitters.
37.hi: Ye hadees Zaid bin Aslam ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

37.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ،
 الْمُنْذِرِ عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، قَالَتْ جَاءَتِ امْرَأَةٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ
 يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ لِي ابْنَةً عُرَيِّسًا أَصَابَتْهَا حَصْبَةٌ فَتَمَرَّقَ شَعْرُهَا أَفَأَصِلُهُ فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ لَعَنَ
 اللَّهُ الْوَاصِلَةَ وَالْمُسْتَوْصِلَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
37.en: Asma', daughter of Abu Bakr, reported that a woman came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and said: I have a daughter who has been newly wedded. She had an attack of smallpox and thus her hair had fallen; should I add false hair to her head? Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Allah has cursed the woman who adds some false hair and the woman who asks for it.
37.hi: Asma, Abu Bakr ki beti, ne bayan kiya ki ek aurat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha: Meri ek beti hai jiski nayi shaadi hui hai. Use chechak ka hamla hua aur uske baal jhad gaye; kya main uske sar mein nakli baal joDun? Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Allah ne us aurat par laanat ki hai jo nakli baal jodti hai aur us aurat par jo isse maangti hai.

37.ar:
حَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي،
 وَعَبْدَةُ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَسْوَدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ،
 أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ غَيْرَ أَنَّحَدِيثِهِمَا فَتَمَرَّطَ شَعْرُهَا ‏.‏
37.en: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Shu'ba with a slight variation of wording.
37.hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

37.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الدَّارِمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا حَبَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورٌ، عَنْ 
 أُمِّهِ، عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، أَتَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ إِنِّي زَوَّجْتُ
 ابْنَتِي فَتَمَرَّقَ شَعْرُ رَأْسِهَا وَزَوْجُهَا يَسْتَحْسِنُهَا أَفَأَصِلُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَنَهَاهَا ‏.‏
37.en: Asma', daughter of Abu Bakr, reported that a woman came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and said: I have married my daughter (whose) hair of head have fallen. Her spouse likes them (the long hair). Allah's Messenger (may add false hair to her head? He forbade her to do this.
37.hi: Asma, Abu Bakr ki beti, ne bayan kiya ki ek aurat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha: Meri beti ki shaadi ki hai jiske sar ke baal jhad gaye hain. Unke shohar unhe (lambe baal) pasand karte hain. Kya Allah ke Rasool (unke sar mein) nakli baal jod sakte hain? Unhone use aisa karne se mana kiya.

37.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا 
 أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي بُكَيْرٍ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ،
 مُرَّةَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْحَسَنَ بْنَ مُسْلِمٍ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ صَفِيَّةَ بِنْتِ شَيْبَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ جَارِيَةً، مِنَ
 الأَنْصَارِ تَزَوَّجَتْ وَأَنَّهَا مَرِضَتْ فَتَمَرَّطَ شَعْرُهَا فَأَرَادُوا أَنْ يَصِلُوهُ فَسَأَلُوا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَلَعَنَ الْوَاصِلَةَ وَالْمُسْتَوْصِلَةَ ‏.‏
37.en: A'isha reported that a girl of the Ansar who had fallen ill and had lost the hair was married. They (her relatives) thought of adding false hair (to her head). so they asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about it, whereupon he cursed the woman who adds false hair and the woman who asks for it.
37.hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Ansar ki ek larki, jo bimaar pad gayi thi aur uske baal jhad gaye the, ki shaadi hui. Woh (uske rishtedaar) nakli baal jodne ka soch rahe the, is liye unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se iske baare mein poocha, isper unhone us aurat par laanat ki jo nakli baal jodti hai aur us aurat par jo isse maangti hai.

37.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ الْحُبَابِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ نَافِعٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي 
 الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ يَنَّاقَ، عَنْ صَفِيَّةَ بِنْتِ شَيْبَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ زَوَّجَتِ
 ابْنَةً لَهَا فَاشْتَكَتْ فَتَسَاقَطَ شَعْرُهَا فَأَتَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ إِنَّ زَوْجَهَا
 يُرِيدُهَا أَفَأَصِلُ شَعَرَهَا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لُعِنَ الْوَاصِلاَتُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ 
 وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ نَافِعٍ،
 بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ لُعِنَ الْمُوصِلاَتُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
37.en: A'isha reported that a woman from the Ansar married her daughter who had lost her hair because of illness. She came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and said: Her husband wants that false hair should be aaded to her head. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The woman who adds false hair has been cursed. This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Nafi' with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
37.hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Ansar ki ek aurat ne apni beti ki shaadi karvaayi jiske baal beemari ki wajah se jhad gaye the. Woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha: Uske shohar chaahte hain ki uske sar mein nakli baal jode jaayein. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Nakli baal jodne wali aurat par laanat ki gayi hai. Ye hadees Nafi ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

37.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ،
 بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى - وَاللَّفْظُ لِزُهَيْرٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ الْقَطَّانُ - عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنِي 
 نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَعَنَ الْوَاصِلَةَ وَالْمُسْتَوْصِلَةَ وَالْوَاشِمَةَ
 وَالْمُسْتَوْشِمَةَ ‏.‏ 
 وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بَزِيعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْمُفَضَّلِ، حَدَّثَنَا صَخْرُ بْنُ،
 جُوَيْرِيَةَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
37.en: Ibn Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) cursing the woman who added false hair and the woman who asked for tattoos. This hadith has been reported on the authority of Abdullah through another chain of transmitters.
37.hi: Ibn Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko us aurat par laanat karte suna jo nakli baal jodti hai aur us aurat par jo tattoo maangti hai. Ye hadees Abdullah ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

37.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لإِسْحَاقَ - أَخْبَرَنَا 
 جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ لَعَنَ اللَّهُ الْوَاشِمَاتِ وَالْمُسْتَوْشِمَاتِ
 وَالنَّامِصَاتِ وَالْمُتَنَمِّصَاتِ وَالْمُتَفَلِّجَاتِ لِلْحُسْنِ الْمُغَيِّرَاتِ خَلْقَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ امْرَأَةً
 مِنْ بَنِي أَسَدٍ يُقَالُ لَهَا أُمُّ يَعْقُوبَ وَكَانَتْ تَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ فَأَتَتْهُ فَقَالَتْ مَا حَدِيثٌ بَلَغَنِي عَنْكَ
 أَنَّكَ لَعَنْتَ الْوَاشِمَاتِ وَالْمُسْتَوْشِمَاتِ وَالْمُتَنَمِّصَاتِ وَالْمُتَفَلِّجَاتِ لِلْحُسْنِ الْمُغَيِّرَاتِ خَلْقَ اللَّهِ
 فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَمَا لِيَ لاَ أَلْعَنُ مَنْ لَعَنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ فِي كِتَابِ
 اللَّهِ فَقَالَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ لَقَدْ قَرَأْتُ مَا بَيْنَ لَوْحَىِ الْمُصْحَفِ فَمَا وَجَدْتُهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَئِنْ كُنْتِ قَرَأْتِيهِ
 لَقَدْ وَجَدْتِيهِ قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏ وَمَا آتَاكُمُ الرَّسُولُ فَخُذُوهُ وَمَا نَهَاكُمْ عَنْهُ فَانْتَهُوا‏}‏ 
 فَقَالَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ فَإِنِّي أَرَى شَيْئًا مِنْ هَذَا عَلَى امْرَأَتِكَ الآنَ ‏.‏ قَالَ اذْهَبِي فَانْظُرِي ‏.‏ قَالَ
 فَدَخَلَتْ عَلَى امْرَأَةِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فَلَمْ تَرَ شَيْئًا فَجَاءَتْ إِلَيْهِ فَقَالَتْ مَا رَأَيْتُ شَيْئًا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَمَا
 لَوْ كَانَ ذَلِكِ لَمْ نُجَامِعْهَا ‏.‏
37.en: 'Abdullah reported that Allah had cursed those women who tattooed and who have themselves tattooed, those who pluck hair from their faces and those who make spaces between their teeth for beautification changing what God has created. This news reached a woman of the tribe of Asad who was called Umm Ya'qub and she used to recite the Holy Qur'an. She came to him and said: What is this news that has reached me from you that you curse those women who tattooed and those women who have themselves tattooed, the women who pluck hair from their faces and who make spaces between their teeth for beautification changing what God has created? Thereupon 'Abdullah said: Should I not curse one upon whom Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has invoked curse and that is in the Book also. Thereupon that woman said: I read the Qur'an from cover to cover, but I did not find that in it. whereupon he said: If you had read (thoroughly) you would have definitely found this in that (as) Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, has said:" What Allah's Messenger brings for you accept that and what he has forbidden you, refrain from that." That woman said: I find this thing in your wife even now. Thereupon he said: Go and see her. She reported: I went to the wife of 'Abdullah but found nothing of this sort in her. She came back to him and said: I have not seen anything. whereupon he said: Had there been anything like it in her, I would have never slept with her in the bed.
37.hi: Abdullah ne bayan kiya ki Allah ne un auraton par laanat ki hai jo tattoo banaati hain aur jo apna tattoo banwaati hain, jo apne chehre se baal noch dalti hain aur jo khoobsurati ke liye apne daanton ke beech jagah banaati hain, Allah ki srijan ko badalte hue. Ye khabar Asad qabile ki ek aurat tak pahunchi jise Umm Ya'qub kaha jaata tha aur woh Muqaddas Quran padha karti thi. Woh unke (Abdullah ke) paas aayi aur kaha: Ye kya khabar mujhe aapke baare mein pahunchi hai ki aap un auraton par laanat karte hain jo tattoo banwaati hain aur woh auraten jo tattoo banaati hain, woh auraten jo apne chehre se baal nochti hain aur khoobsurati ke liye apne daanton ke beech jagah banaati hain, Allah ki srijan ko badalte hue? Isper Abdullah ne kaha: Kya main us par laanat na karun jispar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne laanat maangi hai aur ye Kitaab mein bhi hai. Isper us aurat ne kaha: Maine Quran shuru se aakhir tak padha, lekin mujhe ismein ye nahi mila, isper unhone kaha: Agar tumne (poori tarah se) padha hota, to tumhe zaroor ye usmein mila hota (jaise) Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne kaha hai: "Jo Allah ka Rasool tumhare liye laata hai use qubool karo aur jisse woh tumhe mana karta hai, usse bacho." Us aurat ne kaha: Mujhe ye cheez ab bhi tumhari zauja mein milti hai. Isper unhone kaha: Jaao aur unhe dekho. Unhone (raawi ne) riwayat ki: Main Abdullah ki zauja ke paas gayi lekin mujhe unmein aisi koi cheez nahi mili. Woh unke paas wapas aayi aur kaha: Maine kuch nahi dekha, isper unhone kaha: Agar unmein aisi koi cheez hoti, to main kabhi unke saath bistar mein na sota.

37.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، وَهُوَ ابْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ
 حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُفَضَّلٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ
 مُهَلْهَلٍ - كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، فِي هَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ جَرِيرٍ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي حَدِيثِ
 سُفْيَانَ الْوَاشِمَاتِ وَالْمُسْتَوْشِمَاتِ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ مُفَضَّلٍ الْوَاشِمَاتِ وَالْمَوْشُومَاتِ ‏.‏
37.en: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Mansur with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
37.hi: Ye hadees Mansur ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

37.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ،
 بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ الْحَدِيثَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 مُجَرَّدًا عَنْ سَائِرِ الْقِصَّةِ، مِنْ ذِكْرِ أُمِّ يَعْقُوبَ ‏.‏
37.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Mansur without the story pertaining to Umm Ya'qub.
37.hi: Ye hadees Mansur ki sanad se Umm Ya'qub se mutaliq kahani ke bina riwayat ki gayi hai.

37.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ حَازِمٍ - حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ،
 عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏.‏
37.en: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abdullah.
37.hi: Ye hadees Abdullah ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

37.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ،
 أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ زَجَرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم أَنْ تَصِلَ الْمَرْأَةُ بِرَأْسِهَا شَيْئًا ‏.‏
37.en: Jabir b. Abdullah reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) reprimanded that a woman should add anything to her head (in the form of artificial hair).
37.hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne burai ki ki koi aurat apne sar mein kuch (nakli baalon ke soorat mein) joDe.

37.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ،
 الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنَ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَامَ حَجَّ وَهُوَ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ وَتَنَاوَلَ
 قُصَّةً مِنْ شَعَرٍ كَانَتْ فِي يَدِ حَرَسِيٍّ يَقُولُ يَا أَهْلَ الْمَدِينَةِ أَيْنَ عُلَمَاؤُكُمْ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَنْهَى عَنْ مِثْلِ هَذِهِ وَيَقُولُ ‏
"‏ إِنَّمَا هَلَكَتْ بَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ حِينَ اتَّخَذَ
 هَذِهِ نِسَاؤُهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
37.en: 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Auf said that he heard Mu'awiya b. Abi Sufyin during the season of Hajj, (saying) as he sat upon the pulpit holding a bunch of hair in his hand which was (previously) in the hand of his sentinel: O people of Medina, where are your scholars? I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbidding this and saying: That the people of Bani Isra'il were ruined at the time when their women wore such hair.
37.hi: Abd al-Rahman bin Auf ne kaha ki unhone Hajj ke mausam mein Muawiya bin Abi Sufyan ko, jab woh mimbar par baithe hue baalon ka ek gucchha apne haath mein liye the jo (pehle) unke pahredaar ke haath mein tha, ye kehte suna: Aye Madina ke logo, tumhare aalim kahan hain? Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ise mana karte suna aur ye kehte suna: Banu Isra'il ke log tab barbaad ho gaye the jab unki auraton ne aise baal pehne.

37.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا 
 ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، كُلُّهُمْ
 عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ مَالِكٍ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي حَدِيثِ مَعْمَرٍ ‏
"‏ إِنَّمَا عُذِّبَ بَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ ‏"‏
 ‏.‏
37.en: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Zuhri but with a slight variation of wording.
37.hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

37.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ،
 بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ،
 قَالَ قَدِمَ مُعَاوِيَةُ الْمَدِينَةَ فَخَطَبَنَا وَأَخْرَجَ كُبَّةً مِنْ شَعَرٍ فَقَالَ مَا كُنْتُ أُرَى أَنَّ أَحَدًا يَفْعَلُهُ
 إِلاَّ الْيَهُودَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَلَغَهُ فَسَمَّاهُ الزُّورَ ‏.‏
37.en: Sa'id b. Musayyib reported: Mu'awiya came to Medina and he addressed us and he took out a bunch of hair and said: What do I see that one of you does but that what the Jews did? (I can well recall) that when this act (adding of artificial hair) reached Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), he named it as cheating.
37.hi: Sa'id bin Musayyib ne bayan kiya: Muawiya Madina aaye aur humein khitaab kiya aur unhone baalon ka ek gucchha nikaala aur kaha: Ye kya hai jo main dekh raha hoon ki tum mein se koi karta hai lekin jo Yahudiyon ne kiya (waisa hi)? (Mujhe achhi tarah yaad hai) ki jab ye amal (nakli baal jodna) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) tak pahuncha, unhone ise dhoka kaha.

37.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو غَسَّانَ الْمِسْمَعِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا مُعَاذٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ
 هِشَامٍ - حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَنَّ مُعَاوِيَةَ، قَالَ ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ إِنَّكُمْ قَدْ
 أَحْدَثْتُمْ زِيَّ سَوْءٍ وَإِنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ الزُّورِ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ
 بِعَصًا عَلَى رَأْسِهَا خِرْقَةٌ قَالَ مُعَاوِيَةُ أَلاَ وَهَذَا الزُّورُ ‏.‏ قَالَ قَتَادَةُ يَعْنِي مَا يُكَثِّرُ بِهِ النِّسَاءُ
 أَشْعَارَهُنَّ مِنَ الْخِرَقِ ‏.‏
37.en: Sa, id b. Musayyib reported that Mu'awiya said one day: Should I narrate to you the evil make-up. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) forbade cheating. It was during that time that a person came with a staff and there was a cloth on its head, whereupon Mu, awiya said: Behold, that is cheating. Qatada said: This implies how women artificially increase their hair with the help of rags.
37.hi: Sa'id bin Musayyib ne bayan kiya ki Muawiya ne ek din kaha: Kya main tumhe bura shringaar riwayat na karun? Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne dhoke se mana kiya. Usi waqt ek shakhs ek lathi lekar aaya aur uske sar par kapda tha, isper Muawiya ne kaha: Dekho, ye dhoka hai. Qatada ne kaha: Iska matlab hai ki kaise auraten chithdon ki madad se apne baal kritrim soorat se badhaati hain.

37.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ
 قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ صِنْفَانِ مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ لَمْ أَرَهُمَا قَوْمٌ مَعَهُمْ سِيَاطٌ
 كَأَذْنَابِ الْبَقَرِ يَضْرِبُونَ بِهَا النَّاسَ وَنِسَاءٌ كَاسِيَاتٌ عَارِيَاتٌ مُمِيلاَتٌ مَائِلاَتٌ رُءُوسُهُنَّ
 كَأَسْنِمَةِ الْبُخْتِ الْمَائِلَةِ لاَ يَدْخُلْنَ الْجَنَّةَ وَلاَ يَجِدْنَ رِيحَهَا وَإِنَّ رِيحَهَا لَيُوجَدُ مِنْ مَسِيرَةِ
 كَذَا وَكَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
37.en: AbU Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said this: Two are the types of the denizens of Hell whom I did not see: people having flogs like the tails of the ox with them and they would be beating people, and the women who would be dressed but appear to be naked, who would be inclined (to evil) and make their husbands incline towards it. Their heads would be like the humps of the bukht camel inclined to one side. They will not enter Paradise and they would not smell its odour whereas its odour would be smelt from such and such distance.
37.hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Jahannam ke do kism ke bashinda hain jinhe maine nahi dekha: aise log jinke paas bail ki poonch jaisi kodeya hain aur woh logon ko maar rahe honge, aur woh auraten jo pehnaayi jaayengi lekin nangi lagengi, jo (burai ki taraf) jhuki hongi aur apne shohar ko uski taraf jhukayengi. Unke sar bukht oont ke kohaan jaisa ek taraf jhuka hua honge. Woh Jannat mein daakhil nahi hongi aur na hi iski mahak sooghegi jabki iski mahak itni-itni doori se soonghi jaayegi.

37.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، وَعَبْدَةُ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ 
 أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، قَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَقُولُ إِنَّ زَوْجِي أَعْطَانِي مَا لَمْ يُعْطِنِي
 فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ الْمُتَشَبِّعُ بِمَا لَمْ يُعْطَ كَلاَبِسِ ثَوْبَىْ زُورٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
37.en: A'isha reported that a woman said: Allah's Messenger, may I say to my (co-wife) that my husband has given me (such and such) a thing but which he has not in fact gives me? 'Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The one who makes a false statement of that which one has not been given is like one who wears a garment of falsehood.
37.hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki ek aurat ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya main apni saut se keh sakti hoon ki mere shohar ne mujhe (aisi aisi) cheez di hai jo unhone waastav mein nahi di? Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jo shakhs jhoota bayaan deta hai us cheez ka jo use nahi di gayi hai woh us shakhs jaisa hai jo jhoot ka kapda pehanta hai.

37.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ فَاطِمَةَ، عَنْ 
 أَسْمَاءَ، جَاءَتِ امْرَأَةٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ إِنَّ لِي ضَرَّةً فَهَلْ عَلَىَّ جُنَاحٌ
 أَنْ أَتَشَبَّعَ مِنْ مَالِ زَوْجِي بِمَا لَمْ يُعْطِنِي فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ الْمُتَشَبِّعُ
 بِمَا لَمْ يُعْطَ كَلاَبِسِ ثَوْبَىْ زُورٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
37.en: Asma' reported that a woman came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and said: I have a co-wife. Is there any harm for me if I give her the false impression (of getting something from my husband which he has not in fact given me)? Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The one who creates such a (false impression) of receiving what one has not been given is like one who wears the garment of falsehood.
37.hi: Asma ne bayan kiya ki ek aurat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha: Meri ek saut hai. Kya mujhe koi nuksaan hai agar main use jhoota bhram doon (ki mujhe apne shohar se kuch mila hai jo waastav mein unhone nahi diya)? Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Jo koi aisa (jhoota bhram) banaata hai ki use woh mila hai jo use nahi diya gaya, woh us shakhs jaisa hai jo jhoot ka kapda pehanta hai.

37.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
 أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ هِشَامٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
37.en: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters.
37.hi: Ye hadees Hisham ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ - قَالَ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ،
 ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ حَدَّثَنَا وَاللَّفْظُ، لَهُ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ، - يَعْنِيَانِ الْفَزَارِيَّ - عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ 
 أَنَسٍ، قَالَ نَادَى رَجُلٌ رَجُلاً بِالْبَقِيعِ يَا أَبَا الْقَاسِمِ ‏.‏ فَالْتَفَتَ إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله
 عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي لَمْ أَعْنِكَ إِنَّمَا دَعَوْتُ فُلاَنًا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ تَسَمَّوْا بِاسْمِي وَلاَ تَكَنَّوْا بِكُنْيَتِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
38.en: Anas reported that person at Baqi' called another person as" Abu'l- Qasim," and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) turned towards him. He (the person who had uttered these words) said: Messenger of Allah, I did not mean you, but I called such and such (person), whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: You may call yourself by my name, but not by my kunya.
38.hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki Baqi mein ek shakhs ne doosre shakhs ko "Abu'l-Qasim" kehkar pukaara, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) uski taraf mude. Usne (jisne ye alfaaz kahe the) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mera matlab aap se nahi tha, main to falan-falan (shakhs) ko bula raha tha, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Tum apna naam mere naam par rakh sakte ho, lekin meri kunya par nahi.

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ، - وَهُوَ الْمُلَقَّبُ بِسَبَلاَنَ - أَخْبَرَنَا عَبَّادُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، عَنْ 
 عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، وَأَخِيهِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، سَمِعَهُ مِنْهُمَا، سَنَةَ أَرْبَعٍ وَأَرْبَعِينَ وَمِائَةٍ يُحَدِّثَانِ عَنْ 
 نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ إِنَّ أَحَبَّ أَسْمَائِكُمْ إِلَى
 اللَّهِ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
38.en: Ibn Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The names dearest to Allah are 'Abdullah and 'Abd al-Rahman.
38.hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Allah ko sabse aziz naam Abdullah aur Abd al-Rahman hain.

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ عُثْمَانُ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ، إِسْحَاقُ
 أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ وُلِدَ لِرَجُلٍ
 مِنَّا غُلاَمٌ فَسَمَّاهُ مُحَمَّدًا فَقَالَ لَهُ قَوْمُهُ لاَ نَدَعُكَ تُسَمِّي بِاسْمِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم ‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقَ بِابْنِهِ حَامِلَهُ عَلَى ظَهْرِهِ فَأَتَى بِهِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ
 اللَّهِ وُلِدَ لِي غُلاَمٌ فَسَمَّيْتُهُ مُحَمَّدًا فَقَالَ لِي قَوْمِي لاَ نَدَعُكَ تُسَمِّي بِاسْمِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ تَسَمَّوْا بِاسْمِي وَلاَ تَكْتَنُوا بِكُنْيَتِي
 فَإِنَّمَا أَنَا قَاسِمٌ أَقْسِمُ بَيْنَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
38.en: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that a child was born to a person amongst us and he gave him the name of Muhammad. Thereupon his people said: We will not allow You to give the name of Muhammad (to your child) after the name of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He set forth with his son carrying him on his back and came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), and said: Allah's Messenger a son has been born to me and I have given him the name after the name of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Give him my name but do not give him my kunya, for I am Qasim in the sense that I distribute (the spoils of war) and the dues of Zakat amongst you.
38.hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya ki humme se ek shakhs ke ghar ek bachcha paida hua aur usne uska naam Muhammad rakha. Isper unke logon ne kaha: Hum tumhe apne bachche ka naam Muhammad rakhne nahi denge Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke naam ke baad. Woh apne bete ko peeth par uthaakar chal pade aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye, aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mere ghar ek beta paida hua hai aur maine uska naam Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke naam ke baad rakha hai, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Usse mera naam do lekin meri kunya mat do, kyunki main is maayne mein Qasim hoon ki main (jung ke maal-e-ganimat) aur Zakat ke haq tum mein baantta hoon.

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا هَنَّادُ بْنُ السَّرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْثَرٌ، عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ 
 جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ وُلِدَ لِرَجُلٍ مِنَّا غُلاَمٌ فَسَمَّاهُ مُحَمَّدًا فَقُلْنَا لاَ نَكْنِيكَ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى تَسْتَأْمِرَهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَتَاهُ فَقَالَ إِنَّهُ وُلِدَ لِي غُلاَمٌ فَسَمَّيْتُهُ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ
 وَإِنَّ قَوْمِي أَبَوْا أَنْ يَكْنُونِي بِهِ حَتَّى تَسْتَأْذِنَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ سَمُّوا
 بِاسْمِي وَلاَ تَكَنَّوْا بِكُنْيَتِي فَإِنَّمَا بُعِثْتُ قَاسِمًا أَقْسِمُ بَيْنَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
38.en: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that a child was born to one of the persons amongst us and he decided to give him the name of Muhammad We said: We will not allow you to give the name after the name of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) until you ask him (the Holy Prophet). So he (that person) came and said (to the Holy Prophet): A child was born in my house and I wanted to give him the name (of Muhammad) after the name of Allah's Messenger, whereas my people did not allow me that I should name him after that (sacred) name until I have asked Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) in this connection, whereupon he said: Give him the name after my name, but do not call him by my kunya, for I have been sent as a Qasim as I distribute amongst you.
38.hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya ki humme se ek shakhs ke ghar ek bachcha paida hua aur usne uska naam Muhammad rakhne ka faisla kiya. Humne kaha: Hum tumhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke naam ke baad naam rakhne nahi denge jab tak tum unse (Nabi-e-Paak se) na poocho. To woh (shakhs) aaya aur kaha (Nabi-e-Paak se): Mere ghar mein ek bachcha paida hua aur main use Allah ke Rasool ke naam ke baad naam dena chahta tha, jabki mere logon ne mujhe us (muqaddas) naam ke baad naam rakhne nahi diya jab tak main iske baare mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se na poochoon, isper unhone kaha: Usse mera naam do, lekin use meri kunya se mat pukaaro, kyunki mujhe Qasim ke soorat mein bheja gaya hai kyunki main tum mein baantta hoon.

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا رِفَاعَةُ بْنُ الْهَيْثَمِ الْوَاسِطِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، - يَعْنِي الطَّحَّانَ - عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ،
 بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ ‏
"‏ فَإِنَّمَا بُعِثْتُ قَاسِمًا أَقْسِمُ بَيْنَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
38.en: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Husain With the same chain of transmitters but no mention is made of these words: " (I have been sent as a distributor), so I distribute amongst you."
38.hi: Ye hadees Husain ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin ismein in alfaazon ka koi zikr nahi hai: "(Mujhe ek vitarak ke soorat mein bheja gaya hai), is liye main tum mein baantta hoon."

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَعِيدٍ،
 الأَشَجُّ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ
 قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ تَسَمَّوْا بِاسْمِي وَلاَ تَكَنَّوْا بِكُنْيَتِي فَإِنِّي أَنَا أَبُو
 الْقَاسِمِ أَقْسِمُ بَيْنَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ ‏"‏ وَلاَ تَكْتَنُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
38.en: Jabir b. Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Give the name after my name, but do not give (the kunya of Abu'l-Qasim after my) kunya, for I am Abu'l-Qasim (in the sense) that I distribute amongst you (the spoils of war) and disseminate the knowledge (of revelation). This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Bakr but with a slight variation of wording.
38.hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Naam mere naam ke baad do, lekin kunya (Abu'l-Qasim ki kunya mere baad) mat do, kyunki main Abu'l-Qasim (is maayne mein) hoon ki main tum mein (jung ka maal-e-ganimat) baantta hoon aur (wahi ke) ilm ko phailaata hoon. Ye hadees Abu Bakr ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

38.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ ‏
"‏ إِنَّمَا
 جُعِلْتُ قَاسِمًا أَقْسِمُ بَيْنَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
38.en: This hadith has been reported on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters but there is a slight variation (of wording) that, instead of the word Bu'ithat (I have been sent), the word ju'ilat (I have been made) has been used.
38.hi: Ye hadees A'mash ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin ismein alfaazon mein halka antar hai ki, Bu'ithat (mujhe bheja gaya hai) lafz ki jagah ju'ilat (mujhe banaya gaya hai) lafz istemal kiya gaya hai.

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ،
 سَمِعْتُ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ وُلِدَ لَهُ غُلاَمٌ فَأَرَادَ
 أَنْ يُسَمِّيَهُ مُحَمَّدًا فَأَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَأَلَهُ فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ أَحْسَنَتِ الأَنْصَارُ سَمُّوا
 بِاسْمِي وَلاَ تَكْتَنُوا بِكُنْيَتِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
38.en: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that a child was born to a person from the Ansar and he made up his mind to give him the name of Muhammad. He came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and, asked him (about it), whereupon he said: The Ansar have done well to give the name (to your children) after my name, but do not give them the kunya after my kunya.
38.hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya ki Ansar mein se ek shakhs ke ghar ek bachcha paida hua aur usne uska naam Muhammad rakhne ka faisla kiya. Woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unse (iske baare mein) poocha, isper unhone kaha: Ansar ne achha kiya ki (apne bachchon ka naam) mere naam ke baad rakha, lekin unhe meri kunya ke baad kunya mat do.

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ 
 شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ جَبَلَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ يَعْنِي ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ، ح
 وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي بِشْرُ،
 بْنُ خَالِدٍ أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ سَالِمِ،
 بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ح 
 وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا النَّضْرُ،
 بْنُ شُمَيْلٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، وَمَنْصُورٍ، وَسُلَيْمَانَ، وَحُصَيْنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالُوا سَمِعْنَا 
 سَالِمَ بْنَ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ
 مَنْ ذَكَرْنَا حَدِيثَهُمْ مِنْ قَبْلُ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ النَّضْرِ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ قَالَ وَزَادَ فِيهِ حُصَيْنٌ وَسُلَيْمَانُ
 قَالَ حُصَيْنٌ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا بُعِثْتُ قَاسِمًا أَقْسِمُ بَيْنَكُمْ ‏"‏
 ‏.‏ وَقَالَ سُلَيْمَانُ ‏"‏ فَإِنَّمَا أَنَا قَاسِمٌ أَقْسِمُ بَيْنَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
38.en: This hadith has been narrated through different chains of transmitters on the authority of Shu'ba with a slight variation of wording.
38.hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se doosri sanadon ke zariye alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، قَالَ عَمْرٌو
