 حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ وُلِدَ لِرَجُلٍ
 مِنَّا غُلاَمٌ فَسَمَّاهُ الْقَاسِمَ فَقُلْنَا لاَ نَكْنِيكَ أَبَا الْقَاسِمِ وَلاَ نُنْعِمُكَ عَيْنًا ‏.‏ فَأَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ لَهُ فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ أَسْمِ ابْنَكَ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
38.en: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported: A child was born in the house of a person amongst us, and he gave him the name of Qasim. We said: We will not allow you (to give the name) to your child as Qasim (and thus adopt the kunya of Abu'l-Qasim) and coal your eyes. He (that person) came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and made a mention of that to him, whereupon he said: Call your son 'Abd al-Rahman.
38.hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Humme se ek shakhs ke ghar ek bachcha paida hua, aur usne uska naam Qasim rakha. Humne kaha: Hum tumhe apne bachche ka naam Qasim rakhne nahi denge (aur is tarah Abu'l-Qasim ki kunya apnaane nahi denge) aur apni aankhon ko Thanda karne (khushi karne). Woh (shakhs) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unse iska zikr kiya, isper unhone kaha: Apne bete ko Abd al-Rahman bulaao.

38.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي أُمَيَّةُ بْنُ بِسْطَامٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ يَعْنِي ابْنَ زُرَيْعٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ،
 حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عُلَيَّةَ - كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ رَوْحِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ،
 عَنْ جَابِرٍ، ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَذْكُرْ وَلاَ نُنْعِمُكَ عَيْنًا ‏.‏
38.en: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Ibn Uyaina, but there is no mention of this: " We will not allow you to cool your eyes."
38.hi: Ye hadees Ibn Uyaina ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin ismein iska koi zikr nahi hai: "Hum tumhe apni aankhein Thandi karne nahi denge."

38.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ قَالُوا
 حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ
 أَبُو الْقَاسِمِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ تَسَمَّوْا بِاسْمِي وَلاَ تَكَنَّوْا بِكُنْيَتِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ عَمْرٌو عَنْ
 أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ وَلَمَ يَقُلْ سَمِعْتُ ‏.‏
38.en: Abu Huraira reported that Abu'l-Qasim (ﷺ) said: Give name (to your children) after my name but do not give the kunya (of Abu'l- Qasim) after my kunya. 'Amr reported from Abu Huraira that he did not say that he had heard it directly from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ).
38.hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki Abu'l-Qasim (SAW) ne kaha: Naam (apne bachchon ko) mere naam ke baad do lekin kunya (Abu'l-Qasim ki) meri kunya ke baad mat do. Amr ne Abu Huraira se riwayat ki ki unhone ye nahi kaha ki unhone ise seedhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna.

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، وَأَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ
 وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى الْعَنَزِيُّ - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ نُمَيْرٍ - قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ 
 سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ وَائِلٍ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ، قَالَ لَمَّا قَدِمْتُ نَجْرَانَ سَأَلُونِي
 فَقَالُوا إِنَّكُمْ تَقْرَءُونَ يَا أُخْتَ هَارُونَ وَمُوسَى قَبْلَ عِيسَى بِكَذَا وَكَذَا ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا قَدِمْتُ عَلَى
 رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا يُسَمُّونَ بِأَنْبِيَائِهِمْ
 وَالصَّالِحِينَ قَبْلَهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
38.en: Mughira b. Shu'ba reported: When I came to Najran, they (the Christians of Najran) asked me: You read" O sister of Harun" (i. e. Hadrat Maryam) in the Qur'an, whereas Moses was born much before Jesus. When I came back to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) I asked him about that, whereupon he said: The (people of the old age) used to give names (to their persons) after the names of Apostles and pious persons who had gone before them.
38.hi: Mughira bin Shu'ba ne bayan kiya: Jab main Najran gaya, unhone (Najran ke Isaayiyon ne) mujhse poocha: Tum Quran mein "Aye Haroon ki behn" (yaani Hazrat Maryam) padhte ho, jabki Musa Isa se bahut pehle paida huye the. Jab main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas wapas aaya maine unse iske baare mein poocha, isper unhone kaha: (Purane daur ke log) apne logon ka naam apne se pehle guzre Rasoolon aur nekokaar logon ke naam ke baad rakhte the.

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ،
 سُلَيْمَانَ عَنِ الرُّكَيْنِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سَمُرَةَ، وَقَالَ، يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ 
 الرُّكَيْنَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سَمُرَةَ بْنِ جُنْدَبٍ، قَالَ نَهَانَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 أَنْ نُسَمِّيَ رَقِيقَنَا بِأَرْبَعَةِ أَسْمَاءٍ أَفْلَحَ وَرَبَاحٍ وَيَسَارٍ وَنَافِعٍ ‏.‏
38.en: Samura b. Jundub reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade us to give names to our servants as these four names: Aflah (Successful), Rabdh (Profit), Yasar (Wealth), and Nafi' (Beneficial).
38.hi: Samura bin Jundub ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne humein mana kiya ki hum apne khaadimon ka naam in chaar naamon mein se koi rakhen: Aflah (Kaamyaab), Rabdh (Munafa), Yasar (Daulat), aur Nafi (Faayde-mand).

38.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الرُّكَيْنِ بْنِ الرَّبِيعِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سَمُرَةَ،
 بْنِ جُنْدَبٍ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ لاَ تُسَمِّ غُلاَمَكَ رَبَاحًا وَلاَ يَسَارًا
 وَلاَ أَفْلَحَ وَلاَ نَافِعًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
38.en: Samura b. Jundub reported AUah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Don't give names to your servants as Rabdh, 'Ya ar, Aflah and Nafi'.
38.hi: Samura bin Jundub ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Apne khaadimon ka naam Rabdh, Yasar, Aflah aur Nafi mat do.

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورٌ، عَنِ هِلاَلِ بْنِ يَسَافٍ، عَنْ رَبِيعِ بْنِ عُمَيْلَةَ، عَنْ سَمُرَةَ بْنِ جُنْدَبٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"أَحَبُّ الْكَلاَمِ إِلَى اللَّهِ أَرْبَعٌ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ‏.‏ لاَ يَضُرُّكَ بَأَيِّهِنَّ بَدَأْتَ.‏ وَلاَ تُسَمِّيَنَّ غُلاَمَكَ يَسَارًا وَلاَ رَبَاحًا وَلاَ نَجِيحًا وَلاَ أَفْلَحَ فَإِنَّكَ تَقُولُ أَثَمَّ هُوَ فَلاَ يَكُونُ فَيَقُولُ لاَ‏."‏‏ إِنَّمَا هُنَّ أَرْبَعٌ فَلاَ تَزِيدُنَّ عَلَىَّ ‏.‏
38.en:
Samura b. Jundub reported: The Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) said "The dearest phrases to Allah are four: Subhan Allah (Hallowed be Allah), Al-Hamdulillah (Praise be to Allah), La ilaha illa-Allah (There is no deity but Allah), Allahu Akbar (Allah is Greater). There is no harm for you in which of them begin with (while remembering Allah). 

And do not give these names to your servants: Yasar and Rabah and Najih and Aflah.
38.hi: Samura bin Jundub ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Allah ko sabse aziz alfaaz chaar hain: Subhan Allah (Allah Paak hai), Al-Hamdulillah (Sab tareef Allah ke liye), La ilaha illa-Allah (Allah ke siwaay koi ma'bood nahi), Allahu Akbar (Allah Sabse Buland hai). Tumhe koi nuksaan nahi hai ki tum inmein se kisse (Allah ko yaad karte hue) shuru karo. Aur apne khaadimon ko ye naam mat do: Yasar aur Rabah aur Najih aur Aflah.

38.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنِي جَرِيرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أُمَيَّةُ بْنُ بِسْطَامٍ، حَدَّثَنَا 
 يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ، - وَهْوَ ابْنُ الْقَاسِمِ - ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ
 قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، بِإِسْنَادِ زُهَيْرٍ ‏.‏ فَأَمَّا حَدِيثُ
 جَرِيرٍ وَرَوْحٍ فَكَمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ زُهَيْرٍ بِقِصَّتِهِ ‏.‏ وَأَمَّا حَدِيثُ شُعْبَةَ فَلَيْسَ فِيهِ إِلاَّ ذِكْرُ تَسْمِيَةِ
 الْغُلاَمِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ الْكَلاَمَ الأَرْبَعَ ‏.‏
38.en: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Shu'ba and there is no mention but of the fact about giving the name to the servant and there is no mention of the four expressions (of remembrance) and he did not mention the four words
38.hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur ismein sirf khaadim ko naam dene ki baat ka zikr hai, char (yaad ke) shabdon ka koi zikr nahi hai aur unhone woh chaar alfaaz zikr nahi kiye.

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو
 الزُّبَيْرِ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ أَرَادَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَنْهَى عَنْ
 أَنْ يُسَمَّى بِيَعْلَى وَبِبَرَكَةَ وَبِأَفْلَحَ وَبِيَسَارٍ وَبِنَافِعٍ وَبِنَحْوِ ذَلِكَ ثُمَّ رَأَيْتُهُ سَكَتَ بَعْدُ عَنْهَا
 فَلَمْ يَقُلْ شَيْئًا ثُمَّ قُبِضَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلَمْ يَنْهَ عَنْ ذَلِكَ ثُمَّ أَرَادَ عُمَرُ
 أَنْ يَنْهَى عَنْ ذَلِكَ ثُمَّ تَرَكَهُ ‏.‏
38.en: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) decided to forbid (his followers) to name persons as Ya'la (Elevated), Baraka (Blessing), Aflah (Successful), Yasar and Nafi', but I saw that he kept silent after that and he did not say anything until Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died. And he did not forbid (his followers to do this), then 'Umar decided to prohibit (people) from giving these names, but later on gave up the idea.
38.hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne (apne anuyaayiyon ko) logon ka naam Ya'la (Uchcha), Baraka (Barkat), Aflah (Kaamyaab), Yasar aur Nafi rakhne se mana karne ka faisla kiya, lekin maine dekha ki woh uske baad khamosh rahe aur unhone kuch nahi kaha jab tak Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka intiqaal nahi hua. Aur unhone (iski aakhri soorat mein) mana nahi kiya, phir Umar ne (logon ko) in naamon se mana karne ka faisla kiya, lekin baad mein ye vichaar chhod diya.

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَعُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ،
 وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ،
 أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم غَيَّرَ اسْمَ عَاصِيَةَ وَقَالَ ‏
"‏ أَنْتِ جَمِيلَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَحْمَدُ
 مَكَانَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَنْ ‏.‏
38.en: Ibn 'Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) changed the name of 'Asiya (Disobedient) and said: You are Jamila (i. e. good and handsome). Ahmad (one of the narrators) narrated it with a slight variation of wording.
38.hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Asiya (Napharmani) ka naam badla aur kaha: Tum Jamila ho (yaani achhi aur khoobsurat). Ahmad (raawiyon mein se ek) ne ise alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki.

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ،
 عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ ابْنَةً لِعُمَرَ، كَانَتْ يُقَالُ لَهَا عَاصِيَةُ فَسَمَّاهَا رَسُولُ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَمِيلَةَ ‏.‏
38.en: Ibn 'Umar reported that 'Umar had a daughter who was called 'Asiya. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave her the name of Jamila.
38.hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya ki Umar ki ek beti thi jise Asiya kaha jaata tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe Jamila naam diya.

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِعَمْرٍو - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ 
 مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، مَوْلَى آلِ طَلْحَةَ عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ كَانَتْ جُوَيْرِيَةُ اسْمُهَا
 بَرَّةَ فَحَوَّلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم اسْمَهَا جُوَيْرِيَةَ وَكَانَ يَكْرَهُ أَنْ يُقَالَ خَرَجَ
 مِنْ عِنْدِ بَرَّةَ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ ابْنِ أَبِي عُمَرَ عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ ‏.‏
38.en: Ibn Abbas reported that the name of Juwairiya (the wife of the Holy Prophet) was Barra (Pious). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) changed her name to Juwairiya and said: I did not like that it should be said: He had come out from Barra (Pious). The hadith transmitted on the authority of Ibn Abi 'Umar is slightly different from it.
38.hi: Ibn Abbas ne bayan kiya ki Juwairiya (Nabi-e-Paak ki zauja) ka naam Barra (Nekokaar) tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unka naam Juwairiya badal diya aur kaha: Mujhe ye pasand nahi tha ki kaha jaaye: "Woh Barra (Nekokaari) se bahar aaya." Ibn Abi Umar ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hadees isse thoda alag hai.

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا 
 مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي مَيْمُونَةَ، سَمِعْتُ أَبَا رَافِعٍ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي،
 هُرَيْرَةَ ح 
 وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي مَيْمُونَةَ،
 عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ زَيْنَبَ، كَانَ اسْمُهَا بَرَّةَ فَقِيلَ تُزَكِّي نَفْسَهَا ‏.‏ فَسَمَّاهَا
 رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم زَيْنَبَ ‏.‏ وَلَفْظُ الْحَدِيثِ لِهَؤُلاَءِ دُونَ ابْنِ بَشَّارٍ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ
 أَبِي شَيْبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ ‏.‏
38.en: Abu Huraira reported that the name of Zainab was Barra. It was said of her: She presents herself to be innocent. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave her the name of Zainab.
38.hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki Zainab ka naam Barra tha. Unke baare mein kaha jaata tha: Woh khud ko masoom pesh karti hai. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe Zainab naam diya.

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا 
 أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَطَاءٍ، حَدَّثَتْنِي زَيْنَبُ،
 بِنْتُ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ قَالَتْ كَانَ اسْمِي بَرَّةَ فَسَمَّانِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم زَيْنَبَ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ
 وَدَخَلَتْ عَلَيْهِ زَيْنَبُ بِنْتُ جَحْشٍ وَاسْمُهَا بَرَّةُ فَسَمَّاهَا زَيْنَبَ ‏.‏
38.en: Zainab, daughter of Umm Salama, reported: My name first was Barra. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave me the name of Zainab. Then there entered (into the house of Allah's Prophet as a wife) Zainab, daughter of Jahsh, and her name was also Barra, and he gave her the name of Zainab.
38.hi: Zainab, Umm Salama ki beti, ne bayan kiya: Mera naam pehle Barra tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe Zainab naam diya. Phir Zainab, Jahsh ki beti, (Allah ke Nabi ke ghar mein ek zauja ke soorat mein) daakhil hui, aur unka naam bhi Barra tha, aur unhone unhe bhi Zainab naam diya.

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ،
 عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَطَاءٍ، قَالَ سَمَّيْتُ ابْنَتِي بَرَّةَ فَقَالَتْ لِي زَيْنَبُ بِنْتُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ إِنَّ
 رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ هَذَا الاِسْمِ وَسُمِّيتُ بَرَّةَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ تُزَكُّوا أَنْفُسَكُمُ اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِأَهْلِ الْبِرِّ مِنْكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا بِمَ نُسَمِّيهَا قَالَ
 ‏"‏ سَمُّوهَا زَيْنَبَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
38.en: Muhammad b. 'Amr b. 'Ata' reported: I had given the name Barra to my daughter. Zainab, daughter of Abu Salama, told me that Allah's' Messenger (ﷺ) had forbidden me to give this name. (She said): I was also called Barra, but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Don't hold yourself to be pious. It is God alone who knows the people of piety among you. They (the Companions) said: Then, what name should we give to her? He said: Name her as Zainab.
38.hi: Muhammad bin Amr bin Ata ne bayan kiya: Maine apni beti ka naam Barra rakha tha. Zainab, Abu Salama ki beti, ne mujhe bataya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe ye naam rakhne se mana kiya. (Unhone kaha): Mujhe bhi Barra kaha jaata tha, lekin Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Apne aap ko nekokaar mat samajho. Ye sirf Allah hi jaanta hai ki tum mein se kaun nekokaar hai. Unhone (sahaba ne) kaha: Phir hum unhe kya naam dein? Unhone kaha: Unhe Zainab naam do.

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو الأَشْعَثِيُّ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ - وَاللَّفْظُ
 لأَحْمَدَ - قَالَ الأَشْعَثِيُّ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ،
 عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ أَخْنَعَ اسْمٍ عِنْدَ
 اللَّهِ رَجُلٌ تَسَمَّى مَلِكَ الأَمْلاَكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ زَادَ ابْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ ‏"‏ لاَ مَالِكَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ
 ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ الأَشْعَثِيُّ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ مِثْلُ شَاهَانْ شَاهْ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَمْرٍو
 عَنْ أَخْنَعَ فَقَالَ أَوْضَعَ ‏.‏
38.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The vilest name in Allah's sight is Malik al-Amidh (King of Kings). The narration transmitted on the authority of Shaiba (contains these words): There is no king but Allah, the Exalted and Glorious. Sufyan said: Similarly, the word Shahinshah (is also the vilest appellation). Ahmad b. Hanbal said: I asked Abu 'Amr about the meaning of Akhna. He said: The vilest.
38.hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Allah ki nazar mein sabse ghinaunA naam Malik al-Amidh (Baadshahon ka Baadshah) hai. Shaiba ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hadees mein (ye alfaaz hain): Allah, jo Buland-o-Azeem hai, ke siwaay koi raja nahi hai. Sufyan ne kaha: Isi tarah, Shahinshah lafz bhi (sabse ghinaunA hai). Ahmad bin Hanbal ne kaha: Maine Abu Amr se Akhna ka matlab poocha. Unhone kaha: Sabse ghinaunA.

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، قَالَ
 هَذَا مَا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ أَحَادِيثَ مِنْهَا وَقَالَ
 رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ أَغْيَظُ رَجُلٍ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَأَخْبَثُهُ وَأَغْيَظُهُ عَلَيْهِ
 رَجُلٌ كَانَ يُسَمَّى مَلِكَ الأَمْلاَكِ لاَ مَلِكَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
38.en: Abu Huraira reported from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) so many ahadith and one of them was this that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The most wretched person in the sight of Allah on the Day of Resurrection and the worst person and target of His wrath would of the person who is called Malik al-Amlak (the King of Kings) for there is no king but Allah.
38.hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kayi hadeesein riwayat kin aur unmein se ek ye thi ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Allah ki nazar mein Qayamat ke din sabse abhaagi shakhs aur sabse bure shakhs aur Uske gusse ka nishaana woh shakhs hoga jise Malik al-Amlak (Baadshahon ka Baadshah) kaha jaata hai, kyunki Allah ke siwaay koi raja nahi hai.

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ الْبُنَانِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ،
 بْنِ مَالِكٍ قَالَ ذَهَبْتُ بِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ الأَنْصَارِيِّ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 حِينَ وُلِدَ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي عَبَاءَةٍ يَهْنَأُ بَعِيرًا لَهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَلْ مَعَكَ
 تَمْرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ فَنَاوَلْتُهُ تَمَرَاتٍ فَأَلْقَاهُنَّ فِي فِيهِ فَلاَكَهُنَّ ثُمَّ فَغَرَ فَا الصَّبِيِّ فَمَجَّهُ
 فِي فِيهِ فَجَعَلَ الصَّبِيُّ يَتَلَمَّظُهُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ حُبُّ الأَنْصَارِ التَّمْرَ
 ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَسَمَّاهُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏
38.en: Anas b. Malik reported: I took 'Abdullah b. Abi Talha Ansari to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at the time of his birth. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was at that time wearing a woollen cloak and besmearing the camels with tar. He said: Have you got with you the dates? I said: Yes. He took hold of the dates and put them in his mouth and softened them, then opened the mouth of the infant and put that in it and the child began to lick it. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The Ansar have a liking for the dates, and he (the Holy Prophet) gave him the name of 'Abdullah.
38.hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya: Main Abdullah bin Abi Talha Ansari ko unke paidaish ke waqt Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) us waqt ek oon ka chogha pehne hue the aur oonton ko taar (colouring) lagaa rahe the. Unhone kaha: Kya tumhare paas khajooren hain? Maine kaha: Haan. Unhone khajooren pakadin aur unhe apne munh mein daala aur unhe naram kiya, phir bachche ka munh khola aur woh use daala aur bachcha ise chaatne laga. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ansar ko khajooron ka shauk hai, aur unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) usko Abdullah naam diya.

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ،
 سِيرِينَ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ كَانَ ابْنٌ لأَبِي طَلْحَةَ يَشْتَكِي فَخَرَجَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ فَقُبِضَ الصَّبِيُّ
 فَلَمَّا رَجَعَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ قَالَ مَا فَعَلَ ابْنِي قَالَتْ أُمُّ سُلَيْمٍ هُوَ أَسْكَنُ مِمَّا كَانَ ‏.‏ فَقَرَّبَتْ إِلَيْهِ
 الْعَشَاءَ فَتَعَشَّى ثُمَّ أَصَابَ مِنْهَا فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ قَالَتْ وَارُوا الصَّبِيَّ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا أَصْبَحَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ
 أَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرَهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَعْرَسْتُمُ اللَّيْلَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ قَالَ
 ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَوَلَدَتْ غُلاَمًا فَقَالَ لِي أَبُو طَلْحَةَ احْمِلْهُ حَتَّى تَأْتِيَ بِهِ النَّبِيَّ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَأَتَى بِهِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَبَعَثَتْ مَعَهُ بِتَمَرَاتٍ فَأَخَذَهُ النَّبِيُّ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَمَعَهُ شَىْءٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا نَعَمْ تَمَرَاتٌ ‏.‏ فَأَخَذَهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله
 عليه وسلم فَمَضَغَهَا ثُمَّ أَخَذَهَا مِنْ فِيهِ فَجَعَلَهَا فِي فِي الصَّبِيِّ ثُمَّ حَنَّكَهُ وَسَمَّاهُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ
 ‏.‏
38.en: Anas b. Malik reported that the son of Abu Talha had been ailing. Abu Talha set out (on a journey) and his son breathed his last (in his absence). When Abu Talha came back, he said (to his wife): What about my child? Umm Sulaim (the wife of Abu Talha) said: He is now in a more comfortable state than before. She served him the evening meal and he took it. He then came to her (and had sexual intercourse with her) and when it was all over she said: Make arrangements for the burial of the child. When it was morning. Abu Talha came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and informed him, whereupon he said: Did you spend the night with her. He said: Yes. He (the Holy Prophet) then said: O Allah, bless both of them (and as a result of blessing) she gave birth to a child. Abu Talha said to me (Anas b. Malik) to take the child, (so I took him) and came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). She (Umm Sulaim) also had sent some dates (along with the child). Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) took him (the child) (in his lap) and said: Is there anything with you (for Tahnik). They (the Companions) said: Yes. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) took hold of them (dates and chewed them). He then put them (the chewed dates) in the mouth of the child and then rubbed his palate and gave him the name of 'Abdullah.
38.hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki Abu Talha ke bete bimaar the. Abu Talha (safar par) nikle aur unke bete ne aakhri saans li (unki anupasthiti mein). Jab Abu Talha wapas aaye, unhone (apni zauja se) kaha: Mere bachche ka kya haal hai? Umm Sulaim (Abu Talha ki zauja) ne kaha: Woh ab pehle se zyada aaraam mein hain. Unhone unhe raat ka khaana pesh kiya aur unhone use khaya. Phir woh unke paas aaye (aur unke saath jinsi milaap kiya) aur jab sab kuch khatam ho gaya unhone kaha: Bachche ke dafn ki intezam karo. Jab subah hui, Abu Talha Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unhe bataya, isper unhone kaha: Kya tumne unke saath raat guzaari? Unhone kaha: Haan. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) phir kaha: Aye Allah, donon ko barkat de (aur barkat ke natije mein) unhone ek bachche ko paida kiya. Abu Talha ne mujhse (Anas bin Malik se) kaha ki main bachche ko lekar jaaun, (is liye main use lekar) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya. Woh (Umm Sulaim) kuch khajooren bhi bhej chuki thin (bachche ke saath). Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne use (bachche ko) (apni god mein) liya aur kaha: Kya tumhare paas kuch hai (Tahnik ke liye)? Unhone (sahaba ne) kaha: Haan. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe (khajooren aur unhe chabaaya) liya. Phir unhone unhe (chabai gayi khajooren) bachche ke munh mein daali aur phir uska taalu mala aur use Abdullah naam diya.

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ مَسْعَدَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ 
 أَنَسٍ، بِهَذِهِ الْقِصَّةِ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ يَزِيدَ ‏.‏
38.en: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Anas through another chain of transmit ters.
38.hi: Ye hadees Anas ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ بَرَّادٍ الأَشْعَرِيُّ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا 
 أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ بُرَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَ وُلِدَ لِي غُلاَمٌ فَأَتَيْتُ بِهِ النَّبِيَّ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم فَسَمَّاهُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَحَنَّكَهُ بِتَمْرَةٍ ‏.‏
38.en: Abu Musa reported: A child was born in my house and I brought him to Allah's Apostle (may peace be upod him) and he gave him the name of Ibrahim and he rubbed his palate with dates.
38.hi: Abu Musa ne bayan kiya: Mere ghar mein ek bachcha paida hua aur main use Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laaya aur unhone use Ibrahim naam diya aur khajooron se uska taalu mala.

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مُوسَى أَبُو صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ إِسْحَاقَ - أَخْبَرَنِي 
 هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، وَفَاطِمَةُ بِنْتُ الْمُنْذِرِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُمَا قَالاَ خَرَجَتْ
 أَسْمَاءُ بِنْتُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ حِينَ هَاجَرَتْ وَهِيَ حُبْلَى بِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ فَقَدِمَتْ قُبَاءً فَنُفِسَتْ
 بِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بِقُبَاءٍ ثُمَّ خَرَجَتْ حِينَ نُفِسَتْ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِيُحَنِّكَهُ فَأَخَذَهُ
 رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْهَا فَوَضَعَهُ فِي حَجْرِهِ ثُمَّ دَعَا بِتَمْرَةٍ قَالَ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ
 فَمَكَثْنَا سَاعَةً نَلْتَمِسُهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ نَجِدَهَا فَمَضَغَهَا ثُمَّ بَصَقَهَا فِي فِيهِ فَإِنَّ أَوَّلَ شَىْءٍ دَخَلَ
 بَطْنَهُ لَرِيقُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ قَالَتْ أَسْمَاءُ ثُمَّ مَسَحَهُ وَصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ وَسَمَّاهُ
 عَبْدَ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ جَاءَ وَهُوَ ابْنُ سَبْعِ سِنِينَ أَوْ ثَمَانٍ لِيُبَايِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 وَأَمَرَهُ بِذَلِكَ الزُّبَيْرُ فَتَبَسَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ رَآهُ مُقْبِلاً إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ بَايَعَهُ
 ‏.‏
38.en: 'Urwa b. Zubair and Fatima daughter of Mandhir b. Zubair, reported that Asma' daughter of Abu Bakr was at the time of migration in the family way with 'Abdullah b. Zubair (in her womb). She came to Quba' and gave birth to 'Abdullah at that place and then sent him to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) so that he should rub his palate with chewed dates. Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) took hold of him (the child) and he placed him in his lap and then called for dates. 'A'isha said: Some time was spent before we were able to find them. He (the Holy Prophet) chewed them and then put his saliva in his mouth. The first thing that entered his stomach, was the saliva of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Asma' said: He then rubbed him and blessed him and gave him the name of Abdullah. He ('Abdullah) went to him (the Holy Prophet) when he had attained the age of seven or eight years in order to pledge allegiance to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as Zubair had commanded him to do. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) smiled when he saw him coming towards him and then accepted his allegiance.
38.hi: Urwa bin Zubair aur Fatima, Mandhir bin Zubair ki beti, ne bayan kiya ki Asma, Abu Bakr ki beti, hijrat ke waqt Abdullah bin Zubair se garbhvati thin (apne garbh mein). Woh Quba aayin aur usi jagah Abdullah ko paida kiya aur phir use Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas bheja taaki woh chabai gayi khajooron se uska taalu malein. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne use (bachche ko) pakda aur apni god mein rakha aur phir khajooren maangin. Aisha ne kaha: Kuch waqt lag gaya isse pehle ki hum unhe dhoondh paayein. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) unhe chabaaya aur phir apni lar uske munh mein daali. Sabse pehli cheez jo uske pait mein gayi, woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki lar thi. Asma ne kaha: Phir unhone use mala aur use barkat di aur use Abdullah naam diya. Woh (Abdullah) unke paas gaye jab woh saat ya aath saal ke ho gaye taaki woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se wafadaari ki qasam le, jaisa Zubair ne unhe hukum diya tha karne ke liye. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unhe apni taraf aate dekhkar muskuraaye aur phir unki wafadaari qubool ki.

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ 
 أَسْمَاءَ، أَنَّهَا حَمَلَتْ بِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ بِمَكَّةَ قَالَتْ فَخَرَجْتُ وَأَنَا مُتِمٌّ، فَأَتَيْتُ الْمَدِينَةَ فَنَزَلْتُ
 بِقُبَاءٍ فَوَلَدْتُهُ بِقُبَاءٍ ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَوَضَعَهُ فِي حَجْرِهِ ثُمَّ دَعَا
 بِتَمْرَةٍ فَمَضَغَهَا ثُمَّ تَفَلَ فِي فِيهِ فَكَانَ أَوَّلَ شَىْءٍ دَخَلَ جَوْفَهُ رِيقُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله
 عليه وسلم ثُمَّ حَنَّكَهُ بِالتَّمْرَةِ ثُمَّ دَعَا لَهُ وَبَرَّكَ عَلَيْهِ وَكَانَ أَوَّلَ مَوْلُودٍ وُلِدَ فِي الإِسْلاَمِ ‏.‏
38.en: Asma' reported that she had become pregnant at Mecca with Abdullah b. Zubair (in her womt) and she (further) said: I set out (for migration to Medina) as I was in the advanced stage of pregnancy. I came to Medina and got down at the place known as Quba' and gave birth to a child there. Then I came to Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him). He placed him (the child) in his lap and then commanded for the dates to be brought. He chewed them and then put the saliva in his mouth. The first thing which went into his stomach was the saliva of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He then rubbed his palate with dates and then invoked blessings for him and blessed him. He was the first child who was born in Islam (after Migration).
38.hi: Asma ne bayan kiya ki woh Makkah mein Abdullah bin Zubair se garbhvati ho gayi thi (apne garbh mein) aur unhone (aage) kaha: Main nikli (Madina hijrat karne ke liye) jab main garbhavastha ke aakhri charan mein thi. Main Madina aayi aur Quba naam ki jagah par utri aur wahan ek bachche ko paida kiya. Phir main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi. Unhone use (bachche ko) apni god mein rakha aur phir khajooren laane ka hukum diya. Unhone unhe chabaaya aur phir lar uske munh mein daali. Sabse pehli cheez jo uske pait mein gayi woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki lar thi. Phir unhone khajooron se uska taalu mala aur phir uske liye barkatein maangi aur use barkat di. Woh Islam mein (hijrat ke baad) paida hone waala pehla bachcha tha.

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ،
 بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، أَنَّهَا هَاجَرَتْ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم وَهِيَ حُبْلَى بِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ أَبِي أُسَامَةَ ‏.‏
38.en: Asma', daughter of Abu Bakr, reported that when she migrated to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in Medina she was in the family way with Abdullah b. Zubair in her womb.
38.hi: Asma, Abu Bakr ki beti, ne bayan kiya ki jab woh Madina mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas hijrat karke aayin, woh Abdullah bin Zubair se garbhvati thin apne garbh mein.

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ
 عُرْوَةَ - عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يُؤْتَى بِالصِّبْيَانِ
 فَيُبَرِّكُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَيُحَنِّكُهُمْ ‏.‏
38.en: 'A'isha reported that the new-born infants were brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He blessed them and rubbed their palates with dates.
38.hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki naye paida hue bachche Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laaye jaate the. Unhone unhe barkat di aur khajooron se unka taalu mala.

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ الأَحْمَرُ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ 
 عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ جِئْنَا بِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُحَنِّكُهُ فَطَلَبْنَا تَمْرَةً
 فَعَزَّ عَلَيْنَا طَلَبُهَا ‏.‏
38.en: 'A'isha reported: We took 'Abdullah b. Zubair to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) so that he should put saliva in his mouth and we had to make a good deal of effort in order to procure them.
38.hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya: Hum Abdullah bin Zubair ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laaye taaki woh apni lar uske munh mein daalein, aur humein khajooren haasil karne ke liye kaafi mehnat karni padi.

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَهْلٍ التَّمِيمِيُّ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ،
 حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ مُطَرِّفٍ أَبُو غَسَّانَ - حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ
 أُتِيَ بِالْمُنْذِرِ بْنِ أَبِي أُسَيْدٍ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ وُلِدَ فَوَضَعَهُ النَّبِيُّ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى فَخِذِهِ وَأَبُو أُسَيْدٍ جَالِسٌ فَلَهِيَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِشَىْءٍ
 بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ فَأَمَرَ أَبُو أُسَيْدٍ بِابْنِهِ فَاحْتُمِلَ مِنْ عَلَى فَخِذِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 فَأَقْلَبُوهُ فَاسْتَفَاقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَيْنَ الصَّبِيُّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو
 أُسَيْدٍ أَقْلَبْنَاهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا اسْمُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فُلاَنٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏
 لاَ وَلَكِنِ اسْمُهُ الْمُنْذِرُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَسَمَّاهُ يَوْمَئِذٍ الْمُنْذِرَ ‏.‏
38.en: Sahl b. Sa'd reported that Mundhir b. Aba Usaid was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at the time of his birth Allah's. Apostle (ﷺ) placed him on his thigh and Abfi Usaid kept sitting there. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) had been occupied with something else before him. Abu Usaid commanded his child to be lifted from the lap of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and so he was lifted. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had finished the work he said: Where is the child? Abd Usaid said: Allah's Messenger, we took him away. He said: What is his name? He said; Allah's Messenger, it is so and so, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Nay, his name is Mundhir, and named him Mundhir on that day.
38.hi: Sahl bin Sa'd ne bayan kiya ki Mundhir bin Aba Usaid ko unke paidaish ke waqt Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas laaya gaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe apni jaangh par rakha aur Abu Usaid wahin baithe rahe. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unse pehle kisi doosri cheez mein masroof the. Abu Usaid ne apne bachche ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki god se uthane ka hukum diya aur is tarah use uthaaya gaya. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apna kaam khatm kar chuke, unhone kaha: Bachcha kahan hai? Abd Usaid ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, hum use le gaye. Unhone kaha: Uska naam kya hai? Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye aisa aisa hai, isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Nahi, uska naam Mundhir hai, aur usi din unhone use Mundhir naam diya.

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ الْعَتَكِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو التَّيَّاحِ،
 حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، ح 
 وَحَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، عَنْ أَبِي التَّيَّاحِ،
 عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَحْسَنَ النَّاسِ خُلُقًا وَكَانَ
 لِي أَخٌ يُقَالُ لَهُ أَبُو عُمَيْرٍ - قَالَ أَحْسِبُهُ قَالَ - كَانَ فَطِيمًا - قَالَ - فَكَانَ إِذَا جَاءَ رَسُولُ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَرَآهُ قَالَ ‏
"‏ أَبَا عُمَيْرٍ مَا فَعَلَ النُّغَيْرُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَكَانَ يَلْعَبُ بِهِ
 ‏.‏
38.en: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had the sublimest character among mankind. I had a brother who was called Abu 'Umair. I think he was weaned. When Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) came to our house he saw him, and said: Abu 'Umair, what has the sparrow done? He (Anas) said that he had been playing with that.
38.hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka charitr insaaniyat mein sabse uchcha tha. Mera ek bhai tha jise Abu Umair kaha jaata tha. Mujhe lagta hai unka doodh chhudaya ja chuka tha. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) humare ghar aaye unhone use dekha aur kaha: Abu Umair, chidiya ne kya kiya? Unhone (Anas ne) kaha ki woh usi ke saath khel rahe the.

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ الْغُبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ،
 مَالِكٍ قَالَ قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ يَا بُنَىَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
38.en: Anas b Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) addressed me: O My Son.
38.hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse khitaab kiya: Aye mere Bete.

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَرَ - قَالاَ
 حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ،
 بْنِ شُعْبَةَ قَالَ مَا سَأَلَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَحَدٌ عَنِ الدَّجَّالِ أَكْثَرَ مِمَّا سَأَلْتُهُ
 عَنْهُ فَقَالَ لِي ‏"‏ أَىْ بُنَىَّ وَمَا يُنْصِبُكَ مِنْهُ إِنَّهُ لَنْ يَضُرَّكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ إِنَّهُمْ يَزْعُمُونَ أَنَّ
 مَعَهُ أَنْهَارَ الْمَاءِ وَجِبَالَ الْخُبْزِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ هُوَ أَهْوَنُ عَلَى اللَّهِ مِنْ ذَلِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
38.en: Mughira b. Shu'ba reported that none else had asked more questions from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about the Dajjal than I, but he simply said in a slight mood): O, myson, why are you worried because of him? He will not harm you. I said: The people think that he would have with him rivers of water and mountains of bread, whereupon he said: He would be more insignificant in the sight of Allah than all these things (belonging to him).
38.hi: Mughira bin Shu'ba ne bayan kiya ki kisi aur ne mujhse zyada Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se Dajjal ke baare mein sawaal nahi poocha, lekin unhone (halke mizaaj mein) kaha: Aye mere bete, tum uski wajah se kyun pareshaan ho? Woh tumhe koi nuksaan nahi pahunchaayega. Maine kaha: Log sochte hain ki uske paas paani ki nadiyaan aur roti ke pahaad honge, isper unhone kaha: Woh Allah ki nazar mein in sab cheezon se zyada tuchcha hoga (jo uske paas hongi).

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا سُرَيْجُ بْنُ،
 يُونُسَ حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ،
 رَافِعٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ وَلَيْسَ فِي حَدِيثِ أَحَدٍ مِنْهُمْ
 قَوْلُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِلْمُغِيرَةِ ‏
"‏ أَىْ بُنَىَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ إِلاَّ فِي حَدِيثِ يَزِيدَ وَحْدَهُ ‏.‏
38.en: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Ismail, with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
38.hi: Ye hadees Ismail ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا - وَاللَّهِ،
 - يَزِيدُ بْنُ خُصَيْفَةَ عَنْ بُسْرِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ، يَقُولُ كُنْتُ جَالِسًا
 بِالْمَدِينَةِ فِي مَجْلِسِ الأَنْصَارِ فَأَتَانَا أَبُو مُوسَى فَزِعًا أَوْ مَذْعُورًا ‏.‏ قُلْنَا مَا شَأْنُكَ قَالَ
 إِنَّ عُمَرَ أَرْسَلَ إِلَىَّ أَنْ آتِيَهُ فَأَتَيْتُ بَابَهُ فَسَلَّمْتُ ثَلاَثًا فَلَمْ يَرُدَّ عَلَىَّ فَرَجَعْتُ فَقَالَ مَا مَنَعَكَ
 أَنْ تَأْتِيَنَا فَقُلْتُ إِنِّي أَتَيْتُكَ فَسَلَّمْتُ عَلَى بَابِكَ ثَلاَثًا فَلَمْ يَرُدُّوا عَلَىَّ فَرَجَعْتُ وَقَدْ قَالَ رَسُولُ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ إِذَا اسْتَأْذَنَ أَحَدُكُمْ ثَلاَثًا فَلَمْ يُؤْذَنْ لَهُ فَلْيَرْجِعْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ
 أَقِمْ عَلَيْهِ الْبَيِّنَةَ وَإِلاَّ أَوْجَعْتُكَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أُبَىُّ بْنُ كَعْبٍ لاَ يَقُومُ مَعَهُ إِلاَّ أَصْغَرُ الْقَوْمِ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو
 سَعِيدٍ قُلْتُ أَنَا أَصْغَرُ الْقَوْمِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَاذْهَبْ بِهِ ‏.‏
38.en: Abu Sa'id Khudri reported: I was sitting in Medina in the company of the Ansar when Abu Musa came trembling with fear. We said to him: What is the matter? He said: 'Umar (Allah be pleased with him) sent for me. I went to him and paid him salutation thrice at (his) door but he made no response to me and so I came back. Thereupon he ('Umar) said: What stood in your way that you did not turn up? I said: I did come to you and paid you salutations at your door three times but I was not given any response, so I came back as the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) has said: When any one of you seeks permission three times and he is not granted permission, he should come back. Umar said: Bring a witness to support that you say, otherwise I shall take you to task. Ubayy b. Ka'b said: None should stand with him (as a witness) but the youngest amongst the people. Abu Sa'id said: I am the youngest amongst the people, whereupon he said: Then you go with him (to support his contention).
38.hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri ne bayan kiya: Main Madina mein Ansar ki sohbat mein baitha tha jab Abu Musa Dar se kaanpte hue aaye. Humne unse kaha: Kya baat hai? Unhone kaha: Umar ne mujhe bulaaya. Main unke paas gaya aur unke darwaze par teen baar salaam kiya lekin unhone mujhe koi jawaab nahi diya, is liye main wapas aa gaya. Isper unhone (Umar ne) kaha: Tumhe kis baat ne roka ki tum wapas nahi aaye? Maine kaha: Main aapke paas aaya aur aapke darwaze par teen baar salaam kiya lekin mujhe koi jawaab nahi mila, is liye main wapas chala gaya jaisa Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha hai: Jab tum mein se koi teen baar ijazat maangta hai aur use ijazat nahi mili, use wapas jaana chahiye. Umar ne kaha: Ek gawaah lao is baat ki tasdeeq karne ke liye, warna main tumse sakhti se paisa loonga. Ubayy bin Ka'b ne kaha: Koi bhi unke saath (gawaah ke soorat mein) khada na ho siwaay logon mein sabse choti umar wale ke. Abu Sa'id ne kaha: Main logon mein sabse choti umar wala hoon, isper unhone kaha: Phir tum unke saath jaao (unke daawe ka himayat karne).

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ خُصَيْفَةَ،
 بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ وَزَادَ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ فِي حَدِيثِهِ قَالَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ فَقُمْتُ مَعَهُ فَذَهَبْتُ إِلَى عُمَرَ
 فَشَهِدْتُ ‏.‏
38.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Yazid b. Khusaifa with the same chain of transmitters but with this addition: Abu Sa'id said: So I stood up, and went to 'Umar and gave witness (to what Abu Musa had said).
38.hi: Ye hadees Yazid bin Khusaifa ki sanad se isi sanad se is izafe ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai: Abu Sa'id ne kaha: To main khada hua aur Umar ke paas gaya aur gawaahi di (jo Abu Musa ne kaha tha uski).

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ 
 بُكَيْرِ بْنِ الأَشَجِّ، أَنَّ بُسْرَ بْنَ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ، يَقُولُ كُنَّا فِي مَجْلِسٍ
 عِنْدَ أُبَىِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ فَأَتَى أَبُو مُوسَى الأَشْعَرِيُّ مُغْضَبًا حَتَّى وَقَفَ فَقَالَ أَنْشُدُكُمُ اللَّهَ هَلْ
 سَمِعَ أَحَدٌ مِنْكُمْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏
"‏ الاِسْتِئْذَانُ ثَلاَثٌ فَإِنْ أُذِنَ لَكَ وَإِلاَّ
 فَارْجِعْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أُبَىٌّ وَمَا ذَاكَ قَالَ اسْتَأْذَنْتُ عَلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ أَمْسِ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ
 فَلَمْ يُؤْذَنْ لِي فَرَجَعْتُ ثُمَّ جِئْتُهُ الْيَوْمَ فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ أَنِّي جِئْتُ أَمْسِ فَسَلَّمْتُ ثَلاَثًا
 ثُمَّ انْصَرَفْتُ قَالَ قَدْ سَمِعْنَاكَ وَنَحْنُ حِينَئِذٍ عَلَى شُغْلٍ فَلَوْ مَا اسْتَأْذَنْتَ حَتَّى يُؤْذَنَ لَكَ
 قَالَ اسْتَأْذَنْتُ كَمَا سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ فَوَاللَّهِ لأُوجِعَنَّ ظَهْرَكَ
 وَبَطْنَكَ ‏.‏ أَوْ لَتَأْتِيَنَّ بِمَنْ يَشْهَدُ لَكَ عَلَى هَذَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أُبَىُّ بْنُ كَعْبٍ فَوَاللَّهِ لاَ يَقُومُ مَعَكَ إِلاَّ
 أَحْدَثُنَا سِنًّا قُمْ يَا أَبَا سَعِيدٍ ‏.‏ فَقُمْتُ حَتَّى أَتَيْتُ عُمَرَ فَقُلْتُ قَدْ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ هَذَا ‏.‏
38.en: Abd Sa'id Khudri reported: We were in the company of Ubayy b. Ka'b that Abu Musa Ash'ari came there in a state of anger. He stood (before us) and said: I ask you to bear witness in the name of Allah whether anyone amongst you heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Permission (for entering the house) should be sought three times and if permission is granted to you (then get in). otherwise go back. Ubayy b. Ka'b said: What is the iiiatter? He said: I sought permission yesterday from 'Umar b. Khattab three times but he did not permit me, so I came back; then I went to him today and visited him and informed him that I had come to him yesterday and greeted him thrice, then came back, whereupon he said: Yes, we did hear you but be were at that time busy, but why did you not seek permission (further and you must have never gone back until you were permitted to do so). He said: I sought permission (in the manner) that I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said (in connection 'With the seeking of permission for entering the house of a stranger). Thereupon he (Hadrat Umar) said: By Allah, I shall torture your back and your stomach unless you bring one who may bear witness to what you state. 'Ubayy b. Ka'b said: By Allah, none should stand with you (to bear testimony) but the youngest amongst us. And he therefore, said to Abu Sa'id: Stand up. So I stood up until I came to Umar and said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say this.
38.hi: Abd Sa'id Khudri ne bayan kiya: Hum Ubayy bin Ka'b ki sohbat mein the ki Abu Musa Ash'ari gusse ki haalat mein wahan aaye. Woh (humare saamne) khade hue aur kaha: Main tumse Allah ke naam par gawaahi maangta hoon ki kya tum mein se kisi ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna hai: Ijazat (ghar mein daakhil hone ke liye) teen baar maangi jaani chahiye aur agar tumhe ijazat mil jaaye (to andar jao). warna wapas jao. Ubayy bin Ka'b ne kaha: Kya baat hai? Unhone kaha: Maine kal Umar bin Khattab se teen baar ijazat maangi lekin unhone mujhe ijazat nahi di, is liye main wapas aa gaya; phir main aaj unke paas gaya aur unse mila aur unhe bataya ki main kal unke paas aaya tha aur unhe teen baar salaam kiya, phir wapas aa gaya, isper unhone kaha: Haan, humne tumhe suna lekin hum us waqt masroof the, lekin tumne aur ijazat kyun nahi maangi (tumhe kabhi tab tak wapas nahi jaana chahiye tha jab tak tumhe ijazat na mil jaaye). Unhone kaha: Maine (usi tarah) ijazat maangi jaisa maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kehte suna (kisi ajanabi ke ghar mein daakhil hone ki ijazat maangne ke silsile mein). Isper unhone (Hazrat Umar ne) kaha: Allah ki qasam, main tumhari peeth aur tumhara pait sataaunga jab tak tum kisi ko na lao jo tumhare kahe ki gawaahi de sake. Ubayy bin Ka'b ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, koi bhi tumhare saath (gawaahi dene) khada na ho siwaay hummein se sabse choti umar wale ke. Aur is liye, unhone Abu Sa'id se kaha: Khade ho jao. To main khada hua yahan tak ki main Umar ke paas aaya aur kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna.

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُفَضَّلٍ - حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ،
 بْنُ يَزِيدَ عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا مُوسَى، أَتَى بَابَ عُمَرَ فَاسْتَأْذَنَ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ
 وَاحِدَةٌ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ اسْتَأْذَنَ الثَّانِيَةَ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ ثِنْتَانِ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ اسْتَأْذَنَ الثَّالِثَةَ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ ثَلاَثٌ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ
 انْصَرَفَ فَأَتْبَعَهُ فَرَدَّهُ فَقَالَ إِنْ كَانَ هَذَا شَيْئًا حَفِظْتَهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 فَهَا وَإِلاَّ فَلأَجْعَلَنَّكَ عِظَةً ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ فَأَتَانَا فَقَالَ أَلَمْ تَعْلَمُوا أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ الاِسْتِئْذَانُ ثَلاَثٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَجَعَلُوا يَضْحَكُونَ - قَالَ - فَقُلْتُ أَتَاكُمْ
 أَخُوكُمُ الْمُسْلِمُ قَدْ أُفْزِعَ تَضْحَكُونَ انْطَلِقْ فَأَنَا شَرِيكُكَ فِي هَذِهِ الْعُقُوبَةِ ‏.‏ فَأَتَاهُ فَقَالَ
 هَذَا أَبُو سَعِيدٍ ‏.‏
38.en: Abu Sa'id reported that Abu Musa al-Ash'ari came to the door of 'Umar and sought his permission (to get into his house). Umar said: That is once. He again sought permission for the second time and 'Umar said: It is twice. He again sought permission for the third time and Umar said: It is thrice. He (Abu Musa) then went back. He (Hadrat 'Umar) (sent someone) to pursue him so that he should be brought back. Thereupon he (Hadrat Umar) said: If this act (of yours is in accordance with the command of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) you have preserved in your mind, then it is all right, otherwise (I shall give you such a severe punishment) that it will serve as an example to others. Abu Sa'id said: Then he (Abu Musa) came to us and said: Do you remember Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said this:" Permission is for three times"? They (Companions sitting in that cothpany) began to laugh, whereupon he (Abu Musa) said: There comes to you your Muslim brother who had been perturbed and you laugh. Abu Sa'id said: (Well), you go forth. I shall be your participant in this trouble of yours. So he came to him (Hadrat Umar) and said: Here is Abu Sa'id (to support my statement).
38.hi: Abu Sa'id ne bayan kiya ki Abu Musa al-Ash'ari Umar ke darwaze par aaye aur unse ijazat maangi (unke ghar mein daakhil hone ke liye). Umar ne kaha: Ye ek baar hai. Unhone dobara ijazat maangi doosri baar aur Umar ne kaha: Ye do baar hai. Unhone dobara teesri baar ijazat maangi aur Umar ne kaha: Ye teen baar hai. Woh (Abu Musa) phir wapas chale gaye. Unhone (Hazrat Umar ne) (kisi ko unka) picha karne (bheja) taaki unhe wapas laaya jaaye. Isper unhone (Hazrat Umar ne) kaha: Agar ye amal (tumhara) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke hukum ke mutabik hai jo tumne apne zehan mein rakha hai, to ye theek hai, warna (main tumhe aisi saza dunga) ki ye doosron ke liye ek udaaharan banega. Abu Sa'id ne kaha: Phir woh (Abu Musa) humare paas aaye aur kaha: Kya tumhe yaad hai Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ye kaha tha: "Ijazat teen baar maangi jaani chahiye"? Unhone (us sabha mein baithe sahaba ne) hansna shuru kiya, isper unhone (Abu Musa ne) kaha: Tumhare paas tumhara Musalman bhai aata hai jo pareshaan tha aur tum hanste ho. Abu Sa'id ne kaha: (Achha), tum aage jaao. Main tumhari is mushkil mein tumhaara sahyogi banunga. To woh unke (Hazrat Umar ke) paas aaye aur kaha: Ye rahe Abu Sa'id (mere bayaan ka himayat karne ke liye).

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ 
 أَبِي مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، ح 
 وَحَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ خِرَاشٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَبَابَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ،
 وَسَعِيدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، قَالاَ سَمِعْنَاهُ يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، ‏.‏ بِمَعْنَى
 حَدِيثِ بِشْرِ بْنِ مُفَضَّلٍ عَنْ أَبِي مَسْلَمَةَ، ‏.‏
38.en: This hadith bu been narrated on the authority of Abu Sa'id Khudri through another chain of transmitters.
38.hi: Ye hadees Abu Sa'id Khudri ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

38.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْقَطَّانُ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، حَدَّثَنَا 
 عَطَاءٌ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا مُوسَى، اسْتَأْذَنَ عَلَى عُمَرَ ثَلاَثًا فَكَأَنَّهُ وَجَدَهُ مَشْغُولاً
 فَرَجَعَ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ أَلَمْ تَسْمَعْ صَوْتَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ ائْذَنُوا لَهُ ‏.‏ فَدُعِيَ لَهُ فَقَالَ مَا حَمَلَكَ
 عَلَى مَا صَنَعْتَ قَالَ إِنَّا كُنَّا نُؤْمَرُ بِهَذَا ‏.‏ قَالَ لَتُقِيمَنَّ عَلَى هَذَا بَيِّنَةً أَوْ لأَفْعَلَنَّ ‏.‏ فَخَرَجَ
 فَانْطَلَقَ إِلَى مَجْلِسٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ فَقَالُوا لاَ يَشْهَدُ لَكَ عَلَى هَذَا إِلاَّ أَصْغَرُنَا ‏.‏ فَقَامَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ
 فَقَالَ كُنَّا نُؤْمَرُ بِهَذَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ خَفِيَ عَلَىَّ هَذَا مِنْ أَمْرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 أَلْهَانِي عَنْهُ الصَّفْقُ بِالأَسْوَاقِ ‏.‏
38.en: 'Ubaid b. Umair reported that Abu Musa brought permission from Umar (to enter the house) three times, and finding him busy came back, whereupon Umar said (to the Inmates of his house): Did you not hear the voice of 'Abdullah b. Qais (the Kunya of Abu Musa Ash'ari)? He was called back. and he (Hadrat 'Umar) said: What did prompt you to do it? Thereupon, he said: This is how we have been commanded to act. He (Hadrat 'Umar) said: Bring evidence (in support of) it, otherwise I shall deal (strictly) with you. So he (Abu Musa) set out and came to the meeting of the Ansar and asked them to bear witness before hadrat Umar about this. They (the Companions present there) said: None but the youngest amongst us would bear out this fact. So Abu Sa'id Khudri (who was the youngest one in that company) said: We have been commanded to do so (while visiting the house of other people). Thereupon 'Umar said: This command of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had remained hidden from me up till now due to (my) business in the market.
38.hi: Ubaid bin Umair ne bayan kiya ki Abu Musa Umar se (ghar mein daakhil hone ki) ijazat teen baar maangte the, aur unhe masroof paakar wapas chale gaye, isper Umar ne kaha (apne ghar ke logon se): Kya tumne Abdullah bin Qais (Abu Musa Ash'ari ki kunya) ki aawaaz nahi suni? Unhe wapas bulaaya gaya, aur unhone (Hazrat Umar ne) kaha: Tumhe aisa karne ke liye kis baat ne preit kiya? Isper unhone kaha: Humein aisa hi amal karne ka hukum diya gaya hai. Unhone (Hazrat Umar ne) kaha: Iska saboot lao, warna main tumhare saath (sakhti se) pesh aaunga. Is liye woh (Abu Musa) nikle aur Ansar ki sabha mein aaye aur unse guzaarish ki ki woh Hazrat Umar ke saamne iski gawaahi dein. Unhone (us sabha mein maujood sahaba ne) kaha: Sirf hummein se sabse choti umar wala hi is baat ki gawaahi dega. To Abu Sa'id Khudri (jo us sabha mein sabse choti umar ke the) ne kaha: Humein aisa hi amal karne ka hukum diya gaya hai (jab hum doosron ke ghar jaayein). Isper Umar ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka ye hukum mujhse ab tak chhupa raha bazaar mein (meri) masroofiyat ki wajah se.

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنُ بْنُ حُرَيْثٍ، حَدَّثَنَا 
 النَّضْرُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ شُمَيْلٍ - قَالاَ جَمِيعًا حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ
 فِي حَدِيثِ النَّضْرِ أَلْهَانِي عَنْهُ الصَّفْقُ بِالأَسْوَاقِ ‏.‏
38.en: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ibn Juraij, but there is no mention of the words" business in the market".
38.hi: Ye hadees Ibn Juraij ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin ismein "bazaar mein masroofiyat" ke alfaazon ka koi zikr nahi hai.

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنُ بْنُ حُرَيْثٍ أَبُو عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا طَلْحَةُ بْنُ،
 يَحْيَى عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى الأَشْعَرِيِّ، قَالَ جَاءَ أَبُو مُوسَى إِلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ
 فَقَالَ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ هَذَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ قَيْسٍ ‏.‏ فَلَمْ يَأْذَنْ لَهُ فَقَالَ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ هَذَا أَبُو مُوسَى
 السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ هَذَا الأَشْعَرِيُّ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ فَقَالَ رُدُّوا عَلَىَّ رُدُّوا عَلَىَّ ‏.‏ فَجَاءَ فَقَالَ يَا أَبَا
 مُوسَى مَا رَدَّكَ كُنَّا فِي شُغْلٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏
"‏ الاِسْتِئْذَانُ
 ثَلاَثٌ فَإِنْ أُذِنَ لَكَ وَإِلاَّ فَارْجِعْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ لَتَأْتِيَنِّي عَلَى هَذَا بِبَيِّنَةٍ وَإِلاَّ فَعَلْتُ وَفَعَلْتُ ‏.‏ فَذَهَبَ
 أَبُو مُوسَى قَالَ عُمَرُ إِنْ وَجَدَ بَيِّنَةً تَجِدُوهُ عِنْدَ الْمِنْبَرِ عَشِيَّةً وَإِنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ بَيِّنَةً فَلَمْ تَجِدُوهُ
 ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا أَنْ جَاءَ بِالْعَشِيِّ وَجَدُوهُ قَالَ يَا أَبَا مُوسَى مَا تَقُولُ أَقَدْ وَجَدْتَ قَالَ نَعَمْ أُبَىَّ بْنَ
 كَعْبٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ عَدْلٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ يَا أَبَا الطُّفَيْلِ مَا يَقُولُ هَذَا قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم يَقُولُ ذَلِكَ يَا ابْنَ الْخَطَّابِ فَلاَ تَكُونَنَّ عَذَابًا عَلَى أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم ‏.‏ قَالَ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ إِنَّمَا سَمِعْتُ شَيْئًا فَأَحْبَبْتُ أَنْ أَتَثَبَّتَ ‏.‏
38.en: Abu Musa Ash'ari reported that he went to 'Umar b. Khattab and greeted him by saying: As-Salamu-'Alaikum, here is 'Abdullah b. Qais, but he did not permit him (to get in). He (Abu Musa Ash'ari) again greeted him with as-Salamu-'Alaikum and said: Here is Abu Musa, but he (Hadrat 'Umar) did not permit him (to get in). He again said: As-Salam-u-'Alaikum, (and said) here is Ash'ari, (then receiving no response he came back). He (Hadrat 'Umar) said: Bring him back to me, bring him back to me So he went there (in the presence of Hadrat 'Umar) and he said to him: Abu Musa, what made you go back, while we were busy in some work? He said: I heard Allah's Messenger (may. peace be upon him) as saying: Permission should be sought thrice. And if you are permitted, (then get in), otherwise go back. He said: Bring witness to this fact, otherwise I shall do this and that, i. e. I shall punish you. Abu Musa went away and 'Umar said to him (on his departure): It he (Abu Musa) finds a witness he should meet him by the side of the pulpit in the evening and it he does not find a witness you would not find him there. When it was evening he (Hadrat 'Umar) found him (Abu Musa) there. He (Hadrat 'Umar) said: Abu Musa, have you been able to find a witness to what you have said? He said: Yes. Here is Ubayy bin Ka'b, whereupon he (Hadrat 'Umar) said: Yes, he is an authentic (witness). He (Hadrat 'Umar) said: Abu Tufail (the kunya of Ubayy b. Ka'b), what does he (Abu Musa say? Thereupon he said: Ibn Khattab, I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying so. Do not prove to be a hard (task-master) for the Companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), whereupon he Hadrat 'Umar said: Hallowed be Allah. I had heard something (in this connection), but I wished it to be established (as an undeniable fact).
38.hi: Abu Musa Ash'ari ne bayan kiya ki woh Umar bin Khattab ke paas gaye aur unhe ye kehte hue salaam kiya: As-Salamu-Alaikum, ye rahe Abdullah bin Qais, lekin unhone unhe (andar aane ki) ijazat nahi di. Unhone (Abu Musa Ash'ari ne) dobara unhe As-Salamu-Alaikum kehkar salaam kiya aur kaha: Ye rahe Abu Musa, lekin unhone (Hazrat Umar ne) unhe (andar aane ki) ijazat nahi di. Unhone phir kaha: As-Salamu-Alaikum, (aur kaha) ye rahe Ash'ari, (phir koi jawaab na paakar woh wapas chale gaye). Unhone (Hazrat Umar ne) kaha: Unhe mere paas wapas lao, unhe mere paas wapas lao. To woh wahan (Hazrat Umar ki maujoodgi mein) gaye aur unhone (Umar ne) unse kaha: Abu Musa, kya baat thi ki tum wapas chale gaye, jabki hum kisi kaam mein masroof the? Unhone kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ijazat teen baar maangi jaani chahiye. Aur agar tumhe ijazat mil jaaye, (to andar jao), warna wapas jao. Unhone kaha: Iska saboot lao, warna main aisa aisa karunga, yaani main tumhe saza dunga. Abu Musa chale gaye aur Umar ne unse (unke jaate waqt) kaha: Agar woh (Abu Musa) koi gawaah dhoondh lein, to unhe unse shaam ko mimbar ke pas milna chahiye aur agar unhe koi gawaah nahi milta to tum unhe wahan nahi paaoge. Jab shaam hui unhone (Hazrat Umar ne) unhe (Abu Musa ko) wahan paaya. Unhone (Hazrat Umar ne) kaha: Abu Musa, kya tumhe apne kahe ka gawaah mil gaya? Unhone kaha: Haan. Ye rahe Ubayy bin Ka'b, isper unhone (Hazrat Umar ne) kaha: Haan, woh ek pramanik (gawaah) hain. Unhone (Hazrat Umar ne) kaha: Abu Tufail (Ubayy bin Ka'b ki kunya), (Abu Musa) kya kehte hain? Isper unhone kaha: Ibn Khattab, maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko aisa hi kehte suna. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke sahaba ke liye ek sakht (kaam-daar) mat bano, isper unhone Hazrat Umar ne kaha: Allah muqaddas hai. Maine (is silsile mein) kuch suna tha, lekin main chaahta tha ki ise ek muayyan tathya ke soorat mein sthapit kiya jaaye.

38.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبَانٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ هَاشِمٍ، عَنْ طَلْحَةَ،
 بْنِ يَحْيَى بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ فَقَالَ يَا أَبَا الْمُنْذِرِ آنْتَ سَمِعْتَ هَذَا مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ نَعَمْ فَلاَ تَكُنْ يَا ابْنَ الْخَطَّابِ عَذَابًا عَلَى أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ مِنْ قَوْلِ عُمَرَ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ وَمَا بَعْدَهُ ‏.‏
38.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Talha b. Yahya with the same chain of transmitters but with this variation of wording: He (Hadrat 'Umar) said: Abu Mundhir (the Kunya of Ubayy b. Ka'b), did you hear this from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? Thereupon he said: Yes. and he further said: Ibn Khattab, do not be a torment for the Companions of Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him). No mention has, however, been made of the words of 'Umar:" Hallowed be Allah" and what follows subsequently.
38.hi: Ye hadees Talha bin Yahya ki sanad se isi sanad se is antar ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai: Unhone (Hazrat Umar ne) kaha: Abu Mundhir (Ubayy bin Ka'b ki Kunya), kya aapne ise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna? Isper unhone kaha: Haan. Aur unhone aage kaha: Ibn Khattab, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke sahaba ke liye koi azaab mat bano. Umar ke alfaazon ka: "Allah muqaddas hai" aur jo iske baad aata hai iska koi zikr nahi kiya gaya hai.

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ 
 مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ أَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَدَعَوْتُ
 فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ هَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ أَنَا ‏.‏ قَالَ فَخَرَجَ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ أَنَا
 أَنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
38.en: Jabir b. Abdullah reported: I came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and called him (with a view to seeking permission). whereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Who is it? I said: It is I. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) came out saying: It is I. it is I.
38.hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unhe pukaara (ijazat maangne ke iraade se), isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Kaun hai? Maine kaha: Main hoon. Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) bahar aakar kaha: Main hoon, main hoon.

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي بَكْرٍ - قَالَ يَحْيَى
 أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا - وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ،
 اللَّهِ قَالَ اسْتَأْذَنْتُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ هَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ أَنَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ
 النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَنَا أَنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
38.en: Jabir b. Abdullah reported: I sought permission from Allah's Messenger (may peace be upoh him) to see him. He said: Who is it? I said: It is I. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: It is I. it is I (these words lead me to no conclusion).
38.hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Maine unse milne ke liye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ijazat maangi. Unhone kaha: Kaun hai? Maine kaha: Main hoon. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Main hoon, main hoon (in alfaazon se mujhe koi nishkarsh nahi mila).

38.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا النَّضْرُ بْنُ شُمَيْلٍ، وَأَبُو عَامِرٍ الْعَقَدِيُّ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا 
 مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنِي وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، كُلُّهُمْ
 عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِهِمْ كَأَنَّهُ كَرِهَ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏
38.en: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Shu'ba with a slight variation of wording and that is: The Prophet (ﷺ) uttered these words: It is I. it is I." in the manner as if he disapproved of this.
38.hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se alfaazon mein halke antar ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai aur woh hai: Nabi (SAW) ne ye alfaaz is tarah kahe: "Main hoon, main hoon." jaise unhone isse napasand kiya ho.

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِيَحْيَى -
 ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّ سَهْلَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيَّ، أَخْبَرَهُ 
 أَنَّ رَجُلاً اطَّلَعَ فِي جُحْرٍ فِي بَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَمَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم مِدْرًى يَحُكُّ بِهِ رَأْسَهُ فَلَمَّا رَآهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏
 لَوْ أَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَنْظُرُنِي لَطَعَنْتُ بِهِ فِي عَيْنِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏
 إِنَّمَا جُعِلَ الإِذْنُ مِنْ أَجْلِ الْبَصَرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
38.en: Sahl b. Sa'd as-Sa'id reported that a person peeped through the hole of the door of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and at that time Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had with him a scratching instrument with which he had been scratching his head. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw him. he said: If I were to know that you had been peeping through the door, I would have thrust that into your eyes, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Permission is needed as a protection against glance.
38.hi: Sahl bin Sa'd as-Sa'id ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke darwaze ke chhed se jhaanka, aur us waqt Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas khujaane ka upkaran tha jisse woh apna sar khuja rahe the. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne use dekha, unhone kaha: Agar mujhe pata hota ki tum jhaank rahe ho, to main use tumhari aankhon mein ghusaa deta, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ijazat (jhaankne se) hifaazat ke soorat mein zaroori hai.

38.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّأَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَجُلاً اطَّلَعَ مِنْ جُحْرٍ فِي بَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله
 عليه وسلم وَمَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِدْرًى يُرَجِّلُ بِهِ رَأْسَهُ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ لَوْ أَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَنْظُرُ طَعَنْتُ بِهِ فِي عَيْنِكَ إِنَّمَا جَعَلَ اللَّهُ الإِذْنَ
 مِنْ أَجْلِ الْبَصَرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
38.en: Sahl b. Sa'd as-Sa'idi reported that a person peeped through the hole of the door of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he had with him some pointed thing with which he had been adjusting (the hair of his head). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him: If I were to know that you had been peeping. I would have thrust it in your eyes. Allah has prescribed seeking permission because of protection against glance.
38.hi: Sahl bin Sa'd as-Sa'idi ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke darwaze ke chhed se jhaanka aur unke paas koi nukili cheez thi jisse woh (apne sar ke baalon ko) theek kar rahe the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha: Agar mujhe pata hota ki tum jhaank rahe ho, to main ise tumhari aankhon mein ghusaa deta. Allah ne (jhaankne se) hifaazat ke soorat mein ijazat maangna muqarrar kiya hai.

38.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ،
 قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ،
 حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَحْوَ
 حَدِيثِ اللَّيْثِ وَيُونُسَ ‏.‏
38.en: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Sahl b. Sa'd as-Sa'idi with a slight variation of wording.
38.hi: Ye hadees Sahl bin Sa'd as-Sa'idi ki sanad se alfaazon mein halke antar ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ فُضَيْلُ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ
 لِيَحْيَى وَأَبِي كَامِلٍ - قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ،
 اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، اطَّلَعَ مِنْ بَعْضِ حُجَرِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم فَقَامَ إِلَيْهِ بِمِشْقَصٍ أَوْ مَشَاقِصَ فَكَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 يَخْتِلُهُ لِيَطْعُنَهُ ‏.‏
38.en: Anas b. Malik reported that a person peeped in some of the holes (in the doors) of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (and he found him) standing up (lifting) an arrow or some arrows. The narrator said: I perceived as if Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was going to pierce (his eyes).
38.hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke darwaze ke kuch chhedon mein se jhaanka (aur usne unhe paaya) ek teer ya kuch teer uthaaye khade hue. Raawi ne kaha: Mujhe laga jaise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) (uski aankhein) chheed dene wale the.

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ 
 النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ مَنِ اطَّلَعَ فِي بَيْتِ قَوْمٍ بِغَيْرِ إِذْنِهِمْ فَقَدْ حَلَّ لَهُمْ أَنْ يَفْقَئُوا
 عَيْنَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
38.en: Abu Huraira reported having heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say: He who peeped into the house of people without their consent, it is permissible for them to put out his eyes.
38.hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jo kisi logon ke ghar mein unki sehmati ke bina jhaanka, unke liye jaayez hai ki woh uski aankhein nikaal den.

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ،
 أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ لَوْ أَنَّ رَجُلاً اطَّلَعَ عَلَيْكَ بِغَيْرِ إِذْنٍ فَخَذَفْتَهُ
 بِحَصَاةٍ فَفَقَأْتَ عَيْنَهُ مَا كَانَ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ جُنَاحٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
38.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If a person were to cast a glance in your (house) without permission, and you had in your hand a staff and you would have thrust that in his eyes, there is no harm for you.
38.hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar koi shakhs tumhare (ghar) mein bina ijazat ke jhaake, aur tumhare haath mein ek lathi ho aur tum use uski aankhon mein ghusaa do, tumhe koi nuksaan nahi hai.

38.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ،
 حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ يُونُسَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ،
 أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ جَرِيرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ نَظَرِ الْفُجَاءَةِ فَأَمَرَنِي أَنْ أَصْرِفَ بَصَرِي ‏.‏
38.en: Jarir b. 'Abdullah reported: I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about the sudden glance (that is cast) on the face (of a non-Mahram). He commanded me that I should turn away my eyes.
38.hi: Jarir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se achaanak nazar padne ke baare mein poocha (jo kisi ghair-mahram ke chehre par padti hai). Unhone mujhe apni aankhein modne ka hukum diya.

38.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، وَقَالَ، إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَكِيعٌ،
 حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ يُونُسَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
38.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Yunus through another chain of transmitters.
38.hi: Ye hadees Yunus ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

39.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي عُقْبَةُ بْنُ مُكْرَمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ،
 مَرْزُوقٍ حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي زِيَادٌ، أَنَّ ثَابِتًا، مَوْلَى عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ
 أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ يُسَلِّمُ الرَّاكِبُ
 عَلَى الْمَاشِي وَالْمَاشِي عَلَى الْقَاعِدِ وَالْقَلِيلُ عَلَى الْكَثِيرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
39.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The rider should first greet the pedestrian, and the pedestrian the one who is seated and a small group should greet a larger group (with as-Salam-u-'Alaikum).
39.hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Sawaar ko pehle paidal chalne wale ko salaam karna chahiye, aur paidal chalne wale ko baithe hue shakhs ko, aur ek chhoti toli ko ek badi toli ko salaam karna chahiye (as-Salam-u-Alaikum kehkar).

39.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا 
 عُثْمَانُ بْنُ حَكِيمٍ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ كُنَّا
 قُعُودًا بِالأَفْنِيَةِ نَتَحَدَّثُ فَجَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَامَ عَلَيْنَا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا لَكُمْ
 وَلِمَجَالِسِ الصُّعُدَاتِ اجْتَنِبُوا مَجَالِسَ الصُّعُدَاتِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْنَا إِنَّمَا قَعَدْنَا لِغَيْرِ مَا بَاسٍ قَعَدْنَا
 نَتَذَاكَرُ وَنَتَحَدَّثُ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِمَّا لاَ فَأَدُّوا حَقَّهَا غَضُّ الْبَصَرِ وَرَدُّ السَّلاَمِ وَحُسْنُ الْكَلاَمِ ‏"‏
 ‏.‏
39.en: Abu Talha reported: While we were sitting in front of the houses and talking amongst ourselves, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) happened to come there. He stood by us and said: What about you and your meetings on the paths? Avoid these meetings on the paths. We said: We were sitting here without (any intention of doing harm to the passers-by) ; we are sitting to discuss matters and to hold conversation amongst ourselves. Thereupon he said: If there is no help (for you but to sit on these paths), then give the paths their rights and these are lowering of the gaze, exchanging of greetings and good conversation.
39.hi: Abu Talha ne bayan kiya: Jab hum gharon ke saamne baithe aapas mein baat kar rahe the, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) wahan aaye. Woh humare paas khade hue aur kaha: Ye kya hai ki tum raaston par apni sabhaen karte ho? In raaston par sabha karne se bacho. Humne kaha: Hum yahan (raahgeeron ko koi nuksaan pahunchaane ki koi niyat ke bina) baithe hain; hum maamlon par charcha karne aur aapas mein baat karne baithe hain. Isper unhone kaha: Agar isse bachna nahi ho sakta (aur tumhe in raaston par baithna hi hai), to raaston ke haqoq poore karo aur woh hain aankhon ko neeche rakhna, salaam exchange karna aur achhi baatchit.

39.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ،
 بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِيَّاكُمْ وَالْجُلُوسَ
 بِالطُّرُقَاتِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا لَنَا بُدٌّ مِنْ مَجَالِسِنَا نَتَحَدَّثُ فِيهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ رَسُولُ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِذَا أَبَيْتُمْ إِلاَّ الْمَجْلِسَ فَأَعْطُوا الطَّرِيقَ حَقَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا وَمَا
 حَقُّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ غَضُّ الْبَصَرِ وَكَفُّ الأَذَى وَرَدُّ السَّلاَمِ وَالأَمْرُ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَالنَّهْىُ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ ‏"‏
 ‏.‏
39.en: Abu Sa'id Khudri reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Avoid sitting on the paths. They (the Companions) said: Allah's Messenger, we cannot help but holding our meetings (in these paths) and discuss matters (there). Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: If you insist on holding meetings, then give the path its due right. They said: What are its due rights? Upon this he said: Lowering the gaze, refraining from doing harm, exchanging of greetings. commanding of good and forbidding from evil.
39.hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Raaston par baithne se bacho. Unhone (sahaba ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, hum bina apni sabhaen (in raaston par) kiye reh nahi sakte aur wahan maamlon par charcha karne se bhi. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Agar tum sabha karne par ade ho, to raaste ko uska munasib haq do. Unhone kaha: Uska haq kya hai? Isper unhone kaha: Nazar neeche rakhna, koi nuksaan pahunchaane se bachna, salaam exchange karna, achhaai ka hukum dena aur burai se rokna.

39.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْمَدَنِيُّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ،
 رَافِعٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَعْدٍ - كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، بِهَذَا
 الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
39.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zaid b. Aslam with the same chain of transmitters.
39.hi: Ye hadees Zaid bin Aslam ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

39.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنِ 
 ابْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ حَقُّ الْمُسْلِمِ عَلَى
 الْمُسْلِمِ خَمْسٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ح 
 وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ،
 الْمُسَيَّبِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ خَمْسٌ تَجِبُ لِلْمُسْلِمِ
 عَلَى أَخِيهِ رَدُّ السَّلاَمِ وَتَشْمِيتُ الْعَاطِسِ وَإِجَابَةُ الدَّعْوَةِ وَعِيَادَةُ الْمَرِيضِ وَاتِّبَاعُ الْجَنَائِزِ
 ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ كَانَ مَعْمَرٌ يُرْسِلُ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ وَأَسْنَدَهُ مَرَّةً عَنِ ابْنِ
 الْمُسَيَّبِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ‏.‏
39.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Five are the rights of a Muslim over his brother: responding to salutation, saying Yarhamuk Allah when anybody sneezes and says al-Hamdulillah, visiting the sick. following the bier. ' Abd al-Razzaq said that this hadith has been transmitted as mursal hadith from Zuhri and he then substantiated it on the authority of Ibn Musayyib.
39.hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek Musalman ke apne bhai par paanch haq hain: salaam ka jawaab dena, jab koi cheenkta hai aur al-Hamdulillah kehta hai to Yarhamuk Allah kehna, bimaar se milne jaana, janaaze ke saath jaana. Abd al-Razzaq ne kaha ki ye hadees Zuhri se mursal hadees ke soorat mein riwayat ki gayi hai aur unhone phir ise Ibn Musayyib ki sanad se pushti ki.

39.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ
 جَعْفَرٍ - عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ
 ‏"‏ حَقُّ الْمُسْلِمِ عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِ سِتٌّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قِيلَ مَا هُنَّ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا لَقِيتَهُ فَسَلِّمْ عَلَيْهِ
 وَإِذَا دَعَاكَ فَأَجِبْهُ وَإِذَا اسْتَنْصَحَكَ فَانْصَحْ لَهُ وَإِذَا عَطَسَ فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ فَسَمِّتْهُ وَإِذَا مَرِضَ
 فَعُدْهُ وَإِذَا مَاتَ فَاتَّبِعْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
39.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Six are the rights of a Muslim over another Muslim. It was said to him: Allah's Messenger, what are these? Thereupon he said: When you meet him, offer him greetings;when he invites you to a feast accept it. when he seeks your council give him, and when he sneezes and says:" All praise is due to Allah," you say Yarhamuk Allah (may Allah show mercy to you) ; and when he fails ill visit him; and when he dies follow his bier.
39.hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ek Musalman ke doosre Musalman par chhe haq hain. Unse poocha gaya: Allah ke Rasool, woh kya hain? Isper unhone kaha: Jab tum unse milo, unhe salaam karo; jab woh tumhe khaane par bulaayein, ise qubool karo; jab woh tumse salaah maangein use do, aur jab woh cheenken aur kahein: "Sab tareef Allah ke liye hai," tum Yarhamuk Allah kaho (Allah tum par rehmat kare); aur jab woh bimaar padein unse milne jao; aur jab unka intiqaal ho jaaye unke janaaze ke saath jaao.

39.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ 
 أَنَسًا، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ح 
 وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ سَالِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنْ 
 جَدِّهِ، أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ إِذَا سَلَّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلُ الْكِتَابِ
 فَقُولُوا وَعَلَيْكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
39.en: Anas b. Malik reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When the People of the Book offer you salutations, you should say: The same to you.
39.hi: Anas bin Malik ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Jab Kitaab waale (Yahudi ya Isaayi) tumhe salaam karein, tumhe kehna chahiye: Tumhe bhi wahi.

39.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ،
 - يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْحَارِثِ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ
 لَهُمَا - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ قَتَادَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّعليه وسلم قَالُوا لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِنَّ أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ يُسَلِّمُونَ
 عَلَيْنَا فَكَيْفَ نَرُدُّ عَلَيْهِمْ قَالَ ‏
"‏ قُولُوا وَعَلَيْكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
39.en: Anas reported that the Companions of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said to him: The People. of the Book offer us salutations (by saying as-Salamu- 'Alaikum). How should we reciprocate them? Thereupon he said: Say: Wa 'Alaikum (and upon you too).
