39.en: 'A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) granted sanction to the members of a family of the Ansar for invocation (for removing the effects) of the poison of the scorpion.
39.hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ansar ke ek khaandaan ke sadasyon ko bicchhu ke zeher (ke asar ko hataane) ke liye jhaad-phoonk karne ki ijazat di thi.

39.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ أَبِي
 عُمَرَ - قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ رَبِّهِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا اشْتَكَى الإِنْسَانُ الشَّىْءَ مِنْهُ أَوْ كَانَتْ بِهِ قَرْحَةٌ أَوْ جَرْحٌ قَالَ
 النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِإِصْبَعِهِ هَكَذَا وَوَضَعَ سُفْيَانُ سَبَّابَتَهُ بِالأَرْضِ ثُمَّ رَفَعَهَا ‏"‏
 بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ تُرْبَةُ أَرْضِنَا بِرِيقَةِ بَعْضِنَا لِيُشْفَى بِهِ سَقِيمُنَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ
 ‏"‏ يُشْفَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ زُهَيْرٌ ‏"‏ لِيُشْفَى سَقِيمُنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
39.en: 'A'isha reported that when any person fell ill with a disease or he had any ailment or he had any injury, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) placed his forefinger upon the ground and then lifted it by reciting the name of Allah. (and said): The dust of our ground with the saliva of any one of us would serve as a means whereby our illness would be cured with the sanction of Allah. This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ibn Abu Shaiba and Zubair with a slight variation of wording.
39.hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki jab koi shakhs kisi beemari se pareshaan hota ya koi takleef hoti ya use koi chot lagti, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apni tarjani ungli zameen par rakhte aur phir use uThAte Allah ka naam padhte hue. (Aur kehte): Humari zameen ki mitti, hummein se kisi ke lar ke saath, humari beemari theek karne ka zariya hogi Allah ki ijazat se. Ye hadees Ibn Abu Shaiba aur Zubair ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

39.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ - قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ
 أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُمَا - حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، عَنْ مِسْعَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا 
 مَعْبَدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شَدَّادٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَأْمُرُهَا
 أَنْ تَسْتَرْقِيَ مِنَ الْعَيْنِ ‏.‏
39.en: 'A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded the use of invocation for curing the influence of an evil eye.
39.hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne buri nazar ke asar ke ilaaj ke liye jhaad-phoonk ka istemaal karne ka hukum diya.

39.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ
 مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
39.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Mis'ar with the same chain of transmitters.
39.hi: Ye hadees Mis'ar ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

39.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مَعْبَدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ،
 شَدَّادٍ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَأْمُرُنِي أَنْ أَسْتَرْقِيَ مِنَ
 الْعَيْنِ ‏.‏
39.en: 'A'isha reported: Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) commanded me that I should make use of invocation for curing the influence of an evil eye.
39.hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe hukum diya ki main buri nazar ke asar ke ilaaj ke liye jhaad-phoonk ka istemaal karun.

39.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ الأَحْوَلِ، عَنْ يُوسُفَ بْنِ،
 عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، فِي الرُّقَى قَالَ رُخِّصَ فِي الْحُمَةِ وَالنَّمْلَةِ وَالْعَيْنِ ‏.‏
39.en: Anas b. Malik reported in connection with invocation that he had been granted sanction (to use invocation as a remedy) for the sting of the scorpion and for curing small pustules and dispelling the influence of an evil eye.
39.hi: Anas bin Malik ne jhaad-phoonk ke silsile mein bayan kiya ki unhe (jhaad-phoonk ke istemaal ki) ijazat mili thi bicchhu ke daans ke liye aur choti phunsiyon ke ilaaj aur buri nazar ke asar ko duur karne ke liye.

39.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ،
 بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ صَالِحٍ - كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ عَاصِمٍ،
 عَنْ يُوسُفَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ رَخَّصَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الرُّقْيَةِ
 مِنَ الْعَيْنِ وَالْحُمَةِ وَالنَّمْلَةِ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ سُفْيَانَ يُوسُفُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ ‏.‏
39.en: Anas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) granted him sanction to use invocation (as a cure) for the influence of the evil eye, the sting of the scorpion and small pustules.
39.hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe buri nazar ke asar, bicchhu ke daans, aur choti phunsiyon ke ilaaj ke liye jhaad-phoonk istemaal karne ki ijazat di.

39.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ،
 الزُّبَيْدِيُّ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لِجَارِيَةٍ فِي بَيْتِ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ
 زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَأَى بِوَجْهِهَا سَفْعَةً فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ بِهَا نَظْرَةٌ فَاسْتَرْقُوا لَهَا
 ‏"‏ ‏.‏ يَعْنِي بِوَجْهِهَا صُفْرَةً ‏.‏
39.en: Umm Salama, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to a small girl in the house of Umm Salama that he had been seeing on her face black stains and told her that that was due to the influence of an evil eye, and he asked that she should be cured with the help of invocation (hoping) that her face should become spotless.
39.hi: Umm Salama, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Umm Salama ke ghar ki ek choti larki se kaha ki unhone uske chehre par kaale daag dekhe hain aur usse kaha ki ye buri nazar ke asar ki wajah se hai, aur unhone kaha ki uska jhaad-phoonk se ilaaj karwaaya jaaye (ye ummeed karte hue) ki uska chehra daag-rahit ho jaaye.

39.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي عُقْبَةُ بْنُ مُكْرَمٍ الْعَمِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي 
 أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ رَخَّصَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لآلِ حَزْمٍ
 فِي رُقْيَةِ الْحَيَّةِ وَقَالَ لأَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ عُمَيْسٍ ‏"‏ مَا لِي أَرَى أَجْسَامَ بَنِي أَخِي ضَارِعَةً تُصِيبُهُمُ
 الْحَاجَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ لاَ وَلَكِنِ الْعَيْنُ تُسْرِعُ إِلَيْهِمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ارْقِيهِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَعَرَضْتُ عَلَيْهِ
 فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ارْقِيهِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
39.en: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) granted sanction to the family of Hazm for invocation (in mitigating the effect of the poison of) the snake, and, he said -to Asma' daughter of 'Umais: What is this that I see the children of my brother lean? Are they not fed properly? She said: No, but they fall under the influence of an evil eve. He said: Use invocation. She recited (the words of invocation before him), whereupon he (by approving them) said: Yes, use this invocation for them.
39.hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Hazm khaandaan ko saap (ke zeher ke prabhaav ko kam karne) ke liye jhaad-phoonk karne ki ijazat di, aur unhone Asma, Umais ki beti, se kaha: Ye kya hai ki main dekh raha hoon ki mere bhai ke bachche dubla hain? Kya unhe theek se khilaaya nahi jaata? Unhone kaha: Nahi, lekin unpar buri nazar ka asar padhta hai. Unhone kaha: Jhaad-phoonk istemaal karo. Unhone (unke saamne jhaad-phoonk ke alfaaz) padhe, isper unhone (ise manzoori dete hue) kaha: Haan, unke liye ye jhaad-phoonk istemaal karo.

39.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو
 الزُّبَيْرِ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ أَرْخَصَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي رُقْيَةِ الْحَيَّةِ
 لِبَنِي عَمْرٍو ‏.‏ 
 قَالَ أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ وَسَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ لَدَغَتْ رَجُلاً مِنَّا عَقْرَبٌ وَنَحْنُ
 جُلُوسٌ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَرْقِي قَالَ ‏
"‏ مَنِ
 اسْتَطَاعَ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ يَنْفَعَ أَخَاهُ فَلْيَفْعَلْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
39.en: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) granted a special sanction for invocation in case of the snake poison to a tribe of 'Amr. Abu Zubair said: I heard Jabir b. 'Abdullah as saying that the scorpion stung one of us as we were sitting with Allah's Messenger (may peace upon him). A person said: Allah's Messenger, I use invocation (for curing the effect of sting), whereupon he said: He who is competent amongst you to benefit his brother should do so.
39.hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Amr qabile ko saap ke zeher ke maamle mein jhaad-phoonk ki khaas ijazat di. Abu Zubair ne kaha: Maine Jabir bin Abdullah ko ye kehte suna ki ek bicchhu ne hummein se ek ko daansa jab hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath baithe the. Ek shakhs ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, main jhaad-phoonk istemaal karta hoon (daans ke asar ko theek karne ke liye), isper unhone kaha: Tum mein se jo apne bhai ko faayda pahunchaane mein saksham ho use aisa karna chahiye.

39.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى الأُمَوِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
 مِثْلَهُ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ أَرْقِيهِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ أَرْقِي ‏.‏
39.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Juraij with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
39.hi: Ye hadees Ibn Juraij ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

39.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ،
 عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ كَانَ لِي خَالٌ يَرْقِي مِنَ الْعَقْرَبِ فَنَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الرُّقَى - قَالَ - فَأَتَاهُ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّكَ نَهَيْتَ عَنِ الرُّقَى وَأَنَا
 أَرْقِي مِنَ الْعَقْرَبِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ مَنِ اسْتَطَاعَ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ يَنْفَعَ أَخَاهُ فَلْيَفْعَلْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
39.en: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported I had a maternal uncle who treated the sting of the scorpion with the help of invocation. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade invocation. He came to him and said: Allah's Messenger, you forbade to practise invocation, whereas I employ it for curing the sting of the scorpion, whereupon he said: He who amongst you is capable of employing it as a means to do good should do that.
39.hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Mera ek maama tha jo bicchhu ke daans ka ilaaj jhaad-phoonk ki madad se karta tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne jhaad-phoonk se mana kiya. Woh unke paas aaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aapne jhaad-phoonk karne se mana kiya, jabki main ise bicchhu ke daans ke ilaaj ke liye istemaal karta hoon, isper unhone kaha: Tum mein se jo isse achhaai ke sadhan ke soorat mein istemaal karne mein saksham ho, use aisa karna chahiye.

39.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ
 ‏.‏
39.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters.
39.hi: Ye hadees A'mash ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

39.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ،
 قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الرُّقَى فَجَاءَ آلُ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ إِلَى رَسُولِ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّهُ كَانَتْ عِنْدَنَا رُقْيَةٌ نَرْقِي بِهَا مِنَ الْعَقْرَبِ
 وَإِنَّكَ نَهَيْتَ عَنِ الرُّقَى ‏.‏ قَالَ فَعَرَضُوهَا عَلَيْهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ مَا أَرَى بَأْسًا مَنِ اسْتَطَاعَ مِنْكُمْ
 أَنْ يَنْفَعَ أَخَاهُ فَلْيَنْفَعْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
39.en: Jabir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited invocation. Then the people of Amr b. Hazm came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: We know an invocation which we use for curing the sting of the scorpion but you have prohibited it. They recited (the words of invocation) before him, whereupon he said: I do not see any harm (in it), so he who amongst you is competent to do good to his brother should do that.
39.hi: Jabir ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne jhaad-phoonk se mana kiya. Phir Amr bin Hazm ke log Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: Humein ek jhaad-phoonk pata hai jise hum bicchhu ke daans ke ilaaj ke liye istemaal karte hain lekin aapne ise mana kiya hai. Unhone (unke saamne jhaad-phoonk ke alfaaz) padhe, isper unhone kaha: Mujhe ismein koi nuksaan nazar nahi aata, is liye tum mein se jo apne bhai ki achhaai karne mein saksham ho use aisa karna chahiye.

39.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ،
 بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَوْفِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ الأَشْجَعِيِّ، قَالَ كُنَّا نَرْقِي فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ فَقُلْنَا يَا
 رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَيْفَ تَرَى فِي ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ اعْرِضُوا عَلَىَّ رُقَاكُمْ لاَ بَأْسَ بِالرُّقَى مَا لَمْ يَكُنْ
 فِيهِ شِرْكٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
39.en: 'Auf b. Malik Ashja'i reported We practised incantation in the pre-Islamic days and we said: Allah's Messenger, what is your opinion about it? He said: Let me know your invocation and said: There is no harm in the invocation as long as there is no polytheism in it.
39.hi: Auf bin Malik Ashja'i ne bayan kiya: Hum Islam se pehle ke daur mein jhaad-phoonk (jhaad-phoonk) karte the aur humne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, iske baare mein aapki kya raay hai? Unhone kaha: Mujhe apni jhaad-phoonk bataao, aur kaha: Jhaad-phoonk mein koi harj nahi hai jab tak ismein koi shirk na ho.

39.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُتَوَكِّلِ،
 عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّ نَاسًا، مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانُوا فى
 سَفَرٍ فَمَرُّوا بِحَىٍّ مِنْ أَحْيَاءِ الْعَرَبِ فَاسْتَضَافُوهُمْ فَلَمْ يُضِيفُوهُمْ ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا لَهُمْ هَلْ فِيكُمْ
 رَاقٍ فَإِنَّ سَيِّدَ الْحَىِّ لَدِيغٌ أَوْ مُصَابٌ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنْهُمْ نَعَمْ فَأَتَاهُ فَرَقَاهُ بِفَاتِحَةِ الْكِتَابِ
 فَبَرَأَ الرَّجُلُ فَأُعْطِيَ قَطِيعًا مِنْ غَنَمٍ فَأَبَى أَنْ يَقْبَلَهَا ‏.‏ وَقَالَ حَتَّى أَذْكُرَ ذَلِكَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَأَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ لَهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهِ
 مَا رَقَيْتُ إِلاَّ بِفَاتِحَةِ الْكِتَابِ ‏.‏ فَتَبَسَّمَ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ أَنَّهَا رُقْيَةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ خُذُوا
 مِنْهُمْ وَاضْرِبُوا لِي بِسَهْمٍ مَعَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
39.en: Abu Sa'id Khudri reported that some persons amongst the Companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) set out on a journey and they happened to pass by a tribe from the tribes of Arabia. They demanded hospitality from the members of that tribe, but they did not extend any hospitality to them. They said to them: Is there any invocator amongst you, at the chief of the tribe has bgen stung by a scorpion? A person amongst us said: 'Yes. So he came to him and he practised invocation with the help of Sura al-Fatiha and the person became all right. He was given a flock of sheep (as recompense), but he refused to accept that, saying: I shall make a mention of it to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), and if he approves of it. then I shall accept it. So we came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and made a mention of that to him and he (that person) said: Allah's Messenger by Allah, I did not practice invocation but with the help of Sura al-Fatiha of the Holy Book. He (the Holy Prophet) smiled and said: How did you come to know that it can be used (as invocation)? - and then said: Take out of that and allocate a share for me along with your share.
39.hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke sahaba mein se kuch log ek safar par nikle aur Arabia ke qabilon mein se ek qabile ke paas se guzre. Unhone us qabile ke logon se mehmaannawaazi ki maang ki, lekin unhone unhe koi mehmaannawaazi nahi di. Unhone unse kaha: Kya tum mein koi jhaad-phoonk karne wala hai, kyunki qabile ke sardaar ko bicchhu ne daansa hai? Hummein se ek shakhs ne kaha: Haan. To woh unke paas gaya aur usne Sura al-Fatiha ki madad se jhaad-phoonk ki aur woh shakhs theek ho gaya. Use bakriyon ka ek rewad diya gaya (badle mein), lekin usne ise qubool karne se inkaar kiya, ye kehte hue: Main iska zikr Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se karunga, aur agar woh iski manzoori dete hain, to main ise qubool karunga. To hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unhe iska zikr kiya aur unhone (us shakhs ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Allah ki qasam, maine Muqaddas Kitaab ki Sura al-Fatiha ki madad ke ilawa koi jhaad-phoonk nahi ki. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) muskuraaya aur kaha: Tumhe kaise pata chala ki ise (jhaad-phoonk ke soorat mein) istemaal kiya jaa sakta hai? - aur phir kaha: Usmein se lo aur mere liye bhi apne hisse ke saath ek hissa alag rakho.

39.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ غُنْدَرٍ، مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ
 عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ فَجَعَلَ يَقْرَأُ أُمَّ الْقُرْآنِ وَيَجْمَعُ
 بُزَاقَهُ وَيَتْفُلُ فَبَرَأَ الرَّجُلُ ‏.‏
39.en: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Abu Bishr with the same the same chain of transmitters (with these words): That he recited Umm-ul-Qur'an (Sura Fatiha), and he collected his spittle and he applied that and the person became all right.
39.hi: Ye hadees Abu Bishr ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai (in alfaazon ke saath): Ki unhone Umm-ul-Qur'an (Sura Fatiha) padhi, aur unhone apni lar ikattha ki aur use lagaaya aur woh shakhs theek ho gaya.

39.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ حَسَّانَ،
 عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أَخِيهِ، مَعْبَدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ نَزَلْنَا مَنْزِلاً
 فَأَتَتْنَا امْرَأَةٌ فَقَالَتْ إِنَّ سَيِّدَ الْحَىِّ سَلِيمٌ لُدِغَ فَهَلْ فِيكُمْ مِنْ رَاقٍ فَقَامَ مَعَهَا رَجُلٌ مِنَّا مَا
 كُنَّا نَظُنُّهُ يُحْسِنُ رُقْيَةً فَرَقَاهُ بِفَاتِحَةِ الْكِتَابِ فَبَرَأَ فَأَعْطَوْهُ غَنَمًا وَسَقَوْنَا لَبَنًا فَقُلْنَا أَكُنْتَ
 تُحْسِنُ رُقْيَةً فَقَالَ مَا رَقَيْتُهُ إِلاَّ بِفَاتِحَةِ الْكِتَابِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقُلْتُ لاَ تُحَرِّكُوهَا حَتَّى نَأْتِيَ النَّبِيَّ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَأَتَيْنَا النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرْنَا ذَلِكَ لَهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ مَا
 كَانَ يُدْرِيهِ أَنَّهَا رُقْيَةٌ اقْسِمُوا وَاضْرِبُوا لِي بِسَهْمٍ مَعَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
39.en: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported: We landed at a place where a woman came to us and said: A scorpion has bitten the chief of the tribe. Is there any invocator amongst you? A person amongst us stood up (and went with her). We had no idea that he had been a good invocator but he practiced invocation with the help of Sura al-Fatiha and the (the chief) was all right. They gave him a flock of sheep and served us milk. We said (to him): Are you a good invocator. Thereupon he said: I did not do it but by the help of Sura al-Fatiha. He said: Do not drive (these goats) until we go to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and find out (whether it is permissible to accept (this reward of invocation). So we came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and made a mention of that to him, whereupon he said: How did you come to know that this (Sura al-Fatiha) could be used as an invocation? So distribute them (amongst those who had been present there with him) and allocate a share of mine also.
39.hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne bayan kiya: Hum ek jagah utre jahan ek aurat humare paas aayi aur kaha: Ek bicchhu ne qabile ke sardaar ko kaata hai. Kya tum mein koi jhaad-phoonk karne wala hai? Hummein se ek shakhs khada hua (aur uske saath gaya). Humein nahi pata tha ki woh ek achha jhaad-phoonk karne wala hai lekin usne Sura al-Fatiha ki madad se jhaad-phoonk ki aur (sardaar) theek ho gaya. Unhone use bakriyon ka ek rewad diya aur humein doodh pilaaya. Humne (usse) kaha: Kya tum ek achhe jhaad-phoonk karne wale ho? Isper unhone kaha: Maine ye sirf Sura al-Fatiha ki madad se kiya. Unhone kaha: (In bakriyon ko) mat haanko jab tak hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas na jaayein aur pata na karein (ki kya ye jaayez hai ki jhaad-phoonk ka ye inaam qubool kiya jaaye). To hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unhe iska zikr kiya, isper unhone kaha: Tumhe kaise pata chala ki ise (Sura al-Fatiha ko) jhaad-phoonk ke soorat mein istemaal kiya jaa sakta hai? Is liye inhe (unke beech) baanto jo wahan unke saath maujood the aur mera bhi ek hissa alag rakho.

39.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
 نَحْوَهُ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ فَقَامَ مَعَهَا رَجُلٌ مِنَّا مَا كُنَّا نَأْبِنُهُ بِرُقْيَةٍ ‏.‏
39.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters and he said: There stood up with her a person amongst us whom we did not know before as an invocator.
39.hi: Ye hadees Hisham ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur unhone kaha: Uske saath hummein se ek shakhs khada hua jise hum pehle jhaad-phoonk karne wale ke soorat mein nahi jaante the.

39.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ،
 عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعُ بْنُ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ أَبِي الْعَاصِ الثَّقَفِيِّ، أَنَّهُ
 شَكَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَجَعًا يَجِدُهُ فِي جَسَدِهِ مُنْذُ أَسْلَمَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ
 رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ ضَعْ يَدَكَ عَلَى الَّذِي تَأَلَّمَ مِنْ جَسَدِكَ وَقُلْ بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ
 ‏.‏ ثَلاَثًا ‏.‏ وَقُلْ سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
39.en: Uthman b. Abu al-'As Al-Thaqafi reported that he made a complaint of pain to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that he felt in his body at the time he had become Muslim. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Place your hand at the place where you feel pain in your body and say Bismillah (in the name of Allah) three times and seven times A'udhu billahi wa qudratihi min sharri ma ajidu wa uhadhiru (I seek refuge with Allah and with His Power from the evil that I find and that I fear).
39.hi: Uthman bin Abu al-As Al-Thaqafi ne bayan kiya ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se us dard ki shikaayat ki jo unhe apne badan mein mehsoos hota tha jab se unhone Islam qubool kiya tha. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Apna haath us jagah rakho jahan tumhe apne badan mein dard mehsoos hota hai aur teen baar Bismillah (Allah ke naam par) kaho aur saat baar A'udhu billahi wa qudratihi min sharri ma ajidu wa uhadhiru (Main Allah ki aur Uski taaqat ki panah maangta hoon us burai se jo main mehsoos karta hoon aur jisse main Darta hoon).

39.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ خَلَفٍ الْبَاهِلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي،
 الْعَلاَءِ أَنَّ عُثْمَانَ بْنَ أَبِي الْعَاصِ، أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ
 الشَّيْطَانَ قَدْ حَالَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ صَلاَتِي وَقِرَاءَتِي يَلْبِسُهَا عَلَىَّ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله
 عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ ذَاكَ شَيْطَانٌ يُقَالُ لَهُ خِنْزِبٌ فَإِذَا أَحْسَسْتَهُ فَتَعَوَّذْ بِاللَّهِ مِنْهُ وَاتْفِلْ عَلَى يَسَارِكَ
 ثَلاَثًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَفَعَلْتُ ذَلِكَ فَأَذْهَبَهُ اللَّهُ عَنِّي ‏.‏
39.en: Uthman b. Abu al-'As reported that he came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger, the Satan intervenes between me and my prayer and my reciting of the Qur'an and he confounds me. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:, That is (the doing of a) Satan (devil) who is known as Khinzab, and when you perceive its effect, seek refuge with Allah from it and spit three times to your left. I did that and Allah dispelled that from me.
39.hi: Uthman bin Abu al-As ne bayan kiya ki woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Shaitaan mere aur meri namaz aur mere Quran padhne ke beech aata hai aur mujhe confuse karta hai. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Woh Shaitaan hai jise Khinzab kaha jaata hai, aur jab tum uska asar mehsoos karo, isse Allah ki panah maango aur apni baayi taraf teen baar thooko. Maine aisa kiya aur Allah ne use mujhse duur kiya.

39.ar:
حَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا سَالِمُ بْنُ نُوحٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ،
 حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ أَبِي الْعَاصِ، أَنَّهُ
 أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِهِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ فِي حَدِيثِ سَالِمِ بْنِ نُوحٍ ثَلاَثًا ‏.‏
39.en: 'Uthman b. Abu al-'As reported that he came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and he narrated like this. In the hadith transmitted on the authority of Salam b. Nuh there is no mention of three times,
39.hi: Uthman bin Abu al-As ne bayan kiya ki woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur unhone isi tarah riwayat ki. Salam bin Nuh ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein teen baar ka koi zikr nahi hai.

39.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ،
 حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الشِّخِّيرِ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ أَبِي الْعَاصِ الثَّقَفِيِّ، قَالَ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ
 اللَّهِ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏.‏
39.en: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of 'Uthman b. Abu al-'As with a slight variation of wording.
39.hi: Ye hadees Uthman bin Abu al-As ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

39.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مَعْرُوفٍ، وَأَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ عِيسَى، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ،
 أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ الْحَارِثِ - عَنْ عَبْدِ رَبِّهِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ،
 عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏
"‏ لِكُلِّ دَاءٍ دَوَاءٌ فَإِذَا أُصِيبَ دَوَاءُ الدَّاءِ بَرَأَ
 بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
39.en: Jabir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There is a remedy for every malady, and when the remedy is applied to the disease it is cured with the permission of Allah, the Exalted and Glorious.
39.hi: Jabir ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Har beemari ka ek ilaaj hai, aur jab ilaaj beemari par laagoo kiya jaata hai, ye Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ki ijazat se theek ho jaati hai.

39.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مَعْرُوفٍ، وَأَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو،
 أَنَّ بُكَيْرًا، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ عَاصِمَ بْنَ عُمَرَ بْنِ قَتَادَةَ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَادَ الْمُقَنَّعَ ثُمَّ
 قَالَ لاَ أَبْرَحُ حَتَّى تَحْتَجِمَ فَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏
"‏ إِنَّ فِيهِ
 شِفَاءً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
39.en: Jabir reported that he visited Muqanna' and then said: I will not go away unless you get yourself cupped, for I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say: It is a remedy.
39.hi: Jabir ne bayan kiya ki unhone Muqanna se mulaqaat ki aur phir kaha: Main tab tak nahi jaunga jab tak tum khud ko cupping (hijama) na karwaao, kyunki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ye ek ilaaj hai.

39.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ،
 عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ جَاءَنَا جَابِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فِي أَهْلِنَا وَرَجُلٌ يَشْتَكِي خُرَاجًا
 بِهِ أَوْ جِرَاحًا فَقَالَ مَا تَشْتَكِي قَالَ خُرَاجٌ بِي قَدْ شَقَّ عَلَىَّ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ يَا غُلاَمُ ائْتِنِي بِحَجَّامٍ
 ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ مَا تَصْنَعُ بِالْحَجَّامِ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُعَلِّقَ فِيهِ مِحْجَمًا ‏.‏ قَالَ وَاللَّهِ
 إِنَّ الذُّبَابَ لَيُصِيبُنِي أَوْ يُصِيبُنِي الثَّوْبُ فَيُؤْذِينِي وَيَشُقُّ عَلَىَّ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا رَأَى تَبَرُّمَهُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ
 قَالَ إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ إِنْ كَانَ فِي شَىْءٍ مِنْ أَدْوِيَتِكُمْ
 خَيْرٌ فَفِي شَرْطَةِ مَحْجَمٍ أَوْ شَرْبَةٍ مِنْ عَسَلٍ أَوْ لَذْعَةٍ بِنَارٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله
 عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَمَا أُحِبُّ أَنْ أَكْتَوِيَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَجَاءَ بِحَجَّامٍ فَشَرَطَهُ فَذَهَبَ عَنْهُ مَا يَجِدُ
 ‏.‏
39.en: 'Asim b. 'Umar b. Qatada reported: There came to our house 'Abdullah and another person from amongst the members of the household who complained of a wound. Jabir said: What ails you? He said: There is a wound which is very painful for me, whereupon he said: Boy, bring to me a cupper. He said: 'Abdullah, what do you intend to do with the cupper? I said: I would get this wound cupped. He said: By Allah. oven the touch of fly or cloth causes me pain (and cupping) would thus cause me (unbearable) pain. And when he saw him feeling pain (at the idea of cupping), he said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If there is any effective remedy amongst your remedies, these are (three): Cupping, drinking of honey and cauterisation with the help of fire. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said: As for myself I do not like cauterisation. The cupper was called and he cupped him and he was all right.
39.hi: Asim bin Umar bin Qatada ne bayan kiya: Abdullah aur khaandaan ke ek doosre sadasya humare ghar aaye jinhone ek zakhm ki shikaayat ki. Jabir ne kaha: Tumhe kya hua hai? Unhone kaha: Ek zakhm hai jo mujhe bahut takleef deta hai, isper unhone kaha: Bete, mere liye ek cupping karne wala lao. Unhone kaha: Abdullah, aapka cupping karne wale se kya iraada hai? Maine kaha: Main is zakhm ki cupping karwaaunga. Unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, makhi ya kapde ka sparsh bhi mujhe dard deta hai (aur cupping) is liye mujhe (asahaya) dard degi. Aur jab unhone use (cupping ke khyaal se) dard mehsoos karte dekha, unhone kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar tumhare ilaajon mein koi prabhaavshaali ilaaj hai, to woh ye (teen) hain: Cupping, shahad peena, aur aag se daagna. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha tha: Jahan tak mera sawal hai, mujhe daagna pasand nahi hai. Cupping karne wale ko bulaaya gaya aur usne unhe cupping ki aur woh theek ho gaye.

39.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ 
 أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّ أُمَّ سَلَمَةَ، اسْتَأْذَنَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْحِجَامَةِ
 فَأَمَرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَبَا طَيْبَةَ أَنْ يَحْجُمَهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ حَسِبْتُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ كَانَ أَخَاهَا
 مِنَ الرَّضَاعَةِ أَوْ غُلاَمًا لَمْ يَحْتَلِمْ ‏.‏
39.en: Jabir reported that Umm Salama sought permission from Allah's messenger (may Allah's peace upon him) tor getting herself cupped. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) asked Abu Taiba to cup her. He (Jabir) said: I think he (Abu Taiba) was her faster brother or a young boy before entering upon the adolescent period.
39.hi: Jabir ne bayan kiya ki Umm Salama ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se khud ko cupping karvaane ki ijazat maangi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Abu Taiba se kaha ki woh unhe cupping karein. Unhone (Jabir ne) kaha: Mujhe lagta hai Abu Taiba unke doodh-bhai the ya ek jawaan larka the kishoravastha mein daakhil karne se pehle.

39.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالَ يَحْيَى - وَاللَّفْظُ
 لَهُ - أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ،
 قَالَ بَعَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى أُبَىِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ طَبِيبًا فَقَطَعَ مِنْهُ عِرْقًا ثُمَّ
 كَوَاهُ عَلَيْهِ ‏.‏
39.en: Jabir reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent a phystian to Ubayy b. Ka'b. He cut the vein and then cauterised it.
39.hi: Jabir ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ubayy bin Ka'b ke paas ek chikitsak bheja. Usne uski nas kaati aur phir use daaga.

39.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا 
 عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرَا فَقَطَعَ مِنْهُ عِرْقًا
 ‏.‏
39.en: A'mash reported this with the same chain of transmitters and he made no mention of the fact that he cut one of his veins.
39.hi: A'mash ne ise isi sanad se riwayat ki aur unhone iska koi zikr nahi kiya ki unhone uski ek nas kaati.

39.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي بِشْرُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ 
 سُلَيْمَانَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سُفْيَانَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ رُمِيَ أُبَىٌّ يَوْمَ الأَحْزَابِ
 عَلَى أَكْحَلِهِ فَكَوَاهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
39.en: Jabir b. 'Abdillah reported that on the day of Ahzab Ubayy received the wound of an arrow in his medial arm vein. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) cauterised it.
39.hi: Jabir bin Abdillah ne bayan kiya ki Ahzab ke din Ubayy ko unki baazu ki darmiyan nas mein teer ka zakhm laga. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne use daaga.

39.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى،
 بْنُ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ رُمِيَ سَعْدُ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ فِي أَكْحَلِهِ
 - قَالَ - فَحَسَمَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدِهِ بِمِشْقَصٍ ثُمَّ وَرِمَتْ فَحَسَمَهُ الثَّانِيَةَ ‏.‏
39.en: Jabir reported that Sa'd b. Mu'adh received a wound of the arrow in his vein. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) cauterised it with a rod and it was swollen, to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did it for the second time.
39.hi: Jabir ne bayan kiya ki Sa'd bin Mu'adh ko unki nas mein teer ka zakhm laga. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne use ek lathi se daaga aur ye sooj gayi, is liye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ise dobara kiya.

39.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ صَخْرٍ الدَّارِمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَبَّانُ بْنُ هِلاَلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ،
 حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم احْتَجَمَ
 وَأَعْطَى الْحَجَّامَ أَجْرَهُ وَاسْتَعَطَ ‏.‏
39.en: Ibn 'Abbas reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) got himself cupped and gave to the cupper his wages and he put the medicine in the nostril.
39.hi: Ibn Abbas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne khud ko cupping karvaayi aur cupping karne wale ko uski mazdoori di aur unhone naak mein dawaai daali.

39.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، وَقَالَ،
 أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - أَخْبَرَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ مِسْعَرٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَامِرٍ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، قَالَ
 سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ احْتَجَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَكَانَ لاَ يَظْلِمُ أَحَدًا
 أَجْرَهُ ‏.‏
39.en: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got himself cupped and never withheld the wages of anyone.
39.hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne khud ko cupping karvaayi aur kabhi kisi ki mazdoori nahi roki.

39.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ سَعِيدٍ
 - عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ الْحُمَّى
 مِنْ فَيْحِ جَهَنَّمَ فَابْرُدُوهَا بِالْمَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
39.en: Ibn Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The fever from the vehement raging of the (heat of Hell), so cool it with the help of water.
39.hi: Ibn Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Bukhaar (Jahannam ki garmi) ki ugra jvala se hota hai, is liye ise paani se Thanda karo.

39.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ،
 حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ 
 النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ إِنَّ شِدَّةَ الْحُمَّى مِنْ فَيْحِ جَهَنَّمَ فَابْرُدُوهَا بِالْمَاءِ ‏"‏
 ‏.‏
39.en: Ibn Umar reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Fever is due to vehemence of the heat of Hell, so cool it with water.
39.hi: Ibn Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Bukhaar Jahannam ki ugra garmi se hota hai, is liye ise paani se Thanda karo.

39.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ،
 بْنُ رَافِعٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا الضَّحَّاكُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عُثْمَانَ - كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ نَافِعٍ،
 عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ الْحُمَّى مِنْ فَيْحِ جَهَنَّمَ فَأَطْفِئُوهَا
 بِالْمَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
39.en: Ibn Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Fever is from the vehement raging of the fire of Hell, so extinguish it with water.
39.hi: Ibn Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Bukhaar Jahannam ki aag ki ugra jvala se hota hai, is liye ise paani se bujhao.

39.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي 
 هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ،
 عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ الْحُمَّى مِنْ فَيْحِ جَهَنَّمَ
 فَأَطْفِئُوهَا بِالْمَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
39.en: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Fever is from the vehement Paging of the Hell-fire, so cool it with water.
39.hi: Ibn Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Bukhaar Jahannam ki aag ki ugra jvala se hota hai, is liye ise paani se Thanda karo.

39.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ 
 أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ الْحُمَّى مِنْ فَيْحِ جَهَنَّمَ فَابْرُدُوهَا
 بِالْمَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
39.en: 'A'isha reported Allah's messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Fever is from the vehement raging of the Hell-fire, so cool it with water.
39.hi: Aisha ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Bukhaar Jahannam ki aag ki ugra jvala se hota hai, is liye ise paani se Thanda karo.

39.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، وَعَبْدَةُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، جَمِيعًا
 عَنْ هِشَامٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
39.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters.
39.hi: Ye hadees Hisham ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

39.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ فَاطِمَةَ،
 عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ، أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ تُؤْتَى بِالْمَرْأَةِ الْمَوْعُوكَةِ فَتَدْعُو بِالْمَاءِ فَتَصُبُّهُ فِي جَيْبِهَا وَتَقُولُ
 إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ ابْرُدُوهَا بِالْمَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّهَا مِنْ فَيْحِ
 جَهَنَّمَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
39.en: Asma' reported that a woman running high fever was brought to her. She asked water to be brought and then sprinkled it in the opening of a shirt at the uppermost part of the chest and said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said: Cool (the fever) with water. for it is because of the vehemence of the beat of Hell.
39.hi: Asma ne bayan kiya ki ek aurat jise tez bukhaar tha unke paas laayi gayi. Unhone paani mangwaaya aur phir use kurte ke gale ke khule hisse mein, seene ke sabse upar wale hisse mein, chhidka aur kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha tha: (Bukhaar) ko paani se Thanda karo, kyunki ye Jahannam ki garmi ki ugra jvala ki wajah se hota hai.

39.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، وَأَبُو أُسَامَةَ عَنْ هِشَامٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ وَفِي
 حَدِيثِ ابْنِ نُمَيْرٍ صَبَّتِ الْمَاءَ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ جَيْبِهَا ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ فِي حَدِيثِ أَبِي أُسَامَةَ ‏
"‏ أَنَّهَا
 مِنْ فَيْحِ جَهَنَّمَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو أَحْمَدَ قَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ
 بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
39.en: Hisham reported this hadith with the same chain of transmitters. In the hadith transmitted on the authority of Ibn Numair (the words are): " She poured water on her sides and in the opening of the shirt at the uppermost part of the chest." There is no mention of these words:" It is from the vehemence of the heat of the Hell." This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Usama with the same chain of transmitters.
39.hi: Hisham ne ye hadees isi sanad se riwayat ki. Ibn Numair ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein (alfaaz hain): "Unhone uske paksho par aur kurte ke gale ke khule hisse mein, seene ke sabse upar wale hisse mein, paani daala." In alfaazon ka koi zikr nahi hai: "Ye Jahannam ki garmi ki ugra jvala ki wajah se hai." Ye hadees Abu Usama ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

39.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا هَنَّادُ بْنُ السَّرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَبَايَةَ،
 بْنِ رِفَاعَةَ عَنْ جَدِّهِ، رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ
 ‏
"‏ إِنَّ الْحُمَّى فَوْرٌ مِنْ جَهَنَّمَ فَابْرُدُوهَا بِالْمَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
39.en: Rafi' b. Khadij reported: I heard Allah's messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The fever is due to the intense heat of the Hell, so cool it with water.
39.hi: Rafi bin Khadij ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Bukhaar Jahannam ki tez garmi ki wajah se hota hai, is liye ise paani se Thanda karo.

39.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ
 نَافِعٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبَايَةَ بْنِ رِفَاعَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي 
 رَافِعُ بْنُ خَدِيجٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ الْحُمَّى مِنْ فَوْرِ جَهَنَّمَ
 فَابْرُدُوهَا عَنْكُمْ بِالْمَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ أَبُو بَكْرٍ ‏"‏ عَنْكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي رَافِعُ بْنُ
 خَدِيجٍ ‏.‏
39.en: Rafi' b. Khadij reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The fever is due to the intense heat of Hell, so cool it down in your (bodies) with water. Aba Bakr has made no mention of the word" from you" ('ankum), but he said that Rafi' b. Khadij had informed him of it.
39.hi: Rafi bin Khadij ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Bukhaar Jahannam ki tez garmi ki wajah se hota hai, is liye ise apne (badan) mein paani se Thanda karo. Aba Bakr ne "tumse" (ankum) lafz ka koi zikr nahi kiya, lekin unhone kaha ki Rafi bin Khadij ne unhe iski jaankaari di thi.

39.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، حَدَّثَنِي مُوسَى بْنُ أَبِي،
 عَائِشَةَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ لَدَدْنَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 فِي مَرَضِهِ فَأَشَارَ أَنْ لاَ تَلُدُّونِي ‏.‏ فَقُلْنَا كَرَاهِيَةُ الْمَرِيضِ لِلدَّوَاءِ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا أَفَاقَ قَالَ ‏
"‏ لاَ
 يَبْقَى أَحَدٌ مِنْكُمْ إِلاَّ لُدَّ غَيْرُ الْعَبَّاسِ فَإِنَّهُ لَمْ يَشْهَدْكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
39.en: 'A'isha reported: we (intended to pour) medicine in the mouth of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in his illness, but he pointed out (with the gesture of his hand) that it should not be poured into the mouth against his will. We said: (It was perhaps due to the natural) aversion of the patient against medicine. When he recovered, he said: Medicine should be poured into the mouth of every one of you except Ibn 'Abbas, for he was not present amongst you.
39.hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya: Hum (unki beemari mein) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke munh mein dawaai daalne (ka iraada rakhte) the, lekin unhone (apne haath ke ishare se) bataya ki ise unki marzi ke bina munh mein nahi daala jaana chahiye. Humne kaha: (Ye shaayad) mareez ka dawaai ke prati svaabhaavik virodh (tha). Jab woh theek hue, unhone kaha: Dawaai tum mein se har ek ke munh mein daali jaani chahiye siwaay Ibn Abbas ke, kyunki woh tumhare beech maujood nahi the.

39.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ وَزُهَيْرُ
 بْنُ حَرْبٍ وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ - وَاللَّفْظُ لِزُهَيْرٍ - قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرُونَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ،
 بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أُمِّ قَيْسٍ بِنْتِ مِحْصَنٍ، أُخْتِ عُكَّاشَةَ
 بْنِ مِحْصَنٍ قَالَتْ دَخَلْتُ بِابْنٍ لِي عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمْ يَأْكُلِ الطَّعَامَ
 فَبَالَ عَلَيْهِ فَدَعَا بِمَاءٍ فَرَشَّهُ ‏.‏ 
 قَالَتْ وَدَخَلْتُ عَلَيْهِ بِابْنٍ لِي قَدْ أَعْلَقْتُ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْعُذْرَةِ فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ عَلاَمَهْ تَدْغَرْنَ
 أَوْلاَدَكُنَّ بِهَذَا الْعِلاَقِ عَلَيْكُنَّ بِهَذَا الْعُودِ الْهِنْدِيِّ فَإِنَّ فِيهِ سَبْعَةَ أَشْفِيَةٍ مِنْهَا ذَاتُ الْجَنْبِ
 يُسْعَطُ مِنَ الْعُذْرَةِ وَيُلَدُّ مِنْ ذَاتِ الْجَنْبِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
39.en: Umm Qais, daughter of Mihsan, the sister of 'Ukasha b. Mihsan said: I visited Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) along with my son who had not, by that time, been weaned and he urinated over his (clothes). He ordered water to be brought and sprinkled (it) over them. She (further) said: I visited him (Allah's Apostle) along with my son and I had squeezed the swelling in the uvula, whereupon he said: Why do you afflict your children by compressing like this? Use this Indian aloeswood, for it contains seven types of remedies, one among them being a remedy for pleurisy. It is applied through the nose for a swelling of the uvula and poured into the side of the mouth for pleurisy.
39.hi: Umm Qais, Mihsan ki beti, Ukasha bin Mihsan ki behn, ne kaha: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se milne gayi apne bete ke saath jiska us waqt tak doodh nahi chhuda tha aur usne unke (kapdon) par peshaab kar diya. Unhone paani mangwaaya aur (ise) unpar chhidkaaya. Unhone (aage) kaha: Main unse (Allah ke Rasool se) apne bete ke saath milne gayi thi aur maine uski gale ki jeeb ki sooji hui jagah dabaayi thi, isper unhone kaha: Tum apne bachchon ko is tarah dabaakar kyun takleef deti ho? Ye Indian aloeswood istemaal karo, kyunki ismein saat kism ke ilaaj hain, unmein se ek pleurisy ka ilaaj hai. Ise gale ki jeeb ki sooji ke liye naak ke zariye lagaaya jaata hai aur pleurisy ke liye munh ke ek taraf daala jaata hai.

39.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، أَنَّ ابْنَ شِهَابٍ،
 أَخْبَرَهُ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، أَنَّ أُمَّ قَيْسٍ بِنْتَ مِحْصَنٍ،
 - وَكَانَتْ مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرَاتِ الأُوَلِ اللاَّتِي بَايَعْنَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهِيَ أُخْتُ
 عُكَّاشَةَ بْنِ مِحْصَنٍ أَحَدِ بَنِي أَسَدِ بْنِ خُزَيْمَةَ - قَالَ أَخْبَرَتْنِي أَنَّهَا أَتَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم بِابْنٍ لَهَا لَمْ يَبْلُغْ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ الطَّعَامَ وَقَدْ أَعْلَقَتْ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْعُذْرَةِ - قَالَ يُونُسُ
 أَعْلَقَتْ غَمَزَتْ فَهِيَ تَخَافُ أَنْ يَكُونَ بِهِ عُذْرَةٌ - قَالَتْ - فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم ‏
"‏ عَلاَمَهْ تَدْغَرْنَ أَوْلاَدَكُنَّ بِهَذَا الإِعْلاَقِ عَلَيْكُمْ بِهَذَا الْعُودِ الْهِنْدِيِّ - يَعْنِي بِهِ الْكُسْتَ
 - فَإِنَّ فِيهِ سَبْعَةَ أَشْفِيَةٍ مِنْهَا ذَاتُ الْجَنْبِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ 
 قَالَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ وَأَخْبَرَتْنِي أَنَّ ابْنَهَا ذَاكَ بَالَ فِي حَجْرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم فَدَعَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَاءٍ فَنَضَحَهُ عَلَى بَوْلِهِ وَلَمْ يَغْسِلْهُ غَسْلاً
 ‏.‏
39.en: Umm Qais, daughter of Mihsan, was one of the earlier female emigrants who had pledged allegiance to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). She was the sister of Ukasha b. Mihsan, one of the posterity of Asad b. Khuzaima. She reported that she came to Allah's messenger (ﷺ) along with her son who had not attained the age of weaning and she had compressed the swelling of his uvula. (Yunus said: She compressed the uvula because she was afraid that there might be swelling of uvula.) Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Why do you afflict your children by compressing in this way? You should use Indian aloeswood, for it has seven remedies in it, one of them being the remedy for pleurisy. Ubaidullah reported that she had told that that was the child who had urinated in the lap of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) called for water and sprinkled it on his urine, but he did not wash it well.
39.hi: Umm Qais, Mihsan ki beti, purani aurat prawaasiyon mein se ek thin jinhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se wafadaari ki qasam li thi. Woh Ukasha bin Mihsan ki behn thin, Asad bin Khuzaima ki aulaad mein se ek. Unhone bayan kiya ki woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas apne bete ke saath aayin jiski doodh chhudaane ki umar nahi hui thi aur unhone uski gale ki jeeb ki sooji ko dabaaya tha. (Yunus ne kaha: Unhone gale ki jeeb dabaayi kyunki unhe dar tha ki gale ki jeeb sooj sakti hai.) Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Tum apne bachchon ko is tarah dabaakar kyun takleef deti ho? Tumhe Indian aloeswood istemaal karna chahiye, kyunki ismein saat ilaaj hain, unmein se ek pleurisy ka ilaaj hai. Ubaidullah ne riwayat ki ki unhone bataya ki ye woh bachcha tha jisne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki god mein peshaab kiya tha, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne paani mangwaaya aur use uske peshaab par chhidka, lekin unhone ise achhi tarah nahi dhoya.

39.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحِ بْنِ الْمُهَاجِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي 
 أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، وَسَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، أَخْبَرَهُمَا أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ رَسُولَ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏
"‏ إِنَّ فِي الْحَبَّةِ السَّوْدَاءِ شِفَاءً مِنْ كُلِّ دَاءٍ إِلاَّ السَّامَ ‏"‏
 ‏.‏ وَالسَّامُ الْمَوْتُ ‏.‏ وَالْحَبَّةُ السَّوْدَاءُ الشُّونِيزُ ‏.‏
39.en: Abu Huraira reported that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Nigella seed is a remedy for every disease except death.
39.hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Kalonji (mangraila) har beemari ka ilaaj hai siwaay maut ke.

39.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ،
 شِهَابٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ح 
 وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ،
 قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ،
 ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ 
 الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ عُقَيْلٍ
 وَفِي حَدِيثِ سُفْيَانَ وَيُونُسَ الْحَبَّةُ السَّوْدَاءُ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلِ الشُّونِيزُ ‏.‏
39.en: This hadith has been narrated through other chains of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
39.hi: Ye hadees doosri sanadon ke zariye alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

39.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، -
 وَهُوَ ابْنُ جَعْفَرٍ - عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 قَالَ ‏
"‏ مَا مِنْ دَاءٍ إِلاَّ فِي الْحَبَّةِ السَّوْدَاءِ مِنْهُ شِفَاءٌ إِلاَّ السَّامَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
39.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There is no disease for which Nigella seed does not provide remedy.
39.hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Koi beemari nahi hai jiska ilaaj Kalonji na de.

39.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، حَدَّثَنِي 
 عُقَيْلُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ إِذَا مَاتَ الْمَيِّتُ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا فَاجْتَمَعَ لِذَلِكَ النِّسَاءُ ثُمَّ تَفَرَّقْنَ إِلاَّ أَهْلَهَا وَخَاصَّتَهَا
 - أَمَرَتْ بِبُرْمَةٍ مِنْ تَلْبِينَةٍ فَطُبِخَتْ ثُمَّ صُنِعَ ثَرِيدٌ فَصُبَّتِ التَّلْبِينَةُ عَلَيْهَا ثُمَّ قَالَتْ كُلْنَ مِنْهَا
 فَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏
"‏ التَّلْبِينَةُ مَجَمَّةٌ لِفُؤَادِ الْمَرِيضِ تُذْهِبُ
 بَعْضَ الْحُزْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
39.en: 'A'isha the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: When there was any bereavement in her family the women gathered there for condolence and they departed except the members of the family and some selected persons. She asked to prepare talbina in a small couldron and it was cooked and then tharid was prepared and it was poured over talbina, then she said: Eat it, for I heard Allah's Messenger (may peade be upon him) as saying: Talbina gives comfort to the aggrieved heart and it lessens grief.
39.hi: Aisha, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ne kaha: Jab unke khaandaan mein koi maut hoti, auraten shok manaane wahan ikattha hotin aur woh chali jaatin siwaay khaandaan ke sadasyon aur kuch chune hue logon ke. Unhone ek chhoti degchi mein talbina banaane ko kaha aur ise pakaaya gaya aur phir tharid banaayi gayi aur ise talbina par daala gaya, phir unhone kaha: Ise khaao, kyunki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Talbina dukhi dil ko aaraam deta hai aur ye gam ko kam karta hai.

39.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا 
 مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُتَوَكِّلِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ جَاءَ
 رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ إِنَّ أَخِي اسْتَطْلَقَ بَطْنُهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اسْقِهِ عَسَلاً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَسَقَاهُ ثُمَّ جَاءَهُ فَقَالَ إِنِّي سَقَيْتُهُ عَسَلاً فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُ إِلاَّ
 اسْتِطْلاَقًا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ ثُمَّ جَاءَ الرَّابِعَةَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اسْقِهِ عَسَلاً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَقَدْ سَقَيْتُهُ
 فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُ إِلاَّ اسْتِطْلاَقًا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ صَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَكَذَبَ بَطْنُ
 أَخِيكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَسَقَاهُ فَبَرَأَ ‏.‏
39.en: Abu Sa'id Khudri reported that a person came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and told him that his brother's bowels were loose. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Give him honey. So he gave him that and then came and said: I gave him honey but it has only made his bowels more loose. He said this three times; and then he came the fourth time, and he (the Holy Prophet) said: Give him honey. He said: I did give him, but it has only made his bowels more loose, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Allah has spoken the truth and your brother's bowels are in the wrong. So he made him drink (honey) and he was recovered.
39.hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unhe bataya ki uske bhai ke pet mein dast (diarrhea) hai. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Use shahad do. To usne use shahad diya aur phir aaya aur kaha: Maine use shahad diya lekin isne sirf uske dast ko aur badhaya hai. Usne ye teen baar kaha; aur phir woh chauthi baar aaya, aur unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Use shahad do. Usne kaha: Maine use diya, lekin isne sirf uske dast ko aur badhaya hai, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Allah ne sach kaha hai aur tumhare bhai ka pet galat hai. Is liye usne use (shahad) pilaaya aur woh theek ho gaya.

39.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ عَمْرُو بْنُ زُرَارَةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَطَاءٍ - عَنْ سَعِيدٍ،
 عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُتَوَكِّلِ النَّاجِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله
 عليه وسلم فَقَالَ إِنَّ أَخِي عَرِبَ بَطْنُهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ ‏
"‏ اسْقِهِ عَسَلاً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ شُعْبَةَ
 ‏.‏
39.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Sa'id Khudri through another chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
39.hi: Ye hadees Abu Sa'id Khudri ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

39.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، وَأَبِي النَّضْرِ،
 مَوْلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَهُ يَسْأَلُ، أُسَامَةَ
 بْنَ زَيْدٍ مَاذَا سَمِعْتَ مِنْ، رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الطَّاعُونِ فَقَالَ أُسَامَةُ قَالَ
 رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ الطَّاعُونُ رِجْزٌ أَوْ عَذَابٌ أُرْسِلَ عَلَى بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ أَوْ
 عَلَى مَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ فَإِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ بِهِ بِأَرْضٍ فَلاَ تَقْدَمُوا عَلَيْهِ وَإِذَا وَقَعَ بِأَرْضٍ وَأَنْتُمْ بِهَا
 فَلاَ تَخْرُجُوا فِرَارًا مِنْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَبُو النَّضْرِ ‏"‏ لاَ يُخْرِجُكُمْ إِلاَّ فِرَارٌ مِنْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
39.en: 'Amir b. Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas reported on the authority of his father that he asked Usama b. Zaid: What have you heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about plague? Thereupon Usama said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Plague is a calamity which was sent to Bani Isra'il or upon those who were before you. So when you hear that it has broken out in a land, don't go to it, and when it has broken out in the land where you are, don't run out of it. In the narration transmitted on the authority of Abu Nadr there is a slight variation of wording.
39.hi: Amir bin Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas ne apne waalid ke hawale se ye riwayat ki ki unhone Usama bin Zaid se poocha: Aapne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se mahamaari ke baare mein kya suna hai? Isper Usama ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Mahamaari ek aafat hai jo Banu Isra'il par ya tumse pehle ke logon par bheji gayi thi. Is liye jab tum sunte ho ki ye kisi zameen mein phaili hai, wahan mat jaao, aur jab ye us zameen mein phaili ho jahan tum ho, wahan se mat bhaago. Abu Nadr ki riwayat mein alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli hai.

39.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ، -
 وَنَسَبَهُ ابْنُ قَعْنَبٍ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْقُرَشِيُّ - عَنْ أَبِي النَّضْرِ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدِ،
 بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ الطَّاعُونُ
 آيَةُ الرِّجْزِ ابْتَلَى اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ بِهِ نَاسًا مِنْ عِبَادِهِ فَإِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ بِهِ فَلاَ تَدْخُلُوا عَلَيْهِ وَإِذَا
 وَقَعَ بِأَرْضٍ وَأَنْتُمْ بِهَا فَلاَ تَفِرُّوا مِنْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ هَذَا حَدِيثُ الْقَعْنَبِيِّ وَقُتَيْبَةَ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
39.en: Usama b. Zaid reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said: Plague is the sign of a calamity with which Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, affects people from His servants. So when you hear about it, don't enter there (where it has broken out), and when it has broken out in a land and you are there, then don't run away from it.
39.hi: Usama bin Zaid ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha tha: Mahamaari ek aafat ka nishaan hai jisse Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, Apne bandon mein se logon ko prabhaavit karta hai. Is liye jab tum iske baare mein suno, wahan mat jao (jahan ye phaili hai), aur jab ye kisi zameen mein phaili ho aur tum wahan ho, phir wahan se mat bhaago.

39.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ،
 عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ إِنَّ هَذَا الطَّاعُونَ
 رِجْزٌ سُلِّطَ عَلَى مَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ أَوْ عَلَى بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ فَإِذَا كَانَ بِأَرْضٍ فَلاَ تَخْرُجُوا مِنْهَا
 فِرَارًا مِنْهُ وَإِذَا كَانَ بِأَرْضٍ فَلاَ تَدْخُلُوهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
39.en: Usama reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Plague is a calamity which was inflicted on those who were before you, or upon Bani Isra'il. So when it has broken out in a land, don't run out of it, and when it has spread in a land, then don't enter it.
39.hi: Usama ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Mahamaari ek aafat hai jo tumse pehle ke logon par, ya Banu Isra'il par, thopi gayi thi. Is liye jab ye kisi zameen mein phaili ho, wahan se mat bhaago, aur jab ye kisi zameen mein phail jaaye, wahan mat jaao.

39.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو،
 بْنُ دِينَارٍ أَنَّ عَامِرَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَجُلاً سَأَلَ سَعْدَ بْنَ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ عَنِ الطَّاعُونِ،
 فَقَالَ أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ أَنَا أُخْبِرُكَ عَنْهُ، قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ هُوَ عَذَابٌ
 أَوْ رِجْزٌ أَرْسَلَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَى طَائِفَةٍ مِنْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ أَوْ نَاسٍ كَانُوا قَبْلَكُمْ فَإِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ بِهِ
 بِأَرْضٍ فَلاَ تَدْخُلُوهَا عَلَيْهِ وَإِذَا دَخَلَهَا عَلَيْكُمْ فَلاَ تَخْرُجُوا مِنْهَا فِرَارًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
39.en: 'Amir b. Sa'd reported that a person asked Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas about the plague, whereupon Usama b. Zaid said: I would inform you about it. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: It is a calamity or a disease which Allah sent to a group of Bani Isra'il, or to the people who were before you; so when you hear of it in land, don't enter it and when it has broken out in your land, don't run away from it.
39.hi: Amir bin Sa'd ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs ne Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas se mahamaari ke baare mein poocha, isper Usama bin Zaid ne kaha: Main tumhe iske baare mein bataunga. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ye ek aafat ya beemari hai jo Allah ne Banu Isra'il ke ek giroh par, ya tumse pehle ke logon par bheji thi; is liye jab tum ise kisi zameen mein sunte ho, wahan mat jaao aur jab ye tumhari zameen mein phaili ho, wahan se mat bhaago.

39.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، وَهُوَ
 ابْنُ زَيْدٍ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ،
 دِينَارٍ بِإِسْنَادِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِهِ ‏.‏
39.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Juraij through another chain of transmitters.
39.hi: Ye hadees Ibn Juraij ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

39.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو وَحَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ،
 أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَامِرُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ رَسُولِ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏
"‏ إِنَّ هَذَا الْوَجَعَ أَوِ السَّقَمَ رِجْزٌ عُذِّبَ بِهِ بَعْضُ الأُمَمِ
 قَبْلَكُمْ ثُمَّ بَقِيَ بَعْدُ بِالأَرْضِ فَيَذْهَبُ الْمَرَّةَ وَيَأْتِي الأُخْرَى فَمَنْ سَمِعَ بِهِ بِأَرْضٍ فَلاَ يَقْدَمَنَّ
 عَلَيْهِ وَمَنْ وَقَعَ بِأَرْضٍ وَهُوَ بِهَا فَلاَ يُخْرِجَنَّهُ الْفِرَارُ مِنْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
39.en: Usama b. Zaid reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said this: This calamity or illness was a punishment with which were punished some of the nations before you. Then it was left upon the earth. It goes away once and comes back again. He who heard of its presence in a land should not go towards it, and he who happened to be in a land where it had broken out should not fly from it.
39.hi: Usama bin Zaid ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Ye aafat ya beemari ek saza thi jisse tumse pehle ki kuch qaumein saza payi gayi thin. Phir ye zameen par chhoDi gayi. Ye kabhi kabhi chali jaati hai aur phir wapas aati hai. Jisne kisi zameen mein iski maujoodgi ke baare mein suna use uski taraf nahi jaana chahiye, aur jo kisi aisi zameen mein tha jahan ye phail chuki hai use wahan se nahi bhaagna chahiye.

39.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زِيَادٍ - حَدَّثَنَا 
 مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِإِسْنَادِ يُونُسَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِهِ ‏.‏
39.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with a different chain of transmitters.
39.hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

39.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ حَبِيبٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا بِالْمَدِينَةِ
 فَبَلَغَنِي أَنَّ الطَّاعُونَ قَدْ وَقَعَ بِالْكُوفَةِ فَقَالَ لِي عَطَاءُ بْنُ يَسَارٍ وَغَيْرُهُ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا كُنْتَ بِأَرْضٍ فَوَقَعَ بِهَا فَلاَ تَخْرُجْ مِنْهَا وَإِذَا بَلَغَكَ أَنَّهُ
 بِأَرْضٍ فَلاَ تَدْخُلْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ عَمَّنْ قَالُوا عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ يُحَدِّثُ بِهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَتَيْتُهُ
 فَقَالُوا غَائِبٌ - قَالَ - فَلَقِيتُ أَخَاهُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ فَسَأَلْتُهُ فَقَالَ شَهِدْتُ أُسَامَةَ يُحَدِّثُ
 سَعْدًا قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ إِنَّ هَذَا الْوَجَعَ رِجْزٌ أَوْ عَذَابٌ
 أَوْ بَقِيَّةُ عَذَابٍ عُذِّبَ بِهِ أُنَاسٌ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ فَإِذَا كَانَ بِأَرْضٍ وَأَنْتُمْ بِهَا فَلاَ تَخْرُجُوا مِنْهَا
 وَإِذَا بَلَغَكُمْ أَنَّهُ بِأَرْضٍ فَلاَ تَدْخُلُوهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ حَبِيبٌ فَقُلْتُ لإِبْرَاهِيمَ آنْتَ سَمِعْتَ أُسَامَةَ
 يُحَدِّثُ سَعْدًا وَهُوَ لاَ يُنْكِرُ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏
39.en: Shu'ba reported from Habib: While we were in Medina we heard of plague having broken out in Kufa. 'Ata b. Yasir and others said to me that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said. If you are in a land where it (this scourge) has broken out, don't get out of it, and if you were to know that it had broken (in another land, then don't enter it. I said to him: From whom (did you hear it)? They said: 'Amir b. Sa'd has narrated it. So I came to him. They said that he was not present there. So I met his brother Ibrahim b. Sa'd and asked him. He said: I bear testimony to the fact that Usama narrated it to Sa'd saying: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying that it is a God-sent punishment from the calamity or from the remnant of the calamity with which people were afflicted before you. So when it is in a land and you are there, don't get out of it, and if (this news reaches you) that it has broken out in a land, then don't enter therein. Habib said: I said to Ibrahim: Did you hear Usama narrating it to Sa'd and he was not denying it. He said: Yes.
39.hi: Shu'ba ne Habib se riwayat ki: Jab hum Madina mein the humne suna ki Kufa mein mahamaari phail gayi hai. Ata bin Yasir aur doosron ne mujhse kaha ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha tha: Agar tum kisi aisi zameen mein ho jahan ye (aafat) phail chuki hai, wahan se mat jaao, aur agar tumhe pata chale ki ye (kisi doosri zameen mein) phail gayi hai, wahan mat jaao. Maine unse kaha: Kisse (tumne ye suna)? Unhone kaha: Amir bin Sa'd ne ise riwayat ki. To main unke paas gaya. Unhone kaha ki woh wahan maujood nahi the. Is liye main unke bhai Ibrahim bin Sa'd se mila aur unse poocha. Unhone kaha: Main is baat ki gawaahi deta hoon ki Usama ne ise Sa'd se riwayat ki ye kehte hue: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna ki ye ek Allah ke zariye bheji gayi saza hai us aafat se ya us aafat ke baaki hisse se jisse tumse pehle ke log pareshaan huye the. Is liye jab ye kisi zameen mein ho aur tum wahan ho, wahan se mat jaao, aur agar (tumhe khabar mile) ki ye kisi zameen mein phaili hai, wahan mat jaao. Habib ne kaha: Maine Ibrahim se kaha: Kya aapne Usama ko Sa'd se ye riwayat karte suna aur woh iska khandan nahi kar rahe the? Unhone kaha: Haan.

39.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ لَمْ
 يَذْكُرْ قِصَّةَ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ فِي أَوَّلِ الْحَدِيثِ ‏.‏
39.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters except for the fact that no mention has been made of the account of 'Ata b. Yasir as in the previous hadith.
39.hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai siwaay is baat ke ki Ata bin Yasir ke byore ka koi zikr nahi kiya gaya hai jaisa pichhli hadees mein hai.

39.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
 بْنِ سَعْدٍ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، وَخُزَيْمَةَ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ، وَأُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، قَالُوا قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ شُعْبَةَ ‏.‏
39.en: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Sa'd b. Malik, Khuzaima b. Thabit and Usama b. Zaid.
39.hi: Ye hadees Sa'd bin Malik, Khuzaima bin Thabit aur Usama bin Zaid ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

39.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ،
 عَنْ حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، قَالَ كَانَ أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ وَسَعْدٌ جَالِسَيْنِ
 يَتَحَدَّثَانِ فَقَالاَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏.‏
39.en: Ibrahim b. Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas reported: Usama b. Zaid and Sa'd had been sitting and they had been conversing and they said this hadith.
39.hi: Ibrahim bin Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas ne bayan kiya: Usama bin Zaid aur Sa'd baithe hue the aur woh baat kar rahe the aur unhone ye hadees bayaan ki.

39.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ وَهْبُ بْنُ بَقِيَّةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدٌ، - يَعْنِي الطَّحَّانَ - عَنِ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ،
 بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
 بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏.‏
39.en: This hadith has been transmitted by Ibrahim b. Sa'd b. Malik on the authority of his father.
39.hi: Ye hadees Ibrahim bin Sa'd bin Malik ne apne waalid ki sanad se riwayat ki hai.

39.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ،
 الْحَمِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ نَوْفَلٍ،
 عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، خَرَجَ إِلَى الشَّامِ حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ بِسَرْغَ لَقِيَهُ
 أَهْلُ الأَجْنَادِ أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ بْنُ الْجَرَّاحِ وَأَصْحَابُهُ فَأَخْبَرُوهُ أَنَّ الْوَبَاءَ قَدْ وَقَعَ بِالشَّامِ ‏.‏ قَالَ
 ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ ادْعُ لِيَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ الأَوَّلِينَ ‏.‏ فَدَعَوْتُهُمْ فَاسْتَشَارَهُمْ وَأَخْبَرَهُمْ
 أَنَّ الْوَبَاءَ قَدْ وَقَعَ بِالشَّامِ فَاخْتَلَفُوا فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ قَدْ خَرَجْتَ لأَمْرٍ وَلاَ نَرَى أَنْ تَرْجِعَ
 عَنْهُ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ مَعَكَ بَقِيَّةُ النَّاسِ وَأَصْحَابُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلاَ نَرَى
 أَنْ تُقْدِمَهُمْ عَلَى هَذَا الْوَبَاءِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ارْتَفِعُوا عَنِّي ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ادْعُ لِيَ الأَنْصَارَ فَدَعَوْتُهُمْ لَهُ
 فَاسْتَشَارَهُمْ فَسَلَكُوا سَبِيلَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ وَاخْتَلَفُوا كَاخْتِلاَفِهِمْ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ارْتَفِعُوا عَنِّي ‏.‏ ثُمَّ
 قَالَ ادْعُ لِي مَنْ كَانَ هَا هُنَا مِنْ مَشْيَخَةِ قُرَيْشٍ مِنْ مُهَاجِرَةِ الْفَتْحِ ‏.‏ فَدَعَوْتُهُمْ فَلَمْ يَخْتَلِفْ
 عَلَيْهِ رَجُلاَنِ فَقَالُوا نَرَى أَنْ تَرْجِعَ بِالنَّاسِ وَلاَ تُقْدِمْهُمْ عَلَى هَذَا الْوَبَاءِ ‏.‏ فَنَادَى عُمَرُ
 فِي النَّاسِ إِنِّي مُصْبِحٌ عَلَى ظَهْرٍ فَأَصْبِحُوا عَلَيْهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ بْنُ الْجَرَّاحِ أَفِرَارًا
 مِنْ قَدَرِ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ لَوْ غَيْرُكَ قَالَهَا يَا أَبَا عُبَيْدَةَ - وَكَانَ عُمَرُ يَكْرَهُ خِلاَفَهُ - نَعَمْ
 نَفِرُّ مِنْ قَدَرِ اللَّهِ إِلَى قَدَرِ اللَّهِ أَرَأَيْتَ لَوْ كَانَتْ لَكَ إِبِلٌ فَهَبَطْتَ وَادِيًا لَهُ عِدْوَتَانِ إِحْدَاهُمَا
 خَصْبَةٌ وَالأُخْرَى جَدْبَةٌ أَلَيْسَ إِنْ رَعَيْتَ الْخَصْبَةَ رَعَيْتَهَا بِقَدَرِ اللَّهِ وَإِنْ رَعَيْتَ الْجَدْبَةَ رَعَيْتَهَا
 بِقَدَرِ اللَّهِ قَالَ فَجَاءَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَوْفٍ وَكَانَ مُتَغَيِّبًا فِي بَعْضِ حَاجَتِهِ فَقَالَ إِنَّ عِنْدِي
 مِنْ هَذَا عِلْمًا سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏
"‏ إِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ بِهِ بِأَرْضٍ فَلاَ
 تَقْدَمُوا عَلَيْهِ وَإِذَا وَقَعَ بِأَرْضٍ وَأَنْتُمْ بِهَا فَلاَ تَخْرُجُوا فِرَارًا مِنْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ عُمَرُ
 بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ ‏.‏
39.en:
'Abdullah b. 'Abbas reported: Umar b. Khattab set out for Syria. As he came at Sargh (a town by the side of Hijaz on the way to Syria), there met him the commander of the forces, Abu Ubaida b. Jandb, and his companions. They informed him that a scourge had broken out in Syria. Ibn 'Abbas further reported that 'Umar said: Call to me tile earliest emigrants. So I called them. He (Hadrat 'Umar) sought their advice, and they told him that the scourge had broker, out in Syria. There was a difference of opinion (whether they should proceed further or go back to their homes in such a situation). Some of them said: You ('Umar) have set forth for a task, and, therefore, we would not advise you to go back, whereas some of them said: You have along with you the remnants (of the sacred galaxy) of men and (the blessed) Companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), so we would not advise you to go forth towards this calamity (with such eminent persons and thus expose them deliberately to a danger). He (Hadrat 'Umar) said: You can now go away. He said: Call to me the Ansar. So I called them to him, and he consulted them, and they trod the same path as was trodden by the Muhajirin, and they differed in their opinions as they had differed. He said: Now, you can go. He again said: Call to me the old persons of the Quraish who had migrated before the Victory (that is the Victory of Mecca), so I called them (and Hadrat 'Umar consulted them) and not even two persons differed (from the opinion held by the earlier delegates). They said: Our opinion is that you better go back along with the people and do not make them go to this scourge, So 'Umar made announcement to the people: In the morning I would be on the back of my side. So they (set forth in the morning), whereupon Abu 'Ubaida b. Jarrah said: Are you going to run away from the Divine Decree? Thereupon 'Umar said: Had it been someone else to say this besides you! 'Umar (in fact) did not approve of his opposing (this decision) and he said: Yes, we are running from the Divine Decree (to the) Divine Decree. You should think if there had been camels for you and you happened to get down in a valley having two sides, one of them covered with verdure and the other being barren, would you not (be doing) according to the Divine Decree if you graze them in verdure? And in case you graze them in the barren land (even then you would be grazing them) according to the Divine Decree. 
There happened to come 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Auf and he had been absent in connection with some of his needs. He said: I have with me a knowledge of it, that I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If you hear of its presence (the presence of plague) in a land, don't enter it, but if it spreads in the land where you are, don't fly from it. Thereupon 'Umar b. Khattab praised Allah and then went back?
39.hi: Abdullah bin Abbas ne bayan kiya: Umar bin Khattab Syria ke liye nikle. Jab woh Sargh (Hijaz ke bagal mein ek shehar, Syria ke raaste mein) pahunche, unse fauj ke sardaar, Abu Ubaida bin Jandb, aur unke saathi mile. Unhone unhe bataya ki Syria mein ek aafat phail gayi hai. Ibn Abbas ne aage kaha ki Umar ne kaha: Sabse purane prawaasiyon ko mere paas bulaao. To maine unhe bulaaya. Unhone (Hazrat Umar ne) unse salaah maangi, aur unhone unhe bataya ki Syria mein aafat phail gayi hai. Rai mein antar tha (ki kya unhe aage badhna chahiye ya aisi haalat mein apne gharon ko wapas jaana chahiye). Unmein se kuch ne kaha: Aap (Umar) ek kaam ke liye nikle hain, is liye hum aapko wapas jaane ki salaah nahi denge, jabki kuch ne kaha: Aapke saath (muqaddas jamaat ke) log aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke (barkat waale) sahaba hain, is liye hum aapko is aafat ki taraf badhne ki salaah nahi denge (aise uchcha logon ke saath aur unhe jaanboojh kar khatre mein daalne ki). Unhone (Hazrat Umar ne) kaha: Ab tum jaa sakte ho. Unhone kaha: Ansar ko mere paas bulaao. To maine unhe unke paas bulaaya, aur unhone unse salaah maangi, aur woh usi raaste par chale jaise Muhajirin chale the, aur unki rai mein bhi ussi tarah antar tha jaise pehle ke logon mein tha. Unhone kaha: Ab tum jaa sakte ho. Unhone phir kaha: Quraish ke un boodhe logon ko bulaao jinhone Fatah (yaani Makkah ki Fatah) se pehle hijrat ki thi, is liye maine unhe bulaaya (aur Hazrat Umar ne unse salaah maangi) aur do se zyada logon ne (pehle ke numainda mandal se) asahmati nahi jataayi. Unhone kaha: Humari rai hai ki aapko logon ke saath wapas jaana chahiye aur unhe is aafat ki taraf mat jaane dijiye. To Umar ne logon ko ailaan kiya: Subah main apni sawaari ki peeth par hunga. To woh (subah nikale), isper Abu Ubaida bin Jarrah ne kaha: Kya aap Ilaahi Faisle se bhaag rahe hain? Isper Umar ne kaha: Kaash koi aur tumhare siwaay ye kehta! Umar ne (asal mein) unke virodh ko qubool nahi kiya aur unhone kaha: Haan, hum Ilaahi Faisle se (Doosre) Ilaahi Faisle ki taraf bhaag rahe hain. Tumhe sochna chahiye ki agar tumhare paas oont hote aur tum ek wadi mein utarte jismein do hisse hote, ek hariyaali se dhaka aur doosra banjar, kya tum Ilaahi Faisle ke mutabik nahi hoge agar tum unhe hariyaali mein charaao? Aur agar tum unhe banjar zameen mein charaao (tab bhi tum unhe) Ilaahi Faisle ke mutabik hi charaa rahe hoge. Abd al-Rahman bin Auf aaye jo apni kuch zaroorton ki wajah se gairhaazir the. Unhone kaha: Mere paas iske baare mein ilm hai, ki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Agar tum kisi zameen mein iski maujoodgi (mahamaari ki maujoodgi) ke baare mein suno, wahan mat jaao, lekin agar ye us zameen mein phaile jahan tum ho, wahan se mat bhaago. Isper Umar bin Khattab ne Allah ki tareef ki aur phir wapas chale gaye.

39.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ ابْنُ رَافِعٍ
 حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ مَالِكٍ
 وَزَادَ فِي حَدِيثِ مَعْمَرٍ قَالَ وَقَالَ لَهُ أَيْضًا أَرَأَيْتَ أَنَّهُ لَوْ رَعَى الْجَدْبَةَ وَتَرَكَ الْخَصْبَةَ أَكُنْتَ
 مُعَجِّزَهُ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَسِرْ إِذًا ‏.‏ قَالَ فَسَارَ حَتَّى أَتَى الْمَدِينَةَ فَقَالَ هَذَا الْمَحِلُّ ‏.‏ أَوْ
 قَالَ هَذَا الْمَنْزِلُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ ‏.‏
39.en: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Ma'mar with the same chain of transmitters but with this addition: " Do you think that he would graze in the barren land but would abandon the green land? Would you not attribute it to be a failing on his part? He said: Yes. He said: Then proceed. And he moved on until he came to Medina. And he said to me: This is the right place, or he said: That is the destination if Allah so wills."
39.hi: Ye hadees Ma'mar ki sanad se isi sanad se is izafe ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai: "Kya tumhe lagta hai ki woh banjar zameen mein charaaega lekin hariyaali waali zameen chhod dega? Kya tum ise uski taraf se ek galti nahi maanoge? Unhone kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: Phir aage badho. Aur woh aage badhe yahan tak ki woh Madina pahunche. Aur unhone mujhse kaha: Ye sahi jagah hai, ya unhone kaha: Ye manzil hai agar Allah ne chaaha."

39.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ،
 عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ إِنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ الْحَارِثِ حَدَّثَهُ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ عَبْدِ
 اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ‏.‏
39.en: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of 'Abdullah b. Harith with a slight variation of wording.
39.hi: Ye hadees Abdullah bin Harith ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

39.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ،
 عَامِرِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ أَنَّ عُمَرَ، خَرَجَ إِلَى الشَّامِ فَلَمَّا جَاءَ سَرْغَ بَلَغَهُ أَنَّ الْوَبَاءَ قَدْ وَقَعَ بِالشَّامِ
 ‏.‏ فَأَخْبَرَهُ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَوْفٍ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ إِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ
 بِهِ بِأَرْضٍ فَلاَ تَقْدَمُوا عَلَيْهِ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا وَقَعَ بِأَرْضٍ وَأَنْتُمْ بِهَا فَلاَ تَخْرُجُوا فِرَارًا مِنْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَرَجَعَ
 عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ مِنْ سَرْغَ ‏.‏ وَعَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَنَّ عُمَرَ إِنَّمَا انْصَرَفَ
 بِالنَّاسِ مِنْ حَدِيثِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ ‏.‏
