(The third occasion is this) when the (following) verse was revealed: "Let us summon our children and your children." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) called 'Ali, Fatima, Hasan and Husain and said: O Allah, they are my family.
44.hi: Amir bin Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas ne apne waalid ke hawale se ye riwayat ki ki Muawiya bin Abu Sufyan ne Sa'd ko Gavarnar muqarrar kiya aur kaha: Tumhe Abu Turab (Hazrat Ali (Alayhis Salam)) ki burai karne se kis cheez ne roka, isper unhone kaha: Ye teen baaton ki wajah se hai jo mujhe yaad hai ki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko unke baare mein kehte suna ki main unki burai nahi karunga, aur agar main inmein se koi ek cheez apne liye paata, to woh mujhe laal oonton se zyada aziz hoti. Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke baare mein ye kehte suna jab unhone unhe apne ek abhiyaan (yaani Tabuk) mein peeche chhod diya. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne unse kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aap mujhe auraton aur bachchon ke saath peeche chhod rahe hain. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha: Kya tum santusht nahi ho ki tum mere liye woh ho jo Harun Musa ke liye the is apwaad ke saath ki mere baad koi nabuwwat nahi hai. Aur maine (unhe) Khaibar ke din bhi ye kehte suna: Main zaroor ye jhanda us shakhs ko dunga jo Allah aur Uske Rasool se muhabbat karta hai, aur Allah aur Uske Rasool bhi usse muhabbat karte hain. Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Hum betaabi se iske intezaar mein the, jab unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko bulaao. Unhe bulaaya gaya aur unki aankhein sooji hui thin. Unhone unki aankhon par lar lagaayi aur jhanda unhe soonpa, aur Allah ne unhe jeet di. (Teesra mauka ye hai) jab (ye) aayat nazil hui: "Aao hum apne bachchon aur tumhare bachchon ko bulaaein." Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ali (Alayhis Salam), Fatima (Alayhas Salam), Hasan aur Husain ko bulaaya aur kaha: Aye Allah, ye mera khaandaan hai.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى،
 وَابْنُ بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، سَمِعْتُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
 بْنَ سَعْدٍ عَنْ سَعْدٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِعَلِيٍّ ‏
"‏ أَمَا تَرْضَى أَنْ تَكُونَ
 مِنِّي بِمَنْزِلَةِ هَارُونَ مِنْ مُوسَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏
44.en: Sa'd reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying to 'Ali: Aren't you satisfied with being unto me what Aaron was unto Moses?
44.hi: Sa'd ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Ali (Alayhis Salam) se ye kehte suna: Kya tum santusht nahi ho ki tum mere liye woh ho jo Harun Musa ke liye the?

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْقَارِيَّ - عَنْ 
 سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ ‏"‏ لأُعْطِيَنَّ
 هَذِهِ الرَّايَةَ رَجُلاً يُحِبُّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ يَفْتَحُ اللَّهُ عَلَى يَدَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ مَا أَحْبَبْتُ
 الإِمَارَةَ إِلاَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ - قَالَ - فَتَسَاوَرْتُ لَهَا رَجَاءَ أَنْ أُدْعَى لَهَا - قَالَ - فَدَعَا رَسُولُ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ فَأَعْطَاهُ إِيَّاهَا وَقَالَ ‏"‏ امْشِ وَلاَ تَلْتَفِتْ حَتَّى
 يَفْتَحَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَسَارَ عَلِيٌّ شَيْئًا ثُمَّ وَقَفَ وَلَمْ يَلْتَفِتْ فَصَرَخَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عَلَى
 مَاذَا أُقَاتِلُ النَّاسَ قَالَ ‏"‏ قَاتِلْهُمْ حَتَّى يَشْهَدُوا أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ
 فَإِذَا فَعَلُوا ذَلِكَ فَقَدْ مَنَعُوا مِنْكَ دِمَاءَهُمْ وَأَمْوَالَهُمْ إِلاَّ بِحَقِّهَا وَحِسَابُهُمْ عَلَى اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
44.en: Suhail reported on the authority of Abu Huraira that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said on the Day of Khaibar: I shall certainly give this standard in the hand of one who loves Allah and his Messenger and Allah will grant victory at his hand. Umar b. Khattab said: Never did I cherish for leadership but on that day. I came before him with the hope that I may be called for this, but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) called 'Ali b. Abu Talib and he conferred (this honour) upon him and said: Proceed on and do not look about until Allah grants you victory, and 'Ali went a bit and then halted and did not look about and then said in a loud voice: Allah's Messenger, on what issue should I fight with the people? Thereupon he (the Prophet) said: Fight with them until they bear testimony to the fact that there is no god but Allah and Muhammad is his Messenger, and when they do that then their blood and their riches are inviolable from your hands but what is justified by law and their reckoning is with Allah.
44.hi: Suhail ne Abu Huraira ke hawale se ye riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Khaibar ke din kaha: Main zaroor ye jhanda us shakhs ke haath mein dunga jo Allah aur Uske Rasool se muhabbat karta hai aur jiske haath se Allah jeet dega. Umar bin Khattab ne kaha: Maine kabhi netritva ki khwaish nahi ki siwaay us din ke. Main is ummeed mein unke saamne aaya ki mujhe iske liye bulaaya jaaye, lekin Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ko bulaaya aur unhe (ye samman) diya aur kaha: Aage badho aur idhar-udhar mat dekho jab tak Allah tumhe jeet na de, aur Ali (Alayhis Salam) thoda aage badhe aur phir ruke aur idhar-udhar nahi dekha aur phir buland aawaaz mein kaha: Allah ke Rasool, main kis maamle par logon se larun? Isper unhone (Nabi ne) kaha: Unse tab tak laro jab tak woh is baat ki gawaahi na dein ki Allah ke siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai aur Muhammad Uske Rasool hain, aur jab woh aisa karein to unka khoon aur unki daulat tumhare haathon se apathya hai siwaay uske jise kaanoon munasib maane, aur unka hisaab Allah ke paas hai.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ أَبِي حَازِمٍ - عَنْ أَبِي،
 حَازِمٍ عَنْ سَهْلٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ هَذَا - حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ
 عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ - عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي سَهْلُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 قَالَ يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ ‏"‏ لأُعْطِيَنَّ هَذِهِ الرَّايَةَ رَجُلاً يَفْتَحُ اللَّهُ عَلَى يَدَيْهِ يُحِبُّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَيُحِبُّهُ
 اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَبَاتَ النَّاسُ يَدُوكُونَ لَيْلَتَهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ يُعْطَاهَا - قَالَ - فَلَمَّا أَصْبَحَ
 النَّاسُ غَدَوْا عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كُلُّهُمْ يَرْجُونَ أَنْ يُعْطَاهَا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَيْنَ
 عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي طَالِبٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا هُوَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ يَشْتَكِي عَيْنَيْهِ - قَالَ - فَأَرْسَلُوا إِلَيْهِ
 فَأُتِيَ بِهِ فَبَصَقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي عَيْنَيْهِ وَدَعَا لَهُ فَبَرَأَ حَتَّى كَأَنْ لَمْ
 يَكُنْ بِهِ وَجَعٌ فَأَعْطَاهُ الرَّايَةَ فَقَالَ عَلِيٌّ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أُقَاتِلُهُمْ حَتَّى يَكُونُوا مِثْلَنَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ
 ‏"‏ انْفُذْ عَلَى رِسْلِكَ حَتَّى تَنْزِلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ ثُمَّ ادْعُهُمْ إِلَى الإِسْلاَمِ وَأَخْبِرْهُمْ بِمَا يَجِبُ عَلَيْهِمْ
 مِنْ حَقِّ اللَّهِ فِيهِ فَوَاللَّهِ لأَنْ يَهْدِيَ اللَّهُ بِكَ رَجُلاً وَاحِدًا خَيْرٌ لَكَ مِنْ أَنْ يَكُونَ لَكَ حُمْرُ النَّعَمِ
 ‏"‏ ‏.‏
44.en: Sahl b. Sa'd reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said on the Day of Khaibar: I would certainly give this standard to a person at whose hand Allah would grant victory and who loves Allah and His Messenger and Allah and His Messenger love him also. The people spent the night thinking as to whom it would be given. When it was morning the people hastened to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) all of them hoping that that would be given to him. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Where is 'Ali b. Abu Talib? They said: Allah's Messenger, his eyes are sore. He then sent for him and he was brought and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) applied saliva to his eyes and invoked blessings and he was all right, as if he had no ailment at all, and conferred upon him the standard. 'Ali said: Allah's Messenger, I will fight them until they are like us. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Advance cautiously until you reach their open places, thereafter invite them to Islam and inform them what is obligatory for them from the rights of Allah, for, by Allah, if Allah guides aright even one person through you that is better for you than to possess the most valuable of the camels.
44.hi: Sahl bin Sa'd ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Khaibar ke din kaha: Main zaroor ye jhanda us shakhs ko dunga jiske haath se Allah jeet dega aur jo Allah aur Uske Rasool se muhabbat karta hai aur Allah aur Uske Rasool bhi usse muhabbat karte hain. Log raat bhar sochte rahe ki ye kise diya jaayega. Jab subah hui, log Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas jaldi aaye sab ye ummeed karte hue ki ye unhe diya jaayega. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) kahan hain? Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, unki aankhein dukh rahi hain. Phir unhone unhe bulwaaya aur unhe laaya gaya aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unki aankhon par lar lagaayi aur barkat maangi aur woh theek ho gaye, jaise unhe koi taklif hi na thi, aur unhe jhanda soonpa. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, main unse larunga jab tak woh humaari tarah na ho jaayein. Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Savdhaani se aage badho jab tak tum unki khuli jagahon tak na pahunch jao, phir unhe Islam ka nimantran do aur unhe bataao unki Allah ke prati kya zimmedaariyaan hain, kyunki, Allah ki qasam, agar Allah tumhare zariye ek shakhs ko bhi sahi raah dikhaata hai, ye tumhare liye behtareen oonton ke maalik hone se behtar hai.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ إِسْمَاعِيلَ - عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي،
 عُبَيْدٍ عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ الأَكْوَعِ، قَالَ كَانَ عَلِيٌّ قَدْ تَخَلَّفَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي
 خَيْبَرَ وَكَانَ رَمِدًا فَقَالَ أَنَا أَتَخَلَّفُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَخَرَجَ عَلِيٌّ
 فَلَحِقَ بِالنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمَّا كَانَ مَسَاءُ اللَّيْلَةِ الَّتِي فَتَحَهَا اللَّهُ فِي صَبَاحِهَا
 قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ لأُعْطِيَنَّ الرَّايَةَ - أَوْ لَيَأْخُذَنَّ بِالرَّايَةِ - غَدًا رَجُلٌ
 يُحِبُّهُ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَوْ قَالَ يُحِبُّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ يَفْتَحُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَإِذَا نَحْنُ بِعَلِيٍّ وَمَا
 نَرْجُوهُ فَقَالُوا هَذَا عَلِيٌّ ‏.‏ فَأَعْطَاهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الرَّايَةَ فَفَتَحَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ
 ‏.‏
44.en: Salama b. Akwa' reported that it was 'Ali whom Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) left behind him (in the charge of his family and the Islamic State) on the occasion of the campaign of Khaibar, and his eyes were inflamed and he said: Is it for me to remain behind Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? So he went forth and rejoined Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and on the evening of that night (after which) next morning Allah granted victory. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I will certainly give this standard to a man whom Allah and His Messenger love. or he said: Who loves Allah or His Messenger and Allah will grant him victory through him, and, lo, we saw 'Ali whom we least expected (to be present on that occasion). They (the Companions) said: Here is 'Ali. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon hin) gave him the standard. Allah granted victory at his hand.
44.hi: Salama bin Akwa ne bayan kiya ki Ali (Alayhis Salam) the jinhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Khaibar ki muhim ke mauke par apne peeche (apne khaandaan aur Islami hukumat ki zimmedaari mein) chhoda tha, aur unki aankhein sooji hui thin aur unhone kaha: Kya main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se peeche rehun? Is liye woh aage nikle aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se dobara aa mile aur us raat ki shaam (jiske) agli subah Allah ne jeet di. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Main zaroor ye jhanda us aadmi ko dunga jise Allah aur Uske Rasool muhabbat karte hain, ya unhone kaha: Jo Allah ya Uske Rasool se muhabbat karta hai aur Allah use uske zariye jeet dega, aur dekho, humne Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko dekha jinki humein kam se kam ummeed thi (us mauke par unki maujoodgi ki). Unhone (sahaba ne) kaha: Ye rahe Ali (Alayhis Salam). Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe jhanda diya. Allah ne unke haath se jeet di.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَشُجَاعُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ، قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا 
 إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو حَيَّانَ، حَدَّثَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ حَيَّانَ، قَالَ انْطَلَقْتُ أَنَا وَحُصَيْنُ،
 بْنُ سَبْرَةَ وَعُمَرُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ إِلَى زَيْدِ بْنِ أَرْقَمَ فَلَمَّا جَلَسْنَا إِلَيْهِ قَالَ لَهُ حُصَيْنٌ لَقَدْ لَقِيتَ يَا
 زَيْدُ خَيْرًا كَثِيرًا رَأَيْتَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَسَمِعْتَ حَدِيثَهُ وَغَزَوْتَ مَعَهُ وَصَلَّيْتَ
 خَلْفَهُ لَقَدْ لَقِيتَ يَا زَيْدُ خَيْرًا كَثِيرًا حَدِّثْنَا يَا زَيْدُ مَا سَمِعْتَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم - قَالَ - يَا ابْنَ أَخِي وَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ كَبِرَتْ سِنِّي وَقَدُمَ عَهْدِي وَنَسِيتُ بَعْضَ الَّذِي كُنْتُ
 أَعِي مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَمَا حَدَّثْتُكُمْ فَاقْبَلُوا وَمَا لاَ فَلاَ تُكَلِّفُونِيهِ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ
 قَالَ قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمًا فِينَا خَطِيبًا بِمَاءٍ يُدْعَى خُمًّا بَيْنَ مَكَّةَ
 وَالْمَدِينَةِ فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ وَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ وَوَعَظَ وَذَكَّرَ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَمَّا بَعْدُ أَلاَ أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ فَإِنَّمَا
 أَنَا بَشَرٌ يُوشِكُ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ رَسُولُ رَبِّي فَأُجِيبَ وَأَنَا تَارِكٌ فِيكُمْ ثَقَلَيْنِ أَوَّلُهُمَا كِتَابُ اللَّهِ فِيهِ
 الْهُدَى وَالنُّورُ فَخُذُوا بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ وَاسْتَمْسِكُوا بِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَحَثَّ عَلَى كِتَابِ اللَّهِ وَرَغَّبَ فِيهِ ثُمَّ
 قَالَ ‏"‏ وَأَهْلُ بَيْتِي أُذَكِّرُكُمُ اللَّهَ فِي أَهْلِ بَيْتِي أُذَكِّرُكُمُ اللَّهَ فِي أَهْلِ بَيْتِي أُذَكِّرُكُمُ اللَّهَ فِي
 أَهْلِ بَيْتِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ حُصَيْنٌ وَمَنْ أَهْلُ بَيْتِهِ يَا زَيْدُ أَلَيْسَ نِسَاؤُهُ مِنْ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ قَالَ
 نِسَاؤُهُ مِنْ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ وَلَكِنْ أَهْلُ بَيْتِهِ مَنْ حُرِمَ الصَّدَقَةَ بَعْدَهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَمَنْ هُمْ قَالَ هُمْ آلُ
 عَلِيٍّ وَآلُ عَقِيلٍ وَآلُ جَعْفَرٍ وَآلُ عَبَّاسٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ كُلُّ هَؤُلاَءِ حُرِمَ الصَّدَقَةَ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏
44.en: Yazid b. Hayyan reported, I went along with Husain b. Sabra and 'Umar b. Muslim to Zaid b. Arqam and, as we sat by his side, Husain said to him: Zaid. you have been able to acquire a great virtue that you saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) listened to his talk, fought by his side in (different) battles, offered prayer behind me. Zaid, you have in fact earned a great virtue. Zaid, narrate to us what you heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He said: I have grown old and have almost spent my age and I have forgotten some of the things which I remembered in connection with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), so accept whatever I narrate to you, and which I do not narrate do not compel me to do that. He then said: One day Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up to deliver sermon at a watering place known as Khumm situated between Mecca and Medina. He praised Allah, extolled Him and delivered the sermon and. exhorted (us) and said: Now to our purpose. O people, I am a human being. I am about to receive a messenger (the angel of death) from my Lord and I, in response to Allah's call, (would bid good-bye to you), but I am leaving among you two weighty things: the one being the Book of Allah in which there is right guidance and light, so hold fast to the Book of Allah and adhere to it. He exhorted (us) (to hold fast) to the Book of Allah and then said: The second are the members of my household I remind you (of your duties) to the members of my family. He (Husain) said to Zaid: Who are the members of his household? Aren't his wives the members of his family? Thereupon he said: His wives are the members of his family (but here) the members of his family are those for whom acceptance of Zakat is forbidden. And he said: Who are they? Thereupon he said: 'Ali and the offspring of 'Ali, 'Aqil and the offspring of 'Aqil and the offspring of Ja'far and the offspring of 'Abbas. Husain said: These are those for whom the acceptance of Zakat is forbidden. Zaid said: Yes.
44.hi: Yazid bin Hayyan ne bayan kiya: Main Husain bin Sabra aur Umar bin Muslim ke saath Zaid bin Arqam ke paas gaya aur jab hum unke qareeb baithe, Husain ne unse kaha: Zaid, tumne ek badi punyapurnata haasil ki hai ki tumne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko dekha, unki baat suni, unke saath (mukhtalif) jungon mein lade, unke peeche namaz padhi. Zaid, tumne waastav mein ek badi punyapurnata kamaayi hai. Zaid, humein woh riwayat karo jo tumne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna. Unhone kaha: Main boodha ho gaya hoon aur lagbhag apni umar guzaar chuka hoon aur maine kuch cheezein bhula di hain jo mujhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke silsile mein yaad thin, is liye jo main tumhe riwayat karta hoon use qubool karo, aur jise main riwayat nahi karta use karne ke liye mujhe majboor mat karo. Phir unhone kaha: Ek din Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Khumm naamak paani ki jagah par khutba dene khade hue jo Makkah aur Madina ke beech sthit hai. Unhone Allah ki tareef ki, uski hamd ki aur khutba diya aur (humein) prerit kiya aur kaha: Ab humare maqsad par aate hain. Aye logo, main ek insaan hoon. Main apne Rab se ek doot (Maut ka Farishta) paane wala hoon aur main, Allah ke bulaave ke jawaab mein, (tumhe vida kahunga), lekin main tumhare beech do bhaari cheezein chhod raha hoon: ek Allah ki Kitaab hai jismein sahi margdarshan aur roshni hai, is liye Allah ki Kitaab ko mazbooti se pakdo aur uska paalan karo. Unhone (humein) Allah ki Kitaab (ko mazbooti se pakadne ke liye) prerit kiya aur phir kaha: Doosri cheez mere khaandaan ke sadasya hain, main tumhe (tumhare kartavyon ke baare mein) apne khaandaan ke prati yaad dilaata hoon. Unhone (Husain ne) Zaid se kaha: Unke khaandaan ke sadasya kaun hain? Kya unki zaujaen unke khaandaan ki sadasya nahi hain? Isper unhone kaha: Unki zaujaen unke khaandaan ki sadasya hain (lekin yahan) khaandaan ke sadasya woh hain jinke liye Zakat qubool karna mana hai. Aur unhone kaha: Woh kaun hain? Isper unhone kaha: Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki aulaad, Aqil aur Aqil ki aulaad aur Ja'far ki aulaad aur Abbas ki aulaad. Husain ne kaha: Ye woh hain jinke liye Zakat qubool karna mana hai. Zaid ne kaha: Haan.

44.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكَّارِ بْنِ الرَّيَّانِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَسَّانُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ - عَنْ 
 سَعِيدِ بْنِ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ حَيَّانَ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَرْقَمَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِنَحْوِهِ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ زُهَيْرٍ ‏.‏
44.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zaid b. Arqam through another chain of transmitters.
44.hi: Ye hadees Zaid bin Arqam ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
 أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ أَبِي حَيَّانَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَزَادَ فِي حَدِيثِ
 جَرِيرٍ ‏
"‏ كِتَابُ اللَّهِ فِيهِ الْهُدَى وَالنُّورُ مَنِ اسْتَمْسَكَ بِهِ وَأَخَذَ بِهِ كَانَ عَلَى الْهُدَى وَمَنْ أَخْطَأَهُ
 ضَلَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
44.en: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Hayyan but with this addition: " The Book of Allah contains right guidance, the light, and whoever adheres to it and holds it fast, he is upon right guidance and whosoever deviates from it goes astray.
44.hi: Ye hadees Abu Hayyan ki sanad se is izafe ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai: "Allah ki Kitaab mein sahi margdarshan hai, roshni hai, aur jo koi ise mazbooti se pakDta hai aur qaayam rehta hai, woh sahi margdarshan par hai aur jo isse bhatakta hai woh gumraah ho jaata hai."

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكَّارِ بْنِ الرَّيَّانِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَسَّانُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ - عَنْ سَعِيدٍ،
 - وَهُوَ ابْنُ مَسْرُوقٍ - عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ حَيَّانَ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَرْقَمَ، قَالَ دَخَلْنَا عَلَيْهِ فَقُلْنَا لَهُ
 لَقَدْ رَأَيْتَ خَيْرًا ‏.‏ لَقَدْ صَاحَبْتَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَصَلَّيْتَ خَلْفَهُ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ
 بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ أَبِي حَيَّانَ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏
"‏ أَلاَ وَإِنِّي تَارِكٌ فِيكُمْ ثَقَلَيْنِ أَحَدُهُمَا كِتَابُ اللَّهِ عَزَّ
 وَجَلَّ هُوَ حَبْلُ اللَّهِ مَنِ اتَّبَعَهُ كَانَ عَلَى الْهُدَى وَمَنْ تَرَكَهُ كَانَ عَلَى ضَلاَلَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِيهِ فَقُلْنَا
 مَنْ أَهْلُ بَيْتِهِ نِسَاؤُهُ قَالَ لاَ وَايْمُ اللَّهِ إِنَّ الْمَرْأَةَ تَكُونُ مَعَ الرَّجُلِ الْعَصْرَ مِنَ الدَّهْرِ ثُمَّ يُطَلِّقُهَا
 فَتَرْجِعُ إِلَى أَبِيهَا وَقَوْمِهَا أَهْلُ بَيْتِهِ أَصْلُهُ وَعَصَبَتُهُ الَّذِينَ حُرِمُوا الصَّدَقَةَ بَعْدَهُ ‏.‏
44.en: Yazid b. Hayyan reported: We went to him (Zaid b. Arqam) and said to him. You have found goodness (for you had the honour) to live in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and offered prayer behind him, and the rest of the hadith is the same but with this variation of wording that lie said: Behold, for I am leaving amongst you two weighty things, one of which is the Book of Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, and that is the rope of Allah. He who holds it fast would be on right guidance and he who abandons it would be in error, and in this (hadith) these words are also found: We said: Who are amongst the members of the household? Aren't the wives (of the Holy Prophet) included amongst the members of his house hold? Thereupon he said: No, by Allah, a woman lives with a man (as his wife) for a certain period; he then divorces her and she goes back to her parents and to her people; the members of his household include his ownself and his kith and kin (who are related to him by blood) and for him the acceptance of Zakat is prohibited.
44.hi: Yazid bin Hayyan ne bayan kiya: Hum unke (Zaid bin Arqam ke) paas gaye aur unse kaha: Aapne achhaai paayi hai (kyunki aapko) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein rehne aur unke peeche namaz padhne ka samman mila. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai lekin is alfaazon ke antar ke saath ki unhone kaha: Dekho, main tumhare beech do bhaari cheezein chhod raha hoon, jinmein se ek Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ki Kitaab hai aur ye Allah ki rassi hai. Jo ise mazbooti se pakdta hai woh sahi margdarshan par hoga aur jo ise chhodta hai woh galat raaste par hoga, aur ismein ye alfaaz bhi milte hain: Humne kaha: Khaandaan ke sadasya kaun hain? Kya (Nabi-e-Paak ki) zaujaen unke khaandaan ki sadasya nahi hain? Isper unhone kaha: Nahi, Allah ki qasam, ek aurat ek shakhs ke saath (uski zauja ke soorat mein) ek muayyan muddat tak rehti hai; woh phir use talaaq deta hai aur woh apne maa-baap aur apne logon ke paas wapas chali jaati hai; unke khaandaan ke sadasya unke khud aur unke khoon ke rishtedaar log hain aur unke liye Zakat qubool karna mana hai.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ أَبِي حَازِمٍ - عَنْ أَبِي،
 حَازِمٍ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ اسْتُعْمِلَ عَلَى الْمَدِينَةِ رَجُلٌ مِنْ آلِ مَرْوَانَ - قَالَ - فَدَعَا
 سَهْلَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ فَأَمَرَهُ أَنْ يَشْتِمَ عَلِيًّا - قَالَ - فَأَبَى سَهْلٌ فَقَالَ لَهُ أَمَّا إِذْ أَبَيْتَ فَقُلْ لَعَنَ
 اللَّهُ أَبَا التُّرَابِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ سَهْلٌ مَا كَانَ لِعَلِيٍّ اسْمٌ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ أَبِي التُّرَابِ وَإِنْ كَانَ لَيَفْرَحُ
 إِذَا دُعِيَ بِهَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ أَخْبِرْنَا عَنْ قِصَّتِهِ لِمَ سُمِّيَ أَبَا تُرَابٍ قَالَ جَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم بَيْتَ فَاطِمَةَ فَلَمْ يَجِدْ عَلِيًّا فِي الْبَيْتِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَيْنَ ابْنُ عَمِّكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ
 كَانَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ شَىْءٌ فَغَاضَبَنِي فَخَرَجَ فَلَمْ يَقِلْ عِنْدِي فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم لإِنْسَانٍ ‏"‏ انْظُرْ أَيْنَ هُوَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَجَاءَ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هُوَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ رَاقِدٌ ‏.‏ فَجَاءَهُ
 رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ مُضْطَجِعٌ قَدْ سَقَطَ رِدَاؤُهُ عَنْ شِقِّهِ فَأَصَابَهُ تُرَابٌ
 فَجَعَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَمْسَحُهُ عَنْهُ وَيَقُولُ ‏"‏ قُمْ أَبَا التُّرَابِ قُمْ أَبَا التُّرَابِ
 ‏"‏ ‏.‏
44.en: Sahl b. Sa`d reported that a person from the offspring of Marwan was appointed as the governor of Medina. He called Sahl b. Sa`d and ordered him to abuse `Ali. Sahl refused to do that. He (the governor) said to him: If you do not agree to it (at least) say: May Allah curse Abu Turab. Sahl said: There was no name dearer to `Ali than Abu Turab (for it was given to him by the Prophet himself) and he felt delighted when he was called by this name. He (the governor) said to him: Narrate to us the story of his being named as Abu Turab. He said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to the house of Fatima and he did not find `Ali in the house; whereupon he said: Where is your uncle's son? She said: (There cropped up something) between me and him which had annoyed him with me. He went out and did not rest here. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked a person to find out where he was. He came and said: Allah's Messenger, he is sleeping in the mosque. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to him and found him lying in the mosque and saw that his mantle had slipped from his back and his back was covered with dust and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) began to wipe it away from him (from the body of Hadrat `Ali) saying: Get up, covered with dust (Abu Turab); get up, covered with dust.
44.hi: Sahl bin Sa'd ne bayan kiya ki Marwan ki aulaad mein se ek shakhs Madina ka gavarnar muqarrar kiya gaya. Unhone Sahl bin Sa'd ko bulaaya aur Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko bura-bhala kehne ka hukum diya. Sahl ne aisa karne se inkaar kiya. Unhone (gavarnar ne) unse kaha: Agar tum isse sehmat nahi ho, to (kam se kam) kaho: Allah Abu Turab par laanat kare. Sahl ne kaha: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke liye Abu Turab se zyada aziz koi naam nahi tha (kyunki ye khud Nabi-e-Paak ne diya tha) aur woh khush hote the jab unhe is naam se pukaara jaata. Unhone (gavarnar ne) unse kaha: Unke Abu Turab naam rakhe jaane ki kahani humein sunao. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ke ghar aaye aur unhone Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko ghar mein nahi paaya; isper unhone kaha: Tumhare chacha ka beta kahan hai? Unhone kaha: (Humare beech kuch hua) jisne unhe mujhse naaraaz kiya. Woh bahar gaye aur yahan aaraam nahi kiya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek shakhs se poocha ki woh kahan hain. Woh aaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, woh masjid mein so rahe hain. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unke paas aaye aur unhe masjid mein lete paaya aur dekha ki unka chogha unki peeth se phisal gaya tha aur unki peeth mitti se dhaki thi aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ise unse (Hazrat Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke badan se) safai karne lage ye kehte hue: utho, mitti se dhake hue (Abu Turab); utho, mitti se dhake hue.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ،
 عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَامِرِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ أَرِقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 ذَاتَ لَيْلَةٍ فَقَالَ لَيْتَ رَجُلاً صَالِحًا مِنْ أَصْحَابِي يَحْرُسُنِي اللَّيْلَةَ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَسَمِعْنَا صَوْتَ السِّلاَحِ
 فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ مَنْ هَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ سَعْدُ بْنُ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ يَا رَسُولَ
 اللَّهِ جِئْتُ أَحْرُسُكَ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَنَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى سَمِعْتُ غَطِيطَهُ
 ‏.‏
44.en: 'A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) lay on bed during one night and said: Were there a pious person from amongst my companions who should keep a watch for me during the nightt? She said: We heard the noise of arms, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Who is it? And Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas said: Allah's MesseDger. I have come to serve as your sentinel. 'A'isha said: Allah' s Messenger (ﷺ) slept (such a sound sleep) that I heard the noise of his snoring.
44.hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek raat bistar par lete aur kaha: Kaash mere saathiyon mein se koi nekokaar shakhs hota jo raat bhar mera pahra de. Unhone kaha: Humne hathiyaaron ki aawaaz suni, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Ye kaun hai? Aur Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, main aapka pahredaar bankar aaya hoon. Aisha ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) itni gehri neend soye ki maine unke kharraaTon ki aawaaz suni.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ 
 يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَامِرِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ سَهِرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم مَقْدَمَهُ الْمَدِينَةَ لَيْلَةً فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لَيْتَ رَجُلاً صَالِحًا مِنْ أَصْحَابِي يَحْرُسُنِي اللَّيْلَةَ
 ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَبَيْنَا نَحْنُ كَذَلِكَ سَمِعْنَا خَشْخَشَةَ سِلاَحٍ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ هَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ سَعْدُ بْنُ
 أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا جَاءَ بِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَقَعَ فِي
 نَفْسِي خَوْفٌ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَجِئْتُ أَحْرُسُهُ ‏.‏ فَدَعَا لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ نَامَ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ ابْنِ رُمْحٍ فَقُلْنَا مَنْ هَذَا
44.en: 'A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) laid down on bed during one night on his arrival at Medina and said: Were there a pious person from amongst my Companions who should keep a watch for me durin. the night? She (A'isha) reported: We were in this state that we heard the clanging noise of arms. lie (the Holy Prophet) said: Who is it? He said: This is Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him: What brings you here? Thereupon he said: I harboured fear (lest any harm should come to) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), so I came to serve as your sentinel. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) invoked blessings upon him. He then slept. This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ibn Rumh with a slight variation of wording.
44.hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Madina pahunchne ke baad ek raat bistar par lete aur kaha: Kaash mere sahaba mein se koi nekokaar shakhs hota jo raat bhar mera pahra de. Unhone (Aisha ne) bayaan ki: Hum is haalat mein the ki humne hathiyaaron ki khadkhadaahat suni. Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Ye kaun hai? Unhone kaha: Ye Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas hain. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha: Tumhe yahan kya laaya? Isper unhone kaha: Mujhe (Allah ke Rasool ko koi nuksaan pahunchne ka) dar hua, is liye main aapka pahredaar bankar aaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unke liye barkat maangi. Phir woh so gaye. Ye hadees Ibn Rumh ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، سَمِعْتُ يَحْيَى بْنَ سَعِيدٍ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ 
 عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَامِرِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ أَرِقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَاتَ
 لَيْلَةٍ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ بِلاَلٍ ‏.‏
44.en: 'Abdullah b. 'Amir b. Rabi reported A'isha as saying: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went to bed one night; the rest of the hadith is the same.
44.hi: Abdullah bin Amir bin Rabi ne Aisha ko ye kehte suna: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek raat bistar par gaye; baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورُ بْنُ أَبِي مُزَاحِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَعْدٍ - عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ 
 عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ شَدَّادٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَلِيًّا، يَقُولُ مَا جَمَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَبَوَيْهِ
 لأَحَدٍ غَيْرَ سَعْدِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ فَإِنَّهُ جَعَلَ يَقُولُ لَهُ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ ‏
"‏ ارْمِ فِدَاكَ أَبِي وَأُمِّي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
44.en: `Abdullah b. Shaddad reported that he heard `Ali saying: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not gather his parents except in case of Sa`d b. Malik that he said to him on the Day of Uhud: Shoot an arrow, may my father and mother be taken as ransom for you.
44.hi: Abdullah bin Shaddad ne bayan kiya ki unhone Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko ye kehte suna: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne apne maa-baap ko kabhi ikattha nahi kiya siwaay Sa'd bin Malik ke maamle mein ki unhone Uhud ke din unse kaha: Teer chalaao, mere maa-baap tumpar qurbaan ho jaayein.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، ح
 وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، ح حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ،
 عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ بِشْرٍ، عَنْ مِسْعَرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مِسْعَرٍ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ 
 سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ شَدَّادٍ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ
 ‏.‏
44.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Ali through another chain of transmitters.
44.hi: Ye hadees Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ بِلاَلٍ - عَنْ 
 يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ سَعِيدٍ - عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، قَالَ لَقَدْ جَمَعَ لِي رَسُولُ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَبَوَيْهِ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ ‏.‏
44.en: Sa'd b Abi Waqqqs said: Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) gathered his parents for me on the Day of Uhud.
44.hi: Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Uhud ke din mere liye apne maa-baap ko ikattha kiya.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَابْنُ، رُمْحٍ عَنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا 
 عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
44.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Yabyl b. Sa'id with the same chain of transmitters.
44.hi: Ye hadees Yahya bin Sa'id ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ إِسْمَاعِيلَ - عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ مِسْمَارٍ،
 عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَمَعَ لَهُ أَبَوَيْهِ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ
 كَانَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ قَدْ أَحْرَقَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ ارْمِ
 فِدَاكَ أَبِي وَأُمِّي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَنَزَعْتُ لَهُ بِسَهْمٍ لَيْسَ فِيهِ نَصْلٌ فَأَصَبْتُ جَنْبَهُ فَسَقَطَ فَانْكَشَفَتْ
 عَوْرَتُهُ فَضَحِكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى نَظَرْتُ إِلَى نَوَاجِذِهِ ‏.‏
44.en: 'Amir b. Sa'd reported oLi the authority of his father that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) gathered for him on the Day of Uhud his parents when a polytheist had set fire to (i. e. attacked fiercely) the Muslims. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said to him: (Sa'd), shoot an arrow, (Sa'd), may my mother and father be taken as ransom for you. I drew an arrow and I shot a featherless arrow at him aiming his side that lie fell down and his private parts were exposed. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) laughed that I saw his front teeth.
44.hi: Amir bin Sa'd ne apne waalid ke hawale se ye riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Uhud ke din unke liye unke maa-baap ko ikattha kiya jab ek mushrik ne Musalmaanon par (tez hamla karte hue) aag laga di thi. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha: (Sa'd), teer chalaao, (Sa'd), mere maa-baap tumpar qurbaan ho jaayein. Maine ek teer nikaala aur maine usper ek bina par ka teer chalaaya uski taraf nishaana lete hue jisse woh gir gaya aur uske gupt ang khul gaye. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) itna hanse ki maine unke agle daant dekhe.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُوسَى،
 حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سِمَاكُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي مُصْعَبُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ نَزَلَتْ فِيهِ آيَاتٌ
 مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ - قَالَ - حَلَفَتْ أُمُّ سَعْدٍ أَنْ لاَ تُكَلِّمَهُ أَبَدًا حَتَّى يَكْفُرَ بِدِينِهِ وَلاَ تَأْكُلَ وَلاَ تَشْرَبَ
 ‏.‏ قَالَتْ زَعَمْتَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ وَصَّاكَ بِوَالِدَيْكَ وَأَنَا أُمُّكَ وَأَنَا آمُرُكَ بِهَذَا ‏.‏ قَالَ مَكَثَتْ ثَلاَثًا حَتَّى
 غُشِيَ عَلَيْهَا مِنَ الْجَهْدِ فَقَامَ ابْنٌ لَهَا يُقَالُ لَهُ عُمَارَةُ فَسَقَاهَا فَجَعَلَتْ تَدْعُو عَلَى سَعْدٍ
 فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ فِي الْقُرْآنِ هَذِهِ الآيَةَ ‏{‏ وَوَصَّيْنَا الإِنْسَانَ بِوَالِدَيْهِ حُسْنًا‏}‏ ‏{‏ وَإِنْ جَاهَدَاكَ
 عَلَى أَنْ تُشْرِكَ بِي‏}‏ وَفِيهَا ‏{‏ وَصَاحِبْهُمَا فِي الدُّنْيَا مَعْرُوفًا‏}‏ قَالَ وَأَصَابَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم غَنِيمَةً عَظِيمَةً فَإِذَا فِيهَا سَيْفٌ فَأَخَذْتُهُ فَأَتَيْتُ بِهِ الرَّسُولَ صلى الله
 عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ نَفِّلْنِي هَذَا السَّيْفَ فَأَنَا مَنْ قَدْ عَلِمْتَ حَالَهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ رُدُّهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ أَخَذْتَهُ
 ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقْتُ حَتَّى إِذَا أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أُلْقِيَهُ فِي الْقَبَضِ لاَمَتْنِي نَفْسِي فَرَجَعْتُ إِلَيْهِ فَقُلْتُ أَعْطِنِيهِ
 ‏.‏ قَالَ فَشَدَّ لِي صَوْتَهُ ‏"‏ رُدُّهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ أَخَذْتَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏ يَسْأَلُونَكَ
 عَنِ الأَنْفَالِ‏}‏ قَالَ وَمَرِضْتُ فَأَرْسَلْتُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَتَانِي فَقُلْتُ دَعْنِي
 أَقْسِمْ مَالِي حَيْثُ شِئْتُ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَبَى ‏.‏ قُلْتُ فَالنِّصْفَ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَبَى ‏.‏ قُلْتُ فَالثُّلُثَ ‏.‏ قَالَ
 فَسَكَتَ فَكَانَ بَعْدُ الثُّلُثُ جَائِزًا ‏.‏ قَالَ وَأَتَيْتُ عَلَى نَفَرٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ وَالْمُهَاجِرِينَ فَقَالُوا
 تَعَالَ نُطْعِمْكَ وَنَسْقِيكَ خَمْرًا ‏.‏ وَذَلِكَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تُحَرَّمَ الْخَمْرُ - قَالَ - فَأَتَيْتُهُمْ فِي حَشٍّ
 - وَالْحَشُّ الْبُسْتَانُ - فَإِذَا رَأْسُ جَزُورٍ مَشْوِيٌّ عِنْدَهُمْ وَزِقٌّ مِنْ خَمْرٍ - قَالَ - فَأَكَلْتُ
 وَشَرِبْتُ مَعَهُمْ - قَالَ - فَذُكِرَتِ الأَنْصَارُ وَالْمُهَاجِرُونَ عِنْدَهُمْ فَقُلْتُ الْمُهَاجِرُونَ خَيْرٌ مِنَ
 الأَنْصَارِ - قَالَ - فَأَخَذَ رَجُلٌ أَحَدَ لَحْيَىِ الرَّأْسِ فَضَرَبَنِي بِهِ فَجَرَحَ بِأَنْفِي فَأَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ فِيَّ - يَعْنِي نَفْسَهُ - شَأْنَ الْخَمْرِ
 ‏{‏ إِنَّمَا الْخَمْرُ وَالْمَيْسِرُ وَالأَنْصَابُ وَالأَزْلاَمُ رِجْسٌ مِنْ عَمَلِ الشَّيْطَانِ‏}‏
44.en: Mus'ab b. Sa'd reported on the authority of his father that many verses of the Qur'an had been revealed in connection with him. His mother Umm Sa'd had taken oath that she would never talk with him until he abandoned his faith and she neither ate nor drank and said: Allah has commanded you to treat well your parents and I am your mother and I command you to do this. She passed three days in this state until she fainted because of extreme hunger and at that time her son whose name was Umara stood up and served her drink and she began to curse Sa'd that Allah, the Exalted and Glorions, revealed these verses of the Holy Qur'an:" And We have enjoined upon a person goodness to his parents but if they contend with thee to associate (others) with Me of which you have no knowledge, then obey them not" (xxix. 8) ; Treat thein with customary good in this world" (xxxi. 15). He also reported that there fell to the lot of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) huge spoils of war and there was one sword in them. I picked that up and came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Bestow this sword upon me (as my share in the spoils of war) and you know my state. Thereupon he said: Return it to the place from where you picked it up. I went back until I decided to throw it in a store but my soul repulsed me so I came back and asked him to give that sword to me. He said in a loud voice to return it to the place from where I had picked it up. It was on this occasion that this verse was revealed:" They asked about the spoils of war" (viii. 1). He further said: I once fell ill and sent a message to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). He visited me and I said to him: Permit me to distribute (in charity) my property as much as I like. He did not agree. I said: (Permit me to distribute) half of it. He did not agree. I said: (Permit me to distribute) the third part, whereupon he kept quiet and it was after this (that the distribution of one's property in charity) to the extent of one-third was held valid. He further said: I came to a group of persons of the Ansir and Muhajirin and they said: Come, so that we may serve you wine, and it was before the use of wine had been prohibited. I went to them in a garden and there had been with them the roasted head of a camel and a small water-skin containing wine. I ate and drank along with them and there came under discussion the Ansr (Helpers) and Muhajirin (immigrants). I said: The immigrants are better than the Ansar, that a person picked up a portion of the head (of the camel and struck me with it that my nose was injured. I came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and informed him of the situation that Aliah, the Exalted and Glorious, revealed verses pertaining to wine:" Intoxicants and the games of chance and (sacrificing to) stones set up and (divining by) arrows are only an uncleanliness, the devil's work" (v. 90).
44.hi: Mus'ab bin Sa'd ne apne waalid ke hawale se ye riwayat ki ki Quran ki bahut si aayaten unke silsile mein nazil hui thin. Unki maa Umm Sa'd ne qasam khayi thi ki woh tab tak unse baat nahi karengi jab tak woh apna imaan chhod na dein aur unhone na khaana khaya na paani piya aur kaha: Allah ne tumhe apne maa-baap ke saath achha vyavahaar karne ka hukum diya hai aur main tumhaari maa hoon aur main tumhe ye karne ka hukum deti hoon. Unhone teen din is haalat mein guzaare yahan tak ki woh atyadhik bhookh ki wajah se behosh ho gayin aur us waqt unke bete jiska naam Umara tha khade hue aur unhe peene ke liye kuch diya aur woh Sa'd ko bura-bhala kehne lagin ki Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne Muqaddas Quran ki ye aayaten nazil kin: "Aur Humne har shakhs ko apne maa-baap ke prati achhaai dikhaane ka hukum diya hai lekin agar woh tumse jhagda karein ki tum Mere saath (doosron ko) shareek karo jiske baare mein tumhe koi ilm nahi hai, to unki baat mat maano" (29:8); "Duniya mein unke saath prachalit riwaaz ke mutabik achha vyavahaar karo" (31:15). Unhone ye bhi riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke hisse mein jung ke bade maal-e-ganimat aaye aur unmein ek talwaar thi. Maine use uThAya aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Ye talwaar mujhe de dijiye (maal-e-ganimat mein mere hisse ke soorat mein) aur aap meri haalat jaante hain. Isper unhone kaha: Ise wapas rakh do jahan se tumne ise uThAya tha. Main wapas gaya yahan tak ki maine ise ek gudam mein phenkne ka faisla kiya lekin mere dil ne mujhe rok diya is liye main wapas aaya aur unse ye talwaar dene ko kaha. Unhone buland aawaaz mein kaha ki main ise wapas rakh dun jahan se maine ise uThAya tha. Isi mauke par ye aayat nazil hui: "Woh jung ke maal-e-ganimat ke baare mein poochte hain" (8:1). Unhone aage kaha: Ek baar main bimaar pad gaya aur maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas khabar bheji. Woh mujhse milne aaye aur maine unse kaha: Mujhe apni maal jitna chaahun baantne ki ijazat dijiye. Woh sehmat nahi hue. Maine kaha: (Iska aadha) baantne ki ijazat dijiye. Woh sehmat nahi hue. Maine kaha: (Iska ek-tihai baantne ki ijazat dijiye), isper woh khamosh rahe aur iske baad hi (kisi ki maal ka ek-tihai sadaqe mein baantna) vaidh mana gaya. Unhone aage kaha: Main Ansar aur Muhajirin ke logon ke ek giroh ke paas aaya aur unhone kaha: Aao, hum tumhe sharaab pilaayein, aur ye sharaab mana hone se pehle ki baat hai. Main unke paas ek baag mein gaya aur unke paas oont ka bhuna hua sar tha aur sharaab bhari ek chhoti mashk. Maine unke saath khaya aur piya aur charcha Ansar aur Muhajirin par aayi. Maine kaha: Muhajirin Ansar se behtar hain, isper ek shakhs ne (oont ke) sar ka ek tukda uThAya aur mujhe usse maara jisse meri naak zakhmi ho gayi. Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unhe haalat bataayi ki Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne sharaab se mutaliq aayaten nazil kin: "Nashe wali cheezein, jue ke khel, patthar rakhe hue buton, aur teeron se peshangoi (ye sab) apavitr hain, Shaitaan ka kaam hai" (5:90).

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ،
 عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ مُصْعَبِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ أُنْزِلَتْ فِيَّ أَرْبَعُ آيَاتٍ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ
 الْحَدِيثَ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ زُهَيْرٍ عَنْ سِمَاكٍ وَزَادَ فِي حَدِيثِ شُعْبَةَ قَالَ فَكَانُوا إِذَا أَرَادُوا أَنْ
 يُطْعِمُوهَا شَجَرُوا فَاهَا بِعَصًا ثُمَّ أَوْجَرُوهَا ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِهِ أَيْضًا فَضَرَبَ بِهِ أَنْفَ سَعْدٍ
 فَفَزَرَهُ وَكَانَ أَنْفُ سَعْدٍ مَفْزُورًا ‏.‏
44.en: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Simak and the hadith transmitted on the authority of Shu'ba (the words are): When they intended to feed her (Sa'd'. s mother), they opened her mouth with the help of a stick and then put the feed in her mouth, and in the same hadith the words are: He struck the nose of Sa'd and it was injured and Sa'd had (the mark) of wound on his nose.
44.hi: Ye hadees Simak ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur Shu'ba ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein (alfaaz hain): Jab unhone unhe (Sa'd ki maa ko) khilaana chaaha, unhone ek lakdi ki madad se unka munh khola aur phir unke munh mein khaana daala, aur isi hadees mein alfaaz hain: Usne Sa'd ki naak par maara aur ye zakhmi hui aur Sa'd ki naak par (zakhm ka) nishaan tha.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنِ الْمِقْدَامِ بْنِ شُرَيْحٍ،
 عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سَعْدٍ، فِيَّ نَزَلَتْ ‏{‏ وَلاَ تَطْرُدِ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُمْ بِالْغَدَاةِ وَالْعَشِيِّ‏}‏ قَالَ نَزَلَتْ
 فِي سِتَّةٍ أَنَا وَابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ مِنْهُمْ وَكَانَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ قَالُوا لَهُ تُدْنِي هَؤُلاَءِ ‏.‏
44.en: Sa'd reported: This verse was revealed in relation to six persons and I and Ibn Mas'ud were amongst them. The polytheists said to him (the Holy Prophet): Do not keep such persons near you. It was upon this that (this verse was revealed):" Drive not away those who call upon their Lord morning and evening desiring only His pleasure" (vi. 52).
44.hi: Sa'd ne bayan kiya: Ye aayat chhe logon ke silsile mein nazil hui aur main aur Ibn Mas'ud unmein se the. Mushrikeen ne unse (Nabi-e-Paak se) kaha: Aise logon ko apne qareeb mat rakho. Isi mauke par (ye aayat nazil hui): "Un logon ko dur mat karo jo apne Rab ko subah aur shaam pukaarte hain sirf Uski khushi chaahte hue" (6:52).

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَسَدِيُّ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ، عَنِ 
 الْمِقْدَامِ بْنِ شُرَيْحٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم سِتَّةَ نَفَرٍ فَقَالَ
 الْمُشْرِكُونَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم اطْرُدْ هَؤُلاَءِ لاَ يَجْتَرِئُونَ عَلَيْنَا ‏.‏ قَالَ وَكُنْتُ أَنَا
 وَابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ وَرَجُلٌ مِنْ هُذَيْلٍ وَبِلاَلٌ وَرَجُلاَنِ لَسْتُ أُسَمِّيهِمَا فَوَقَعَ فِي نَفْسِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَقَعَ فَحَدَّثَ نَفْسَهُ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏ وَلاَ تَطْرُدِ
 الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُمْ بِالْغَدَاةِ وَالْعَشِيِّ يُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَهُ‏}‏
44.en: Sa'd reported: We were six men in the company of Allah's Messenger (, nay peace be upon him) that the polytheists said to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ): Drive them away so that they may not be overbold upon us. He said: I, Ibn Mas'ud and a person from the tribe of Hudhail, Bilal and two other persons, whose names I do not know (were amongst such persons). And there occurred to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) what. Allah wished and he talked with himself that Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, revealed:" Do not drive away those who call their Lord morning and evening desiring to seek His pleasure."
44.hi: Sa'd ne bayan kiya: Hum chhe log Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein the ki mushrikeen ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kaha: Unhe door karo taaki woh humpar zyada himmat na dikhaayein. Unhone kaha: Main, Ibn Mas'ud aur Hudhail qabile ka ek shakhs, Bilal aur do doosre log, jinke naam mujhe nahi pata (in logon mein the). Aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath jo Allah ne chaaha hua aur unhone apne aap se baat ki ki Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne nazil kiya: "Un logon ko dur mat karo jo apne Rab ko subah aur shaam pukaarte hain Uski khushi chaahte hue."

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الْمُقَدَّمِيُّ، وَحَامِدُ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْبَكْرَاوِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى،
 قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ - قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، قَالَ لَمْ يَبْقَ
 مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي بَعْضِ تِلْكَ الأَيَّامِ الَّتِي قَاتَلَ فِيهِنَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم غَيْرُ طَلْحَةَ وَسَعْدٍ ‏.‏ عَنْ حَدِيثِهِمَا ‏.‏
44.en: Abu 'Uthman reported on one of the days when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was fighting and none remained with him save Talha and Sa'd.
44.hi: Abu Uthman ne bayan kiya ki un dinon mein se ek din jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) jung lad rahe the, koi bhi unke saath nahi bacha siwaay Talha aur Sa'd ke.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ،
 بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ نَدَبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم النَّاسَ يَوْمَ الْخَنْدَقِ
 فَانْتَدَبَ الزُّبَيْرُ ثُمَّ نَدَبَهُمْ فَانْتَدَبَ الزُّبَيْرُ ثُمَّ نَدَبَهُمْ فَانْتَدَبَ الزُّبَيْرُ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم ‏
"‏ لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ حَوَارِيٌّ وَحَوَارِيَّ الزُّبَيْرُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
44.en: Jabir b. Abdullah reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) exhorting people on the Day of the Battle of the Ditch to fight. Zubair said: I am ready (to participate). He then again exhorted and he again said: I am ready to participate. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Behold. for every Prophet there is a helper and my helper is Zubair.
44.hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Khaai ki jung ke din logon ko larne ke liye prerit karte suna. Zubair ne kaha: Main taiyaar hoon (hissa lene ke liye). Unhone dobara prerit kiya aur unhone (Zubair ne) dobara kaha: Main hissa lene ke liye taiyaar hoon. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Dekho, har Nabi ke liye ek sahaayak hota hai aur mera sahaayak Zubair hai.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ،
 وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ جَمِيعًا عَنْ وَكِيعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ 
 جَابِرٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ ‏.‏
44.en: Jabir reported this hadith through another chain of transmitters.
44.hi: Jabir ne ye hadees ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ الْخَلِيلِ، وَسُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ ابْنِ مُسْهِرٍ، قَالَ إِسْمَاعِيلُ
 أَخْبَرَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، قَالَ كُنْتُ
 أَنَا وَعُمَرُ بْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، يَوْمَ الْخَنْدَقِ مَعَ النِّسْوَةِ فِي أُطُمِ حَسَّانٍ فَكَانَ يُطَأْطِئُ لِي مَرَّةً
 فَأَنْظُرُ وَأُطَأْطِئُ لَهُ مَرَّةً فَيَنْظُرُ فَكُنْتُ أَعْرِفُ أَبِي إِذَا مَرَّ عَلَى فَرَسِهِ فِي السِّلاَحِ إِلَى بَنِي
 قُرَيْظَةَ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ قَالَ فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لأَبِي
 فَقَالَ وَرَأَيْتَنِي يَا بُنَىَّ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَمَا وَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ جَمَعَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم يَوْمَئِذٍ أَبَوَيْهِ فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ فِدَاكَ أَبِي وَأُمِّي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
44.en: 'Abdullah b. Zubair reported on the Day of the Battle of the Trench: I and Umar b. Abu Salama were with women folk in the fort of Hassan (b. Thabit). He at one time leaned for me and I cast a glance and at anothertime I leaned for him and he would see and I recognised my father as he rode on his horse with his arms towards the tribe of Quraizah. 'Abdullah b. 'Urwa reported from Abdullah b. Zubair: I made a mention of that to my father, whereupon he said: My son, did you see me (on that occasion)? He said: Yes. Thereupon he said: By Allah, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) addressed me saying: I would sacrifice for thee my father and my mother.
44.hi: Abdullah bin Zubair ne Khaai ki jung ke din ke baare mein bayan kiya: Main aur Umar bin Abu Salama Hassan (bin Thabit) ke quile mein auraton ke saath the. Woh kabhi mere liye jhukte aur main ek nazar daalta aur kabhi main unke liye jhukta aur woh dekhte aur maine apne waalid ko pehchaana jab woh apne ghode par sawaar apne hathiyaaron ke saath Quraiza qabile ki taraf badh rahe the. Abdullah bin Urwa ne Abdullah bin Zubair se riwayat ki: Maine iska zikr apne waalid se kiya, isper unhone kaha: Mere bete, kya tumne mujhe (us mauke par) dekha? Unhone kaha: Haan. Isper unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse khitaab karte hue kaha: Main tumhaari khaatir apne maa-baap ko qurbaan karunga.

44.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ،
 قَالَ لَمَّا كَانَ يَوْمُ الْخَنْدَقِ كُنْتُ أَنَا وَعُمَرُ بْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ فِي الأُطُمِ الَّذِي فِيهِ النِّسْوَةُ يَعْنِي
 نِسْوَةَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ ابْنِ مُسْهِرٍ فِي هَذَا الإِسْنَادِ
 وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُرْوَةَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ وَلَكِنْ أَدْرَجَ الْقِصَّةَ فِي حَدِيثِ هِشَامٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ
 عَنِ ابْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ ‏.‏
44.en: 'Abdullah b. Zubair reported: When it was the Day of the Battle of the Ditch I and 'Umar b. Salama were in the fort in which there were women, i. e. the wives of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) ; the rest of the hadith is the same.
44.hi: Abdullah bin Zubair ne bayan kiya: Jab Khaai ki jung ka din tha main aur Umar bin Salama quile mein the jismein auraten thin, yaani Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zaujaen; baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

44.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ - عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ 
 أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ عَلَى حِرَاءٍ هُوَ وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ
 وَعُمَرُ وَعُثْمَانُ وَعَلِيٌّ وَطَلْحَةُ وَالزُّبَيْرُ فَتَحَرَّكَتِ الصَّخْرَةُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم ‏
"‏ اهْدَأْ فَمَا عَلَيْكَ إِلاَّ نَبِيٌّ أَوْ صِدِّيقٌ أَوْ شَهِيدٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
44.en: Abu Huraira reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was upon the mountain of Hira, ' and there were along with him Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman. 'Ali, Talha, 'Zubair, that the mountain stirred; thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Be calm, there is none upon you but a Prophet, a Fiddle (the testifier of truth) and a Martyr.
44.hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Hira pahaad par the, aur unke saath Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman, Ali (Alayhis Salam), Talha, Zubair the, ki pahaad hila. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Shaant raho, tumpar koi bhi nahi hai siwaay ek Nabi, ek Siddiq (sach ki tasdeeq karne wala) aur ek Shaheed ke.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ بْنِ خُنَيْسٍ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ الأَزْدِيُّ، قَالاَ
 حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبِي أُوَيْسٍ، حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ سُهَيْلِ،
 بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ عَلَى
 جَبَلِ حِرَاءٍ فَتَحَرَّكَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ اسْكُنْ حِرَاءُ فَمَا عَلَيْكَ إِلاَّ
 نَبِيٌّ أَوْ صِدِّيقٌ أَوْ شَهِيدٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَعَلَيْهِ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرُ وَعُثْمَانُ
 وَعَلِيٌّ وَطَلْحَةُ وَالزُّبَيْرُ وَسَعْدُ بْنُ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ رضى الله عنهم ‏.‏
44.en: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was on the mountain of Hira' that it stirred; thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Hira! be calm, for there is none upon you but a Prophet, a Siddiq, a Shahid, and there were upon it Allah's Prophet (ﷺ), Abu Bakr, 'Umar, Uthman, 'Ali, Talha, Zubair, Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas (Allah be pleased witli them).
44.hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Hira pahaad par the ki ye hila; isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Hira! shaant raho, kyunki tumpar koi bhi nahi hai siwaay ek Nabi, ek Siddiq, ek Shaheed ke, aur ispar Allah ke Nabi (SAW), Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman, Ali (Alayhis Salam), Talha, Zubair, Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (Allah unse khush ho) the.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، وَعَبْدَةُ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ،
 قَالَ قَالَتْ لِي عَائِشَةُ أَبَوَاكَ وَاللَّهِ مِنَ الَّذِينَ اسْتَجَابُوا لِلَّهِ وَالرَّسُولِ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا أَصَابَهُمُ
 الْقَرْحُ ‏.‏
44.en: Hisham reported on the authority of his father ('Urwa b. Zubair) that A'isha said: BY Allah, both fathers of yours are amongst those who have been men. tioned in this verse:" Those who responded to the call of Allah and the Messenger after the misfortune had fallen upon thein".
44.hi: Hisham ne apne waalid (Urwa bin Zubair) ke hawale se ye riwayat ki ki Aisha ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, tumhare donon waalid unmein se hain jinka is aayat mein zikr kiya gaya hai: "Jinhone Allah aur Rasool ke aahvaan ka jawaab diya jung ke natije mein aayi mushkil ke baad."

44.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ
 وَزَادَ تَعْنِي أَبَا بَكْرٍ وَالزُّبَيْرَ ‏.‏
44.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hishan through the same chain of transmitters but with this addition (that by both fathers of yours) he meant Abu Bakr and Zubair.
44.hi: Ye hadees Hisham ki sanad se isi sanad se is izafe ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai ki (tumhare donon waalid se) unka matlab Abu Bakr aur Zubair se tha.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنِ الْبَهِيِّ، عَنْ 
 عُرْوَةَ، قَالَ قَالَتْ لِي عَائِشَةُ كَانَ أَبَوَاكَ مِنَ الَّذِينَ اسْتَجَابُوا لِلَّهِ وَالرَّسُولِ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا أَصَابَهُمُ
 الْقَرْحُ ‏.‏
44.en: 'Urwa reported: 'Aisha said to me: Your fathers (Zubair and Abu Bakr) were amongst those about whom (it has been revealed):" Those who responded to the call of Allah and His Messenger after the misfortune had fallen upon them."
44.hi: Urwa ne bayan kiya: Aisha ne mujhse kaha: Tumhare waalid (Zubair aur Abu Bakr) unmein se the jinke baare mein (ye nazil hui): "Jinhone Allah aur Uske Rasool ke aahvaan ka jawaab diya jung ke natije mein aayi mushkil ke baad."

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي 
 زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدٌ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ أَنَسٌ
 قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ إِنَّ لِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ أَمِينًا وَإِنَّ أَمِينَنَا أَيَّتُهَا الأُمَّةُ أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ
 بْنُ الْجَرَّاحِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
44.en: Anas reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: For every Umma there is a man of trust and the man of trust of this Umma is Abu 'Ubaida b. Jarrah.
44.hi: Anas ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Har Ummat ke liye ek vishvaas ka aadmi hota hai aur is Ummat ka vishvaas ka aadmi Abu Ubaida bin Jarrah hain.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ سَلَمَةَ - عَنْ ثَابِتٍ،
 عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ أَهْلَ الْيَمَنِ، قَدِمُوا عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالُوا ابْعَثْ مَعَنَا
 رَجُلاً يُعَلِّمْنَا السُّنَّةَ وَالإِسْلاَمَ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَخَذَ بِيَدِ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ هَذَا أَمِينُ هَذِهِ الأُمَّةِ
 ‏"‏ ‏.‏
44.en: Anas reported that the people of Yemen came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Send with us a person who should teach us Sunnah and al-Islam, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) caught hold of the hand of Ubaida and said: He is a man of trust of this Umma.
44.hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki Yemen ke log Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: Humare saath ek shakhs bhejiye jo humein Sunnat aur Islam sikhaaye, isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) Ubaida ka haath pakda aur kaha: Woh is Ummat ke vishvaas ke aadmi hain.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ،
 بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا إِسْحَاقَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ صِلَةَ بْنِ زُفَرَ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، قَالَ
 جَاءَ أَهْلُ نَجْرَانَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ابْعَثْ إِلَيْنَا
 رَجُلاً أَمِينًا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ لأَبْعَثَنَّ إِلَيْكُمْ رَجُلاً أَمِينًا حَقَّ أَمِينٍ حَقَّ أَمِينٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَاسْتَشْرَفَ
 لَهَا النَّاسُ - قَالَ - فَبَعَثَ أَبَا عُبَيْدَةَ بْنَ الْجَرَّاحِ ‏.‏
44.en: Hudhaifa reported that the people of Najran came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger, send along with us a man of trust; whereupon he said: I would definitely send to you a man of trust, a man of trust in the true sense of the term. Thereupon his Companions looked up eagerly and he sent Abu Ubaida b. Jarrah.
44.hi: Hudhaifa ne bayan kiya ki Najran ke log Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, humare saath ek vishvaas ke aadmi ko bhejiye; isper unhone kaha: Main zaroor tumhare paas ek vishvaas ka aadmi bhejunga, wastavik soorat mein ek vishvaas ka aadmi. Isper unke sahaba ne betaab hokar dekha aur unhone Abu Ubaida bin Jarrah ko bheja.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ الْحَفَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ،
 بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
44.en: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Abu Ishaq with the same chain of transmitters.
44.hi: Ye hadees Abu Ishaq ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي يَزِيدَ،
 عَنْ نَافِعِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِحَسَنٍ ‏
"‏ اللَّهُمَّ
 إِنِّي أُحِبُّهُ فَأَحِبَّهُ وَأَحْبِبْ مَنْ يُحِبُّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
44.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying to Hasan: O Allah, behold, I love him. Thou too love him and love one who loves him.
44.hi: Abu Huraira ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Hasan (Alayhis Salam) se ye kehte hue riwayat ki: Aye Allah, dekho, main unse muhabbat karta hoon. Tu bhi unse muhabbat kar aur us shakhs se bhi muhabbat kar jo unse muhabbat karta hai.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي يَزِيدَ، عَنْ نَافِعِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ،
 بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ خَرَجْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي طَائِفَةٍ مِنَ
 النَّهَارِ لاَ يُكَلِّمُنِي وَلاَ أُكَلِّمُهُ حَتَّى جَاءَ سُوقَ بَنِي قَيْنُقَاعَ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ حَتَّى أَتَى خِبَاءَ فَاطِمَةَ
 فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَثَمَّ لُكَعُ أَثَمَّ لُكَعُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ يَعْنِي حَسَنًا فَظَنَنَّا أَنَّهُ إِنَّمَا تَحْبِسُهُ أُمُّهُ لأَنْ تُغَسِّلَهُ وَتُلْبِسَهُ
 سِخَابًا فَلَمْ يَلْبَثْ أَنْ جَاءَ يَسْعَى حَتَّى اعْتَنَقَ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا صَاحِبَهُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُحِبُّهُ فَأَحِبَّهُ وَأَحْبِبْ مَنْ يُحِبُّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
44.en: Abu Huraira reported: I went along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at a time during the day but he did not talk to me and I did not talk to him until he reached the market of Bani Qainuqa`. He came back to the tent of Fatima and said: Is the little chap (meaning Hasan) there? We were under the impression that his mother had detained him in order to bathe him and dress him and garland him with a sweet garland. Not much time had passed that he (Hasan) came running until both of them embraced each other, thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: O Allah, I love him; love him Thou and love one who loves him (Hasan).
44.hi: Abu Huraira ne bayan kiya: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath din mein ek waqt gaya lekin unhone mujhse baat nahi ki aur maine unse baat nahi ki yahan tak ki woh Banu Qainuqa ke bazaar tak pahunche. Woh Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ke tambu tak wapas aaye aur kaha: Kya woh chhota bacha (yaani Hasan (Alayhis Salam)) yahan hai? Humein laga ki unki maa ne unhe roka hoga unhe nahlaane, kapde pehnaane aur ek meethi maala se saja ne ke liye. Zyada waqt nahi guzra tha ki woh (Hasan (Alayhis Salam)) daudte hue aaye yahan tak ki donon ne ek-doosre ko gale lagaaya, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Aye Allah, main unse muhabbat karta hoon; Tu bhi unse muhabbat kar aur us shakhs se bhi muhabbat kar jo unse (Hasan se) muhabbat karta hai.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَدِيٍّ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ ثَابِتٍ
 - حَدَّثَنَا الْبَرَاءُ بْنُ عَازِبٍ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ الْحَسَنَ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ عَلَى عَاتِقِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم وَهُوَ يَقُولُ ‏
"‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُحِبُّهُ فَأَحِبَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
44.en: Al-Bara' b. Azib reported: I saw Hasan b. 'Ali upon the shoulders of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and he was saying: O Allah, I love him, and love him Thou.
44.hi: Al-Bara bin Azib ne bayan kiya: Maine Hasan bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke kandhon par (baithe) dekha aur woh keh rahe the: Aye Allah, main unse muhabbat karta hoon, aur Tu bhi unse muhabbat kar.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ قَالَ ابْنُ نَافِعٍ حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا 
 شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَدِيٍّ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ ثَابِتٍ - عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم وَاضِعًا الْحَسَنَ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ عَلَى عَاتِقِهِ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ ‏
"‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُحِبُّهُ فَأَحِبَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
44.en: Al-Bara' b. Azib reported: I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) with Al-Hasan b. 'Ali placed upon his shoulders  and he was saying: O Allah, I love him, and love him Thou.
44.hi: Al-Bara bin Azib ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko dekha jinke kandhon par al-Hasan bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) baithe the aur woh keh rahe the: Aye Allah, main unse muhabbat karta hoon, aur Tu bhi unse muhabbat kar.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الرُّومِيِّ الْيَمَامِيُّ، وَعَبَّاسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَظِيمِ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا 
 النَّضْرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عَمَّارٍ - حَدَّثَنَا إِيَاسٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ لَقَدْ قُدْتُ
 بِنَبِيِّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالْحَسَنِ وَالْحُسَيْنِ بَغْلَتَهُ الشَّهْبَاءَ حَتَّى أَدْخَلْتُهُمْ حُجْرَةَ
 النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم هَذَا قُدَّامَهُ وَهَذَا خَلْفَهُ ‏.‏
44.en: Iyas reported on the authority of his father: I (had the honour of) leading the white mule on which rode Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and with him were Hasan and Husain, till it reached the apartment of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). The one amongst them was seated before him and the other one was seated behind him.
44.hi: Iyas ne apne waalid ke hawale se ye riwayat ki: Mujhe safed khachchar ki lagaam pakadne ka samman mila jispar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) sawaar the aur unke saath Hasan (Alayhis Salam) aur Husain (Alayhis Salam) the, yahan tak ki ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke kamre tak pahuncha. Unmein se ek unke aage baithe hue tha aur doosra unke peeche.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي بَكْرٍ
 - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، عَنْ زَكَرِيَّاءَ، عَنْ مُصْعَبِ بْنِ شَيْبَةَ، عَنْ صَفِيَّةَ بِنْتِ شَيْبَةَ، قَالَتْ
 قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ خَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم غَدَاةً وَعَلَيْهِ مِرْطٌ مُرَحَّلٌ مِنْ شَعْرٍ أَسْوَدَ
 فَجَاءَ الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ فَأَدْخَلَهُ ثُمَّ جَاءَ الْحُسَيْنُ فَدَخَلَ مَعَهُ ثُمَّ جَاءَتْ فَاطِمَةُ فَأَدْخَلَهَا
 ثُمَّ جَاءَ عَلِيٌّ فَأَدْخَلَهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏{‏ إِنَّمَا يُرِيدُ اللَّهُ لِيُذْهِبَ عَنْكُمُ الرِّجْسَ أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ وَيُطَهِّرَكُمْ
 تَطْهِيرًا‏}‏
44.en: 'A'isha reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) went out one norning wearing a striped cloak of the black camel's hair that there came Hasan b. 'Ali. He wrapped hitn under it, then came Husain and he wrapped him under it along with the other one (Hasan). Then came Fatima and he took her under it, then came 'Ali and he also took him under it and then said: Allah only desires to take away any uncleanliness from you, O people of the household, and purify you (thorough purifying)
44.hi: Aisha ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ek subah kaale oont ke baal ka dhaari-daar chogha pehne bahar aaye ki Hasan bin Ali (Alayhis Salam) aaye. Unhone unhe iske andar lapeta, phir Husain (Alayhis Salam) aaye aur unhe bhi doosre (Hasan) ke saath usmein lapeta. Phir Fatima (Alayhas Salam) aayin aur unhone unhe bhi usmein liya, phir Ali (Alayhis Salam) aaye aur unhe bhi usmein liya aur phir kaha: Allah bas ye chaahta hai ki tumse har tarah ki apavitrata hataaye, Aye khaandaan ke logo, aur tumhe (poori tarah) muqaddas kare.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْقَارِيُّ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ،
 عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ مَا كُنَّا نَدْعُو زَيْدَ بْنَ حَارِثَةَ إِلاَّ زَيْدَ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ
 حَتَّى نَزَلَ الْقُرْآنُ ‏{‏ ادْعُوهُمْ لآبَائِهِمْ هُوَ أَقْسَطُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ‏}‏ قَالَ الشَّيْخُ أَبُو أَحْمَدَ مُحَمَّدُ
 بْنُ عِيسَى أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْعَبَّاسِ السَّرَّاجُ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُوسُفَ الدُّوَيْرِيُّ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا
 قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ ‏.‏
44.en: Salim b. 'Abdullah reported on the authority of his father: We were in the habit of calling Zaid b. Harith as Zaid b. Muhammad until it was revealed in the Qur'an:" Call them by the names of their fathers. This is more equitable with Allah" (This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Qutaiba b. Sa'd)
44.hi: Salim bin Abdullah ne apne waalid ke hawale se ye riwayat ki: Hum Zaid bin Harith ko Zaid bin Muhammad kehte the yahan tak ki Quran mein ye nazil hua: "Unhe unke waalidon ke naam se bulaao. Ye Allah ki nazar mein zyada munasib hai" (33:5). (Ye hadees Qutaiba bin Sa'd ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai)

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الدَّارِمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَبَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ،
 حَدَّثَنِي سَالِمٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
44.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority 'Abdullah through another chain of transmitters.
44.hi: Ye hadees Abdullah ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ قَالَ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى
 أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرُونَ، حَدَّثَنَا - إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - يَعْنُونَ ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ،
 أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، يَقُولُ بَعَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعْثًا وَأَمَّرَ عَلَيْهِمْ أُسَامَةَ
 بْنَ زَيْدٍ فَطَعَنَ النَّاسُ فِي إِمْرَتِهِ فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ إِنْ تَطْعَنُوا
 فِي إِمْرَتِهِ فَقَدْ كُنْتُمْ تَطْعَنُونَ فِي إِمْرَةِ أَبِيهِ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَايْمُ اللَّهِ إِنْ كَانَ لَخَلِيقًا لِلإِمْرَةِ وَإِنْ
 كَانَ لَمِنْ أَحَبِّ النَّاسِ إِلَىَّ وَإِنَّ هَذَا لَمِنْ أَحَبِّ النَّاسِ إِلَىَّ بَعْدَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
44.en: Ibn 'Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent an expedition and appointed Usama b. Zaid as its chief. The people objected to his command, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up and said: You object to his command and before this you objected to the command of his father (Zaid). By Allah, he was fit as the commander and he was one of the dearest of persons to me and after him, behold! this one (Usama) is one of the dearest of persons to me.
44.hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek muhim bheji aur Usama bin Zaid ko iska sardaar muqarrar kiya. Logon ne unke sardaar muqarrar hone par aitraaz kiya, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khade hue aur kaha: Tum unke sardaar hone par aitraaz karte ho aur isse pehle tumne unke waalid (Zaid) ke sardaar hone par bhi aitraaz kiya tha. Allah ki qasam, woh (Zaid) sardaari ke laayak the aur woh un logon mein se the jo mujhe sabse aziz the, aur unke baad, dekho! ye shakhs (Usama) un logon mein se hai jo mujhe sabse aziz hain.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ حَمْزَةَ
 - عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ وَهُوَ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ ‏
"‏ إِنْ
 تَطْعَنُوا فِي إِمَارَتِهِ - يُرِيدُ أُسَامَةَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ - فَقَدْ طَعَنْتُمْ فِي إِمَارَةِ أَبِيهِ مِنْ قَبْلِهِ وَايْمُ اللَّهِ
 إِنْ كَانَ لَخَلِيقًا لَهَا ‏.‏ وَايْمُ اللَّهِ إِنْ كَانَ لأَحَبَّ النَّاسِ إِلَىَّ ‏.‏ وَايْمُ اللَّهِ إِنَّ هَذَا لَهَا لَخَلِيقٌ
 - يُرِيدُ أُسَامَةَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ - وَايْمُ اللَّهِ إِنْ كَانَ لأَحَبَّهُمْ إِلَىَّ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ فَأُوصِيكُمْ بِهِ فَإِنَّهُ مِنْ
 صَالِحِيكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
44.en: Salim reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said on the pulpit: You object to the command of Usima b. Zaid as you had objected before to the command of his father (Zaid). By Allah, he was most competent for it and, by Allah, he was dearest to me amongst people and, by Allah, the same is the case with Usama b. Zaid. He is most dear to me after him and I advise you to treat him well for he is pious amongst you.
44.hi: Salim ne apne waalid ke hawale se ye riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mimbar par kaha: Tum Usama bin Zaid ke sardaar hone par aitraaz karte ho jaise tumne pehle unke waalid (Zaid) ke sardaar hone par aitraaz kiya tha. Allah ki qasam, woh iske sabse zyada laayak the aur, Allah ki qasam, woh logon mein mujhe sabse aziz the aur, Allah ki qasam, Usama bin Zaid ka bhi yehi haal hai. Woh unke baad mujhe sabse aziz hain aur main tumhe salaah deta hoon ki tum unke saath achha vyavahaar karo kyunki woh tum mein mutaqqi hain.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ الشَّهِيدِ،
 عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُلَيْكَةَ، قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ لاِبْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ أَتَذْكُرُ إِذْ تَلَقَّيْنَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم أَنَا وَأَنْتَ وَابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ نَعَمْ فَحَمَلَنَا وَتَرَكَكَ ‏.‏
44.en: Abdullah b. Abu Mulaika reported that Abdullah b. Jafar said to Ibn Zubair: Do you remember (the occasion) when we three (i. e. I, you and lbn 'Abbas) met Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he mounted us (on his camel) but left you? He said: Yes.
44.hi: Abdullah bin Abu Mulaika ne bayan kiya ki Abdullah bin Ja'far ne Ibn Zubair se kaha: Kya tumhe yaad hai (woh mauka) jab humne teenon ne (yaani main, tum aur Ibn Abbas) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se mulaqaat ki aur unhone humein (apne oont par) sawaar kiya lekin tumhe chhod diya? Unhone kaha: Haan.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ الشَّهِيدِ، بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ
 ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ وَإِسْنَادِهِ ‏.‏
44.en: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Habib b. Ash-Shahid.
44.hi: Ye hadees Habib bin Ash-Shahid ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ - وَاللَّفْظُ لِيَحْيَى - قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ
 حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ، يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ الأَحْوَلِ، عَنْ مُوَرِّقٍ الْعِجْلِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ،
 اللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا قَدِمَ مِنْ سَفَرٍ تُلُقِّيَ بِصِبْيَانِ
 أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ - قَالَ - وَإِنَّهُ قَدِمَ مِنْ سَفَرٍ فَسُبِقَ بِي إِلَيْهِ فَحَمَلَنِي بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ ثُمَّ جِيءَ بِأَحَدِ
 ابْنَىْ فَاطِمَةَ فَأَرْدَفَهُ خَلْفَهُ - قَالَ - فَأُدْخِلْنَا الْمَدِينَةَ ثَلاَثَةً عَلَى دَابَّةٍ ‏.‏
44.en: Abdullah b. Ja'far reported that when Allah's Messenger (may peace be, upon him) came back from a journey, the children of his family used to accord him welcome. It was in this way that once he came back from a journey and I went to him first of all. He mounted me before him. Then there came one of the two sons of Fatima and he mounted him behind him and this is how we three entered Medina riding on a beast.
44.hi: Abdullah bin Ja'far ne bayan kiya ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) safar se wapas aate, unke khaandaan ke bachche unka svaagat karte. Isi tarah ek baar woh safar se wapas aaye aur main sabse pehle unke paas gaya. Unhone mujhe apne aage sawaar kiya. Phir Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ke do beton mein se ek aaye aur unhone unhe apne peeche sawaar kiya aur is tarah hum teenon Madina mein ek jaanwar par sawaar hokar daakhil hue.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، حَدَّثَنِي 
 مُوَرِّقٌ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا قَدِمَ مِنْ سَفَرٍ
 تُلُقِّيَ بِنَا - قَالَ - فَتُلُقِّيَ بِي وَبِالْحَسَنِ أَوْ بِالْحُسَيْنِ - قَالَ - فَحَمَلَ أَحَدَنَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ
 وَالآخَرَ خَلْفَهُ حَتَّى دَخَلْنَا الْمَدِينَةَ ‏.‏
44.en: Abdullah b. Ja'a'far reported that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came back from a journey he met us. Once he met me, Hasan or Husain, and he mounted one of us before him and the other one behind him until we entered Medina.
44.hi: Abdullah bin Ja'far ne bayan kiya ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) safar se wapas aate woh humse milte. Ek baar woh mujhse, Hasan (Alayhis Salam) ya Husain (Alayhis Salam) se mile, aur unhone humme se ek ko apne aage sawaar kiya aur doosre ko apne peeche yahan tak ki hum Madina mein daakhil hue.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَهْدِيُّ بْنُ مَيْمُونٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ،
 أَبِي يَعْقُوبَ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، مَوْلَى الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ أَرْدَفَنِي
 رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ خَلْفَهُ فَأَسَرَّ إِلَىَّ حَدِيثًا لاَ أُحَدِّثُ بِهِ أَحَدًا مِنَ
 النَّاسِ ‏.‏
44.en: Abdullah b. Ja'far reported that one day Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) mounted me behind him and narrated to me something in secret which I would narrate to none amongst people.
44.hi: Abdullah bin Ja'far ne bayan kiya ki ek din Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe apne peeche sawaar kiya aur mujhe kuch guptata mein bataya jo main logon mein se kisi ko nahi bataunga.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، وَأَبُو أُسَامَةَ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا 
 أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ وَوَكِيعٌ وَأَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
 أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، وَاللَّفْظُ، حَدِيثُ أَبِي أُسَامَةَ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا 
 أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ 
 عَلِيًّا، بِالْكُوفَةِ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏
"‏ خَيْرُ نِسَائِهَا مَرْيَمُ
 بِنْتُ عِمْرَانَ وَخَيْرُ نِسَائِهَا خَدِيجَةُ بِنْتُ خُوَيْلِدٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ وَأَشَارَ وَكِيعٌ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ
 وَالأَرْضِ ‏.‏
44.en: `Abdullah b. Ja`far reported that he heard `Ali say in Kufa that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The best of the women of her time was Mary, daughter of `Imran, and the best of the women of her time was Khadija, daughter of Khuwailid. Abu Kuraib said that Waki` pointed towards the sky and the earth.
44.hi: Abdullah bin Ja'far ne bayan kiya ki unhone Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko Kufa mein ye kehte suna ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Apne daur ki auraton mein sabse behtareen Mary thin, Imran ki beti, aur apne daur ki auraton mein sabse behtareen Khadija thin, Khuwailid ki beti. Abu Kuraib ne kaha ki Waki ne aasmaan aur zameen ki taraf ishara kiya.

44.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ،
 بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى وَابْنُ بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ،
 بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ 
 أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ كَمَلَ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ كَثِيرٌ وَلَمْ يَكْمُلْ
 مِنَ النِّسَاءِ غَيْرُ مَرْيَمَ بِنْتِ عِمْرَانَ وَآسِيَةَ امْرَأَةِ فِرْعَوْنَ وَإِنَّ فَضْلَ عَائِشَةَ عَلَى النِّسَاءِ
 كَفَضْلِ الثَّرِيدِ عَلَى سَائِرِ الطَّعَامِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
44.en: Abu Musa reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There are many persons amongst men who are quite perfect but there are none perfect amongst women except Mary, daughter of 'Imran, Asiya wife of Pharaoh, and the excellence of 'A'isha as compared to women is that of Tharid over all other foods.
44.hi: Abu Musa ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte suna: Mardon mein bahut se aise log hain jo bilkul mukammal hain lekin auraton mein koi mukammal nahi hai siwaay Mary, Imran ki beti, Aasiya, Firaun ki zauja, aur (auraton ke muqable) Aisha ki fazeelat waisi hai jaise Tharid (soop mein bhigi roti) sab doosre khaano se behtar hai.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ وَابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنْ
