Unke alfaaz suno aur phir mere paas aao. To woh sawaar hokar gaye yahan tak ki woh Makkah pahunche aur unhone unke (Nabi-e-Paak ke muqaddas) alfaaz sune aur phir Abu Dharr ke paas wapas aaye aur kaha: Maine unhe achhe naitik gunon ko vikasit karne ke liye prerit karte dekha hai aur unki abhivyaktiyon ko kisi bhi tarah shayari nahi kaha jaa sakta. Unhone (Abu Dharr ne) kaha: Main isse santusht nahi hua us baat ke silsile mein jo mere zehan mein thi (jab maine tumhe bheja). To unhone safar ke liye raashan aur paani se bhari ek chhoti mashk li (aur nikle) yahan tak ki woh Makkah pahunche. Woh masjid (Kaaba) mein aaye aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko dhoondhne lage aur unhe pehchaana nahi aur unhe ye bhi pasand nahi tha ki woh unke baare mein kisi se poochhein yahan tak ki raat ho gayi, aur woh so gaye. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne unhe dekha aur paaya ki woh ek ajanabi hain. Is liye woh unke saath gaye. Unhone unka anusaran kiya lekin ek ne doosre se kuch bhi nahi poocha yahan tak ki subah ho gayi. Woh phir paani aur apna raashan masjid mein le aaye aur wahan ek din guzaara, lekin unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko nahi dekha yahan tak ki raat ho gayi. Phir woh apne bistar par wapas gaye, aur usi waqt Ali (Alayhis Salam) guzre aur unhone kaha: Ye shakhs ab tak apni manzil nahi paa saka. Unhone unhe khada kiya aur unke saath gaye aur koi bhi apne saathi se kisi baat ke baare mein nahi poochta. Aur jab teesra din tha unhone waisa hi kiya. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne unhe khadhaya aur unhe apne saath laaye. Unhone kaha: Us Hasti ki qasam, jiske siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai, tum mujhe (wajah) kyun nahi batate jo tumhe is shehar mein le aaya? Unhone kaha: (Main aisa karunga) bashart-e ki tum mujhse vaada aur ehad karo ki tum mujhe sahi raah dikhaoge. Unhone phir aisa kiya. Unhone (Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne) kaha: Yaqeenan, woh sachche hain aur woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) hain aur jab subah ho, mera anusaran karo aur agar main kuch aisa kahun jismein mujhe tumhaare baare mein dar mehsoos ho, main is tarah khada hoonga jaise main paani phenk raha hoon aur agar main aage badhun, tum tab mera anusaran karo yahan tak ki main (kisi ghar mein) daakhil hoon. Unhone aisa kiya aur maine unka anusaran kiya yahan tak ki woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas pahunche. Woh unke saath Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke (ghar) mein daakhil hue aur unke alfaaz sune aur isi jagah Islam qubool kiya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse kaha: Apne logon ke paas jaao aur unhe soochit karo jab tak mera hukum tumhe pahunche. Isper unhone kaha: Us Hasti ki qasam jiske Haath mein meri zindagi hai, main Makkah ke logon se buland aawaaz mein ye baat kahunga. To woh nikle yahan tak ki woh masjid mein aaye aur phir buland aawaaz mein bole (ye kehte hue): Main gawaahi deta hoon ki Allah ke siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai aur Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain. Logon ne unpar hamla kiya aur unhe girAaya jab al-Abbas aaye aur unke uThpar jhuke aur kaha: Tumpar afsos, kya tumhe nahi pata ki woh Ghifar qabile se hain aur Syria ki taraf tumhaara vyaapaar raasta (is qabile ke basne wale ilaake) se guzarta hai, aur unhone unhe bachaaya. Unhone (Abu Dharr ne) agle din bhi waisa hi kiya aur unhone (Makkah walon ne) dobara unpar hamla kiya aur al-Abbas unpar jhuke aur unhe bachaaya.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ بَيَانٍ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ أَبِي،
 حَازِمٍ عَنْ جَرِيرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، ح 
 وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْحَمِيدِ بْنُ بَيَانٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، عَنْ بَيَانٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ قَيْسَ بْنَ أَبِي،
 حَازِمٍ يَقُولُ قَالَ جَرِيرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ مَا حَجَبَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُنْذُ أَسْلَمْتُ
 وَلاَ رَآنِي إِلاَّ ضَحِكَ ‏.‏
44.en: (6050) Jarir b. 'Abdullah said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) never refused me permission to see him since I embraced Islam and never looked at me but with a smile.
44.hi: Jarir bin Abdullah ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kabhi mujhe unse milne ki ijazat nahi maana jab se maine Islam qubool kiya aur kabhi mujhe muskuraahat ke bina nahi dekha.

44.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، وَأَبُو أُسَامَةَ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا 
 ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، قَالَ مَا حَجَبَنِي
 رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُنْذُ أَسْلَمْتُ وَلاَ رَآنِي إِلاَّ تَبَسَّمَ فِي وَجْهِي ‏.‏ زَادَ ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ
 فِي حَدِيثِهِ عَنِ ابْنِ إِدْرِيسَ وَلَقَدْ شَكَوْتُ إِلَيْهِ أَنِّي لاَ أَثْبُتُ عَلَى الْخَيْلِ فَضَرَبَ بِيَدِهِ فِي
 صَدْرِي وَقَالَ ‏
"‏ اللَّهُمَّ ثَبِّتْهُ وَاجْعَلْهُ هَادِيًا مَهْدِيًّا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
44.en: Jarir reported: Since I embraced Islam Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) never refused to see me and he did not see me but with a smile on his face. Ibn Numair has made this addition to this hadith which has been reported on the authority of Ibn Idris that he (Jarir) made this complaint to him (to the Holy Prophet): I cannot sit upon the horse with firmness, whereupon he (Allah's Apostle) struck his chest with his hand and prayed: O Allah, make him steadfast and rightly-guided.
44.hi: Jarir ne bayan kiya: Jab se maine Islam qubool kiya Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kabhi mujhse milne se inkaar nahi kiya aur unhone mujhe kabhi apne chehre par muskuraahat ke bina nahi dekha. Ibn Numair ne is hadees mein ye izafa kiya, jo Ibn Idris ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai, ki unhone (Jarir ne) unse (Nabi-e-Paak se) ye shikaayat ki: Main ghode par mazbooti se nahi baith paata, isper unhone (Allah ke Rasool ne) apne haath se unke seene par thoka aur dua ki: Aye Allah, ise sthir aur sahi margdarshit banaa.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْحَمِيدِ بْنُ بَيَانٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدٌ، عَنْ بَيَانٍ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، قَالَ
 كَانَ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ بَيْتٌ يُقَالُ لَهُ ذُو الْخَلَصَةِ وَكَانَ يُقَالُ لَهُ الْكَعْبَةُ الْيَمَانِيَةُ وَالْكَعْبَةُ الشَّامِيَّةُ
 فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ هَلْ أَنْتَ مُرِيحِي مِنْ ذِي الْخَلَصَةِ وَالْكَعْبَةِ الْيَمَانِيَةِ
 وَالشَّامِيَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَنَفَرْتُ إِلَيْهِ فِي مِائَةٍ وَخَمْسِينَ مِنْ أَحْمَسَ فَكَسَرْنَاهُ وَقَتَلْنَا مَنْ وَجَدْنَا عِنْدَهُ
 فَأَتَيْتُهُ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ - قَالَ - فَدَعَا لَنَا وَلأَحْمَسَ ‏.‏
44.en: Jabir reported that there was in pre-Islamic days a temple called Dhu'l- Khalasah and it was called the Yamanite Ka'ba or the northern Ka'ba. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said unto me: Will you rid me of Dhu'l-Khalasah and so I went forth at the head of 350 horsemen of the tribe of Ahmas and we destroyed it and killed whomsoever we found there. Then we came back to him (to the Holy Prophet) and informed him and he blessed us and the tribe of Ahmas.
44.hi: Jabir ne bayan kiya ki Islam se pehle ke daur mein ek but-khana tha jise Dhu'l-Khalasah kaha jaata tha aur ise Yemeni Kaaba ya uttari Kaaba kaha jaata tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse kaha: Kya tum mujhe Dhu'l-Khalasah se azad karoge aur is liye main Ahmas qabile ke 350 ghudsawaaron ke agua ke soorat mein nikla aur humne ise nasht kiya aur jise bhi humne wahan paaya use qatal kiya. Phir hum unke (Nabi-e-Paak ke) paas wapas aaye aur unhe bataya aur unhone humein aur Ahmas qabile ko barkat di.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، عَنْ قَيْسِ،
 بْنِ أَبِي حَازِمٍ عَنْ جَرِيرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْبَجَلِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 ‏"‏ يَا جَرِيرُ أَلاَ تُرِيحُنِي مِنْ ذِي الْخَلَصَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ بَيْتٍ لِخَثْعَمَ كَانَ يُدْعَى كَعْبَةَ الْيَمَانِيَةِ ‏.‏ قَالَ
 فَنَفَرْتُ فِي خَمْسِينَ وَمِائَةِ فَارِسٍ وَكُنْتُ لاَ أَثْبُتُ عَلَى الْخَيْلِ فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم فَضَرَبَ يَدَهُ فِي صَدْرِي فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ ثَبِّتْهُ وَاجْعَلْهُ هَادِيًا مَهْدِيًّا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ
 فَانْطَلَقَ فَحَرَّقَهَا بِالنَّارِ ثُمَّ بَعَثَ جَرِيرٌ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجُلاً يُبَشِّرُهُ
 يُكْنَى أَبَا أَرْطَاةَ مِنَّا فَأَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ لَهُ مَا جِئْتُكَ حَتَّى تَرَكْنَاهَا
 كَأَنَّهَا جَمَلٌ أَجْرَبُ ‏.‏ فَبَرَّكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى خَيْلِ أَحْمَسَ وَرِجَالِهَا
 خَمْسَ مَرَّاتٍ ‏.‏
44.en: Jarir b. 'Abdullah al-Bajali said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me: Can't on rid me of Dhu'I-Khalasah, the idol-house of Khath'am, and this idol-house was called the Yamanite Ka'ba. So I went along with 150 horsemen and I could not sit with steadfastness upon the horse. I made the mention of it to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he struck his hand on my chest and said: O Allah, grant him steadfastness and make him the guide of righteousness and the rightly-guided one. So he went away and he set fire to it. Then Jarir sent some person to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) whose Kunya was Abu Arta to give him the happy news about that. He came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: I have not come to you (but with the news) that we have left Dhu'l-Khalasah as a scabed camel. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) blessed the horses of Ahmas and the men of their tribe five times.
44.hi: Jarir bin Abdullah al-Bajali ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse kaha: Kya tum mujhe Dhu'l-Khalasah, Khath'am ke murti-ghar, se azad nahi kar sakte, aur ye murti-ghar Yemeni Kaaba kaha jaata tha. Is liye main 150 ghudsawaaron ke saath gaya aur main ghode par sthirta se nahi baith saka. Maine iska zikr Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kiya aur unhone apna haath mere seene par maara aur kaha: Aye Allah, use sthirta de aur use sahi margdarshan ka aur sahi margdarshit ka margdarshak bana. To woh nikle aur unhone ise aag laga di. Phir Jarir ne kisi ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas bheja jinki Kunya Abu Arta thi taaki unhe iski khushkhabri di jaaye. Woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: Main aapke paas (sirf) is khabar ke saath aaya hoon ki humne Dhu'l-Khalasah ko ek khaarish-grast oont ki tarah chhod diya hai. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ahmas qabile ke ghodon aur unke logon ko paanch baar barkat di.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح،
 وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ، - يَعْنِي الْفَزَارِيَّ
 ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ فِي
 حَدِيثِ مَرْوَانَ فَجَاءَ بَشِيرُ جَرِيرٍ أَبُو أَرْطَاةَ حُصَيْنُ بْنُ رَبِيعَةَ يُبَشِّرُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم ‏.‏
44.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ismail with different chains of transmitters and in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Marwan (the words are): "A person giving the glad tidings on behalf of Jarir came or Abu Husain b. Rabi`a came in order to give glad tidings to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ)."
44.hi: Ye hadees Ismail ki sanad se mukhtalif sanadon ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai aur Marwan ki sanad se riwayat ki hui hadees mein (alfaaz hain): "Jarir ki taraf se khushkhabri dene wala shakhs aaya, ya Abu Husain bin Rabi'a Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko khushkhabri dene aaye."

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ النَّضْرِ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ، حَدَّثَنَا 
 وَرْقَاءُ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْيَشْكُرِيُّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُبَيْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي يَزِيدَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّوسلم أَتَى الْخَلاَءَ فَوَضَعْتُ لَهُ وَضُوءًا فَلَمَّا خَرَجَ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ وَضَعَ
 هَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فِي رِوَايَةِ زُهَيْرٍ قَالُوا ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ قُلْتُ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ فَقِّهْهُ
 ‏"‏ ‏.‏
44.en: Ibn 'Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to privy and I placed for him water for ablution, When he came out he said: Who placed it here? And in a version of Zuhair they (the Companions) said, and in the version of Abu Bakr (the words are): I said: It is Ibn 'Abbas (who has done that), whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: May Allah grant him deep understanding of religion.
44.hi: Ibn Abbas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) shauchaalay gaye aur maine unke liye wuzu ka paani rakha. Jab woh bahar aaye, unhone kaha: Ye kisne rakha? Aur Zuhair ki riwayat mein woh (sahaba) bole, aur Abu Bakr ki riwayat mein (alfaaz hain): Maine kaha: Ye Ibn Abbas hain (jinhone ye kiya), isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Allah unhe deen ki gehri samajh de.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الْعَتَكِيُّ، وَخَلَفُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ حَمَّادِ،
 بْنِ زَيْدٍ - قَالَ أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، - حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ،
 قَالَ رَأَيْتُ فِي الْمَنَامِ كَأَنَّ فِي يَدِي قِطْعَةَ إِسْتَبْرَقٍ وَلَيْسَ مَكَانٌ أُرِيدُ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ إِلاَّ طَارَتْ
 إِلَيْهِ - قَالَ - فَقَصَصْتُهُ عَلَى حَفْصَةَ فَقَصَّتْهُ حَفْصَةُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ
 النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ أَرَى عَبْدَ اللَّهِ رَجُلاً صَالِحًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
44.en: Ibn 'Umar reported: I saw in a state of sleep as if I have in my hand a piece of silk cloth and there is no place in the Paradise where I intend to reach but that piece of cloth does not fly towards it. I made a mention of it to Hafsa (the sister of Ibn 'Umar) and Hafsa made a mention of it to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), whereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: I find 'Abdullah b 'Umar a pious person.
44.hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya: Maine so raha tha maine dekha ki jaise mere haath mein resham ka ek tukda hai aur Jannat mein koi jagah nahi hai jahan main pahunchna chaahta hoon lekin woh kapda uska tukda uski taraf nahi udta. Maine iska zikr Hafsa (Ibn Umar ki behn) se kiya aur Hafsa ne iska zikr Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kiya, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha: Mujhe Abdullah bin Umar ek nekokaar shakhs lagta hai.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِعَبْدٍ - قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ،
 الرَّزَّاقِ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ كَانَ الرَّجُلُ فِي حَيَاةِ رَسُولِ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا رَأَى رُؤْيَا قَصَّهَا عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَتَمَنَّيْتُ
 أَنْ أَرَى رُؤْيَا أَقُصُّهَا عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ وَكُنْتُ غُلاَمًا شَابًّا عَزَبًا وَكُنْتُ
 أَنَامُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَرَأَيْتُ فِي النَّوْمِ كَأَنَّ مَلَكَيْنِ
 أَخَذَانِي فَذَهَبَا بِي إِلَى النَّارِ فَإِذَا هِيَ مَطْوِيَّةٌ كَطَىِّ الْبِئْرِ وَإِذَا لَهَا قَرْنَانِ كَقَرْنَىِ الْبِئْرِ وَإِذَا
 فِيهَا نَاسٌ قَدْ عَرَفْتُهُمْ فَجَعَلْتُ أَقُولُ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ النَّارِ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ النَّارِ أَعُوذُ
 بِاللَّهِ مِنَ النَّارِ - قَالَ - فَلَقِيَهُمَا مَلَكٌ فَقَالَ لِي لَمْ تُرَعْ ‏.‏ فَقَصَصْتُهَا عَلَى حَفْصَةَ فَقَصَّتْهَا
 حَفْصَةُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ نِعْمَ الرَّجُلُ
 عَبْدُ اللَّهِ لَوْ كَانَ يُصَلِّي مِنَ اللَّيْلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ سَالِمٌ فَكَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ لاَ يَنَامُ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ
 إِلاَّ قَلِيلاً ‏.‏
44.en: Ibn 'Umar reported that when a person saw anything in sleep during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) he narrated it to Allah's Messenger, and I also had a longing that I should also see in a dream something which I should narrate to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and I was at that time an unmarried young man. I was sleeping in the mosque during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) tl) at I saw in a dream as if two Angels have taken hold of me and they have carried me to the fire, and, lo, it was built like the easing of a well and had two pillars like those of a well; and, lo, there were people in it whom I knew and I cried out: I seek refuge with Allah from Hell-fire; I seek refuge with Allah from Hell-fire. Then another Angel joined the two others, and said unto me: You need not fear I narrated this dream to llafsa and she narrated it to Allah's Messenger, whereupon Allah's Apostle said: Worthy is this man Abdullah, O that he would pray at night, and Silim added that Abdullah afterwards slept only but for a small part of the night.
44.hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya ki jab koi shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein neend mein kuch dekhta, woh ise Allah ke Rasool ko riwayat karta, aur mujhe bhi ye khwaish thi ki main bhi sapne mein kuch dekhun jise main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko riwayat karun aur main us waqt ek kunwara jawaan aadmi tha. Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein masjid mein so raha tha jab maine sapne mein dekha jaise do Farishton ne mujhe pakda hai aur woh mujhe aag ki taraf le gaye hain, aur, dekho, ye ek kuen ki taraah baayi hui thi aur ismein do khambe the kuen jaise; aur, dekho, ismein log the jinhe main jaanta tha aur main chillaaya: Main Jahannam ki aag se Allah ki panah maangta hoon; main Jahannam ki aag se Allah ki panah maangta hoon. Phir ek doosra Farishta un doosron ke saath aa mila, aur usne mujhse kaha: Tumhe dar nahi lena chahiye. Maine ye sapna Hafsa se riwayat kiya aur unhone ise Allah ke Rasool ko riwayat kiya, isper Allah ke Rasool ne kaha: Ye aadmi, Abdullah, laayak hai, kaash woh raat mein namaz padhta, aur Salim ne izafa kiya ki Abdullah baad mein raat ke sirf ek chhote hisse mein sote the.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ خَالِدٍ، خَتَنُ الْفِرْيَابِيِّ
 عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ الْفَزَارِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ كُنْتُ أَبِيتُ
 فِي الْمَسْجِدِ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لِي أَهْلٌ فَرَأَيْتُ فِي الْمَنَامِ كَأَنَّمَا انْطُلِقَ بِي إِلَى بِئْرٍ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ ‏.‏
44.en: Ibn Umar reported: I used to spend nights in the mosque and by that time I had no wife and children. I saw in a dream as if I am being taken to a well. I made a mention of it to Allah's Messenger (may peacebe upon him). The rest of the hadith is the same.
44.hi: Ibn Umar ne bayan kiya: Main masjid mein raaten guzaarta tha aur us waqt meri koi zauja ya bachche nahi the. Maine sapne mein dekha jaise mujhe ek kuen ki taraf le jaaya ja raha hai. Maine iska zikr Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kiya. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، سَمِعْتُ 
 قَتَادَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ أُمِّ سُلَيْمٍ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ خَادِمُكَ أَنَسٌ ادْعُ اللَّهَ لَهُ
 فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ اللَّهُمَّ أَكْثِرْ مَالَهُ وَوَلَدَهُ وَبَارِكْ لَهُ فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
44.en: Anas reported that Umm Sulaim said (to the Holy Prophet) Allah's Messenger, here is your servant Anas, invoke blessings of Allah upon him. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: O Allah, make an increase in his wealth, and progeny, and confer blessings upon him in everything Thou hast bestowed upon him.
44.hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki Umm Sulaim ne (Nabi-e-Paak se) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye rahe aapke naukar Anas, unke liye Allah ki barkatein maangiye. Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Aye Allah, unki daulat aur aulaad mein izafa kar aur jo bhi Tu unhe de use barkat de.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا،
 يَقُولُ قَالَتْ أُمُّ سُلَيْمٍ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ خَادِمُكَ أَنَسٌ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
44.en: Anas reported (that his mother) Umm Sulaim said (to the Holy Prophet) Allah's Messenger, here is your servant Anas. The rest of the hadith is the same.
44.hi: Anas ne bayan kiya (ki unki maa) Umm Sulaim ne (Nabi-e-Paak se) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye rahe aapke naukar Anas. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ،
 سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏
44.en: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Anas through another chain of transmitters.
44.hi: Ye hadees Anas ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

44.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ 
 أَنَسٍ، قَالَ دَخَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَيْنَا وَمَا هُوَ إِلاَّ أَنَا وَأُمِّي وَأُمُّ حَرَامٍ خَالَتِي
 فَقَالَتْ أُمِّي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ خُوَيْدِمُكَ ادْعُ اللَّهَ لَهُ - قَالَ - فَدَعَا لِي بِكُلِّ خَيْرٍ وَكَانَ فِي
 آخِرِ مَا دَعَا لِي بِهِ أَنْ قَالَ ‏
"‏ اللَّهُمَّ أَكْثِرْ مَالَهُ وَوَلَدَهُ وَبَارِكْ لَهُ فِيهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
44.en: Anas reportedAllah's Apostle (ﷺ) visited us and there was none else (in the house) but I, my mother and my mother's sister Umm Haram. My mother said to him: Allah's Messenger, here is a small servant of yours, invoke blessings of Allah upon him. And he invoked blessings for me (that I should be bestowed upon) every good and this was what he (said) at the end of what be supplicated for me: O Allah, make an increase in his wealth, and progeny, and cqnfer blessings (upon him) in (each one) of them.
44.hi: Anas ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) humse milne aaye aur (ghar mein) koi doosra nahi tha siwaay mere, meri maa aur meri maa ki behn Umm Haram ke. Meri maa ne unse kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye rahe aapka chhota naukar, unke liye Allah ki barkatein maangiye. Aur unhone mere liye barkat maangi (ki mujhe) har achhaai (di jaaye) aur ye woh tha jo unhone mere liye dua ke ant mein kaha: Aye Allah, unki daulat aur aulaad mein izafa kar aur unmein se har ek mein (unhe) barkat de.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو مَعْنٍ الرَّقَاشِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ،
 حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسٌ، قَالَ جَاءَتْ بِي أُمِّي أُمُّ أَنَسٍ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَدْ أَزَّرَتْنِي
 بِنِصْفِ خِمَارِهَا وَرَدَّتْنِي بِنِصْفِهِ فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَذَا أُنَيْسٌ ابْنِي أَتَيْتُكَ بِهِ يَخْدُمُكَ
 فَادْعُ اللَّهَ لَهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ اللَّهُمَّ أَكْثِرْ مَالَهُ وَوَلَدَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَنَسٌ فَوَاللَّهِ إِنَّ مَالِي لَكَثِيرٌ وَإِنَّ
 وَلَدِي وَوَلَدَ وَلَدِي لَيَتَعَادُّونَ عَلَى نَحْوِ الْمِائَةِ الْيَوْمَ ‏.‏
44.en: Anas reported: My mother Umm Anas came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). And she prepared my lower garment out of the half of her headdress and (with the other half) she covered my upper body and said: Allah's Messenger, here is my son Unais; I have brought him to you for serving you. Invoke blessings of Allah upon him. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: O Allah, make an increase in his wealth, and progeny. Anas said: By Allah, my fortune is huge and my children, and grand-children are now more than one hundred.
44.hi: Anas ne bayan kiya: Meri maa Umm Anas Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayin. Aur unhone meri neechli kapda apne sirdaastar ke aadhe hisse se taiyaar kiya aur (doosre aadhe se) unhone mera upari badan dhaka aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye rahe mere bete Unais; main unhe aapki sewa ke liye laayi hoon. Unke liye Allah ki barkatein maangiye. Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) kaha: Aye Allah, unki daulat aur aulaad mein izafa kar. Anas ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, meri daulat bhaari hai aur mere bachche, aur pote-poti ab sau se zyada hain.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سُلَيْمَانَ - عَنِ الْجَعْدِ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ،
 قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ مَرَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَمِعَتْ أُمِّي أُمُّ سُلَيْمٍ
 صَوْتَهُ فَقَالَتْ بِأَبِي وَأُمِّي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أُنَيْسٌ ‏.‏ فَدَعَا لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 ثَلاَثَ دَعَوَاتٍ قَدْ رَأَيْتُ مِنْهَا اثْنَتَيْنِ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَأَنَا أَرْجُو الثَّالِثَةَ فِي الآخِرَةِ ‏.‏
44.en: Anas b. Malik said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) passed (by our house) that my mother Umm Sulaim listened to his voice and said: Allah's Messenger, let my father and mother be sacrificed for thee, here is Unais (and requested him to invoke blessings upon me). So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) invoked three blessings upon me. I have seen (the results) of the two in this very world (in regard to wealth and progeny) and I hope to see (the result) of the third one in the Hereafter.
44.hi: Anas bin Malik ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) (humare ghar ke paas se) guzre ki meri maa Umm Sulaim ne unki aawaaz suni aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mere maa-baap aap par qurbaan ho jaayein, ye rahe Unais (aur unhone unse mere liye barkat maangne ki guzaarish ki). To Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne meri khaatir teen barkatein maangi. Maine in mein se do ke (natije) is duniya mein dekhe hain (daulat aur aulaad ke silsile mein) aur mujhe teesri (natija) Aakhirat mein dekhne ki ummeed hai.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا ثَابِتٌ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ
 أَتَى عَلَىَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَنَا أَلْعَبُ مَعَ الْغِلْمَانِ - قَالَ - فَسَلَّمَ عَلَيْنَا
 فَبَعَثَنِي إِلَى حَاجَةٍ فَأَبْطَأْتُ عَلَى أُمِّي فَلَمَّا جِئْتُ قَالَتْ مَا حَبَسَكَ قُلْتُ بَعَثَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم لِحَاجَةٍ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ مَا حَاجَتُهُ قُلْتُ إِنَّهَا سِرٌّ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ لاَ تُحَدِّثَنَّ بِسِرِّ رَسُولِ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَحَدًا ‏.‏ قَالَ أَنَسٌ وَاللَّهِ لَوْ حَدَّثْتُ بِهِ أَحَدًا لَحَدَّثْتُكَ يَا ثَابِتُ ‏.‏
44.en: Anas reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to me as I was playing with playmates. He greeted and sent me on an errand and I made delay in going to my mother. When I came to her she said: What detained you? I said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent me on an errand. She said: What was the purpose? I said: It is something secret. Therupon she said: Do not then divulge the secret of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to anyone. Anas said: By Allah, if I were to divulge it to anyone, then, O Thabit, I would have divulged it to you.
44.hi: Anas ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mere paas aaye jab main apne khel-saathiyon ke saath khel raha tha. Unhone salaam kiya aur mujhe ek kaam ke liye bheja aur mujhe apni maa ke paas jaane mein der ho gayi. Jab main unke paas aaya unhone kaha: Tumhe kis baat ne roka? Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe ek kaam ke liye bheja tha. Unhone kaha: Uska maqsad kya tha? Maine kaha: Ye kuch guptata ki baat hai. Isper unhone kaha: Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka raaz kisi ko mat bataana. Anas ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, agar main ise kisi ko bataata, to, Aye Thabit, main tumhe zaroor bataata.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَارِمُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، قَالَ
 سَمِعْتُ أَبِي يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ أَسَرَّ إِلَىَّ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سِرًّا
 فَمَا أَخْبَرْتُ بِهِ أَحَدًا بَعْدُ ‏.‏ وَلَقَدْ سَأَلَتْنِي عَنْهُ أُمُّ سُلَيْمٍ فَمَا أَخْبَرْتُهَا بِهِ ‏.‏
44.en: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) told me something secretly. I informed none about that and Umm Sulaim asked me about it, but I did not tell her even.
44.hi: Anas bin Malik ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe gupt soorat se kuch bataaya. Maine iske baare mein kisi ko soochit nahi kiya aur Umm Sulaim ne mujhse iske baare mein poocha, lekin maine unhe bhi nahi bataya.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عِيسَى، حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي النَّضْرِ،
 عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي يَقُولُ، مَا سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ
 لِحَىٍّ يَمْشِي أَنَّهُ فِي الْجَنَّةِ إِلاَّ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَلاَمٍ ‏.‏
44.en: 'Amir b. Sa'd reported that he heard his father (Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas) say: never heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say unto one living and moving about that he was in Paradise except to 'Abdullah b. Salim.
44.hi: Amir bin Sa'd ne bayan kiya ki unhone apne waalid (Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas) ko ye kehte suna: Maine kabhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko kisi zinda aur chalte-phirte shakhs ke baare mein ye kehte nahi suna ki woh Jannat mein hai siwaay Abdullah bin Salim ke.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى الْعَنَزِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَوْنٍ،
 عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ عُبَادٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ بِالْمَدِينَةِ فِي نَاسٍ فِيهِمْ بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِ
 النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ فِي وَجْهِهِ أَثَرٌ مِنْ خُشُوعٍ فَقَالَ بَعْضُ الْقَوْمِ هَذَا
 رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ هَذَا رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ ‏.‏ فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ يَتَجَوَّزُ فِيهِمَا ثُمَّ خَرَجَ فَاتَّبَعْتُهُ
 فَدَخَلَ مَنْزِلَهُ وَدَخَلْتُ فَتَحَدَّثْنَا فَلَمَّا اسْتَأْنَسَ قُلْتُ لَهُ إِنَّكَ لَمَّا دَخَلْتَ قَبْلُ قَالَ رَجُلٌ كَذَا
 وَكَذَا قَالَ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ مَا يَنْبَغِي لأَحَدٍ أَنْ يَقُولَ مَا لاَ يَعْلَمُ وَسَأُحَدِّثُكَ لِمَ ذَاكَ رَأَيْتُ رُؤْيَا
 عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَصَصْتُهَا عَلَيْهِ رَأَيْتُنِي فِي رَوْضَةٍ - ذَكَرَ سَعَتَهَا
 وَعُشْبَهَا وَخُضْرَتَهَا - وَوَسْطَ الرَّوْضَةِ عَمُودٌ مِنْ حَدِيدٍ أَسْفَلُهُ فِي الأَرْضِ وَأَعْلاَهُ فِي السَّمَاءِ
 فِي أَعْلاَهُ عُرْوَةٌ ‏.‏ فَقِيلَ لِي ارْقَهْ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ لاَ أَسْتَطِيعُ ‏.‏ فَجَاءَنِي مِنْصَفٌ - قَالَ ابْنُ
 عَوْنٍ وَالْمِنْصَفُ الْخَادِمُ - فَقَالَ بِثِيَابِي مِنْ خَلْفِي - وَصَفَ أَنَّهُ رَفَعَهُ مِنْ خَلْفِهِ بِيَدِهِ - فَرَقِيتُ
 حَتَّى كُنْتُ فِي أَعْلَى الْعَمُودِ فَأَخَذْتُ بِالْعُرْوَةِ فَقِيلَ لِيَ اسْتَمْسِكْ ‏.‏ فَلَقَدِ اسْتَيْقَظْتُ وَإِنَّهَا
 لَفِي يَدِي فَقَصَصْتُهَا عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ تِلْكَ الرَّوْضَةُ الإِسْلاَمُ وَذَلِكَ
 الْعَمُودُ عَمُودُ الإِسْلاَمِ وَتِلْكَ الْعُرْوَةُ عُرْوَةُ الْوُثْقَى وَأَنْتَ عَلَى الإِسْلاَمِ حَتَّى تَمُوتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ
 وَالرَّجُلُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَلاَمٍ ‏.‏
44.en: Qais b. 'Ubada reported: I was in the company of some persons, amongst whom some were the Companions of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) in Medina, that there came a person whose face depicted the fear (of Allah). Some people said: He is a person from amongst the people of Paradise; he is a person from amongst the people of Paradise. He observed two short rak'ahs of prayer and then went out. I followed him and he got into his house and I also got in and we began to converse with each other. And when he became familiar (with me) I said to Him: When you entered (the mosque) before (your entrance in the house) a person said so and so (that you are amongst the people of Paradise), whereupon he said: It is not meet for anyone to say anything which he does not know. I shall (now) tell you why they (say) this. I saw a dream during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and narrated it to him. I seemed to be in a garden ; in the midst of it, there stood an iron pillar, with its base in the earth and its summit in the sky: and upon its summit there was a handhold. It was said to me: Climb up this (pillar). I said to him (visitant in the dream): I am unable to do it. Thereupon a helper came to me, and he (supported) me (by catching hold of my) garment from behind and thus helped me with his hand and so I climbed up till I was at the summit of the pillar, and grasped the handhold. It was said to me: Hold it tightly. It was at this that I woke up when (the handhold) was in the grip) of my hand. I narrated it (the dream) to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), whereupon he said: That garden implies al-Islam and that pillar implies the pillar of Islam. And that handhold is the firmest faith (as referred to in the Qur'an). And you will remain attached to Islam until you shall die. And that man was 'Abdullah b. Salim.
44.hi: Qais bin Ubada ne bayan kiya: Main kuch logon ki sohbat mein tha, jinmein Madina mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke kuch Sahaba (RA) bhi the, ke ek shakhs aaya jiske chehre par (Allah ka) khauf zaahir tha. Kuch logon ne kaha: Ye Jannat ke logon mein se ek shakhs hai; ye Jannat ke logon mein se ek shakhs hai. Unhone do mukhtasar rakat namaz padhi aur phir bahar chale gaye. Main unke peeche gaya aur woh apne ghar mein daakhil hue aur main bhi daakhil hua aur hum aapas mein baatein karne lage. Aur jab woh mujhse mil-julle, maine unse kaha: Jab aap (masjid mein) aaye the, ek shakhs ne aisa-aisa kaha (ki aap Jannat ke logon mein se hain), isper unhone farmaya: Kisi ko bhi aisi baat nahi kehni chahiye jiska usse ilm na ho. Main tumhe abhi bataata hoon ki unhone aisa kyun kaha. Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke zindagi kaal mein ek khwaab dekha aur ise unhe riwayat kiya. Mujhe laga jaise main ek baag mein hoon; iske beech mein, loha ka ek khambha khada tha, jiski buniyaad zameen mein thi aur uska sira aasmaan mein tha; aur uske sire par ek pakad thi. Mujhse kaha gaya: Is (khambhe) par chadho. Maine unse (khwaab mein aane wale se) kaha: Main aisa nahi kar sakta. Isper ek madadgaar mere paas aaya, aur usne (mujhe) peeche se mera kapda pakadkar (sahaara diya) aur is tarah apne haath se meri madad ki aur main chadhta gaya yahan tak ki main khambhe ke sire tak pahuncha, aur pakad ko thaam liya. Mujhse kaha gaya: Ise mazbooti se pakdo. Isi waqt main jaaga jab (pakad) mere haath mein thi. Maine ise (khwaab ko) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko riwayat kiya, isper unhone farmaya: Woh baag Islam ko darsaata hai aur woh khambha Islam ke sutoon ko darsaata hai. Aur woh pakad sabse mazboot imaan hai (jaisa Quran mein zikr kiya gaya hai). Aur tum Islam se juDe rahoge jab tak tum mar na jaao. Aur woh shakhs Abdullah bin Salim the.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَبَّادِ بْنِ جَبَلَةَ بْنِ أَبِي رَوَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَرَمِيُّ بْنُ عُمَارَةَ،
 حَدَّثَنَا قُرَّةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، قَالَ قَالَ قَيْسُ بْنُ عُبَادٍ كُنْتُ فِي حَلْقَةٍ فِيهَا
 سَعْدُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ وَابْنُ عُمَرَ فَمَرَّ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَلاَمٍ فَقَالُوا هَذَا رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ ‏.‏ فَقُمْتُ
 فَقُلْتُ لَهُ إِنَّهُمْ قَالُوا كَذَا وَكَذَا ‏.‏ قَالَ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ مَا كَانَ يَنْبَغِي لَهُمْ أَنْ يَقُولُوا مَا لَيْسَ
 لَهُمْ بِهِ عِلْمٌ إِنَّمَا رَأَيْتُ كَأَنَّ عَمُودًا وُضِعَ فِي رَوْضَةٍ خَضْرَاءَ فَنُصِبَ فِيهَا وَفِي رَأْسِهَا
 عُرْوَةٌ وَفِي أَسْفَلِهَا مِنْصَفٌ - وَالْمِنْصَفُ الْوَصِيفُ - فَقِيلَ لِيَ ارْقَهْ ‏.‏ فَرَقِيتُ حَتَّى أَخَذْتُ
 بِالْعُرْوَةِ فَقَصَصْتُهَا عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم ‏
"‏ يَمُوتُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَهُوَ آخِذٌ بِالْعُرْوَةِ الْوُثْقَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏
44.en: Qais b. 'Ubaida reported: I was (sitting) in a company in which there were (besides others) Sa'd b. Malik and Ibn 'Umar that 'Abdullah b. Saliim happened to pass (by that side). They (the people sitting in that company) said: He is a person from amongst the dwellers of Paradise. I stood up and said to him: They say such and such (thing about you), whereupon he said: Hallowed be Allah, it is not meet for them to say (anything) of which They have no knowledge. Verily I saw as if a pillar had been raised in a green garden and there had been fixed at its (upper) end a handhold and there was a helper at its base. It was said to me: Climb up. So I climbed up and caught hold of the haildhold. I narrated (the contents of this dream) to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), whereupon he said: 'Abdullah would die in a state that he would be catching hold of the firmest handhold (he would die holding fast to the faith).
44.hi: Qais bin Ubaida ne bayan kiya: Main ek majlis mein (baitha) tha jismein Sa'd bin Malik aur Ibn Umar (RA) bhi maujood the ke Abdullah bin Salim wahan se guzre. Unhone (us majlis mein baithe logon ne) kaha: Ye Jannat ke bashindon mein se ek shakhs hai. Main khada hua aur unse kaha: Woh aisa-aisa kehte hain (aapke baare mein), isper unhone farmaya: Allah Paak hai, unhe aisi koi baat nahi kehni chahiye jiska unhe ilm na ho. Yaqeenan maine dekha jaise ek khambha ek sabz baag mein khada kiya gaya hai aur uske (upari) sire par ek pakad lagaayi gayi hai aur uski buniyaad par ek madadgaar tha. Mujhse kaha gaya: chadho. To main chadha aur pakad thaam li. Maine (is khwaab ka byora) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko riwayat kiya, isper unhone farmaya: Abdullah is haalat mein marega ki woh sabse mazboot pakad ko thaame hoga (woh imaan ko mazbooti se pakde hue marega).

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِقُتَيْبَةَ - حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ،
 عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنْ خَرَشَةَ بْنِ الْحُرِّ، قَالَ كُنْتُ جَالِسًا فِي حَلْقَةٍ فِي
 مَسْجِدِ الْمَدِينَةِ - قَالَ - وَفِيهَا شَيْخٌ حَسَنُ الْهَيْئَةِ وَهُوَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَلاَمٍ - قَالَ - فَجَعَلَ
 يُحَدِّثُهُمْ حَدِيثًا حَسَنًا - قَالَ - فَلَمَّا قَامَ قَالَ الْقَوْمُ مَنْ سَرَّهُ أَنْ يَنْظُرَ إِلَى رَجُلٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ
 الْجَنَّةِ فَلْيَنْظُرْ إِلَى هَذَا ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقُلْتُ وَاللَّهِ لأَتْبَعَنَّهُ فَلأَعْلَمَنَّ مَكَانَ بَيْتِهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَتَبِعْتُهُ فَانْطَلَقَ
 حَتَّى كَادَ أَنْ يَخْرُجَ مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ ثُمَّ دَخَلَ مَنْزِلَهُ - قَالَ - فَاسْتَأْذَنْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَأَذِنَ لِي فَقَالَ
 مَا حَاجَتُكَ يَا ابْنَ أَخِي قَالَ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ سَمِعْتُ الْقَوْمَ يَقُولُونَ لَكَ لَمَّا قُمْتَ مَنْ سَرَّهُ أَنْ يَنْظُرَ
 إِلَى رَجُلٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ فَلْيَنْظُرْ إِلَى هَذَا ‏.‏ فَأَعْجَبَنِي أَنْ أَكُونَ مَعَكَ قَالَ اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِأَهْلِ
 الْجَنَّةِ وَسَأُحَدِّثُكَ مِمَّ قَالُوا ذَاكَ إِنِّي بَيْنَمَا أَنَا نَائِمٌ إِذْ أَتَانِي رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ لِي قُمْ ‏.‏ فَأَخَذَ
 بِيَدِي فَانْطَلَقْتُ مَعَهُ - قَالَ - فَإِذَا أَنَا بِجَوَادَّ عَنْ شِمَالِي - قَالَ - فَأَخَذْتُ لآخُذَ فِيهَا
 فَقَالَ لِي لاَ تَأْخُذْ فِيهَا فَإِنَّهَا طُرُقُ أَصْحَابِ الشِّمَالِ - قَالَ - فَإِذَا جَوَادُّ مَنْهَجٌ عَلَى
 يَمِيِنِي فَقَالَ لِي خُذْ هَا هُنَا ‏.‏ فَأَتَى بِي جَبَلاً فَقَالَ لِي اصْعَدْ - قَالَ - فَجَعَلْتُ إِذَا أَرَدْتُ
 أَنْ أَصْعَدَ خَرَرْتُ عَلَى اسْتِي - قَالَ - حَتَّى فَعَلْتُ ذَلِكَ مِرَارًا - قَالَ - ثُمَّ انْطَلَقَ بِي حَتَّى
 أَتَى بِي عَمُودًا رَأْسُهُ فِي السَّمَاءِ وَأَسْفَلُهُ فِي الأَرْضِ فِي أَعْلاَهُ حَلْقَةٌ فَقَالَ لِيَ ‏.‏ اصْعَدْ
 فَوْقَ هَذَا ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ كَيْفَ أَصْعَدُ هَذَا وَرَأْسُهُ فِي السَّمَاءِ - قَالَ - فَأَخَذَ بِيَدِي فَزَجَلَ
 بِي - قَالَ - فَإِذَا أَنَا مُتَعَلِّقٌ بِالْحَلْقَةِ - قَالَ - ثُمَّ ضَرَبَ الْعَمُودَ فَخَرَّ - قَالَ - وَبَقِيتُ
 مُتَعَلِّقًا بِالْحَلْقَةِ حَتَّى أَصْبَحْتُ - قَالَ - فَأَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَصَصْتُهَا عَلَيْهِ
 فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ أَمَّا الطُّرُقُ الَّتِي رَأَيْتَ عَنْ يَسَارِكَ فَهِيَ طُرُقُ أَصْحَابِ الشِّمَالِ - قَالَ - وَأَمَّا
 الطُّرُقُ الَّتِي رَأَيْتَ عَنْ يَمِينِكَ فَهِيَ طُرُقُ أَصْحَابِ الْيَمِينِ وَأَمَّا الْجَبَلُ فَهُوَ مَنْزِلُ الشُّهَدَاءِ
 وَلَنْ تَنَالَهُ وَأَمَّا الْعَمُودُ فَهُوَ عَمُودُ الإِسْلاَمِ وَأَمَّا الْعُرْوَةُ فَهِيَ عُرْوَةُ الإِسْلاَمِ وَلَنْ تَزَالَ مُتَمَسِّكًا
 بِهَا حَتَّى تَمُوتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
44.en: Kharasha b. Hurr reported: I was sitting in a circle in the mosque of Medina and there was an old man, quite handsome. He was 'Abdullah b. Salim. He was telling good things to them (to the people sitting in that company). As he stood up (to depart) the people said: He who is desirous of looking at a person from amongst the people of Paradise should see him. I said: By Allah, I will follow him, and would try to know his residence. So I followed him and he walked on until he reached the outskirts of Medina. He then entered his house. I sought permission from him to get in, and he granted me the permission, saying: My nephew, what is the need (that has brought you here)? I said to him: As you stood up, I heard people say about you: He who is desirous of seeing a person from among the people of Paradise should look at him. So I became desirous of accompanying you. He ('Abdullah b. Salim) said: It is Allah Who knows best about the people of Paradise. I would, however, narrate to you as to why they said like it. (The story is) that while I was asleep (one night) there came to me a person (in the dream) who asked me to stand up. (So I stood up) and he caught hold of my hand and I walked along with him, and, lo, I found some paths on my left and I was about to set out upon them. Thereupon he said to me Do not set yourself on (them) for these are the paths of the leftists (denizens of Hell-fire). Then there were paths leading to the right side, whereupon he said: Set yourself on these paths. We came across a hill and he said to me: Climb up, and I attempted to climb up that I fell upon my buttocks. I made several attempts (but failed to succeed). He led until he came to a pillar (so high) that its upper end touched the sky and its base was in the earth. And there was a handhold at its upper end. He said to me Climb over it. I said: How can I climb upon it, as its upper end touches the sky? He cought hold of my hand and pushed me up and I found myself suspended with the handhold. He then struck the pillar and it fell down, but I remained attached to that handhold until it was morning (and the dream was thus over). I came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and narrated it to him. He said: So far as the paths which you saw on your left are concerned, these are paths of the leftists (denizens of Hell) and the paths which you saw on your right, these are the paths of the rightists (the dwellers of Paradise) and the mountain represents the destination of the martyrs which you would not be able to attain. The pillar implies the pillar of Islam. and so far as the handhold is concerned, it implies the handhold of Islam, and you would hold to it fastly until you would meet death.
44.hi: Kharasha bin Hurr ne bayan kiya: Main Madina ki masjid mein ek majlis mein baitha tha aur wahan ek boodha shakhs tha, kaafi khoobsurat. Woh Abdullah bin Salim the. Woh unhe (us majlis mein baithe logon ko) achhi baatein bata rahe the. Jab woh (jaane ke liye) khade huye, logon ne kaha: Jo koi Jannat ke logon mein se kisi ko dekhna chaahta hai use unhe dekhna chahiye. Maine kaha: Allah ki qasam, main unka peecha karunga, aur unka ghar jaanne ki koshish karunga. To main unka peecha karta raha aur woh chalte rahe yahan tak ki woh Madina ke bahari ilaake tak pahunche. Phir woh apne ghar mein daakhil hue. Maine unse andar aane ki ijazat maangi, aur unhone mujhe ijazat di ye kehte hue: Mere bhatije, kya zaroorat hai (jo tumhe yahan laayi)? Maine unse kaha: Jab aap khade huye, maine logon ko aapke baare mein ye kehte suna: Jo koi Jannat ke logon mein se kisi ko dekhna chaahe use unhe dekhna chahiye. Is liye mujhe aapke saath jaane ki khwaish hui. Unhone (Abdullah bin Salim ne) kaha: Allah hi behtar jaanta hai Jannat ke logon ke baare mein. Main, halaanki, tumhe riwayat karunga ki unhone aisa kyun kaha. (Kissa ye hai) ki jab main (ek raat) so raha tha ek shakhs mere paas aaya (khwaab mein) jisne mujhse khade hone ko kaha. (Is liye main khada hua) aur usne mera haath thaama aur main uske saath chala, aur, dekho, maine apni baayi taraf kuch raaste paaye aur main unpar chalne hi wala tha. Isper usne mujhse kaha: Inpar khud ko mat le jao kyunki ye baayi taraf walon ke raaste hain (Jahannam ke bashinde). Phir daayi taraf ki taraf jaane wale raaste the, isper usne kaha: In raaston par khud ko le jao. Hum ek pahaad ke paas aaye aur usne mujhse kaha: Chadho, aur maine chadhne ki koshish ki lekin main apni sarrin ke bal gir gaya. Maine kayi koshishen kin (lekin saphal nahi ho paaya). Woh mujhe le gaya yahan tak ki woh ek khambhe ke paas aaya (itna oncha) ki iska upari sira aasmaan ko chhu raha tha aur iski buniyaad zameen mein thi. Aur uske upari sire par ek pakad thi. Usne mujhse kaha: Ispar chadho. Maine kaha: Main ispar kaise chadh sakta hoon, jabki iska upari sira aasmaan ko chhu raha hai? Usne mera haath thaama aur mujhe upar dhakela aur maine khud ko us pakad ke saath latka hua paaya. Phir usne khambhe ko maara aur ye gir gaya, lekin main us pakad se juda raha yahan tak ki subah ho gayi (aur khwaab is tarah khatm hua). Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unhe ye riwayat kiya. Unhone farmaya: Jahan tak un raaston ka sawaal hai jo tumne apni baayi taraf dekhe, ye baayi taraf walon (Jahannam ke bashindon) ke raaste hain aur jo raaste tumne apni daayi taraf dekhe, ye daayi taraf walon (Jannat ke bashindon) ke raaste hain aur pahaad shaheedon ki manzil ko darsaata hai jise tum haasil nahi kar paaoge. Khambha Islam ke sutoon ko darsaata hai. Aur jahan tak pakad ka sawaal hai, ye Islam ki pakad ko darsaata hai, aur tum ise mazbooti se pakde rahoge yahan tak ki tumhaari mout ho.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، قَالَ
 عَمْرٌو حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ، مَرَّ بِحَسَّانَ
 وَهُوَ يُنْشِدُ الشِّعْرَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَلَحَظَ إِلَيْهِ فَقَالَ قَدْ كُنْتُ أُنْشِدُ وَفِيهِ مَنْ هُوَ خَيْرٌ مِنْكَ ‏.‏
 ثُمَّ الْتَفَتَ إِلَى أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ فَقَالَ أَنْشُدُكَ اللَّهَ أَسَمِعْتَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ
 ‏
"‏ أَجِبْ عَنِّي اللَّهُمَّ أَيِّدْهُ بِرُوحِ الْقُدُسِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ اللَّهُمَّ نَعَمْ ‏.‏
44.en: Abu Huraira reported that 'Umar happened to pass by Hassan as he was reciting verses in the mosque. He (Hadrat 'Umar) looked towards him (meaningfully), whereupon he (gassin) said: I used to recite (verses) when one better than you (the Holy Prophet) had been present (here). He then looked towards Abu Huraira and said to him: I adjure you by Allah (to tell) if you had not heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: (Hassan), give a reply on my behalf; Allah I help him with Ruh-ul-Qudus. He (Abu Huraira) said: By Allah, it is so (i. e. the Prophet actually said these words).
44.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Umar (RA) Hassan ke paas se guzre jab woh masjid mein sher padh rahe the. Unhone (Hazrat Umar ne) unki taraf (mahatvapurna taur par) dekha, isper unhone (Hassan ne) kaha: Main sher padha karta tha jab tumse behtar (Allah ke Rasool SAW) yahan maujood hote the. Phir unhone Abu Huraira ki taraf dekha aur unse kaha: Main tumhe Allah ki qasam deta hoon (batane ke liye) ki kya tumne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye kehte nahi suna: Hassan, mere taraf se jawaab do; Allah, Ruh-ul-Qudus se unki madad kar. Unhone (Abu Huraira ne) kaha: Allah ki qasam, aisa hi hai (yaani Nabi (SAW) ne waaqai ye alfaaz farmaaye).

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَاهُ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ،
 أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَنَّ حَسَّانَ، قَالَ فِي حَلْقَةٍ فِيهِمْ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ
 أَنْشُدُكَ اللَّهَ يَا أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ أَسَمِعْتَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
44.en: Ibn Musayyib reported that Hassan said to a circle in which there was also Abu Huraira: Abu Huraira, I adjure you by Allah (to tell) whether you-had not heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying like this.
44.hi: Ibn Musayyib ne bayan kiya ki Hassan ne ek majlis mein kaha jismein Abu Huraira bhi maujood the: Abu Huraira, main tumhe Allah ki qasam deta hoon (batane ke liye) ki kya tumne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko aisa kehte nahi suna.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ 
 الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ حَسَّانَ بْنَ ثَابِتٍ الأَنْصَارِيَّ، يَسْتَشْهِدُ
 أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ أَنْشُدُكَ اللَّهَ هَلْ سَمِعْتَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏
"‏ يَا حَسَّانُ أَجِبْ
 عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم اللَّهُمَّ أَيِّدْهُ بِرُوحِ الْقُدُسِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ نَعَمْ
 ‏.‏
44.en: 'Abd al-Rahman reported that he heard Hassin b. Thabit al-Ansari call Abu Huraira to bear witness by saying: I adjure you by Allah if you had not heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) saying: Hassin, give a reply on behalf of the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, help him with Ruh-ul-Qudus. Abu Huraira said: Yes, it is so.
44.hi: Abd al-Rahman ne bayan kiya ki unhone Hassan bin Thabit al-Ansari ko Abu Huraira se gawaahi maangte suna ye kehte hue: Main tumhe Allah ki qasam deta hoon agar tumne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate nahi suna: Hassan, Allah ke Rasool ki taraf se jawaab do. Aye Allah, Ruh-ul-Qudus se unki madad kar. Abu Huraira ne kaha: Haan, aisa hi hai.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَدِيٍّ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ ثَابِتٍ
 - قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ بْنَ عَازِبٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ لِحَسَّانَ
 بْنِ ثَابِتٍ ‏
"‏ اهْجُهُمْ أَوْ هَاجِهِمْ وَجِبْرِيلُ مَعَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
44.en: Al-Bari' b. 'Azib reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Hassan b. Thibit, write satire (against the non-believers) ; Gabriel is with you.
44.hi: Al-Bara bin Azib ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Hassan bin Thabit, (kaafiron ke khilaaf) vyangya likho; Jibril tumhare saath hain.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنِيهِ زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا 
 غُنْدَرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ
 مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
44.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters.
44.hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ 
 أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ حَسَّانَ بْنَ ثَابِتٍ، كَانَ مِمَّنْ كَثَّرَ عَلَى عَائِشَةَ فَسَبَبْتُهُ فَقَالَتْ يَا ابْنَ أُخْتِي دَعْهُ فَإِنَّهُ
 كَانَ يُنَافِحُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
44.en: Hisham reported on the authority of his father that Hassan b. Thabit talked much about 'A'isha. I scolded him, whereupon she said: My nephew, leave him for he defended Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).
44.hi: Hisham ne apne waalid ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki ki Hassan bin Thabit Aisha (RA) ke baare mein bahut baatein karte the. Maine unhe daanta, isper unhone (Aisha ne) kaha: Mere bhatije, unhe chhod do kyunki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka difaa kiya tha.

44.ar: حَدَّثَنَاهُ عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
44.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hishim with the same chain of transmitters.
44.hi: Ye hadees Hisham ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي بِشْرُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ،
 عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، قَالَ دَخَلْتُ عَلَى عَائِشَةَ وَعِنْدَهَا حَسَّانُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ يُنْشِدُهَا
 شِعْرًا يُشَبِّبُ بِأَبْيَاتٍ لَهُ فَقَالَ حَصَانٌ رَزَانٌ مَا تُزَنُّ بِرِيبَةٍ وَتُصْبِحُ غَرْثَى مِنْ لُحُومِ الْغَوَافِلِ
 فَقَالَتْ لَهُ عَائِشَةُ لَكِنَّكَ لَسْتَ كَذَلِكَ ‏.‏ قَالَ مَسْرُوقٌ فَقُلْتُ لَهَا لِمَ تَأْذَنِينَ لَهُ يَدْخُلُ عَلَيْكِ وَقَدْ
 قَالَ اللَّهُ ‏{‏ وَالَّذِي تَوَلَّى كِبْرَهُ مِنْهُمْ لَهُ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ‏}‏ فَقَالَتْ فَأَىُّ عَذَابٍ أَشَدُّ مِنَ الْعَمَى
 إِنَّهُ كَانَ يُنَافِحُ أَوْ يُهَاجِي عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
44.en: Masruq reported: I visited 'A'isha when Hassin was sitting there and reciting verses from his compilation: She is chaste and prudent. There is no calumny against her and she rises up early in the morning without eating the meat of the un- mindful. 'A'isha said: But you are not so. Masruq said: I said to her: Why do you permit him to visit you, whereas Allah has said:" And as for him among them who took upon himself the main part thereof, he shall have a grievous punishment" (XXIV. ll)? Thereupon she said: What tornient can be more severe than this that he has become blind? He used to write satire as a rebuttal on behalf of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).
44.hi: Masruq ne bayan kiya: Main Aisha (RA) se milne gaya jab Hassan wahan baithe apne kalam mein se sher padh rahe the: Woh muqaddas aur aqlmand hain. Unpar koi ilzaam nahi hai aur woh subah jaldi uThti hain bina gaafil logon ka gosht khaaye. Aisha (RA) ne kaha: Lekin tum aise nahi ho. Masruq ne kaha: Maine unse kaha: Aap unhe apne paas aane ki ijazat kyun dete hain, jabki Allah ne farmaaya hai: "Aur unmein se jisne iska sabse bada hissa apne zimme liya use dukhad azaab milega" (24:11)? Isper unhone kaha: Isse zyada sakht azaab kya ho sakta hai ki woh andhe ho gaye hain? Woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki taraf se vyangya-jawaab likha karte the.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَاهُ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، فِي هَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ قَالَتْ
 كَانَ يَذُبُّ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ حَصَانٌ رَزَانٌ ‏.‏
44.en: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
44.hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ زَكَرِيَّاءَ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ،
 عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ قَالَ حَسَّانُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ائْذَنْ لِي فِي أَبِي سُفْيَانَ قَالَ ‏
"‏ كَيْفَ بِقَرَابَتِي
 مِنْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَالَّذِي أَكْرَمَكَ لأَسُلَّنَّكَ مِنْهُمْ كَمَا تُسَلُّ الشَّعَرَةُ مِنَ الْخَمِيرِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ حَسَّانُ وَإِنَّ
 سَنَامَ الْمَجْدِ مِنْ آلِ هَاشِمٍ بَنُو بِنْتِ مَخْزُومٍ وَوَالِدُكَ الْعَبْدُ قَصِيدَتَهُ هَذِهِ ‏.‏
44.en: 'A'isha reported that Hassin said: Allah's Messenger, permit me to write satire against Abu Sufyan, whereupon he said: How can it be because I am also related to him? Thereupon he (Hassan) said: By Him Who has honoured you. I shall draw you out from them (their family) just as hair is drawn out from the fermented (flour). Thereupon Hassan said: The dignity and greatness belongs to the tribe of Bint Makhzum from amongst the tribe of Hisham, whereas your father was a slave.
44.hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Hassan ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mujhe Abu Sufyan ke khilaaf vyangya likhne ki ijazat dijiye, isper unhone (Nabi SAW ne) farmaaya: Ye kaise ho sakta hai, jabki main bhi unse rishtedaar hoon? Isper unhone (Hassan ne) kaha: Us Hasti ki qasam jisne aapko izzat di, main aapko unse (unke khaandaan se) is tarah nikaal dunga jaise baal khameer se nikaale jaate hain. Isper Hassan ne (aage) kaha: Izzat aur azmat Hisham qabile mein se Bint Makhzum qabile ki hai, jabki tumhaara waalid ek ghulam tha.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ
 قَالَتِ اسْتَأْذَنَ حَسَّانُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي هِجَاءِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ
 أَبَا سُفْيَانَ وَقَالَ بَدَلَ الْخَمِيرِ الْعَجِينِ ‏.‏
44.en: 'Urwa reported on the same chain of transmitters that Hassan b. Thabit sought permission from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) to satirise against the polytheists, but he did not mention Abu Sufyan. And instead of the word al- Khamir, the word al-'Ajin was used.
44.hi: Urwa ne isi sanad se ye riwayat ki ki Hassan bin Thabit ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se mushrikeen ke khilaaf vyangya likhne ki ijazat maangi, lekin unhone Abu Sufyan ka koi zikr nahi kiya. Aur al-Khamir lafz ki jagah al-Ajin lafz istemal kiya gaya.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، حَدَّثَنِي خَالِدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ،
 حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي هِلاَلٍ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ غَزِيَّةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ،
 بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ اهْجُوا قُرَيْشًا
 فَإِنَّهُ أَشَدُّ عَلَيْهَا مِنْ رَشْقٍ بِالنَّبْلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَى ابْنِ رَوَاحَةَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اهْجُهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَهَجَاهُمْ
 فَلَمْ يُرْضِ فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَى كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ثُمَّ أَرْسَلَ إِلَى حَسَّانَ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ فَلَمَّا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ قَالَ
 حَسَّانُ قَدْ آنَ لَكُمْ أَنْ تُرْسِلُوا إِلَى هَذَا الأَسَدِ الضَّارِبِ بِذَنَبِهِ ثُمَّ أَدْلَعَ لِسَانَهُ فَجَعَلَ يُحَرِّكُهُ
 فَقَالَ وَالَّذِي بَعَثَكَ بِالْحَقِّ لأَفْرِيَنَّهُمْ بِلِسَانِي فَرْىَ الأَدِيمِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ تَعْجَلْ فَإِنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ أَعْلَمُ قُرَيْشٍ بِأَنْسَابِهَا - وَإِنَّ لِي فِيهِمْ نَسَبًا - حَتَّى يُلَخِّصَ
 لَكَ نَسَبِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَتَاهُ حَسَّانُ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَدْ لَخَّصَ لِي نَسَبَكَ وَالَّذِي بَعَثَكَ
 بِالْحَقِّ لأَسُلَّنَّكَ مِنْهُمْ كَمَا تُسَلُّ الشَّعَرَةُ مِنَ الْعَجِينِ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَسَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ لِحَسَّانَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ رُوحَ الْقُدُسِ لاَ يَزَالُ يُؤَيِّدُكَ مَا نَافَحْتَ عَنِ اللَّهِ
 وَرَسُولِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَتْ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ هَجَاهُمْ حَسَّانُ فَشَفَى
 وَاشْتَفَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ حَسَّانُ هَجَوْتَ مُحَمَّدًا فَأَجَبْتُ عَنْهُ وَعِنْدَ اللَّهِ فِي ذَاكَ الْجَزَاءُ هَجَوْتَ
 مُحَمَّدًا بَرًّا تَقِيًّا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ شِيمَتُهُ الْوَفَاءُ فَإِنَّ أَبِي وَوَالِدَهُ وَعِرْضِي لِعِرْضِ مُحَمَّدٍ مِنْكُمْ
 وِقَاءُ ثَكِلْتُ بُنَيَّتِي إِنْ لَمْ تَرَوْهَا تُثِيرُ النَّقْعَ مِنْ كَنَفَىْ كَدَاءِ يُبَارِينَ الأَعِنَّةَ مُصْعِدَاتٍ عَلَى
 أَكْتَافِهَا الأَسَلُ الظِّمَاءُ تَظَلُّ جِيَادُنَا مُتَمَطِّرَاتٍ تُلَطِّمُهُنَّ بِالْخُمُرِ النِّسَاءُ فَإِنْ أَعْرَضْتُمُو عَنَّا
 اعْتَمَرْنَا وَكَانَ الْفَتْحُ وَانْكَشَفَ الْغِطَاءُ وَإِلاَّ فَاصْبِرُوا لِضِرَابِ يَوْمٍ يُعِزُّ اللَّهُ فِيهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ
 وَقَالَ اللَّهُ قَدْ أَرْسَلْتُ عَبْدًا يَقُولُ الْحَقَّ لَيْسَ بِهِ خَفَاءُ وَقَالَ اللَّهُ قَدْ يَسَّرْتُ جُنْدًا هُمُ الأَنْصَارُ
 عُرْضَتُهَا اللِّقَاءُ لَنَا فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ مِنْ مَعَدٍّ سِبَابٌ أَوْ قِتَالٌ أَوْ هِجَاءُ فَمَنْ يَهْجُو رَسُولَ اللَّهِ
 مِنْكُمْ وَيَمْدَحُهُ وَيَنْصُرُهُ سَوَاءُ وَجِبْرِيلٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ فِينَا وَرُوحُ الْقُدْسِ لَيْسَ لَهُ كِفَاءُ
44.en:
'A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (may peace be uport him) said. Satirise against the (non-believing amongst the) Quraish, for (the satire) is more grievous to them than the hurt of an arrow. So he (the Holy Prophet) sent (someone) to Ibn Rawiha and asked him to satirise against them, and he composed a satire, but it did not appeal to him (to the Holy Prophet). He then sent (someone) to Ka'b b. Malik (to do the same, but what he composed did not appeal to the Holy Prophet). He then sent one to Hassan b. Thabit. As he got into his presence, Hassan said: Now you have called for this lion who strikes (the enemies) with his tail. He then brought out his tongue and began to move it and said: By Him Who has sent you with Truth, I shall tear them with my tongue as the leather is torn. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Don't be hasty; (let) Abu Bakr who has the best know- ledge of the lineage of the Quraish draw a distinction for you in regard to my lineage, as my lineage is thesame as theirs. Hassan then came to him (Abu Bakr) and after making inquiry (in regard to the lineage of the Holy Prophet) came back to him (the holy Prophet) and said: Allah's Messenger, he (Abu Bakr) has drawn a distinction in vour lineage (and that of the Quraish) By Him Who has sent you with Truth, I shall draw out from them (your name) as hair is drawn out from the flour. 'A'isha said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying to Hassin: Verily Ruh-ul- Qudus would continue to help you so long as you put up a defence on behalf of Allah and His Messenger. And she said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying: Hassan satirised against them and gave satisfaction to the (Muslims) and disquieted (the non-Muslims). 
You satirised Muhammad, but I replied on his behalf, 
And there is reward with Allah for this. 
You satirised Muhammad. virtuous, righteous, 
The Apostle of Allah, whose nature is truthfulness. 
So verily my father and his father and my honour 
Are a protection to the honour of Muhammad; 
May I lose my dear daughter, if you don't see her, 
Wiping away the dust from the two sides of Kada', 
They pull at the rein, going upward; 
On their shoulders are spears thirsting (for the blood of the enemy) ; 
our steeds are sweating-our women wipe them with their mantles. 
If you had not interfered with us, we would have performed the 'Umra, 
And (then) there was the Victory, and the darkness cleared away. 
Otherwise wait for the fighting on the day in which Allah will honour whom He pleases. 
And Allah said: I have sent a servant who says the Truth in which there is no ambiguity; 
And Allah said: I have prepared an army-they are the Ansar whose object is fighting (the enemy), 
There reaches every day from Ma'add abuse, or fighting or satire; 
Whoever satirises the Apostle from amongst you, or praises him and helps it is all the same, 
And Gabriel, the Messenger of Allah is among us, and the Holy Spirit who has no match.
44.hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Quraish (jo imaan nahi rakhte) ke khilaaf vyangya likho, kyunki (vyangya) unhe teer se lagi chot se zyada dukhad hai. To unhone (Nabi SAW ne) Ibn Rawaha ke paas (kisi ko) bheja aur unse unke khilaaf vyangya likhne ko kaha, aur unhone ek vyangya banaayi, lekin ye unhe (Nabi SAW ko) pasand nahi aayi. Phir unhone Ka'b bin Malik ke paas (kisi ko) bheja (waisa hi karne ke liye, lekin jo unhone banaya woh bhi Nabi SAW ko pasand nahi aaya). Phir unhone Hassan bin Thabit ke paas ek shakhs bheja. Jaise woh unke paas pahunche, Hassan ne kaha: Ab aapne is sher ko bulaya hai jo (dushmanon par) apni poonch se vaar karta hai. Phir unhone apni zubaan bahar nikaali aur ise hilaane lage aur kaha: Us Hasti ki qasam jisne aapko Sach ke saath bheja, main unhe apni zubaan se is tarah phaad dunga jaise chamda phaada jaata hai. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jaldi mat karo; Abu Bakr, jinhe Quraish ke vansh ka sabse behtareen ilm hai, tumhare liye mere vansh ke baare mein antar spashth karenge, kyunki mera vansh unka hi hai. Hassan phir unke (Abu Bakr ke) paas gaye aur (Nabi SAW ke vansh ke baare mein) poochh-taachh karke unke (Nabi ke) paas wapas aaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, unhone (Abu Bakr ne) aapke vansh (aur Quraish ke vansh) mein antar spashth kar diya hai. Us Hasti ki qasam jisne aapko Sach ke saath bheja, main unmein se aapka naam is tarah nikaal loonga jaise baal aate se nikaala jaata hai. Aisha (RA) ne kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Hassan se ye farmaate suna: Yaqeenan Ruh-ul-Qudus tumhaari madad karte rahenge jab tak tum Allah aur Uske Rasool ki taraf se difaa karte raho. Aur unhone (Aisha ne) kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Hassan ne unke khilaaf vyangya likhi aur (Musalmaanon ko) santushti di aur (gair-Musalmaanon ko) bechain kiya. Unhone Muhammad ke khilaaf vyangya likhi, lekin maine unki taraf se jawaab diya, Aur ismein Allah ki taraf se sawaab hai. Tumne Muhammad ke khilaaf vyangya likhi, jo nekokaar aur seedhe hain, Allah ke Rasool, jinki fitrat sachchaai hai. Is liye yaqeenan mera waalid aur unke waalid aur meri izzat Muhammad ki izzat ki hifaazat hain; Kaash meri aziz beti kho jaaye, agar tum use na dekho, Kada ke donon taraf se dhool poonchhte hue, Woh lagaam kheenchte hain, upar ki taraf jaate hue; Unke kandhon par barchhein hain jo (dushman ke khoon ki) pyaasi hain; Humaare ghode paseene se tar hain - hamaari auraten unhe apni chaadaron se ponchti hain. Agar tumne humme dakhal na diya hota, hum Umra kar chuke hote, Aur (phir) jeet hoti, aur andhera saaf ho jaata. Warna us din ki jung ka intezaar karo jismein Allah jise chaahega izzat dega. Aur Allah ne farmaaya: Maine ek banda bheja hai jo aisa Sach kehta hai jismein koi ashaknata nahi hai; Aur Allah ne farmaaya: Maine ek fauj taiyaar ki hai - woh Ansar hain jinka maqsad (dushman se) jung hai, Har din Ma'add se bura-bhala, ya jung, ya vyangya pahunchta hai; Tum mein se jo koi Rasool ke khilaaf vyangya likhta hai, ya unki tareef karta hai aur unki madad karta hai, sab barabar hai, Aur Jibril, Allah ke Rasool, humare saath hain, aur Ruh-ul-Qudus jiska koi jodi nahi hai.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ يُونُسَ الْيَمَامِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، عَنْ 
 أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، يَزِيدَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ كُنْتُ أَدْعُو أُمِّي إِلَى الإِسْلاَمِ وَهِيَ
 مُشْرِكَةٌ فَدَعَوْتُهَا يَوْمًا فَأَسْمَعَتْنِي فِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا أَكْرَهُ فَأَتَيْتُ
 رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَنَا أَبْكِي قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي كُنْتُ أَدْعُو أُمِّي إِلَى
 الإِسْلاَمِ فَتَأْبَى عَلَىَّ فَدَعَوْتُهَا الْيَوْمَ فَأَسْمَعَتْنِي فِيكَ مَا أَكْرَهُ فَادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَهْدِيَ أُمَّ أَبِي
 هُرَيْرَةَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِ أُمَّ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَخَرَجْتُ
 مُسْتَبْشِرًا بِدَعْوَةِ نَبِيِّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمَّا جِئْتُ فَصِرْتُ إِلَى الْبَابِ فَإِذَا هُوَ
 مُجَافٌ فَسَمِعَتْ أُمِّي خَشْفَ قَدَمَىَّ فَقَالَتْ مَكَانَكَ يَا أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ‏.‏ وَسَمِعْتُ خَضْخَضَةَ الْمَاءِ
 قَالَ - فَاغْتَسَلَتْ وَلَبِسَتْ دِرْعَهَا وَعَجِلَتْ عَنْ خِمَارِهَا فَفَتَحَتِ الْبَابَ ثُمَّ قَالَتْ يَا أَبَا
 هُرَيْرَةَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ - قَالَ - فَرَجَعْتُ إِلَى
 رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَتَيْتُهُ وَأَنَا أَبْكِي مِنَ الْفَرَحِ - قَالَ - قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ
 اللَّهِ أَبْشِرْ قَدِ اسْتَجَابَ اللَّهُ دَعْوَتَكَ وَهَدَى أُمَّ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ‏.‏ فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ وَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ وَقَالَ
 خَيْرًا - قَالَ - قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يُحَبِّبَنِي أَنَا وَأُمِّي إِلَى عِبَادِهِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
 وَيُحَبِّبَهُمْ إِلَيْنَا - قَالَ - فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ حَبِّبْ عُبَيْدَكَ هَذَا
 - يَعْنِي أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ وَأُمَّهُ - إِلَى عِبَادِكَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَحَبِّبْ إِلَيْهِمُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَمَا خُلِقَ مُؤْمِنٌ
 يَسْمَعُ بِي وَلاَ يَرَانِي إِلاَّ أَحَبَّنِي ‏.‏
44.en: Abu Huraira reported: I invited my mother, who was a polytlieist, to Islam. I invited her one day and she said to me something about Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) which I hated. I came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) weeping and said: Allah's Messenger, I invited my mother to Islam but she did not accept (my invitation). I invited her today but she said to me something which I did not like. (Kindly) supplicate Allah that He may set the mother of Abu Huraira right. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: O Allah, set the mother of Abu Huraira on the right path. I came out quite pleased with the supplication of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and when I came near the door it was closed from within. My mother heard the noise of my footsteps and she said: Abu Huraira, just wait. And I heard the noise of falling of water. She took a bath and put on the shirt and quickly covered her head with a headdress and opened the door and then said: Abu Huraira, I bear witness to the fact that there is no god but Allah and Muhammad is His bondsman and His Messenger. He (Abu Huraira) said: I went back to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and (this time) I was shedding the tears of joy. I said: Allah's Messenger, be happy, for Allah has responded to your supplication and He has set on the right path the mother of Abu Huraira. He (the Holy Prophet) praised Allah, and extolled Him and uttered good words. I said: Allah's Messenger, supplicate to Allah so that He may instill love of mine and that of my mother too in the believing servants and let our hearts be filled with their love, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: O Allah, let there be love of these servants of yours, i.e. Abu Huraira and his mother, in the hearts of the believing servants and let their hearts be filled with the love of the believing servants. (Abu Huraira said: This prayer) was so well granted by Allah that no believer was ever born who heard of me and who saw me but did not love me.
44.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine apni maa ko, jo mushrik thin, Islam ki taraf nimantrit kiya. Ek din maine unhe nimantrit kiya aur unhone mujhse Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke baare mein kuch aisa kaha jo mujhe napasand aaya. Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas ronde hue aaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, maine apni maa ko Islam ki taraf nimantrit kiya lekin unhone (mera nimantran) qubool nahi kiya. Aaj maine unhe nimantrit kiya lekin unhone mujhse kuch aisa kaha jo mujhe napasand aaya. (Meherbani karke) Allah se dua kijiye ki Woh Abu Huraira ki maa ko sahi raah par le aaye. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Aye Allah, Abu Huraira ki maa ko sahi raah par le aa. Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki dua se khush hokar bahar aaya aur jab main darwaze ke qareeb pahuncha ye andar se band tha. Meri maa ne mere qadmon ki aawaaz suni aur unhone kaha: Abu Huraira, thoda ruko. Aur maine paani girne ki aawaaz suni. Unhone gusl kiya aur qamees pehni aur jaldi se apna sar sirdaastar se dhaaka aur darwaza khola aur phir kaha: Abu Huraira, main gawaahi deti hoon ki Allah ke siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai aur Muhammad Uske banda aur Rasool hain. Unhone (Abu Huraira ne) kaha: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas wapas gaya aur (is baar) khushi ke aansu bahaa raha tha. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, khush ho jaayiye, kyunki Allah ne aapki dua qubool ki hai aur Usne Abu Huraira ki maa ko sahi raah par la diya hai. Unhone (Nabi SAW ne) Allah ki tareef ki, Uski hamd ki aur achhe alfaaz kahe. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Allah se dua kijiye ki Woh momino ke dilon mein mera aur meri maa ka muhabbat daal de aur humaare liye bhi unka muhabbat humaare dilon mein daal de, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Aye Allah, Apne in bandon, yaani Abu Huraira aur unki maa, ka muhabbat momino ke dilon mein daal de aur unka dil momino ke muhabbat se bhar de. (Abu Huraira ne kaha: Ye dua) Allah ne itni achhi tarah qubool ki ki koi bhi momin paida nahi hua jisne mera zikr suna ya mujhe dekha ho lekin mujhse muhabbat na kiya ho.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ جَمِيعًا عَنْ سُفْيَانَ،
 قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ
 إِنَّكُمْ تَزْعُمُونَ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يُكْثِرُ الْحَدِيثَ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَاللَّهُ الْمَوْعِدُ
 كُنْتُ رَجُلاً مِسْكِينًا أَخْدُمُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى مِلْءِ بَطْنِي وَكَانَ الْمُهَاجِرُونَ
 يَشْغَلُهُمُ الصَّفْقُ بِالأَسْوَاقِ وَكَانَتِ الأَنْصَارُ يَشْغَلُهُمُ الْقِيَامُ عَلَى أَمْوَالِهِمْ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ مَنْ يَبْسُطُ ثَوْبَهُ فَلَنْ يَنْسَى شَيْئًا سَمِعَهُ مِنِّي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَبَسَطْتُ ثَوْبِي
 حَتَّى قَضَى حَدِيثَهُ ثُمَّ ضَمَمْتُهُ إِلَىَّ فَمَا نَسِيتُ شَيْئًا سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْهُ ‏.‏
44.en: Al-A'raj reported that he heard Abu Huraira as saying: You are under the impression that Abu Huraira transmits so many ahadith from Allah's Messenger (may peace up upon him) ; (bear in mind) Allah is the great Reckoner. I was a poor man and I served Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) being satisfied with bare subsistence, whereas the immigrants remained busy with transactions in the bazar; while the Ansar had been engaged in looking after their properties. (He further reported) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: He who spreads the cloth would not forget anything that he would hear from me. I spread my cloth until he narrated something. I then pressed it against my (chest), so I never forgot anything that I heard from him.
44.hi: Al-A'raj ne bayan kiya ki unhone Abu Huraira (RA) ko ye kehte suna: Tumhe lagta hai ki Abu Huraira Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se itni saari ahadees riwayat karta hai; (dhyaan rakho) Allah sabse bada Hisaab lene wala hai. Main ek gareeb aadmi tha aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki khidmat karta tha bas guzaare laayak khaana par santusht rehte hue, jabki Muhajirin bazaar mein vyaapaar mein masroof rehte the aur Ansar apni zameenon ki dekhbhaal mein lage rehte the. (Unhone aage riwayat ki) ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jo apna kapda phailaayega use mujhse jo bhi woh sunega usmein se kuch nahi bhoolega. Maine apna kapda phailaaya yahan tak ki unhone kuch riwayat kiya. Maine phir ise apne seene se lagaaya, is liye main unse jo kuch bhi suna use kabhi nahi bhoola.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ خَالِدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْنٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا 
 عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي،
 هُرَيْرَةَ بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ غَيْرَ أَنَّ مَالِكًا، انْتَهَى حَدِيثُهُ عِنْدَ انْقِضَاءِ قَوْلِ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ
 فِي حَدِيثِهِ الرِّوَايَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ مَنْ يَبْسُطْ ثَوْبَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ إِلَى آخِرِهِ ‏.‏
44.en: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Huraira but with the variation that the hadith transmitted on the authority of Malik conclude with the words of Abu Huraira and there is no mention of a transmission of these from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ): " who spreads his cloth," to the end.
44.hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin is antar ke saath ki Malik ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hadees Abu Huraira ke alfaazon par khatm hoti hai aur ismein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se in alfaazon ki riwayat ka koi zikr nahi hai: "Jo apna kapda phailaata hai," ant tak.

44.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى التُّجِيبِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ،
 شِهَابٍ أَنَّ عُرْوَةَ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ أَلاَ يُعْجِبُكَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ جَاءَ فَجَلَسَ
 إِلَى جَنْبِ حُجْرَتِي يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُسْمِعُنِي ذَلِكَ وَكُنْتُ أُسَبِّحُ فَقَامَ
 قَبْلَ أَنْ أَقْضِيَ سُبْحَتِي وَلَوْ أَدْرَكْتُهُ لَرَدَدْتُ عَلَيْهِ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمْ
 يَكُنْ يَسْرُدُ الْحَدِيثَ كَسَرْدِكُمْ ‏.‏
44.en: 'A'isha reported: Don't you feel surprised at Abu Huraira? He came (one day) and sat beside the nook of my apartment and began to narrate (the hadith of Allah's Apostle). I was hearing while I was engaged in extolling Allah (reciting Subhan Allah) constantly. He stood up before I finished my repetition of Subhan Allah. if I were to meet him I would have warned him in stern words that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not speak so quickly as you talk.
44.hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Kya tumhe Abu Huraira par hairat nahi hota? Woh (ek din) aaye aur mere kamre ke ek kone mein baithe aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki hadees riwayat karne lage. Main sun rahi thi jabki main lagataar Allah ki tasbeeh (Subhan Allah kehte hue) mein masroof thi. Woh mere tasbeeh khatam karne se pehle hi khade ho gaye. Agar main unse milti to main unhe sakht alfaazon mein chetaavni deti ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) itni jaldi baat nahi karte the jitna tum karte ho.

44.ar:
قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ وَقَالَ ابْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ إِنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ يَقُولُونَ إِنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ
 قَدْ أَكْثَرَ وَاللَّهُ الْمَوْعِدُ وَيَقُولُونَ مَا بَالُ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ وَالأَنْصَارِ لاَ يَتَحَدَّثُونَ مِثْلَ أَحَادِيثِهِ وَسَأُخْبِرُكُمْ
 عَنْ ذَلِكَ إِنَّ إِخْوَانِي مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ كَانَ يَشْغَلُهُمْ عَمَلُ أَرَضِيهِمْ وَإِنَّ إِخْوَانِي مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ
 كَانَ يَشْغَلُهُمُ الصَّفْقُ بِالأَسْوَاقِ وَكُنْتُ أَلْزَمُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى مِلْءِ بَطْنِي
 فَأَشْهَدُ إِذَا غَابُوا وَأَحْفَظُ إِذَا نَسُوا وَلَقَدْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمًا ‏"‏ أَيُّكُمْ
 يَبْسُطُ ثَوْبَهُ فَيَأْخُذُ مِنْ حَدِيثِي هَذَا ثُمَّ يَجْمَعُهُ إِلَى صَدْرِهِ فَإِنَّهُ لَمْ يَنْسَ شَيْئًا سَمِعَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
 فَبَسَطْتُ بُرْدَةً عَلَىَّ حَتَّى فَرَغَ مِنْ حَدِيثِهِ ثُمَّ جَمَعْتُهَا إِلَى صَدْرِي فَمَا نَسِيتُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ الْيَوْمِ
 شَيْئًا حَدَّثَنِي بِهِ وَلَوْلاَ آيَتَانِ أَنْزَلَهُمَا اللَّهُ فِي كِتَابِهِ مَا حَدَّثْتُ شَيْئًا أَبَدًا ‏{‏ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَكْتُمُونَ
 مَا أَنْزَلْنَا مِنَ الْبَيِّنَاتِ وَالْهُدَى‏}‏ إِلَى آخِرِ الآيَتَيْنِ ‏.‏
44.en: Ibn Shihab transmitted on the authority of Ibn Musayyib that Abu Huraira said: People say that Abu Huraira transmits so many ahadith, whereas Allah is the Reckoner, and they say: How is it with Muhajirs and the Ansar that they do not narrate ahadith like him (like Abu Huraira)? Abu Huraira said: I tell you that my brothers from Ansar remained busy with their lands and my brothers Muhajirs were busy in transactions in the bazars, but I always kept myself attached to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with bare subsistence. I remained present (in the company of the Holy Prophet), whereas they had been absent. I retained in my mind (what the Prophet said), whereas they forgot it. One day Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: He who amongst you spreads the cloth and listens to my talk and would then press it against his chest would never forget anything heard from me. So I spread my mantle and when he had concluded his talk I then pressed it against my chest and so I never forgot after that day anything that he (the Holy Prophet) said. And if these two verses would not have been revealed in the Book I would have never transmitted anything (to anybody):" Those who conceal the clear evidence and the guidance that We revealed" (ii. 159) tip to the last verse.
44.hi: Ibn Shihab ne Ibn Musayyib ki sanad se ye riwayat ki ki Abu Huraira ne kaha: Log kehte hain ki Abu Huraira itni saari ahadees riwayat karta hai, jabki Allah Hisaab lene wala hai, aur woh kehte hain: Muhajirin aur Ansar ka kya hai ki woh iski (Abu Huraira ki) tarah ahadees riwayat nahi karte? Abu Huraira ne kaha: Main tumhe bataata hoon ki mere Ansar bhai apni zameenon mein masroof rehte the aur mere Muhajir bhai bazaaron mein vyaapaar mein masroof rehte the, lekin main hamesha Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath juda raha bas guzaare laayak khaana par (santusht rehte hue). Main (Nabi SAW ki sohbat mein) maujood raha, jabki woh gair-haazir rahte the. Maine (jo Nabi ne farmaaya) yaad rakha, jabki woh bhool jaate the. Ek din Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jo tum mein se apna kapda phailaaye aur mera kalam sune aur phir ise apne seene se lagaaye, woh mujhse jo suna use kabhi nahi bhoolega. To maine apna chogha phailaaya aur jab unhone apni baat khatm ki maine ise apne seene se lagaaya aur isi din ke baad se main unhone (Nabi ne) jo kuch kaha use kabhi nahi bhoola. Aur agar ye do aayaten Kitaab mein nazil na hui hoti, main kabhi kisi ko kuch riwayat na karta: "Jo log saaf saboot aur margdarshan chhupaate hain jo Humne nazil kiya" (2:159) akhri aayat tak.

44.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، عَنْ شُعَيْبٍ، عَنِ 
 الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، وَأَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ
 تَقُولُونَ إِنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يُكْثِرُ الْحَدِيثَ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِهِمْ
 ‏.‏
44.en: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Huraira (and the words are): You say that Abu Huraira narrates so many ahadith from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ; the rest of the hadith is the same.
44.hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai (aur alfaaz hain): Tum kehte ho ki Abu Huraira Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se itni saari ahadees riwayat karta hai; baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

44.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
 وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ - وَاللَّفْظُ لِعَمْرٍو - قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرُونَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ،
 عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، - وَهُوَ كَاتِبُ عَلِيٍّ
 قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَلِيًّا، رضى الله عنه وَهُوَ يَقُولُ بَعَثَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَا
 وَالزُّبَيْرَ وَالْمِقْدَادَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ائْتُوا رَوْضَةَ خَاخٍ فَإِنَّ بِهَا ظَعِينَةً مَعَهَا كِتَابٌ فَخُذُوهُ مِنْهَا ‏"‏
 ‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقْنَا تَعَادَى بِنَا خَيْلُنَا فَإِذَا نَحْنُ بِالْمَرْأَةِ فَقُلْنَا أَخْرِجِي الْكِتَابَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ مَا مَعِي
 كِتَابٌ ‏.‏ فَقُلْنَا لَتُخْرِجِنَّ الْكِتَابَ أَوْ لَتُلْقِيَنَّ الثِّيَابَ ‏.‏ فَأَخْرَجَتْهُ مِنْ عِقَاصِهَا فَأَتَيْنَا بِهِ رَسُولَ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَإِذَا فِيهِ مِنْ حَاطِبِ بْنِ أَبِي بَلْتَعَةَ إِلَى نَاسٍ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ مِنْ
 أَهْلِ مَكَّةَ يُخْبِرُهُمْ بِبَعْضِ أَمْرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله
 عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَا حَاطِبُ مَا هَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ تَعْجَلْ عَلَىَّ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي كُنْتُ امْرَأً مُلْصَقًا
 فِي قُرَيْشٍ - قَالَ سُفْيَانُ كَانَ حَلِيفًا لَهُمْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ مِنْ أَنْفُسِهَا - وَكَانَ مِمَّنْ كَانَ مَعَكَ
