45.en: 'Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Truth leads one to Paradise and virtue leads one to Paradise and the person tells the truth until he is recorded as truthful, and lie leads to obscenity and obscenity leads to Hell, and the person tells a lie until he is recorded as a liar.
45.hi: Abdullah (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Sach shakhs ko Jannat tak le jaata hai aur nekokaari Jannat tak le jaati hai aur shakhs sach kehta rehta hai yahan tak ki use sachcha darj kar diya jaata hai, aur jhoot behayaai tak le jaata hai aur behayaai Jahannam tak le jaati hai, aur shakhs jhoot bolta rehta hai yahan tak ki use jhoota darj kar diya jaata hai.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَهَنَّادُ بْنُ السَّرِيِّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ 
 مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 ‏
"‏ إِنَّ الصِّدْقَ بِرٌّ وَإِنَّ الْبِرَّ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ وَإِنَّ الْعَبْدَ لَيَتَحَرَّى الصِّدْقَ حَتَّى يُكْتَبَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ
 صِدِّيقًا وَإِنَّ الْكَذِبَ فُجُورٌ وَإِنَّ الْفُجُورَ يَهْدِي إِلَى النَّارِ وَإِنَّ الْعَبْدَ لَيَتَحَرَّى الْكَذِبَ حَتَّى يُكْتَبَ
 كَذَّابًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
45.en: 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Telling of truth is a virtue and virtue leads to Paradise and the servant who endeavours to tell the truth is recorded as truthful, and lie is obscenity and obscenity leads to Hell-Fire, and the servant who endeavours to tell a lie is recorded as a liar. Ibn Abu Shaiba reported this from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ).
45.hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Sach kehna nekokaari hai aur nekokaari Jannat tak le jaati hai, aur woh banda jo sach kehne ki koshish karta hai use sachcha darj kiya jaata hai, aur jhoot behayaai hai aur behayaai Jahannam tak le jaati hai, aur woh banda jo jhoot kehne ki koshish karta hai use jhoota darj kiya jaata hai. Ibn Abu Shaiba ne ise Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، وَوَكِيعٌ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ،
 ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ
 رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ عَلَيْكُمْ بِالصِّدْقِ فَإِنَّ الصِّدْقَ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْبِرِّ وَإِنَّ الْبِرَّ
 يَهْدِي إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ وَمَا يَزَالُ الرَّجُلُ يَصْدُقُ وَيَتَحَرَّى الصِّدْقَ حَتَّى يُكْتَبَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ صِدِّيقًا وَإِيَّاكُمْ
 وَالْكَذِبَ فَإِنَّ الْكَذِبَ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْفُجُورِ وَإِنَّ الْفُجُورَ يَهْدِي إِلَى النَّارِ وَمَا يَزَالُ الرَّجُلُ يَكْذِبُ
 وَيَتَحَرَّى الْكَذِبَ حَتَّى يُكْتَبَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ كَذَّابًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: 'Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: It is obligatory for you to tell the truth, for truth leads to virtue and virtue leads to Paradise, and the man who continues to speak the truth and endeavours to tell the truth is eventually recorded as truthful with Allah, and beware of telling of a lie for telling of a lie leads to obscenity and obscenity leads to Hell-Fire, and the person who keeps telling lies and endeavours to tell a lie is recorded as a liar with Allah.
45.hi: Abdullah (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Tumhaare liye zaroori hai ki sach bolo, kyunki sach nekokaari tak le jaata hai aur nekokaari Jannat tak le jaati hai, aur jo shakhs sach bolta rehta hai aur sach kehne ki koshish karta hai use aakhir mein Allah ke paas sachcha darj kar diya jaata hai, aur jhoot bolne se bacho kyunki jhoot behayaai tak le jaata hai aur behayaai Jahannam tak le jaati hai, aur jo shakhs jhoot bolta rehta hai aur jhoot kehne ki koshish karta hai use Allah ke paas jhoota darj kar diya jaata hai.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مِنْجَابُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ التَّمِيمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ،
 إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ
 فِي حَدِيثِ عِيسَى ‏"‏ وَيَتَحَرَّى الصِّدْقَ وَيَتَحَرَّى الْكَذِبَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ ابْنِ مُسْهِرٍ ‏"‏ حَتَّى
 يَكْتُبَهُ اللَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: This hadith has been reported on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters and no mention is made in the hadith transmitted on the authority of 'Isa (of these words): " He who endeavours to tell the truth and endeavours to tell a lie," and in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Mushir (the words are):" Until Allah records it".
45.hi: Ye hadees A'mash ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur Isa ki riwayat mein (in alfaazon ka) koi zikr nahi hai: "Jo sach kehne ki aur jo jhoot kehne ki koshish karta hai," aur Mushir ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: "Yahan tak ki Allah ise darj kar de."

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَعُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِقُتَيْبَةَ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ،
 عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ قَالَ
 رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا تَعُدُّونَ الرَّقُوبَ فِيكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْنَا الَّذِي لاَ يُولَدُ
 لَهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ لَيْسَ ذَاكَ بِالرَّقُوبِ وَلَكِنَّهُ الرَّجُلُ الَّذِي لَمْ يُقَدِّمْ مِنْ وَلَدِهِ شَيْئًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَمَا
 تَعُدُّونَ الصُّرَعَةَ فِيكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْنَا الَّذِي لاَ يَصْرَعُهُ الرِّجَالُ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ لَيْسَ بِذَلِكَ وَلَكِنَّهُ
 الَّذِي يَمْلِكُ نَفْسَهُ عِنْدَ الْغَضَبِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: Abdullah b. Mas'ud reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Whom do you count as" Raqub" amongst you? They (his Companions) said: One who has no children (the children are born unto him but they do not survive). Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: He is not a Raqub but Raqub is one who does not find his child as the forerunner (in Paradise). He then said: Whom do you count as a wrestler amongst you? We said: He who wrestles with persons. He said: No, it is not he but one who controls himself when in a fit of rage.
45.hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Tum mein se "Raqub" kise maante ho? Unhone (Sahaba ne) kaha: Woh jiske koi bachche na hon (bachche paida hote hain lekin woh zinda nahi rehte). Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) farmaaya: Woh Raqub nahi hai, balki Raqub woh hai jo apne bachche ko (Jannat mein) agrasar ke soorat mein na paaye. Unhone phir farmaaya: Tum mein pahalwaan kise maante ho? Humne kaha: Jo logon se kushti ladta hai. Unhone farmaaya: Nahi, ye woh nahi hai, balki woh hai jo apne gusse ke waqt khud par kaabu rakhta hai.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ،
 بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَ مَعْنَاهُ ‏.‏
45.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters.
45.hi: Ye hadees A'mash ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَعَبْدُ الأَعْلَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ، قَالاَ كِلاَهُمَا قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ
 عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 قَالَ ‏
"‏ لَيْسَ الشَّدِيدُ بِالصُّرَعَةِ إِنَّمَا الشَّدِيدُ الَّذِي يَمْلِكُ نَفْسَهُ عِنْدَ الْغَضَبِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The strong-man is not one who wrestles well but the strong man is one who controls himself when he is in a fit of rage.
45.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Taakatvar aadmi woh nahi hai jo achhi kushti ladta hai balki taakatvar aadmi woh hai jo apne gusse ke waqt khud par kaabu rakhta hai.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا حَاجِبُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، عَنِ الزُّبَيْدِيِّ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَخْبَرَنِي 
 حُمَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ
 ‏"‏ لَيْسَ الشَّدِيدُ بِالصُّرَعَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا فَالشَّدِيدُ أَيُّمَ هُوَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ الَّذِي يَمْلِكُ نَفْسَهُ
 عِنْدَ الْغَضَبِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: Abu Huraira reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: One is not strong because of one's wrestling skillfully. They said: Allah's Messenger, then who is strong? He said: He who controls his anger when he is in a fit of rage.
45.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Koi shakhs is liye taakatvar nahi hai kyunki woh achhi tarah kushti ladta hai. Unhone (Sahaba ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, phir taakatvar kaun hai? Unhone farmaaya: Woh jo apne gusse par kaabu rakhta hai jab use gussa aata hai.

45.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ،
 ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ بَهْرَامَ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، كِلاَهُمَا
 عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
45.en: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters.
45.hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ، قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ ابْنُ الْعَلاَءِ،
 حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ صُرَدٍ، قَالَ اسْتَبَّ رَجُلاَنِ
 عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَجَعَلَ أَحَدُهُمَا تَحْمَرُّ عَيْنَاهُ وَتَنْتَفِخُ أَوْدَاجُهُ قَالَ رَسُولُ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ إِنِّي لأَعْرِفُ كَلِمَةً لَوْ قَالَهَا لَذَهَبَ عَنْهُ الَّذِي يَجِدُ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ
 مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ الرَّجُلُ وَهَلْ تَرَى بِي مِنْ جُنُونٍ قَالَ ابْنُ الْعَلاَءِ فَقَالَ وَهَلْ
 تَرَى ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ الرَّجُلَ
45.en: Sulaiman b. Surad reported that two persons abused each other in the presence of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and the eyes of one of them became red as embers and the veins of his neck were swollen. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I know of a wording, if he were to utter that, his fit of rage (would be no more and that wording is): I seek refuge with Allah from Satan the accursed. The person said: Do you find any madness in me? Ibn al-'Ala' said: Do you see it? And he made no mention of the person.
45.hi: Sulaiman bin Surad (RA) ne bayan kiya ki do log Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki maujoodgi mein ek-doosre ko bura-bhala kehne lage aur unmein se ek ki aankhein angaaron ki tarah laal ho gayin aur uski gardan ki naseen sooj gayin. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Main ek aisa lafz jaanta hoon ki agar woh use kahe to uska gussa khatam ho jaayega (aur woh lafz hai): Main Shaitaan-e-laanti se Allah ki panah maangta hoon. Us shakhs ne kaha: Kya aapko mujhme koi paagalpan nazar aata hai? Ibn al-Ala ne kaha: Kya tum ye dekhte ho? Aur unhone us shakhs ka koi zikr nahi kiya.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، سَمِعْتُ الأَعْمَشَ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ 
 عَدِيَّ بْنَ ثَابِتٍ، يَقُولُ حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ صُرَدٍ، قَالَ اسْتَبَّ رَجُلاَنِ عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم فَجَعَلَ أَحَدُهُمَا يَغْضَبُ وَيَحْمَرُّ وَجْهُهُ فَنَظَرَ إِلَيْهِ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ
 ‏"‏ إِنِّي لأَعْلَمُ كَلِمَةً لَوْ قَالَهَا لَذَهَبَ ذَا عَنْهُ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَامَ إِلَى
 الرَّجُلِ رَجُلٌ مِمَّنْ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ أَتَدْرِي مَا قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم آنِفًا قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنِّي لأَعْلَمُ كَلِمَةً لَوْ قَالَهَا لَذَهَبَ ذَا عَنْهُ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ
 الرَّجِيمِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ الرَّجُلُ أَمَجْنُونًا تَرَانِي
45.en: Sulaiman b. Surad reported that two persons abused each other in the presence of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and one of them fell into a rage and his face became red. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) saw him and said: I know of a wording; if he were to utter that, he would get out (of the fit of anger) (and the wording is): I seek refuge with Allah from Satan, the accursed. Thereupon, a person went to him who had heard that from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and said to him: Do you know what Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said? He (the Holy Prophet) said: I know of a wording; if he were to say that, (the fit) would be no more (and the words are): I seek refuge with Allah from Satan, the accursed. And the person said to him: Do you find me mad?
45.hi: Sulaiman bin Surad (RA) ne bayan kiya ki do log Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki maujoodgi mein ek-doosre ko bura-bhala kehne lage aur unmein se ek gusse mein aa gaya aur uska chehra laal ho gaya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne use dekha aur farmaaya: Main ek aisa lafz jaanta hoon; agar woh use kahe, to woh (gusse ki haalat se) baahar aa jaayega (aur woh lafz hai): Main Shaitaan-e-laanti se Allah ki panah maangta hoon. Isper, ek shakhs uske paas gaya jisne ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suna tha aur usse kaha: Kya tumhe pata hai Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kya farmaaya? Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) farmaaya: Main ek lafz jaanta hoon; agar woh use kahe, to (gussa) khatam ho jaayega (aur woh alfaaz hain): Main Shaitaan-e-laanti se Allah ki panah maangta hoon. Aur us shakhs ne usse kaha: Kya tumhe main paagal lagta hoon?

45.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ
 ‏.‏
45.en: This hadith has been reported on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters.
45.hi: Ye hadees A'mash ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ 
 ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ لَمَّا صَوَّرَ اللَّهُ آدَمَ فِي الْجَنَّةِ
 تَرَكَهُ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَتْرُكَهُ فَجَعَلَ إِبْلِيسُ يُطِيفُ بِهِ يَنْظُرُ مَا هُوَ فَلَمَّا رَآهُ أَجْوَفَ عَرَفَ
 أَنَّهُ خُلِقَ خَلْقًا لاَ يَتَمَالَكُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: Anas reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When Allah fashioned Adam in Paradise, He left him as He liked him to leave. Then Iblis roamed round him to see what actually that was and when he found him hollow from within, he recognised that he had been created with a disposition that he would not have control over himself.
45.hi: Anas (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jab Allah ne Aadam ko Jannat mein Dhaala, Usne unhe utni der chhoDa jitna Usne chhoDna pasand kiya. Phir Iblis unke aas-paas ghooma ye dekhne ke liye ki ye waastav mein kya hai aur jab usne unhe andar se khokhla paaya, usne pehchaana ki unhe aise mizaj ke saath banaaya gaya hai ki woh apne aap par kaabu nahi rakh payenge.

45.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
45.en: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Humaid with the same chain of transmitters.
45.hi: Isi jaisi ek hadees Humaid ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ، - يَعْنِي الْحِزَامِيَّ - عَنِ أَبِي،
 الزِّنَادِ عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ إِذَا قَاتَلَ
 أَحَدُكُمْ أَخَاهُ فَلْيَجْتَنِبِ الْوَجْهَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When any one of you fights with his brother he should avoid striking at the face.
45.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jab tum mein se koi apne bhai se laDta hai, use uske chehre par maarne se bachna chahiye.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ،
 بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ ‏
"‏ إِذَا ضَرَبَ أَحَدُكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Zinad and he said: " When one amongst you strikes (at the face)."
45.hi: Ye hadees Abu Zinad ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur unhone kaha: "Jab tum mein se koi (chehre par) maarta hai."

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ،
 عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ إِذَا قَاتَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ أَخَاهُ فَلْيَتَّقِ الْوَجْهَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: When any one of you fights with his brother, he should spare his face.
45.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jab tum mein se koi apne bhai se laDta hai, use uske chehre ko bachaana chahiye.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، سَمِعَ أَبَا،
 أَيُّوبَ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ إِذَا قَاتَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ
 أَخَاهُ فَلاَ يَلْطِمَنَّ الْوَجْهَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When any one of you fights with his brother, he should not slap at the face.
45.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jab tum mein se koi apne bhai se laDta hai, use uske chehre par thappad nahi maarna chahiye.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُثَنَّى، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ،
 حَاتِمٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنِ الْمُثَنَّى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ 
 أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَفِي حَدِيثِ ابْنِ حَاتِمٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ إِذَا قَاتَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ أَخَاهُ فَلْيَجْتَنِبِ الْوَجْهَ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ خَلَقَ آدَمَ
 عَلَى صُورَتِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Huraira and in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Ibn Hatim Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) is reported to have said: When any one of you fights with his brother, he should avoid his face for Allah created Adam in His own image.
45.hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur Ibn Hatim ki riwayat mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke ye alfaaz milte hain: Jab tum mein se koi apne bhai se laDta hai, use uske chehre se bachna chahiye kyunki Allah ne Aadam ko Apni surat par banaaya hai.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى،
 بْنِ مَالِكٍ الْمَرَاغِيِّ - وَهُوَ أَبُو أَيُّوبَ - عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 قَالَ ‏
"‏ إِذَا قَاتَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ أَخَاهُ فَلْيَجْتَنِبِ الْوَجْهَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When any one of you fights with his brother, he should avoid the face.
45.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jab tum mein se koi apne bhai se laDta hai, use chehre se bachna chahiye.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ 
 أَبِيهِ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ حَكِيمِ بْنِ حِزَامٍ، قَالَ مَرَّ بِالشَّامِ عَلَى أُنَاسٍ وَقَدْ أُقِيمُوا فِي الشَّمْسِ
 وَصُبَّ عَلَى رُءُوسِهِمُ الزَّيْتُ فَقَالَ مَا هَذَا قِيلَ يُعَذَّبُونَ فِي الْخَرَاجِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَمَا إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ
 رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏
"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُعَذِّبُ الَّذِينَ يُعَذِّبُونَ فِي الدُّنْيَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: 'Urwa reported on the authority of his father that Hisham b. Hakim b. Hizam happened to pass by some people in Syria who had been made to stand in the sun and olive-oil was being poured upon their heads. He said: What is this? It was said: They are being punished for (not paying) the Kharaj (the government revenue). Thereupon he said: Allah would punish those who torment people in this world (without any genuine reason).
45.hi: Urwa ne apne waalid ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki ki Hisham bin Hakim bin Hizam Syria mein kuch logon ke paas se guzre jinhe dhoop mein khada kiya gaya tha aur unke saron par zaitun ka tel Dala jaa raha tha. Unhone kaha: Ye kya hai? Kaha gaya: Unhe Kharaj (sarkaari mahasool) na dene ki saza di ja rahi hai. Isper unhone kaha: Allah unhe saza dega jo logon ko is duniya mein (bina kisi vaajib wajah ke) taklif dete hain.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ مَرَّ هِشَامُ بْنُ حَكِيمِ
 بْنِ حِزَامٍ عَلَى أُنَاسٍ مِنَ الأَنْبَاطِ بِالشَّامِ قَدْ أُقِيمُوا فِي الشَّمْسِ فَقَالَ مَا شَأْنُهُمْ قَالُوا
 حُبِسُوا فِي الْجِزْيَةِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ هِشَامٌ أَشْهَدُ لَسَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ
 ‏
"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُعَذِّبُ الَّذِينَ يُعَذِّبُونَ النَّاسَ فِي الدُّنْيَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: Hisham reported on the authority of his father that Hisham b. Hakim b. Hizam happened to pass by people, the farmers of Syria, who had been made to stand in the sun. He said: What is the matter with them? They said: They have been detained for Jizya. Thereupon Hisham said: I bear testimony to the fact that I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah would torment those who torment people in the world.
45.hi: Hisham ne apne waalid ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki ki Hisham bin Hakim bin Hizam kuch logon ke paas se guzre, Syria ke kisaanon ke, jinhe dhoop mein khada kiya gaya tha. Unhone kaha: Inhe kya hua hai? Unhone kaha: Unhe Jizya (kar) na dene ki wajah se rok kar rakha gaya hai. Isper Hisham ne kaha: Main gawaahi deta hoon ki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Allah unhe saza dega jo logon ko is duniya mein taklif dete hain.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، وَأَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا 
 جَرِيرٌ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ هِشَامٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَزَادَ فِي حَدِيثِ جَرِيرٍ قَالَ وَأَمِيرُهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ عُمَيْرُ بْنُ
 سَعْدٍ عَلَى فِلَسْطِينَ فَدَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ فَحَدَّثَهُ فَأَمَرَ بِهِمْ فَخُلُّوا ‏.‏
45.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters and he made this addition of Jarir that (Hisham b. Hakim) went to Umair b. Sa'd who was then ruler in Palestine and he narrated to him this hadith and he (submitting before the words of the Prophet) commanded that they should be let off and so they were let off.
45.hi: Ye hadees Hisham ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur unhone Jarir ki riwayat mein ye izafa kiya ki (Hisham bin Hakim) Umair bin Sa'd ke paas gaye jo us waqt Palestine mein hakim the aur unhone unhe ye hadees riwayat ki aur unhone (Nabi ke alfaazon ke saamne sar jhukaate hue) hukum diya ki unhe chhod diya jaaye, aur unhe chhod diya gaya.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ،
 بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ أَنَّ هِشَامَ بْنَ حَكِيمٍ، وَجَدَ رَجُلاً وَهُوَ عَلَى حِمْصَ يُشَمِّسُ نَاسًا مِنَ النَّبَطِ فِي
 أَدَاءِ الْجِزْيَةِ فَقَالَ مَا هَذَا إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏
"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ
 يُعَذِّبُ الَّذِينَ يُعَذِّبُونَ النَّاسَ فِي الدُّنْيَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: 'Urwa b. Zubair reported that Hisham b. Hakim found a person (the ruler of Hims) who had been detaining some Nabateans in connection with the dues of Jizya. He said: What is this? I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah would torment those persons who torment people in the world.
45.hi: Urwa bin Zubair ne bayan kiya ki Hisham bin Hakim ne ek shakhs (Hims ke gavarnar) ko paaya jo Jizya ke bakaaya ke silsile mein kuch Nabateion ko rok kar rakhe hue the. Unhone kaha: Ye kya hai? Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Allah un logon ko saza dega jo logon ko is duniya mein taklif dete hain.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ،
 أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا - سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، سَمِعَ جَابِرًا، يَقُولُ مَرَّ رَجُلٌ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ
 بِسِهَامٍ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ أَمْسِكْ بِنِصَالِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: 'Amr heard Jabir as saying: A person happened to come to the mosque with an arrow; thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him: Take hold of its pointed head.
45.hi: Amr ne Jabir ko ye kehte suna: Ek shakhs masjid mein ek teer lekar aaya, isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne usse farmaaya: Iski nokdaar sira pakDo.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، قَالَ أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ، يَحْيَى - وَاللَّفْظُ
 لَهُ - أَخْبَرَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، مَرَّ بِأَسْهُمٍ
 فِي الْمَسْجِدِ قَدْ أَبْدَى نُصُولَهَا فَأُمِرَ أَنْ يَأْخُذَ بِنُصُولِهَا كَىْ لاَ يَخْدِشَ مُسْلِمًا ‏.‏
45.en: Jabir b. Abdullah reported that a person happened to come to the mosque with arrows and their iron-ends were exposed, so he was commanded that he should grasp the pointed heads so that these might not do any harm to a Muslim.
45.hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs masjid mein teer lekar aaya aur unke loha ke sire khule hue the, is liye use hukum diya gaya ki woh unhe nokdaar hisson se pakDe taaki ye kisi Musalman ko koi nuksaan na pahunchaa payein.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ 
 أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ أَمَرَ رَجُلاً كَانَ يَتَصَدَّقُ بِالنَّبْلِ
 فِي الْمَسْجِدِ أَنْ لاَ يَمُرَّ بِهَا إِلاَّ وَهُوَ آخِذٌ بِنُصُولِهَا ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ رُمْحٍ كَانَ يَصَّدَّقُ بِالنَّبْلِ
 ‏.‏
45.en: Jabir reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded a person who had been distributing arrows freely in the mosque that he should not move about in the mosque but by catching hold of their iron-heads. Ibn Rumh narrated this with a slight variation of wording.
45.hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne ek shakhs ko jo masjid mein teer bant raha tha hukum diya ki woh masjid mein bina unke loha wale sire pakDe idhar-udhar na jaaye. Ibn Rumh ne ise alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا هَدَّابُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي،
 مُوسَى أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ إِذَا مَرَّ أَحَدُكُمْ فِي مَجْلِسٍ أَوْ سُوقٍ وَبِيَدِهِ
 نَبْلٌ فَلْيَأْخُذْ بِنِصَالِهَا ثُمَّ لْيَأْخُذْ بِنِصَالِهَا ثُمَّ لْيَأْخُذْ بِنِصَالِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ أَبُو مُوسَى وَاللَّهِ
 مَا مُتْنَا حَتَّى سَدَّدْنَاهَا بَعْضُنَا فِي وُجُوهِ بَعْضٍ ‏.‏
45.en: Abd Musa reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: When any one of you happens to go to a meeting or the bazar with an arrow in his hand he must grasp its pointed head; then (he again said): He must grasp its pointed head. Abu Musa said: By Allah, we did not court death until some of us had flung arrows upon the faces of one another.
45.hi: Abu Musa (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jab tum mein se koi majlis mein ya bazaar mein haath mein teer lekar jaaye, to use uska nokdaar sira pakDna chahiye; phir (unhone dobara farmaaya): Use uska nokdaar sira pakDna chahiye. Abu Musa ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, humne maut ko tab tak nahi bulaaya jab tak humme se kuch logon ne ek-doosre ke chehron par teer nahi phenke.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ بَرَّادٍ الأَشْعَرِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ - قَالاَ
 حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ بُرَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 قَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا مَرَّ أَحَدُكُمْ فِي مَسْجِدِنَا أَوْ فِي سُوقِنَا وَمَعَهُ نَبْلٌ فَلْيُمْسِكْ عَلَى نِصَالِهَا بِكَفِّهِ
 أَنْ يُصِيبَ أَحَدًا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ مِنْهَا بِشَىْءٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ أَوْ قَالَ ‏"‏ لِيَقْبِضْ عَلَى نِصَالِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: Abu Musa reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) assaying: He who amongst you moves in the mosque or in the bazar and there is an arrow with him he should take hold of its iron-head in his palm, so that none amongst the Muslims should receive any injury from it, or he said, should catch its iron-head.
45.hi: Abu Musa (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jo tum mein se masjid mein ya bazaar mein chalta hai aur uske paas teer hai, use chahiye ki woh uske loha wale sire ko apni hatheli mein pakDe, taaki kisi Musalman ko isse koi chot na pahunche, ya unhone kaha, use iske loha wale sire ko pakDna chahiye.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، قَالَ عَمْرٌو حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ 
 أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ أَبُو الْقَاسِمِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏
 مَنْ أَشَارَ إِلَى أَخِيهِ بِحَدِيدَةٍ فَإِنَّ الْمَلاَئِكَةَ تَلْعَنُهُ حَتَّى وَإِنْ كَانَ أَخَاهُ لأَبِيهِ وَأُمِّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: Abu Huraira reported: Abu'l-Qasim (the kunya of Allah's Messenger, may peace be upon him), said: He who pointed a weapon towards his brother the angels invoke curse upon him even if he is his real brother so long as he does not abandon it (the pointing of weapon towards one's brother Muslim).
45.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Abu'l-Qasim (Allah ke Rasool ki kunya) ne farmaaya: Jo apne bhai ki taraf hathiyaar ka ishara karta hai, Farishte uspar laanat karte hain chahe woh uska khud ka (sagaa) bhai hi kyun na ho, jab tak woh isse (apne Musalman bhai ki taraf hathiyaar ka ishara karna) chhod na de.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ،
 عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
45.en: Abu Huraira reported a hadith like this from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) through another chain of transmitters.
45.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne isi jaisi ek hadees Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، قَالَ
 هَذَا مَا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ أَحَادِيثَ مِنْهَا وَقَالَ
 رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ لاَ يُشِيرُ أَحَدُكُمْ إِلَى أَخِيهِ بِالسِّلاَحِ فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَدْرِي أَحَدُكُمْ
 لَعَلَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَنْزِعُ فِي يَدِهِ فَيَقَعُ فِي حُفْرَةٍ مِنَ النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: Abu Huraira reported a hadith from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ; (one of them was this) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: None amongst you should point a weapon towards his brother, for he does not know that Satan might cause the weapon (to slip) from his hand and (he may injure anyone) and thus he may fall into Hell-Fire.
45.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ek hadees riwayat ki; (unmein se ek ye thi) ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Tum mein se koi bhi apne bhai ki taraf hathiyaar ka ishara na kare, kyunki use nahi pata ki Shaitaan uske haath se hathiyaar (fisla) sakta hai (aur woh kisi ko zakhmi kar sakta hai) aur is tarah woh Jahannam ki aag mein gir sakta hai.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ سُمَىٍّ، مَوْلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي،
 صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ بَيْنَمَا رَجُلٌ يَمْشِي بِطَرِيقٍ
 وَجَدَ غُصْنَ شَوْكٍ عَلَى الطَّرِيقِ فَأَخَّرَهُ فَشَكَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ فَغَفَرَ لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: While a person was going along the path he found a thorny branch upon it. He pushed it to a side and Allah approved (this action) of his and (as a mark of appreciation) granted him pardon.
45.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Ek shakhs raaste par chal raha tha ki usne uspar kaanTedaar shaakha paayi. Usne ise ek taraf hataya aur Allah ne uske is amal ki qadar ki aur (iski qadar-daani ke nishaan ke soorat mein) use maaf kar diya.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ
 قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ مَرَّ رَجُلٌ بِغُصْنِ شَجَرَةٍ عَلَى ظَهْرِ طَرِيقٍ فَقَالَ
 وَاللَّهِ لأُنَحِّيَنَّ هَذَا عَنِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ لاَ يُؤْذِيهِمْ ‏.‏ فَأُدْخِلَ الْجَنَّةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A person while walking along the path saw the branches of a tree lying there. He said: By Allah, I shall remove these from this so that these may not do harm to the Muslims, and he was admitted to Paradise.
45.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Ek shakhs raaste par chalte hue wahan padi darakht ki shaakhaon ko dekha. Usne kaha: Allah ki qasam, main inhe yahan se hataaunga taaki ye Musalmaanon ko koi nuksaan na pahunchaayein, aur use Jannat mein daakhil kiya gaya.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ 
 أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ رَجُلاً يَتَقَلَّبُ
 فِي الْجَنَّةِ فِي شَجَرَةٍ قَطَعَهَا مِنْ ظَهْرِ الطَّرِيقِ كَانَتْ تُؤْذِي النَّاسَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying that he saw a person enjoying himself in Paradise because of the tree that he cut from the path which was a source of inconvenience to the people.
45.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna ki unhone ek shakhs ko Jannat mein khush hote dekha us darakht ki wajah se jise usne raaste se kaata tha jo logon ke liye takleef ka srot tha.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ،
 عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ إِنَّ شَجَرَةً كَانَتْ تُؤْذِي الْمُسْلِمِينَ
 فَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ فَقَطَعَهَا فَدَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying that there was a tree which caused inconvenience to the Muslims; a person came there and cut that (tree) (and thus entered ) Paradise).
45.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna ki ek darakht tha jo Musalmaanon ko takleef pahunchaata tha; ek shakhs wahan aaya aur usne ise kaata (aur is tarah woh Jannat mein daakhil hua).

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبَانَ بْنِ صَمْعَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو
 الْوَازِعِ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَرْزَةَ، قَالَ قُلْتُ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ عَلِّمْنِي شَيْئًا أَنْتَفِعُ بِهِ قَالَ ‏
"‏ اعْزِلِ الأَذَى
 عَنْ طَرِيقِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: Abu Barza reported: I said: Allah's Messenger, teach me something so that I may derive benefit from it. He said: Remove the troublesome thing from the paths of the Muslims.
45.hi: Abu Barza (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mujhe kuch aisa sikhaiye jisse main faayda uThA sakoon. Unhone farmaaya: Musalmaanon ke raaston se takleef dene wali cheezein hataao.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ الْحَبْحَابِ، عَنْ أَبِي الْوَازِعِ،
 الرَّاسِبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي بَرْزَةَ الأَسْلَمِيِّ، أَنَّ أَبَا بَرْزَةَ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي لاَ أَدْرِي لَعَسَى أَنْ تَمْضِيَ وَأَبْقَى بَعْدَكَ فَزَوِّدْنِي شَيْئًا يَنْفَعُنِي اللَّهُ بِهِ
 ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ افْعَلْ كَذَا افْعَلْ كَذَا - أَبُو بَكْرٍ نَسِيَهُ - وَأَمِرَّ
 الأَذَى عَنِ الطَّرِيقِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: Abu Barza reported that he said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ): Allah's Messenger, I do not know whether I would survive after you, so confer upon me something by which Allah should benefit me. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Do this and that and remove the troublesome things from the paths.
45.hi: Abu Barza (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mujhe nahi pata ki main aapke baad zinda rahunga ya nahi, is liye mujhe kuch aisa ata kijiye jisse Allah mujhe faayda pahunchaaye. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Ye aur woh karo aur raaston se takleef dene wali cheezein hataao.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَسْمَاءَ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ الضُّبَعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا جُوَيْرِيَةُ، - يَعْنِي
 ابْنَ أَسْمَاءَ - عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ عُذِّبَتِ
 امْرَأَةٌ فِي هِرَّةٍ سَجَنَتْهَا حَتَّى مَاتَتْ فَدَخَلَتْ فِيهَا النَّارَ لاَ هِيَ أَطْعَمَتْهَا وَسَقَتْهَا إِذْ هِيَ
 حَبَسَتْهَا وَلاَ هِيَ تَرَكَتْهَا تَأْكُلُ مِنْ خَشَاشِ الأَرْضِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: Abdullah reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: A woman was tormented because of a cat which she had confined until it died and she had to get into Hell. She did not allow it either to eat or drink as it was confined, nor did she free it so that it might eat the vermin of the earth.
45.hi: Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Ek aurat ko ek billi ki wajah se saza di gayi jise usne band kar rakha tha yahan tak ki woh mar gayi aur usse Jahannam mein daakhil hona pada. Usne use na khaana khaane diya na paani, kyunki woh band thi, na hi use azaad kiya taaki woh zameen ke keede-makode khaa sake.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ خَالِدٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ 
 مَعْنِ بْنِ عِيسَى، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ جُوَيْرِيَةَ ‏.‏
45.en: The above hadith is narrated through another chain of transmitters with the same meaning
45.hi: Upar wali hadees isi matlab ke saath ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

45.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ 
 نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ عُذِّبَتِ امْرَأَةٌ فِي هِرَّةٍ
 أَوْثَقَتْهَا فَلَمْ تُطْعِمْهَا وَلَمْ تَسْقِهَا وَلَمْ تَدَعْهَا تَأْكُلُ مِنْ خَشَاشِ الأَرْضِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Ibn 'Umar through another chain of transmitters. And Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A woman was tormented because of a cat which she had tied and thus allowed it neither to eat or drink nor set it free so that it might eat the vermin of the earth.
45.hi: Ye hadees Ibn Umar (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai. Aur Ibn Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Ek aurat ko ek billi ki wajah se saza di gayi jise usne baandh rakha tha aur is tarah use na khaane diya na paani, na hi use azaad kiya taaki woh zameen ke keede-makode khaa sake.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ،
 عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
45.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters.
45.hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، قَالَ
 هَذَا مَا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ أَحَادِيثَ مِنْهَا وَقَالَ
 رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ دَخَلَتِ امْرَأَةٌ النَّارَ مِنْ جَرَّاءِ هِرَّةٍ لَهَا - أَوْ هِرٍّ - رَبَطَتْهَا
 فَلاَ هِيَ أَطْعَمَتْهَا وَلاَ هِيَ أَرْسَلَتْهَا تُرَمِّمُ مِنْ خَشَاشِ الأَرْضِ حَتَّى مَاتَتْ هَزْلاً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: Abu Huraira reported from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) A hadith out of which one was this that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: A woman got into Hell-Fire because of a cat whom she had tied, and thus it could not eat, and she did not let it free so that it could devour the vermin of the earth, until it died.
45.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ek hadees riwayat ki jismein se ek ye thi ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Ek aurat Jahannam ki aag mein daakhil hui ek billi ki wajah se jise usne baandh rakha tha, aur is tarah woh khaa nahi sakti thi, aur usne use azaad nahi kiya taaki woh zameen ke keede-makode khaa sake, yahan tak ki woh mar gayi.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ الأَزْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا 
 الأَعْمَشُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُسْلِمٍ الأَغَرِّ، أَنَّهُ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، وَأَبِي،
 هُرَيْرَةَ قَالاَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ الْعِزُّ إِزَارُهُ وَالْكِبْرِيَاءُ رِدَاؤُهُ فَمَنْ
 يُنَازِعُنِي عَذَّبْتُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: Abu Sa'id Khudri and Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, said: Glory is His lower garment and Majesty is His cloak and (Allah says, ) He who contends with Me in regard to them I shall torment him.
45.hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri aur Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne farmaaya: Azmat Meri chaadar hai aur Buzurgi Mera kambal hai aur (Allah farmaate hain,) jo in donon ke baare mein Mujhse jhagda karega, Main use saza dunga.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مُعْتَمِرِ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيُّ،
 عَنْ جُنْدَبٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَدَّثَ ‏
"‏ أَنَّ رَجُلاً قَالَ وَاللَّهِ لاَ يَغْفِرُ اللَّهُ
 لِفُلاَنٍ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى قَالَ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَتَأَلَّى عَلَىَّ أَنْ لاَ أَغْفِرَ لِفُلاَنٍ فَإِنِّي قَدْ غَفَرْتُ لِفُلاَنٍ
 وَأَحْبَطْتُ عَمَلَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ أَوْ كَمَا قَالَ ‏.‏
45.en: Jundub reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stated that a person said: Allah would not forgive such and such (person). Thereupon Allah the Exalted and Glorious, said: Who is he who adjures about Me that I would not grant pardon to so and so; I have granted pardon to so and so and blotted out his deeds (who took an oath that I would not grant pardon to him).
45.hi: Jundub (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya ki ek shakhs ne kaha: Allah falan-falan (shakhs) ko kabhi maaf nahi karega. Isper Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne farmaaya: Kaun hai jo Mere baare mein qasam khaata hai ki Main falan-falan ko maaf nahi karunga; Maine falan-falan ko maaf kar diya hai aur (us shakhs ke, jisne qasam khayi thi ki Main use maaf nahi karunga) uske amal mita diye.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي حَفْصُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ،
 عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ رُبَّ أَشْعَثَ مَدْفُوعٍ
 بِالأَبْوَابِ لَوْ أَقْسَمَ عَلَى اللَّهِ لأَبَرَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) as saying: Many a person with disheveled hair and covered with dust is turned away from the doors (whereas he is held in such a high esteem by Allah) that if he were to adjure in the name of Allah (about anything) Allah would fulfil that.
45.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Bahut se aise log jinke baal uljhe hain aur jo mitti se dhake hain unhe darwazon se bhaga diya jaata hai (jabki Allah ki nazar mein unka darja itna uchcha hai) ki agar woh Allah ke naam par qasam khaayein (kisi cheez ke baare mein), to Allah use poora karega.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي،
 صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ح 
 وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ 
 أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ إِذَا قَالَ الرَّجُلُ هَلَكَ النَّاسُ
 ‏.‏ فَهُوَ أَهْلَكُهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ لاَ أَدْرِي أَهْلَكَهُمْ بِالنَّصْبِ أَوْ أَهْلَكُهُمْ بِالرَّفْعِ ‏.‏
45.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When a person says that people are ruined he is himself ruined. Abu Ishaq said: I do not know whether he said" ahlakahum or ahlakuhum.
45.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jab koi shakhs kehta hai ki log barbaad ho gaye, to woh khud barbaad ho jaata hai. Abu Ishaq ne kaha: Mujhe nahi pata ki unhone "Ahlakahum" kaha ya "Ahlakuhum".

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، عَنْ رَوْحِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي 
 أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ حَكِيمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ بِلاَلٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ،
 بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
45.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Suhail with the same chain of transmitters.
45.hi: Ye hadees Suhail ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، عَنِ 
 اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ، وَيَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ 
 يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، - يَعْنِي
 الثَّقَفِيَّ - سَمِعْتُ يَحْيَى بْنَ سَعِيدٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو بَكْرٍ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ
 - أَنَّ عَمْرَةَ، حَدَّثَتْهُ أَنَّهَا، سَمِعَتْ عَائِشَةَ، تَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ
 ‏
"‏ مَا زَالَ جِبْرِيلُ يُوصِينِي بِالْجَارِ حَتَّى ظَنَنْتُ أَنَّهُ لَيُوَرِّثَنَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: 'A'isha reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Gabriel impressed upon me (kind treatment) towards the neighbour (so much) that I thought as if he would confer upon him the (right) of inheritance.
45.hi: Aisha (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jibril ne mujhpar padosi (ke saath achhe sulook) ki taakeed itni baar ki ki maine socha ki shaayad woh use virasat mein hissa bhi de denge.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، حَدَّثَنِي هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ،
 عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
45.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'A'isha through another chain of transmitters.
45.hi: Ye hadees Aisha (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْقَوَارِيرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ،
 عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ مَا زَالَ جِبْرِيلُ
 يُوصِينِي بِالْجَارِ حَتَّى ظَنَنْتُ أَنَّهُ سَيُوَرِّثُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: Ibn Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Gabriel impressed upon me (the kind treatment) towards the neighbour (so much) that I thought as if he would soon confer upon him the (right) of inheritance.
45.hi: Ibn Umar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jibril ne mujhpar padosi (ke saath achhe sulook) ki taakeed itni baar ki ki maine socha ki jald hi woh use virasat mein hissa de denge.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لإِسْحَاقَ - قَالَ أَبُو
 كَامِلٍ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ، إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ الْعَمِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عِمْرَانَ،
 الْجَوْنِيُّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 ‏
"‏ يَا أَبَا ذَرٍّ إِذَا طَبَخْتَ مَرَقَةً فَأَكْثِرْ مَاءَهَا وَتَعَاهَدْ جِيرَانَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: Abu Dharr reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Abu Dharr, when you prepare the broth, add water to that and give that (as a present) to your neighbour.
45.hi: Abu Dharr (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Abu Dharr, jab tum shorba banaao, ismein paani milaao aur ise (tohfe ke soorat mein) apne padosi ko do.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو
 كُرَيْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ،
 عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ، قَالَ إِنَّ خَلِيلِي صلى الله عليه وسلم أَوْصَانِي ‏
"‏ إِذَا طَبَخْتَ مَرَقًا فَأَكْثِرْ مَاءَهُ
 ثُمَّ انْظُرْ أَهْلَ بَيْتٍ مِنْ جِيرَانِكَ فَأَصِبْهُمْ مِنْهَا بِمَعْرُوفٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: Abu Dharr reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded me thus: Whenever you prepare a broth, add water to it, and have in your mind the members of the household of your neighbours and then give them out of this with courtesy.
45.hi: Abu Dharr (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhe ye hukum diya: Jab bhi tum shorba banaao, ismein paani milaao, aur apne padosiyon ke ghar-waalon ka khyaal rakho aur phir unhe adab ke saath ismein se do.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو غَسَّانَ الْمِسْمَعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ، - يَعْنِي
 الْخَزَّازَ - عَنْ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ، قَالَ قَالَ لِيَ
 النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ لاَ تَحْقِرَنَّ مِنَ الْمَعْرُوفِ شَيْئًا وَلَوْ أَنْ تَلْقَى أَخَاكَ بِوَجْهٍ طَلْقٍ
 ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: Abu Dharr reported: Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said to me: Don't consider anything insignificant out of good things even if it is that you meet your brother with a cheerful countenance.
45.hi: Abu Dharr (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse farmaaya: Achhaai ki kisi cheez ko chhota mat samjho, chahe ye sirf itna ho ki tum apne bhai se khush chehre ke saath milo.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، وَحَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ، عَنْ بُرَيْدِ،
 بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا
 أَتَاهُ طَالِبُ حَاجَةٍ أَقْبَلَ عَلَى جُلَسَائِهِ فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ اشْفَعُوا فَلْتُؤْجَرُوا وَلْيَقْضِ اللَّهُ عَلَى لِسَانِ
 نَبِيِّهِ مَا أَحَبَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: Abu Musa reported that when any needy (person) came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with a need he commanded him to his Companions, saying: Make a recommendation for him, and you would get the reward. Allah, however, gives the verdict through the tongue of His Apostle what He likes most.
45.hi: Abu Musa (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab bhi koi zaroorat-mand shakhs kisi zaroorat ke saath Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aata, woh apne Sahaba se farmaate: Uski sifaarish karo aur tumhe sawaab milega. Allah, halaanki, Apne Rasool ki zubaan se woh faisla deta hai jo Use sabse zyada pasand hai.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ بُرَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ 
 جَدِّهِ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ح 
 وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ بُرَيْدٍ،
 عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ إِنَّمَا مَثَلُ الْجَلِيسِ
 الصَّالِحِ وَالْجَلِيسِ السَّوْءِ كَحَامِلِ الْمِسْكِ وَنَافِخِ الْكِيرِ فَحَامِلُ الْمِسْكِ إِمَّا أَنْ يُحْذِيَكَ وَإِمَّا
 أَنْ تَبْتَاعَ مِنْهُ وَإِمَّا أَنْ تَجِدَ مِنْهُ رِيحًا طَيِّبَةً وَنَافِخُ الْكِيرِ إِمَّا أَنْ يُحْرِقَ ثِيَابَكَ وَإِمَّا أَنْ
 تَجِدَ رِيحًا خَبِيثَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: Abu Musa reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The similitude of good company and that of bad company is that of the owner of musk and of the one (iron-smith) blowing bellows, and the owner of musk would either offer you free of charge or you would buy it from him or you would. smell its pleasant odour, and so far as one who blows the. bellows is concerned, he would either burn your clothes or you shall have to smell its repugnant smell.
45.hi: Abu Musa (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Achhi sohbat aur buri sohbat ki misaal mushk waale (attar) aur bhaTThi phookne waale (lohaar) ki misaal jaisi hai, aur mushk waala tumhe (ya to) muft mein dega ya tum use usse khareedoge ya tum iski khushboo mehsoos karoge, aur jahan tak bhaTThi phookne waale ka sawaal hai, woh ya to tumhaare kapde jala dega ya tumhe iski badbudaar khushboo mehsoos karni padegi.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ قُهْزَاذَ، حَدَّثَنَا سَلَمَةُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ،
 أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ حَزْمٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ،
 ح 
 وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ بَهْرَامَ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُمَا
 - قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، أَنَّأَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ جَاءَتْنِي امْرَأَةٌ
 وَمَعَهَا ابْنَتَانِ لَهَا فَسَأَلَتْنِي فَلَمْ تَجِدْ عِنْدِي شَيْئًا غَيْرَ تَمْرَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ فَأَعْطَيْتُهَا إِيَّاهَا فَأَخَذَتْهَا
 فَقَسَمَتْهَا بَيْنَ ابْنَتَيْهَا وَلَمْ تَأْكُلْ مِنْهَا شَيْئًا ثُمَّ قَامَتْ فَخَرَجَتْ وَابْنَتَاهَا فَدَخَلَ عَلَىَّ النَّبِيُّ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم فَحَدَّثْتُهُ حَدِيثَهَا فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ مَنِ ابْتُلِيَ مِنَ
 الْبَنَاتِ بِشَىْءٍ فَأَحْسَنَ إِلَيْهِنَّ كُنَّ لَهُ سِتْرًا مِنَ النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: 'A'isha, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), said: A woman came to me along with her two daughters. She asked me for (charity) but she found nothing with me except one date, so I gave her that. She accepted it and then divided it between her two daughters and herself ate nothing out of that. She then got up and went out, and so did her two daughters. (In the meanwhile) Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) visited me and I narrated to him her story. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: He who is involved (in the responsibility) of (bringing up) daughters, and he accords benevolent treatment towards them, there would be protection for him against Hell-Fire.
45.hi: Aisha (RA), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ne kaha: Ek aurat apni do betiyon ke saath mere paas aayi. Usne mujhse (sadaqe ki) maang ki lekin usne mere paas kuch nahi paaya siwaay ek khajoor ke, is liye maine use woh de di. Usne ise qubool kiya aur phir ise apni donon betiyon mein baant diya aur khud isme se kuch nahi khaya. Woh phir uThi aur bahar chali gayi, aur uski donon betiyaan bhi. (Isi beech), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mujhse milne aaye aur maine unhe uska kissa sunaaya. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jo (betiyon ki parvaarish ki) zimmedaari nibhaata hai, aur unke saath meherbaani ka vyavahaar karta hai, uske liye Jahannam ki aag se hifaazat hogi.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَكْرٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُضَرَ - عَنِ ابْنِ الْهَادِ، أَنَّ زِيَادَ،
 بْنَ أَبِي زِيَادٍ مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَيَّاشٍ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ عِرَاكِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، سَمِعْتُهُ يُحَدِّثُ، عُمَرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ
 عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ جَاءَتْنِي مِسْكِينَةٌ تَحْمِلُ ابْنَتَيْنِ لَهَا فَأَطْعَمْتُهَا ثَلاَثَ تَمَرَاتٍ فَأَعْطَتْ
 كُلَّ وَاحِدَةٍ مِنْهُمَا تَمْرَةً وَرَفَعَتْ إِلَى فِيهَا تَمْرَةً لِتَأْكُلَهَا فَاسْتَطْعَمَتْهَا ابْنَتَاهَا فَشَقَّتِ التَّمْرَةَ
 الَّتِي كَانَتْ تُرِيدُ أَنْ تَأْكُلَهَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَأَعْجَبَنِي شَأْنُهَا فَذَكَرْتُ الَّذِي صَنَعَتْ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ أَوْجَبَ لَهَا بِهَا الْجَنَّةَ أَوْ أَعْتَقَهَا بِهَا مِنَ النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: 'A'isha reported: A poor woman came to me along with her daughters. I gave her three dates. She gave a date to each of them and then she took up one date and brought that to her mouth in order to eat that, but her daughters expressed desire to eat it. She then divided the date that she intended to eat between them. This (kind) treatment of her impressed me and I mentioned that which she did to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Thereupon he said: Verily Allah has assured Paradise for her, because of (this act) of her, or He has rescued her from Hell-Fire.
45.hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Ek gareeb aurat apni betiyon ke saath mere paas aayi. Maine use teen khajooren din. Usne har ek ko ek khajoor di aur phir ek khajoor uThAyi aur ise apne munh mein le jaane hi wali thi ki uski betiyon ne use khaane ki khwaish jataayi. Usne phir woh khajoor jise woh khud khaana chaahti thi unmein baant di. Uska ye (meherbaan) vyavahaar mujhpar gehra asar chhod gaya aur maine jo usne kiya woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se zikr kiya. Isper unhone farmaaya: Yaqeenan, Allah ne is (amal) ki wajah se uske liye Jannat ka vaada kiya hai, ya Usne use Jahannam ki aag se bacha liya hai.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أَحْمَدَ الزُّبَيْرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، عَنْ 
 عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم ‏
"‏ مَنْ عَالَ جَارِيَتَيْنِ حَتَّى تَبْلُغَا جَاءَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَنَا وَهُوَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَضَمَّ أَصَابِعَهُ ‏.‏
45.en: Malik reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He, who brought up two girls properly till they grew up, he and I would come (together) (very closely) on the Day of Resurrection, and he interlaced his fingers (for explaining the point of nearness between him and that person).
45.hi: Malik (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jo do larkiyon ko unke bade hone tak achhi tarah paalega, woh aur main Qayamat ke din ek saath (bahut qareeb) aayenge, aur unhone (nazdeeki ka spashteekaran karte hue) apni ungliyaan aapas mein jodi.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ،
 عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ لاَ يَمُوتُ لأَحَدٍ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ ثَلاَثَةٌ
 مِنَ الْوَلَدِ فَتَمَسَّهُ النَّارُ إِلاَّ تَحِلَّةَ الْقَسَمِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Anyone amongst the Muslims, three of whose children die, and he resigns himself calmly to the will of God, Fire will not touch him but for the fulfilment of the oath.
45.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Musalmaanon mein se koi bhi shakhs, jiske teen bachche mar jaayein, aur woh sabar ke saath Allah ki marzi ko qubool kare, Jahannam ki aag use nahi chhuegi siwaay iske ki qasam poori honi hai.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ،
 بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، وَابْنُ، رَافِعٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ 
 الزُّهْرِيِّ، ‏.‏ بِإِسْنَادِ مَالِكٍ وَبِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِهِ إِلاَّ أَنَّ فِي حَدِيثِ سُفْيَانَ ‏
"‏ فَيَلِجَ النَّارَ إِلاَّ تَحِلَّةَ
 الْقَسَمِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: This hadith has been reported by Zuhri on the authority of Malik, and in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Sufyan (the words are): " He would enter into Fire, except for the fulfilment of the oath."
45.hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ne Malik ki sanad se riwayat ki hai, aur Sufyan ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: "Woh Jahannam ki aag mein daakhil hoga, siwaay iske ki qasam poori honi hai."

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ - عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ 
 أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لِنِسْوَةٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ ‏"‏ لاَ
 يَمُوتُ لإِحْدَاكُنَّ ثَلاَثَةٌ مِنَ الْوَلَدِ فَتَحْتَسِبَهُ إِلاَّ دَخَلَتِ الْجَنَّةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتِ امْرَأَةٌ مِنْهُنَّ أَوِ اثْنَيْنِ
 يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَوِ اثْنَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to a woman of the Ansar: In case anyone amongst you sees the sad demise of three children of (hers) and she resigns herself to the will of God hoping to get reward, she would be admitted to Paradise. A woman from amongst them said: Allah's Messenger, even if they (the children who die) are two. Thereupon, he (the Holy Prophet, ) said: Even if they are two.
45.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Ansar ki ek aurat se farmaaya: Agar tum mein se koi apne teen bachchon ki dukhad maut dekhti hai aur woh sawaab ki ummeed rakhte hue Allah ki marzi ko qubool karti hai, use Jannat mein daakhil kiya jaayega. Unmein se ek aurat ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, agar woh (mare hue bachche) do hon? Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) farmaaya: Chahe woh do hon.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ، فُضَيْلُ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ،
 بْنِ الأَصْبَهَانِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، ذَكْوَانَ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ جَاءَتِ امْرَأَةٌ إِلَى رَسُولِ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ذَهَبَ الرِّجَالُ بِحَدِيثِكَ فَاجْعَلْ لَنَا مِنْ نَفْسِكَ
 يَوْمًا نَأْتِيكَ فِيهِ تُعَلِّمُنَا مِمَّا عَلَّمَكَ اللَّهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ اجْتَمِعْنَ يَوْمَ كَذَا وَكَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَاجْتَمَعْنَ فَأَتَاهُنَّ
 رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَعَلَّمَهُنَّ مِمَّا عَلَّمَهُ اللَّهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا مِنْكُنَّ مِنِ امْرَأَةٍ تُقَدِّمُ
 بَيْنَ يَدَيْهَا مِنْ وَلَدِهَا ثَلاَثَةً إِلاَّ كَانُوا لَهَا حِجَابًا مِنَ النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتِ امْرَأَةٌ وَاثْنَيْنِ وَاثْنَيْنِ
 وَاثْنَيْنِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَاثْنَيْنِ وَاثْنَيْنِ وَاثْنَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: Abu Sa'id Khudri reported that a woman came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger, men receive your instructions; kindly allocate at your convenience a day for us also, on which we would come to you and you would teach us what Allah has taught you. He said: You assemble on such and such a day. They assembled and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to them and taught them what Allah had taught him and he then said: No woman amongst you who sends her three children as her forerunners (in the Hereafter) but they would serve him as a protection against Hell-Fire. A woman said: What about two and two and two? Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Even if they are two and two and two.
45.hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek aurat Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mard aapki taalimaat paate hain; meherbaani karke apni suvidha ke mutabik humaare liye bhi ek din muqarrar kijiye, jismein hum aapke paas aayenge aur aap humein woh sikhaayenge jo Allah ne aapko sikhaaya hai. Unhone farmaaya: Tum aisi-aisi din ikattha ho jaao. Woh ikattha huin aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unke paas aaye aur unhe woh sikhaaya jo Allah ne unhe sikhaaya tha aur phir unhone farmaaya: Tum mein se koi bhi aurat jo apne teen bachchon ko (Aakhirat mein) apne agrasar ke soorat mein bhejti hai, unse Jahannam ki aag ke khilaaf ek hifaazat kavach ki tarah kaam lega. Ek aurat ne kaha: Do bachchon ka kya? Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Chahe woh do hon.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ،
 اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الأَصْبَهَانِيِّ، فِي هَذَا الإِسْنَادِ
 ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ مَعْنَاهُ وَزَادَا جَمِيعًا عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الأَصْبَهَانِيِّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا
 حَازِمٍ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ ‏
"‏ ثَلاَثَةً لَمْ يَبْلُغُوا الْحِنْثَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: Abu Huraira reported that he (the Holy Prophet) said: Three (children) who die in childhood.
45.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) farmaaya: Teen (bachche) jo bachpan mein mar jaate hain.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، - وَتَقَارَبَا فِي اللَّفْظِ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا 
 الْمُعْتَمِرُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي السَّلِيلِ، عَنْ أَبِي حَسَّانَ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لأَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ إِنَّهُ قَدْ مَاتَ لِيَ
 ابْنَانِ فَمَا أَنْتَ مُحَدِّثِي عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِحَدِيثٍ تُطَيِّبُ بِهِ أَنْفُسَنَا عَنْ
 مَوْتَانَا قَالَ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏
"‏ صِغَارُهُمْ دَعَامِيصُ الْجَنَّةِ يَتَلَقَّى أَحَدُهُمْ أَبَاهُ - أَوْ قَالَ أَبَوَيْهِ
 - فَيَأْخُذُ بِثَوْبِهِ - أَوْ قَالَ بِيَدِهِ - كَمَا آخُذُ أَنَا بِصَنِفَةِ ثَوْبِكَ هَذَا فَلاَ يَتَنَاهَى - أَوْ قَالَ
 فَلاَ يَنْتَهِي - حَتَّى يُدْخِلَهُ اللَّهُ وَأَبَاهُ الْجَنَّةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ سُوَيْدٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو السَّلِيلِ
 وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَعِيدٍ - عَنِ التَّيْمِيِّ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ
 وَقَالَ فَهَلْ سَمِعْتَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَيْئًا تُطَيِّبُ بِهِ أَنْفُسَنَا عَنْ مَوْتَانَا
 قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏
45.en: Abu Hassan reported: I said to Abu Huraira that my two children had died. Would you narrate to me anything from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) a hadith which would soothe our hearts in our bereavements? He said: Yes. Small children are the fowls of Paradise. If one of them meets his father (or he said his parents) he would take hold of his cloth, or he said with his hand as I take hold of the hem of your cloth (with my hand). And he (the child) would not take off (his hand) from it until Allah causes his father to enter Paradise. This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Tamim with the same chain of transmitters. And he is reported to have said: Did you hear from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) anything which may soothe our heart in our bereavements? He said: Yes.
45.hi: Abu Hassan ne bayan kiya: Maine Abu Huraira (RA) se kaha ki mere do bachchon ka intiqaal ho gaya hai. Kya aap mujhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se koi aisi hadees riwayat karenge jo humaare gam mein humaare dilon ko sukoon de? Unhone kaha: Haan. Chhote bachche Jannat ke parinde hain. Agar unmein se koi apne waalid se milta hai (ya unhone kaha unke maa-baap se), woh unka kapda pakDta hai, ya unhone kaha apne haath se, jaise main tumhaare kapde ka kinaara apne haath se pakDta hoon. Aur woh (bachcha) ise tab tak nahi chhodega jab tak Allah uske waalid ko Jannat mein daakhil na kare. Ye hadees Tamim ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai. Aur unhone kaha ki unhone poocha: Kya aapne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kuch suna jo humaare gam mein humaare dilon ko sukoon de? Unhone kaha: Haan.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، وَأَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ
 - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي بَكْرٍ - قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصٌ، - يَعْنُونَ ابْنَ غِيَاثٍ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصِ،
 بْنِ غِيَاثٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، طَلْقِ بْنِ مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ جَرِيرٍ، عَنْ 
 أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ أَتَتِ امْرَأَةٌ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِصَبِيٍّ لَهَا فَقَالَتْ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ ادْعُ
 اللَّهَ لَهُ فَلَقَدْ دَفَنْتُ ثَلاَثَةً قَالَ ‏"‏ دَفَنْتِ ثَلاَثَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ لَقَدِ احْتَظَرْتِ بِحِظَارٍ
 شَدِيدٍ مِنَ النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ عُمَرُ مِنْ بَيْنِهِمْ عَنْ جَدِّهِ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ الْبَاقُونَ عَنْ طَلْقٍ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرُوا
 الْجَدَّ ‏.‏
45.en: Abu Huraira reported that a woman came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) with her child and said: Allah's Apostle, invoke Allah's blessing upon him for I have already buried three. He said: You have buried three! She said: Yes. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: You have, indeed, safeguarded yourself against the torment of Hell with a strong safeguard. 'Umar has made a mention of his father, whereas others have not made a mention of his father.
45.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek aurat apne bachche ke saath Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, iske liye Allah se barkat maangiye kyunki maine pehle hi teen (bachchon) ko dafn kiya hai. Unhone farmaaya: Tumne teen ko dafn kiya! Unhone kaha: Haan. Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) farmaaya: Tumne waastav mein khud ko Jahannam ke azaab se ek mazboot hifaazat kavach ke saath bacha liya hai. Umar ne apne waalid ka zikr kiya, jabki doosron ne unke waalid ka zikr nahi kiya.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ طَلْقِ بْنِ مُعَاوِيَةَ،
 النَّخَعِيِّ أَبِي غِيَاثٍ عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ جَرِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ جَاءَتِ امْرَأَةٌ
 إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِابْنٍ لَهَا فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّهُ يَشْتَكِي وَإِنِّي أَخَافُ
 عَلَيْهِ قَدْ دَفَنْتُ ثَلاَثَةً ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏
"‏ لَقَدِ احْتَظَرْتِ بِحِظَارٍ شَدِيدٍ مِنَ النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ عَنْ
 طَلْقٍ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ الْكُنْيَةَ ‏.‏
45.en: Abu Huraira reported that a woman came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) with her child and said: Allah's Messenger, he is ailing, and I am afraid (that he may die), as I have already buried three. Thereupon he said: It (their sad demise) would be a protection against Hell-Fire for you. Zuhair has not mentioned the kunya of Abu Ghiyath; he has mentioned his name.
45.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek aurat apne bachche ke saath Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye bimaar hai, aur mujhe dar hai (ki ye mar sakta hai), kyunki maine pehle hi teen (bachchon) ko dafn kiya hai. Isper unhone farmaaya: Ye (unki dukhad maut) tumhaare liye Jahannam ki aag ke khilaaf hifaazat hogi. Zuhair ne Abu Ghiyath ki Kunya ka koi zikr nahi kiya; unhone unka naam zikr kiya hai.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ
 قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ إِذَا أَحَبَّ عَبْدًا دَعَا جِبْرِيلَ فَقَالَ إِنِّي أُحِبُّ
 فُلاَنًا فَأَحِبَّهُ - قَالَ - فَيُحِبُّهُ جِبْرِيلُ ثُمَّ يُنَادِي فِي السَّمَاءِ فَيَقُولُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ فُلاَنًا
 فَأَحِبُّوهُ ‏.‏ فَيُحِبُّهُ أَهْلُ السَّمَاءِ - قَالَ - ثُمَّ يُوضَعُ لَهُ الْقَبُولُ فِي الأَرْضِ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا أَبْغَضَ
 عَبْدًا دَعَا جِبْرِيلَ فَيَقُولُ إِنِّي أُبْغِضُ فُلاَنًا فَأَبْغِضْهُ - قَالَ - فَيُبْغِضُهُ جِبْرِيلُ ثُمَّ يُنَادِي
 فِي أَهْلِ السَّمَاءِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُبْغِضُ فُلاَنًا فَأَبْغِضُوهُ - قَالَ - فَيُبْغِضُونَهُ ثُمَّ تُوضَعُ لَهُ الْبَغْضَاءُ
 فِي الأَرْضِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: When Allah loves a servant, He calls Gabriel and says: Verily, I so and so; you should also love him, and then Gabriel begins to love him. Then he makes an announcement in the heaven saying: Allah loves so and so and you also love him, and then the inhabitants of the Heaven (the Angels) also begin to love him and then there is conferred honour upon him in the earth; and when Allah is angry with any servant He calls Gabriel and says: I am angry with such and such and you also become angry with him, and then Gabriel also becomes angry and then makes an announcement amongst the inhabitants of heaven: Verily Allah is angry with so-and so, so you also become angry with him, and thus they also become angry with him. Then he becomes the object of wrath on the earth also.
45.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jab Allah kisi banda se muhabbat karta hai, Woh Jibril ko bulaata hai aur farmaata hai: Yaqeenan, Mujhe falan-falan se muhabbat hai; tum bhi usse muhabbat karo, aur phir Jibril bhi usse muhabbat karne lagte hain. Phir woh aasmaan mein ailaan karte hain ye kehte hue: Allah ko falan-falan se muhabbat hai aur tum bhi usse muhabbat karo, aur phir aasmaan ke bashinda (Farishte) bhi usse muhabbat karne lagte hain aur phir uski izzat zameen mein bhi ki jaati hai; aur jab Allah kisi banda se naaraaz hota hai Woh Jibril ko bulaata hai aur farmaata hai: Main falan-falan se naaraaz hoon aur tum bhi usse naaraaz ho, aur phir Jibril bhi naaraaz hote hain aur phir aasmaan ke bashindon mein ailaan karte hain: Yaqeenan, Allah falan-falan se naaraaz hai, is liye tum bhi usse naaraaz ho, aur is tarah woh bhi usse naaraaz ho jaate hain. Phir woh zameen mein bhi gusse ka nishaana banta hai.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْقَارِيَّ - وَقَالَ
 قُتَيْبَةُ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ يَعْنِي الدَّرَاوَرْدِيَّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو الأَشْعَثِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا 
 عَبْثَرٌ، عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي 
 مَالِكٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ أَنَسٍ - كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ غَيْرَ أَنَّ حَدِيثَ، الْعَلاَءِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ
 لَيْسَ فِيهِ ذِكْرُ الْبُغْضِ ‏.‏
45.en: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Suhail with the same chain of transmitters except with this variation that in the hadith transmitted on the authority of 'Ali' b. Musayyib, there is no mention of (the word)" Anger".
45.hi: Ye hadees Suhail ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai siwaay is antar ke ki Ali bin Musayyib ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein "Gussa" lafz ka koi zikr nahi hai.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ،
 بْنِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ الْمَاجِشُونُ عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا بِعَرَفَةَ فَمَرَّ عُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ
 وَهُوَ عَلَى الْمَوْسِمِ فَقَامَ النَّاسُ يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَيْهِ فَقُلْتُ لأَبِي يَا أَبَتِ إِنِّي أَرَى اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ عُمَرَ
 بْنَ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَمَا ذَاكَ قُلْتُ لِمَا لَهُ مِنَ الْحُبِّ فِي قُلُوبِ النَّاسِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ بِأَبِيكَ أَنْتَ
 سَمِعْتَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ جَرِيرٍ
 عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ ‏.‏
45.en: Suhail b. Abi Salih, reported: We were in Arafa that there happened to pass Umar b. Abd al-'Aziz and he was the Amir of Hajj. People stood up in order to catch a glimpse of him. I said to my father: Father, I think that Allah loves Umar b. Abd al- 'Aziz. He said: How is it? I said: It is because of the love in people's heart for him. Thereupon he said: By One Who created your father, I heard Abu Huraira narrating from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) a hadith like one transmitted on the authority of Suhail.
45.hi: Suhail bin Abi Salih ne bayan kiya: Hum Arafa mein the ki Umar bin Abd al-Aziz wahan se guzre aur woh us waqt Hajj ke Amir the. Log unhe dekhne ke liye khade huye. Maine apne waalid se kaha: Waalid, mujhe lagta hai Allah Umar bin Abd al-Aziz se muhabbat karta hai. Unhone kaha: Ye kaise? Maine kaha: Ye logon ke dilon mein unke prati (jo) muhabbat hai uski wajah se hai. Isper unhone kaha: Us Hasti ki qasam Jisne tumhaare waalid ko banaaya, maine Abu Huraira (RA) ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ek hadees riwayat karte suna jo Suhail ki riwayat ki hui hadees jaisi hai.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ - عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ 
 أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ الأَرْوَاحُ جُنُودٌ مُجَنَّدَةٌ
 فَمَا تَعَارَفَ مِنْهَا ائْتَلَفَ وَمَا تَنَاكَرَ مِنْهَا اخْتَلَفَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) Saying: Souls are troops collected together and those who familiarised with each other (in the heaven from where these come) would have affinity, with one another (in the world) and those amongst them who opposed each other (in the Heaven) would also be divergent (in the world).
45.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Roohein ikatthi ki gayi fauj jaisi hain aur jo ek-doosre se (Aasmaan mein, jahan se ye aati hain) jaan-pehchaan rakhti hain, unmein (is duniya mein) aapsi lagaav hoga, aur unmein se jinhone ek-doosre ka virodh kiya (Aasmaan mein) woh bhi (is duniya mein) alag-thalag rahenge.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا كَثِيرُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ بُرْقَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا 
 يَزِيدُ بْنُ الأَصَمِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، بِحَدِيثٍ يَرْفَعُهُ قَالَ ‏
"‏ النَّاسُ مَعَادِنُ كَمَعَادِنِ الْفِضَّةِ وَالذَّهَبِ
 خِيَارُهُمْ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ خِيَارُهُمْ فِي الإِسْلاَمِ إِذَا فَقُهُوا وَالأَرْوَاحُ جُنُودٌ مُجَنَّدَةٌ فَمَا تَعَارَفَ
 مِنْهَا ائْتَلَفَ وَمَا تَنَاكَرَ مِنْهَا اخْتَلَفَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: Abu Huraira narrated directly from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that he said: People are like mines of gold and silver; those who were excellent in Jahiliya (during the days of ignorance) are excellent In Islam, when they have, an understanding, and the souls are troops collected together and those who had a mutual familiarity amongst themselves in the store of prenatal existence would have affinity amongst them, (in this world also) and those who opposed one of them, would be at variance with one another.
45.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne seedhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki ki unhone farmaaya: Log sone aur chandi ki khaanon jaise hain; jo Jaahiliyat ke daur mein behtareen the woh Islam mein bhi behtareen hain, jab unhe (deen ki) samajh ho, aur roohein ikatthi ki gayi fauj jaisi hain aur jinke beech Aasmaan mein, janam se pehle ki haalat mein, aapsi jaan-pehchaan thi, unmein aapsi lagaav hoga, (is duniya mein bhi), aur jinhone unmein se kisi ek ka virodh kiya, woh ek-doosre se alag-thalag rahenge.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ،
 أَبِي طَلْحَةَ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ أَعْرَابِيًّا، قَالَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَتَى السَّاعَةُ
 قَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا أَعْدَدْتَ لَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ حُبَّ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ ‏.‏
 قَالَ ‏"‏ أَنْتَ مَعَ مَنْ أَحْبَبْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: Anas b. Malik reported that a desert Arab said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ): When would be the Last Hour? Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: What preparation have you made for that? Thereupon he said: The love of Allah and of His Messenger (that is my preparation for the Last Hour) (for the Day of Resurrection). Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: You would be along with one whom you love.
45.hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek registaan ke Arab ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kaha: Qayamat kab hogi? Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Tumne iske liye kya taiyaari ki hai? Isper usne kaha: Allah aur Uske Rasool se muhabbat (yehi meri Qayamat ke din ki taiyaari hai). Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) farmaaya: Tum unhi ke saath hoge jinse tum muhabbat karte ho.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ،
 اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ - وَاللَّفْظُ لِزُهَيْرٍ - قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ،
 قَالَ قَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَتَى السَّاعَةُ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَمَا أَعْدَدْتَ لَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ كَبِيرًا
 ‏.‏ قَالَ وَلَكِنِّي أُحِبُّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَأَنْتَ مَعَ مَنْ أَحْبَبْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ 
 حَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ عَبْدٌ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ ابْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا 
 عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، مِنَ الأَعْرَابِ أَتَى
 رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ مَا أَعْدَدْتُ لَهَا مِنْ كَثِيرٍ أَحْمَدُ عَلَيْهِ
 نَفْسِي ‏.‏
45.en: Anas reported that a person said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ): When would be the Last Hour? He (the Holy Prophet) said: What preparation have you made for that? And he gave no details, but said: I love Allah and His Messenger. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: You would be along with one whom you love. Anas b. Malik reported through another chain of transmitters that a desert Arab came to Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon, him), the rest of the hadith is the same but with this variation that he said: I have not made much preparations which merit appreciation for myself.
45.hi: Anas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kaha: Qayamat kab hogi? Unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) farmaaya: Tumne iske liye kya taiyaari ki hai? Aur usne koi tafseel nahi di, balki kaha: Mujhe Allah aur Uske Rasool se muhabbat hai. Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) farmaaya: Tum unhi ke saath hoge jinse tum muhabbat karte ho. Anas bin Malik ne ek doosri sanad ke zariye ye riwayat ki ki ek registaan ka Arab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai lekin is antar ke saath ki usne kaha: Maine apne liye koi khaas taiyaari nahi ki jiski sarahna ki jaaye.

45.ar:
