حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الْعَتَكِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زَيْدٍ - حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتٌ الْبُنَانِيُّ،
 عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ
 اللَّهِ مَتَى السَّاعَةُ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَمَا أَعْدَدْتَ لِلسَّاعَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ حُبَّ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَإِنَّكَ
 مَعَ مَنْ أَحْبَبْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَنَسٌ فَمَا فَرِحْنَا بَعْدَ الإِسْلاَمِ فَرَحًا أَشَدَّ مِنْ قَوْلِ النَّبِيِّ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فَإِنَّكَ مَعَ مَنْ أَحْبَبْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَنَسٌ فَأَنَا أُحِبُّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَأَبَا بَكْرٍ
 وَعُمَرَ فَأَرْجُو أَنْ أَكُونَ مَعَهُمْ وَإِنْ لَمْ أَعْمَلْ بِأَعْمَالِهِمْ ‏.‏
45.en: Anas b. Malik reported that a person came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said to Allah's Messenger: When would be the Last Hour? Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: What preparation have you made for the Last Hour? He said: The love of Allah and of His Messenger (is my only preparation). Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: You would be along with one whom you love. Anas said: Nothing pleased us more after accepting Islam than the words of Allah's Apostle: You would be along with one whom you love. And Anas said. I love Allah and His Messenger and Abu Bakr and Umar, and I hope that I would be along with them although I have not acted like them.
45.hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unse kaha: Qayamat kab hogi? Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) farmaaya: Tumne Qayamat ke liye kya taiyaari ki hai? Usne kaha: Allah aur Uske Rasool se muhabbat (meri iklauti taiyaari hai). Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) farmaaya: Tum unhi ke saath hoge jinse tum muhabbat karte ho. Anas ne kaha: Islam qubool karne ke baad Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke in alfaazon se zyada humein kuch pasand nahi aaya: Tum unhi ke saath hoge jinse tum muhabbat karte ho. Aur Anas ne kaha: Mujhe Allah aur Uske Rasool se, aur Abu Bakr aur Umar se muhabbat hai, aur mujhe ummeed hai ki main unke saath rahunga chahe maine unke jaisa amal na kiya ho.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ الْغُبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتٌ الْبُنَانِيُّ،
 عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ قَوْلَ أَنَسٍ فَأَنَا أُحِبُّ ‏.‏ وَمَا
 بَعْدَهُ ‏.‏
45.en: Anas b. Malik reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) this hadith through another chain of transmitters but he did not make mention of the words of Anas: I love, and what follows subsequently.
45.hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye hadees ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki lekin unhone Anas ke ye alfaaz zikr nahi kiye: "Mujhe muhabbat hai," aur uske baad ki baaton ka bhi koi zikr nahi kiya.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ،
 عُثْمَانُ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ بَيْنَمَا
 أَنَا وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ، صلى الله عليه وسلم خَارِجَيْنِ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ فَلَقِينَا رَجُلاً عِنْدَ سُدَّةِ الْمَسْجِدِ
 فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَتَى السَّاعَةُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا أَعْدَدْتَ لَهَا
 ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَكَأَنَّ الرَّجُلَ اسْتَكَانَ ثُمَّ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا أَعْدَدْتُ لَهَا كَبِيرَ صَلاَةٍ وَلاَ صِيَامٍ
 وَلاَ صَدَقَةٍ وَلَكِنِّي أُحِبُّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَأَنْتَ مَعَ مَنْ أَحْبَبْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: Anas b. Malik reported: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and I were coming out of the mosque that we met a person on the threshold of the mosque and he said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ): When would be the Last Hour? Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: What preparation have you made for that? The man became silent and then said: Allah's Messenger, I have made no significant preparation with prayer and fasting and charity but I, however, love Allah and His Messenger. Thereupon (the Holy Prophet) said: You would be along with one whom you love.
45.hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aur main masjid se bahar aa rahe the ki humaari mulaqaat masjid ki dahleez par ek shakhs se hui aur usne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kaha: Qayamat kab hogi? Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Tumne iske liye kya taiyaari ki hai? Woh shakhs khamosh ho gaya aur phir kaha: Allah ke Rasool, maine namaz, roze aur sadaqe ke saath koi khaas taiyaari nahi ki hai, lekin mujhe Allah aur Uske Rasool se muhabbat hai. Isper unhone (Nabi-e-Paak ne) farmaaya: Tum unhi ke saath hoge jinse tum muhabbat karte ho.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ الْيَشْكُرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ،
 جَبَلَةَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ 
 النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِنَحْوِهِ ‏.‏
45.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Anas through another chain of transmitters.
45.hi: Ye hadees Anas (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، ح 
 وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ 
 قَتَادَةَ، سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا، ح 
 وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو غَسَّانَ الْمِسْمَعِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ
 هِشَامٍ - حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ
 ‏.‏
45.en: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Anas with different chains of transmitters.
45.hi: Ye hadees Anas (RA) ki sanad se mukhtalif sanadon ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ،
 عُثْمَانُ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى رَسُولِ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَيْفَ تَرَى فِي رَجُلٍ أَحَبَّ قَوْمًا وَلَمَّا يَلْحَقْ
 بِهِمْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ الْمَرْءُ مَعَ مَنْ أَحَبَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
45.en: 'Abdullah reported that a person came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ): What is your opinion about the person who loves the people but his (acts or deeds are not identical to theirs)? Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: A person would be along with one whom he loves.
45.hi: Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se kaha: Iske baare mein aapki kya raay hai jo logon se muhabbat karta hai lekin uske (amal ya kaam unke jaise) nahi hain? Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Shakhs unhi ke saath hoga jinse woh muhabbat karta hai.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ بِشْرُ،
 بْنُ خَالِدٍ أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا 
 أَبُو الْجَوَّابِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ قَرْمٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ 
 النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
45.en: A hadith like this has been transmitted on the authority of 'Abdullah.
45.hi: Isi jaisi ek hadees Abdullah (RA) ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ،
 نُمَيْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَ
 أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجُلٌ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ جَرِيرٍ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ ‏.‏
45.en: Abu Musa, reported that a person came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ; the rest of the hadith is the same.
45.hi: Abu Musa (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya; baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، وَأَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ فُضَيْلُ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ
 لِيَحْيَى - قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيِّ،
 عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ، قَالَ قِيلَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَرَأَيْتَ
 الرَّجُلَ يَعْمَلُ الْعَمَلَ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ وَيَحْمَدُهُ النَّاسُ عَلَيْهِ قَالَ ‏
"‏ تِلْكَ عَاجِلُ بُشْرَى الْمُؤْمِنِ ‏"‏
 ‏.‏
45.en: Abu Dharr reported: It was said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ): What is your opinion about the person who has done good deeds and the people praise him? He said: It is glad tidings for a believer (which he has received in this mortal world).
45.hi: Abu Dharr (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se poocha gaya: Iske baare mein aapki kya raay hai jisne nekokaar amal kiye hain aur log uski tareef karte hain? Unhone farmaaya: Ye ek momin ke liye khushkhabri hai (jo usne is faani duniya mein paayi hai).

45.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ وَكِيعٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ،
 بْنُ بَشَّارٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا 
 إِسْحَاقُ، أَخْبَرَنَا النَّضْرُ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيِّ، بِإِسْنَادِ حَمَّادِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ ‏.‏
 بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي، حَدِيثِهِمْ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ غَيْرَ عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ وَيُحِبُّهُ النَّاسُ عَلَيْهِ ‏.‏ وَفِي
 حَدِيثِ عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ وَيَحْمَدُهُ النَّاسُ ‏.‏ كَمَا قَالَ حَمَّادٌ ‏.‏
45.en: This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters also and the one transmitted on the authority of Shu'ba (the words are): " People love him." In the hadith transmitted on the authority of 'Abd-us-Samad (the words are):" People praise him as stated by Hammad."
45.hi: Ye hadees ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai aur Shu'ba ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: "Log usse muhabbat karte hain." Abd-us-Samad ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: "Log uski tareef karte hain jaisa Hammad ne kaha."

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، وَوَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ،
 اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي وَأَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ وَوَكِيعٌ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ،
 عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ الصَّادِقُ
 الْمَصْدُوقُ ‏
"‏ إِنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ يُجْمَعُ خَلْقُهُ فِي بَطْنِ أُمِّهِ أَرْبَعِينَ يَوْمًا ثُمَّ يَكُونُ فِي ذَلِكَ عَلَقَةً مِثْلَ
 ذَلِكَ ثُمَّ يَكُونُ فِي ذَلِكَ مُضْغَةً مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ ثُمَّ يُرْسَلُ الْمَلَكُ فَيَنْفُخُ فِيهِ الرُّوحَ وَيُؤْمَرُ بِأَرْبَعِ كَلِمَاتٍ
 بِكَتْبِ رِزْقِهِ وَأَجَلِهِ وَعَمَلِهِ وَشَقِيٌّ أَوْ سَعِيدٌ فَوَالَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُهُ إِنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ لَيَعْمَلُ بِعَمَلِ
 أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ حَتَّى مَا يَكُونَ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَهَا إِلاَّ ذِرَاعٌ فَيَسْبِقُ عَلَيْهِ الْكِتَابُ فَيَعْمَلُ بِعَمَلِ أَهْلِ
 النَّارِ فَيَدْخُلُهَا وَإِنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ لَيَعْمَلُ بِعَمَلِ أَهْلِ النَّارِ حَتَّى مَا يَكُونَ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَهَا إِلاَّ ذِرَاعٌ
 فَيَسْبِقُ عَلَيْهِ الْكِتَابُ فَيَعْمَلُ بِعَمَلِ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ فَيَدْخُلُهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
46.en: Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who is the most truthful (of the human beings) and his being truthful (is a fact) said: Verily your creation is on this wise. The constituents of one of you are collected for forty days in his mother's womb in the form of blood, after which it becomes a clot of blood in another period of forty days. Then it becomes a lump of flesh and forty days later Allah sends His angel to it with instructions concerning four things, so the angel writes down his livelihood, his death, his deeds, his fortune and misfortune. By Him, besides Whom there is no god, that one amongst you acts like the people deserving Paradise until between him and Paradise there remains but the distance of a cubit, when suddenly the writing of destiny overcomes him and he begins to act like the denizens of Hell and thus enters Hell, and another one acts in the way of the denizens of Hell, until there remains between him and Hell a distance of a cubit that the writing of destiny overcomes him and then he begins to act like the people of Paradise and enters Paradise.
46.hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW), jo (insaanon mein) sabse sachche hain aur jinka sachcha hona ek Haqeeqat hai, ne farmaaya: Yaqeenan tumhaari paidaayish is tarah hoti hai. Tum mein se har ek ki khilqat chaalis din tak uski maa ke pet mein khoon ke soorat mein ikattha rehti hai, iske baad ye chaalis din ki ek aur muddat mein khoon ka Thakka ban jaati hai. Phir ye gosht ka Lotha ban jaati hai aur chaalis din baad Allah is (Lothe) ke paas Apna Farishta bheja hai chaar baaton ka hukum lekar, is liye Farishta uski rozi, uski maut, uske amal aur uski khushnaseebi aur badnaseebi darj karta hai. Us Hasti ki qasam jiske siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai, tum mein se koi Jannat ke logon jaisa amal karta rehta hai yahan tak ki uske aur Jannat ke beech sirf ek gaz ki doori bacha rehti hai, ki achaanak (uski) takdeer ki likhaai use pakad leti hai aur woh Jahannam ke logon jaisa amal karne lagta hai aur Jahannam mein daakhil ho jaata hai, aur doosra shakhs Jahannam ke logon jaisa amal karta rehta hai, yahan tak ki uske aur Jahannam ke beech sirf ek gaz ki doori bacha rehti hai ki takdeer ki likhaai use pakad leti hai aur phir woh Jannat ke logon jaisa amal karne lagta hai aur Jannat mein daakhil ho jaata hai.

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ جَرِيرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ،
 الْحَمِيدِ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَعِيدٍ،
 الأَشَجُّ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ بْنُ الْحَجَّاجِ،
 كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فِي حَدِيثِ وَكِيعٍ ‏"‏ إِنَّ خَلْقَ أَحَدِكُمْ يُجْمَعُ فِي بَطْنِ
 أُمِّهِ أَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ فِي حَدِيثِ مُعَاذٍ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ ‏"‏ أَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً أَرْبَعِينَ يَوْمًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
 وَأَمَّا فِي حَدِيثِ جَرِيرٍ وَعِيسَى ‏"‏ أَرْبَعِينَ يَوْمًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
46.en: This hadith has been reported on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters and in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Waki' (the words are): " The creation of any one of you is like this that (semen) is collected in the womb of the mother for forty nights," and in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Shu'ba (the words are):" Forty nights and forty days." And in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Jarir and 'Isa (the words are):" Forty days."
46.hi: Ye hadees A'mash ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur Waki ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: "Tum mein se har ek ki khilqat is tarah hoti hai ki (nutfa) chaalis raaton tak maa ke pet mein ikattha rehta hai," aur Shu'ba ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: "Chaalis raat aur chaalis din." Aur Jarir aur Isa ki riwayat mein alfaaz hain: "Chaalis din."

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ نُمَيْرٍ - قَالاَ
 حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الطُّفَيْلِ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ بْنِ أَسِيدٍ، يَبْلُغُ
 بِهِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ يَدْخُلُ الْمَلَكُ عَلَى النُّطْفَةِ بَعْدَ مَا تَسْتَقِرُّ فِي الرَّحِمِ
 بِأَرْبَعِينَ أَوْ خَمْسَةٍ وَأَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً فَيَقُولُ يَا رَبِّ أَشَقِيٌّ أَوْ سَعِيدٌ فَيُكْتَبَانِ فَيَقُولُ أَىْ رَبِّ
 أَذَكَرٌ أَوْ أُنْثَى فَيُكْتَبَانِ وَيُكْتَبُ عَمَلُهُ وَأَثَرُهُ وَأَجَلُهُ وَرِزْقُهُ ثُمَّ تُطْوَى الصُّحُفُ فَلاَ يُزَادُ فِيهَا
 وَلاَ يُنْقَصُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
46.en: Hudhaifa b. Usaid reported directly from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that he said: When the drop of (semen) remains in the womb for forty or forty five nights, the angel comes and says: My Lord, will he be good or evil? And both these things would be written. Then the angel says: My Lord, would he be male or female? And both these things are written. And his deeds and actions, his death, his livelihood; these are also recorded. Then his document of destiny is rolled and there is no addition to nor subtraction from it.
46.hi: Hudhaifa bin Usaid (RA) ne seedhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye riwayat ki ki unhone farmaaya: Jab (nutfe) ki boond maa ke pet mein chaalis ya paintaalis raaton tak rehti hai, Farishta aata hai aur kehta hai: Mere Rab, ye achha hoga ya bura? Aur donon baaten likh di jaati hain. Phir Farishta kehta hai: Mere Rab, ye mard hoga ya striyon? Aur ye donon bhi likh di jaati hain. Aur uske amal aur kaam, uski maut, uski rozi; ye bhi darj kiye jaate hain. Phir uska takdeer ka dastaavez lapeta jaata hai aur ismein na koi izafa hota hai na koi kami.

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَرْحٍ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو،
 بْنُ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ الْمَكِّيِّ، أَنَّ عَامِرَ بْنَ وَاثِلَةَ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مَسْعُودٍ،
 يَقُولُ الشَّقِيُّ مَنْ شَقِيَ فِي بَطْنِ أُمِّهِ وَالسَّعِيدُ مَنْ وُعِظَ بِغَيْرِهِ ‏.‏ فَأَتَى رَجُلاً مِنْ أَصْحَابِ
 رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُقَالُ لَهُ حُذَيْفَةُ بْنُ أَسِيدٍ الْغِفَارِيُّ فَحَدَّثَهُ بِذَلِكَ مِنْ قَوْلِ
 ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ فَقَالَ وَكَيْفَ يَشْقَى رَجُلٌ بِغَيْرِ عَمَلٍ فَقَالَ لَهُ الرَّجُلُ أَتَعْجَبُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ فَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ
 رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏
"‏ إِذَا مَرَّ بِالنُّطْفَةِ ثِنْتَانِ وَأَرْبَعُونَ لَيْلَةً بَعَثَ اللَّهُ إِلَيْهَا
 مَلَكًا فَصَوَّرَهَا وَخَلَقَ سَمْعَهَا وَبَصَرَهَا وَجِلْدَهَا وَلَحْمَهَا وَعِظَامَهَا ثُمَّ ‏.‏ قَالَ يَا رَبِّ أَذَكَرٌ
 أَمْ أُنْثَى فَيَقْضِي رَبُّكَ مَا شَاءَ وَيَكْتُبُ الْمَلَكُ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ يَا رَبِّ أَجَلُهُ ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ رَبُّكَ مَا شَاءَ
 وَيَكْتُبُ الْمَلَكُ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ يَا رَبِّ رِزْقُهُ ‏.‏ فَيَقْضِي رَبُّكَ مَا شَاءَ وَيَكْتُبُ الْمَلَكُ ثُمَّ يَخْرُجُ الْمَلَكُ
 بِالصَّحِيفَةِ فِي يَدِهِ فَلاَ يَزِيدُ عَلَى مَا أُمِرَ وَلاَ يَنْقُصُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
46.en: 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud reported: Evil one is he who is evil in the womb of his mother and the good one is he who takes a lesson from the (fate of) others. The narrator came to a person from amongst the Companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who was called Hudhaifa b. Usaid Ghifari and said: How can a person be an evil one without (committing an evil) deed? Thereupon the person said to him: You are surprised at this, whereas I have heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When forty-two nights pass after the semen gets into the womb, Allah sends the angel and gives him shape. Then he creates his sense of hearing, sense of sight, his skin, his flesh, his bones, and then says: My Lord, would he be male or female? And your Lord decides as He desires and the angel then puts down that also and then says: My Lord, what about his age? And your Lord decides as He likes it and the angel puts it down. Then he says: My Lord, what about his livelihood? And then the Lord decides as He likes and the angel writes it down, and then the angel gets out with his scroll of destiny in his hand and nothing is added to it and nothing is subtracted from it.
46.hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) ne bayan kiya: Bura woh hai jo apni maa ke pet mein hi bura ho, aur achha woh hai jo doosron ke (anjaam se) sabak leta hai. Raawi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke ek sahabi ke paas aaya jinhe Hudhaifa bin Usaid Ghifari kaha jaata tha, aur kaha: Koi shakhs bina koi bura amal kiye bura kaise ho sakta hai? Isper us shakhs ne unse kaha: Tumhe isper hairat hota hai, jabki maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jab nutfe ke pet mein pahunchne ke baad bayaalis raaten guzarti hain, Allah Farishta bhejta hai aur use aakaar deta hai. Phir Woh uski sunne ki taaqat, dekhne ki taaqat, uski khaal, uska gosht, uski haddiyaan banaata hai, aur phir farmaata hai: Mere Rab, ye mard hoga ya striyon? Aur tumhaara Rab jaisa chaahta hai faisla karta hai aur Farishta ise bhi likh deta hai aur phir kehta hai: Mere Rab, iski umar ke baare mein kya? Aur tumhaara Rab jaisa chaahta hai faisla karta hai aur Farishta ise likh deta hai. Phir woh kehta hai: Mere Rab, iski rozi ke baare mein kya? Aur phir Rab jaisa chaahta hai faisla karta hai aur Farishta ise likh deta hai, aur phir Farishta apna takdeer ka dastaavez haath mein liye bahar aata hai aur ismein na kuch jodta hai na ghatAta hai.

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ النَّوْفَلِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي 
 أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ أَبَا الطُّفَيْلِ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مَسْعُودٍ، يَقُولُ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِمِثْلِ
 حَدِيثِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْحَارِثِ ‏.‏
46.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud through another chain of transmitters.
46.hi: Ye hadees Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ أَبُو
 خَيْثَمَةَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَطَاءٍ، أَنَّ عِكْرِمَةَ بْنَ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا الطُّفَيْلِ حَدَّثَهُ قَالَ دَخَلْتُ
 عَلَى أَبِي سَرِيحَةَ حُذَيْفَةَ بْنِ أَسِيدٍ الْغِفَارِيِّ فَقَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 بِأُذُنَىَّ هَاتَيْنِ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ إِنَّ النُّطْفَةَ تَقَعُ فِي الرَّحِمِ أَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً ثُمَّ يَتَصَوَّرُ عَلَيْهَا الْمَلَكُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
 قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَسِبْتُهُ قَالَ الَّذِي يَخْلُقُهَا ‏"‏ فَيَقُولُ يَا رَبِّ أَذَكَرٌ أَوْ أُنْثَى فَيَجْعَلُهُ اللَّهُ ذَكَرًا أَوْ
 أُنْثَى ثُمَّ يَقُولُ يَا رَبِّ أَسَوِيٌّ أَوْ غَيْرُ سَوِيٍّ فَيَجْعَلُهُ اللَّهُ سَوِيًّا أَوْ غَيْرَ سَوِيٍّ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ
 يَا رَبِّ مَا رِزْقُهُ مَا أَجَلُهُ مَا خُلُقُهُ ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُهُ اللَّهُ شَقِيًّا أَوْ سَعِيدًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
46.en: Abu Tufail reported: I visited Abu Sariha Hudhaifa b. Usaid al-Ghifari who said: I listened with these two ears of mine Allahs Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The semen stays in the womb for forty nights, then the angel, gives it a shape. Zubair said: I think that he said: One who fashions that and decides whether he would be male or female. Then he (the angel) says: Would his limbs be full or imperfect? And then the Lord makes thein full and perfect or otherwise as He desires. Then he says: My Lord, what about his livelihood, and his death and what about his disposition? And then the Lord decides about his misfortune and fortune.
46.hi: Abu Tufail ne bayan kiya: Main Abu Sariha Hudhaifa bin Usaid al-Ghifari se milne gaya jinhone kaha: Maine apne in do kaanon se Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Nutfa maa ke pet mein chaalis raaton tak rehta hai, phir Farishta ise aakaar deta hai. Zubair ne kaha: Mujhe lagta hai unhone (Nabi ne) farmaaya: Woh (Farishta) ise Dhaalta hai aur faisla karta hai ki ye mard hoga ya striyon. Phir woh kehta hai: Kya iske ang poore honge ya adhoore? Aur phir Rab jaisa chaahta hai unhe poora aur mukammal banaata hai ya nahi. Phir woh kehta hai: Mere Rab, iski rozi, aur iski maut aur iske mizaj ke baare mein kya? Aur phir Rab iski badnaseebi aur khushnaseebi ke baare mein faisla karta hai.

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا رَبِيعَةُ بْنُ كُلْثُومٍ، حَدَّثَنِي 
 أَبِي كُلْثُومٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الطُّفَيْلِ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ بْنِ أَسِيدٍ الْغِفَارِيِّ، صَاحِبِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم رَفَعَ الْحَدِيثَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ أَنَّ مَلَكًا مُوَكَّلاً بِالرَّحِمِ إِذَا أَرَادَ
 اللَّهُ أَنْ يَخْلُقَ شَيْئًا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ لِبِضْعٍ وَأَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏.‏
46.en: Hadhaifa b. Usaid Ghifari, a Companion of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), reported it directly from Allah's Messenger (may peace upon him). as he said: There is an angel who looks after the womb when Allah decides to create any- thing after more than forty nights are over; the rest of the hadith is the same.
46.hi: Hudhaifa bin Usaid Ghifari, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke ek sahabi, ne seedhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye riwayat ki ki unhone farmaaya: Ek Farishta hai jo pet ki dekhbhaal karta hai jab Allah chaalis raaton se zyada ke baad kuch banaane ka faisla karta hai; baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو كَامِلٍ، فُضَيْلُ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ،
 اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، وَرَفَعَ الْحَدِيثَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏
"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ قَدْ وَكَّلَ
 بِالرَّحِمِ مَلَكًا فَيَقُولُ أَىْ رَبِّ نُطْفَةٌ أَىْ رَبِّ عَلَقَةٌ أَىْ رَبِّ مُضْغَةٌ ‏.‏ فَإِذَا أَرَادَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَقْضِيَ
 خَلْقًا - قَالَ - قَالَ الْمَلَكُ أَىْ رَبِّ ذَكَرٌ أَوْ أُنْثَى شَقِيٌّ أَوْ سَعِيدٌ فَمَا الرِّزْقُ فَمَا الأَجَلُ
 فَيُكْتَبُ كَذَلِكَ فِي بَطْنِ أُمِّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
46.en: Anas b. Malik reported directly from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that he said: Allah, the Exlated and Glorious, has appointed an angel as the caretaker of the womb, and he would say: My Lord, it is now a drop of semen; my Lord, It is now a clot of blood; my Lord, it has now become a lump of flesh, and when Allah decides to give it a final shape, the angel says: My Lord, would it be male or female or would he be an evil or a good person? What about his livelihood and his age? And it is all written as he is in the womb of his mother.
46.hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne seedhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye riwayat ki ki unhone farmaaya: Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne ek Farishta ko pet ka nigehbaan muqarrar kiya hai, aur woh kahega: Mere Rab, ye ab nutfe ki boond hai; mere Rab, ye ab khoon ka Thakka hai; mere Rab, ye ab gosht ka Lotha ban chuka hai, aur jab Allah ise aakhri aakaar dene ka faisla karta hai, Farishta kehta hai: Mere Rab, ye mard hoga ya striyon, ya ye achha hoga ya bura? Iski rozi aur iski umar ke baare mein kya? Aur ye sab kuch likh diya jaata hai jab ye apni maa ke pet mein hi hota hai.

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ
 لِزُهَيْرٍ - قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدَةَ،
 عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ كُنَّا فِي جَنَازَةٍ فِي بَقِيعِ الْغَرْقَدِ فَأَتَانَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَعَدَ وَقَعَدْنَا حَوْلَهُ وَمَعَهُ مِخْصَرَةٌ فَنَكَّسَ فَجَعَلَ يَنْكُتُ بِمِخْصَرَتِهِ
 ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا مِنْكُمْ مِنْ أَحَدٍ مَا مِنْ نَفْسٍ مَنْفُوسَةٍ إِلاَّ وَقَدْ كَتَبَ اللَّهُ مَكَانَهَا مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ وَالنَّارِ
 وَإِلاَّ وَقَدْ كُتِبَتْ شَقِيَّةً أَوْ سَعِيدَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَفَلاَ نَمْكُثُ عَلَى كِتَابِنَا
 وَنَدَعُ الْعَمَلَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ كَانَ مِنْ أَهْلِ السَّعَادَةِ فَسَيَصِيرُ إِلَى عَمَلِ أَهْلِ السَّعَادَةِ وَمَنْ كَانَ
 مِنْ أَهْلِ الشَّقَاوَةِ فَسَيَصِيرُ إِلَى عَمَلِ أَهْلِ الشَّقَاوَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اعْمَلُوا فَكُلٌّ مُيَسَّرٌ أَمَّا
 أَهْلُ السَّعَادَةِ فَيُيَسَّرُونَ لِعَمَلِ أَهْلِ السَّعَادَةِ وَأَمَّا أَهْلُ الشَّقَاوَةِ فَيُيَسَّرُونَ لِعَمَلِ أَهْلِ الشَّقَاوَةِ
 ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ ‏{‏ فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَى وَاتَّقَى * وَصَدَّقَ بِالْحُسْنَى * فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُ لِلْيُسْرَى * وَأَمَّا مَنْ
 بَخِلَ وَاسْتَغْنَى * وَكَذَّبَ بِالْحُسْنَى * فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُ لِلْعُسْرَى‏}‏
46.en: Ali reported: We were in a funeral in the graveyard of Gharqad when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to us and we sat around him. He had a stick with him. He lowered his head and began to scratch the earth with his stick, and then said: There is not one amongst you whom a seat in Paradise or Hell has not been allotted and about whom it has not been written down whether he would be an evil person or a blessed person. A person said: Allah's Messenger, should we not then depend upon our destiny and abandon our deeds? Thereupon he said: Acts of everyone will be facilitated in that which has been created for him so that whoever belongs to the company of the blessed will have good works made easier for him and whoever belongs to the unfortunate ones will have evil acts made easier for him. He then recited this verse (from the Qur'an): "Then, who gives to the needy and guards against evil and accepts the excellent (the truth of Islam and the path of righteousness it prescribes), We shall make easy for him the easy end and who is miserly and considers himself above need, We shall make easy for him the difficult end" (xcii. 5-10).
46.hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne bayan kiya: Hum Gharqad ke qabristan mein ek janaaze mein the ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) humaare paas aaye aur hum unke aas-paas baith gaye. Unke paas ek lakdi thi. Unhone apna sar jhukaaya aur apni lakdi se zameen khodne lage aur phir farmaaya: Tum mein se koi bhi aisa nahi hai jiske liye Jannat ya Jahannam mein koi jagah muqarrar na ki gayi ho aur jiske baare mein ye na likha gaya ho ki woh bura hoga ya achha. Ek shakhs ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya humein phir apni takdeer par bharosa karke apne amal chhod nahi dene chahiye? Isper unhone farmaaya: Har shakhs ke amal usmein aasaan kar diye jaayenge jiske liye woh banaaya gaya hai, is liye jo khushnaseebi ke giroh se mutaliq hoga uske liye achhe amal aasaan kar diye jaayenge, aur jo badnaseeb logon se mutaliq hoga uske liye bure amal aasaan kar diye jaayenge. Phir unhone ye Qurani aayat padhi: "Is liye jo zaroorat-mand ko deta hai aur burai se bachne ki koshish karta hai aur behtareen (Islam ke sach aur uske batAye hue nekokaari ke raaste) ko qubool karta hai, Hum uske liye aasaan raaste ki taraf raah aasaan karenge, aur jo kanjoos hai aur khud ko zaroorat se upar samajhta hai, Hum uske liye mushkil raaste ki taraf raah aasaan karenge" (92:5-10).

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَهَنَّادُ بْنُ السَّرِيِّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ 
 مَنْصُورٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ فِي مَعْنَاهُ وَقَالَ فَأَخَذَ عُودًا ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ مِخْصَرَةً ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي
 شَيْبَةَ فِي حَدِيثِهِ عَنْ أَبِي الأَحْوَصِ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
46.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Mansur with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
46.hi: Ye hadees Mansur ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَأَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا 
 وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ
 - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ السُّلَمِيِّ،
 عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ جَالِسًا وَفِي يَدِهِ عُودٌ يَنْكُتُ
 بِهِ فَرَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا مِنْكُمْ مِنْ نَفْسٍ إِلاَّ وَقَدْ عُلِمَ مَنْزِلُهَا مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ وَالنَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا
 يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَلِمَ نَعْمَلُ أَفَلاَ نَتَّكِلُ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ ‏.‏ اعْمَلُوا فَكُلٌّ مُيَسَّرٌ لِمَا خُلِقَ لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ
 ‏{‏ فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَى وَاتَّقَى * وَصَدَّقَ بِالْحُسْنَى‏}‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏ فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُ لِلْعُسْرَى‏}‏
46.en: 'Ali reported that one day Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was sitting with a wood in his hand and he was scratching the ground. He raised his head and said: There is not one amongst you who has not been allotted his seat in Paradise or Hell. They said: Allah's Messenger. then, why should we perform good deeds, why not depend upon our destiny? Thereupon he said. No, do perform good deeds, for everyone is facilitated in that for which he has been created; then he recited this verse:" Then, who gives to the needy and guards against evil and accepts the excellent (the truth of Islam and the path of righteousness it prescribes), We shall make easy for him the easy end..." (xcii. 5-10).
46.hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne bayan kiya ki ek din Allah ke Rasool (SAW) haath mein lakdi liye baithe the aur zameen khod rahe the. Unhone apna sar uThAya aur farmaaya: Tum mein se koi bhi aisa nahi hai jiske liye Jannat ya Jahannam mein uski jagah muqarrar na ki gayi ho. Unhone (Sahaba ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, phir humein nekokaar amal kyun karne chahiye, apni takdeer par bharosa kyun na karein? Isper unhone farmaaya: Nahi, nekokaar amal karo, kyunki har shakhs ke liye woh aasaan kar diya jaata hai jiske liye woh banaaya gaya hai; phir unhone ye aayat padhi: "Is liye jo zaroorat-mand ko deta hai aur burai se bachne ki koshish karta hai aur behtareen ko qubool karta hai, Hum uske liye aasaan raaste ki taraf raah aasaan karenge..." (92:5-10).

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ 
 مَنْصُورٍ، وَالأَعْمَشِ، أَنَّهُمَا سَمِعَا سَعْدَ بْنَ عُبَيْدَةَ، يُحَدِّثُهُ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ السُّلَمِيِّ، عَنْ 
 عَلِيٍّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِنَحْوِهِ ‏.‏
46.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Ali through another chain of transmitters.
46.hi: Ye hadees Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى،
 أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ جَاءَ سُرَاقَةُ بْنُ مَالِكِ بْنِ جُعْشُمٍ قَالَ
 يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ بَيِّنْ لَنَا دِينَنَا كَأَنَّا خُلِقْنَا الآنَ فِيمَا الْعَمَلُ الْيَوْمَ أَفِيمَا جَفَّتْ بِهِ الأَقْلاَمُ وَجَرَتْ
 بِهِ الْمَقَادِيرُ أَمْ فِيمَا نَسْتَقْبِلُ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ ‏.‏ بَلْ فِيمَا جَفَّتْ بِهِ الأَقْلاَمُ وَجَرَتْ بِهِ الْمَقَادِيرُ ‏"‏
 ‏.‏ قَالَ فَفِيمَ الْعَمَلُ قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ ثُمَّ تَكَلَّمَ أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ بِشَىْءٍ لَمْ أَفْهَمْهُ فَسَأَلْتُ مَا قَالَ فَقَالَ
 ‏"‏ اعْمَلُوا فَكُلٌّ مُيَسَّرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
46.en: Jabir reported that Suriqa b. Malik b. Ju'shuin came and said: Allah's Messenger, explain our religion to us (in a way) as if we have been created just now. Whosoever deeds we do today, is it because of the fact that-the pens have dried (after recording them) and the destitiles have began to operate or these have effects in future? Thereupon he said: The pens have dried tmd destinies have begun to operate. (Suraqa b. Malik) said: If it Is so, then what is the use of doing good deeds? Zuhair said: Then Abu Zubair said something but I could not understand that and I said. What did he say? Thereupon he said: Act, for everyone is facilitated what he intends to do.
46.hi: Jabir (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Suraqa bin Malik bin Ju'shum aaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, humein humaara deen samjhaiye jaise humein abhi paida kiya gaya ho. Aaj hum jo bhi amal karte hain, kya iski wajah ye hai ki (Qalam) sookh chuka hai (unhe darj karne ke baad) aur takdeerein kaam karna shuru kar chuki hain ya inka natija mustaqbil mein hoga? Isper unhone farmaaya: Qalam sookh chuka hai aur takdeerein kaam karna shuru kar chuki hain. (Suraqa bin Malik ne) kaha: Agar aisa hai, to nekokaar amal karne ka kya faayda? Zuhair ne kaha: Phir Abu Zubair ne kuch kaha lekin main samajh nahi paaya aur maine kaha: Unhone kya farmaaya? Isper unhone kaha: Amal karo, kyunki har shakhs ke liye woh aasaan kar diya jaata hai jo woh karna chaahta hai.

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ،
 عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِهَذَا الْمَعْنَى وَفِيهِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ كُلُّ عَامِلٍ مُيَسَّرٌ لِعَمَلِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
46.en: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Jabir b. Abdullah with the same wording (and includes these words): " Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Every doer of deed is facilitated in his action."
46.hi: Ye hadees Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ki sanad se isi alfaazon mein riwayat ki gayi hai (aur ismein ye alfaaz shaamil hain): "Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Har amal karne wale ke liye uska amal aasaan kar diya jaata hai."

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ الضُّبَعِيِّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُطَرِّفٌ،
 عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ، قَالَ قِيلَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَعُلِمَ أَهْلُ الْجَنَّةِ مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ قَالَ فَقَالَ
 ‏"‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قِيلَ فَفِيمَ يَعْمَلُ الْعَامِلُونَ قَالَ ‏"‏ كُلٌّ مُيَسَّرٌ لِمَا خُلِقَ لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
46.en: 'Imran b. Husain repotted that it was said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ): Has there been drawn a distinction between the people of Paradise and the denizens of hell? He said: Yes. It was again said: (If it is so), then What is the use of doing good deeds? Thereupon he said: Everyone is facilitated in what has been created for him.
46.hi: Imran bin Husain (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se poocha gaya: Kya Jannat ke logon aur Jahannam ke logon mein antar kiya gaya hai? Unhone farmaaya: Haan. Dobara poocha gaya: (Agar aisa hai), to phir nekokaar amal karne ka kya faayda? Isper unhone farmaaya: Har shakhs ke liye woh aasaan kar diya jaata hai jiske liye woh banaaya gaya hai.

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ،
 وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى،
 أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، كُلُّهُمْ
 عَنْ يَزِيدَ الرِّشْكِ، فِي هَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ حَمَّادٍ وَفِي حَدِيثِ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ قَالَ قُلْتُ
 يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏
46.en: This hadith has been narrated through other chains of transmiters with slight variations of wording.
46.hi: Ye hadees kuch doosri sanadon ke zariye alfaazon mein halki tabdeeliyon ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَزْرَةُ بْنُ،
 ثَابِتٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ يَعْمُرَ، عَنْ أَبِي الأَسْوَدِ الدِّئَلِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي عِمْرَانُ
 بْنُ الْحُصَيْنِ أَرَأَيْتَ مَا يَعْمَلُ النَّاسُ الْيَوْمَ وَيَكْدَحُونَ فِيهِ أَشَىْءٌ قُضِيَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَمَضَى عَلَيْهِمْ
 مِنْ قَدَرِ مَا سَبَقَ أَوْ فِيمَا يُسْتَقْبَلُونَ بِهِ مِمَّا أَتَاهُمْ بِهِ نَبِيُّهُمْ وَثَبَتَتِ الْحُجَّةُ عَلَيْهِمْ فَقُلْتُ بَلْ
 شَىْءٌ قُضِيَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَمَضَى عَلَيْهِمْ قَالَ فَقَالَ أَفَلاَ يَكُونُ ظُلْمًا قَالَ فَفَزِعْتُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ فَزَعًا
 شَدِيدًا وَقُلْتُ كُلُّ شَىْءٍ خَلْقُ اللَّهِ وَمِلْكُ يَدِهِ فَلاَ يُسْأَلُ عَمَّا يَفْعَلُ وَهُمْ يُسْأَلُونَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لِي
 يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ إِنِّي لَمْ أُرِدْ بِمَا سَأَلْتُكَ إِلاَّ لأَحْزُرَ عَقْلَكَ إِنَّ رَجُلَيْنِ مِنْ مُزَيْنَةَ أَتَيَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالاَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَرَأَيْتَ مَا يَعْمَلُ النَّاسُ الْيَوْمَ وَيَكْدَحُونَ فِيهِ أَشَىْءٌ
 قُضِيَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَمَضَى فِيهِمْ مِنْ قَدَرٍ قَدْ سَبَقَ أَوْ فِيمَا يُسْتَقْبَلُونَ بِهِ مِمَّا أَتَاهُمْ بِهِ نَبِيُّهُمْ وَثَبَتَتِ
 الْحُجَّةُ عَلَيْهِمْ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ بَلْ شَىْءٌ قُضِيَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَمَضَى فِيهِمْ وَتَصْدِيقُ ذَلِكَ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ
 عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏ وَنَفْسٍ وَمَا سَوَّاهَا * فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَاهَا‏}‏ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
46.en: Abu al-Aswad reported that 'Imran b Husain asked him: What is your view, what the people do today in the world, and strive for, is it something decreed for them or preordained for them or will their fate in the Hereafter be deterrained by the fact that their Prophets brought them teaching which they did not act upon? I said: Of course, it is something which is predetermined for them and preordained for them. He (further) said: Then, would it not be an injustice (to punish them)? I felt greatly disturbed because of that, and said: Everything is created by Allah and lies in His Power. He would not be questioned as to what He does, but they would be questioned; thereupon he said to me: May Allah have mercy upon you, I did not mean to ask you but for testing your intelligence. Two men of the tribe of Muzaina came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger, what is your opinion that the people do in the world and strive for, is something decreed for them; something preordained for them and will their fate in the Hereafter be determined by the fact that their Prophets brought them teachings which they did not act upon. and thus they became deserving of punishment? Thereupon, he said: Of course, it happens as it is decreed by Destiny and preordained for them, and this view is confirmed by this verse of the Book of Allah, the Exalted and Glorious:" Consider the soul and Him Who made it perfect, then breathed into it its sin and its piety" (xci. 8).
46.hi: Abu al-Aswad ne bayan kiya ki Imran bin Husain (RA) ne unse poocha: Iske baare mein tumhaari kya raay hai, jo log aaj is duniya mein karte hain aur jiski koshish karte hain, kya ye unke liye pehle se tay kiya gaya hai ya pehle se muqarrar kiya gaya hai, ya Aakhirat mein unki takdeer is baat se tay hogi ki unke Nabiyon ne unhe jo taalim di usper unhone amal kiya ya nahi? Maine kaha: Zaroor, ye kuch aisa hai jo unke liye pehle se tay kiya gaya hai aur pehle se muqarrar kiya gaya hai. Unhone (aage) kaha: Phir kya ye anyaay nahi hoga (unhe saza dena)? Mujhe isse bahut pareshaani hui aur maine kaha: Har cheez Allah ne banaayi hai aur Uski taaqat mein hai. Usse ye nahi poocha jaayega ki Woh kya karta hai, lekin unse zaroor poocha jaayega; isper unhone mujhse kaha: Allah tumpar rehmat kare, mera iraada tumse poochne ka nahi tha balki tumhaari samajh ki pareeksha lene ka tha. Muzaina qabile ke do log Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, iske baare mein aapki kya raay hai, jo log is duniya mein karte hain aur jiski koshish karte hain, kya ye unke liye tay kiya gaya hai, unke liye muqarrar kiya gaya hai, aur Aakhirat mein unki takdeer is baat se tay hogi ki unke Nabiyon ne unhe jo taalim di usper unhone amal nahi kiya, aur is tarah woh saza ke laayak ho gaye? Isper unhone farmaaya: Zaroor, aisa hota hai jaisa Takdeer ne muqarrar kiya hai aur unke liye pehle se tay kiya gaya hai, aur is nazariye ki pushti Allah ki Kitaab, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ki is aayat se hoti hai: "Rooh ka aur Us Hasti ka jisne ise mukammal banaaya, phir ismein uski burai aur uska taqwa phoonka" (91:8).

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ - عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ 
 أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ إِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَيَعْمَلُ الزَّمَنَ
 الطَّوِيلَ بِعَمَلِ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ ثُمَّ يُخْتَمُ لَهُ عَمَلُهُ بِعَمَلِ أَهْلِ النَّارِ وَإِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَيَعْمَلُ الزَّمَنَ الطَّوِيلَ
 بِعَمَلِ أَهْلِ النَّارِ ثُمَّ يُخْتَمُ لَهُ عَمَلُهُ بِعَمَلِ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
46.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Verily, a man would perform the deeds of the people of Paradise for a long time, then his deeds would be concluded with the deeds of the people of Hell. And verily, a man would perform the deeds of the people of Hell for a long time, and then his deeds would be concluded with the deeds of the people of Paradise.
46.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Yaqeenan, ek shakhs lambe waqt tak Jannat ke logon jaisa amal karta hai, phir uske amal Jahannam ke logon jaise amal ke saath khatm hote hain. Aur yaqeenan, ek shakhs lambe waqt tak Jahannam ke logon jaisa amal karta hai, aur phir uske amal Jannat ke logon jaise amal ke saath khatm hote hain.

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْقَارِيَّ - عَنْ 
 أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ إِنَّ
 الرَّجُلَ لَيَعْمَلُ عَمَلَ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ فِيمَا يَبْدُو لِلنَّاسِ وَهُوَ مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ ‏.‏ وَإِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَيَعْمَلُ
 عَمَلَ أَهْلِ النَّارِ فِيمَا يَبْدُو لِلنَّاسِ وَهُوَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
46.en: Sahl b. Sa'd reported it from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that a person performs deeds like the deeds of the people of Paradise apparently before people and he would be amongst the dwellers of Hell and a person acts apparently like the people of Hell, but (in fact) he would be among the dwellers of Paradise.
46.hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (RA) ne seedhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye riwayat ki ki ek shakhs zaahiri taur par logon ke saamne Jannat ke logon jaisa amal karta hai lekin (asal mein) woh Jahannam ke bashindon mein se hoga, aur ek shakhs zaahiri taur par Jahannam ke logon jaisa amal karta hai lekin (asal mein) woh Jannat ke bashindon mein se hoga.

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، وَإِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ دِينَارِ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ الْمَكِّيُّ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدَةَ،
 الضَّبِّيُّ جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ حَاتِمٍ وَابْنِ دِينَارٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ،
 عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم ‏"‏ احْتَجَّ آدَمُ وَمُوسَى فَقَالَ مُوسَى يَا آدَمُ أَنْتَ أَبُونَا خَيَّبْتَنَا وَأَخْرَجْتَنَا مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ
 فَقَالَ لَهُ آدَمُ أَنْتَ مُوسَى اصْطَفَاكَ اللَّهُ بِكَلاَمِهِ وَخَطَّ لَكَ بِيَدِهِ أَتَلُومُنِي عَلَى أَمْرٍ قَدَّرَهُ اللَّهُ
 عَلَىَّ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَخْلُقَنِي بِأَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فَحَجَّ آدَمُ مُوسَى
 فَحَجَّ آدَمُ مُوسَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ ابْنِ أَبِي عُمَرَ وَابْنِ عَبْدَةَ قَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا خَطَّ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ الآخَرُ
 كَتَبَ لَكَ التَّوْرَاةَ بِيَدِهِ ‏.‏
46.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) as saying: There was argument between Adam and Moses. Moses said to Adam: You are our father. You did us harm and caused us to get out of Paradise. Adam said to him: You are Moses. Allah selected you (for direct conversation with you) and wrote with His own Hand the Book (Torah) for you. Despite this you blame me for an act which Allah had ordained for me forty years before He created me. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said:. This is how Adam came the better of Moses and Adam came the better of Moses.
46.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Aadam aur Musa ke beech bahas hui. Musa ne Aadam se kaha: Tum humaare waalid ho. Tumne humein nuksaan pahunchaaya aur humein Jannat se bahar nikalne ka wajah bane. Aadam ne unse kaha: Tum Musa ho. Allah ne tumhe chuna (khud se seedhi baatchit ke liye) aur tumhaare liye Apne khud ke Haath se Kitaab (Torah) likhi. Iske bawajood tum mujhe us amal ke liye dosh dete ho jo Allah ne mere liye chaalis saal pehle muqarrar kiya tha isse pehle ki Woh mujhe paida kare. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Is tarah Aadam Musa par bhaari pade, aur Aadam Musa par bhaari pade.

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، فِيمَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِ عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ 
 الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ تَحَاجَّ آدَمُ وَمُوسَى
 فَحَجَّ آدَمُ مُوسَى فَقَالَ لَهُ مُوسَى أَنْتَ آدَمُ الَّذِي أَغْوَيْتَ النَّاسَ وَأَخْرَجْتَهُمْ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ فَقَالَ
 آدَمُ أَنْتَ الَّذِي أَعْطَاهُ اللَّهُ عِلْمَ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَاصْطَفَاهُ عَلَى النَّاسِ بِرِسَالَتِهِ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ
 فَتَلُومُنِي عَلَى أَمْرٍ قُدِّرَ عَلَىَّ قَبْلَ أَنْ أُخْلَقَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
46.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There was argument between Adam and Moses, and Adam came the better of Moses. Moses said to him: You are the same Adam who misled people, and caused them to get out of Paradise. Adam said: You are the same (Moses) whom Allah endowed the knowledge of everything and selected him amongst the people as His Messenger. He said: Yes. Adam then again said: Even then you blame me for an affair which had been ordained for me before I was created.
46.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Aadam aur Musa ke beech bahas hui, aur Aadam Musa par bhaari pade. Musa ne unse kaha: Tum wahi Aadam ho jinhone logon ko gumraah kiya aur unhe Jannat se bahar nikaalne ka wajah bane. Aadam ne kaha: Tum wahi (Musa) ho jinhe Allah ne har cheez ka ilm diya aur logon mein se apne Rasool ke soorat mein chuna. Unhone (Musa ne) kaha: Haan. Aadam ne phir kaha: Iske bawajood tum mujhe us maamle ke liye dosh dete ho jo mere paida hone se pehle hi muqarrar kiya ja chuka tha.

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مُوسَى بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُوسَى بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ الأَنْصَارِيُّ،
 حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ، حَدَّثَنِي الْحَارِثُ بْنُ أَبِي ذُبَابٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ هُرْمُزَ - وَعَبْدِ
 الرَّحْمَنِ الأَعْرَجِ قَالاَ سَمِعْنَا أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ احْتَجَّ
 آدَمُ وَمُوسَى عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلاَمُ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمَا فَحَجَّ آدَمُ مُوسَى قَالَ مُوسَى أَنْتَ آدَمُ الَّذِي خَلَقَكَ
 اللَّهُ بِيَدِهِ وَنَفَخَ فِيكَ مِنْ رُوحِهِ وَأَسْجَدَ لَكَ مَلاَئِكَتَهُ وَأَسْكَنَكَ فِي جَنَّتِهِ ثُمَّ أَهْبَطْتَ النَّاسَ
 بِخَطِيئَتِكَ إِلَى الأَرْضِ فَقَالَ آدَمُ أَنْتَ مُوسَى الَّذِي اصْطَفَاكَ اللَّهُ بِرِسَالَتِهِ وَبِكَلاَمِهِ وَأَعْطَاكَ
 الأَلْوَاحَ فِيهَا تِبْيَانُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَقَرَّبَكَ نَجِيًّا فَبِكَمْ وَجَدْتَ اللَّهَ كَتَبَ التَّوْرَاةَ قَبْلَ أَنْ أُخْلَقَ
 قَالَ مُوسَى بِأَرْبَعِينَ عَامًا ‏.‏ قَالَ آدَمُ فَهَلْ وَجَدْتَ فِيهَا ‏{‏ وَعَصَى آدَمُ رَبَّهُ فَغَوَى‏}‏ قَالَ
 نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَفَتَلُومُنِي عَلَى أَنْ عَمِلْتُ عَمَلاً كَتَبَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَىَّ أَنْ أَعْمَلَهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَخْلُقَنِي بِأَرْبَعِينَ
 سَنَةً قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فَحَجَّ آدَمُ مُوسَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏
46.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There was an argument between Adam and Moses (peace be upon both of them) in the presence of their Lord. Adam came the better of Moses. Moses said: Are you that Adam whom Allah created with His Hand and breathed into himHis sprit, and commanded angels to fall in prostration before him and He made you live in Paradise with comfort and ease. Then you caused the people to get down to the earth because of your lapse. Adam said: Are you that Moses whom Allah selected for His Messengership and for His conversation with him and conferred upon you the tablets, in which everything was clearly explained and granted you the audience in order to have confidential talk with you. What is your opinion, how long Torah would haye been written before I was created? Moses said: Forty years before. Adam said: Did you not see these words: Adam committed an error and he was enticed to (do so). He (Moses) said: Yes. Whereupon, he (Adam) said: Do you then blame me for an act which Allah had ordained for me forty years before He created me? Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: This is how Adam came the better of Moses.
46.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Aadam aur Musa (donon par shaanti ho) ke beech unke Rab ki maujoodgi mein bahas hui. Aadam Musa par bhaari pade. Musa ne kaha: Kya tum wahi Aadam ho jinhe Allah ne Apne Haath se banaaya, aur unmein Apni Rooh phoonki, aur Farishton ko unke saamne sajde mein girne ka hukum diya, aur tumhe Jannat mein aaraam aur suvidha ke saath rehne diya? Phir tum apni galti ki wajah se logon ko zameen par utarne ka wajah bane. Aadam ne kaha: Kya tum wahi Musa ho jise Allah ne apni Rasool ke soorat mein chuna, aur khud se baatchit ke liye chuna, aur tumhe woh takhtiyaan din, jinmein har cheez saaf tareeke se samjhaayi gayi thi, aur tumhe khaas guptagoo ke liye apni sohbat di? Tumhaari kya raay hai, Torah mere paida hone se kitne saal pehle likhi gayi hogi? Musa ne kaha: Chaalis saal pehle. Aadam ne kaha: Kya tumne ye alfaaz nahi dekhe: Aadam se galti hui aur woh (aisa karne ke liye) uksaaya gaya? Unhone (Musa ne) kaha: Haan. Isper unhone (Aadam ne) kaha: Phir tum mujhe us amal ke liye kyun dosh dete ho jo Allah ne mere paida hone se chaalis saal pehle mere liye muqarrar kiya tha? Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Is tarah Aadam Musa par bhaari pade.

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَابْنُ، حَاتِمٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي،
 عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله
 عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ احْتَجَّ آدَمُ وَمُوسَى فَقَالَ لَهُ مُوسَى أَنْتَ آدَمُ الَّذِي أَخْرَجَتْكَ خَطِيئَتُكَ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ
 فَقَالَ لَهُ آدَمُ أَنْتَ مُوسَى الَّذِي اصْطَفَاكَ اللَّهُ بِرِسَالَتِهِ وَبِكَلاَمِهِ ثُمَّ تَلُومُنِي عَلَى أَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِّرَ
 عَلَىَّ قَبْلَ أَنْ أُخْلَقَ فَحَجَّ آدَمُ مُوسَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏
46.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There was an argument between Adam and Moses. Moses said: Are you that Adam whose lapse caused you to get out of Paradise? Adam said to him: Are you that Moses whom Allah selected for His Messengership, for His conversation and you blame me for an affair which had been ordained for me before I was created? This is how Adam came the better of Moses.
46.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Aadam aur Musa ke beech bahas hui. Musa ne kaha: Kya tum wahi Aadam ho jinki galti ki wajah se tum Jannat se bahar nikale gaye? Aadam ne unse kaha: Kya tum wahi Musa ho jinhe Allah ne apni Rasool ke soorat mein chuna aur khud se baatchit ke liye chuna, aur (iske bawajood) tum mujhe ek aise maamle ke liye dosh dete ho jo mere paida hone se pehle hi muqarrar kiya ja chuka tha? Is tarah Aadam Musa par bhaari pade.

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ بْنُ النَّجَّارِ الْيَمَامِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ،
 عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ح
46.en: Abu Huraira narrated a hadith like this through another chain of transmitters.
46.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne isi jaisi ek hadees ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki.

46.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، عَنْ أَبِي،
 هُرَيْرَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏.‏
46.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters.
46.hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

46.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ الضَّرِيرُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ حَسَّانَ،
 عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَحْوَ حَدِيثِهِمْ
 ‏.‏
46.en: Abu Huraira reported a hadith like this through another chain of transmitters.
46.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne isi jaisi ek hadees ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat ki.

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَرْحٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ،
 وَهْبٍ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو هَانِئٍ الْخَوْلاَنِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحُبُلِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو،
 بْنِ الْعَاصِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏
"‏ كَتَبَ اللَّهُ مَقَادِيرَ الْخَلاَئِقِ
 قَبْلَ أَنْ يَخْلُقَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ بِخَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ - قَالَ - وَعَرْشُهُ عَلَى الْمَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
46.en: Abdullah b. 'Amr b. al-'As reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah ordained the measures (of quality) of the creation fifty thousand years before He created the heavens and the earth, as His Throne was upon water.
46.hi: Abdullah bin Amr bin al-As (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Allah ne makhlooqaat ke naap-tol (ke tareeke) aasmaan aur zameen banaane se pachaas hazaar saal pehle hi tay kar diye the, jab Uska Arsh paani par tha.

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُقْرِئُ، حَدَّثَنَا حَيْوَةُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَهْلٍ التَّمِيمِيُّ،
 حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا نَافِعٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ يَزِيدَ - كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ أَبِي هَانِئٍ، ‏.‏ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ
 مِثْلَهُ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُمَا لَمْ يَذْكُرَا وَعَرْشُهُ عَلَى الْمَاءِ ‏.‏
46.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Hani with the same chain of transmitters, but there is no mention of" His Throne was upon water."
46.hi: Ye hadees Abu Hani ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin ismein iska koi zikr nahi hai: "Uska Arsh paani par tha."

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الْمُقْرِئِ، قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ،
 اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْمُقْرِئُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَيْوَةُ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو هَانِئٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحُبُلِيَّ،
 أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ، يَقُولُ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 يَقُولُ ‏"‏ إِنَّ قُلُوبَ بَنِي آدَمَ كُلَّهَا بَيْنَ إِصْبَعَيْنِ مِنْ أَصَابِعِ الرَّحْمَنِ كَقَلْبٍ وَاحِدٍ يُصَرِّفُهُ حَيْثُ
 يَشَاءُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ مُصَرِّفَ الْقُلُوبِ صَرِّفْ قُلُوبَنَا
 عَلَى طَاعَتِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
46.en: Abdullah b. Amr b. al-'As reported that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Verily, the hearts of all the sons of Adam are between the two fingers out of the fingers of the Compassionate Lord as one heart. He turns that to any (direction) He likes. Then Allahs Messenger (ﷺ) said: 0 Allah, the Turner of the hearts, turn our hearts to Thine obedience.
46.hi: Abdullah bin Amr bin al-As (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Yaqeenan, Aadam ki sab aulaad ke dil Rehmvaan ki do ungliyon ke beech ek dil jaise hain. Woh use jis taraf chaahte hain moD dete hain. Phir Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Aye Allah, dilon ko Modne waale, humaare dilon ko Apni itaat ki taraf moD de.

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ،
 بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مَالِكٍ، فِيمَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِ عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ،
 أَنَّهُ قَالَ أَدْرَكْتُ نَاسًا مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُونَ كُلُّ شَىْءٍ بِقَدَرٍ
 ‏.‏ قَالَ وَسَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ كُلُّ شَىْءٍ
 بِقَدَرٍ حَتَّى الْعَجْزُ وَالْكَيْسُ أَوِ الْكَيْسُ وَالْعَجْزُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
46.en: Tawus reported: I found some Companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Everything is by measure. And he further said: I heard Abdullah b. 'Umar as saying: There is a neasure for everything-even for incapacity and-capability.
46.hi: Tawus ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke kuch Sahaba ko ye kehte paaya: Har cheez ek naap ke mutabik hai. Aur unhone aage kaha: Maine Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ko ye kehte suna: Har cheez ke liye ek naap hai - yahan tak ki bebasi aur salahiyat ke liye bhi.

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ زِيَادِ،
 بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبَّادِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ الْمَخْزُومِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ جَاءَ مُشْرِكُو
 قُرَيْشٍ يُخَاصِمُونَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْقَدَرِ فَنَزَلَتْ ‏{‏ يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِي
 النَّارِ عَلَى وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا مَسَّ سَقَرَ* إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَاهُ بِقَدَرٍ‏}‏
46.en: Abu Huraira reported that the polytheists of the Quraish came to have an argument with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in regard to Destiny and then this verse was revealed: " On the day when they are dragged into the Fire upon their faces, taste the touch of Fire. Surely, We have created everything according to a measure" (liv. 48).
46.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Quraish ke mushrikeen Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas Taqdeer ke baare mein bahas karne aaye aur isi mauke par ye aayat nazil hui: "Us din jab unhe unke chehron ke bal Jahannam ki aag mein ghaseeta jaayega, (unse kaha jaayega:) Aag ke chhune ka maza chakho. Yaqeenan, Humne har cheez ko ek andaaze ke mutabik banaaya hai" (54:48).

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لإِسْحَاقَ - قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا 
 عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ مَا رَأَيْتُ شَيْئًا
 أَشْبَهَ بِاللَّمَمِ مِمَّا قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَتَبَ عَلَى
 ابْنِ آدَمَ حَظَّهُ مِنَ الزِّنَى أَدْرَكَ ذَلِكَ لاَ مَحَالَةَ فَزِنَى الْعَيْنَيْنِ النَّظَرُ وَزِنَى اللِّسَانِ النُّطْقُ وَالنَّفْسُ
 تَمَنَّى وَتَشْتَهِي وَالْفَرْجُ يُصَدِّقُ ذَلِكَ أَوْ يُكَذِّبُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدٌ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ
 سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ ‏.‏
46.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Verily Allah has fixed the very portion of adultery which a man will indulge in, and which he of necessity must commit. The adultery of the eye is the lustful look, and the adultery of the tongue is the licentious speech, the heart desires and yearns, which the parts may or may not put into effect.
46.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Yaqeenan Allah ne insaan ke liye zina ka woh hissa muqarrar kiya hai jismein woh mubtala hoga aur jise woh zaroor karega. Aankh ka zina hey nazar dekhna hai, aur zubaan ka zina badchalni bhari baat karna hai; dil chaahta hai aur tarasta hai, jise ang haqiqat mein poora karein ya na karein.

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو هِشَامٍ الْمَخْزُومِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا 
 سُهَيْلُ بْنُ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏
 كُتِبَ عَلَى ابْنِ آدَمَ نَصِيبُهُ مِنَ الزِّنَى مُدْرِكٌ ذَلِكَ لاَ مَحَالَةَ فَالْعَيْنَانِ زِنَاهُمَا النَّظَرُ وَالأُذُنَانِ
 زِنَاهُمَا الاِسْتِمَاعُ وَاللِّسَانُ زِنَاهُ الْكَلاَمُ وَالْيَدُ زِنَاهَا الْبَطْشُ وَالرِّجْلُ زِنَاهَا الْخُطَا وَالْقَلْبُ
 يَهْوَى وَيَتَمَنَّى وَيُصَدِّقُ ذَلِكَ الْفَرْجُ وَيُكَذِّبُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
46.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying. Allah fixed the very portion of adultery which a man will indulge in. There would be no escape from it. The adultery of the eye is the lustful look and the adultery of the ears is listening to voluptuous (song or talk) and the adultery of the tongue is licentious speech and the adultery of the hand is the lustful grip (embrace) and the adultery of the feet is to walk (to the place) where he intends to commit adultery and the heart yearns and desires which he may or may not put into effect.
46.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Allah ne insaan ke liye zina ka woh hissa muqarrar kiya hai jismein woh mubtala hoga. Ismein koi bachaav nahi hai. Aankh ka zina hey nazar dekhna hai, aur kaanon ka zina badchalni bhari (geet ya baat) sunna hai, aur zubaan ka zina badchalni bhari baat karna hai, aur haath ka zina hey iraade se pakDna (aalingan) hai aur paon ka zina us jagah chalna hai jahan woh zina karne ka iraada rakhta hai, aur dil tarasta hai aur chaahta hai, jise woh (ang) poora kare ya na kare.

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا حَاجِبُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، عَنِ الزُّبَيْدِيِّ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَخْبَرَنِي 
 سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 ‏"‏ مَا مِنْ مَوْلُودٍ إِلاَّ يُولَدُ عَلَى الْفِطْرَةِ فَأَبَوَاهُ يُهَوِّدَانِهِ وَيُنَصِّرَانِهِ وَيُمَجِّسَانِهِ كَمَا تُنْتَجُ الْبَهِيمَةُ
 بَهِيمَةً جَمْعَاءَ هَلْ تُحِسُّونَ فِيهَا مِنْ جَدْعَاءَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ وَاقْرَءُوا إِنْ شِئْتُمْ
 ‏{‏ فِطْرَةَ اللَّهِ الَّتِي فَطَرَ النَّاسَ عَلَيْهَا لاَ تَبْدِيلَ لِخَلْقِ اللَّهِ‏}‏ الآيَةَ ‏.‏
46.en: There is none born but is created to his true nature (Islam). It is his parents who make him a Jew or a Christian or a Magian quite as beasts produce their young with their limbs perfect. Do you see anything deficient in them? Then he quoted the Qur'an., The nature made by Allah in which He has created men there is no altering of Allah's creation; that is the right religion" (ar-Rum:30)
46.hi: Koi bhi bachcha paida nahi hota lekin woh apni asli fitrat (Islam) ke saath paida hota hai. Ye uske maa-baap hain jo use Yahudi, Isaayi ya Majoosi banaate hain, bilkul jaisa jaanwar apne bachchon ko mukammal angon ke saath paida karte hain. Kya tumhe unmein koi kami dikhti hai? Phir unhone Quran padha: "Wo fitrat jo Allah ne banaayi, jismein Usne insaanon ko paida kiya; Allah ki banaayi hui fitrat mein koi badlaav nahi hai; yehi seedha deen hai" (Ar-Rum: 30).

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا 
 عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ ‏
"‏ كَمَا تُنْتَجُ الْبَهِيمَةُ بَهِيمَةً
 ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ جَمْعَاءَ ‏.‏
46.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters and there is no mention of his deficiency in limbs.
46.hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai aur ismein unke angon ki kami ka koi zikr nahi hai.

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ عِيسَى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ،
 يَزِيِدَ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا سَلَمَةَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا مِنْ مَوْلُودٍ إِلاَّ يُولَدُ عَلَى الْفِطْرَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ اقْرَءُوا ‏{‏ فِطْرَةَ
 اللَّهِ الَّتِي فَطَرَ النَّاسَ عَلَيْهَا لاَ تَبْدِيلَ لِخَلْقِ اللَّهِ ذَلِكَ الدِّينُ الْقَيِّمُ‏}‏
46.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: No child is born but upon Fitra. He then said. Recite: The nature made by Allah in which He created man, there is no altering of Allah's nature; that is the right religion."
46.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Koi bachcha paida nahi hota lekin Fitrat par. Phir unhone farmaaya: Padho: "Wo fitrat jo Allah ne banaayi, jismein Usne insaan ko paida kiya, Allah ki fitrat mein koi badlaav nahi hai; yehi seedha deen hai."

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ،
 قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا مِنْ مَوْلُودٍ إِلاَّ يُلِدَ عَلَى الْفِطْرَةِ فَأَبَوَاهُ يُهَوِّدَانِهِ
 وَيُنَصِّرَانِهِ وَيُشَرِّكَانِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَرَأَيْتَ لَوْ مَاتَ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُ
 أَعْلَمُ بِمَا كَانُوا عَامِلِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
46.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: No babe is born but upon Fitra. It is his parents who make him a Jew or a Christian or a Polytheist. A person said: Allah's Messenger, what is your opinion if they were to die before that (before reaching the age of adolescence when they can distinguish between right and wrong)? He said: It is Allah alone Who knows what they would be doing.
46.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Koi bachcha paida nahi hota lekin Fitrat par. Ye uske maa-baap hain jo use Yahudi, Isaayi ya Mushrik banaate hain. Ek shakhs ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, iske baare mein aapki kya raay hai agar woh (bachche) uske (baalig hone se, jab woh sahi aur galat mein farq kar sakte hain) pehle mar jaayein? Unhone farmaaya: Sirf Allah hi jaanta hai ki woh kya karte.

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ،
 نُمَيْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي كِلاَهُمَا، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ فِي حَدِيثِ ابْنِ نُمَيْرٍ ‏"‏ مَا مِنْ مَوْلُودٍ
 يُولَدُ إِلاَّ وَهُوَ عَلَى الْمِلَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ ‏"‏ إِلاَّ عَلَى هَذِهِ الْمِلَّةِ
 حَتَّى يُبَيِّنَ عَنْهُ لِسَانُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ أَبِي كُرَيْبٍ عَنْ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ ‏"‏ لَيْسَ مِنْ مَوْلُودٍ يُولَدُ
 إِلاَّ عَلَى هَذِهِ الْفِطْرَةِ حَتَّى يُعَبِّرَ عَنْهُ لِسَانُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
46.en:
It is reported on the authority of Abu Mu'awiya that (the Holy Prophet) said: Every new-born babe is born on the millat (of Islam and he) remains on this until his tongue is enabled to express himself. 
This hadith has been narratted on the authority of Abu Mu'awiya through another chain of transmitters (and the words are):" Every child is born but on this Fitra so long as he does not express himself with his tongue."
46.hi: Abu Mu'awiya ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai ki unhone (Pavitr Nabi ne) farmaaya: Har naya paida hua bachcha Islam ki (asli) millat par paida hota hai (aur woh) isi par rehta hai jab tak uski zubaan khud ko zaahir karne ke laayak nahi ho jaati. Ye hadees Abu Mu'awiya ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai (aur alfaaz hain): Har bachcha Fitrat par paida hota hai jab tak woh apni zubaan se khud ko zaahir nahi karta.

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، قَالَ
 هَذَا مَا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ أَحَادِيثَ مِنْهَا وَقَالَ
 رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ يُولَدُ يُولَدُ عَلَى هَذِهِ الْفِطْرَةِ فَأَبَوَاهُ يُهَوِّدَانِهِ وَيُنَصِّرَانِهِ
 كَمَا تَنْتِجُونَ الإِبِلَ فَهَلْ تَجِدُونَ فِيهَا جَدْعَاءَ حَتَّى تَكُونُوا أَنْتُمْ تَجْدَعُونَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا يَا
 رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَفَرَأَيْتَ مَنْ يَمُوتُ صَغِيرًا قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا كَانُوا عَامِلِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
46.en: Abu Huraira reported from Allah's Messenger (may peace be upom him) many ahadith and one amongst them is that he is reported to have said: An infant is born according to his (true) nature. It is his parents Who make him a Jew, a Christian, just as a she-camel gives birth to its young ones. Do you find any deficiency in their limbs? You cut their ears (i. e. after birth). They (the Companions of the Holy Prophet) said: What is your opinion about him who dies in infancy? Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: It is Allah alone Who knows best what they would be doing.
46.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se bahut si hadeesein riwayat kin, aur unmein se ek ye thi ki unhone farmaaya: Ek bachcha apni (asli) fitrat ke mutabik paida hota hai. Ye uske maa-baap hain jo use Yahudi, Isaayi banaate hain, jaise ek oontni apne bachchon ko paida karti hai. Kya tumhe unke angon mein koi kami dikhti hai? Tum unke kaan (paidaish ke baad) kaTte ho. Unhone (Sahaba ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, iske baare mein aapki kya raay hai jo bachpan mein hi mar jaata hai? Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Sirf Allah hi behtar jaanta hai ki woh kya karte.

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - يَعْنِي الدَّرَاوَرْدِيَّ - عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ 
 أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ كُلُّ إِنْسَانٍ تَلِدُهُ أُمُّهُ عَلَى
 الْفِطْرَةِ وَأَبَوَاهُ بَعْدُ يُهَوِّدَانِهِ وَيُنَصِّرَانِهِ وَيُمَجِّسَانِهِ فَإِنْ كَانَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ فَمُسْلِمٌ كُلُّ إِنْسَانٍ
 تَلِدُهُ أُمُّهُ يَلْكُزُهُ الشَّيْطَانُ فِي حِضْنَيْهِ إِلاَّ مَرْيَمَ وَابْنَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
46.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The mother of every person gives him birth according to his true nature. It is subsequently his parents who make him a Jew or a Christian or a Magian. Had his parents been Muslim he would have also remained a Muslim. Every person to whom his mother gives birth (has two aspects of his life) ; when his mother gives birth Satan strikes him but it was not the case with Mary and her son (Jesus Christ).
46.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Har shakhs ki maa use uski asli fitrat ke mutabik paida karti hai. Baad mein uske maa-baap hi use Yahudi, Isaayi ya Majoosi banaate hain. Agar uske maa-baap Musalman hote, to woh bhi Musalman hi rehta. Har shakhs jise uski maa paida karti hai (uski zindagi ke do pehlu hain); jab uski maa use paida karti hai, Shaitaan use chhuta hai, lekin Mary aur unke bete (Isa) ke saath aisa nahi hua tha.

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، وَيُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ،
 شِهَابٍ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سُئِلَ عَنْ
 أَوْلاَدِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا كَانُوا عَامِلِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
46.en: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked about the children of the polytheists, whereupon he said: It is Allah Who knows best what they would be doing.
46.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se mushrikeen ke bachchon ke baare mein poocha gaya, isper unhone farmaaya: Sirf Allah hi behtar jaanta hai ki woh kya karte.

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ،
 عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ بَهْرَامَ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا سَلَمَةُ بْنُ شَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا 
 الْحَسَنُ بْنُ أَعْيَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْقِلٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ - كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِإِسْنَادِ يُونُسَ
 وَابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ ‏.‏ مِثْلَ حَدِيثِهِمَا غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي، حَدِيثِ شُعَيْبٍ وَمَعْقِلٍ سُئِلَ عَنْ ذَرَارِيِّ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
 ‏.‏
46.en: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Shu'aib and Ma'qil with a slight variation of wording.
46.hi: Ye hadees Shu'aib aur Ma'qil ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ،
 قَالَ سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ أَطْفَالِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ مَنْ يَمُوتُ مِنْهُمْ صَغِيرًا
 فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا كَانُوا عَامِلِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
46.en: Abu Huraira reported that Allahs Messenger (way peace be upon him) was asked about the children of the polytheists who die young. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: It is Allah Who knows what they would be doing.
46.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se mushrikeen ke un bachchon ke baare mein poocha gaya jo choti umar mein mar jaate hain. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Sirf Allah hi jaanta hai ki woh kya karte.

46.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ،
 عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ أَطْفَالِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ قَالَ
 ‏
"‏ اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا كَانُوا عَامِلِينَ إِذْ خَلَقَهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
46.en: Ibn Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked about the children of the polytheists, whereupon he said: It is Allah alone Who knows what they would be doing according to their creation.
46.hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se mushrikeen ke bachchon ke baare mein poocha gaya, isper unhone farmaaya: Sirf Allah hi jaanta hai ki woh apni khilqat ke mutabik kya karte.

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ رَقَبَةَ،
 بْنِ مَسْقَلَةَ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنْ أُبَىِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ، قَالَ
 قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ إِنَّ الْغُلاَمَ الَّذِي قَتَلَهُ الْخَضِرُ طُبِعَ كَافِرًا وَلَوْ عَاشَ
 لأَرْهَقَ أَبَوَيْهِ طُغْيَانًا وَكُفْرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
46.en: Ubayy b. Ka'b reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The young man whom Khadir killed was a non-believer by his very nature and had he survived he would have involved his parents in defiance and unbelief.
46.hi: Ubayy bin Ka'b (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jis jawaan larke ko Khadir ne qatal kiya woh apni fitrat mein hi ek gair-imaandaar tha, aur agar woh zinda rehta, to woh apne maa-baap ko naafarmani aur kufr mein daal deta.

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ فُضَيْلِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو،
 عَنْ عَائِشَةَ بِنْتِ طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، قَالَتْ تُوُفِّيَ صَبِيٌّ فَقُلْتُ طُوبَى لَهُ عُصْفُورٌ
 مِنْ عَصَافِيرِ الْجَنَّةِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ أَوَلاَ تَدْرِينَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ خَلَقَ الْجَنَّةَ
 وَخَلَقَ النَّارَ فَخَلَقَ لِهَذِهِ أَهْلاً وَلِهَذِهِ أَهْلاً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
46.en: 'A'isha, the mother of the believers, reported that a child died and I said: There is happiness for this child who is a bird from amongst the birds of Paradise. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Don't you know that Allah created the Paradise and He created the Hell and He created the dwellers for this (Paradise) and the denizens for this (Hell)?
46.hi: Aisha (RA), Imaandaaron ki Maa, ne bayan kiya ki ek bachche ka intiqaal ho gaya aur maine kaha: Is bachche ke liye khushi hai jo Jannat ke parindon mein se ek hai. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Kya tumhe nahi pata ki Allah ne Jannat banaayi aur Usne Jahannam banaayi aur Usne is (Jannat) ke liye bashinde banaaye aur is (Jahannam) ke liye bhi bashinde banaaye?

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ يَحْيَى، عَنْ عَمَّتِهِ، عَائِشَةَ
 بِنْتِ طَلْحَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، قَالَتْ دُعِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى جَنَازَةِ
 صَبِيٍّ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ طُوبَى لِهَذَا عُصْفُورٌ مِنْ عَصَافِيرِ الْجَنَّةِ لَمْ يَعْمَلِ
 السُّوءَ وَلَمْ يُدْرِكْهُ قَالَ ‏
"‏ أَوَغَيْرَ ذَلِكَ يَا عَائِشَةُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ خَلَقَ لِلْجَنَّةِ أَهْلاً خَلَقَهُمْ لَهَا وَهُمْ
 فِي أَصْلاَبِ آبَائِهِمْ وَخَلَقَ لِلنَّارِ أَهْلاً خَلَقَهُمْ لَهَا وَهُمْ فِي أَصْلاَبِ آبَائِهِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
46.en: 'A'isha, the mother of the believers, said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was called to lead the funeral prayer of a child of the Ansar. I said: Allah's Messenger, there is happiness for this child who is a bird from the birds of Paradise for it committed no sin nor has he reached the age when one can commit sin. He said: 'A'isha, per adventure, it may be otherwise, because God created for Paradise those who are fit for it while they were yet in their father's loins and created for Hell those who are to go to Hell. He created them for Hell while they were yet in their father's loins.
46.hi: Aisha (RA), Imaandaaron ki Maa, ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko Ansar ke ek bachche ki janaaza namaz ki agrasi karne ke liye bulaaya gaya. Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, is bachche ke liye khushi hai jo Jannat ke parindon mein se ek hai kyunki usne koi gunah nahi kiya na hi woh us umar tak pahuncha jahan koi gunah kar sake. Unhone farmaaya: Aisha, shaayad aisa na ho, kyunki Allah ne Jannat ke liye un logon ko banaaya jo iske laayak hain jab woh abhi apne waalid ke sulb (nutfe) mein the, aur Jahannam ke liye unhe banaaya jo Jahannam mein jaayenge. Unhe Jahannam ke liye tab banaaya jab woh abhi apne waalid ke sulb mein the.

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ زَكَرِيَّاءَ، عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ يَحْيَى، ح
 وَحَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ مَعْبَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا 
 مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ سُفْيَانَ الثَّوْرِيِّ، عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ يَحْيَى، بِإِسْنَادِ وَكِيعٍ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِهِ
 ‏.‏
46.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Yahya with the same chain of transmitters.
46.hi: Ye hadees Yahya ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

46.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي بَكْرٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ،
 عَنْ مِسْعَرٍ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ مَرْثَدٍ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْيَشْكُرِيِّ، عَنِ الْمَعْرُورِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ،
 عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَتْ أُمُّ حَبِيبَةَ زَوْجُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ أَمْتِعْنِي بِزَوْجِي
 رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَبِأَبِي أَبِي سُفْيَانَ وَبِأَخِي مُعَاوِيَةَ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ قَدْ سَأَلْتِ اللَّهَ لآجَالٍ مَضْرُوبَةٍ وَأَيَّامٍ مَعْدُودَةٍ وَأَرْزَاقٍ مَقْسُومَةٍ لَنْ
 يُعَجِّلَ شَيْئًا قَبْلَ حِلِّهِ أَوْ يُؤَخِّرَ شَيْئًا عَنْ حِلِّهِ وَلَوْ كُنْتِ سَأَلْتِ اللَّهَ أَنْ يُعِيذَكِ مِنْ عَذَابٍ
