حَدَّثَنِي حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ،
 حَدَّثَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ يَعْمُرَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَقُولُ ‏
"‏ اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ وَعَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْتُ وَبِكَ
 خَاصَمْتُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِعِزَّتِكَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ أَنْ تُضِلَّنِي أَنْتَ الْحَىُّ الَّذِي لاَ يَمُوتُ وَالْجِنُّ
 وَالإِنْسُ يَمُوتُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
48.en: Ibn 'Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to say: " O Allah, it is unto Thee that I surrender myself. I affirm my faith in Thee and repose my trust in Thee and turn to Thee in repentance and with Thy help fought my adversaries. O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee with Thine Power; there is no god but Thou, lest Thou leadest me astray. Thou art ever-living that dieth not, while the Jinn and mankind die."
48.hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) kaha karte the: "Aye Allah, main khud ko Tere hawaale karta hoon. Main Tujhpar imaan rakhta hoon aur Tujhpar bharosa karta hoon aur Teri taraf tauba karta hoon aur Teri madad se apne dushmanon se larai ki. Aye Allah, main Teri Taakat ki panah maangta hoon; Tere siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai, kahin Tu mujhe gumraah na kar de. Tu hamesha zinda hai aur kabhi nahi marega, jabki jinn aur insaan marte hain."

48.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، عَنْ سُهَيْلِ،
 بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا كَانَ فِي
 سَفَرٍ وَأَسْحَرَ يَقُولُ ‏
"‏ سَمَّعَ سَامِعٌ بِحَمْدِ اللَّهِ وَحُسْنِ بَلاَئِهِ عَلَيْنَا رَبَّنَا صَاحِبْنَا وَأَفْضِلْ
 عَلَيْنَا عَائِذًا بِاللَّهِ مِنَ النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
48.en: Abu Huraira reported that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) set out on a journey in the morning, he used to say: " A listener listened to our praising Allah (for) His goodly trial of us. Our Lord! acompany us, guard us and bestow upon us Thy grace. I am seeker of refuge in Allah from the Fire."
48.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) subah kisi safar par nikalte, woh kehte: "Ek sunne wale ne humaari Allah ki hamd suni Uski humaari behtareen azmaayish ke liye. Humaare Rab, humaare saath rah, humaari hifaazat kar aur humpar Apna fazl ata kar. Main Allah se Jahannam ki aag se panah maangta hoon."

48.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ،
 عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ بْنِ أَبِي مُوسَى الأَشْعَرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ كَانَ
 يَدْعُو بِهَذَا الدُّعَاءِ ‏
"‏ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي خَطِيئَتِي وَجَهْلِي وَإِسْرَافِي فِي أَمْرِي وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ
 بِهِ مِنِّي اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي جِدِّي وَهَزْلِي وَخَطَئِي وَعَمْدِي وَكُلُّ ذَلِكَ عِنْدِي اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي مَا
 قَدَّمْتُ وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي أَنْتَ الْمُقَدِّمُ وَأَنْتَ الْمُؤَخِّرُ
 وَأَنْتَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
48.en: Abu Musa Ash'ari reported on the authority of his father that Allahs Apostle (ﷺ) used to supplicate in these words: " O Allah, forgive me my faults, my ignorance, my immoderation in my concerns. And Thou art better aware (of my affairs) than myself. O Allah, grant me forgiveness (of the faults which I committed) seriously or otherwise (and which I committed inadvertently and de- liberately. All these (failings) are in me. O Allah, grant me forgiveness from the fault which I did in haste or deferred, which I committed in privacy or in public and Thou art better aware of (them) than myself. Thou art the First and the Last and over all things Thou art Omnipotent."
48.hi: Abu Musa Ash'ari (RA) ne apne waalid ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) in alfaazon mein dua maanga karte the: "Aye Allah, mujhe meri khaamiyaan, meri anjaanpan aur apne maamlon mein meri ziyaadatiyaan maaf kar. Aur Tu mujhse zyada (mere maamlon ke baare mein) jaanta hai. Aye Allah, mujhe (un galtiyon ki) maafi de jo maine jaan-boojh kar ya bina soche-samjhe kiin (aur jo maine anjaane mein aur jaan-boojh kar kiin). Ye sab (khaamiyaan) mujhme hain. Aye Allah, mujhe us galti ki maafi de jo maine jaldbaazi mein ki ya der se ki, jo maine chhupkar ki ya khule taur par ki, aur Tu mujhse zyada (unke baare mein) jaanta hai. Tu Awwal hai aur Aakhir hai aur har cheez par Tu Qaadir hai."

48.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ الْمِسْمَعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ،
 فِي هَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
48.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters.
48.hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

48.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ دِينَارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو قَطَنٍ، عَمْرُو بْنُ الْهَيْثَمِ الْقُطَعِيُّ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ،
 بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ الْمَاجِشُونِ عَنْ قُدَامَةَ بْنِ مُوسَى، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ السَّمَّانِ، عَنْ 
 أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏
"‏ اللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ لِي دِينِيَ الَّذِي
 هُوَ عِصْمَةُ أَمْرِي وَأَصْلِحْ لِي دُنْيَاىَ الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَاشِي وَأَصْلِحْ لِي آخِرَتِي الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَادِي
 وَاجْعَلِ الْحَيَاةَ زِيَادَةً لِي فِي كُلِّ خَيْرٍ وَاجْعَلِ الْمَوْتَ رَاحَةً لِي مِنْ كُلِّ شَرٍّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
48.en: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to supplicate (in these words): " O Allah, set right for me my religion which is the safeguard of my affairs. And set right for me the affairs of my world wherein is my living. And set right for me my Hereafter on which depends my after-life. And make the life for me (a source) of abundance for every good and make my death a source of comfort for me protecting me against every evil."
48.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ye dua maanga karte the: "Aye Allah, mere liye mera deen theek kar jo mere maamlon ki hifaazat hai. Aur mere liye meri duniya ke maamle theek kar jismein meri guzar-baseer hai. Aur mere liye meri Aakhirat theek kar jispar meri baad ki zindagi ka daaromadaar hai. Aur meri zindagi ko har achhaai ke liye izafe (ka srot) bana, aur meri maut ko mere liye sukoon ka srot bana, jo mujhe har burai se bachaaye."

48.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ،
 عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ أَبِي الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ كَانَ
 يَقُولُ ‏
"‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُّقَى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏
48.en: Abdullah reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to supplicate (in these words): " O Allah. I beg of Thee the right guidance, safeguard against evils, chastity and freedom from want."
48.hi: Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ye dua maanga karte the: "Aye Allah, main Tujhse sahi margdarshan, buraiyon se hifaazat, paakizgi aur zaroorat se mukti maangta hoon."

48.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي،
 إِسْحَاقَ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ غَيْرَ أَنَّ ابْنَ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالَ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ ‏
"‏ وَالْعِفَّةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
48.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Ishaq with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording.
48.hi: Ye hadees Abu Ishaq ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

48.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ،
 - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ نُمَيْرٍ - قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآَخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ،
 عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، وَعَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيِّ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَرْقَمَ، قَالَ لاَ أَقُولُ لَكُمْ إِلاَّ
 كَمَا كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ كَانَ يَقُولُ ‏
"‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ
 وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْهَرَمِ وَعَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ اللَّهُمَّ آتِ نَفْسِي تَقْوَاهَا وَزَكِّهَا أَنْتَ خَيْرُ مَنْ
 زَكَّاهَا أَنْتَ وَلِيُّهَا وَمَوْلاَهَا اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ لاَ يَنْفَعُ وَمِنْ قَلْبٍ لاَ يَخْشَعُ وَمِنْ
 نَفْسٍ لاَ تَشْبَعُ وَمِنْ دَعْوَةٍ لاَ يُسْتَجَابُ لَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
48.en: Zaid b. Alqam reported: I am not going to say anything but only that which Allah's Messenger (may peace be upgn him) used to say. He used to supplicate:" O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from incapacity, from sloth, from cowardice, from miserliness, decrepitude and from torment of the grave. O Allah, grant to my soul the sense of righteousness and purify it, for Thou art the Best Purifier thereof. Thou art the Protecting Friend thereof, and Guardian thereof. O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from the knowledge which does not benefit, from the heart that does not entertain the fear (of Allah), from the soul that does not feel contented and the supplication that is not responded."
48.hi: Zaid bin Alqam (RA) ne bayan kiya: Main sirf woh kahunga jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) kaha karte the. Woh ye dua maangte: "Aye Allah, main Teri panah maangta hoon lachaari se, susti se, buzdili se, kanjoosi se, budhape se aur qabar ke azaab se. Aye Allah, mere nafs ko taqwa ata kar aur ise paak kar, kyunki Tu ise paak karne wala Behtareen hai. Tu iska Sarparast aur Nigehbaan hai. Aye Allah, main Teri panah maangta hoon us ilm se jo faayda-mand nahi hai, us dil se jo (Allah ka) Dar mehsoos nahi karta, us nafs se jo santusht nahi hota, aur us dua se jiska koi jawaab nahi milta."

48.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا 
 إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سُوَيْدٍ النَّخَعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ كَانَ
 رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَمْسَى قَالَ ‏"‏ أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
 لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ الْحَسَنُ فَحَدَّثَنِي الزُّبَيْدُ أَنَّهُ حَفِظَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
 فِي هَذَا ‏"‏ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ اللَّهُمَّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَأَعُوذُ
 بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ اللَّهُمَّ
 إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
48.en: Abdullah b. Mas'ud reported that when it was evening Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to supplicate: " We entered upon evening and the whole Kingdom of Allah also entered upon evening and praise is due to Allah. There is no god but Allah, the One Who has no partner with Him." Hasan said that Zubaid reported to him that he memorised it from Ibrahim in these very words." His is the Sovereignty and Praise is due to Him, and He is Potent over everything. O Allah, I beg of Thee the good of this night and I seek refuge in Thee from the evil of this night and the evil which follows it. O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from sloth, from the evil of vanity. O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from torment in the Hell-Fire and from torment in the grave."
48.hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab shaam hoti, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ye dua maangte: "Humne shaam mein daakhil ho gaye aur Allah ki saari Baadshahat bhi shaam mein daakhil ho gayi, aur hamd Allah ke liye hai. Allah ke siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai, Woh Akela hai Jiska koi saathi nahi hai." Hasan ne kaha ki Zubaid ne unhe bataya ki unhone ise Ibrahim se in hi alfaazon mein yaad kiya tha: "Baadshahat Usi ki hai aur hamd Usi ke liye hai, aur Woh har cheez par Qaadir hai. Aye Allah, main Tujhse is raat ki bhalai maangta hoon aur main Teri panah maangta hoon is raat ki burai se aur uski burai se jo iske baad aati hai. Aye Allah, main Teri panah maangta hoon susti se, ghamand ki burai se. Aye Allah, main Teri panah maangta hoon Jahannam ki aag ke azaab se aur qabar ke azaab se."

48.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
 بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كَانَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 إِذَا أَمْسَى قَالَ ‏"‏ أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ
 ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أُرَاهُ قَالَ فِيهِنَّ ‏"‏ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ
 مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهَا وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا
 رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
 ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا أَصْبَحَ قَالَ ذَلِكَ أَيْضًا ‏"‏ أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
48.en: Abdullah reported that when it was evening Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to supplicate: " We have entered upon evening and so, too, the whole Kingdom of Allah has entered upon evening. Praise is due to Allah. There is no god but Allah, the One having no partner with Him." He (the narrator) said: I think that he also uttered (in this supplication these words):" His is tne Sovercignty and to Him is praise due and He is Potent over everything. My Lord, I beg of Thee good that lies in this night and good that follows it and I seek refuge in Thee from the evil that lies in this night and from the evil of that which follows it. My Lord, I seek refuge in Thee from sloth, from the evil of vanity. My Lord, I seek refuge in Thee from torment of the Hell-Fire and from torment of the grave." And when it was morning he said like this:" We entered upon morning and the whole Kingdom of Allah enter ed upon morning."
48.hi: Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab shaam hoti, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ye dua maangte: "Humne shaam mein daakhil ho gaye aur Allah ki saari Baadshahat bhi shaam mein daakhil ho gayi. Hamd Allah ke liye hai. Allah ke siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai, Woh Akela hai Jiska koi saathi nahi hai." Unhone (raawi ne) kaha: Mujhe lagta hai unhone ye bhi kaha (is dua mein): "Baadshahat Usi ki hai aur Usi ki hamd hai aur Woh har cheez par Qaadir hai. Mere Rab, main Tujhse is raat ki bhalai aur iske baad aane wali bhalai maangta hoon, aur main Teri panah maangta hoon is raat ki burai se aur uski burai se jo iske baad aati hai. Mere Rab, main Teri panah maangta hoon susti se, ghamand ki burai se. Mere Rab, main Teri panah maangta hoon Jahannam ki aag ke azaab se aur qabar ke azaab se." Aur jab subah hoti woh isi tarah kehte: "Humne subah mein daakhil ho gaye aur Allah ki saari Baadshahat bhi subah mein daakhil ho gayi."

48.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ زَائِدَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ،
 عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَمْسَى قَالَ ‏"‏ أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ
 اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَخَيْرِ مَا فِيهَا وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ
 مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَالْهَرَمِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ وَفِتْنَةِ الدُّنْيَا
 وَعَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ وَزَادَنِي فِيهِ زُبَيْدٌ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ عَنْ
 عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رَفَعَهُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ
 الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
48.en: Abdullah reported that when it was evening Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to supplicate: " We have entered upon evening and so has the Kingdom of Allah entere d upon evening; praise is due to Allah, there is no god but Allah the One, and there is no partner with Him. O Allah, I beg of Thee the blessing of this night and the blessing of that which lies in it. I seek refuge in Thee from the evil of it and what lies in it. O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from sloth, from decrepitude, from the evil of vanity, from trial of the world, and from torment of the grave." Zubaid, through another chain of transmitters, has narrated on the authority of Abdullah directly this addition:" There is no god but Allah, the One, there is no partner with Him, His is the Sovereignty and to Him is praise due and He is Potent over everything."
48.hi: Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab shaam hoti, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ye dua maangte: "Humne shaam mein daakhil ho gaye aur Allah ki Baadshahat bhi shaam mein daakhil ho gayi; hamd Allah ke liye hai, Allah ke siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai, Woh Akela hai, Uska koi saathi nahi hai. Aye Allah, main Tujhse is raat ki barkat aur ismein maujood barkat maangta hoon. Main iski burai se aur ismein maujood burai se Teri panah maangta hoon. Aye Allah, main Teri panah maangta hoon susti se, budhape se, ghamand ki burai se, duniya ki azmaayish se, aur qabar ke azaab se." Zubaid ne, ek doosri sanad ke zariye, seedhe Abdullah se ye izafa riwayat ki: "Allah ke siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai, Woh Akela hai, Uska koi saathi nahi hai, Baadshahat Usi ki hai aur hamd Usi ke liye hai, aur Woh har cheez par Qaadir hai."

48.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي،
 هُرَيْرَةَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَقُولُ ‏
"‏ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ أَعَزَّ جُنْدَهُ
 وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ وَغَلَبَ الأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ فَلاَ شَىْءَ بَعْدَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
48.en: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Huraira that Allah's Messenge; (ﷺ) used to supplicate thus: " There is no god but Allah, the One Who conferred upon His armies the honour of victory and helped His servant rout the clans; there is nothing after that."
48.hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ye dua maanga karte the: "Allah ke siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai, Woh Akela hai Jisne Apni fauj ko jeet ki izzat di aur Apne banda ki madad ki qabilon ko shikast dene mein; ismein baad kuch nahi hai."

48.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَاصِمَ بْنَ كُلَيْبٍ،
 عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي
 وَسَدِّدْنِي وَاذْكُرْ بِالْهُدَى هِدَايَتَكَ الطَّرِيقَ وَالسَّدَادِ سَدَادَ السَّهْمِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
48.en: 'Ali reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him: Say," O Allah, direct me to the right path and make me adhere to the straight path," and when you make a mention of right guidance, keep in mind the right path and when you consider of the straight (path), keep in mind the straightness of the arrow.
48.hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unse farmaaya: Kaho, "Aye Allah, mujhe sahi raah dikha aur mujhe seedhi raah par kaayam rakh," aur jab tum sahi margdarshan ka zikr karo, seedhe raaste ko dhyaan mein rakho aur jab tum seedhepan ke baare mein sochte ho, teer ki seedhaayi ko dhyaan mein rakho.

48.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ إِدْرِيسَ - أَخْبَرَنَا عَاصِمُ بْنُ كُلَيْبٍ،
 بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ قَالَ قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى
 وَالسَّدَادَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
48.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Asim b. Kulaib with the same chain of transmitters that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me: Say:" O Allah, I beg of Thee righteousness and adhering to the straight path."
48.hi: Ye hadees Asim bin Kulaib ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne mujhse farmaaya: Kaho: "Aye Allah, main Tujhse nekokaari aur seedhe raaste par chalne ki taufeek maangta hoon."

48.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَرَ
 - قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، مَوْلَى آلِ طَلْحَةَ عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ،
 عَنْ جُوَيْرِيَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَرَجَ مِنْ عِنْدِهَا بُكْرَةً حِينَ صَلَّى الصُّبْحَ وَهِيَ
 فِي مَسْجِدِهَا ثُمَّ رَجَعَ بَعْدَ أَنْ أَضْحَى وَهِيَ جَالِسَةٌ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا زِلْتِ عَلَى الْحَالِ الَّتِي فَارَقْتُكِ
 عَلَيْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَقَدْ قُلْتُ بَعْدَكِ أَرْبَعَ كَلِمَاتٍ ثَلاَثَ
 مَرَّاتٍ لَوْ وُزِنَتْ بِمَا قُلْتِ مُنْذُ الْيَوْمِ لَوَزَنَتْهُنَّ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ
 وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
48.en: Juwairiya reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came out from (her apartment) in the morning as she was busy in observing her dawn prayer in her place of worship. He came back in the forenoon and she was still sitting there. He (the Holy Prophet) said to her: You have been in the same seat since I left you. She said: Yes. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: I recited four words three times after I left you and if these are to be weighed against what you have recited since morning these would outweigh them and (these words) are:" Hallowed be Allah and praise is due to Him according to the number of His creation and according to the pleasure of His Self and according to the weight of His Throne and according to the ink (used in recording) words (for His Praise)."
48.hi: Juwairiya (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) (unke kamre se) subah bahar gaye jab woh apni ibadatgaah mein Fajr ki namaz mein masroof thin. Woh Chaasht (din chadhne) ke waqt wapas aaye aur woh abhi bhi wahin baithi thin. Unhone (Pavitr Nabi ne) unse kaha: Tum jab se maine tumhe chhoda hai isi jagah baithi ho. Unhone kaha: Haan. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Maine tumhe chhodne ke baad chaar alfaaz teen baar padhe aur agar inhe uske muqable rakha jaaye jo tumne subah se ab tak padha hai, ye unse zyada bhaari honge, aur (ye alfaaz hain): "Allah pavitra hai (Woh kamiyon se pak hai) aur Uski hamd hai Uski makhlooq ki tadaad ke mutabik aur Uski khud ki khushi ke mutabik aur Uske Arsh ke wazan ke mutabik aur Uski (hamd ke) alfaazon ko darj karne mein istemal hone wali roshnaai ke mutabik."

48.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ وَإِسْحَاقُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ بِشْرٍ، عَنْ مِسْعَرٍ،
 عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي رِشْدِينَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنْ جُوَيْرِيَةَ، قَالَتْ مَرَّ بِهَا
 رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ صَلَّى صَلاَةَ الْغَدَاةِ أَوْ بَعْدَ مَا صَلَّى الْغَدَاةَ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ
 نَحْوَهُ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏
"‏ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ رِضَا نَفْسِهِ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ زِنَةَ
 عَرْشِهِ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ مِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
48.en: Juwairiya reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) happened to pass by her as she was observing her dawn prayer; or after she had observed her dawn prayer. The rest of the hadith is the same but with this variation that he said: " Hallowed be Allah according to the number of His creation, hallowed be Allah according to the pleasure of His Self, hallowed be Allah according to the weight of His Throne, hallowed be Allah according to the ink used in recording His words."
48.hi: Juwairiya (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unke paas se guzre jab woh Fajr ki namaz mein masroof thin; ya unki Fajr ki namaz padhne ke baad. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai lekin is antar ke saath ki unhone farmaaya: "Allah pavitra hai Uski makhlooq ki tadaad ke mutabik, Allah pavitra hai Uski khud ki khushi ke mutabik, Allah pavitra hai Uske Arsh ke wazan ke mutabik, Allah pavitra hai Uske alfaazon ko darj karne mein istemal hone wali roshnaai ke mutabik."

48.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا 
 مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ أَبِي لَيْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيٌّ، أَنَّ فَاطِمَةَ،
 اشْتَكَتْ مَا تَلْقَى مِنَ الرَّحَى فِي يَدِهَا وَأَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَبْىٌ فَانْطَلَقَتْ فَلَمْ
 تَجِدْهُ وَلَقِيَتْ عَائِشَةَ فَأَخْبَرَتْهَا فَلَمَّا جَاءَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَخْبَرَتْهُ عَائِشَةُ بِمَجِيءِ
 فَاطِمَةَ إِلَيْهَا فَجَاءَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَيْنَا وَقَدْ أَخَذْنَا مَضَاجِعَنَا فَذَهَبْنَا نَقُومُ
 فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ عَلَى مَكَانِكُمَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَعَدَ بَيْنَنَا حَتَّى وَجَدْتُ بَرْدَ قَدَمِهِ
 عَلَى صَدْرِي ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَلاَ أُعَلِّمُكُمَا خَيْرًا مِمَّا سَأَلْتُمَا إِذَا أَخَذْتُمَا مَضَاجِعَكُمَا أَنْ تُكَبِّرَا
 اللَّهَ أَرْبَعًا وَثَلاَثِينَ وَتُسَبِّحَاهُ ثَلاَثًا وَثَلاَثِينَ وَتَحْمَدَاهُ ثَلاَثًا وَثَلاَثِينَ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمَا مِنْ خَادِمٍ
 ‏"‏ ‏.‏
48.en: It is reported on the authority of Ali that Fatima had corns in her hand because of working at the hand-mill. There had fallen to the lot of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) some prisoners of war. She (Fatima) came to the Prophet (ﷺ) but she did not find him (in the house). She met A'isha and informed her (about her hardship). When Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) came, she (A'isha) informed him about the visit of Fatima. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to them (Fatima and her family). They had gone to their beds. 'Ali further (reported): We tried to stand up (as a mark of respect) but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Keep to your beds, and he sat amongst us and I felt the coldness of his feet upon my chest. He then said: May I not direct you to something better than what you have asked for? When you go to your bed, you should recite Takbir (Allah-o-Akbar) thirty-four times and Tasbih (Subhan Allah) thirty-three times and Tahmid (al-Hamdu li-Allah) thirty-three times, and that is better than the servant for you.
48.hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ke haathon par chakki chalaane ki wajah se ghaTTe pad gaye the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas jung ke kuch qaidi aaye the. Woh (Fatima (Alayhas Salam)) Nabi (SAW) ke paas aayin lekin unhe (ghar mein) nahi paaya. Woh Aisha (RA) se milin aur unhe (apni mushkil ke baare mein) bataya. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aaye, unhone (Aisha ne) unhe Fatima (Alayhas Salam) ke aane ke baare mein bataya. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unke (Fatima (Alayhas Salam) aur unke khaandaan ke) paas aaye. Woh apne bistar par ja chuke the. Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne aage (riwayat ki): Humne khade hone ki koshish ki (samman ke nishaan ke soorat mein) lekin Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Apne bistar par hi raho, aur woh humaare beech baith gaye aur maine unke paon ki Thandak apne seene par mehsoos ki. Phir unhone farmaaya: Kya main tumhe usse behtar cheez na bataun jo tumne maanga hai? Jab tum apne bistar par jao, tumhe Takbeer (Allahu Akbar) chauntis (34) baar aur Tasbeeh (Subhan Allah) tettis (33) baar aur Tahmeed (al-Hamdu Lillah) tettis (33) baar padhni chahiye, aur ye tumhaare liye naukar se behtar hai.

48.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا 
 أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَفِي حَدِيثِ
 مُعَاذٍ ‏
"‏ أَخَذْتُمَا مَضْجَعَكُمَا مِنَ اللَّيْلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
48.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters but. with a slight variation of wording.
48.hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

48.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي يَزِيدَ،
 عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، ح 
 وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، وَعُبَيْدُ بْنُ يَعِيشَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا 
 عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ الْحَكَمِ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، وَزَادَ، فِي الْحَدِيثِ قَالَ عَلِيٌّ
 مَا تَرَكْتُهُ مُنْذُ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ قِيلَ لَهُ وَلاَ لَيْلَةَ صِفِّينَ قَالَ وَلاَ لَيْلَةَ
 صِفِّينِ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ عَطَاءٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى قَالَ قُلْتُ لَهُ وَلاَ لَيْلَةَ صِفِّينَ
48.en: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ibn Abi Laili but with this addition: " Ali said: Ever since I heard this (supplication) from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), I never abandoned it. It was said to him, Not even in the night of Siffin (battle of Siffin)? He sad: Yes, not even in the night of Siffin,"
48.hi: Ye hadees Ibn Abu Laila ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin is izafe ke saath: "Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: Jab se maine ye (dua) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suni hai, maine ise kabhi nahi chhoda. Unse poocha gaya: Siffin ki raat bhi nahi? Unhone kaha: Haan, Siffin ki raat bhi nahi (chhoda)."

48.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي أُمَيَّةُ بْنُ بِسْطَامَ الْعَيْشِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زُرَيْعٍ - حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ،
 وَهُوَ ابْنُ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ فَاطِمَةَ، أَتَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم تَسْأَلُهُ خَادِمًا وَشَكَتِ الْعَمَلَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا أَلْفَيْتِيهِ عِنْدَنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَلاَ أَدُلُّكِ عَلَى مَا
 هُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكِ مِنْ خَادِمٍ تُسَبِّحِينَ ثَلاَثًا وَثَلاَثِينَ وَتَحْمَدِينَ ثَلاَثًا وَثَلاَثِينَ وَتُكَبِّرِينَ أَرْبَعًا وَثَلاَثِينَ
 حِينَ تَأْخُذِينَ مَضْجَعَكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ 
 وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الدَّارِمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَبَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سُهَيْلٌ، بِهَذَا
 الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
48.en: Abu Huraira reported that Fatima came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and asked for a servant and told him of the hardship of household work. He said: You would not be able to get a servant from us. May I not direct you to what is better than the servant for you? Recite Subhaana Allah thirty-three times, al- Hamdu li-Allah thirty-three times and Allah-o-Akbar thirty-four times as you go to bed. This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Suhail with the same chain of transmitters.
48.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Fatima (Alayhas Salam) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayin aur naukar ki maang ki aur unhe ghar ke kaam ki mushkil bataayi. Unhone (Pavitr Nabi ne) farmaaya: Tumhe humaare paas se naukar nahi milega. Kya main tumhe naukar se behtar cheez na bataun? Jab tum bistar par jao Subhan Allah tettis baar, al-Hamdu Lillah tettis baar aur Allahu Akbar chauntis baar padho. Ye hadees Suhail ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

48.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي،
 هُرَيْرَةَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ إِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ صِيَاحَ الدِّيَكَةِ فَاسْأَلُوا اللَّهَ مِنْ
 فَضْلِهِ فَإِنَّهَا رَأَتْ مَلَكًا وَإِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ نَهِيقَ الْحِمَارِ فَتَعَوَّذُوا بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ فَإِنَّهَا رَأَتْ
 شَيْطَانًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
48.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as say- ing. When you listen to the crowing of the cock, ask Allah for His favour as it sees Angels and when you listen to the braying of the donkey, seek refuge in Allah from the Satan for it sees Satan.
48.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jab tum murgi ki bang sunte ho, Allah se Uska fazl maango kyunki woh Farishton ko dekhta hai, aur jab tum gadhe ki aawaaz sunte ho, Shaitaan se Allah ki panah maango kyunki woh Shaitaan ko dekhta hai.

48.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ وَعُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ سَعِيدٍ
 - قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْعَالِيَةِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ،
 أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَقُولُ عِنْدَ الْكَرْبِ ‏
"‏ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ لاَ
 إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
 ‏"‏ ‏.‏
48.en: Ibn 'Abbas reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) used to supplicate during the time of trouble (in these words): " There is no god but Allah, the Great, the Tolerant, there is no god but Allah, the Lord of the Magnificent Throne There is no god but Allah, the Lord of the Heaven and the earth, the Lord of the Edifying Throne."
48.hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mushkil ke waqt ye dua maangte the: "Allah ke siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai, Woh Buzurg hai, Sahansheel hai; Allah ke siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai, Woh Shaandaar Arsh ka Rab hai. Allah ke siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai, Woh Aasmaanon aur Zameen ka Rab hai, izzat waale Arsh ka Rab hai."

48.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَحَدِيثُ مُعَاذِ
 بْنِ هِشَامٍ أَتَمُّ ‏.‏
48.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters.
48.hi: Ye hadees Hisham ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

48.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ الْعَبْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ،
 عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، أَنَّ أَبَا الْعَالِيَةِ الرِّيَاحِيَّ، حَدَّثَهُمْ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم كَانَ يَدْعُو بِهِنَّ وَيَقُولُهُنَّ عِنْدَ الْكَرْبِ فَذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ مُعَاذِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ
 قَتَادَةَ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏
"‏ رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
48.en: Ibn Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to supplicate (with these words) and he (uttered these words) at the time of trouble; the rest of the hadith is the same except with this difference that insted of saying: " The Lord of heaven and the earth," he said:" The Lord of the heaven and that of the earth."
48.hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ye dua maangte (in alfaazon mein) aur unhone mushkil ke waqt (ye alfaaz) kahe; baaki hadees waisi hi hai siwaay is antar ke ki "Aasmaan aur Zameen ka Rab" kehne ki jagah unhone kaha: "Aasmaan ka aur Zameen ka Rab."

48.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُوسُفُ بْنُ،
 عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ أَبِي الْعَالِيَةِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ
 إِذَا حَزَبَهُ أَمْرٌ قَالَ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ مُعَاذٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ وَزَادَ مَعَهُنَّ ‏
"‏ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
48.en: Ibn 'Abbas reported this hadith through another chain of transmitters with a sliglit variation of wording.
48.hi: Ye hadees Ibn Abbas (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

48.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَبَّانُ بْنُ هِلاَلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ الْجُرَيْرِيُّ،
 عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْجِسْرِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ الصَّامِتِ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم سُئِلَ أَىُّ الْكَلاَمِ أَفْضَلُ قَالَ ‏
"‏ مَا اصْطَفَى اللَّهُ لِمَلاَئِكَتِهِ أَوْ لِعِبَادِهِ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
 ‏"‏ ‏.‏
48.en: Abu Dharr reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked as to which words were the best. He said: Those for which Allah made a choice for His Angels and His servants (and the words are):" Hallowed be Allah and praise is due to Him."
48.hi: Abu Dharr (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se poocha gaya ki kaunse alfaaz sabse behtareen hain. Unhone farmaaya: Woh jinke liye Allah ne Apne Farishton aur Apne bandon ke liye pasand kiya (aur woh alfaaz hain): "Allah pavitra hai (Woh kamiyon se pak hai) aur hamd Usi ke liye hai."

48.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي بُكَيْرٍ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنِ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ،
 عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْجَسْرِيِّ، مِنْ عَنَزَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَلاَ أُخْبِرُكَ بِأَحَبِّ الْكَلاَمِ إِلَى اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَخْبِرْنِي
 بِأَحَبِّ الْكَلاَمِ إِلَى اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ أَحَبَّ الْكَلاَمِ إِلَى اللَّهِ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
48.en: Abu Dharr reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Should I not inform you about the words liked most by Allah? I said: Allah's Mes- senger, do inform me about the words liked most by Allah. He said: Verily, the words liked most by Allah are:" hallowed be Allah and praise is due to Him."
48.hi: Abu Dharr (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Kya main tumhe un alfaazon ke baare mein na bataun jo Allah ko sabse zyada pasand hain? Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, mujhe Allah ko sabse zyada pasand alfaazon ke baare mein bataiye. Unhone farmaaya: Yaqeenan, Allah ko sabse zyada pasand alfaaz hain: "Allah pavitra hai (Woh kamiyon se pak hai) aur hamd Usi ke liye hai."

48.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ حَفْصٍ الْوَكِيعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ 
 طَلْحَةَ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ كَرِيزٍ، عَنْ أُمِّ الدَّرْدَاءِ، عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ مُسْلِمٍ يَدْعُو لأَخِيهِ بِظَهْرِ الْغَيْبِ إِلاَّ قَالَ الْمَلَكُ وَلَكَ بِمِثْلٍ ‏"‏
 ‏.‏
48.en: Abu Dharr reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: There is no believing servant who supplicates for his brother behind his back (in his absence) that the Angels do not say: The same be for you too.
48.hi: Abu Dharr (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Koi bhi imaandaar banda nahi hai jo apne bhai ke liye uski gairhaazri mein dua maange lekin Farishte ye na kahen: Tumhare liye bhi wahi ho.

48.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا النَّضْرُ بْنُ شُمَيْلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ سَرْوَانَ،
 الْمُعَلِّمُ حَدَّثَنِي طَلْحَةُ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ كَرِيزٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَتْنِي أُمُّ الدَّرْدَاءِ، قَالَتْ حَدَّثَنِي سَيِّدِي،
 أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏
"‏ مَنْ دَعَا لأَخِيهِ بِظَهْرِ الْغَيْبِ قَالَ الْمَلَكُ
 الْمُوَكَّلُ بِهِ آمِينَ وَلَكَ بِمِثْلٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
48.en: Umm Darda' reported: My husband reported that he heard Allah's Mes- senger (ﷺ) as saying: He who supplicates for his brother behind his back (in his absence), the Angel commissioned (for carrying supplication to his Lord) says: Amen, and it is for you also.
48.hi: Umm Darda (RA) ne bayan kiya: Mere pati (Abu Darda) ne bataya ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jo apne bhai ke liye uski gairhaazri mein dua maangta hai, muqarrar Farishta kehta hai: Aameen, aur tumhaare liye bhi wahi ho.

48.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ أَبِي،
 سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ صَفْوَانَ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ صَفْوَانَ - وَكَانَتْ تَحْتَهُ الدَّرْدَاءُ
 قَالَ قَدِمْتُ الشَّامَ فَأَتَيْتُ أَبَا الدَّرْدَاءِ فِي مَنْزِلِهِ فَلَمْ أَجِدْهُ وَوَجَدْتُ أُمَّ الدَّرْدَاءِ فَقَالَتْ أَتُرِيدُ
 الْحَجَّ الْعَامَ فَقُلْتُ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَادْعُ اللَّهَ لَنَا بِخَيْرٍ فَإِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ
 يَقُولُ ‏
"‏ دَعْوَةُ الْمَرْءِ الْمُسْلِمِ لأَخِيهِ بِظَهْرِ الْغَيْبِ مُسْتَجَابَةٌ عِنْدَ رَأْسِهِ مَلَكٌ مُوَكَّلٌ كُلَّمَا دَعَا
 لأَخِيهِ بِخَيْرٍ قَالَ الْمَلَكُ الْمُوَكَّلُ بِهِ آمِينَ وَلَكَ بِمِثْلٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ 
 قَالَ فَخَرَجْتُ إِلَى السُّوقِ فَلَقِيتُ أَبَا الدَّرْدَاءِ فَقَالَ لِي مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ يَرْوِيهِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
48.en: Safwan (and he was Ibn 'Abdullah b. Safwan, and he had been married to Umm Darda') reported: I visited Abu Darda's house in Syria. I did not find him there but Umm Darda' (was present at the house). She said: Do you intend to perform Hajj during this year? I said: Yes. She said: Do supplicate Allah for blessings upon us, for Allah's Apostle (may peace be upon hiin) used to say: The supplication of a Muslim for his brother at his back (in his absence) is responded so long as he makes a supplica- tion for blessings for his brother and the commissioned Angel says: Amen, and says: May it be for you too I I went to the bazar and met Abfi Dardi' and he narrated like this from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).
48.hi: Safwan (jo Ibn Abdullah bin Safwan the, aur unki shaadi Umm Darda se hui thi) ne bayan kiya: Main Abu Darda ke ghar Syria mein gaya. Maine unhe wahan nahi paaya lekin Umm Darda (ghar mein) maujood thin. Unhone kaha: Kya aap is saal Hajj karne ka iraada rakhte hain? Maine kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: Humaare liye barkat ki dua maango, kyunki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) kaha karte the: Kisi Musalman ki apne bhai ke liye uski gairhaazri mein maangi gayi dua qubool ki jaati hai jab tak woh apne bhai ke liye barkaton ki dua maangta hai aur muqarrar Farishta kehta hai: Aameen, aur kehta hai: Tumhaare liye bhi wahi ho! Main bazaar gaya aur Abu Darda se mila aur unhone bhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se isi tarah riwayat ki.

48.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ أَبِي،
 سُلَيْمَانَ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ وَقَالَ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ صَفْوَانَ، ‏.‏
48.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Safwan b. 'Abdullah b. Safwan with the same chain of transmitters.
48.hi: Ye hadees Safwan bin Abdullah bin Safwan ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

48.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ نُمَيْرٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو
 أُسَامَةَ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ عَنْ زَكَرِيَّاءَ بْنِ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ،
 مَالِكٍ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَيَرْضَى عَنِ الْعَبْدِ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ الأَكْلَةَ
 فَيَحْمَدَهُ عَلَيْهَا أَوْ يَشْرَبَ الشَّرْبَةَ فَيَحْمَدَهُ عَلَيْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
48.en: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Allah is pleased with His servant who says: Al-Hamdu lillah while taking a morsel of food and while drinking.
48.hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Allah apne us banda se khush hota hai jo khaane ka ek Lokma khaate waqt aur peete waqt al-Hamdu Lillah kehta hai.

48.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ الأَزْرَقُ، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ، بِهَذَا
 الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
48.en: This hadith is reported through Ishaaq bin Yusuf Al-Azraq from Zakariyya bin Abi Za'ida through the same chain.
48.hi: Ye hadees Ishaq bin Yusuf al-Azraq ke zariye Zakariyya bin Abu Zaida se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

48.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدٍ، مَوْلَى
 ابْنِ أَزْهَرَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ يُسْتَجَابُ لأَحَدِكُمْ
 مَا لَمْ يَعْجَلْ فَيَقُولُ قَدْ دَعَوْتُ فَلاَ أَوْ فَلَمْ يُسْتَجَبْ لِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
48.en: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The supplication of every one of you is granted if he does not grow impatient and says: I supplicated but it was not granted.
48.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Tum mein se har ek ki dua qubool ki jaati hai agar woh betaab na ho aur ye na kahe: Maine dua maangi thi lekin ye qubool nahi hui.

48.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ لَيْثٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ،
 عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ، مَوْلَى عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ وَكَانَ مِنَ الْقُرَّاءِ
 وَأَهْلِ الْفِقْهِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ يُسْتَجَابُ
 لأَحَدِكُمْ مَا لَمْ يَعْجَلْ فَيَقُولُ قَدْ دَعَوْتُ رَبِّي فَلَمْ يَسْتَجِبْ لِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
48.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The supplication of one of you is granted if he does not grow impatient and say- I supplicated my Lord but it was not granted.
48.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Tum mein se kisi ki dua qubool ki jaati hai agar woh betaab na ho aur ye na kahe: Maine apne Rab se dua maangi thi lekin ye qubool nahi hui.

48.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مُعَاوِيَةُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ صَالِحٍ -
 عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِدْرِيسَ الْخَوْلاَنِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ يَزَالُ يُسْتَجَابُ لِلْعَبْدِ مَا لَمْ يَدْعُ بِإِثْمٍ أَوْ قَطِيعَةِ رَحِمٍ مَا لَمْ يَسْتَعْجِلْ
 ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قِيلَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا الاِسْتِعْجَالُ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَقُولُ قَدْ دَعَوْتُ وَقَدْ دَعَوْتُ فَلَمْ أَرَ يَسْتَجِيبُ
 لِي فَيَسْتَحْسِرُ عِنْدَ ذَلِكَ وَيَدَعُ الدُّعَاءَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
48.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The supplication of the servant is granted in case he does not supplicate for sin or for severing the ties of blood, or he does not become impatient. It was said: Allah's Messenger, what does:" If he does not grow impatient" imply? He said: That he should say like this: I supplicated and I supplicated but I did not find it being responded. and theu he becomes frustrated and abandons supplication.
48.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Banda ki dua qubool ki jaati hai jab tak woh gunah ke liye ya rishtedaari ke rishte todne ke liye dua na maange, ya woh betaab na ho. Poocha gaya: Allah ke Rasool, "agar woh betaab na ho" ka kya matlab hai? Unhone farmaaya: Ki woh ye kahe: Maine dua maangi aur maine dua maangi lekin maine ise qubool hote nahi paaya, aur phir woh mayoos ho jaata hai aur dua maangna chhod deta hai.

49.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا هَدَّابُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا 
 مُعَاذُ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ،
 بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ التَّيْمِيِّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ، فُضَيْلُ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ
 - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا التَّيْمِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ،
 قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ قُمْتُ عَلَى بَابِ الْجَنَّةِ فَإِذَا عَامَّةُ مَنْ دَخَلَهَا
 الْمَسَاكِينُ وَإِذَا أَصْحَابُ الْجَدِّ مَحْبُوسُونَ إِلاَّ أَصْحَابَ النَّارِ فَقَدْ أُمِرَ بِهِمْ إِلَى النَّارِ وَقُمْتُ
 عَلَى بَابِ النَّارِ فَإِذَا عَامَّةُ مَنْ دَخَلَهَا النِّسَاءُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
49.en: Usama b. Zaid reported that Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) said: I stood at the door of Paradise and I found that the overwhelming majority of those who entered therein was that of poor persons and the wealthy persons were detained to get into that. The denizens of Hell were commanded to get into Hell, and I stood upon the door of Fire and the majority amongst them who entered there was that of women.
49.hi: Usama bin Zaid (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Main Jannat ke darwaze par khada hua aur maine paaya ki jo log bade paimaane par usmein daakhil huye woh gareeb log the, jabki daulatmand logon ko rok kar rakha gaya tha usmein daakhil hone se. Jahannam ke bashindon ko Jahannam mein daakhil hone ka hukum diya gaya, aur main Jahannam ki aag ke darwaze par khada hua aur unmein se bade paimaane par jo log usmein daakhil huye woh auraten thin.

49.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي رَجَاءٍ،
 الْعُطَارِدِيِّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، يَقُولُ قَالَ مُحَمَّدٌ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ اطَّلَعْتُ فِي
 الْجَنَّةِ فَرَأَيْتُ أَكْثَرَ أَهْلِهَا الْفُقَرَاءَ وَاطَّلَعْتُ فِي النَّارِ فَرَأَيْتُ أَكْثَرَ أَهْلِهَا النِّسَاءَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
49.en: Ibn Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I had a chance to look into the Paradise and I found that majority of the people was poor and I looked into the Fire and there I found the majority constituted by women.
49.hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Mujhe Jannat mein jhaankne ka mauka mila aur maine paaya ki zyaadatar log gareeb the, aur maine Jahannam ki aag mein jhaanka aur wahan maine paaya ki zyaadatar log auraten thin.

49.ar: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا الثَّقَفِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَيُّوبُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
49.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas through another chain of transmitters.
49.hi: Ye hadees Ibn Abbas (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

49.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَشْهَبِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو رَجَاءٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ،
 أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم اطَّلَعَ فِي النَّارِ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ أَيُّوبَ ‏.‏
49.en: Ibn 'Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stated like this: He looked into the Fire of Hell. The rest of the hadith is the same.
49.hi: Ibn Abbas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne isi tarah farmaaya: Unhone Jahannam ki aag mein jhaanka. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

49.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ، سَمِعَ أَبَا رَجَاءٍ،
 عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
49.en: This hadith is narrated likewise through another chain of transmitters.
49.hi: Ye hadees isi tarah ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

49.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي التَّيَّاحِ، قَالَ كَانَ لِمُطَرِّفِ
 بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ امْرَأَتَانِ فَجَاءَ مِنْ عِنْدِ إِحْدَاهُمَا فَقَالَتِ الأُخْرَى جِئْتَ مِنْ عِنْدِ فُلاَنَةَ فَقَالَ
 جِئْتُ مِنْ عِنْدِ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ فَحَدَّثَنَا أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ إِنَّ
 أَقَلَّ سَاكِنِي الْجَنَّةِ النِّسَاءُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
49.en: Imran b. Husain reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Amongst the inmates of Paradise the women would form a minority.
49.hi: Imran bin Husain (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jannat ke bashindon mein auraten kam tadaad mein hongi.

49.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ 
 أَبِي التَّيَّاحِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُطَرِّفًا، يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّهُ كَانَتْ لَهُ امْرَأَتَانِ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ مُعَاذٍ ‏.‏
49.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Mutarrif through another chain of transmitters.
49.hi: Ye hadees Mutarrif ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

49.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ أَبُو زُرْعَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ،
 عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ كَانَ
 مِنْ دُعَاءِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ زَوَالِ نِعْمَتِكَ وَتَحَوُّلِ
 عَافِيَتِكَ وَفُجَاءَةِ نِقْمَتِكَ وَجَمِيعِ سَخَطِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
49.en: 'Abdullah b. Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) supplicated in these words: " O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from the withdrawal of Thine blessing and the change of Thine protection (from me) and from the sudden wrath of Thine, and from every displeasure of Thine."
49.hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) in alfaazon mein dua maangte the: "Aye Allah, main Teri panah maangta hoon Teri barkaton ke chhin jaane se aur Teri hifaazat ke (mujhse) badal jaane se, aur Tere achaanak gusse se, aur Teri har naaraazgi se."

49.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، وَمُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ التَّيْمِيِّ،
 عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيِّ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏
 مَا تَرَكْتُ بَعْدِي فِتْنَةً هِيَ أَضَرُّ عَلَى الرِّجَالِ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
49.en: Usama b. Zaid reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: I have not left after me any (chance) of turmoil more injurious to men than the harm done to the men because of women.
49.hi: Usama bin Zaid (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Maine apne baad mardon ke liye auraton ki wajah se jitna nuksaandeh fitna chhoda hai, koi doosra fitna nahi chhoda.

49.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، وَسُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، جَمِيعًا
 عَنِ الْمُعْتَمِرِ، قَالَ ابْنُ مُعَاذٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، قَالَ قَالَ أَبِي حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُثْمَانَ،
 عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ حَارِثَةَ، وَسَعِيدِ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ نُفَيْلٍ، أَنَّهُمَا حَدَّثَا عَنْ رَسُولِ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏
"‏ مَا تَرَكْتُ بَعْدِي فِي النَّاسِ فِتْنَةً أَضَرَّ عَلَى الرِّجَالِ
 مِنَ النِّسَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
49.en: Usama b. Zaid b. Harith and Sa'id b. Zaid b. 'Amr b. Naufal both reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: I have not left after me turmoil for the people but the harm done to men by women.
49.hi: Usama bin Zaid bin Harith aur Sa'id bin Zaid bin Amr bin Naufal (RA) donon ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Maine logon ke liye apne baad auraton ki wajah se mardon ko hone wale nuksaan se badhkar koi fitna nahi chhoda.

49.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ الأَحْمَرُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا 
 يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ 
 سُلَيْمَانَ التَّيْمِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
49.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Sulaiman Taimi with the same chain of transmitters.
49.hi: Ye hadees Sulaiman Taimi ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

49.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ،
 عَنْ أَبِي مَسْلَمَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا نَضْرَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله
 عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ الدُّنْيَا حُلْوَةٌ خَضِرَةٌ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ مُسْتَخْلِفُكُمْ فِيهَا فَيَنْظُرُ كَيْفَ تَعْمَلُونَ
 فَاتَّقُوا الدُّنْيَا وَاتَّقُوا النِّسَاءَ فَإِنَّ أَوَّلَ فِتْنَةِ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ كَانَتْ فِي النِّسَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ
 ابْنِ بَشَّارٍ ‏"‏ لِيَنْظُرَ كَيْفَ تَعْمَلُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
49.en: Abu Sa'id Khudri reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The world is sweet and green (alluring) and verily Allah is going to install you as vicegerent in it in order to see how you act. So avoid the allurement of women: verily, the first trial for the people of Isra'il was caused by women. And in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Ibn Bashshar the words are:" So that He should see how you act."
49.hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Duniya meethi aur hariyaali (lubhaawani) hai aur yaqeenan Allah tumhe ismein apna khalifa (naib) banaane wala hai ye dekhne ke liye ki tum kaise amal karte ho. Isliye auraton ke lalach se bacho: yaqeenan, Bani Isra'il ke logon ke liye pehli azmaayish auraton ki wajah se aayi thi. Aur Ibn Bashshar ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein alfaaz hain: "Taaki Woh dekh sake ki tum kaise amal karte ho."

49.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ الْمُسَيَّبِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَنَسٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عِيَاضٍ أَبَا ضَمْرَةَ
 - عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ بَيْنَمَا ثَلاَثَةُ نَفَرٍ يَتَمَشَّوْنَ أَخَذَهُمُ الْمَطَرُ فَأَوَوْا إِلَى غَارٍ فِي جَبَلٍ فَانْحَطَّتْ
 عَلَى فَمِ غَارِهِمْ صَخْرَةٌ مِنَ الْجَبَلِ فَانْطَبَقَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ انْظُرُوا أَعْمَالاً
 عَمِلْتُمُوهَا صَالِحَةً لِلَّهِ فَادْعُوا اللَّهَ تَعَالَى بِهَا لَعَلَّ اللَّهَ يَفْرُجُهَا عَنْكُمْ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَحَدُهُمُ اللَّهُمَّ
 إِنَّهُ كَانَ لِي وَالِدَانِ شَيْخَانِ كَبِيرَانِ وَامْرَأَتِي وَلِيَ صِبْيَةٌ صِغَارٌ أَرْعَى عَلَيْهِمْ فَإِذَا أَرَحْتُ
 عَلَيْهِمْ حَلَبْتُ فَبَدَأْتُ بِوَالِدَىَّ فَسَقَيْتُهُمَا قَبْلَ بَنِيَّ وَأَنَّهُ نَأَى بِي ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ الشَّجَرُ فَلَمْ آتِ
 حَتَّى أَمْسَيْتُ فَوَجَدْتُهُمَا قَدْ نَامَا فَحَلَبْتُ كَمَا كُنْتُ أَحْلُبُ فَجِئْتُ بِالْحِلاَبِ فَقُمْتُ عِنْدَ رُءُوسِهِمَا
 أَكْرَهُ أَنْ أُوقِظَهُمَا مِنْ نَوْمِهِمَا وَأَكْرَهُ أَنْ أَسْقِيَ الصِّبْيَةَ قَبْلَهُمَا وَالصِّبْيَةُ يَتَضَاغَوْنَ عِنْدَ
 قَدَمَىَّ فَلَمْ يَزَلْ ذَلِكَ دَأْبِي وَدَأْبَهُمْ حَتَّى طَلَعَ الْفَجْرُ فَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنِّي فَعَلْتُ ذَلِكَ ابْتِغَاءَ
 وَجْهِكَ فَافْرُجْ لَنَا مِنْهَا فُرْجَةً نَرَى مِنْهَا السَّمَاءَ ‏.‏ فَفَرَجَ اللَّهُ مِنْهَا فُرْجَةً فَرَأَوْا مِنْهَا السَّمَاءَ
 ‏.‏ وَقَالَ الآخَرُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّهُ كَانَتْ لِيَ ابْنَةُ عَمٍّ أَحْبَبْتُهَا كَأَشَدِّ مَا يُحِبُّ الرِّجَالُ النِّسَاءَ وَطَلَبْتُ
 إِلَيْهَا نَفْسَهَا فَأَبَتْ حَتَّى آتِيَهَا بِمِائَةِ دِينَارٍ فَتَعِبْتُ حَتَّى جَمَعْتُ مِائَةَ دِينَارٍ فَجِئْتُهَا بِهَا
 فَلَمَّا وَقَعْتُ بَيْنَ رِجْلَيْهَا قَالَتْ يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ اتَّقِ اللَّهَ وَلاَ تَفْتَحِ الْخَاتَمَ إِلاَّ بِحَقِّهِ ‏.‏ فَقُمْتُ عَنْهَا
 فَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنِّي فَعَلْتُ ذَلِكَ ابْتِغَاءَ وَجْهِكَ فَافْرُجْ لَنَا مِنْهَا فُرْجَةً ‏.‏ فَفَرَجَ لَهُمْ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ
 الآخَرُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي كُنْتُ اسْتَأْجَرْتُ أَجِيرًا بِفَرَقِ أَرُزٍّ فَلَمَّا قَضَى عَمَلَهُ قَالَ أَعْطِنِي حَقِّي ‏.‏
 فَعَرَضْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَرَقَهُ فَرَغِبَ عَنْهُ فَلَمْ أَزَلْ أَزْرَعُهُ حَتَّى جَمَعْتُ مِنْهُ بَقَرًا وَرِعَاءَهَا فَجَاءَنِي
 فَقَالَ اتَّقِ اللَّهَ وَلاَ تَظْلِمْنِي حَقِّي ‏.‏ قُلْتُ اذْهَبْ إِلَى تِلْكَ الْبَقَرِ وَرِعَائِهَا فَخُذْهَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ اتَّقِ
 اللَّهَ وَلاَ تَسْتَهْزِئْ بِي ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ إِنِّي لاَ أَسْتَهْزِئُ بِكَ خُذْ ذَلِكَ الْبَقَرَ وَرِعَاءَهَا ‏.‏ فَأَخَذَهُ فَذَهَبَ
 بِهِ فَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنِّي فَعَلْتُ ذَلِكَ ابْتِغَاءَ وَجْهِكَ فَافْرُجْ لَنَا مَا بَقِيَ ‏.‏ فَفَرَجَ اللَّهُ مَا بَقِيَ
 ‏.‏
49.en: 'Abdullah b. 'Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Three persons set out on a journey. They were overtaken by rain and they had to find protection in a mountain cave where at its mouth there fell a rock of that mountain and thus blocked them altogether. One of them said to the others: Look to your good deeds that you performed for the sake of Allah and then supplicate Allah, the Exalted, that He might rescue you (from this trouble). One of them said: 0 Allah, I had my parents who were old and my wife and my small children also. I tended the flock and when I came back to them in the evening, I milked them (the sheep, goats, cows, etc.) and first served that milk to my parents. One day I was obliged to go out to a distant place in search of fodder and I could not come back before evening and found them (the parents) asleep. I milked the animals as I used to milk and brought milk to them and stood by their heads avoiding to disturb them from sleep and I did not deem it advisable to serve milk to my children before serving them. My children wept near my feet. I remained there in that very state and my parents too until it was morning. And (0 Allah) if Thou art aware that I did this in order to seek Thine pleasure, grant us riddance from this trouble. (The rock slipped a bit) that they could see the sky. The second one said: 0 Allah, I had a female cousin whom I loved more than the men love the women. I wanted to have sexual intercourse with her; she refused but on the condition of getting one hundred dinirs. It was with very great difficulty that I could collect one hundred dinirs and then paid them to her and when I was going to have a sexual intercourse with her, that she said: Servant of Allah, fear Allah and do not break the seal (of chastity) but by lawful means. I got up. 0 Allah, if Thou art aware that I did this in order to seek Thine pleasure, rid us from this trouble. The situation was somewhat eased for them. The third one said: Allah, I employed a workman for a measure of rice. After he had finished his work I gave him his dues (in the form of) a measure of rice, but he did not accept them. I used these rice as seeds, and that gave a bumper crop and I became rich enough to have cows and flocks (in my possession). He came to me and said: Fear Allah, and commit no crueltv upon me in regard to my dues. I said to him: Takeaway this flock of cows and sheep. He said: Fear Allah and do not make a fun of me. I said: I am not making a fun of you. You take the cows and the flocks. So he took them. 0 Allah, if Thou art aware that I did it for Thine pleasure, case the situation for us. And Allah relieved them from the rest of the trouble.
49.hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Teen log ek safar par nikle. Barish ne unhe apni chapet mein le liya aur unhe ek pahaad ki ghufa mein hifaazat dhoondhni padi jiske munh par us pahaad ki ek chattaan gir padi aur unhe poori tarah bandI bana diya. Unmein se ek ne doosron se kaha: Apne un nekokaar amalon ko dekho jo tumne Allah ki khaatir kiye, aur phir Allah, Buland-o-Azeem, se dua maango ki Woh tumhe (is museebat se) chhutkaara de. Unmein se ek ne kaha: Aye Allah, mere boodhe maa-baap the, aur meri zauja aur mere chhote bachche bhi. Main bhedon ko charaata tha aur jab main shaam ko unke paas wapas aata, main unka doodh nikaalta aur sabse pehle apne maa-baap ko pilaata. Ek din mujhe chaara dhoondne door jaana pada aur main shaam se pehle wapas nahi aa saka aur unhe (maa-baap ko) sote hue paaya. Maine jaanwaron ka doodh nikaala jaisa main aksar nikaalta tha aur unke paas doodh laaya aur unke sar ke paas khada raha, unhe neend se jagaana napasand karte hue, aur maine ye theek nahi samjha ki apne bachchon ko unse pehle doodh pilaaun. Mere bachche mere paon ke qareeb rote rahe. Main isi haalat mein raha aur mere maa-baap bhi yahan tak ki subah ho gayi. Aur (aye Allah) agar Tujhe pata hai ki maine ye Teri khushi ki khaatir kiya, to humein is museebat se raha de. (Chattaan thoda hili) ki woh aasmaan dekh sake. Doosre ne kaha: Aye Allah, meri ek chachaazaad thi jisse main utni hi muhabbat karta tha jitni koi mard aurat se karta hai. Maine usse jinsi ta'alluq banaane ki khwaish jataayi; usne inkaar kiya lekin ek sau dinar dene ki shart par (maan gayi). Bahut mushkil se main sau dinar ikattha kar paaya aur unhe usse diye aur jab main uske saath jinsi ta'alluq banaane hi wala tha, usne kaha: Allah ke banda, Allah se Dar aur is muhar (pavitrata) ko na tod siwaay munasib tareeke ke. Main uT gaya. Aye Allah, agar Tujhe pata hai ki maine ye Teri khushi ki khaatir kiya, to humein is museebat se raha de. Haalat unke liye kuch aasaan ho gayi. Teesre ne kaha: Aye Allah, maine ek mazdoor ko chaawal ki ek naap ke badle kaam par rakha. Jab usne apna kaam poora kar liya, maine use uska mehnataana (chaawal ki us naap ke soorat mein) diya, lekin usne ise qubool nahi kiya. Maine woh chaawal beej ke soorat mein istemal kiye, aur isse bahut bhaari fasal huyi aur main itna daulatmand ho gaya ki mere paas gaayen aur bhedein hui. Woh mere paas aaya aur kaha: Allah se Dar, aur mere haq ke maamle mein mujhpar koi zulm mat kar. Maine usse kaha: (In) gaayon aur bhedon ka rewad le jao. Usne kaha: Allah se Dar, aur mera mazaak mat udaa. Maine kaha: Main tumhaara mazaak nahi udaa raha. Ye gaayen aur rewad le lo. To usne unhe le liya. Aye Allah, agar Tujhe pata hai ki maine ye Teri khushi ki khaatir kiya, to humein is museebat se raha de. Aur Allah ne unhe baaki museebat se bhi mukt kar diya.

49.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ،
 جُرَيْجٍ أَخْبَرَنِي مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنْ 
 عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ طَرِيفٍ الْبَجَلِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا 
 أَبِي وَرَقَبَةُ بْنُ مَسْقَلَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَحَسَنٌ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالُوا
 حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - يَعْنُونَ ابْنَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، كُلُّهُمْ
 عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ أَبِي ضَمْرَةَ عَنْ مُوسَى
 بْنِ عُقْبَةَ وَزَادُوا فِي حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏"‏ وَخَرَجُوا يَمْشُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ صَالِحٍ ‏"‏ يَتَمَاشَوْنَ ‏"‏
 ‏.‏ إِلاَّ عُبَيْدَ اللَّهِ فَإِنَّ فِي حَدِيثِهِ ‏"‏ وَخَرَجُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ بَعْدَهَا شَيْئًا ‏.‏
49.en: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Musa b. 'Uqba but with a slight variation of wording.
49.hi: Ye hadees Musa bin Uqba ki sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

49.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَهْلٍ التَّمِيمِيُّ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ بَهْرَامَ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ
 بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ قَالَ ابْنُ سَهْلٍ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ 
 الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَخْبَرَنِي سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله
 عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ انْطَلَقَ ثَلاَثَةُ رَهْطٍ مِمَّنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ حَتَّى آوَاهُمُ الْمَبِيتُ إِلَى غَارٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
 وَاقْتَصَّ الْحَدِيثَ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ قَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنْهُمُ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ
 كَانَ لِي أَبَوَانِ شَيْخَانِ كَبِيرَانِ فَكُنْتُ لاَ أَغْبُقُ قَبْلَهُمَا أَهْلاً وَلاَ مَالاً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ فَامْتَنَعَتْ
 مِنِّي حَتَّى أَلَمَّتْ بِهَا سَنَةٌ مِنَ السِّنِينَ فَجَاءَتْنِي فَأَعْطَيْتُهَا عِشْرِينَ وَمِائَةَ دِينَارٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ
 ‏"‏ فَثَمَّرْتُ أَجْرَهُ حَتَّى كَثُرَتْ مِنْهُ الأَمْوَالُ فَارْتَعَجَتْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ فَخَرَجُوا مِنَ الْغَارِ يَمْشُونَ
49.en: Abdullah b 'Umar reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Three persons belonging to the earlier Ummahs set out on a journey until they had to spend a night in a cave. The rest of the hadith is the same and the additional words are:" A person amongst them said: O Allah, I had my aged parents and I served them milk before I (served that) to my wife, children and my servants." And in case of the second one, the words are: "She avoided me until she was hard pressed because of famine and she came to me and I gave her one hundred and twenty dinars." And in case of the third one (the words are):" I invested his wages, and it brought profit and, as a result thereof, the merchandise increased and there was an abundance of goods." And he (the narrator said) that they got out of the cave and began to walk.
49.hi: Abdullah bin Umar (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Purani Ummaton mein se teen log ek safar par nikle yahan tak ki unhe ek ghufa mein raat guzaarni padi. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai aur ye izafi alfaaz hain: "Unmein se ek ne kaha: Aye Allah, mere boodhe maa-baap the aur maine unhe apni zauja, bachchon aur apne naukaron se pehle doodh pilaya." Aur doosre ke maamle mein, alfaaz hain: "Woh mujhse bachti rahi yahan tak ki woh akaal ki wajah se sakht museebat mein aa gayi aur mere paas aayi aur maine use ek sau bees dinar diye." Aur teesre ke maamle mein (alfaaz hain): "Maine uski mazdoori mein paisa laga diya, aur isse munafa hua aur natijatan, saamaan mein bahutayat aa gayi." Aur unhone (raawi ne) kaha ki woh ghufa se bahar aaye aur chalne lage.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي زَيْدُ بْنُ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ أَبِي،
 صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏
"‏ قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ
 أَنَا عِنْدَ ظَنِّ عَبْدِي بِي وَأَنَا مَعَهُ حَيْثُ يَذْكُرُنِي وَاللَّهِ لَلَّهُ أَفْرَحُ بِتَوْبَةِ عَبْدِهِ مِنْ أَحَدِكُمْ يَجِدُ
 ضَالَّتَهُ بِالْفَلاَةِ وَمَنْ تَقَرَّبَ إِلَىَّ شِبْرًا تَقَرَّبْتُ إِلَيْهِ ذِرَاعًا وَمَنْ تَقَرَّبَ إِلَىَّ ذِرَاعًا تَقَرَّبْتُ إِلَيْهِ
 بَاعًا وَإِذَا أَقْبَلَ إِلَىَّ يَمْشِي أَقْبَلْتُ إِلَيْهِ أُهَرْوِلُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
50.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, said: I live in the thought of My servant and I am with him as he remembers Me. (The Holy Prophet) further said: By Allah, Allah is more pleased wth the repentance of His servant than what one of you would do on finding the lost camel in the waterless desert. When he draws near Me by the span of his hand. I draw near him by the length of a cubit and when he draws near Me by the length of a cubit. I draw near him by the length of a fathom and when he draws near Me walking I draw close to him hurriedly.
50.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna ki Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne farmaaya: Main apne banda ke saath uski soch mein rehta hoon aur main uske saath hoon jab woh Mujhe yaad karta hai. (Pavitr Nabi ne) aage farmaaya: Allah ki qasam, Allah apne banda ki tauba se usse zyada khush hota hai jitna khush tum mein se koi hoga apna gum hua oont bina paani ki registaani zameen mein paakar. Jab woh ek baalisht Mere qareeb aata hai, Main ek gaz uske qareeb aata hoon aur jab woh ek gaz Mere qareeb aata hai, Main ek Fathom (baazuon ki poori lambaai) ki doori uske qareeb aata hoon aur jab woh chalte hue Mere qareeb aata hai, Main jaldi se uski taraf aata hoon.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ الْقَعْنَبِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ
 الرَّحْمَنِ الْحِزَامِيَّ - عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ لَلَّهُ أَشَدُّ فَرَحًا بِتَوْبَةِ أَحَدِكُمْ مِنْ أَحَدِكُمْ بِضَالَّتِهِ إِذَا وَجَدَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
50.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah is more pleased with the repentance of His servant when he turns penitently towards Him than one of you would be on finding the lost camel.
50.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Allah apne banda ki tauba se usse zyada khush hota hai jab woh pachhtaawe ke saath Uski taraf mudta hai, us khushi se jo tum mein se kisi ko apna gum hua oont paakar hoti hai.

50.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، عَنْ 
 أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَعْنَاهُ ‏.‏
50.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters.
50.hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِعُثْمَانَ - قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ
 أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ، عُثْمَانُ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ،
 سُوَيْدٍ قَالَ دَخَلْتُ عَلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَعُودُهُ وَهُوَ مَرِيضٌ فَحَدَّثَنَا بِحَدِيثَيْنِ حَدِيثًا عَنْ نَفْسِهِ
 وَحَدِيثًا عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 يَقُولُ ‏
"‏ لَلَّهُ أَشَدُّ فَرَحًا بِتَوْبَةِ عَبْدِهِ الْمُؤْمِنِ مِنْ رَجُلٍ فِي أَرْضٍ دَوِيَّةٍ مَهْلَكَةٍ مَعَهُ رَاحِلَتُهُ
 عَلَيْهَا طَعَامُهُ وَشَرَابُهُ فَنَامَ فَاسْتَيْقَظَ وَقَدْ ذَهَبَتْ فَطَلَبَهَا حَتَّى أَدْرَكَهُ الْعَطَشُ ثُمَّ قَالَ أَرْجِعُ
 إِلَى مَكَانِي الَّذِي كُنْتُ فِيهِ فَأَنَامُ حَتَّى أَمُوتَ ‏.‏ فَوَضَعَ رَأْسَهُ عَلَى سَاعِدِهِ لِيَمُوتَ فَاسْتَيْقَظَ
 وَعِنْدَهُ رَاحِلَتُهُ وَعَلَيْهَا زَادُهُ وَطَعَامُهُ وَشَرَابُهُ فَاللَّهُ أَشَدُّ فَرَحًا بِتَوْبَةِ الْعَبْدِ الْمُؤْمِنِ مِنْ هَذَا
 بِرَاحِلَتِهِ وَزَادِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
50.en: Harith b. Suwaid said: I went to see 'Abdullah to inquire about his health as he was sick and he narrated to us a hadith of Allahs Messenger (ﷺ). He heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah is more pleased with the repentance of His believing servant than a person who loses his riding beast carrying food and drink. He sleeps (being disappointed of its recovery) and then gets up and goes in search for that, until he is stricken with thirst. then comes back to the place where he had been before and goes to sleep completely exhausted placing his head upon his hands waiting for death. And when he gets up, lot there is before him his riding beast and his provisions of food and drink. Allah is more pleased with the repentance of His servant than the recovery of this riding beast along with the provisions (of food and drink).
50.hi: Harith bin Suwaid ne kaha: Main Abdullah (bin Mas'ud RA) se milne gaya unki tabiyat poochne kyunki woh bimaar the, aur unhone humein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki ek hadees riwayat ki. Unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Allah apne imaandaar banda ki tauba se usse zyada khush hota hai jitna us shakhs ko hoga jiska sawaari waala jaanwar, jispar khaana aur paani laada hua ho, gum ho jaaye. Woh (mayoosi mein) so jaata hai aur phir uThta hai aur use dhoondhne nikalta hai, yahan tak ki uski pyaas se haalat kharaab ho jaati hai. Phir woh usi jagah wapas aata hai jahan woh pehle tha aur poori tarah thak-haar kar apne haathon par sar rakhkar so jaata hai, maut ka intezaar karta hua. Aur jab woh uThta hai, dekho, uske saamne uska sawaari waala jaanwar hai aur khaana aur paani ka saamaan bhi. Allah apne banda ki tauba se, us sawaari waale jaanwar aur uske saath saamaan ke milne se zyada khush hota hai.

50.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، عَنْ قُطْبَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ،
 عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ ‏
"‏ مِنْ رَجُلٍ بِدَاوِيَّةٍ مِنَ الأَرْضِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
50.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of A'mash through another chain of transmitters.
50.hi: Ye hadees A'mash ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

50.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَارَةُ،
 بْنُ عُمَيْرٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْحَارِثَ بْنَ سُوَيْدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، حَدِيثَيْنِ أَحَدُهُمَا عَنْ رَسُولِ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالآخَرُ عَنْ نَفْسِهِ فَقَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 ‏
"‏ لَلَّهُ أَشَدُّ فَرَحًا بِتَوْبَةِ عَبْدِهِ الْمُؤْمِنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ جَرِيرٍ ‏.‏
50.en: 'Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah is more pleased with the repentance of a believing man. The rest of the hadith is the same.
50.hi: Abdullah (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Allah ek imaandaar aadmi ki tauba se zyada khush hota hai. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو يُونُسَ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ، قَالَ
 خَطَبَ النُّعْمَانُ بْنُ بَشِيرٍ فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ لَلَّهُ أَشَدُّ فَرَحًا بِتَوْبَةِ عَبْدِهِ مِنْ رَجُلٍ حَمَلَ زَادَهُ وَمَزَادَهُ
 عَلَى بَعِيرٍ ثُمَّ سَارَ حَتَّى كَانَ بِفَلاَةٍ مِنَ الأَرْضِ فَأَدْرَكَتْهُ الْقَائِلَةُ فَنَزَلَ فَقَالَ تَحْتَ شَجَرَةٍ
 فَغَلَبَتْهُ عَيْنُهُ وَانْسَلَّ بَعِيرُهُ فَاسْتَيْقَظَ فَسَعَى شَرَفًا فَلَمْ يَرَ شَيْئًا ثُمَّ سَعَى شَرَفًا ثَانِيًا
 فَلَمْ يَرَ شَيْئًا ثُمَّ سَعَى شَرَفًا ثَالِثًا فَلَمْ يَرَ شَيْئًا فَأَقْبَلَ حَتَّى أَتَى مَكَانَهُ الَّذِي قَالَ فِيهِ فَبَيْنَمَا
 هُوَ قَاعِدٌ إِذْ جَاءَهُ بَعِيرُهُ يَمْشِي حَتَّى وَضَعَ خِطَامَهُ فِي يَدِهِ فَلَلَّهُ أَشَدُّ فَرَحًا بِتَوْبَةِ الْعَبْدِ
 مِنْ هَذَا حِينَ وَجَدَ بَعِيرَهُ عَلَى حَالِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ سِمَاكٌ فَزَعَمَ الشَّعْبِيُّ أَنَّ النُّعْمَانَ رَفَعَ هَذَا
 الْحَدِيثَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَمَّا أَنَا فَلَمْ أَسْمَعْهُ ‏.‏
50.en: Nu'man b. Bashir reported: Allah is more pleased with the repentance of a believing servant than of a person who set out on a journey with a provision of food and drink on the back of his camel. He went on until he came to a waterless desert and he felt like sleeping. So he got down under the shade of a tree and was overcome by sleep and his camel ran away. As he got up he tried to see (the camel) standing upon a mound. but did not find it. He then got upon the other mound, but could not see anything. He then climbed upon the third mound but did not see anything until he came back to the place where he had been previously. And as he was sitting (in utter disappointment) there came to him the camel, till that (camel) placed its nosestring in his hand. Allah is more pleased with the repentance of His servant than the person who found (his lost camel) in this very state. Simak reported that Sha'bi was of the opinion that Nu'min traced it to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). Simak, however, did not hear that himself.
50.hi: Nu'man bin Bashir (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah apne imaandaar banda ki tauba se us shakhs se zyada khush hota hai jo apne oont ki peeth par khaane aur paani ka saamaan lekar ek safar par nikla. Woh chalta gaya yahan tak ki woh ek bina paani ki registaani zameen tak pahuncha aur usse neend aane lagi. Isliye woh ek darakht ki chhaaya mein utra aur usse neend ne aa gheera aur uska oont bhaag gaya. Jab woh utha, usne (oont ko) ek Tille par khada dekhna chaaha, lekin use nahi paaya. Phir woh doosre Tille par chadha, lekin use kuch nazar nahi aaya. Phir woh teesre Tille par chadha lekin use kuch nazar nahi aaya, yahan tak ki woh wapas usi jagah aa gaya jahan woh pehle tha. Aur jab woh (poori tarah niraash) wahan baitha tha, oont uske paas aaya, yahan tak ki us (oont) ne apni naak ki rassi uske haath mein rakh di. Allah apne banda ki tauba se, us shakhs se zyada khush hota hai jo (apna gum hua oont) is haalat mein paaye. Simak ne bayaan ki ki Sha'bi ki raay thi ki Nu'man ne ise Allah ke Rasool tak pahunchaya, lekin Simak ne ise khud (Nu'man se) nahi suna.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَجَعْفَرُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ جَعْفَرٌ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ، يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا 
 عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِيَادِ بْنِ لَقِيطٍ، عَنْ إِيَادٍ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله
 عليه وسلم ‏"‏ كَيْفَ تَقُولُونَ بِفَرَحِ رَجُلٍ انْفَلَتَتْ مِنْهُ رَاحِلَتُهُ تَجُرُّ زِمَامَهَا بِأَرْضٍ قَفْرٍ لَيْسَ
 بِهَا طَعَامٌ وَلاَ شَرَابٌ وَعَلَيْهَا لَهُ طَعَامٌ وَشَرَابٌ فَطَلَبَهَا حَتَّى شَقَّ عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ مَرَّتْ بِجِذْلِ شَجَرَةٍ
 فَتَعَلَّقَ زِمَامُهَا فَوَجَدَهَا مُتَعَلِّقَةً بِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْنَا شَدِيدًا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَمَا وَاللَّهِ لَلَّهُ أَشَدُّ فَرَحًا بِتَوْبَةِ عَبْدِهِ مِنَ الرَّجُلِ بِرَاحِلَتِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ جَعْفَرٌ
 حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِيَادٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ ‏.‏
50.en: Al-Bara' b. 'Azib reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: What is your opinion about the delight of a person whose camel loaded with the provisions of food and drink is lost and that moves about with its nosestring trailing upon the waterless desert in which there is neither food nor drink, and lie wanders about in search of that until he is completely exhausted and then accidentally it happens to pass by the trunk of a tree and its nosestring gets entangled in that and he finds it entangled therein? He (in response to the question of the Holy Prophet) said: Allah's Messenger, he would feel highly delighted. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said. By Allah, Allah is more delighted at the repentance of His servant than that person (as he finds his lost) camel.
50.hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Tumhaari kya raay hai us shakhs ki khushi ke baare mein jiska oont, khaane aur paani ke saamaan ke saath, gum ho jaata hai aur woh apni naak ki latakti rassi ke saath bina paani ki registaani zameen mein ghoomta hai jahan na khaana hai na paani, aur woh use dhoondhte huye ghoomta hai yahan tak ki woh poori tarah thak-haar jaata hai aur phir achaanak ye ek darakht ke tane ke paas se guzarta hai aur uski naak ki rassi usmein uljh jaati hai aur usse ye uljhi hui mil jaati hai? Isper unhone (Pavitr Nabi ke sawaal ke jawaab mein) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, use bahut khushi hogi.
