Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Allah ki qasam, Allah apne banda ki tauba se us shakhs se zyada khush hota hai jise (apna gum hua) oont mile.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا 
 عِكْرِمَةُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، - وَهُوَ
 عَمُّهُ - قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ لَلَّهُ أَشَدُّ فَرَحًا بِتَوْبَةِ عَبْدِهِ حِينَ يَتُوبُ
 إِلَيْهِ مِنْ أَحَدِكُمْ كَانَ عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ بِأَرْضِ فَلاَةٍ فَانْفَلَتَتْ مِنْهُ وَعَلَيْهَا طَعَامُهُ وَشَرَابُهُ فَأَيِسَ
 مِنْهَا فَأَتَى شَجَرَةً فَاضْطَجَعَ فِي ظِلِّهَا قَدْ أَيِسَ مِنْ رَاحِلَتِهِ فَبَيْنَا هُوَ كَذَلِكَ إِذَا هُوَ بِهَا
 قَائِمَةً عِنْدَهُ فَأَخَذَ بِخِطَامِهَا ثُمَّ قَالَ مِنْ شِدَّةِ الْفَرَحِ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ عَبْدِي وَأَنَا رَبُّكَ ‏.‏ أَخْطَأَ
 مِنْ شِدَّةِ الْفَرَحِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
50.en: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Allah is more pleased with the repentance of a servant as he turns towards Him for repentance than this that one amongst you is upon the camel in a waterless desert and there is upon (that camel) his provision of food and drink also and it is lost by him, and he having lost all hope (to get tbat) lies down in the shadow and is disappointed about his camel and there he finds that camel standing before him. He takes hold of his nosestring and then out of boundless joy says: 0 Lord, Thou art my servant and I am Thine Lord. He commits this mistake out of extreme delight.
50.hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Allah apne banda ki tauba se, jab woh Uski taraf tauba mein mudta hai, usse zyada khush hota hai is baat se ki tum mein se koi apne oont par ho bina paani ki registaani zameen mein aur uspar (oont par) uska khaane aur paani ka saamaan bhi ho aur woh use gum de baithe, aur poori tarah ummeed khoke chhaaya mein leT jaaye aur apne oont se mayoos ho jaaye aur wahan use apne saamne khada wahi oont mile. Woh uski naak ki rassi thaam leta hai aur phir behad khushi mein kehta hai: Aye Rab, Tu mera banda hai aur main Tera Rab hoon. Woh behad khushi ki wajah se ye galti karta hai.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا هَدَّابُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ لَلَّهُ أَشَدُّ فَرَحًا بِتَوْبَةِ عَبْدِهِ مِنْ أَحَدِكُمْ إِذَا اسْتَيْقَظَ عَلَى
 بَعِيرِهِ قَدْ أَضَلَّهُ بِأَرْضِ فَلاَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ 
 وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَحْمَدُ الدَّارِمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَبَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ،
 مَالِكٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
50.en: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Allah is more pleased with the repentance of His servant than if one of you gets up and he finds his camel missing in a waterless desert (and then he accidentally finds it). This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik through another chain of transmitters.
50.hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Allah apne banda ki tauba se usse zyada khush hota hai is baat se ki tum mein se koi uThe aur apna oont bina paani ki registaani zameen mein gum paaye (aur phir achaanak use paa le). Ye hadees Anas bin Malik (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، - قَاصِّ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ
 الْعَزِيزِ - عَنْ أَبِي صِرْمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ حِينَ حَضَرَتْهُ الْوَفَاةُ كُنْتُ كَتَمْتُ عَنْكُمْ
 شَيْئًا سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 يَقُولُ ‏
"‏ لَوْلاَ أَنَّكُمْ تُذْنِبُونَ لَخَلَقَ اللَّهُ خَلْقًا يُذْنِبُونَ يَغْفِرُ لَهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
50.en: Abu Sirma reported that when the time of the death of Abu Ayyub Ansari drew near, he said: I used to conceal from you a thing which I heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Had you not committed sins, Allah would have brought into existence a creation that would have committed sin (and Allah) would have forgiven them.
50.hi: Abu Sirma ne bayan kiya ki jab Abu Ayyub Ansari (RA) ki maut ka waqt qareeb aaya, unhone kaha: Main tumse ek baat chhupaya karta tha jo maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se suni thi, aur maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Agar tum gunah na karte, Allah aisi makhlooq banaata jo gunah karti (aur Allah) unhe maaf kar deta.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عِيَاضٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ
 عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْفِهْرِيُّ - حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ رِفَاعَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ كَعْبٍ الْقُرَظِيِّ، عَنْ 
 أَبِي صِرْمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏
"‏ لَوْ
 أَنَّكُمْ لَمْ تَكُنْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبٌ يَغْفِرُهَا اللَّهُ لَكُمْ لَجَاءَ اللَّهُ بِقَوْمٍ لَهُمْ ذُنُوبٌ يَغْفِرُهَا لَهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
50.en: Abu Ayyub Ansari reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: If you were not to commit sins, Allah would have swept you out of existence and would have replaced you by another people who have committed sin, and then asked forgiveness from Allah, and He would have granted them pardon.
50.hi: Abu Ayyub Ansari (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Agar tum gunah na karte, Allah tumhe zameen se hataakar tumhaari jagah aise doosre log laata jo gunah karte, aur phir Allah se maafi maangte, aur Woh unhe maafi deta.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ الْجَزَرِيِّ، عَنْ 
 يَزِيدَ بْنِ الأَصَمِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي
 بِيَدِهِ لَوْ لَمْ تُذْنِبُوا لَذَهَبَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ وَلَجَاءَ بِقَوْمٍ يُذْنِبُونَ فَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَ اللَّهَ فَيَغْفِرُ لَهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
50.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said: By Him in Whose Hand is my life, if you were not to commit sin, Allah would sweep you out of existence and He would replace (you by) those people who would commit sin and seek forgiveness from Allah, and He would have pardoned them.
50.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Us Hasti ki qasam Jiske Haath mein meri zindagi hai, agar tum gunah na karte, Allah tumhe zameen se hataakar tumhaari jagah aise log laata jo gunah karte aur Allah se maafi maangte, aur Woh unhe maaf kar deta.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، وَقَطَنُ بْنُ نُسَيْرٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِيَحْيَى - أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ،
 بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ إِيَاسٍ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيِّ، عَنْ حَنْظَلَةَ الأُسَيِّدِيِّ،
 قَالَ - وَكَانَ مِنْ كُتَّابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ - لَقِيَنِي أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَقَالَ كَيْفَ
 أَنْتَ يَا حَنْظَلَةُ قَالَ قُلْتُ نَافَقَ حَنْظَلَةُ قَالَ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ مَا تَقُولُ قَالَ قُلْتُ نَكُونُ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُذَكِّرُنَا بِالنَّارِ وَالْجَنَّةِ حَتَّى كَأَنَّا رَأْىَ عَيْنٍ فَإِذَا خَرَجْنَا مِنْ عِنْدِ
 رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَافَسْنَا الأَزْوَاجَ وَالأَوْلاَدَ وَالضَّيْعَاتِ فَنَسِينَا كَثِيرًا قَالَ
 أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَوَاللَّهِ إِنَّا لَنَلْقَى مِثْلَ هَذَا ‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقْتُ أَنَا وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ حَتَّى دَخَلْنَا عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم قُلْتُ نَافَقَ حَنْظَلَةُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم ‏"‏ وَمَا ذَاكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ نَكُونُ عِنْدَكَ تُذَكِّرُنَا بِالنَّارِ وَالْجَنَّةِ حَتَّى كَأَنَّا
 رَأْىَ عَيْنٍ فَإِذَا خَرَجْنَا مِنْ عِنْدِكَ عَافَسْنَا الأَزْوَاجَ وَالأَوْلاَدَ وَالضَّيْعَاتِ نَسِينَا كَثِيرًا ‏.‏
 فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ إِنْ لَوْ تَدُومُونَ عَلَى مَا تَكُونُونَ
 عِنْدِي وَفِي الذِّكْرِ لَصَافَحَتْكُمُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ عَلَى فُرُشِكُمْ وَفِي طُرُقِكُمْ وَلَكِنْ يَا حَنْظَلَةُ سَاعَةً
 وَسَاعَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ ‏.‏
50.en: Hanzala Usayyidi, who was amongst the scribes of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). reported: I met Abu Bakr. He said: Who are you? He (Hanzala) said: Hanzala has turned to be a hypocrite. He (Abu Bakr) said: Hallowed be Allah, what are you saying? Thereupon he said: I say that when we are in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) we ponder over Hell-Fire and Paradise as if we are seeing them with our very eyes and when we are away from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) we attend to our wives, our children, our business; most of these things (pertaining to After-life) slip out of our minds. Abu Bakr said: By Allah, I also experience the same. So I and Abu Bakr went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said to him: Allah's Messenger, Hanzala has turned to be a hypocrite. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: What has happened to you? I said: Allah's Messenger, when we are in your company, we are reminded of Hell-Fire and Paradise as if we are seeing them with our own eyes, but whenever we go away from you and attend to our wives, children and business, much of these things go out of our minds. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: By Him in Whose Hand is my life, if your state of mind remains the same as it is in my presence and you are always busy in remembrance (of Allah), the Angels will shake hands with you in your beds and in your paths but, Hanzala, time should be devoted (to the worldly affairs) and time (should be devoted to prayer and meditation). He (the Holy Prophet) said this thrice.
50.hi: Hanzala Usayyidi, jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke likhne walon (katibon) mein se the, ne bayan kiya: Main Abu Bakr se mila. Unhone kaha: Tum kaise ho? Unhone (Hanzala ne) kaha: Hanzala munafiq ho gaya hai. Unhone (Abu Bakr ne) kaha: Allah pavitra hai (Woh kamiyon se pak hai), tum ye kya keh rahe ho? Isper unhone kaha: Main kehta hoon ki jab hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein hote hain hum Jahannam ki aag aur Jannat ke baare mein isi tarah sochte hain jaise hum unhe apni khud ki aankhon se dekh rahe hon, aur jab hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se door hote hain hum apni zaujaon, apne bachchon, apne dhandhon mein masroof ho jaate hain; inmein se zyaadatar cheezein (Aakhirat se mutaliq) humaare zehan se nikal jaati hain. Abu Bakr ne kaha: Allah ki qasam, mujhe bhi yehi mehsoos hota hai. Isliye main aur Abu Bakr, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaye aur unse kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Hanzala munafiq ho gaya hai. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Tumhe kya hua hai? Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, jab hum aapki sohbat mein hote hain, humein Jahannam ki aag aur Jannat ki yaad aati hai jaise hum unhe apni khud ki aankhon se dekh rahe hon, lekin jab bhi hum aapse door jaate hain aur apni zaujaon, bachchon aur dhandhon mein masroof hote hain, inmein se bahut si cheezein humaare zehan se nikal jaati hain. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Us Hasti ki qasam Jiske Haath mein meri zindagi hai, agar tumhaari mansik haalat wahi rahe jo meri maujoodgi mein hoti hai aur tum hamesha (Allah ke) Zikr mein masroof raho, Farishte tumse apne bistaron par aur apne raaston par haath milaayenge, lekin, Hanzala, waqt (duniyaavi maamlon ke liye) alag rakha jaana chahiye aur waqt (namaz aur dhyaan ke liye bhi). Unhone (Pavitr Nabi ne) ye teen baar farmaaya.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، سَمِعْتُ أَبِي يُحَدِّثُ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ،
 الْجُرَيْرِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيِّ، عَنْ حَنْظَلَةَ، قَالَ كُنَّا عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 فَوَعَظَنَا فَذَكَّرَ النَّارَ - قَالَ - ثُمَّ جِئْتُ إِلَى الْبَيْتِ فَضَاحَكْتُ الصِّبْيَانَ وَلاَعَبْتُ الْمَرْأَةَ -
 قَالَ - فَخَرَجْتُ فَلَقِيتُ أَبَا بَكْرٍ فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لَهُ فَقَالَ وَأَنَا قَدْ فَعَلْتُ مِثْلَ مَا تَذْكُرُ ‏.‏ فَلَقِينَا
 رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ نَافَقَ حَنْظَلَةُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَهْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَحَدَّثْتُهُ
 بِالْحَدِيثِ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَأَنَا قَدْ فَعَلْتُ مِثْلَ مَا فَعَلَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا حَنْظَلَةُ سَاعَةً وَسَاعَةً وَلَوْ
 كَانَتْ تَكُونُ قُلُوبُكُمْ كَمَا تَكُونُ عِنْدَ الذِّكْرِ لَصَافَحَتْكُمُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ حَتَّى تُسَلِّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِي الطُّرُقِ
 ‏"‏ ‏.‏
50.en: Hanzala reported: We were in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he delivered to us a sermon and made a mention of Hell-Fire. Then I came to my house and began to laugh with my children and sport with my wife. (Hanzala) further reported: I went out and met Abu Bakr and made a mention of that to him. Thereupon he said: I have done the same as you have mentioned. So we went to see Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said to him: Allah's Messenger, Hanzala has turned to he a hypocrite. And he (the Holy Prophet) said Show respite. And then I narrated to him the story, and Abu Bakr said: I have done the same as he has done. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Hanzala, there is a time for worldly affairs and a time for (worship and devotion), and if your state of mind is always the same as it is at the time of remembrance of Allah, the Angels would shake hands with you and would greet you on the path by saying: As-Salamu-Alaikum.
50.hi: Hanzala ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein the aur unhone humein khutba diya aur Jahannam ki aag ka zikr kiya. Phir main apne ghar aaya aur apne bachchon ke saath hansne laga aur apni zauja ke saath khelne laga. (Hanzala ne) aage bataya: Main bahar nikla aur Abu Bakr se mila aur unhe iska zikr kiya. Isper unhone kaha: Maine bhi wahi kiya hai jo tumne bataya. Isliye hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se milne gaye aur unse kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Hanzala munafiq ho gaya hai. Aur unhone (Pavitr Nabi ne) kaha: Rukhsat do (aisa keh kar khud ko dosh mat do). Aur phir maine unhe poori kahani sunayi, aur Abu Bakr ne kaha: Maine bhi wahi kiya hai jo unhone kiya. Isper unhone (Pavitr Nabi ne) farmaaya: Hanzala, duniyaavi maamlon ke liye ek waqt hai aur (ibadat aur bandagi ke liye) ek waqt hai, aur agar tumhaari mansik haalat hamesha wahi rahe jo Allah ke Zikr ke waqt hoti hai, Farishte tumse haath milaayenge aur tumhe raaste par as-Salamu-Alaikum kahenge.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ دُكَيْنٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ،
 عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيِّ، عَنْ حَنْظَلَةَ التَّمِيمِيِّ الأُسَيِّدِيِّ الْكَاتِبِ، قَالَ كُنَّا عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله
 عليه وسلم فَذَكَّرَنَا الْجَنَّةَ وَالنَّارَ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِهِمَا ‏.‏
50.en: Hanzala Taimi Ufayyidi, the scribe of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), reported: We were in the presence of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he brought to our minds the problems pertaining to Paradise and Hell-Fire. The rest of the hadith is the same.
50.hi: Hanzala Taimi Usayyidi, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke likhne wale, ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki maujoodgi mein the aur unhone humaare zehan mein Jannat aur Jahannam ki aag se mutaliq maamlon ko taaza kiya. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ، - يَعْنِي الْحِزَامِيَّ - عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ 
 الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ لَمَّا خَلَقَ اللَّهُ الْخَلْقَ كَتَبَ
 فِي كِتَابِهِ فَهُوَ عِنْدَهُ فَوْقَ الْعَرْشِ إِنَّ رَحْمَتِي تَغْلِبُ غَضَبِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
50.en: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: When Allah created the creation as He was upon the Throne, He put down in His Book: Verily, My mercy predominates My wrath.
50.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jab Allah ne makhlooqaat banaayi jab Woh Arsh par tha, Usne Apni Kitaab mein ye darj kiya: Yaqeenan, Meri Rehmat Mere gusse par bhaari hai.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ 
 أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ سَبَقَتْ رَحْمَتِي غَضَبِي
 ‏"‏ ‏.‏
50.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, said: My mercy excels My wrath.
50.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna ki Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne farmaaya: Meri Rehmat Mere gusse par bhaari hai.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ خَشْرَمٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو ضَمْرَةَ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ،
 بْنِ مِينَاءَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ لَمَّا قَضَى اللَّهُ الْخَلْقَ
 كَتَبَ فِي كِتَابِهِ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ فَهُوَ مَوْضُوعٌ عِنْدَهُ إِنَّ رَحْمَتِي تَغْلِبُ غَضَبِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
50.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When Allah created the creation, He ordained for Himself and this document is with Him: Verily, My mercy predominates Mv wrath.
50.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Jab Allah ne makhlooqaat banaayi, Usne Apne liye ye muqarrar kiya, aur ye dastaavez Uske paas hai: Yaqeenan, Meri Rehmat Mere gusse par bhaari hai.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى التُّجِيبِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ،
 أَنَّ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 يَقُولُ ‏
"‏ جَعَلَ اللَّهُ الرَّحْمَةَ مِائَةَ جُزْءٍ فَأَمْسَكَ عِنْدَهُ تِسْعَةً وَتِسْعِينَ وَأَنْزَلَ فِي الأَرْضِ جُزْءًا
 وَاحِدًا فَمِنْ ذَلِكَ الْجُزْءِ تَتَرَاحَمُ الْخَلاَئِقُ حَتَّى تَرْفَعَ الدَّابَّةُ حَافِرَهَا عَنْ وَلَدِهَا خَشْيَةَ أَنْ
 تُصِيبَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
50.en: Abu Huraira reported: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah created mercy in one hundred parts and He retained with Him ninety-nine parts, and He has sent down upon the earth one part, and it is because of this one part that there is mutual love among the creation so much so that the animal lifts up its hoof from its young one, fearing that it might harm it.
50.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Allah ne Rehmat ko sau hisson mein banaaya aur Unnyaave (99) hisse Apne paas rakhe, aur Usne ek hissa zameen par nazil kiya, aur isi ek hisse ki wajah se makhlooqaat mein aapsi muhabbat hai, itni ki jaanwar apne bachche par se apna khur is Dar se uThA leta hai ki kahin use koi nuksaan na pahunche.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - يَعْنُونَ ابْنَ
 جَعْفَرٍ - عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ
 ‏
"‏ خَلَقَ اللَّهُ مِائَةَ رَحْمَةٍ فَوَضَعَ وَاحِدَةً بَيْنَ خَلْقِهِ وَخَبَأَ عِنْدَهُ مِائَةً إِلاَّ وَاحِدَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
50.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah created one hundred (parts of mercy) and He distributed one amongst His creation and kept this one hundred excepting one with Himself (for the Day of Resurrection).
50.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Allah ne sau (Rehmat ke hisse) banaaye aur ek hissa Apni makhlooq mein baanta aur ye sau hisse, ek ke ilawa, Apne paas rakhe (Qayamat ke din ke liye).

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ 
 أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مِائَةَ رَحْمَةٍ أَنْزَلَ مِنْهَا رَحْمَةً
 وَاحِدَةً بَيْنَ الْجِنِّ وَالإِنْسِ وَالْبَهَائِمِ وَالْهَوَامِّ فَبِهَا يَتَعَاطَفُونَ وَبِهَا يَتَرَاحَمُونَ وَبِهَا تَعْطِفُ
 الْوَحْشُ عَلَى وَلَدِهَا وَأَخَّرَ اللَّهُ تِسْعًا وَتِسْعِينَ رَحْمَةً يَرْحَمُ بِهَا عِبَادَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
50.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There are one hundred (parts of) mercy for Allah and He has sent down out of these one part of mercy upon the jinn and human beings and animals and the insects, and it is because of this (one part) that they love one another, show kindness to one another and even the beast treats its young one with affection, and Allah has reserved ninety nine parts of mercy with which He would treat His servants on the Day of Resurrection.
50.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Allah ke paas sau (hisson mein) Rehmat hai aur Usne inmein se ek hissa jinn, insaanon, jaanwaron aur keede-makode par nazil kiya, aur isi (ek hisse) ki wajah se woh ek-doosre se muhabbat karte hain, ek-doosre ke saath meherbaani se pesh aate hain aur jaanwar tak apne bachche ke saath narmi se pesh aata hai, aur Allah ne Rehmat ke ninnyaave (99) hisse apne paas rakhe hain jinse Woh Qayamat ke din Apne bandon ke saath vyavahaar karega.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ التَّيْمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو
 عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيُّ عَنْ سَلْمَانَ الْفَارِسِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ إِنَّ لِلَّهِ
 مِائَةَ رَحْمَةٍ فَمِنْهَا رَحْمَةٌ بِهَا يَتَرَاحَمُ الْخَلْقُ بَيْنَهُمْ وَتِسْعَةٌ وَتِسْعُونَ لِيَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
50.en: Salman Farisi reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Verily, there are one hundred (parts of) mercy for Allah, and it is one part of this mercy by virtue of which there is mutual love between the people and ninety-nine reserved for the Day of Resurrection.
50.hi: Salman Farsi (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Yaqeenan, Allah ke paas sau (hisson mein) Rehmat hai, aur is Rehmat ka ek hissa woh hai jiski wajah se logon mein aapsi muhabbat hai, aur ninnyaave (99) Qayamat ke din ke liye rakhe gaye hain.

50.ar: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
50.en: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Mu'tamir, reported on the authority of his father.
50.hi: Ye hadees Mu'tamir ki sanad se apne waalid se riwayat ki gayi hai.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ 
 سَلْمَانَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ خَلَقَ يَوْمَ خَلَقَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ
 مِائَةَ رَحْمَةٍ كُلُّ رَحْمَةٍ طِبَاقَ مَا بَيْنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالأَرْضِ فَجَعَلَ مِنْهَا فِي الأَرْضِ رَحْمَةً فَبِهَا
 تَعْطِفُ الْوَالِدَةُ عَلَى وَلَدِهَا وَالْوَحْشُ وَالطَّيْرُ بَعْضُهَا عَلَى بَعْضٍ فَإِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ الْقِيَامَةِ أَكْمَلَهَا
 بِهَذِهِ الرَّحْمَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
50.en: Salman reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Verily, Allah created, on the same very day when He created the heavens and the earth, one hundred parts of mercy. Every part of mercy is coextensive with the space between the heavens. and the earth and He out of this mercy endowed one part to the earth and it is because of this that the mother shows affection to her child and even the beasts and birds show kindness to one another and when there would be the Day of Resurrection, Allah would make full (use of Mercy).
50.hi: Salman (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Yaqeenan, Allah ne, usi din jab Usne aasmaan aur zameen banaaye, sau (hisson mein) Rehmat banaayi. Rehmat ka har hissa aasmaan aur zameen ke beech ki jagah jitna vishaal hai, aur Usne is Rehmat mein se ek hissa zameen ko diya, aur isi ki wajah se ek maa apne bachche ko muhabbat dikhaati hai aur yahan tak ki jaanwar aur parinde bhi ek-doosre ke saath meherbaani se pesh aate hain, aur jab Qayamat ka din aayega, Allah Rehmat ka poora istemal karega.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَهْلٍ التَّمِيمِيُّ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِحَسَنٍ -
 حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو غَسَّانَ، حَدَّثَنِي زَيْدُ بْنُ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ،
 أَنَّهُ قَالَ قَدِمَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِسَبْىٍ فَإِذَا امْرَأَةٌ مِنَ السَّبْىِ تَبْتَغِي
 إِذَا وَجَدَتْ صَبِيًّا فِي السَّبْىِ أَخَذَتْهُ فَأَلْصَقَتْهُ بِبَطْنِهَا وَأَرْضَعَتْهُ فَقَالَ لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَتَرَوْنَ هَذِهِ الْمَرْأَةَ طَارِحَةً وَلَدَهَا فِي النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْنَا لاَ وَاللَّهِ وَهِيَ تَقْدِرُ
 عَلَى أَنْ لاَ تَطْرَحَهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَلَّهُ أَرْحَمُ بِعِبَادِهِ مِنْ هَذِهِ
 بِوَلَدِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
50.en: 'Umar b. Khattab reported that there were brought some prisoners to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) amongst whom there was also a woman, who was searching (for someone) and when she found a child amongst the prisoners, she took hold of it, pressed it against her chest and provided it suck. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Do you think this woman would ever afford to throw her child in the Fire? We said: By Allah, so far as it lies in her power, she would never throw the child in Fire. ' Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Allah is more kind to His servants than this woman is to her child.
50.hi: Umar bin Khattab (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas kuch qaidi laaye gaye jinmein ek aurat bhi thi jo (kisi ki) talaash mein thi aur jab usne qaidiyon mein ek bachcha paaya, usne use pakda, apne seene se lagaaya aur use doodh pilaaya. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Tumhaari kya raay hai, kya ye aurat kabhi apne bachche ko aag mein phenkegi? Humne kaha: Allah ki qasam, jab tak ye uske vash mein hai, woh kabhi apne bachche ko aag mein nahi phenkegi. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Allah apne bandon ke saath is aurat se zyada meherbaan hai jitna ye apne bachche ke saath hai.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ جَمِيعًا عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ
 ابْنُ أَيُّوبَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، أَخْبَرَنِي الْعَلاَءُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ لَوْ يَعْلَمُ الْمُؤْمِنُ مَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ مِنَ الْعُقُوبَةِ مَا طَمِعَ بِجَنَّتِهِ أَحَدٌ وَلَوْ
 يَعْلَمُ الْكَافِرُ مَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ مِنَ الرَّحْمَةِ مَا قَنِطَ مِنْ جَنَّتِهِ أَحَدٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
50.en: 'Ala' reported on the authority of his father who reported on the authority of Abu Huraira that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: If a believer were to know the punishment (in Hell) none would have the audacity to aspire for Paradise (but he would earnestly desire to be rescued from Hell), and if a non-believer were to know what is there with Allah as a mercy. none would have been disappointed in regard to Paradise.
50.hi: Ala ne apne waalid ke hawaale se, Abu Huraira (RA) ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Agar ek momin ko (Jahannam ki) saza ka ilm ho jaaye, koi bhi Jannat mein daakhil hone ki himmat na kare (balki woh bas Jahannam se bachne ki khwaish rakhega), aur agar ek kaafir ko pata chal jaaye ki Allah ke paas kitni Rehmat hai, koi bhi Jannat ke baare mein mayoos na ho.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مَرْزُوقِ ابْنِ بِنْتِ مَهْدِيِّ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ 
 أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ قَالَ
 رَجُلٌ لَمْ يَعْمَلْ حَسَنَةً قَطُّ لأَهْلِهِ إِذَا مَاتَ فَحَرِّقُوهُ ثُمَّ اذْرُوا نِصْفَهُ فِي الْبَرِّ وَنِصْفَهُ فِي الْبَحْرِ
 فَوَاللَّهِ لَئِنْ قَدَرَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ لَيُعَذِّبَنَّهُ عَذَابًا لاَ يُعَذِّبُهُ أَحَدًا مِنَ الْعَالَمِينَ فَلَمَّا مَاتَ الرَّجُلُ فَعَلُوا
 مَا أَمَرَهُمْ فَأَمَرَ اللَّهُ الْبَرَّ فَجَمَعَ مَا فِيهِ وَأَمَرَ الْبَحْرَ فَجَمَعَ مَا فِيهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ لِمَ فَعَلْتَ هَذَا
 قَالَ مِنْ خَشْيَتِكَ يَا رَبِّ وَأَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ ‏.‏ فَغَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
50.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying that a person who had never done any good deed asked the members of his family to burn his dead body when he would die and to scatter half of its ashes over the land and half in the ocean. By Allah, if Allah finds him in His grip, He would torment him with a torment with which He did not afflict anyone amongst the people of the world; and when the person died, it was done to him as he had commanded (his family) to do. Allah commanded the land to collect (the ashes scattered on it) and He commanded the ocean and that collected (ashes) contained in it. Allah questioned him why he had done. that He said: My Lord, it is out of Thine fear that I have done it and Thou art well aware of it, and Allah granted him pardon:.
50.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya ki ek shakhs jisne kabhi koi nekokaar amal nahi kiya tha, ne apne khaandaan ke logon se kaha ki jab woh mar jaaye, uske murda badan ko jala dein aur uski aadhi raakh zameen par bikher dein aur aadhi samundar mein. Allah ki qasam, agar Allah use apni pakad mein le, to Woh use aisi saza dega jaisi Usne is duniya mein kisi ko nahi di hai; aur jab us shakhs ki maut hui, uske saath waisa hi kiya gaya jaisa usne hukum diya tha. Allah ne zameen ko hukum diya ki woh (bikheri hui raakh) ikattha kare, aur Usne samundar ko hukum diya, aur usne bhi apni ikattha (raakh) di. Allah ne usse poocha ki usne aisa kyun kiya. Usne kaha: Mere Rab, ye Tere Dar ki wajah se hai ki maine ye kiya, aur Tu isse achhi tarah waaqif hai, aur Allah ne use maafi de di.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ عَبْدٌ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ ابْنُ رَافِعٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ
 لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، قَالَ قَالَ لِيَ الزُّهْرِيُّ أَلاَ أُحَدِّثُكَ بِحَدِيثَيْنِ عَجِيبَيْنِ
 قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ أَخْبَرَنِي حُمَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ أَسْرَفَ رَجُلٌ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ فَلَمَّا حَضَرَهُ الْمَوْتُ أَوْصَى بَنِيهِ فَقَالَ إِذَا أَنَا مُتُّ
 فَأَحْرِقُونِي ثُمَّ اسْحَقُونِي ثُمَّ اذْرُونِي فِي الرِّيحِ فِي الْبَحْرِ فَوَاللَّهِ لَئِنْ قَدَرَ عَلَىَّ رَبِّي لَيُعَذِّبُنِي
 عَذَابًا مَا عَذَّبَهُ بِهِ أَحَدًا ‏.‏ قَالَ فَفَعَلُوا ذَلِكَ بِهِ فَقَالَ لِلأَرْضِ أَدِّي مَا أَخَذْتِ ‏.‏ فَإِذَا هُوَ قَائِمٌ
 فَقَالَ لَهُ مَا حَمَلَكَ عَلَى مَا صَنَعْتَ فَقَالَ خَشْيَتُكَ يَا رَبِّ - أَوْ قَالَ - مَخَافَتُكَ ‏.‏ فَغَفَرَ لَهُ
 بِذَلِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ 
 قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ وَحَدَّثَنِي حُمَيْدٌ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 قَالَ ‏"‏ دَخَلَتِ امْرَأَةٌ النَّارَ فِي هِرَّةٍ رَبَطَتْهَا فَلاَ هِيَ أَطْعَمَتْهَا وَلاَ هِيَ أَرْسَلَتْهَا تَأْكُلُ مِنْ
 خَشَاشِ الأَرْضِ حَتَّى مَاتَتْ هَزْلاً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ ذَلِكَ لِئَلاَّ يَتَّكِلَ رَجُلٌ وَلاَ يَيْأَسَ رَجُلٌ
 ‏.‏
50.en:
Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying that a person committed sin beyond measure and when he was going to die, he left this will: (When I die), bum my dead body and then cast them (the ashes) to the wind and in the ocean. By Allah, if my Lord takes hold of me, He would torment me as He has not tormented anyone else. They did as he had asked them to do. He (the Lord) said to the earth: Return what you have taken. And he was thus restored to his (original form). He (Allah) said to him: What prompted you to do this? He said: My Lord, it was Thine fear or Thine awe, and Allah pardoned him because of this. 

Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying that a woman was thrown into Hell-Fire because of a cat whom she had tied and did not provide it with food. nor did she set it free to eat vermin of the earth until it died emaciated. 

Az-Zuhri said: (These two ahadith) show that a person should neither feel confident (of getting into Paradise) because of his deeds, nor should he lose (all hopes) of getting into Paradise.
50.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya ki ek shakhs ne had se zyada gunah kiye, aur jab woh marne wala tha, usne ye wasiyat chhodi: (Jab main marun), mere murda badan ko jala dena aur phir unhe (raakh ko) hawaa mein aur samundar mein bikher dena. Allah ki qasam, agar mera Rab mujhe pakad le, to Woh mujhe aisi saza dega jaisi Usne kisi aur ko nahi di hai. Unhone waisa hi kiya jaisa usne unse karne ko kaha tha. Unhone (Allah ne) zameen se kaha: Jo tune liya hai woh wapas kar. Aur isi tarah woh apni asli soorat mein wapas laaya gaya. Unhone (Allah ne) usse kaha: Tujhe ye karne par kis cheez ne uksaaya? Usne kaha: Mere Rab, ye Tera Dar tha, ya Tera khauf, aur Allah ne isi wajah se use maaf kar diya. Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya ki ek aurat ko ek billi ki wajah se Jahannam ki aag mein phenka gaya jise usne baandh rakha tha aur use khaana nahi diya tha, na hi use azaad kiya taaki woh zameen ke keede-makode khaa sake, yahan tak ki woh (bhookh se) kamzor hokar mar gayi. Az-Zuhri ne kaha: (Ye do ahadees) darsaati hain ki kisi shakhs ko na to apne (nekokaar) amalon ki wajah se (Jannat mein jaane ka) pura bharosa hona chahiye, na hi use Jannat mein daakhil hone ki (poori tarah) umeed chhod deni chahiye.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي الزُّبَيْدِيُّ، قَالَ
 الزُّهْرِيُّ حَدَّثَنِي حُمَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ أَسْرَفَ عَبْدٌ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ مَعْمَرٍ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏"‏
 فَغَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ حَدِيثَ الْمَرْأَةِ فِي قِصَّةِ الْهِرَّةِ وَفِي حَدِيثِ الزُّبَيْدِيِّ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَقَالَ
 اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ لِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ أَخَذَ مِنْهُ شَيْئًا أَدِّ مَا أَخَذْتَ مِنْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
50.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying that a servant transgressed the litnit in committing sins. The rest of the hadith is the same but there is no mention of the story of the cat in it and in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Ziibaidl (the words are): " Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, said to everything which had taken a part of lies ashes to return what it had taken."
50.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya ki ek banda ne gunahon mein had paar kar li. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai lekin ismein billi ki kahani ka zikr nahi hai, aur Zubaidi ki sanad se riwayat ki hui hadees mein alfaaz hain: "Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne har us cheez se farmaaya jisne uski raakh ka koi hissa liya tha ki woh jo usne liya hai use wapas kare."

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، سَمِعَ 
 عُقْبَةَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْغَافِرِ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 ‏
"‏ أَنَّ رَجُلاً فِيمَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ رَاشَهُ اللَّهُ مَالاً وَوَلَدًا فَقَالَ لِوَلَدِهِ لَتَفْعَلُنَّ مَا آمُرُكُمْ بِهِ أَوْ لأُوَلِّيَنَّ
 مِيرَاثِي غَيْرَكُمْ إِذَا أَنَا مُتُّ فَأَحْرِقُونِي - وَأَكْثَرُ عِلْمِي أَنَّهُ قَالَ - ثُمَّ اسْحَقُونِي وَاذْرُونِي
 فِي الرِّيحِ فَإِنِّي لَمْ أَبْتَهِرْ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ خَيْرًا وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يَقْدِرُ عَلَىَّ أَنْ يُعَذِّبَنِي - قَالَ - فَأَخَذَ
 مِنْهُمْ مِيثَاقًا فَفَعَلُوا ذَلِكَ بِهِ وَرَبِّي فَقَالَ اللَّهُ مَا حَمَلَكَ عَلَى مَا فَعَلْتَ فَقَالَ مَخَافَتُكَ ‏.‏ قَالَ
 فَمَا تَلاَفَاهُ غَيْرُهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
50.en: Abu Sa'id Khudri reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said that a person amongst the earlier nations before you was conferred property and children by Allah, He said to his children: 'You must do as I command you to do, otherwise I will make others besides you as my inheritors. As I die, burn my body and blow my ashes in the wind as I do not find any merit of mine which would please Allah, and if Allah were to take hold of me, He would punish me. He took a pledge from them and they did as he commanded thein to do. Allah said: What prompted you to do this? He said: My Lord. Thine fear, and Allah did not punish him at all.
50.hi: Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya ki purani Ummaton mein se tumse pehle ek shakhs ko Allah ne maal aur bachche diye the. Usne apne bachchon se kaha: Tumhe wahi karna hoga jo main tumhe hukum deta hoon, warna main tumhaari jagah kisi aur ko apna waaris banaunga. Jab main maroon, mere badan ko jala dena aur meri raakh hawaa mein bikher dena, kyunki mujhe apna koi bhi aisa amal nazar nahi aata jo Allah ko khush kare, aur agar Allah mujhe apni pakad mein le, to Woh mujhe saza dega. Usne unse ek ehad liya aur unhone waisa hi kiya jaisa usne unhe hukum diya tha. Allah ne farmaaya: Tujhe ye karne par kis cheez ne uksaaya? Usne kaha: Mere Rab, Tera khauf, aur Allah ne use bilkul bhi saza nahi di.

50.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ الْحَارِثِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي أَبِي
 حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ،
 بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ قَتَادَةَ،
 ذَكَرُوا جَمِيعًا بِإِسْنَادِ شُعْبَةَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِهِ وَفِي حَدِيثِ شَيْبَانَ وَأَبِي عَوَانَةَ ‏"‏ أَنَّ رَجُلاً مِنَ
 النَّاسِ رَغَسَهُ اللَّهُ مَالاً وَوَلَدًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ التَّيْمِيِّ ‏"‏ فَإِنَّهُ لَمْ يَبْتَئِرْ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ خَيْرًا ‏"‏
 ‏.‏ قَالَ فَسَّرَهَا قَتَادَةُ لَمْ يَدَّخِرْ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ خَيْرًا ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ شَيْبَانَ ‏"‏ فَإِنَّهُ وَاللَّهِ مَا ابْتَأَرَ
 عِنْدَ اللَّهِ خَيْرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ أَبِي عَوَانَةَ ‏"‏ مَا امْتَأَرَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ بِالْمِيمِ ‏.‏
50.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording and Qatada explained the word" lam yasiru" as: " I find no good in store for rxie in the eye of Allah."
50.hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi sanad se alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai aur Qatada ne "Lam Yasir" lafz ki vyaakhya is tarah ki: "Mujhe Allah ki nazar mein apni koi bhi achhaai bachi hui nazar nahi aati."

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ،
 بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم فِيمَا يَحْكِي عَنْ رَبِّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَذْنَبَ عَبْدٌ ذَنْبًا فَقَالَ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي ‏.‏
 فَقَالَ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى أَذْنَبَ عَبْدِي ذَنْبًا فَعَلِمَ أَنَّ لَهُ رَبًّا يَغْفِرُ الذَّنْبَ وَيَأْخُذُ بِالذَّنْبِ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ
 عَادَ فَأَذْنَبَ فَقَالَ أَىْ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي ‏.‏ فَقَالَ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى عَبْدِي أَذْنَبَ ذَنْبًا فَعَلِمَ
 أَنَّ لَهُ رَبًّا يَغْفِرُ الذَّنْبَ وَيَأْخُذُ بِالذَّنْبِ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ عَادَ فَأَذْنَبَ فَقَالَ أَىْ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي ‏.‏ فَقَالَ
 تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى أَذْنَبَ عَبْدِي ذَنْبًا فَعَلِمَ أَنَّ لَهُ رَبًّا يَغْفِرُ الذَّنْبَ وَيَأْخُذُ بِالذَّنْبِ وَاعْمَلْ مَا
 شِئْتَ فَقَدْ غَفَرْتُ لَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى لاَ أَدْرِي أَقَالَ فِي الثَّالِثَةِ أَوِ الرَّابِعَةِ ‏"‏ اعْمَلْ
 مَا شِئْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
50.en:
Abu Huraira reported from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that his Lord, the Exalted and Glorious, thus said. A servant committed a sin and he said: O Allah, forgive me my sins, and Allah (the Exalted and Glorious) said: My servant commited a sin and then he came to realise that he has a Lord Who forgives the sins and takes to account (the sinner) for the sin. He then again committed a sin and said: My Lord, forgive me my sin, and Allah, the Exalted and High, said: My servant committed a sin and then came to realise that he has a Lord Who would forgive his sin or would take (him) to account for the sin. He again committed a sin and said: My Lord, forgive me for my sin, and Allah (the Exalted and High) said: My servant sas committed a sin and then came to realise that he has a Lord Who forgives the sins or takes (him) to account for sin. O servant, do what you like. I have granted you forgiveness. 
'Abd al-A'la said: I do not know whether he said thrice or four times to do" what you desire".
50.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye riwayat ki ki unke Rab, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne is tarah farmaaya: Ek banda ne gunah kiya aur usne kaha: Aye Allah, mere gunah maaf kar de, aur Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne farmaaya: Mere banda ne gunah kiya aur phir use ehsaas hua ki uska ek Rab hai Jo gunah maaf karta hai aur gunah ka hisaab bhi leta hai. Usne phir gunah kiya aur kaha: Mere Rab, mera gunah maaf kar de, aur Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne farmaaya: Mere banda ne gunah kiya aur phir use ehsaas hua ki uska ek Rab hai Jo uska gunah maaf karega ya use hisaab ke liye pakadega. Usne phir gunah kiya aur kaha: Mere Rab, mera gunah maaf kar de, aur Allah (Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar) ne farmaaya: Mere banda ne gunah kiya aur phir use ehsaas hua ki uska ek Rab hai Jo gunah maaf karta hai ya use hisaab ke liye pakadta hai. Aye banda, jo chaahe kar. Maine tujhe maaf kar diya hai. Abd al-A'la ne kaha: Mujhe nahi pata ki unhone "jo tu chaahta hai" teen baar kaha ya chaar baar.

50.ar:
قَالَ أَبُو أَحْمَدَ حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ زَنْجُويَهْ الْقُرَشِيُّ الْقُشَيْرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى،
 بْنُ حَمَّادٍ النَّرْسِيُّ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
50.en: The hadlth has been narrated on the authority of 'Abd al-A'la b. Hammad with the same chain of transmitters.
50.hi: Ye hadees Abd al-A'la bin Hammad ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ،
 بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ قَالَ كَانَ بِالْمَدِينَةِ قَاصٌّ يُقَالُ لَهُ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبِي عَمْرَةَ - قَالَ - فَسَمِعْتُهُ
 يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ إِنَّ عَبْدًا
 أَذْنَبَ ذَنْبًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ ‏.‏ وَذَكَرَ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ ‏"‏ أَذْنَبَ ذَنْبًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي
 الثَّالِثَةِ ‏"‏ قَدْ غَفَرْتُ لِعَبْدِي فَلْيَعْمَلْ مَا شَاءَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
50.en: Abu Huraira reported lie heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying that a servant committed a sin. The rest of the hadith is the same, but there is a slight variation of wording.
50.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna ki ek banda ne gunah kiya. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai lekin alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ،
 قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عُبَيْدَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ إِنَّ
 اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ يَبْسُطُ يَدَهُ بِاللَّيْلِ لِيَتُوبَ مُسِيءُ النَّهَارِ وَيَبْسُطُ يَدَهُ بِالنَّهَارِ لِيَتُوبَ مُسِيءُ
 اللَّيْلِ حَتَّى تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ مِنْ مَغْرِبِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ 
 وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
50.en:
Abu Musa reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying that Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, Stretches out His Hand during the night so that the people may repent for the fault committed from dawn till dusk and He stretches out His Hand during the day so that the people may repent for the fault committed from dusk to dawn. (He would accept repentance) before the sun rises in the west (before the Day of Resurrection). 

A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters.
50.hi: Abu Musa (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya ki Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, raat ko Apna Haath phailaate hain taaki log subah tak ke gunahon ki tauba maang sakein aur Woh din mein Apna Haath phailaate hain taaki log shaam se subah tak ke gunahon ki tauba maang sakein, (Woh tauba qubool karenge) suraj ke Pashchim se nikalne se pehle (Qayamat aane se pehle). Isi jaisi ek hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ،
 عُثْمَانُ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ لَيْسَ أَحَدٌ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ الْمَدْحُ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِنْ أَجْلِ ذَلِكَ مَدَحَ نَفْسَهُ وَلَيْسَ أَحَدٌ
 أَغْيَرَ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِنْ أَجْلِ ذَلِكَ حَرَّمَ الْفَوَاحِشَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
50.en: 'Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Nothing is more loveable to Allah than His praise as He has praised Himself and no one is more self-respecting than Allah Himself and it As because of this that He has prohibited abominable acts.
50.hi: Abdullah (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Koi bhi cheez Allah ko Uski khud ki hamd se zyada aziz nahi hai jaisa Usne khud Apni hamd ki hai, aur Allah se zyada koi bhi Apni izzat ka khyaal nahi rakhta, aur isi wajah se Usne ghinaune amalon ko mana kiya hai.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا 
 أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، وَأَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ،
 عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ لاَ أَحَدٌ أَغْيَرَ مِنَ اللَّهِ
 وَلِذَلِكَ حَرَّمَ الْفَوَاحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ وَلاَ أَحَدٌ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ الْمَدْحُ مِنَ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
50.en: 'Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: None is more self-respectidg than Allah and it is because of this that He has prohibited abominable acts-both visible and invisible-and none loves His praise more than Allah Himself.
50.hi: Abdullah (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Allah se zyada koi bhi Apni izzat ka khyaal nahi rakhta, aur isi wajah se Usne ghinaune amalon ko mana kiya hai - dikhne wale aur na dikhne wale donon - aur Allah se zyada koi bhi Apni khud ki hamd ko pasand nahi karta.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ 
 عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا وَائِلٍ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مَسْعُودٍ، يَقُولُ قُلْتُ لَهُ آنْتَ
 سَمِعْتَهُ مِنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ نَعَمْ وَرَفَعَهُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏
"‏ لاَ أَحَدٌ أَغْيَرَ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَلِذَلِكَ حَرَّمَ الْفَوَاحِشَ
 مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ وَلاَ أَحَدٌ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ الْمَدْحُ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَلِذَلِكَ مَدَحَ نَفْسَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
50.en: 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud reported it directly from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that he said: None is more self-respecting than Allah and it is because of this that He has prohibited abominable acts-both visible and invisible and nothing is loved by Allah more than the praise of His Ownself and it is because of this that He has praised Himself.
50.hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) ne seedhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye riwayat ki ki unhone farmaaya: Allah se zyada koi bhi Apni izzat ka khyaal nahi rakhta, aur isi wajah se Usne ghinaune amalon ko mana kiya hai - dikhne wale aur na dikhne wale donon - aur Allah ko Apni khud ki hamd se zyada koi bhi cheez aziz nahi hai, aur isi wajah se Usne Apni hamd ki hai.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ
 أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ،
 بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ لَيْسَ أَحَدٌ
 أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ الْمَدْحُ مِنَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ مِنْ أَجْلِ ذَلِكَ مَدَحَ نَفْسَهُ وَلَيْسَ أَحَدٌ أَغْيَرَ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِنْ
 أَجْلِ ذَلِكَ حَرَّمَ الْفَوَاحِشَ وَلَيْسَ أَحَدٌ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ الْعُذْرُ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِنْ أَجْلِ ذَلِكَ أَنْزَلَ الْكِتَابَ
 وَأَرْسَلَ الرُّسُلَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
50.en: Abdullah b. Mas'ud reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: None loves one's own praise more than Allah, the Exalted and Glurious, does. It is because of this that He has praised Himself, and none is more self-respecting than Allah and it is because of this that He has prohibited abominable acts and there is none who is more anxious to accept the apologies of the people than Allah Himself and it is because of this that He has revealed the Book and sent the Messengers.
50.hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Koi bhi apni hamd ko utni muhabbat nahi karta jitna Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, karta hai. Isi wajah se Usne Apni hamd ki hai, aur Allah se zyada koi bhi Apni izzat ka khyaal nahi rakhta aur isi wajah se Usne ghinaune amalon ko mana kiya hai, aur koi bhi Allah se zyada logon ka uzr qubool karne ke liye betaab nahi hai, aur isi wajah se Usne Kitaab utaari aur Rasool bheje.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ حَجَّاجِ بْنِ أَبِي،
 عُثْمَانَ قَالَ قَالَ يَحْيَى وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله
 عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَغَارُ وَإِنَّ الْمُؤْمِنَ يَغَارُ وَغَيْرَةُ اللَّهِ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ الْمُؤْمِنُ مَا حَرَّمَ عَلَيْهِ
 ‏"‏ ‏.‏
50.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah is self-respecting and a believer is also self-respecting and the respect of Allah is injured if a believer does what He has forbidden him to do.
50.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Allah Apni izzat ka khyaal rakhne wale hain aur ek momin bhi apni izzat ka khyaal rakhta hai, aur Allah ki izzat ko tab thes pahunchti hai jab momin woh karta hai jo Usne use karne se mana kiya hai.

50.ar:
قَالَ يَحْيَى وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ، أَنَّ عُرْوَةَ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتَ أَبِي
 بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَتْهُ أَنَّهَا، سَمِعَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏
"‏ لَيْسَ شَىْءٌ أَغْيَرَ مِنَ اللَّهِ
 عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
50.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Asma' daughter of Abu Bakr, through another chain of transmitters.
50.hi: Ye hadees Asma (Abu Bakr ki beti RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبَانُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، وَحَرْبُ بْنُ شَدَّادٍ،
 عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ رِوَايَةِ حَجَّاجٍ حَدِيثَ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ خَاصَّةً وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ حَدِيثَ أَسْمَاءَ ‏.‏
50.en: Abu Salama reported from Abu Huraira that he narrated that Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon hin) said: There is none more self-respecting than Allah, the Exalted and Glorious There is no mention of the narration of Asma'.
50.hi: Abu Salama ne Abu Huraira (RA) se riwayat ki ki unhone bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Allah se zyada koi bhi Apni izzat ka khyaal nahi rakhta. Ismein Asma (RA) ki riwayat ka koi zikr nahi hai.

50.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الْمُقَدَّمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْمُفَضَّلِ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى،
 بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ
 ‏
"‏ لاَ شَىْءَ أَغْيَرُ مِنَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
50.en: Asma' reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: There is none more self-respecting than Allah, the Exalted and Glorious.
50.hi: Asma (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, se zyada koi bhi Apni izzat ka khyaal nahi rakhta.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ - عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ 
 أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ الْمُؤْمِنُ يَغَارُ وَاللَّهُ أَشَدُّ
 غَيْرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
50.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him ) as saying: A believer is self-respecting and Allah is extremely self-respecting.
50.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Ek momin apni izzat ka khyaal rakhta hai aur Allah bahut zyada Apni izzat ka khyaal rakhte hain.

50.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْعَلاَءَ،
 بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
50.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba through another chain of transmitters.
50.hi: Ye hadees Shu'ba ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ فُضَيْلُ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ يَزِيدَ،
 بْنِ زُرَيْعٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي كَامِلٍ - حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ، حَدَّثَنَا التَّيْمِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ،
 بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ أَنَّ رَجُلاً، أَصَابَ مِنِ امْرَأَةٍ قُبْلَةً فَأَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ لَهُ ذَلِكَ
 - قَالَ - فَنَزَلَتْ ‏{‏ أَقِمِ الصَّلاَةَ طَرَفَىِ النَّهَارِ وَزُلَفًا مِنَ اللَّيْلِ إِنَّ الْحَسَنَاتِ يُذْهِبْنَ السَّيِّئَاتِ
 ذَلِكَ ذِكْرَى لِلذَّاكِرِينَ‏}‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ الرَّجُلُ أَلِيَ هَذِهِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏
"‏ لِمَنْ عَمِلَ بِهَا مِنْ
 أُمَّتِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
50.en: 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud reported that a person kissed a woman and he came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and made a mention of that to him. It was (on this occasion) that this verse was revealed: " And observe prayer at the (two) ends of the day and in the first hours of the night. Surely, good deeds take away evil deeds. That is a reminder for the mindful" (xi. 115). That person said: Allah's Messenger, does it concern me only? He (the Holy Prophet) said: It concerns every one of my Unimah, who acts according to it.
50.hi: Abdullah bin Mas'ud (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs ne ek aurat ko chooma aur woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unhe iska zikr kiya. (Isi mauke par) ye aayat nazil hui: "Aur namaz ka ehteraam karo din ke (do) siron par aur raat ke pehle ghantoon mein. Yaqeenan, nekokaar amal bure amalon ko mita dete hain. Ye Dhyaan rakhne walon ke liye ek yaad-daasht hai" (11:114). Us shakhs ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya ye sirf mujhpar hi laagoo hoti hai? Unhone (Pavitr Nabi ne) farmaaya: Ye meri Ummat mein se har us shakhs par laagoo hoti hai jo isper amal karta hai.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُثْمَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ،
 مَسْعُودٍ أَنَّ رَجُلاً، أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ أَنَّهُ أَصَابَ مِنِ امْرَأَةٍ إِمَّا قُبْلَةً أَوْ
 مَسًّا بِيَدٍ أَوْ شَيْئًا كَأَنَّهُ يَسْأَلُ عَنْ كَفَّارَتِهَا - قَالَ - فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ
 حَدِيثِ يَزِيدَ ‏.‏
50.en: Ibn Mas'ud reported that a person came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and told him that he had kissed a woman or touched her with his hand or did something like this. He inquired of him about its expiation. It was (on this occasion) that Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, revealed this verse (as mentioned above).
50.hi: Ibn Mas'ud (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unhe bataya ki usne ek aurat ko chooma ya apne haath se chhua ya isi jaisa kuch kiya. Usne unse iske kaffare ke baare mein poocha. (Isi mauke par) Allah, Buland-o-Azeem aur Shaandaar, ne ye aayat (upar bataayi gayi) nazil ki.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ التَّيْمِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ قَالَ
أَصَابَ رَجُلٌ مِنِ امْرَأَةٍ شَيْئًا دُونَ الْفَاحِشَةِ فَأَتَى عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ فَعَظَّمَ عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ أَتَى أَبَا
بَكْرٍ فَعَظَّمَ عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ يَزِيدَ وَالْمُعْتَمِرِ ‏.‏
50.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Sulaiman Taimi with the same chain of transmitters that a person had taken liberty with a woman less than fomication. He came to 'Umar b. Khattab and he took it to be a serious offence. Then he came to Abu Bakr and he also took it to be a serious offence. Then he came the Allahs Apostle (ﷺ) and he made a mention of this to him. The rest of the hadith is the same.
50.hi: Ye hadees Sulaiman Taimi ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai ki ek shakhs ne kisi aurat ke saath, zina se kam koi galat harkat ki thi. Woh Umar bin Khattab ke paas aaya aur unhone ise ek sangin gunah maana. Phir woh Abu Bakr ke paas aaya aur unhone bhi ise ek sangin gunah maana. Phir woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur unhe iska zikr kiya. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ - وَاللَّفْظُ لِيَحْيَى
- قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ 
عَلْقَمَةَ، وَالأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ
اللَّهِ إِنِّي عَالَجْتُ امْرَأَةً فِي أَقْصَى الْمَدِينَةِ وَإِنِّي أَصَبْتُ مِنْهَا مَا دُونَ أَنْ أَمَسَّهَا فَأَنَا هَذَا
فَاقْضِ فِيَّ مَا شِئْتَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ عُمَرُ لَقَدْ سَتَرَكَ اللَّهُ لَوْ سَتَرْتَ نَفْسَكَ - قَالَ - فَلَمْ يَرُدَّ
النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَيْئًا فَقَامَ الرَّجُلُ فَانْطَلَقَ فَأَتْبَعَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
رَجُلاً دَعَاهُ وَتَلاَ عَلَيْهِ هَذِهِ الآيَةَ ‏{‏ أَقِمِ الصَّلاَةَ طَرَفَىِ النَّهَارِ وَزُلَفًا مِنَ اللَّيْلِ إِنَّ الْحَسَنَاتِ يُذْهِبْنَ السَّيِّئَاتِ ذَلِكَ ذِكْرَى لِلذَّاكِرِينَ‏}‏ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ هَذَا لَهُ خَاصَّةً قَالَ
‏"‏ بَلْ لِلنَّاسِ كَافَّةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
50.en: 'Abdullah reported that a person came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger, I sported with a woman in the outskirts of Medina, and I have committed an offence short of fornication. Here I am (before you), kindly deliver verdict about me which you deem fit. Unar said: Allah concealed your fault. You had better conceal it yourself also. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), however, gave no reply to him. The man stood up and went away and Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) sent a person after him to call him and be recited this verse:" And observe prayer at the ends of the day and in the first hours of the night. Surely, good deeds take away evil deeds. That is a reminder for the mindful" (xi. 115). A person amongst the people said: Allah's Apostle, does it concern this marn only? Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: No, but the people at large.
50.hi: Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, maine Madina ke bahari ilaake mein ek aurat ke saath (jinsi) khelbaad ki hai, aur maine zina se kam ek gunah kiya hai. Ye raha main (aapke saamne), meherbaani karke mere baare mein jo bhi faisla theek samjhen dein. Umar ne kaha: Allah ne tumhaari khaami chhupaayi hai. Tumhe bhi khud isse chhupaana chahiye tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW), halaanki, ne use koi jawaab nahi diya. Woh shakhs khada hua aur chala gaya, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne uske peeche ek shakhs bheja use bulaane ke liye, aur unhone ye aayat padhi: "Aur namaz ka ehteraam karo din ke (do) siron par aur raat ke pehle ghantoon mein. Yaqeenan, nekokaar amal bure amalon ko mita dete hain. Ye Dhyaan rakhne walon ke liye ek yaad-daasht hai" (11:114). Logon mein se ek shakhs ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya ye sirf isi shakhs par laagoo hoti hai? Isper unhone (Pavitr Nabi ne) farmaaya: Nahi, balki (ye) sab logon par (laagoo hoti hai).

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ الْحَكَمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْعِجْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ،
عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ خَالِهِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ
صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ أَبِي الأَحْوَصِ وَقَالَ فِي حَدِيثِهِ فَقَالَ مُعَاذٌ يَا رَسُولَ
اللَّهِ هَذَا لِهَذَا خَاصَّةً أَوْ لَنَا عَامَّةً قَالَ ‏
"‏ بَلْ لَكُمْ عَامَّةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
50.en: This hadith has been transmitted by Abu al-Ahwas and in this (these words are) also found: Mu'adh said: Allah's Messenger, does it concern this particular case or to all of us? And he (the Holy Prophet) said: Of course, to all of you.
50.hi: Ye hadees Abu al-Ahwas ne riwayat ki hai aur ismein (ye alfaaz bhi) milte hain: Mu'adh ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya ye sirf isi maamle par laagoo hoti hai ya humme se sab par? Aur unhone (Pavitr Nabi ne) farmaaya: Zaroor, tum sab par.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَاصِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ،
بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ
يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَصَبْتُ حَدًّا فَأَقِمْهُ عَلَىَّ - قَالَ - وَحَضَرَتِ الصَّلاَةُ فَصَلَّى مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ
صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمَّا قَضَى الصَّلاَةَ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي أَصَبْتُ حَدًّا فَأَقِمْ فِيَّ
كِتَابَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ هَلْ حَضَرْتَ الصَّلاَةَ مَعَنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ قَدْ غُفِرَ لَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
50.en: Anas reported that a person came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Allah's Messenger, I have committed an offence which deserves imposition of haad, so impose it upon me according to the Book of Allah. Thereupon he said: Were you not present with us at the time of prayer? He said: Yes. Thereupon he said: You have been granted pardon.
50.hi: Anas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, maine aisa gunah kiya hai jo Hadd (Islami saza) ke laayak hai, isliye mujhpar Allah ki Kitaab ke mutabik ise laagoo kijiye. Isper unhone (Pavitr Nabi ne) farmaaya: Kya tum namaz ke waqt humaare saath maujood nahi the? Usne kaha: Haan. Isper unhone farmaaya: Tumhe maafi de di gayi hai.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِزُهَيْرٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا 
 عُمَرُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَدَّادٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُمَامَةَ، قَالَ بَيْنَمَا رَسُولُ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْمَسْجِدِ وَنَحْنُ قُعُودٌ مَعَهُ إِذْ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ
 إِنِّي أَصَبْتُ حَدًّا فَأَقِمْهُ عَلَىَّ ‏.‏ فَسَكَتَ عَنْهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ أَعَادَ فَقَالَ
 يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي أَصَبْتُ حَدًّا فَأَقِمْهُ عَلَىَّ ‏.‏ فَسَكَتَ عَنْهُ وَأُقِيمَتِ الصَّلاَةُ فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ
 نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ أَبُو أُمَامَةَ فَاتَّبَعَ الرَّجُلُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 حِينَ انْصَرَفَ وَاتَّبَعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْظُرُ مَا يَرُدُّ عَلَى الرَّجُلِ فَلَحِقَ
 الرَّجُلُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي أَصَبْتُ حَدًّا فَأَقِمْهُ عَلَىَّ
 - قَالَ أَبُو أُمَامَةَ - فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَرَأَيْتَ حِينَ خَرَجْتَ مِنْ
 بَيْتِكَ أَلَيْسَ قَدْ تَوَضَّأْتَ فَأَحْسَنْتَ الْوُضُوءَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ثُمَّ شَهِدْتَ
 الصَّلاَةَ مَعَنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ نَعَمْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 ‏"‏ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ غَفَرَ لَكَ حَدَّكَ - أَوْ قَالَ - ذَنْبَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
50.en: Abu Umama reported: We were sitting in the mosque in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). A person came there and said: Allah's Messenger, I have committed an offence which deserves the imposition of hadd upon me, so impose it upon me. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) kept silent. He repeated it and said: Allah's Messenger, I have committed an offence which deserves the imposition of hadd upon me, so impose it upon me. He (the Holy Prophet) kept silent, and it was at this time that Iqama was pronounced for prayer (and the prayer was observed). And when Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) had concluded the payer that person followed Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Abu Umama said: I too followed Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) after he had concluded the prayer, so that I should know what answer he would give to that person. That person remained attached to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger, I have committed an offence which deserves imposition of hadd upon me, so impose it upon me. Abu Umama reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him: Didn't you see that as you got out of the house, you performed ablution perfectly well. He said: Allah's Messenger, of course. I did it. He again said to him: Then you observed prayer along with us. He said: Allah's Messenger, yes, it is so. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him: Verily, Allah has exempted you from the imposition of hadd, or he said. From your sin.
50.hi: Abu Umama (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum masjid mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein baithe the. Ek shakhs wahan aaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, maine aisa gunah kiya hai jo Hadd ke laayak hai, isliye mujhpar Hadd laagoo kijiye. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) khamosh rahe. Usne (apni baat) dohraayi aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, maine aisa gunah kiya hai jo Hadd ke laayak hai, isliye mujhpar Hadd laagoo kijiye. Woh (Pavitr Nabi) khamosh rahe, aur isi waqt namaz ke liye Iqama padhi gayi (aur namaz padhi gayi). Aur jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne namaz khatm ki, woh shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke peeche gaya. Abu Umama ne kaha: Main bhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke peeche gaya, unke namaz khatm karne ke baad, taaki mujhe pata chale ki woh us shakhs ko kya jawaab dete hain. Woh shakhs Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath juda raha aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, maine aisa gunah kiya hai jo Hadd ke laayak hai, isliye mujhpar Hadd laagoo kijiye. Abu Umama ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne usse kaha: Kya tumne ye nahi dekha ki jab tum ghar se nikle, tumne poore adab se wuzu kiya? Usne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, zaroor, maine aisa kiya. Unhone dobara usse kaha: Phir tumne humaare saath namaz padhi. Usne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, haan, aisa hi hai. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne usse kaha: Yaqeenan, Allah ne tumhe Hadd se maafi de di hai, ya unhone kaha, tumhaare gunah se.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا 
مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الصِّدِّيقِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّ نَبِيَّ
اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ كَانَ فِيمَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ رَجُلٌ قَتَلَ تِسْعَةً وَتِسْعِينَ نَفْسًا
فَسَأَلَ عَنْ أَعْلَمِ أَهْلِ الأَرْضِ فَدُلَّ عَلَى رَاهِبٍ فَأَتَاهُ فَقَالَ إِنَّهُ قَتَلَ تِسْعَةً وَتِسْعِينَ نَفْسًا
فَهَلْ لَهُ مِنَ تَوْبَةٍ فَقَالَ لاَ ‏.‏ فَقَتَلَهُ فَكَمَّلَ بِهِ مِائَةً ثُمَّ سَأَلَ عَنْ أَعْلَمِ أَهْلِ الأَرْضِ فَدُلَّ عَلَى
رَجُلٍ عَالِمٍ فَقَالَ إِنَّهُ قَتَلَ مِائَةَ نَفْسٍ فَهَلْ لَهُ مِنْ تَوْبَةٍ فَقَالَ نَعَمْ وَمَنْ يَحُولُ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ التَّوْبَةِ
انْطَلِقْ إِلَى أَرْضِ كَذَا وَكَذَا فَإِنَّ بِهَا أُنَاسًا يَعْبُدُونَ اللَّهَ فَاعْبُدِ اللَّهَ مَعَهُمْ وَلاَ تَرْجِعْ إِلَى
أَرْضِكَ فَإِنَّهَا أَرْضُ سَوْءٍ ‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقَ حَتَّى إِذَا نَصَفَ الطَّرِيقَ أَتَاهُ الْمَوْتُ فَاخْتَصَمَتْ فِيهِ
مَلاَئِكَةُ الرَّحْمَةِ وَمَلاَئِكَةُ الْعَذَابِ فَقَالَتْ مَلاَئِكَةُ الرَّحْمَةِ جَاءَ تَائِبًا مُقْبِلاً بِقَلْبِهِ إِلَى اللَّهِ ‏.‏ وَقَالَتْ
مَلاَئِكَةُ الْعَذَابِ إِنَّهُ لَمْ يَعْمَلْ خَيْرًا قَطُّ ‏.‏ فَأَتَاهُمْ مَلَكٌ فِي صُورَةِ آدَمِيٍّ فَجَعَلُوهُ بَيْنَهُمْ فَقَالَ
قِيسُوا مَا بَيْنَ الأَرْضَيْنِ فَإِلَى أَيَّتِهِمَا كَانَ أَدْنَى فَهُوَ لَهُ ‏.‏ فَقَاسُوهُ فَوَجَدُوهُ أَدْنَى إِلَى الأَرْضِ
الَّتِي أَرَادَ فَقَبَضَتْهُ مَلاَئِكَةُ الرَّحْمَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قَتَادَةُ فَقَالَ الْحَسَنُ ذُكِرَ لَنَا أَنَّهُ لَمَّا أَتَاهُ الْمَوْتُ
نَأَى بِصَدْرِهِ ‏.‏
50.en: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There was a person before you who had killed ninety-nine persons and then made an inquiry about the learned persons of the world (who could show him the way to salvation). He was directed to a monk. He came to him and told him that he had killed ninety-nine persons and asked him whether there was any scope for his repentance to be accepted. He said: No. He killed him also and thus completed one hundred. He then asked about the learned persons of the earth and he was directed to a scholar, and he told him that he had killed one hundred persons and asked him whether there was any scope for his repentance to be accepted. He said: Yes; what stands between you and the repentance? You better go to such and such land; there are people devoted to prayer and worship and you also worship along with them and do not come to the land of yours since it was an evil land (for you). So he went away and he had hardly covered half the distance when death came to him and there was a dispute between the angels of mercy and the angels of punishment. The angels of mercy said: This man has come as a penitant and remorseful to Allah and the angels of punishment said: He has done no good at all. Then there came another angel in the form of a human being in order to decide between them. He said: You measure the land to which he has drawn near. They measured it and found him nearer to the land where he intended to go (the land of piety), and so the angels of mercy took possession of it. Qatada said that Hasan told him that it was said to them that as death approached him, he crawled upon his chest (and managed) to slip in the land of mercy.
50.hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Tumse pehle ek shakhs tha jisne ninnyaave (99) log qatal kiye the aur phir usne duniya ke ilm waalon ke baare mein poochh-taachh ki (jo use mukti ka raasta dikha sakte). Use ek sanyaasi (paadri) ki taraf bheja gaya. Woh unke paas aaya aur unhe bataya ki usne ninnyaave logon ko qatal kiya hai aur unse poocha ki kya uski tauba qubool hone ki koi gunjaish hai. Unhone kaha: Nahi. Usne unhe bhi qatal kar diya aur is tarah sau poore kiye. Phir usne zameen ke ilm waalon ke baare mein poocha aur use ek aalim ki taraf bheja gaya, aur usne unhe bataya ki usne sau logon ko qatal kiya hai aur unse poocha ki kya uski tauba qubool hone ki koi gunjaish hai. Unhone kaha: Haan; tumhaare aur tauba ke beech kya rukaawat hai? Behtar hoga ki tum aisi-aisi zameen mein jao; wahan aise log hain jo namaz aur ibadat mein masroof hain aur tum bhi unke saath ibadat karo aur apni zameen mein wapas mat aana kyunki ye tumhaare liye ek bad-shagun zameen thi. Isliye woh chal pada aur usne aadhi doori bhi tay nahi ki thi ki usse maut aa gayi, aur Rehmat ke Farishton aur Saza ke Farishton ke beech ek jhagda ho gaya. Rehmat ke Farishton ne kaha: Ye shakhs pachhtaawe aur tauba ke saath Allah ki taraf aaya hai, aur Saza ke Farishton ne kaha: Usne bilkul koi nekokaari nahi ki. Phir ek doosra Farishta insaan ki soorat mein aaya taaki unke beech faisla kare. Usne kaha: Us zameen ki doori naapo jiske woh qareeb hua hai. Unhone use naapa aur paaya ki woh us zameen ke zyada qareeb hai jahan woh jaana chahta tha (Rehmat ki zameen), aur isliye Rehmat ke Farishton ne use apni takdeer mein le liya. Qatada ne kaha ki Hasan ne unhe bataya ki jab maut uske qareeb aayi, woh apne seene ke bal ghisatta hua Rehmat ki zameen mein pahuncha.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ 
 أَبَا الصِّدِّيقِ النَّاجِيَّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ أَنَّ رَجُلاً
 قَتَلَ تِسْعَةً وَتِسْعِينَ نَفْسًا فَجَعَلَ يَسْأَلُ هَلْ لَهُ مِنْ تَوْبَةٍ فَأَتَى رَاهِبًا فَسَأَلَهُ فَقَالَ لَيْسَتْ
 لَكَ تَوْبَةٌ ‏.‏ فَقَتَلَ الرَّاهِبَ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ يَسْأَلُ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ إِلَى قَرْيَةٍ فِيهَا قَوْمٌ صَالِحُونَ
 فَلَمَّا كَانَ فِي بَعْضِ الطَّرِيقِ أَدْرَكَهُ الْمَوْتُ فَنَأَى بِصَدْرِهِ ثُمَّ مَاتَ فَاخْتَصَمَتْ فِيهِ مَلاَئِكَةُ
 الرَّحْمَةِ وَمَلاَئِكَةُ الْعَذَابِ فَكَانَ إِلَى الْقَرْيَةِ الصَّالِحَةِ أَقْرَبَ مِنْهَا بِشِبْرٍ فَجُعِلَ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا ‏"‏
 ‏.‏
50.en: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying that a man killed ninety-nine persons and then he began to make an inquiry whether there was any way left for him for repentance. He came to a monk and asked him about that, and he said: There is no chance for repentance for you. He killed the monk also and then began to make an inquiry and moved from one village to another village where there lived pious persons, and as he had covered some distance, he was overtaken by death, but he managed to crawl upon his chest (to the side nearer to the place where the pious men lived). He died and then there was a dispute between the angels of mercy and the angels of punishment and (when it was measured) he was found to be nearer to the village where pious persons were living equal to the Space of a span and he was thus included among them.
50.hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna ki ek aadmi ne ninnyaave logon ko qatal kiya aur phir usne poochh-taachh shuru ki ki kya uske liye tauba ki koi gunjaish bachi hai. Woh ek sanyaasi ke paas gaya aur unse iske baare mein poocha, aur unhone kaha: Tumhaare liye tauba ki koi gunjaish nahi hai. Usne sanyaasi ko bhi qatal kar diya aur phir poochh-taachh shuru ki aur ek gaon se doosre gaon jaane laga jahan nekokaar log rehte the, aur jab usne kuch doori tay kar li, use maut ne aa dabocha, lekin usne apne seene ke bal (us jagah ki taraf) ghisatna shuru kiya jahan nekokaar log rehte the. Uski maut ho gayi aur phir Rehmat ke Farishton aur Saza ke Farishton ke beech ek jhagda hua, aur (jab naapa gaya) woh us gaon ke ek baalisht ke barabar qareeb paaya gaya jahan nekokaar log rehte the, aur is tarah use unmein shaamil kiya gaya.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ
 نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ مُعَاذِ بْنِ مُعَاذٍ وَزَادَ فِيهِ ‏
"‏ فَأَوْحَى اللَّهُ إِلَى هَذِهِ أَنْ تَبَاعَدِي وَإِلَى هَذِهِ أَنْ
 تَقَرَّبِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
50.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Qatida with the same chain of transmitters but (with this variation of wording): " Allah commanded the earth (from where) he wanted to come out to move itself away and to the other earth (where he wanted to go) to draw nearer."
50.hi: Ye hadees Qatada ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai lekin (is alfaazon ke antar ke saath): "Allah ne us zameen ko, jahan se woh nikalna chaahta tha, hukum diya ki woh khud ko door hataaye, aur doosri zameen ko (jahan woh jaana chaahta tha) khud ko qareeb laane ka hukum diya."

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِي،
 بُرْدَةَ عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ إِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ الْقِيَامَةِ
 دَفَعَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ إِلَى كُلِّ مُسْلِمٍ يَهُودِيًّا أَوْ نَصْرَانِيًّا فَيَقُولُ هَذَا فَكَاكُكَ مِنَ النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
50.en: Abu Musa' reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: When it will be the Day of Resurrection Allah would deliver to every Muslim a Jew or a Christian and say: That is your rescue from Hell-Fire.
50.hi: Abu Musa (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jab Qayamat ka din hoga, Allah har Musalman ko ek Yahudi ya Isaayi soonpega aur farmaayega: Ye Jahannam ki aag se tumhaari mukti hai.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ،
 أَنَّ عَوْنًا، وَسَعِيدَ بْنَ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، حَدَّثَاهُ أَنَّهُمَا، شَهِدَا أَبَا بُرْدَةَ يُحَدِّثُ عُمَرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ
 عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ لاَ يَمُوتُ رَجُلٌ مُسْلِمٌ إِلاَّ أَدْخَلَ اللَّهُ مَكَانَهُ
 النَّارَ يَهُودِيًّا أَوْ نَصْرَانِيًّا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَاسْتَحْلَفَهُ عُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بِاللَّهِ الَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ
 هُوَ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ أَنَّ أَبَاهُ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ فَحَلَفَ لَهُ - قَالَ
 - فَلَمْ يُحَدِّثْنِي سَعِيدٌ أَنَّهُ اسْتَحْلَفَهُ وَلَمْ يُنْكِرْ عَلَى عَوْنٍ قَوْلَهُ ‏.‏
50.en: Abu Burda reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: No Muslim would die but Allah would admit in his stead a Jew or a Christian in Hell-Fire. 'Umar b. Abd al-'Aziz took an oath: By One besides Whom there is no god but He, thrice that his father had narrated that to him from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).
50.hi: Abu Burda ne apne waalid ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Koi bhi Musalman nahi marega lekin Allah uski jagah ek Yahudi ya Isaayi ko Jahannam ki aag mein daakhil karega. Umar bin Abd al-Aziz ne teen baar qasam khayi: Us Hasti ki qasam jiske siwaay koi ma'bood nahi hai, ki unke waalid ne unhe ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat ki.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، جَمِيعًا عَنْ عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ،
 الْوَارِثِ أَخْبَرَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ عَفَّانَ وَقَالَ عَوْنُ بْنُ عُتْبَةَ
 ‏.‏
50.en: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of 'Aun b. Utba.
50.hi: Ye hadees Aun bin Utba ki sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَبَّادِ بْنِ جَبَلَةَ بْنِ أَبِي رَوَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَرَمِيُّ بْنُ عُمَارَةَ،
 حَدَّثَنَا شَدَّادٌ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ الرَّاسِبِيُّ، عَنْ غَيْلاَنَ بْنِ جَرِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ يَجِيءُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ نَاسٌ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ بِذُنُوبٍ أَمْثَالِ الْجِبَالِ
 فَيَغْفِرُهَا اللَّهُ لَهُمْ وَيَضَعُهَا عَلَى الْيَهُودِ وَالنَّصَارَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فِيمَا أَحْسِبُ أَنَا ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو رَوْحٍ
 لاَ أَدْرِي مِمَّنِ الشَّكُّ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو بُرْدَةَ فَحَدَّثْتُ بِهِ عُمَرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ فَقَالَ أَبُوكَ حَدَّثَكَ هَذَا
 عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قُلْتُ نَعَمْ ‏.‏
50.en: Abu Burda reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There would come people amongst the Muslims on the Day of Resurrection with as heavy sins as a mountain, and Allah would forgive them and He would place in their stead the Jews and the Christians. (As far as I think), Abu Raub said: I do not know as to who is in doubt. Abu Burda said: I narrated it to 'Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz, whereupon he said: Was it your father who narrated it to you from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ)? I said: Yes.
50.hi: Abu Burda (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Musalmaanon mein se kuch log Qayamat ke din aisi bhaari gunahon ke saath aayenge jaise ek pahaad, aur Allah unhe maaf karega aur unki jagah Yahudi aur Isaayi rakhega. (Jitna mujhe yaad hai), Abu Raub ne kaha: Mujhe nahi pata ki kaun shak mein hai. Abu Burda ne kaha: Maine ise Umar bin Abd al-Aziz ko riwayat kiya, isper unhone kaha: Kya tumhaare waalid ne ye tumhe Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se riwayat kiya? Maine kaha: Haan.

50.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ الدَّسْتَوَائِيِّ، عَنْ 
 قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ مُحْرِزٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَجُلٌ لاِبْنِ عُمَرَ كَيْفَ سَمِعْتَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله
 عليه وسلم يَقُولُ فِي النَّجْوَى قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ ‏
"‏ يُدْنَى الْمُؤْمِنُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مِنْ رَبِّهِ عَزَّ
 وَجَلَّ حَتَّى يَضَعَ عَلَيْهِ كَنَفَهُ فَيُقَرِّرُهُ بِذُنُوبِهِ فَيَقُولُ هَلْ تَعْرِفُ فَيَقُولُ أَىْ رَبِّ أَعْرِفُ ‏.‏ قَالَ
 فَإِنِّي قَدْ سَتَرْتُهَا عَلَيْكَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَإِنِّي أَغْفِرُهَا لَكَ الْيَوْمَ ‏.‏ فَيُعْطَى صَحِيفَةَ حَسَنَاتِهِ وَأَمَّا
 الْكُفَّارُ وَالْمُنَافِقُونَ فَيُنَادَى بِهِمْ عَلَى رُءُوسِ الْخَلاَئِقِ هَؤُلاَءِ الَّذِينَ كَذَبُوا عَلَى اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
50.en: Safwan b. Muhriz reported that a person said to Ibn 'Umar: How did you hear Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying something about intimate conversation? He said: I heard him say: A believer will be brought to his Lord, the Exalted and Glorious, on the Day of Resurrection and He would place upon him His veil (of Light) and make him confess his faults and say: Do you recognise (your faults)? He would say: My Lord, I do recognise (them). He (the Lord) would say: I concealed them for you in the world. And today I forgive them. And he would then be given the Book containing (the account of his) good deeds. And so far as the non-believers and hypocrites are concerned, there would be general announcement about them before all creation telling them that these (people, i. e. non-believers and hypocrites) told a lie about Allah.
50.hi: Safwan bin Muhriz ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs ne Ibn Umar (RA) se kaha: Aapne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko guptagoo (najwa) ke baare mein kya farmaate suna?
