حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، -
 يَعْنُونَ ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ بَادِرُوا بِالأَعْمَالِ سِتًّا طُلُوعَ الشَّمْسِ مِنْ مَغْرِبِهَا أَوِ الدُّخَانَ أَوِ الدَّجَّالَ أَوِ
 الدَّابَّةَ أَوْ خَاصَّةَ أَحَدِكُمْ أَوْ أَمْرَ الْعَامَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
54.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said: Hasten to do good deeds before six things happen: the rising of the sun from the west, the smoke, the Dajjal, the beast and (the death) of one of you or the general turmoil.
54.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Chhe cheezon ke hone se pehle nekokaar amal karne mein jaldi karo: suraj ka pashchim se nikalna, dhuaan, Dajjal, jaanwar, aur tum mein se kisi ki (maut) ya vyapak fitna.

54.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أُمَيَّةُ بْنُ بِسْطَامَ الْعَيْشِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ،
 عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ رِيَاحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏
 بَادِرُوا بِالأَعْمَالِ سِتًّا الدَّجَّالَ وَالدُّخَانَ وَدَابَّةَ الأَرْضِ وَطُلُوعَ الشَّمْسِ مِنْ مَغْرِبِهَا وَأَمْرَ
 الْعَامَّةِ وَخُوَيِّصَةَ أَحَدِكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
54.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Hasten in performing these good deeds (before these) six things (happen): (the appearance) of the Dajjal, the smoke, the beast of the earth, the rising of the sun from the west, the general turmoil (leading to large-scale massacre) and death of masses and individuals.
54.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: In chhe cheezon (ke hone) se pehle nekokaar amal karne mein jaldi karo: Dajjal ka pragat hona, dhuaan, zameen ka jaanwar, suraj ka pashchim se nikalna, vyapak fitna (jismein bade paimaane par khoon-kharaba ho) aur bade paimaane par aur ek-ek karke maut.

54.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ،
 حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
54.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Qatada through another chain of transmitters.
54.hi: Ye hadees Qatada ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

54.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ مُعَلَّى بْنِ زِيَادٍ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ،
 قُرَّةَ عَنْ مَعْقِلِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ح 
 
 وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنِ الْمُعَلَّى بْنِ زِيَادٍ، رَدَّهُ إِلَى مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ
 قُرَّةَ رَدَّهُ إِلَى مَعْقِلِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ رَدَّهُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ الْعِبَادَةُ فِي الْهَرْجِ
 كَهِجْرَةٍ إِلَىَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
54.en: Ma'qil b. Yasar reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Worshiping during the period of widespread turmoil is like emigration towards me.
54.hi: Ma'qil bin Yasar (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Vyapak fitne ke daur mein ibadat karna meri taraf hijrat karne jaisa hai.

54.ar: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَبُو كَامِلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
54.en: The previous hadith is narrated through Abu Kamil from Hammad with the same chain.
54.hi: Pichhli hadees Abu Kamil ke zariye Hammad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

54.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مَهْدِيٍّ - حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ،
 عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الأَقْمَرِ، عَنْ أَبِي الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ
 ‏
"‏ لاَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ إِلاَّ عَلَى شِرَارِ النَّاسِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
54.en: Abdullah reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: The Last Hour would affect (most terribly) the wicked persons.
54.hi: Abdullah (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Aakhri Ghadi badkaar logon par (sabse zyada bhayaanak taur par) asar karegi.

54.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، وَعَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي،
 حَازِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ 
 
 وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ 
 سَهْلاً، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُشِيرُ بِإِصْبَعِهِ الَّتِي تَلِي الإِبْهَامَ وَالْوُسْطَى
 وَهُوَ يَقُولُ ‏
"‏ بُعِثْتُ أَنَا وَالسَّاعَةُ هَكَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
54.en: This hadith has been reported by Sahl b. Sa'd that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: I and the Last Hour are (close to each other) like this (and he, in order to explain it) pointed (by joining his) forefinger, (one) next to the thumb and the middle finger (together).
54.hi: Sahl bin Sa'd (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Main aur Aakhri Ghadi is tarah (ek-doosre ke qareeb) hain, aur (isse spashth karte hue) unhone apni tarjani ungli, angoothe ke bagal wali, aur beech ki ungli ko jodkar dikhaya.

54.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ،
 قَالَ سَمِعْتُ قَتَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ بُعِثْتُ
 أَنَا وَالسَّاعَةُ كَهَاتَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ شُعْبَةُ وَسَمِعْتُ قَتَادَةَ يَقُولُ فِي قَصَصِهِ كَفَضْلِ إِحْدَاهُمَا
 عَلَى الأُخْرَى فَلاَ أَدْرِي أَذَكَرَهُ عَنْ أَنَسٍ أَوْ قَالَهُ قَتَادَةُ ‏.‏
54.en: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) said: I and the Last Hour have been sent like this. Shu'ba said: I heard Qatada as saying in his narration: The excellence of one over the other. And I do not know whether he narrated it from Anas or Qatada himself said so.
54.hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Main aur Aakhri Ghadi is tarah bheje gaye hain. Shu'ba ne kaha: Maine Qatada ko apni riwayat mein ye kehte suna: Ek ka doosre par bardaasht. Aur mujhe nahi pata ki unhone ye Anas se riwayat ki ya khud Qatada ne aisa kaha.

54.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ الْحَارِثِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْحَارِثِ - حَدَّثَنَا 
 شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ قَتَادَةَ، وَأَبَا التَّيَّاحِ، يُحَدِّثَانِ أَنَّهُمَا سَمِعَا أَنَسًا، يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ بُعِثْتُ أَنَا وَالسَّاعَةُ هَكَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَرَنَ شُعْبَةُ بَيْنَ إِصْبَعَيْهِ الْمُسَبِّحَةِ
 وَالْوُسْطَى يَحْكِيهِ ‏.‏
54.en: Shu'ba reported: I heard Qatada and Abu Tayyab narrating that both of them heard Anas as narrating that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I and the Last Hour have been sent like this, and Shu'ba drew his forefinger and middle finger near each other while narrating it.
54.hi: Shu'ba ne bayan kiya: Maine Qatada aur Abu Tayyab dono ko riwayat karte suna ki unhone dono ne Anas se suna ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Main aur Aakhri Ghadi is tarah bheje gaye hain, aur Shu'ba ne apni tarjani aur beech ki ungli ko riwayat karte huye ek-doosre ke qareeb kiya.

54.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ،
 بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي التَّيَّاحِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِهَذَا
 ‏.‏
54.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Anas through another chain of transmitters.
54.hi: Ye hadees Anas (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

54.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ حَمْزَةَ، - يَعْنِي
 الضَّبِّيَّ - وَأَبِي التَّيَّاحِ عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏.‏
54.en: Anas reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying like this, but he narrated it through another chain of transmitters.
54.hi: Anas (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se isi jaisi baat riwayat ki, lekin unhone ise ek doosri sanad ke zariye riwayat kiya.

54.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو غَسَّانَ الْمِسْمَعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ مَعْبَدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ
 قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ بُعِثْتُ أَنَا وَالسَّاعَةُ كَهَاتَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَضَمَّ السَّبَّابَةَ
 وَالْوُسْطَى ‏.‏
54.en: Anas reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: I and the Last Hour have been sent like this and (he while doing it) joined the forefinger with the middle finger.
54.hi: Anas (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Main aur Aakhri Ghadi is tarah bheje gaye hain, aur (ye kehte huye) unhone apni tarjani ungli ko beech ki ungli ke saath joda.

54.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ 
 أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ الأَعْرَابُ إِذَا قَدِمُوا عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَأَلُوهُ
 عَنِ السَّاعَةِ مَتَى السَّاعَةُ فَنَظَرَ إِلَى أَحْدَثِ إِنْسَانٍ مِنْهُمْ فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ إِنْ يَعِشْ هَذَا لَمْ يُدْرِكْهُ
 الْهَرَمُ قَامَتْ عَلَيْكُمْ سَاعَتُكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
54.en: 'A'isha reported that when the desert Arabs came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) they asked about the Last Hour as to when that would come. And he looked towards the youngest amongst them and said: If he lives he would not grow very old that he would find your Last Hour coming to you (he would see you dying).
54.hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki jab registaan ke Arab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aate, woh Aakhri Ghadi ke baare mein poochte ki ye kab aayegi. Aur unhone unmein sabse choti umar wale shakhs ki taraf dekha aur farmaaya: Agar ye zinda raha, to isse pehle ki woh bahut boodha ho, ye Aakhri Ghadi ko tumhaari taraf aata hua paayega (yaani ye tumhaari maut dekhega).

54.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ 
 ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، سَأَلَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَتَى تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ وَعِنْدَهُ
 غُلاَمٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ يُقَالُ لَهُ مُحَمَّدٌ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ إِنْ يَعِشْ هَذَا
 الْغُلاَمُ فَعَسَى أَنْ لاَ يُدْرِكَهُ الْهَرَمُ حَتَّى تَقُومَ السَّاعَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
54.en: Anas reported that a person asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as to when the Last Hour would come. He had in his presence a young boy of the Ansar who was called Muhammad. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: If this young boy lives, he may not grow very old till (he would see) the Last Hour coming to you.
54.hi: Anas (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se poocha ki Aakhri Ghadi kab aayegi. Unke saamne Ansar ka ek jawaan larka tha jise Muhammad kaha jaata tha. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Agar ye jawaan larka zinda raha, to shaayad ye bahut boodha na ho paaye ki Aakhri Ghadi tumhaari taraf aa jaaye.

54.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ
 زَيْدٍ - حَدَّثَنَا مَعْبَدُ بْنُ هِلاَلٍ الْعَنَزِيُّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله
 عليه وسلم قَالَ مَتَى تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ قَالَ فَسَكَتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم هُنَيْهَةً
 ثُمَّ نَظَرَ إِلَى غُلاَمٍ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ مِنْ أَزْدِ شَنُوءَةَ فَقَالَ ‏
"‏ إِنْ عُمِّرَ هَذَا لَمْ يُدْرِكْهُ الْهَرَمُ حَتَّى تَقُومَ
 السَّاعَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قَالَ أَنَسٌ ذَاكَ الْغُلاَمُ مِنْ أَتْرَابِي يَوْمَئِذٍ ‏.‏
54.en: Anas b. Malik reported that a person asked Allah's Apostle (ﷺ): When would the Last Hour come? Thereupon Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) kept quiet for a while. Then looked at a young boy in his presence belonging to the tribe of Azd Shanu'a and he said: If this boy lives he would not grow very old till the Last Hour would come to you. Anas said that this young boy was of our age during those days.
54.hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya ki ek shakhs ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se poocha: Aakhri Ghadi kab aayegi? Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) kuch der khamosh rahe. Phir unhone Azd Shanu'a qabile ke apne saamne maujood ek jawaan larke ki taraf dekha aur kaha: Agar ye larka zinda raha, to ye bahut boodha nahi ho paayega ki Aakhri Ghadi tumhaari taraf aa jaaye. Anas ne kaha ki us daur mein ye jawaan larka humaari hi umar ka tha.

54.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ 
 أَنَسٍ، قَالَ مَرَّ غُلاَمٌ لِلْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ وَكَانَ مِنْ أَقْرَانِي فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
 ‏
"‏ إِنْ يُؤَخَّرْ هَذَا فَلَنْ يُدْرِكَهُ الْهَرَمُ حَتَّى تَقُومَ السَّاعَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
54.en: Anas reported: A young boy of Mughira b. Shu'ba happened to pass by (the Holy Prophet) and he was of my age. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: If he lives long he would not grow very old till the Last Hour would come (to the old people of this generation).
54.hi: Anas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Mughira bin Shu'ba ka ek jawaan larka (Nabi ke) paas se guzra aur woh meri hi umar ka tha. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Agar woh lambi zindagi jeeye, to woh bahut boodha nahi ho paayega jab Aakhri Ghadi (is peedhi ke boodhon ki taraf) aa jaaye.

54.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ 
 أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، يَبْلُغُ بِهِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ وَالرَّجُلُ يَحْلُبُ اللِّقْحَةَ
 فَمَا يَصِلُ الإِنَاءُ إِلَى فِيهِ حَتَّى تَقُومَ وَالرَّجُلاَنِ يَتَبَايَعَانِ الثَّوْبَ فَمَا يَتَبَايَعَانِهِ حَتَّى تَقُومَ
 وَالرَّجُلُ يَلِطُ فِي حَوْضِهِ فَمَا يَصْدُرُ حَتَّى تَقُومَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
54.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The Last Hour would come (so sudden) that a person would be milking the she- camel and the (milk) would not reach the brim of the vessel that the Last Hour would come, and the two persons would be engaged in buying and selling of the clothes and their bargain would not be struck before the Last Hour would come. And someone would be setting his tank in order and he would have hardly set it right when the Last Hour would come.
54.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Aakhri Ghadi is tarah (achaanak) aayegi ki ek shakhs oontni ka doodh nikaal raha hoga aur doodh bartan ke kinaare tak pahunchne se pehle Aakhri Ghadi aa jaayegi, aur do log kapdon ki khareed-farokht mein masroof honge aur unka sauda Aakhri Ghadi aane se pehle poora nahi hoga. Aur koi apna hauz theek kar raha hoga aur woh use mushkil se hi theek kar paayega ki Aakhri Ghadi aa jaayegi.

54.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ،
 عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا بَيْنَ النَّفْخَتَيْنِ أَرْبَعُونَ
 ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا يَا أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ أَرْبَعُونَ يَوْمًا قَالَ أَبَيْتُ ‏.‏ قَالُوا أَرْبَعُونَ شَهْرًا قَالَ أَبَيْتُ ‏.‏ قَالُوا
 أَرْبَعُونَ سَنَةً قَالَ أَبَيْتُ ‏"‏ ثُمَّ يُنْزِلُ اللَّهُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَيَنْبُتُونَ كَمَا يَنْبُتُ الْبَقْلُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ
 ‏"‏ وَلَيْسَ مِنَ الإِنْسَانِ شَىْءٌ إِلاَّ يَبْلَى إِلاَّ عَظْمًا وَاحِدًا وَهُوَ عَجْبُ الذَّنَبِ وَمِنْهُ يُرَكَّبُ الْخَلْقُ
 يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
54.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Between the two blowings of the trumpet (there would be an interval of forty). They said: Abu Huraira, do you mean forty days? He said: I cannot say anything. They said: Do you mean forty months? He said: I cannot say anything. They said: Do you mean forty years? He said: I cannot say anything. Then Allah would cause the water to, descend from the sky and they (people) will sprout like vegetable. The only thing in a man which would not decay would be one bone (the tailbone) from which the whole frame would be reconstituted on the Day of Resurrection.
54.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Do Singhaa (trumpet) ke bajne ke beech (chaalis ka antar hoga). Unhone (Sahaba ne) kaha: Abu Huraira, aapka matlab chaalis din hai? Unhone kaha: Main kuch nahi keh sakta. Unhone kaha: Aapka matlab chaalis mahine hai? Unhone kaha: Main kuch nahi keh sakta. Unhone kaha: Aapka matlab chaalis saal hai? Unhone kaha: Main kuch nahi keh sakta. Phir Allah aasmaan se paani utaarenge aur log (naye) ugenge sabziyon ki tarah. Insaan mein sirf ek haddi (Ajb, rerdhee ki haddi ka aakhri hissa) hai jo kabhi galti nahi, aur isi se poora dhaancha Qayamat ke din dobara banaaya jaayega.

54.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ، - يَعْنِي الْحِزَامِيَّ - عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ 
 الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ كُلُّ ابْنِ آدَمَ يَأْكُلُهُ
 التُّرَابُ إِلاَّ عَجْبَ الذَّنَبِ مِنْهُ خُلِقَ وَفِيهِ يُرَكَّبُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
54.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The earth would consume all of the son of Adam except his tailbone. From it he was created, and from it he will be recreated (on the Day of Resurrection).
54.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Zameen Aadam ki aulad ki har cheez khaa jaayegi siwaay uski Ajb (rerdhee ki haddi ka aakhri hissa) ke. Isi se woh banaaya gaya tha aur isi se woh (Qayamat ke din) dobara banaaya jaayega.

54.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، قَالَ
 هَذَا مَا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ أَحَادِيثَ مِنْهَا وَقَالَ
 رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ فِي الإِنْسَانِ عَظْمًا لاَ تَأْكُلُهُ الأَرْضُ أَبَدًا فِيهِ يُرَكَّبُ
 يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا أَىُّ عَظْمٍ هُوَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ عَجْبُ الذَّنَبِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
54.en: Abu Huraira reported so many ahadith from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and amongst these one was this that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: There is a bone in the human being which the earth would never consume and it is from this that new bodies would be reconstituted (on the Day of Resurrection). They said: Allah's Messenger, which bone is that? Thereupon he said: It is the spinal bone.
54.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se bahut si ahadees riwayat kin aur unmein se ek ye thi ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Insaan mein ek haddi hai jise zameen kabhi nahi khaayegi, aur isi se (Qayamat ke din) naye jism dobara banaaye jaayenge. Unhone (Sahaba ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, ye kaunsi haddi hai? Isper unhone farmaaya: Ye rerdhee ki haddi hai.

55.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - يَعْنِي الدَّرَاوَرْدِيَّ - عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ 
 أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ الدُّنْيَا سِجْنُ الْمُؤْمِنِ
 وَجَنَّةُ الْكَافِرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
55.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The world is a prison-house for a believer and Paradise for a non-believer.
55.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Duniya momin ke liye ek qaidkhaana hai aur gair-imaandaar ke liye Jannat.

55.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ بِلاَلٍ - عَنْ 
 جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَرَّ بِالسُّوقِ
 دَاخِلاً مِنْ بَعْضِ الْعَالِيَةِ وَالنَّاسُ كَنَفَتَهُ فَمَرَّ بِجَدْىٍ أَسَكَّ مَيِّتٍ فَتَنَاوَلَهُ فَأَخَذَ بِأُذُنِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ
 ‏"‏ أَيُّكُمْ يُحِبُّ أَنَّ هَذَا لَهُ بِدِرْهَمٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا مَا نُحِبُّ أَنَّهُ لَنَا بِشَىْءٍ وَمَا نَصْنَعُ بِهِ قَالَ ‏"‏
 أَتُحِبُّونَ أَنَّهُ لَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا وَاللَّهِ لَوْ كَانَ حَيًّا كَانَ عَيْبًا فِيهِ لأَنَّهُ أَسَكُّ فَكَيْفَ وَهُوَ مَيِّتٌ
 فَقَالَ ‏"‏ فَوَاللَّهِ لَلدُّنْيَا أَهْوَنُ عَلَى اللَّهِ مِنْ هَذَا عَلَيْكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
55.en: Jabir b. Abdullah reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) happened to walk through the bazar coming from the side of 'Aliya and the people were on both his sides. There he found a dead lamb with very short ears. He took hold of his ear and said: Who amongst you would like to have this for a dirham? They said: We do not like to have it even for less than that as it is of no use to us. He said: Do you wish to have it (free of any cost)? They said: By Allah, even if it were alive (we would not have liked to possess that), for there is defect in it as its ear is very short; now it is dead also. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: By Allah, this world is more insignificant in the eye of Allah than it (this dead lamb) is in your eye.
55.hi: Jabir bin Abdullah (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Aaliya ki taraf se bazaar mein guzre aur log unke dono taraf the. Wahan unhe ek mara hua bhed ka bachcha mila jiske kaan bahut chhote the. Unhone uska kaan pakda aur farmaaya: Tum mein se kaun ise ek dirham mein lena chaahega? Unhone kaha: Hum ise itni bhi keemat mein nahi chaahte kyunki ye humaare liye be-kaam hai. Unhone farmaaya: Kya tum ise (bina koi keemat diye) lena chaahoge? Unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, agar ye zinda bhi hota (to bhi hum ise na lete), kyunki ismein khaami hai ki iska kaan bahut chhota hai; ab to ye mar bhi chuka hai. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Allah ki qasam, ye duniya Allah ki nazar mein isse bhi zyada nagany hai jitni ye (ye mara hua bachcha) tumhaari nazar mein hai.

55.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى الْعَنَزِيُّ، وَإِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَرْعَرَةَ السَّامِيُّ، قَالاَ
 حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، - يَعْنِيَانِ الثَّقَفِيَّ - عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي حَدِيثِ الثَّقَفِيِّ فَلَوْ كَانَ حَيًّا كَانَ هَذَا السَّكَكُ بِهِ عَيْبًا
 ‏.‏
55.en: Jabir reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) narrating a hadith like this with a slight variation of wording.
55.hi: Jabir (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se isi jaisi ek hadees riwayat ki, alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath.

55.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا هَدَّابُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ أَتَيْتُ
 النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ يَقْرَأُ ‏{‏ أَلْهَاكُمُ التَّكَاثُرُ‏}‏ قَالَ ‏
"‏ يَقُولُ ابْنُ آدَمَ مَالِي مَالِي
 - قَالَ - وَهَلْ لَكَ يَا ابْنَ آدَمَ مِنْ مَالِكَ إِلاَّ مَا أَكَلْتَ فَأَفْنَيْتَ أَوْ لَبِسْتَ فَأَبْلَيْتَ أَوْ تَصَدَّقْتَ
 فَأَمْضَيْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
55.en: Mutarrif reported on the authority of his father: I came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as he was reciting:" Abundance diverts you" (cii. 1). He said: The son of Adam claims: My wealth, my wealth. And he (the Holy Prophet) said: O son of Adam. is there anything as your belonging except that which you consumed, which you utilised, or which you wore and then it was worn out or you gave as charity and sent it forward?
55.hi: Mutarrif ne apne waalid ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaya jab woh (Sura Takathur) padh rahe the: "Bahutayat tumhe be-parvaah kar deti hai" (102:1). Unhone farmaaya: Aadam ki aulad daawa karti hai: Mera maal, mera maal. Aur unhone (Pavitr Nabi ne) farmaaya: Aye Aadam ki aulad, tumhaara khud ka kya hai siwaay us cheez ke jise tumne khaaya aur istemal kiya, ya jise tumne pehna aur woh puraana ho gaya, ya jo tumne sadaqe mein diya aur bhej diya?

55.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، وَقَالاَ،
 جَمِيعًا حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنَا 
 أَبِي كُلُّهُمْ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ انْتَهَيْتُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
 فَذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ هَمَّامٍ ‏.‏
55.en: Mutarrif reported on the authority of his father: I went to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). The rest of the hadith is the same.
55.hi: Mutarrif ne apne waalid ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki: Main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas gaya. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai.

55.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي،
 هُرَيْرَةَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ يَقُولُ الْعَبْدُ مَالِي مَالِي إِنَّمَا لَهُ مِنْ مَالِهِ
 ثَلاَثٌ مَا أَكَلَ فَأَفْنَى أَوْ لَبِسَ فَأَبْلَى أَوْ أَعْطَى فَاقْتَنَى وَمَا سِوَى ذَلِكَ فَهُوَ ذَاهِبٌ وَتَارِكُهُ
 لِلنَّاسِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
55.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: A servant says, My wealth. my wealth, but out of his wealth three things are only his: whatever he eats and makes use of or by means of which he dresses himself and it wears out or he gives as charity, and this is what he stored for himself (as a reward for the Hereafter), and what is beyond this (it is of no use to you) because you are to depart and leave it for other people.
55.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Banda kehta hai: Mera maal, mera maal, lekin uske maal mein se sirf teen cheezein uski hain: jo woh khaata hai aur istemal karta hai, ya jise pehankar khud ko sajaata hai aur woh puraana ho jaata hai, ya jo woh sadaqe mein deta hai, aur yahi hai jo usne apne liye (Aakhirat ke sawaab ke soorat mein) jama kiya hai, aur jo iske ilaawa hai (uska tumhare liye koi faayda nahi) kyunki tumhe jaana hoga aur ise doosron ke liye chhodna hoga.

55.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي 
 الْعَلاَءُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
55.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of al-'Ala' b. 'Abd al-Rahman with the same chain of transmitters.
55.hi: Ye hadees Ala bin Abd al-Rahman ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

55.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، قَالَ
 يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ
 قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ يَتْبَعُ الْمَيِّتَ ثَلاَثَةٌ فَيَرْجِعُ اثْنَانِ وَيَبْقَى وَاحِدٌ يَتْبَعُهُ
 أَهْلُهُ وَمَالُهُ وَعَمَلُهُ فَيَرْجِعُ أَهْلُهُ وَمَالُهُ وَيَبْقَى عَمَلُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
55.en: Anas b. Malik reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Three things follow the bier of a dead man. Two of them come back and one is left with him: the members of his family, wealth and his good deeds. The members of his family and wealth come back and the deeds alone are left with him.
55.hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Teen cheezein murda shakhs ke taboot ke peeche jaati hain. Inmein se do wapas laut aati hain aur ek uske saath rehti hai: uske khaandaan ke log, uska maal aur uske nekokaar amal. Uske khaandaan ke log aur uska maal wapas laut aate hain aur sirf uske amal uske saath rehte hain.

55.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ حَرْمَلَةَ بْنِ عِمْرَانَ التُّجِيبِيَّ -
 أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ الْمِسْوَرَ بْنَ مَخْرَمَةَ،
 أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَمْرَو بْنَ عَوْفٍ وَهُوَ حَلِيفُ بَنِي عَامِرِ بْنِ لُؤَىٍّ وَكَانَ شَهِدَ بَدْرًا مَعَ رَسُولِ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعَثَ أَبَا عُبَيْدَةَ بْنَ
 الْجَرَّاحِ إِلَى الْبَحْرَيْنِ يَأْتِي بِجِزْيَتِهَا وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم هُوَ صَالَحَ
 أَهْلَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ وَأَمَّرَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْعَلاَءَ بْنَ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ فَقَدِمَ أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ بِمَالٍ مِنَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ فَسَمِعَتِ
 الأَنْصَارُ بِقُدُومِ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ فَوَافَوْا صَلاَةَ الْفَجْرِ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمَّا
 صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم انْصَرَفَ فَتَعَرَّضُوا لَهُ فَتَبَسَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله
 عليه وسلم حِينَ رَآهُمْ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَظُنُّكُمْ سَمِعْتُمْ أَنَّ أَبَا عُبَيْدَةَ قَدِمَ بِشَىْءٍ مِنَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ ‏"‏
 ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا أَجَلْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ ‏"‏ فَأَبْشِرُوا وَأَمِّلُوا مَا يَسُرُّكُمْ فَوَاللَّهِ مَا الْفَقْرَ أَخْشَى
 عَلَيْكُمْ ‏.‏ وَلَكِنِّي أَخْشَى عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْ تُبْسَطَ الدُّنْيَا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَا بُسِطَتْ عَلَى مَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ فَتَنَافَسُوهَا
 كَمَا تَنَافَسُوهَا وَتُهْلِكَكُمْ كَمَا أَهْلَكَتْهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
55.en: `Amr b. `Auf, who was an ally of Banu `Amir b. Luwayy (and he was one amongst them) who participated in Badr along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) reported that, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent Abu `Ubaida b. Al-Jarrah to Bahrain for collecting Jizya and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had made a truce with the people of Bahrain and had appointed `Ala' b. Hadrami and Abu `Ubaida (for this purpose). They came with wealth from Bahrain and the Ansar heard about the arrival of Abu `Ubaida and they had observed the dawn prayer along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had finished the prayer, they (the Ansar) came before him and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) smiled as he saw them and then said: I think you have heard about the arrival of Abu `Ubaida with goods from Bahrain. They said: Allah's Messenger, yes, it is so. Thereupon he said: Be happy and be hopeful of that which gives you delight. By Allah, it is not the poverty about which I fear in regard to you but I am afraid in your case that (the worldly) riches way be given to you as were given to those who had gone before you and you begin to vie with one another for them as they vied for them, and these may destroy you as these destroyed them.
55.hi: Amr bin Auf (RA), jo Banu Amir bin Luwayy ke sahyogi the (aur unhi mein se ek the) aur jinhone Badr ki jung mein Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath hissa liya, ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Abu Ubaida bin al-Jarrah ko Bahrain jizya ikattha karne bheja aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Bahrain ke logon ke saath sulah ki thi aur Ala bin Hadrami ko (is maqsad ke liye) muqarrar kiya tha, saath mein Abu Ubaida ko bhi. Woh Bahrain se maal lekar aaye aur Ansar ne Abu Ubaida ke aane ki khabar suni aur unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath Fajr ki namaz padhi thi. Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne namaz khatm ki, woh (Ansar) unke saamne aaye aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) unhe dekhkar muskuraaye aur phir farmaaya: Mujhe lagta hai tumne Bahrain se saamaan lekar Abu Ubaida ke aane ki khabar suni hai. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool, haan, aisa hi hai. Isper unhone farmaaya: Khush raho aur jo cheez tumhe khushi degi uski ummeed rakho. Allah ki qasam, mujhe tumhaare baare mein gareebi ka koi dar nahi hai balki mujhe dar hai ki (duniyaavi) daulat tumhe di jaayegi jaisi tumse pehle logon ko di gayi thi aur tum unke jaisa isse haasil karne ke liye pratispardha karoge jaisa unhone kiya, aur ye tumhe usi tarah barbaad kar sakti hai jaise usne unhe barbaad kiya.

55.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
 بْنِ سَعْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو
 الْيَمَانِ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِإِسْنَادِ يُونُسَ وَمِثْلِ حَدِيثِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي حَدِيثِ
 صَالِحٍ ‏
"‏ وَتُلْهِيَكُمْ كَمَا أَلْهَتْهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
55.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri as reported by Yunus with a slight variation of wording.
55.hi: Ye hadees Zuhri ki sanad se Yunus ke zariye alfaazon mein halki tabdeeli ke saath riwayat ki gayi hai.

55.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ سَوَّادٍ الْعَامِرِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ،
 الْحَارِثِ أَنَّ بَكْرَ بْنَ سَوَادَةَ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ يَزِيدَ بْنَ رَبَاحٍ - هُوَ أَبُو فِرَاسٍ مَوْلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ
 عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ - حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله
 عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا فُتِحَتْ عَلَيْكُمْ فَارِسُ وَالرُّومُ أَىُّ قَوْمٍ أَنْتُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ
 بْنُ عَوْفٍ نَقُولُ كَمَا أَمَرَنَا اللَّهُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَوْ غَيْرَ ذَلِكَ تَتَنَافَسُونَ
 ثُمَّ تَتَحَاسَدُونَ ثُمَّ تَتَدَابَرُونَ ثُمَّ تَتَبَاغَضُونَ أَوْ نَحْوَ ذَلِكَ ثُمَّ تَنْطَلِقُونَ فِي مَسَاكِينِ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ
 فَتَجْعَلُونَ بَعْضَهُمْ عَلَى رِقَابِ بَعْضٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
55.en: `Abdullah b. `Amr b. al-`As reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: How would you be, O people, when Persia and Rome would be conquered for you? `Abd ar-Rahman b `Auf said: We would say as Allah has commanded us and we would express our gratitude to Allah. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Nothing else besides it? You would (in fact) vie with one another, then you would feel jealous, then your relations would be estranged and then you will bear enmity against one another, or something to the same effect. Then you would go to the poor emigrants and would make some the masters of the others.
55.hi: Abdullah bin Amr bin al-As (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Aye logo, tum kaisi haalat mein hoge jab Persia aur Rome tumhaare liye fatah kar liye jaayenge? Abd al-Rahman bin Auf ne kaha: Hum wahi kahenge jo Allah ne humein hukum diya hai aur hum Allah ka shukriya karenge. Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Iske ilaawa aur kuch nahi? Tum waastav mein ek-doosre se pratispardha karoge, phir jalan mehsoos karoge, phir tumhaare rishte kamzor ho jaayenge aur phir tum ek-doosre se dushmani rakhoge, ya isi jaisa kuch. Phir tum gareeb Muhajirin ke paas jaaoge aur unmein se kuchhon ko doosron ka aaqa banaoge.

55.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ قُتَيْبَةُ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ، يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا 
 الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحِزَامِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ
 اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏
"‏ إِذَا نَظَرَ أَحَدُكُمْ إِلَى مَنْ فُضِّلَ عَلَيْهِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْخَلْقِ فَلْيَنْظُرْ
 إِلَى مَنْ هُوَ أَسْفَلَ مِنْهُ مِمَّنْ فُضِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
55.en: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: When one of you looks at one who stands at a higher level than you in regard to wealth and physical structure he should also see one who stands at a lower level than you in regard to these things (in which he stands) at a higher level (as compared to him).
55.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaaya: Jab tum mein se koi apne se maal aur badan ki taraah mein bade darje ke shakhs ki taraf dekhe, use apne se kam darje wale ki taraf bhi dekhna chahiye (in maamlon mein jinmein woh khud se bade darje wale ki taraf dekhta hai).

55.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، عَنْ 
 أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ سَوَاءً ‏.‏
55.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters.
55.hi: Ye hadees Abu Huraira (RA) ki sanad se ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai.

55.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ،
 ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، وَوَكِيعٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ،
 عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ انْظُرُوا إِلَى
 مَنْ أَسْفَلَ مِنْكُمْ وَلاَ تَنْظُرُوا إِلَى مَنْ هُوَ فَوْقَكُمْ فَهُوَ أَجْدَرُ أَنْ لاَ تَزْدَرُوا نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ
 أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ ‏"‏ عَلَيْكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
55.en:
Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Look at those who stand at a lower level than you but don't look at those who stand at a higher level than you, for that is better-suited that you do not disparage Allah's favors.

In the chain narrated by Abu Mu'awiya's he said: Upon you.
55.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Un logon ki taraf dekho jo tumse kam darje mein hain, aur un logon ki taraf mat dekho jo tumse zyada darje mein hain, kyunki ye zyada munasib hai taaki tum Allah ki nematon ki qadar kam na karo. Abu Mu'awiya ki riwayat ki hui sanad mein unhone kaha: Tumpar.

55.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ،
 حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبِي عَمْرَةَ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ إِنَّ ثَلاَثَةً فِي بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ أَبْرَصَ وَأَقْرَعَ وَأَعْمَى فَأَرَادَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَبْتَلِيَهُمْ
 فَبَعَثَ إِلَيْهِمْ مَلَكًا فَأَتَى الأَبْرَصَ فَقَالَ أَىُّ شَىْءٍ أَحَبُّ إِلَيْكَ قَالَ لَوْنٌ حَسَنٌ وَجِلْدٌ حَسَنٌ
 وَيَذْهَبُ عَنِّي الَّذِي قَدْ قَذِرَنِي النَّاسُ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَمَسَحَهُ فَذَهَبَ عَنْهُ قَذَرُهُ وَأُعْطِيَ لَوْنًا حَسَنًا
 وَجِلْدًا حَسَنًا قَالَ فَأَىُّ الْمَالِ أَحَبُّ إِلَيْكَ قَالَ الإِبِلُ - أَوْ قَالَ الْبَقَرُ شَكَّ إِسْحَاقُ - إِلاَّ
 أَنَّ الأَبْرَصَ أَوِ الأَقْرَعَ قَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا الإِبِلُ وَقَالَ الآخَرُ الْبَقَرُ - قَالَ فَأُعْطِيَ نَاقَةً عُشَرَاءَ
 فَقَالَ بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِيهَا - قَالَ - فَأَتَى الأَقْرَعَ فَقَالَ أَىُّ شَىْءٍ أَحَبُّ إِلَيْكَ قَالَ شَعَرٌ
 حَسَنٌ وَيَذْهَبُ عَنِّي هَذَا الَّذِي قَذِرَنِي النَّاسُ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَمَسَحَهُ فَذَهَبَ عَنْهُ وَأُعْطِيَ شَعَرًا
 حَسَنًا - قَالَ - فَأَىُّ الْمَالِ أَحَبُّ إِلَيْكَ قَالَ الْبَقَرُ ‏.‏ فَأُعْطِيَ بَقَرَةً حَامِلاً فَقَالَ بَارَكَ اللَّهُ
 لَكَ فِيهَا - قَالَ - فَأَتَى الأَعْمَى فَقَالَ أَىُّ شَىْءٍ أَحَبُّ إِلَيْكَ قَالَ أَنْ يَرُدَّ اللَّهُ إِلَىَّ بَصَرِي
 فَأُبْصِرَ بِهِ النَّاسَ - قَالَ - فَمَسَحَهُ فَرَدَّ اللَّهُ إِلَيْهِ بَصَرَهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَىُّ الْمَالِ أَحَبُّ إِلَيْكَ
 قَالَ الْغَنَمُ ‏.‏ فَأُعْطِيَ شَاةً وَالِدًا فَأُنْتِجَ هَذَانِ وَوَلَّدَ هَذَا - قَالَ - فَكَانَ لِهَذَا وَادٍ مِنَ الإِبِلِ
 وَلِهَذَا وَادٍ مِنَ الْبَقَرِ وَلِهَذَا وَادٍ مِنَ الْغَنَمِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ إِنَّهُ أَتَى الأَبْرَصَ فِي صُورَتِهِ وَهَيْئَتِهِ فَقَالَ
 رَجُلٌ مِسْكِينٌ قَدِ انْقَطَعَتْ بِيَ الْحِبَالُ فِي سَفَرِي فَلاَ بَلاَغَ لِيَ الْيَوْمَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ ثُمَّ بِكَ أَسْأَلُكَ
 بِالَّذِي أَعْطَاكَ اللَّوْنَ الْحَسَنَ وَالْجِلْدَ الْحَسَنَ وَالْمَالَ بَعِيرًا أَتَبَلَّغُ عَلَيْهِ فِي سَفَرِي ‏.‏ فَقَالَ
 الْحُقُوقُ كَثِيرَةٌ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ كَأَنِّي أَعْرِفُكَ أَلَمْ تَكُنْ أَبْرَصَ يَقْذَرُكَ النَّاسُ فَقِيرًا فَأَعْطَاكَ اللَّهُ
 فَقَالَ إِنَّمَا وَرِثْتُ هَذَا الْمَالَ كَابِرًا عَنْ كَابِرٍ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ إِنْ كُنْتَ كَاذِبًا فَصَيَّرَكَ اللَّهُ إِلَى مَا
 كُنْتَ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَأَتَى الأَقْرَعَ فِي صُورَتِهِ فَقَالَ لَهُ مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ لِهَذَا وَرَدَّ عَلَيْهِ مِثْلَ مَا رَدَّ عَلَى
 هَذَا فَقَالَ إِنْ كُنْتَ كَاذِبًا فَصَيَّرَكَ اللَّهُ إِلَى مَا كُنْتَ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَأَتَى الأَعْمَى فِي صُورَتِهِ وَهَيْئَتِهِ
 فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِسْكِينٌ وَابْنُ سَبِيلٍ انْقَطَعَتْ بِيَ الْحِبَالُ فِي سَفَرِي فَلاَ بَلاَغَ لِيَ الْيَوْمَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ
 ثُمَّ بِكَ أَسْأَلُكَ بِالَّذِي رَدَّ عَلَيْكَ بَصَرَكَ شَاةً أَتَبَلَّغُ بِهَا فِي سَفَرِي فَقَالَ قَدْ كُنْتُ أَعْمَى فَرَدَّ
 اللَّهُ إِلَىَّ بَصَرِي فَخُذْ مَا شِئْتَ وَدَعْ مَا شِئْتَ فَوَاللَّهِ لاَ أَجْهَدُكَ الْيَوْمَ شَيْئًا أَخَذْتَهُ لِلَّهِ فَقَالَ
 أَمْسِكْ مَالَكَ فَإِنَّمَا ابْتُلِيتُمْ فَقَدْ رُضِيَ عَنْكَ وَسُخِطَ عَلَى صَاحِبَيْكَ ‏.‏
55.en: Abu Huraira, narrated that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There were three persons in Bani Isra'il, one suffering from leprosy, the other bald-headed and the third one blind. Allah decided to test them. So He sent an angel who came to the one who was suffering from leprosy and said: Which thing do you like most? He said: Beautiful colour and fine skin and removal of that which makes me detestable in the eye of people. He wiped him and his illness was no more and he was conferred upon beautiful colour and beautiful skin. He (the angel) again said: Which property do you like most? He said: Camels, or he said: The cow the narrator is, however, doubtful about it, but (out of the persons) suffering from leprosy or baldness one of them definitely said: The camel. And the other one said: Cow. And he (one who demanded camel) was bestowed upon a she-camel, in an advanced stage of pregnancy, and while giving he said: May Allah bless you in this. Then he came to the bald-headed person and said: Which thing do you like most? He said: Beautiful hair and that (this baldness) may be removed from me because of which people hate me. He wiped his body and his illness was removed and he was bestowed upon beautiful hair, and the angel said: Which wealth do you like most? He said: The cow. And he was given a pregnant cow and while handing it over to him he (the angel) said: May Allah bless you in this. Then he came to the blind man and he said: Which thing do you like most? He said: Allah should restore my eyesight so that I should be able to see people with the help of that. He wiped his body and Allah restored to him his eyesight, and he (the angel) also said: Which wealth do you like most? He said: The flock of sheep. And he was given a pregnant goat and that gave birth to young ones and it so happened that one valley abounded in camels and the other one in cows and the third one in sheep. He then came to the one who had suffered from leprosy in his (old) form and shape and he said: I am a poor person and my provision has run short in my journey and there is none to take me to my destination except with the help of Allah and your favour. I beg of you in His name Who gave you fine colour and fine skin, and the camel in the shape of wealth (to confer upon me) a camel which should carry me in my journey. He said: I have many responsibilities to discharge. Thereupon he said: I perceive as if I recognise you. Were you not suffering from leprosy whom people hated and you were a destitute and Allah conferred upon you (wealth)? He said: I have inherited this property from my forefathers. Thereupon he said: If you are a liar may Allah change you to that very position in which you had been. He then came to the one who was bald-headed in his (old) form and said to him the same what he had said to him (one suffering from leprosy) and he gave him the same reply as he had given him and he said: If you are a liar, may Allah turn you to your previous position in which you had been. And then he came to the blind man in his (old) form and shape and he said: I am a destitute person and a wayfarer. My provision have ran short and today there is no way to reach the destination but with the help of Allah and then with your help and I beg of you in the (name) of One Who restored your eyesight and gave you the flock of sheep to give me a sheep by which I should be able to make my provisions for the journey. He said: I was blind and Allah restored to me my eyesight; you take whatever you like and leave whatever you like. By Allah, I shall not stand in your way today for what you take in the name of God. Thereupon, he said: You keep with you what you have (in your possession). The fact is that you three were put to test and Allah is well pleased with you and He is annoyed with your companions.
55.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne riwayat ki ki unhone Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Banu Isra'il mein teen log the, ek kodh se pareshaan, doosra ganjaapan se aur teesra andha. Allah ne unki pareeksha lene ka faisla kiya. Isliye Usne ek Farishta bheja jo kodh se pareshaan shakhs ke paas aaya aur kaha: Tumhe kaunsi cheez sabse zyada pasand hai? Usne kaha: Khoobsurat rang aur achhi khaal, aur woh cheez jo mujhe logon ki nazron mein ghinauna banaati hai woh door ho jaaye. Usne use ponchha aur uski beemari khatm ho gayi aur use khoobsurat rang aur khoobsurat khaal di gayi. Usne (Farishte ne) dobara kaha: Tumhe kaunsi daulat sabse zyada pasand hai? Usne kaha: Oont, ya usne kaha: gaay - raawi ko isper shak hai, lekin (in do logon mein se) kodh ya ganjapan se pareshaan shakhs mein se ek ne zaroor kaha: Oont. Aur doosre ne kaha: Gaay. Aur use (oont maangne wale ko) ek garbhvati oontni di gayi, aur dete waqt usne (Farishte ne) kaha: Allah tumhe ismein barkat de. Phir woh ganje shakhs ke paas aaya aur kaha: Tumhe kaunsi cheez sabse zyada pasand hai? Usne kaha: Khoobsurat baal aur (ye ganjapan) jiski wajah se log mujhse ghrina karte hain woh mujhse door ho jaaye. Usne uska badan ponchha aur uski beemari door ho gayi aur use khoobsurat baal diye gaye, aur Farishte ne kaha: Tumhe kaunsi daulat sabse zyada pasand hai? Usne kaha: Gaay. Aur use ek garbhvati gaay di gayi, aur use sopte huye usne (Farishte ne) kaha: Allah tumhe ismein barkat de. Phir woh andhe shakhs ke paas aaya aur usne kaha: Tumhe kaunsi cheez sabse zyada pasand hai? Usne kaha: Allah meri roshni wapas de taaki main logon ko dekh sakoon. Usne uska badan ponchha aur Allah ne uski aankhon ki roshni wapas kar di, aur usne (Farishte ne) ye bhi poocha: Tumhe kaunsi daulat sabse zyada pasand hai? Usne kaha: Bhedon ka jhund. Aur use ek garbhvati bakri di gayi jisne bachche paida kiye aur aisa hua ki ek waadi oonton se bhar gayi aur doosri gaayon se aur teesri bhedon se. Phir woh (Farishta) us shakhs ke paas aaya jo pehle kodh se pareshaan tha, apne purane rang-soorat mein, aur usne kaha: Main ek gareeb shakhs hoon aur meri safar mein rasad khatm ho gayi hai aur Allah ki madad aur tumhaari meherbaani ke bina koi mera manzil tak pahunchne mein sahaayak nahi hai. Main tumse Uske naam par bhikh maangta hoon Jisne tumhe khoobsurat rang aur khoobsurat khaal di aur maal ke soorat mein oont diya (mujhe) ek oont dijiye jo mere safar mein mujhe le jaaye. Usne kaha: Mere paas bahut zimmedaariyaan hain. Isper usne kaha: Mujhe lagta hai jaise main tumhe pehchaanta hoon. Kya tum kodh se pareshaan nahi the jinse log ghrina karte the aur tum gareeb the, aur Allah ne tumhe (ye sab) diya? Usne kaha: Ye maal mujhe apne poorvajon se virasat mein mila hai. Isper usne kaha: Agar tum jhoote ho, to Allah tumhe usi haalat mein wapas kar de jismein tum pehle the. Phir woh us shakhs ke paas aaya jo pehle ganja tha, apne purane soorat mein, aur usne wahi kaha jo usne (kodh waale se) kaha tha aur usne bhi wahi jawaab diya jo usne (kodh waale ne) diya tha, aur usne (Farishte ne) kaha: Agar tum jhoote ho, to Allah tumhe wapas usi haalat mein le aaye jismein tum pehle the. Phir woh us andhe shakhs ke paas aaya, apne purane soorat mein, aur usne kaha: Main ek gareeb musaafir hoon. Meri rasad khatm ho chuki hai aur aaj mere paas manzil tak pahunchne ka koi zariya nahi hai siwaay Allah ki madad ke aur phir tumhaari madad ke, aur main tumse Us Hasti ke naam par bhikh maangta hoon Jisne tumhaari aankhon ki roshni wapas di, mujhe ek bhed dijiye jisse main apni safar ke liye rasad jama kar sakoon. Usne kaha: Main andha tha aur Allah ne mujhe (meri) aankhon ki roshni wapas di; tum jo chaaho le lo aur jo chaaho chhod do. Allah ki qasam, main aaj tumhe kisi bhi cheez lene se nahi rokunga jo tum Allah ke naam par lete ho. Isper usne (Farishte ne) kaha: Tum jo kuch tumhaare paas hai apne paas hi rakho. (Asal baat ye hai ki) tum teenon ki pareeksha li gayi thi aur Allah tumse khush hai aur tumhaare saathiyon se naaraaz hai.

55.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَبَّاسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَظِيمِ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لإِسْحَاقَ - قَالَ
 عَبَّاسٌ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ، إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا - أَبُو بَكْرٍ الْحَنَفِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا بُكَيْرُ بْنُ مِسْمَارٍ، حَدَّثَنِي 
 عَامِرُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ كَانَ سَعْدُ بْنُ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ فِي إِبِلِهِ فَجَاءَهُ ابْنُهُ عُمَرُ فَلَمَّا رَآهُ سَعْدٌ
 قَالَ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ شَرِّ هَذَا الرَّاكِبِ فَنَزَلَ فَقَالَ لَهُ أَنَزَلْتَ فِي إِبِلِكَ وَغَنَمِكَ وَتَرَكْتَ النَّاسَ
 يَتَنَازَعُونَ الْمُلْكَ بَيْنَهُمْ فَضَرَبَ سَعْدٌ فِي صَدْرِهِ فَقَالَ اسْكُتْ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله
 عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏
"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْعَبْدَ التَّقِيَّ الْغَنِيَّ الْخَفِيَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
55.en: It is reported on the authority of Amir b. Sa'd that Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas was in the fold of his camels that his son 'Umar came to him. When Sa'd saw him he said: I seek refuge with Allah from the mischief of this rider. And as he got down he said to him: You are busy with your camels and your sheep and you have abandoned people who are contending with one another for kingdom. Sa'd struck his chest and said: Keep quite. I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Allah loves the servant who is God-conscious and is free from want and is hidden (from the view of people).
55.hi: Amir bin Sa'd ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki gayi hai ki Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas apne oonton ke bade mein the ki unke bete Umar unke paas aaye. Jab Sa'd ne unhe dekha, unhone kaha: Main is savaar ki bura-baat se Allah ki panah maangta hoon. Aur jab woh (Umar) utre, unhone unse kaha: Aap apne oonton aur apni bhedon mein masroof hain aur aapne un logon ko chhod diya hai jo baadshaahat ke liye aapas mein jhagad rahe hain. Sa'd ne apni chhaati par thoka aur kaha: Khamosh raho. Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Allah us banda se muhabbat karta hai jo Allah ka Dar rakhta hai, zaroorat se mukt hai aur (logon ki nazron se) chhupa hua hai.

55.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ الْحَارِثِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ،
 عَنْ سَعْدٍ، ح 
 
 وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي وَابْنُ، بِشْرٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ،
 عَنْ قَيْسٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَعْدَ بْنَ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، يَقُولُ وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَوَّلُ رَجُلٍ مِنَ الْعَرَبِ رَمَى
 بِسَهْمٍ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَلَقَدْ كُنَّا نَغْزُو مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا لَنَا طَعَامٌ نَأْكُلُهُ
 إِلاَّ وَرَقُ الْحُبْلَةِ وَهَذَا السَّمُرُ حَتَّى إِنَّ أَحَدَنَا لَيَضَعُ كَمَا تَضَعُ الشَّاةُ ثُمَّ أَصْبَحَتْ بَنُو أَسَدٍ
 تُعَزِّرُنِي عَلَى الدِّينِ لَقَدْ خِبْتُ إِذًا وَضَلَّ عَمَلِي وَلَمْ يَقُلِ ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ إِذًا ‏.‏
55.en: Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas is reported to have, said: By Allah, I am the first person amongst the Arabs to throw an arrow in the cause of Allah and we used to go with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and there was no food for us to eat but only the leaves of hubla and samur trees (they are wild trees) and as a result thereof one amongst us would relieve himself as does the goat. (How strange it is) that now the people of Banu Asad (the progeny of Zubair) instruct me in religion and try to impose punishment upon me (in regard to it). If it is so (that I am so ignorant of religion), then indeed, I am undone and my deeds have been lost. Ibn Numair, however, did not make a mention of the word (idhan) thus? (in his narration).
55.hi: Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas (RA) ne bayan kiya: Allah ki qasam, main Arabon mein sabse pehla shakhs hoon jisne Allah ki raah mein teer chalaaya, aur hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath jaate the aur humaare paas khaane ke liye kuch nahi hota tha siwaay hubla aur samur (kaanTedaar jangli darakhton) ke pattoon ke, aur iske natije mein humme se koi bakri jaisa (mal) tyaag karta. (Kitni ajeeb baat hai) ki ab Banu Asad ke log (Zubair ki aulad) mujhe deen mein taalim dete hain aur mujhpar (iske baare mein) saza thopne ki koshish karte hain. Agar aisa hai (ki main deen ke baare mein itna anjaan hoon), to yaqeenan main barbaad ho gaya hoon aur mere amal barbaad ho chuke hain. Ibn Numair ne, halaanki, apni riwayat mein "idhan" lafz ka koi zikr nahi kiya.

55.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ
 وَقَالَ حَتَّى إِنْ كَانَ أَحَدُنَا لَيَضَعُ كَمَا تَضَعُ الْعَنْزُ مَا يَخْلِطُهُ بِشَىْءٍ ‏.‏
55.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Isma'il b. Khalid with the same chain of transmitters and the words are: " One amongst us would relieve himself as the goats do without anything mixing with its excrement."
55.hi: Ye hadees Ismail bin Khalid ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai (aur alfaaz hain): "Humme se koi bakriyon ki tarah tyaag karta bina kisi cheez ke uske mal mein mile."

55.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ، حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدُ بْنُ هِلاَلٍ، عَنْ 
 خَالِدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ الْعَدَوِيِّ، قَالَ خَطَبَنَا عُتْبَةُ بْنُ غَزْوَانَ فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ وَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ أَمَّا
 بَعْدُ فَإِنَّ الدُّنْيَا قَدْ آذَنَتْ بِصُرْمٍ وَوَلَّتْ حَذَّاءَ وَلَمْ يَبْقَ مِنْهَا إِلاَّ صُبَابَةٌ كَصُبَابَةِ الإِنَاءِ يَتَصَابُّهَا
 صَاحِبُهَا وَإِنَّكُمْ مُنْتَقِلُونَ مِنْهَا إِلَى دَارٍ لاَ زَوَالَ لَهَا فَانْتَقِلُوا بِخَيْرِ مَا بِحَضْرَتِكُمْ فَإِنَّهُ قَدْ
 ذُكِرَ لَنَا أَنَّ الْحَجَرَ يُلْقَى مِنْ شَفَةِ جَهَنَّمَ فَيَهْوِي فِيهَا سَبْعِينَ عَامًا لاَ يُدْرِكُ لَهَا قَعْرًا وَوَاللَّهِ
 لَتُمْلأَنَّ أَفَعَجِبْتُمْ وَلَقَدْ ذُكِرَ لَنَا أَنَّ مَا بَيْنَ مِصْرَاعَيْنِ مِنْ مَصَارِيعِ الْجَنَّةِ مَسِيرَةُ أَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةً
 وَلَيَأْتِيَنَّ عَلَيْهَا يَوْمٌ وَهُوَ كَظِيظٌ مِنَ الزِّحَامِ وَلَقَدْ رَأَيْتُنِي سَابِعَ سَبْعَةٍ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى
 الله عليه وسلم مَا لَنَا طَعَامٌ إِلاَّ وَرَقُ الشَّجَرِ حَتَّى قَرِحَتْ أَشْدَاقُنَا فَالْتَقَطْتُ بُرْدَةً فَشَقَقْتُهَا
 بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ سَعْدِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ فَاتَّزَرْتُ بِنِصْفِهَا وَاتَّزَرَ سَعْدٌ بِنِصْفِهَا فَمَا أَصْبَحَ الْيَوْمَ مِنَّا أَحَدٌ
 إِلاَّ أَصْبَحَ أَمِيرًا عَلَى مِصْرٍ مِنَ الأَمْصَارِ وَإِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ أَنْ أَكُونَ فِي نَفْسِي عَظِيمًا وَعِنْدَ
 اللَّهِ صَغِيرًا وَإِنَّهَا لَمْ تَكُنْ نُبُوَّةٌ قَطُّ إِلاَّ تَنَاسَخَتْ حَتَّى يَكُونَ آخِرُ عَاقِبَتِهَا مُلْكًا فَسَتَخْبُرُونَ
 وَتُجَرِّبُونَ الأُمَرَاءَ بَعْدَنَا ‏.‏
55.en: 'Umair al-'Adawi reported: 'Utba b. Ghazwan delivered us a sermon and he praised Allah and lauded Him, then said: Now coming to the point, verily the world has been given the news of its end and that too quite early. Nothing would be left out of it but only water left in the utensil which its owner leaves, and you are going to shift to an abode which knows no end, and you should shift with the good before you, for we have been told that a stone would be thrown at one side of the Hell and it would go down even for seventy years but would not be able to reach its bottom. By Allah, it would be fully packed. Do you find it something strange, and it has been mentioned that there yawns a distance which one would be able to cover in forty years from one end to another of Paradise, and a day would come when it would be fully packed and you must be knowing that I was the seventh amongst seven who had been with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and we had nothing to eat but the leaves of the tree until the corners of the mouth were injured. We found a sheet which we tore in two and divided between myself and Sa'd b. Malik. I made the lower garment with halt of it and so did Sa'd make the lower garment with half of it and today there is none amongst us who has not become the governor of a city from amongst the cities (of the Islamic Commonwealth) and I seek refuge with Allah that I should consider myself great whereas I am insignificant in the eye of Allah. Prophethood does not remain for ever and its impact fades with the result that it changes eventually into kingship, and you would soon come to know and experience those rulers who would come after us and see (how far they are from religion).
55.hi: Umair al-Adawi ne bayan kiya: Utba bin Ghazwan ne humein khutba diya aur Allah ki hamd ki, phir kaha: Ab humaare maqsad par aate hain, yaqeenan, duniya ko uske ant ki khabar mil chuki hai aur ye khabar bhi kaafi jaldi mili hai. Ismein se kuch nahi bachega siwaay us paani ke jo bartan mein bacha hota hai jise uska maalik chhod deta hai, aur tumhe ek aise Thikaane ki taraf badhna hai jiska koi ant nahi, aur tumhe achhaai lekar aage badhna chahiye, kyunki humein bataya gaya hai ki Jahannam ki ek taraf ek patthar phenka jaayega aur woh sattar saal tak neeche girta rahega lekin uske tal tak nahi pahunch paayega. Allah ki qasam, ye poori tarah bhar jaayegi. Kya tumhe ye hairat-angez lagta hai? Aur ye bhi kaha gaya hai ki Jannat ke ek sire se doosre sire tak itni doori phaili hui hai jise koi chaalis saal mein tay kar paayega, aur ek din aayega jab ye bhi bhar jaayegi, aur tumhe pata hona chahiye ki main saat logon mein saatvan tha jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath the aur humaare paas khaane ke liye kuch nahi tha siwaay darakht ke pattoon ke, yahan tak ki humaare munh ke konon mein zakhm ho gaye. Humein ek chaadar mili jise humne do hisson mein phaada aur mere aur Sa'd bin Malik ke beech baant liya. Maine iske aadhe hisse se apna neeche pehna jaane wala kapda banaaya aur Sa'd ne bhi apne aadhe hisse se aisa hi kiya, aur aaj humme se koi bhi aisa nahi hai jo (Islami hukumat mein) kisi shehar ka gavarnar na bana ho, aur main Allah ki panah maangta hoon ki main khud ko bada samjhoon jabki main Allah ki nazar mein bahut chhota hoon. Nabuwwat hamesha ke liye nahi rehti aur iska prabhaav dheere-dheere kam hota hai, natijatan, ye aakhirkaar baadshaahat mein badal jaati hai, aur tum jald hi un shaasakon ke baare mein jaanoge aur unka anubhav karoge jo humaare baad aayenge (aur dekhoge ki woh deen se kitne door hain).

55.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ سَلِيطٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ، حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدُ بْنُ،
 هِلاَلٍ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، وَقَدْ أَدْرَكَ الْجَاهِلِيَّةَ قَالَ خَطَبَ عُتْبَةُ بْنُ غَزْوَانَ وَكَانَ أَمِيرًا
 عَلَى الْبَصْرَةِ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ شَيْبَانَ ‏.‏
55.en: Khalid b. 'Umair reported and he had seen the pre-Islamic days also, that 'Uqba b. Ghazwan delivered this address and he was the governor of Basra. The rest of the hadith is the same as transmitted by Shaiban.
55.hi: Khalid bin Umair, jinhone Islam se pehle ka daur bhi dekha tha, ne bayan kiya ki Uqba bin Ghazwan ne ye khutba diya aur woh Basra ke gavarnar the. Baaki hadees waisi hi hai jaisi Shaiban ne riwayat ki.

55.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ قُرَّةَ بْنِ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ،
 بْنِ هِلاَلٍ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُتْبَةَ بْنَ غَزْوَانَ، يَقُولُ لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُنِي سَابِعَ سَبْعَةٍ
 مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا طَعَامُنَا إِلاَّ وَرَقُ الْحُبْلَةِ حَتَّى قَرِحَتْ أَشْدَاقُنَا ‏.‏
55.en: Khalid b. Umair reported: I heard Uqba b. Ghazwan as saving: I found myself as the seventh amongst the seven who had been along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). We had nothing to eat but the leaves of hubla (a wild tree) until the corners of our mouths were injured.
55.hi: Khalid bin Umair ne bayan kiya: Maine Uqba bin Ghazwan ko ye kehte suna: Main saat logon mein saatvan tha jo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath the. Humaare paas khaane ke liye kuch nahi tha siwaay hubla (ek jangli darakht) ke pattoon ke, yahan tak ki humaare munh ke konon mein zakhm ho gaye.

55.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ 
 أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَلْ نَرَى رَبَّنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ قَالَ ‏"‏ هَلْ تُضَارُّونَ فِي
 رُؤْيَةِ الشَّمْسِ فِي الظَّهِيرَةِ لَيْسَتْ فِي سَحَابَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا لاَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَهَلْ تُضَارُّونَ فِي
 رُؤْيَةِ الْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ الْبَدْرِ لَيْسَ فِي سَحَابَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا لاَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَوَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لاَ تُضَارُّونَ
 فِي رُؤْيَةِ رَبِّكُمْ إِلاَّ كَمَا تُضَارُّونَ فِي رُؤْيَةِ أَحَدِهِمَا - قَالَ - فَيَلْقَى الْعَبْدَ فَيَقُولُ أَىْ فُلْ
 أَلَمْ أُكْرِمْكَ وَأُسَوِّدْكَ وَأُزَوِّجْكَ وَأُسَخِّرْ لَكَ الْخَيْلَ وَالإِبِلَ وَأَذَرْكَ تَرْأَسُ وَتَرْبَعُ فَيَقُولُ بَلَى
 ‏.‏ قَالَ فَيَقُولُ أَفَظَنَنْتَ أَنَّكَ مُلاَقِيَّ فَيَقُولُ لاَ ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ فَإِنِّي أَنْسَاكَ كَمَا نَسِيتَنِي ‏.‏ ثُمَّ يَلْقَى
 الثَّانِيَ فَيَقُولُ أَىْ فُلْ أَلَمْ أُكْرِمْكَ وَأُسَوِّدْكَ وَأُزَوِّجْكَ وَأُسَخِّرْ لَكَ الْخَيْلَ وَالإِبِلَ وَأَذَرْكَ تَرْأَسُ
 وَتَرْبَعُ فَيَقُولُ بَلَى أَىْ رَبِّ ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ أَفَظَنَنْتَ أَنَّكَ مُلاَقِيَّ فَيَقُولُ لاَ ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ فَإِنِّي أَنْسَاكَ
 كَمَا نَسِيتَنِي ‏.‏ ثُمَّ يَلْقَى الثَّالِثَ فَيَقُولُ لَهُ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ فَيَقُولُ يَا رَبِّ آمَنْتُ بِكَ وَبِكِتَابِكَ وَبِرُسُلِكَ
 وَصَلَّيْتُ وَصُمْتُ وَتَصَدَّقْتُ ‏.‏ وَيُثْنِي بِخَيْرٍ مَا اسْتَطَاعَ فَيَقُولُ هَا هُنَا إِذًا - قَالَ - ثُمَّ يُقَالُ
 لَهُ الآنَ نَبْعَثُ شَاهِدَنَا عَلَيْكَ ‏.‏ وَيَتَفَكَّرُ فِي نَفْسِهِ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْهَدُ عَلَىَّ فَيُخْتَمُ عَلَى فِيهِ
 وَيُقَالُ لِفَخِذِهِ وَلَحْمِهِ وَعِظَامِهِ انْطِقِي فَتَنْطِقُ فَخِذُهُ وَلَحْمُهُ وَعِظَامُهُ بِعَمَلِهِ وَذَلِكَ لِيُعْذِرَ مِنْ
 نَفْسِهِ ‏.‏ وَذَلِكَ الْمُنَافِقُ وَذَلِكَ الَّذِي يَسْخَطُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
55.en: Abu Huraira reported that they (the Companions of the Holy Prophet) said: Allah's Messenger, will we be able to see our Lord on the Day of Judgment? He said: Do you feel any difficulty in seeing the sun in the noon when there is no cloud over it? They said: No. He again said: Do you feel any difficulty in seeing the moon on the fourteenth night when there is no cloud over it? They said: No. Thereupon he said: By Allah Who is One in Whose Hand is my life. you will not face any difficulty in seeing your Lord but only so much as you feel in seeing one of them. Then Allah would sit in judgment upon the servant and would say: O, so and so, did I not honour you and make you the chief and provide you the spouse and subdue for you horses, camels, and afforded you an opportunity to rule over your subjects? He would say: Yes. And then it would be said: Did you not think that you would meet Us? And he would say: No. Thereupon He (Allah) would say: Well, We forget you as you forgot Us. Then the second person would be brought for judgment. (And Allah would) say: 0, so and so. did We not honour you and make you the chief and make you pair and subdue for you horses and camels and afford you an opportunity to rule over your subjects? He would say: Yes, my Lord. And He (the Lord) would say: Did you not think that you would be meeting Us? And he would say: No. And then He (Allah) would say: Well, I forget you today as you forgot Us. Then the third -one would be brought and He (Allah) would say to him as He said before. And he (the third person) would say: O, my Lord, I affirmed my faith in Thee and in Thy Book and in Thy Messenger and I observed prayer and fasts and gave charity, and he would speak in good terms like this as he would be able to do. And He (Allah) would say: Well, We will bring our witnesses to you. And the man would think in his mind who would bear witness upon him and then his mouth would be sealed and it would be said to his thighs, to his flesh and to his bones to speak and his thighs. flesh and bones would bear witness to his deeds and it would be done so that he should not be able to make any excuse for himself and he would be a hypocrite and Allah would be annoyed with him.
55.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne bayan kiya ki unhone (Pavitr Nabi ke Sahaba ne) kaha: Allah ke Rasool, kya hum Qayamat ke din apne Rab ko dekh paayenge? Unhone farmaaya: Kya tumhe dopahar ke waqt suraj dekhne mein koi mushkil hoti hai jab uspar koi baadal na ho? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Unhone phir kaha: Kya tumhe chaudhvin raat ko chaand dekhne mein koi mushkil hoti hai jab uspar koi baadal na ho? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Isper unhone farmaaya: Us Hasti ki qasam Jo Akeli hai aur Jiske Haath mein meri zindagi hai, tumhe apne Rab ko dekhne mein koi mushkil nahi hogi, siwaay itni jitni tumhe inmein se ek ko dekhne mein hoti hai. Phir Allah banda ka hisaab lenge aur farmaayenge: Aye falan-falan, kya Maine tumhe izzat nahi di aur tumhe sardaar nahi banaya aur tumhe zauja nahi di aur ghode aur oont tumhaare adheen nahi kiye aur tumhe apni praja par raaj karne ka mauka nahi diya? Woh kahega: Zaroor. Aur phir kaha jaayega: Kya tumne ye nahi socha tha ki tum Humse miloge? Aur woh kahega: Nahi. Isper Woh (Allah) farmaayenge: Achha, Hum tumhe bhula denge jaise tumne Humein bhula diya tha. Phir doosre shakhs ko hisaab ke liye laaya jaayega. (Aur Allah farmaayenge) Aye falan-falan, kya Humne tumhe izzat nahi di aur tumhe sardaar nahi banaya aur tumhe zauja nahi di aur ghode aur oont tumhaare adheen nahi kiye aur tumhe apni praja par raaj karne ka mauka nahi diya? Woh kahega: Haan, mere Rab. Aur Woh (Rab) farmaayenge: Kya tumne ye nahi socha ki tum Humse miloge? Aur woh kahega: Nahi. Aur phir Woh (Allah) farmaayenge: Achha, Main tumhe aaj bhula deta hoon jaise tumne Humein bhula diya tha. Phir teesra shakhs laaya jaayega aur Woh (Allah) usse wahi kahenge jo pehle kaha tha. Aur woh (teesra shakhs) kahega: Aye mere Rab, maine Tujhpar aur Teri Kitaab par aur Tere Rasool par apna imaan pushT kiya aur main namaz padhta tha, roze rakhta tha aur sadaqa deta tha, aur woh achhe alfaazon mein baat karega jitna woh kar sakega. Aur Woh (Allah) farmaayenge: Achha, Hum tumhaare khilaaf Apne gawaah laayenge. Aur woh shakhs (khud se) sochega ki kaun uske khilaaf gawaahi dega, aur uska munh band kar diya jaayega aur uski jaanghon, uske gosht aur uski haddiyon se kaha jaayega ki woh bolein aur uski jaanghen, gosht aur haddiyaan uske amalon ki gawaahi denge, aur ye is tarah kiya jaayega taaki woh khud ke liye koi bahaana na de paaye aur woh ek munafiq hoga aur Allah usse naaraaz honge.

55.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ النَّضْرِ بْنِ أَبِي النَّضْرِ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو النَّضْرِ، هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ
 حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ الأَشْجَعِيُّ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ الثَّوْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدٍ الْمُكْتِبِ، عَنْ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ،
 عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَضَحِكَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَلْ
 تَدْرُونَ مِمَّ أَضْحَكُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْنَا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ مِنْ مُخَاطَبَةِ الْعَبْدِ رَبَّهُ يَقُولُ
 يَا رَبِّ أَلَمْ تُجِرْنِي مِنَ الظُّلْمِ قَالَ يَقُولُ بَلَى ‏.‏ قَالَ فَيَقُولُ فَإِنِّي لاَ أُجِيزُ عَلَى نَفْسِي إِلاَّ
 شَاهِدًا مِنِّي قَالَ فَيَقُولُ كَفَى بِنَفْسِكَ الْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكَ شَهِيدًا وَبِالْكِرَامِ الْكَاتِبِينَ شُهُودًا - قَالَ
 - فَيُخْتَمُ عَلَى فِيهِ فَيُقَالُ لأَرْكَانِهِ انْطِقِي ‏.‏ قَالَ فَتَنْطِقُ بِأَعْمَالِهِ - قَالَ - ثُمَّ يُخَلَّى بَيْنَهُ
 وَبَيْنَ الْكَلاَمِ - قَالَ - فَيَقُولُ بُعْدًا لَكُنَّ وَسُحْقًا ‏.‏ فَعَنْكُنَّ كُنْتُ أُنَاضِلُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
55.en: Anas b. Malik reported: We were in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) when he smiled, and said: Do you know why I laughed? We said: Allah and His Messenger, know best. Thereupon he said: It was because (there came to my mind the) talk which the servant would have with his Lord (on the Day of judgment). He would say: My Lord, have you not guaranteed me protection against injustice? He would say: Yes. Then the servant would say: I do not deem valid any witness against me but my own self, and He would say: Well, enough would be the witness of your self against you and that of the two angels who had been appointed to record your deeds. Then the seal would be set upon his mouth and it would be said to his hands and feet to speak and they would speak of his deeds. Then the mouth would be made free to talk, he would say (to the hands and feet): Be away, let there be curse of Allah upon you. It was for your safety that I contended.
55.hi: Anas bin Malik (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki sohbat mein the jab woh muskuraaye aur kaha: Kya tumhe pata hai maine kyun hansi? Humne kaha: Allah aur Uska Rasool behtar jaante hain. Isper unhone farmaaya: (Ye is baat ki wajah se tha ki mere zehan mein aayi) woh baatchit jo banda apne Rab se (Qayamat ke din) karega. Woh kahega: Mere Rab, kya Aapne mujhe anyaay se hifaazat ka bharosa nahi diya? Woh farmaayenge: Zaroor. Phir banda kahega: Main apne khud ke siwaay kisi aur ki gawaahi mahatva nahi deta jo mere khilaaf ho. Aur Woh farmaayenge: Achha, tumhaari khud ki gawaahi tumhaare khilaaf kaafi hai, aur do Farishton ki bhi jinhe tumhaare amal darj karne ke liye muqarrar kiya gaya tha. Phir uske munh par muhur laga di jaayegi aur uske haathon aur paeron se kaha jaayega ki woh bolein aur woh uske amalon ke baare mein bolenge. Phir munh ko bolne ke liye azaad kar diya jaayega, woh (haath-paeron se) kahega: Door raho, tumpar Allah ki laanat ho. Tumhaari hi hifaazat ke liye to main jhagad raha tha.

55.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ الْقَعْقَاعِ،
 عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
"‏ اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ
 رِزْقَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ قُوتًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
55.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: O Allah, make for the family of Muhammad the provision which is a bare subsistence.
55.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Aye Allah, Muhammad ke khaandaan ke liye itni hi rozi kar jitni bas zaroorat poori kar sake.

55.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالُوا
 حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ الْقَعْقَاعِ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ
 قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ رِزْقَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ قُوتًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ
 عَمْرٍو ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
55.en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: 0 Allah, provide for the, family of Muhammad their subsistence, and in the narration transmitted on the authority of 'Amr (the words are):" O Allah, provide us subsistence"
55.hi: Abu Huraira (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Aye Allah, Muhammad ke khaandaan ke liye unki rozi mahaiyaa kar, aur Amr ki riwayat ki hui hadees mein alfaaz hain: "Aye Allah, humein rozi de."

55.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الأَعْمَشَ، ذَكَرَ عَنْ عُمَارَةَ،
 بْنِ الْقَعْقَاعِ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ ‏
"‏ كَفَافًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
55.en: 'Umara b. al-Qa'qa' reported this hadith with the same chain of transmitters but instead of the word" qut" (bare subsistence) there has been used the word" Kafaf" (adequate means to meet the needs).
55.hi: Umara bin Qa'qa ne ye hadees isi sanad se riwayat ki hai lekin "Qut" (bas zaroorat poori karne wali rozi) lafz ki jagah "Kafaf" (zaroorton ko poora karne ke liye kaafi saadhan) lafz istemal kiya gaya hai.

55.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ، زُهَيْرٌ
 حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ مَا شَبِعَ آلُ مُحَمَّدٍ
 صلى الله عليه وسلم مُنْذُ قَدِمَ الْمَدِينَةَ مِنْ طَعَامِ بُرٍّ ثَلاَثَ لَيَالٍ تِبَاعًا حَتَّى قُبِضَ ‏.‏
55.en: 'A'isha reported: Never had the family of Muhammad (ﷺ) eaten to the fill since their, arrival in Medina with the bread of wheat for three successive nights until his (Holy Prophet's) death.
55.hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Madina aane ke baad se Muhammad (SAW) ke khaandaan ne kabhi lagataar teen raaton tak gehun ki roti pet bharkar nahi khayi, unki maut tak.

55.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ
 أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ،
 قَالَتْ مَا شَبِعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ تِبَاعًا مِنْ خُبْزِ بُرٍّ حَتَّى مَضَى
 لِسَبِيلِهِ ‏.‏
55.en: 'A'isha reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Never did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) eat to his fill the bread of wheat for three successive days until he had run the course of his life.
55.hi: Aisha (RA) ne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kabhi lagataar teen dinon tak gehun ki roti pet bharkar nahi khayi, apne zindagi ke daur mein.

55.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ،
 عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ يَزِيدَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا
 قَالَتْ مَا شَبِعَ آلُ مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ خُبْزِ شَعِيرٍ يَوْمَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ حَتَّى قُبِضَ
 رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
55.en: 'A'isha reported: Never did the family of Muhammad (ﷺ) eat to the fill the bread of barley for two successive days until Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died.
55.hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Muhammad (SAW) ke khaandaan ne kabhi lagataar do dinon tak jau ki roti pet bharkar nahi khayi, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki wafat tak.

55.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَابِسٍ،
 عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ مَا شَبِعَ آلُ مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ خُبْزِ بُرٍّ فَوْقَ ثَلاَثٍ
 ‏.‏
55.en: 'A'isha reported: Never could the family of Muhammad (ﷺ) (afford to eat to the fill) the bread of wheat beyond three days (successively).
55.hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Muhammad (SAW) ke khaandaan ne kabhi teen dinon se zyada gehun ki roti pet bharkar nahi khayi (lagataar).

55.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ 
 أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ مَا شَبِعَ آلُ مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ خُبْزِ الْبُرِّ ثَلاَثًا حَتَّى
 مَضَى لِسَبِيلِهِ ‏.‏
55.en: 'A'isha reported: Never could the family of Muhammad (may peace. be upon him) (afford to eat) the bread of wheat for three (successive days) until he ran the course of his life.
55.hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Muhammad (SAW) ke khaandaan ko kabhi lagataar teen dinon tak (khaane ko) gehun ki roti nahi mili, unki poori zindagi mein.

55.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ مِسْعَرٍ، عَنْ هِلاَلِ بْنِ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ 
 عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ مَا شَبِعَ آلُ مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَيْنِ مِنْ خُبْزِ بُرٍّ إِلاَّ وَأَحَدُهُمَا
 تَمْرٌ ‏.‏
55.en: 'A'isha reported: Never could the family of Muhammad (ﷺ) (afford to eat) the bread of wheat for two days successively. Even (out of these two days) one (was such wherein he could get) only a date.
55.hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Muhammad (SAW) ke khaandaan ko kabhi lagataar do dinon tak (khaane ko) gehun ki roti nahi mili. In do dinon mein se ek din bhi sirf ek khajoor hi mili.

55.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، قَالَ وَيَحْيَى بْنُ يَمَانٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَنْ 
 هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ إِنْ كُنَّا آلَ مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَنَمْكُثُ
 شَهْرًا مَا نَسْتَوْقِدُ بِنَارٍ إِنْ هُوَ إِلاَّ التَّمْرُ وَالْمَاءُ ‏.‏
55.en: 'A'isha reported: We the family of Muhammad (ﷺ) used to spend (the whole) month in which we (did not need to) kindle the fire as (we had nothing to cook) ; we had only dates and water (to fill our bellies).
55.hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya: Hum, Muhammad (SAW) ke khaandaan, poora mahina bina aag jalaaye guzaarte (kyunki humaare paas pakaane ko kuch nahi hota); humaare paas sirf khajoor aur paani hota (pet bharne ke liye).

55.ar:
وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ عَنْ 
 هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ إِنْ كُنَّا لَنَمْكُثُ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ آلَ مُحَمَّدٍ ‏.‏ وَزَادَ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ فِي
 حَدِيثِهِ عَنِ ابْنِ نُمَيْرٍ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَأْتِيَنَا اللُّحَيْمُ ‏.‏
55.en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Urwa with the same chain of transmitters (and the words are): " We used to spend-" And he did not make a mention of the family of Muhammad (ﷺ), and Abu Kuraib made this addition to his hadith which was transmitted on the authority of Ibn Numair (and the words are):" But this that there was brought to us some meat."
55.hi: Ye hadees Urwa ki sanad se isi sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai (aur alfaaz hain): "Hum guzaarte the." Aur unhone Muhammad (SAW) ke khaandaan ka koi zikr nahi kiya, aur Abu Kuraib ne apni hadees mein ye izafa kiya jo unhone Ibn Numair ki sanad se riwayat ki: "Lekin kabhi hume gosht mil jaata."

55.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ بْنِ كُرَيْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ 
 أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ تُوُفِّيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَمَا فِي رَفِّي مِنْ شَىْءٍ يَأْكُلُهُ
 ذُو كَبِدٍ إِلاَّ شَطْرُ شَعِيرٍ فِي رَفٍّ لِي فَأَكَلْتُ مِنْهُ حَتَّى طَالَ عَلَىَّ فَكِلْتُهُ فَفَنِيَ ‏.‏
55.en: `A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died (in such a state) that there had been nothing in my wooden tub which a living being could afford to eat but a handful of barley. I had been eating out of that for a fairly long duration when I thought of measuring it and it was almost finished.
55.hi: Aisha (RA) ne bayan kiya ki Allah ke Rasool (SAW) is haalat mein guzar gaye ki mere lakdi ke bartan mein koi bhi zinda insaan khaa sakne laayak sirf ek muTThi jau tha. Main kaafi lambe waqt tak usmein se khaati rahi yahan tak ki maine socha ki ise naap loon aur woh takriban khatm ho chuka tha.

55.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ،
 رُومَانَ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ تَقُولُ وَاللَّهِ يَا ابْنَ أُخْتِي إِنْ كُنَّا لَنَنْظُرُ إِلَى الْهِلاَلِ
 ثُمَّ الْهِلاَلِ ثُمَّ الْهِلاَلِ ثَلاَثَةَ أَهِلَّةٍ فِي شَهْرَيْنِ وَمَا أُوقِدَ فِي أَبْيَاتِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم نَارٌ - قَالَ - قُلْتُ يَا خَالَةُ فَمَا كَانَ يُعَيِّشُكُمْ قَالَتِ الأَسْوَدَانِ التَّمْرُ وَالْمَاءُ إِلاَّ أَنَّهُ
 قَدْ كَانَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم جِيرَانٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ وَكَانَتْ لَهُمْ مَنَائِحُ فَكَانُوا
 يُرْسِلُونَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ أَلْبَانِهَا فَيَسْقِينَاهُ ‏.‏
55.en: 'A'isha used to say to 'Urwa: Son of my sister, by Allah, I used to see the new moon, then the new moon, then the new moon, i. e. three moons in two months, and fire was not kindled in the house of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). I ('Urwa) said: Auntie, then what were your means of sustenance? She said: Dates and water. But it (so happened) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had some Ansar as his neighbours and they had milch animals and they used to send to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) some milk of their (animals) and he served that to us.
55.hi: Aisha (RA) Urwa se kaha karti thin: Mere behn ke bete, Allah ki qasam, maine naya chaand dekha, phir naya chaand, phir naya chaand, yaani do mahinon mein teen chaand, aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke ghar mein aag nahi jalaayi jaati thi. Maine (Urwa ne) kaha: Chachi, phir aapki rozi ka zariya kya tha? Unhone kaha: Khajoor aur paani. Lekin (ye bhi hua ki) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke kuch Ansar padosi the aur unke paas doodh dene wale jaanwar the aur woh Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas unka kuch doodh bhejte the aur woh humein pila dete the.

55.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَحْمَدُ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو صَخْرٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ،
 بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ قُسَيْطٍ ح وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو صَخْرٍ،
 عَنِ ابْنِ قُسَيْطٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ
 لَقَدْ مَاتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَمَا شَبِعَ مِنْ خُبْزٍ وَزَيْتٍ فِي يَوْمٍ وَاحِدٍ مَرَّتَيْنِ
 ‏.‏
55.en: 'Urwa b. Zubair reported on the authority of 'A'isha, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), that she said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died (in a state) that it never happened that he could eat to his fill the bread with olive oil twice during a day.
55.hi: Urwa bin Zubair ne Aisha (RA), Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki zauja, ke hawaale se ye riwayat ki ki unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) is haalat mein guzar gaye ki aisa kabhi nahi hua ki unhone din mein do baar zaitun ke tel ke saath roti pet bharkar khayi ho.

55.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْمَكِّيُّ الْعَطَّارُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ،
 عَنْ أُمِّهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، ح 
 
 وَحَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْعَطَّارُ، حَدَّثَنِي مَنْصُورُ،
 بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحَجَبِيُّ عَنْ أُمِّهِ، صَفِيَّةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ تُوُفِّيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه
 وسلم حِينَ شَبِعَ النَّاسُ مِنَ الأَسْوَدَيْنِ التَّمْرِ وَالْمَاءِ ‏.‏
55.en: 'A'isha reported this hadith through other chains of transmitters also (and the words are) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died (in a state) when the people could afford to eat only the dates and water.
